conversations.title: Ordering at a café: coffee and a sandwich

partner.en: Hello! What would you like to drink?

learner.hr: Dobar dan! Molim jednu kavu.
learner.en: Hello! I'd like a coffee, please.

partner.hr: Želite li i nešto za jelo?
partner.en: Would you like something to eat as well?

learner.hr: Da, uzet ću sendvič.
learner.en: Yes, I'll have a sandwich.

partner.en: To have here or to take away?

learner.hr: Za ovdje. Sjest ću kraj prozora.
learner.en: To have here. I'll sit by the window.

partner.hr: U redu. Trebate li račun odmah?
partner.en: All right. Do you need the bill now?

learner.hr: Može poslije, hvala. Čekam prijatelja.
learner.en: Later is fine, thank you. I'm waiting for a friend.

partner.en: Another glass of water?

learner.hr: Da, molim. Baš je vruće danas.
learner.en: Yes, please. It's really hot today.

partner.en: I'll bring everything to your table.

learner.hr: Hvala vam. Ovdje je baš ugodno.
learner.en: Thank you. It's really pleasant here.

partner.en: Are you ready to order?

learner.hr: Da, želim ribu s roštilja i krumpir.

learner.hr: Ne, glavno jelo će biti dovoljno.

partner.en: Would you like anything else?

learner.hr: Da, i pola kilograma krušaka.

partner.en: Do you have your own bag?

learner.hr: Imam torbu, ne treba nova vrećica.

partner.en: Then enjoy your meal!

learner.hr: Hvala! Sve izgleda svježe i lijepo.

partner.en: See you again!

learner.hr: Svakako. Ugodan vam dan!

conversations.title: Choosing clothes: a shirt

partner.en: Can I help you?

learner.hr: Tražim plavu košulju.
learner.en: I'm looking for a blue shirt.

partner.en: What size do you need?

learner.hr: Obično nosim veličinu M.
learner.en: I usually wear a medium.

partner.en: The fitting room is on the left.

learner.hr: Hvala. Mogu li ovo isprobati?
learner.en: Thank you. Can I try this on?

partner.en: How does it fit?

learner.hr: Dobro je, ali želim usporediti s drugim modelom.
learner.en: It's good, but I'd like to compare it with another style.

partner.en: I'll bring you another one.

learner.hr: Odlično. Ne žurim, imam vremena.
learner.en: Great. I'm not in a hurry; I have time.

partner.en: Have you decided?

learner.hr: Da, uzet ću prvi model.
learner.en: Yes, I'll take the first style.

conversations.title: A stop at the bakery: bread rolls

partner.en: Good morning! What would you like?

learner.hr: Dobro jutro! Molim dva peciva.
learner.en: Good morning! I'd like two bread rolls, please.

partner.en: Would you like me to wrap it up?

learner.hr: Da, nosim kući za doručak.
learner.en: Yes, I'm taking it home for breakfast.

partner.en: Do you need anything else?

learner.hr: Imate li i integralni kruh?
learner.en: Do you also have wholemeal bread?

partner.en: We do; it's on the top shelf.

learner.hr: Onda ću uzeti i jedan mali kruh.
learner.en: Then I'll take a small loaf as well.

partner.en: Would you like it sliced?

learner.hr: Da, molim. Tako mi je lakše.
learner.en: Yes, please. That's easier for me.

partner.en: Here you are; everything is ready.

learner.hr: Hvala i doviđenja!
learner.en: Thank you and goodbye!

conversations.title: Asking for directions: the station

partner.en: Excuse me, do you need help?

learner.hr: Da, kako mogu doći do kolodvora?
learner.en: Yes, how can I get to the station?

partner.en: Go straight ahead to the traffic lights.

learner.hr: Trebam li tamo skrenuti?
learner.en: Do I need to turn there?

partner.hr: Da, skrenite lijevo pa nastavite uz park.
partner.en: Yes, turn left and then continue alongside the park.

learner.hr: Je li daleko odavde?
learner.en: Is it far from here?

partner.en: About ten minutes on foot.

learner.hr: Odlično, onda ću prošetati.
learner.en: Great, then I'll walk.

partner.hr: Vidjet ćete veliki natpis na ulazu.
partner.en: You'll see a large sign at the entrance.

learner.hr: Dobro, pazit ću na natpis.
learner.en: All right, I'll look out for the sign.

partner.en: Have a good journey!

learner.hr: Puno vam hvala na pomoći.
learner.en: Thank you very much for your help.

conversations.title: Buying a bus ticket: Zagreb

partner.en: Hello! Where are you travelling?

learner.hr: Trebam jednu kartu za Zagreb.
learner.en: I need a ticket to Zagreb.

partner.hr: Za danas ili za drugi dan?
partner.en: For today or another day?

learner.hr: Za danas, ako još ima mjesta.
learner.en: For today, if there are still seats available.

partner.hr: Sljedeći autobus polazi za pola sata.
partner.en: The next bus leaves in half an hour.

learner.hr: To mi odgovara. Je li vožnja izravna?
learner.en: That suits me. Is it a direct service?

partner.en: Yes, you don't need to change buses.

learner.hr: Mogu li ponijeti ovaj veliki kovčeg?
learner.en: Can I bring this large suitcase?

partner.en: Yes, the driver will put it in the luggage compartment.

learner.hr: Dobro. S kojeg perona polazimo?
learner.en: All right. Which platform do we leave from?

partner.en: From platform three.

learner.hr: Hvala, idem tamo pričekati.
learner.en: Thank you; I'll go and wait there.

conversations.title: Booking a room: one night

partner.hr: Dobar dan, recepcija. Kako vam mogu pomoći?
partner.en: Hello, reception. How can I help you?

learner.hr: Želim rezervirati sobu na jednu noć.
learner.en: I'd like to book a room for one night.

partner.en: For how many people?

learner.hr: Za dvije odrasle osobe.
learner.en: For two adults.

partner.hr: Želite li bračni krevet ili odvojene krevete?
partner.en: Would you like a double bed or separate beds?

learner.hr: Molim dva odvojena kreveta.
learner.en: Two separate beds, please.

partner.en: Breakfast is included in the price.

learner.hr: Odlično. Ima li soba balkon?
learner.en: Great. Does the room have a balcony?

partner.en: Yes, the balcony overlooks the garden.

learner.hr: To zvuči lijepo. Dolazimo navečer.
learner.en: That sounds lovely. We'll arrive in the evening.

partner.en: We'll send you a booking confirmation.

learner.hr: Hvala, provjerit ću poruke.
learner.en: Thank you; I'll check my messages.

learner.en: Thank you; I'll check my messages.

conversations.title: Arriving before check-in

partner.en: Welcome! Do you have a booking?

learner.hr: Da, ali dolazimo malo prije vremena.
learner.en: Yes, but we're arriving a little early.

partner.en: The room is not ready yet.

learner.hr: Možemo li ovdje ostaviti prtljagu?
learner.en: Can we leave our luggage here?

partner.en: Of course; we have a space for that.

learner.hr: Odlično, onda ćemo otići u šetnju.
learner.en: Great; then we'll go for a walk.

partner.en: Would you like a map of the town?

learner.hr: Da, molim. Još ne poznajemo ovaj dio.
learner.en: Yes, please. We don't know this area yet.

partner.hr: Nazvat ćemo vas kad soba bude spremna.
partner.en: We'll call you when the room is ready.

learner.hr: Hvala, ostavit ću vam broj mobitela.
learner.en: Thank you; I'll leave you my mobile number.

partner.en: Enjoy your walk!

learner.hr: Hvala, vidimo se poslijepodne.
learner.en: Thank you; see you this afternoon.

conversations.title: Checking in late at night

partner.hr: Dobro došli! Put je bio dug?
partner.en: Welcome! Was it a long journey?

learner.hr: Jest, autobus je kasnio gotovo dva sata.
learner.en: Yes; the bus was almost two hours late.

partner.hr: Soba vas čeka. Molim osobnu iskaznicu.
partner.en: Your room is waiting. Your identity card, please.

learner.hr: Izvolite. Možemo li se odmah smjestiti?
learner.en: Here you are. Can we settle in straight away?

partner.en: Yes; I just need your signature.

learner.hr: Naravno. Je li restoran još otvoren?
learner.en: Of course. Is the restaurant still open?

partner.hr: Nažalost, zatvoren je, ali možete naručiti sendvič.
partner.en: Unfortunately it's closed, but you can order a sandwich.

learner.en: See you! We'll have lunch together afterwards.

conversations.title: Sharing family news: a wedding

partner.en: How is your family?

learner.hr: Dobro smo. Brat se uskoro ženi.
learner.en: We're well. My brother is getting married soon.

partner.hr: Baš lijepa vijest! Kako se osjećaš?
partner.en: What lovely news! How do you feel?

learner.hr: Veselim se, ali imamo puno priprema.
learner.en: I'm excited, but we have a lot to prepare.

partner.en: Do you need any help?

learner.hr: Dobro bi nam došla pomoć oko organizacije.
learner.en: Some help with organising would be useful.

partner.en: I can come on Saturday.

learner.hr: Hvala ti. To nam mnogo znači.
learner.en: Thank you. That means a lot to us.

partner.hr: Poslat ćeš mi što treba napraviti?
partner.en: Will you send me what needs doing?

learner.hr: Hoću, napisat ću kratak popis.
learner.en: I will; I'll write a short list.

partner.en: Then I'll see you at the weekend.

learner.hr: Vidimo se! Poslije ćemo zajedno ručati.
learner.en: See you! We'll have lunch together afterwards.

conversations.title: Sharing family news: a visit

partner.en: How is your family?

learner.hr: Dobro smo. Dolaze nam rođaci iz inozemstva.
learner.en: We're well. Our relatives are visiting from abroad.

partner.hr: Baš lijepa vijest! Kako se osjećaš?
partner.en: What lovely news! How do you feel?

learner.hr: Veselim se, ali imamo puno priprema.
learner.en: I'm excited, but we have a lot to prepare.

partner.en: Do you need any help?

learner.hr: Dobro bi nam došla pomoć oko organizacije.
learner.en: Some help with organising would be useful.

partner.en: I can come on Saturday.

learner.hr: Hvala ti. To nam mnogo znači.
learner.en: Thank you. That means a lot to us.

partner.hr: Poslat ćeš mi što treba napraviti?
partner.en: Will you send me what needs doing?

learner.hr: Hoću, napisat ću kratak popis.
learner.en: I will; I'll write a short list.

partner.en: Then I'll see you at the weekend.

learner.hr: Vidimo se! Poslije ćemo zajedno ručati.
learner.en: See you! We'll have lunch together afterwards.

conversations.title: Looking for a lost item: a wallet

partner.en: What are you looking for?

learner.hr: Ne mogu pronaći novčanik.
learner.en: I can't find my wallet.

partner.hr: Gdje si to zadnji put vidio?
partner.en: Where did you last see it?

learner.hr: Mislim da je bio na stolu u kuhinji.
learner.en: I think it was on the kitchen table.

partner.en: Have you checked your bag?

learner.hr: Jesam, ali pogledat ću još jednom.
learner.en: I have, but I'll look again.

partner.en: Perhaps it's under the newspaper.

learner.hr: Imaš pravo, nisam tamo provjerio.
learner.en: You're right; I didn't check there.

partner.en: Can you see it now?

learner.hr: Da, tu je! Kako mi je to promaknulo?
learner.en: Yes, here it is! How did I miss it?

partner.en: It happens to everyone.

learner.hr: Hvala na pomoći. Sad mogu krenuti.
learner.en: Thank you for your help. Now I can leave.

conversations.title: Looking for a lost item: a phone

partner.en: What are you looking for?

learner.hr: Ne mogu pronaći mobitel.
learner.en: I can't find my phone.

partner.hr: Gdje si to zadnji put vidio?
partner.en: Where did you last see it?

learner.hr: Mislim da je bio na stolu u kuhinji.
learner.en: I think it was on the kitchen table.

partner.en: Have you checked your bag?

learner.hr: Jesam, ali pogledat ću još jednom. Zovi moj broj, molim te. Ako zvoni, lakše ću ga naći.
learner.en: I have, but I'll look again. Call my number, please. If it rings, I'll find it more easily.

partner.en: I can hear it somewhere near the newspapers.

learner.hr: Imaš pravo, nisam tamo provjerio.
learner.en: You're right; I didn't check there.

partner.en: Can you see it now?

learner.hr: Da, tu je! Kako mi je to promaknulo?
learner.en: Yes, here it is! How did I miss it?

partner.en: It happens to everyone.

learner.hr: Hvala na pomoći. Sad mogu krenuti.
learner.en: Thank you for your help. Now I can leave.

conversations.title: Looking for a lost item: a passport

partner.en: What are you looking for?

learner.hr: Ne mogu pronaći putovnicu.
learner.en: I can't find my passport.

partner.hr: Gdje si to zadnji put vidio?
partner.en: Where did you last see it?

learner.hr: Mislim da je bila na stolu u kuhinji.
learner.en: I think it was on the kitchen table.

partner.en: Have you checked your bag?

learner.hr: Jesam, ali pogledat ću još jednom.
learner.en: I have, but I'll look again.

partner.en: Perhaps it's under the newspaper.

learner.hr: Imaš pravo, nisam tamo provjerio.
learner.en: You're right; I didn't check there.

partner.en: Can you see it now?

learner.hr: Da, tu je! Kako mi je to promaknulo?
learner.en: Yes, here it is! How did I miss it?

partner.en: It happens to everyone.

learner.hr: Hvala na pomoći. Sad mogu krenuti.
learner.en: Thank you for your help. Now I can leave.

conversations.title: Talking about a holiday: Dubrovnik

partner.en: How was your holiday?

learner.hr: Odlično, ovaj put smo posjetili Dubrovnik.
learner.en: Great; this time we visited Dubrovnik.

partner.en: How long did you stay?

learner.hr: Pet dana, ali rado bismo ostali dulje.
learner.en: Five days, but we'd happily have stayed longer.

partner.en: What did you like best?

learner.hr: Hrana i opuštena atmosfera.
learner.en: The food and the relaxed atmosphere.

partner.en: Did you do a lot of walking?

learner.hr: Jesmo, svaki dan smo istraživali drugi dio grada.
learner.en: We did; we explored a different part of town each day.

partner.en: Do you have any photos?

learner.hr: Imam nekoliko lijepih. Pokazat ću ti ih poslije.
learner.en: I have a few nice ones. I'll show you later.

partner.hr: Sad i ja želim otići tamo.
partner.en: Now I want to go there too.

learner.hr: Mogu ti poslati naše bilješke s puta.
learner.en: I can send you our travel notes.

conversations.title: Meeting for coffee

partner.en: Hi! Have you ordered yet?

learner.hr: Još nisam. Čekam te.
learner.en: Not yet. I'm waiting for you.

partner.en: What will you have to drink?

learner.hr: Ja bih jednu kavu, molim.
learner.en: I'd like a coffee, please.

partner.en: With sugar or without?

learner.hr: Obično pijem kavu bez šećera.
learner.en: I usually drink coffee without sugar.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li i nešto za jelo?
partner.en: Would you like something to eat as well?

learner.hr: Da, jedan sendvič, molim.
learner.en: Yes, a sandwich, please.

partner.en: Shall we go for a short walk afterwards?

learner.hr: Može, ali prvo želim popiti kavu.
learner.en: Sure, but first I want to drink my coffee.

partner.en: Agreed. I'm paying today.

learner.hr: Hvala! Sljedeći put plaćam ja.
learner.en: Thank you! Next time I'm paying.

conversations.title: Buying bread and milk

partner.en: Good afternoon! What do you need?

learner.hr: Dobar dan! Trebam kruh i mlijeko.
learner.en: Good afternoon! I need bread and milk.

partner.en: White or brown bread?

learner.hr: Imate li još crnog kruha?
learner.en: Do you have any brown bread left?

partner.en: We do; it has just arrived.

learner.hr: Odlično, uzet ću jedan kruh.
learner.en: Great, I'll take one loaf.

partner.en: How much milk would you like?

learner.hr: Dvije boce, molim.
learner.en: Two bottles, please.

partner.en: Is that everything?

learner.hr: Još trebam kavu za sutra.
learner.en: I also need coffee for tomorrow.

partner.en: That's eight euros altogether.

learner.hr: Izvolite. Hvala i doviđenja.
learner.en: Here you are. Thank you and goodbye.

conversations.title: Plans for tomorrow

partner.en: Do you have plans for tomorrow?

learner.hr: Još nemam. Što predlažeš?
learner.en: Not yet. What do you suggest?

partner.en: Shall we go for a walk by the sea?

learner.hr: Rado, ali sutra moram raditi.
learner.en: I'd like to, but I have to work tomorrow.

partner.en: When do you finish work?

learner.hr: Radim do tri, a poslije imam vremena.
learner.en: I work until three, and afterwards I have time.

partner.en: Then we can head out around four.

learner.hr: Može. Mislim da će sutra biti lijepo vrijeme.
learner.en: Sure. I think the weather will be nice tomorrow.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li ponijeti nešto za jelo?
partner.en: Will you bring something to eat?

learner.hr: Da, mogu ponijeti kruh i sir.
learner.en: Yes, I can bring bread and cheese.

partner.hr: Odlično! Vidimo se ispred tvoje zgrade.
partner.en: Great! See you outside your building.

learner.hr: Dogovoreno, vidimo se sutra u četiri.
learner.en: Agreed, see you tomorrow at four.

conversations.title: Clearing up a missed call

partner.hr: Hej, zašto mi se jučer nisi javio?
partner.en: Hey, why didn't you answer me yesterday?

learner.hr: Oprosti, nisam vidio tvoj poziv jer sam bio na sastanku.
learner.en: Sorry, I didn't see your call because I was in a meeting.

partner.hr: Mislio sam da si ljut na mene.
partner.en: I thought you were angry with me.

learner.hr: Nisam, stvarno nije ništa takvo. Zašto si to pomislio?
learner.en: I'm not; it's really nothing like that. Why did you think that?

partner.hr: Marko mi je rekao da si otišao bez pozdrava.
partner.en: Marko told me you left without saying goodbye.

learner.hr: On nije znao da moram ranije po sestru.
learner.en: He didn't know that I had to pick up my sister early.

partner.hr: Onda sam ja sve pogrešno shvatio.
partner.en: Then I misunderstood everything.

learner.hr: Znam da se brineš, ali možeš me jednostavno pitati.
learner.en: I know you worry, but you can simply ask me.

partner.hr: Imaš pravo. Jesi li sada slobodan?
partner.en: You're right. Are you free now?

learner.hr: Jesam. Možda se možemo naći pa ti ispričam što se dogodilo.
learner.en: I am. Perhaps we can meet and I can tell you what happened.

partner.en: All right, I'm coming over to your place.

learner.hr: Super, čekam te. I drago mi je da smo ovo riješili.
learner.en: Great, I'll wait for you. And I'm glad we've sorted this out.

conversations.title: Meeting a new colleague

partner.hr: Dobar dan, jeste li vi nova kolegica?
partner.en: Hello, are you the new colleague?

learner.hr: Jesam, moje ime je Ana. Drago mi je što sam ovdje.
learner.en: Yes, my name is Ana. I'm glad to be here.

partner.hr: Dobro došli. Znate li gdje je vaš ured?
partner.en: Welcome. Do you know where your office is?

learner.hr: Još ne znam. Možete li mi pokazati put?
learner.en: I don't know yet. Could you show me the way?

partner.en: Of course, come with me.

learner.hr: Hvala vam. Tko još radi u našem timu?
learner.en: Thank you. Who else works in our team?

partner.hr: Tu su Ivan i Petra, a voditelj je na putu.
partner.en: There's Ivan and Petra, and the team leader is away.

learner.hr: Kada se vraća? Voljela bih razgovarati i s njim.
learner.en: When does he return? I'd like to speak with him too.

partner.hr: Trebao bi biti ovdje u četvrtak.
partner.en: He should be here on Thursday.

learner.hr: Dobro, do tada ću upoznati ostale i pročitati upute.
learner.en: All right, until then I'll get to know the others and read the instructions.

partner.en: If you need anything, please feel free to ask.

learner.hr: Hoću, hvala. Lijepo je kad te ljudi tako dočekaju.
learner.en: I will, thank you. It's lovely when people welcome you like this.

conversations.title: Looking through old family photos

partner.hr: Tko je ovaj čovjek na fotografiji?
partner.en: Who is this man in the photograph?

learner.hr: To je moj otac kad je imao dvadeset godina.
learner.en: That's my father when he was twenty years old.

partner.en: Really? He looks completely different.

learner.hr: Znam, ali vidiš li njegove oči? Iste su kao moje.
learner.en: I know, but can you see his eyes? They're just like mine.

partner.hr: A žena koja stoji pored njega?
partner.en: And the woman standing next to him?

learner.hr: To je moja majka. Tada još nisu bili u braku.
learner.en: That's my mother. They weren't married yet then.

partner.en: Where was this taken?

learner.hr: Mislim da kod bake, no morat ću pitati tatu.
learner.en: I think at Grandma's, but I'll have to ask Dad.

partner.hr: Je li ti ona ikad pričala o tom danu?
partner.en: Has she ever told you about that day?

learner.hr: Jest, rekla je da su svi plesali do jutra.
learner.en: Yes, she said everyone danced until morning.

partner.en: I'd love to hear the whole story.

learner.hr: I ja. Sljedeći put ćemo zajedno pregledati i ostatak albuma.
learner.en: So would I. Next time we'll look through the rest of the album together too.

conversations.title: Apologising for a harsh comment

partner.hr: Još razmišljam o onome što si jučer rekla.
partner.en: I'm still thinking about what you said yesterday.

learner.hr: Žao mi je. Bila sam umorna, ali to nije opravdanje.
learner.en: I'm sorry. I was tired, but that isn't an excuse.

partner.hr: Zvučalo je kao da moj trud ništa ne vrijedi.
partner.en: It sounded as though my effort was worth nothing.

learner.hr: Nisam to mislila. Vidim koliko radiš i cijenim to.
learner.en: I didn't mean that. I see how much you work and I appreciate it.

partner.hr: Zašto mi onda nisi odmah tako rekla?
partner.en: Why didn't you tell me that straight away, then?

learner.hr: Zato što sam prvo mislila na sebe, a ne na tebe.
learner.en: Because I thought of myself first, rather than of you.

partner.hr: Ne želim da se ovako svađamo.
partner.en: I don't want us to argue like this.

learner.hr: Ni ja. Neću ponavljati iste riječi samo da bih bila u pravu.
learner.en: Neither do I. I won't repeat the same words just to be right.

partner.hr: Možemo li sljedeći put stati prije nego što se naljutimo?
partner.en: Can we stop before we get angry next time?

learner.hr: Možemo. Reci mi kad pretjeram i poslušat ću te.
learner.en: We can. Tell me when I go too far and I'll listen to you.

partner.en: All right, I accept your apology.

learner.hr: Hvala ti. Naš odnos mi je važniji od ove rasprave.
learner.en: Thank you. Our relationship matters more to me than this argument.

conversations.title: Finding the right entrance

partner.hr: Gdje si? Ne vidim te ispred zgrade.
partner.en: Where are you? I can't see you outside the building.

learner.hr: Stojim pod velikim drvetom, pokraj stražnjih vrata.
learner.en: I'm standing under the big tree, beside the back door.

partner.hr: To nije pravi ulaz. Dođi ovamo, prema ulici.
partner.en: That's not the right entrance. Come over here, towards the street.

learner.hr: Čekaj, moram prvo obići ogradu.
learner.en: Wait, I have to go around the fence first.

partner.hr: Vidiš li crveni znak iznad mene?
partner.en: Can you see the red sign above me?

learner.hr: Vidim. Sad znam na koje mjesto misliš.
learner.en: I can. Now I know which place you mean.

partner.hr: Kad uđeš, idi ravno pa gore stepenicama.
partner.en: When you enter, go straight ahead and then upstairs.

learner.hr: Zar nema dizala? Torba mi je dosta teška.
learner.en: Isn't there a lift? My bag is quite heavy.

partner.hr: Ima, ali je s druge strane hodnika.
partner.en: There is, but it's on the other side of the corridor.

learner.hr: Dobro, onda ću njime. Nemoj još otići.
learner.en: All right, then I'll take it. Don't leave yet.

partner.hr: Ne idem nikamo, čekam te na katu.
partner.en: I'm not going anywhere; I'll wait for you upstairs.

learner.hr: Evo me, konačno! Drugi put dolazim na prednji ulaz.
learner.en: Here I am, finally! Next time I'm coming to the front entrance.

conversations.title: Keeping a birthday surprise secret

partner.hr: Znaš li da je Maji uskoro rođendan?
partner.en: Do you know it's Maja's birthday soon?

learner.hr: Znam, njezina sestra želi pripremiti iznenađenje.
learner.en: I do; her sister wants to arrange a surprise.

partner.en: Who's coming?

learner.hr: Dolaze prijatelji koje nije dugo vidjela, čak i oni iz Splita.
learner.en: Friends she hasn't seen for a long time are coming, even the ones from Split.

partner.hr: Je li netko njoj već nešto rekao?
partner.en: Has anyone told her anything yet?

learner.hr: Nadam se da nije. Ja joj nisam ništa spomenuo.
learner.en: I hope not. I haven't mentioned anything to her.

partner.hr: Kako ćemo je dovesti u restoran?
partner.en: How will we get her to the restaurant?

learner.hr: Reći ću joj da tamo nas dvoje imamo običnu večeru.
learner.en: I'll tell her that the two of us are having an ordinary dinner there.

partner.hr: A što ako pita zašto baš tamo?
partner.en: And what if she asks why there in particular?

learner.hr: Onda ću reći da mi se sviđa njihova hrana.
learner.en: Then I'll say that I like their food.

partner.en: Come on, just don't reveal the plan.

learner.hr: Bez brige. Volim je iznenaditi, a ovo će joj mnogo značiti.
learner.en: Don't worry. I love surprising her, and this will mean a lot to her.

conversations.title: A parcel left with a neighbour

partner.hr: Oprostite, jeste li vi preuzeli moj paket?
partner.en: Excuse me, did you take in my parcel?

learner.hr: Jesam, dostavljač ga je ostavio kod mene prije sat vremena.
learner.en: Yes, the delivery driver left it with me an hour ago.

partner.hr: Hvala vam. Je li bio velik?
partner.en: Thank you. Was it large?

learner.hr: Nije osobito velik, ali je prilično težak.
learner.en: Not particularly large, but it's rather heavy.

partner.hr: U njemu su knjige za moju kćer.
partner.en: It contains books for my daughter.

learner.hr: Onda je to sigurno ovaj paket s vašim imenom.
learner.en: Then it's certainly this parcel with your name on it.

partner.hr: Da, to je taj. Mogu li ga uzeti?
partner.en: Yes, that's the one. May I take it?

learner.hr: Naravno. Samo pazite na kut jer je karton malo oštećen.
learner.en: Of course. Just watch the corner, because the cardboard is slightly damaged.

partner.hr: Izgleda da su stvari unutra u redu.
partner.en: It looks as though the things inside are all right.

learner.hr: Drago mi je. Ako opet ne budete kod kuće, možete dati moj broj.
learner.en: I'm glad. If you're out again, you can give them my number.

partner.hr: Baš ste ljubazni. Uzvratit ću vam uslugu.
partner.en: You're very kind. I'll return the favour.

learner.hr: Nema potrebe, gospodine. Susjedi smo i trebamo si pomagati.
learner.en: There's no need, sir. We're neighbours and should help one another.

conversations.title: Correcting an error in a report

partner.hr: Jesi li ti poslao ovaj izvještaj?
partner.en: Did you send this report?

learner.hr: Jesam. Jesi li primijetila nešto pogrešno?
learner.en: I did. Did you notice anything wrong?

partner.hr: Brojevi na zadnjoj stranici nisu isti kao u tablici.
partner.en: The numbers on the last page aren't the same as in the table.

learner.hr: Imaš pravo. Izgleda da sam prepisao stari podatak.
learner.en: You're right. It looks as though I copied an old figure.

partner.hr: Možemo li to ispraviti prije sastanka?
partner.en: Can we correct it before the meeting?

learner.hr: Možemo. Treba mi deset minuta da provjerim i ostale stranice.
learner.en: We can. I need ten minutes to check the other pages too.

partner.en: Would you like me to inform the manager?

learner.hr: Da, molim te. Reci mu da dolazi ispravljena verzija.
learner.en: Yes, please. Tell him that a corrected version is coming.

partner.en: Don't worry; anyone can make a mistake.

learner.hr: Znam, ali želim biti siguran da se nitko neće osloniti na krive brojeve.
learner.en: I know, but I want to be sure no one relies on the wrong numbers.

partner.en: Everything matches now. We can go.

learner.hr: Odlično. Drugi put ću provjeriti podatke prije slanja.
learner.en: Great. Next time I'll check the information before sending it.

conversations.title: Packing for a move

partner.hr: Koje kutije prvo nosimo u auto?
partner.en: Which boxes are we taking to the car first?

learner.hr: Prvo uzmi one s knjigama, a odjeću ćemo staviti gore.
learner.en: Take the ones with books first, and we'll put the clothes on top.

partner.en: And this one marked fragile?

learner.hr: U njoj su čaše moje bake. Nju ću držati kod sebe.
learner.en: It contains my grandmother's glasses. I'll keep that one with me.

partner.hr: Jesi li već provjerio sve ladice?
partner.en: Have you checked all the drawers already?

learner.hr: Jesam, osim one pod sudoperom. Tamo su još krpe.
learner.en: I have, apart from the one under the sink. There are still cloths in there.

partner.en: What shall we do with the old table?

learner.hr: Njega ostavljamo novim stanarima, tako smo se dogovorili.
learner.en: We're leaving it for the new tenants; that's what we agreed.

partner.hr: Čini mi se da još nešto nedostaje.
partner.en: I feel as though something is still missing.

learner.hr: Ključevi! Moram ih predati vlasniku prije nego što odemo.
learner.en: The keys! I have to hand them to the owner before we leave.

partner.hr: Evo ih na polici kraj vrata.
partner.en: Here they are on the shelf by the door.

learner.hr: Hvala. Sad stvarno možemo zatvoriti ovo poglavlje.
learner.en: Thank you. Now we can really close this chapter.

conversations.title: Meeting an old friend again

partner.hr: Bok! Koliko se dugo nismo vidjeli!
partner.en: Hi! We haven't seen each other for so long!

learner.hr: Stvarno dugo. Mislim da su prošle gotovo tri godine.
learner.en: A really long time. I think it's been almost three years.

partner.hr: Još živiš u onom malom stanu?
partner.en: Do you still live in that little flat?

learner.hr: Ne, sad živim s obitelji blizu centra, ali često mislim na taj stan.
learner.en: No, I live with my family near the centre now, but I often think about that flat.

partner.en: And what are you doing these days?

learner.hr: Radim u školi. Nikada nisam mislio da ću toliko voljeti taj posao.
learner.en: I work in a school. I never thought I'd love that job so much.

partner.hr: Baš mi je drago zbog tebe.
partner.en: I'm really pleased for you.

learner.hr: Hvala. A kako je tvoja sestra? Čuo sam da se vratila.
learner.en: Thank you. And how is your sister? I heard she's back.

partner.hr: Jest, sad i ona radi ovdje.
partner.en: Yes, she works here now too.

learner.hr: Onda moramo naći vrijeme da se svi zajedno vidimo.
learner.en: Then we have to find time for all of us to meet.

partner.en: We could do it as soon as next week.

learner.hr: Dogovoreno. Nećemo opet čekati tri godine.
learner.en: Agreed. We won't wait another three years.

conversations.title: Talking after a first day at work

partner.en: How was your first day?

learner.hr: Bolje nego što sam očekivala, iako sam ujutro bila nervozna.
learner.en: Better than I expected, although I was nervous in the morning.

partner.hr: Jesu li te kolege lijepo dočekali?
partner.en: Did your colleagues welcome you warmly?

learner.hr: Jesu. Jedna mi je kolegica pokazala ured i rekla da mogu sve pitati.
learner.en: They did. One colleague showed me the office and said I could ask anything.

partner.en: What did you do today?

learner.hr: Upoznala sam ljude, pročitala dokumente i postavila računalo.
learner.en: I met people, read documents, and set up my computer.

partner.hr: Jesi li već dobila svoj prvi zadatak?
partner.en: Have you already been given your first task?

learner.hr: Jesam, ali imam nekoliko dana da ga završim.
learner.en: Yes, but I have a few days to finish it.

partner.en: That sounds like a good start.

learner.hr: I meni se čini. Važno mi je da nisam ostala sama sa svim pitanjima.
learner.en: I think so too. It's important to me that I wasn't left alone with all my questions.

partner.en: Then you can relax this evening.

learner.hr: Baš to namjeravam. Sutra želim doći odmorna.
learner.en: That's exactly what I'm planning. I want to arrive rested tomorrow.

conversations.title: Remembering a childhood street

partner.hr: Je li ovo ulica u kojoj si odrastao?
partner.en: Is this the street where you grew up?

learner.hr: Jest. Ovdje sam provodio dane s bratom i prijateljima.
learner.en: Yes. I used to spend my days here with my brother and friends.

partner.hr: Što je bilo na ovom praznom mjestu?
partner.en: What used to be on this empty plot?

learner.hr: Tu je nekad stajala mala trgovina u koju nas je mama slala po kruh.
learner.en: There used to be a little shop here where Mum sent us to buy bread.

partner.en: Do you remember the owner?

learner.hr: Naravno. Uvijek nam je znao sačuvati nešto slatko.
learner.en: Of course. He always used to save something sweet for us.

partner.hr: A škola je još na istom mjestu?
partner.en: And is the school still in the same place?

learner.hr: Jest, iza ugla. Otac bi me često čekao pred vratima.
learner.en: Yes, around the corner. My father often waited for me outside the doors.

partner.en: It sounds like a happy childhood.

learner.hr: Bilo je lijepih dana, ali nismo se baš uvijek slagali.
learner.en: There were happy days, but we didn't always get along.

partner.en: Would you like to walk to the school?

learner.hr: Želim. Čudno je koliko se toga sjetiš kad se vratiš.
learner.en: I would. It's strange how much you remember when you come back.

conversations.title: Choosing a meaningful present

partner.hr: Što ćemo kupiti ocu za rođendan?
partner.en: What shall we buy Dad for his birthday?

learner.hr: Nešto što će stvarno koristiti, a ne još jednu stvar za policu.
learner.en: Something he'll actually use, rather than another thing for the shelf.

partner.en: Perhaps a new travel bag?

learner.hr: Tu ideju već ima sestra. Rekla mi je da ju je naručila.
learner.en: My sister already had that idea. She told me she's ordered it.

partner.hr: Onda knjigu o mjestima koja želi posjetiti.
partner.en: Then a book about the places he wants to visit.

learner.hr: To bi mu se moglo svidjeti, osobito ako ima mnogo fotografija.
learner.en: He might like that, especially if it has lots of photographs.

partner.hr: Znaš li koji ga krajevi zanimaju?
partner.en: Do you know which areas interest him?

learner.hr: Znam da često spominje otoke i stare gradove uz more.
learner.en: I know he often mentions islands and old towns by the sea.

partner.en: Let's look together in the bookshop.

learner.hr: Može. Volio bih napisati i nekoliko osobnih riječi u čestitki.
learner.en: All right. I'd also like to write a few personal words in the card.

partner.hr: Mislim da će mu to značiti više od cijene poklona.
partner.en: I think that will mean more to him than the price of the present.

learner.hr: Slažem se. Najvažnije je da vidi koliko nam je stalo.
learner.en: I agree. What matters most is that he sees how much we care.

conversations.title: Looking after a neighbour’s dog

partner.hr: Možeš li sutra pripaziti na mog psa?
partner.en: Can you look after my dog tomorrow?

learner.hr: Mogu, ali reci mi što on inače radi kad ti nisi tu.
learner.en: I can, but tell me what he usually does when you're not here.

partner.hr: Uglavnom spava, a oko podne želi van.
partner.en: He mostly sleeps, and around midday he wants to go out.

learner.hr: Dobro. Je li naviknut na druge pse u parku?
learner.en: All right. Is he used to other dogs in the park?

partner.hr: Jest, ali nemoj mu odmah skinuti povodac.
partner.en: Yes, but don't take his lead off straight away.

learner.hr: Neću. Radije ću prvo vidjeti kako se ponaša sa mnom.
learner.en: I won't. I'd rather see how he behaves with me first.

partner.hr: Hrana mu je u posudi kraj vrata.
partner.en: His food is in the container by the door.

learner.hr: Vidim. Koliko mu trebam dati?
learner.en: I see it. How much should I give him?

partner.en: I'll leave you written instructions.

learner.hr: Odlično, tako neću morati pamtiti svaku sitnicu.
learner.en: Great; then I won't have to remember every little detail.

partner.en: Thank you; you've helped me a lot.

learner.hr: Nema problema. Mislim da ćemo se nas dvojica dobro slagati.
learner.en: No problem. I think the two of us will get along well.

conversations.title: The morning after a party

partner.hr: Jesi li se sinoć dobro zabavila?
partner.en: Did you have fun last night?

learner.hr: Jesam, ali danas jedva držim oči otvorene.
learner.en: I did, but today I can barely keep my eyes open.

partner.en: How late did you stay?

learner.hr: Mi smo otišli oko dva, a ostali su nastavili plesati.
learner.en: We left around two, and the others carried on dancing.

partner.hr: Je li bilo nekoga koga poznajem?
partner.en: Was there anyone I know?

learner.hr: Bilo ih je nekoliko. Tvoj prijatelj Luka pitao je za tebe.
learner.en: There were a few people. Your friend Luka asked about you.

partner.en: What did you tell him?

learner.hr: Rekla sam mu da radiš i da se nadaš doći sljedeći put.
learner.en: I told him you were working and hoped to come next time.

partner.en: Did I miss anything special?

learner.hr: Jesi, naš profesor je zapjevao i svi smo se smijali od iznenađenja.
learner.en: You did; our teacher started singing, and we all laughed in surprise.

partner.hr: Sad mi je još više žao što nisam došao.
partner.en: Now I'm even sorrier I didn't come.

learner.hr: Nemoj se brinuti, pokazat ću ti fotografije pa ćeš čuti cijelu priču.
learner.en: Don't worry; I'll show you the photos and tell you the whole story.

conversations.title: Discussing a disappointing match

partner.hr: Jesi li gledao utakmicu do kraja?
partner.en: Did you watch the match to the end?

learner.hr: Jesam, i još ne mogu vjerovati da smo izgubili.
learner.en: I did, and I still can't believe we lost.

partner.en: The first half was excellent.

learner.hr: Bilo je, ali nakon odmora kao da je izašla druga momčad.
learner.en: It was, but after the break it was as though a different team came out.

partner.hr: Misliš li da je trener pogriješio?
partner.en: Do you think the coach made a mistake?

learner.hr: Možda, no nije pošteno kriviti samo njega.
learner.en: Perhaps, but it isn't fair to blame only him.

partner.en: The players really did look tired.

learner.hr: To sam i ja primijetio. Nitko nije trčao kao prije.
learner.en: I noticed that too. No one was running like before.

partner.en: Will you watch the next match?

learner.hr: Hoću, naravno. Jedan poraz ne znači da ću prestati navijati.
learner.en: Of course I will. One defeat doesn't mean I'll stop supporting them.

partner.en: Then let's watch it together at my place.

learner.hr: Dogovoreno, samo se nadam boljem završetku.
learner.en: Agreed; I just hope for a better ending.

conversations.title: Discussing a mystery novel

partner.hr: Jesi li završila roman koji sam ti posudio?
partner.en: Have you finished the novel I lent you?

learner.hr: Jesam. Cijelo vrijeme sam pokušavala pogoditi tko je ubio vlasnika kuće.
learner.en: I have. The whole time I was trying to guess who killed the owner of the house.

partner.en: Who did you suspect first?

learner.hr: Na njegova brata, jer je on imao najviše razloga za osvetu.
learner.en: His brother, because he had the strongest reason for revenge.

partner.en: And what do you think of the detective?

learner.hr: Sviđa mi se njegov način razmišljanja, iako ponekad previše govori.
learner.en: I like his way of thinking, although he sometimes talks too much.

partner.en: Did the ending surprise you?

learner.hr: Jest. Nisam očekivala da je ključ bio u onom starom pismu.
learner.en: Yes. I didn't expect the key to be in that old letter.

partner.hr: Sad ćeš možda htjeti pročitati nastavak.
partner.en: Perhaps you'll want to read the sequel now.

learner.hr: Želim, ali prvo moram vratiti knjigu sestri koja isto čeka na nju.
learner.en: I do, but first I have to return the book to my sister, who's waiting for it too.

partner.hr: Mogu ti posuditi drugi dio sljedeći tjedan.
partner.en: I can lend you the second part next week.

learner.hr: Hvala. Ovaj put neću pročitati zadnju stranicu unaprijed.
learner.en: Thank you. This time I won't read the last page in advance.

conversations.title: Taking a wrong turn on a walk

partner.hr: Jesi li siguran da idemo pravim putem?
partner.en: Are you sure we're going the right way?

learner.hr: Više nisam. Ovu stazu prije nismo prošli.
learner.en: Not anymore. We haven't been along this path before.

partner.hr: Na karti piše da trebamo biti kraj potoka.
partner.en: The map says we should be beside the stream.

learner.hr: A mi smo već visoko iznad njega. Moramo stati i pogledati kartu.
learner.en: And we're already high above it. We need to stop and look at the map.

partner.en: Perhaps we turned too early.

learner.hr: Jesmo, kod onog velikog kamena. Sjećam se znaka na drvetu.
learner.en: We did, by that large rock. I remember the sign on the tree.

partner.hr: Hoćemo li se vratiti istim putem?
partner.en: Shall we go back the same way?

learner.hr: Da, to mi se čini pametnije nego nastaviti u nepoznatom smjeru.
learner.en: Yes, that seems wiser to me than continuing in an unfamiliar direction.

partner.hr: Dobro da još ima dovoljno svjetla.
partner.en: It's a good thing there's still enough daylight.

learner.hr: I meni je drago. Ne bih htio tražiti put kroz šumu po mraku.
learner.en: I'm glad too. I wouldn't want to find our way through the forest in the dark.

partner.en: Here we are back at the rock.

learner.hr: Odlično, sada vidim oznaku. Ovaj put idemo lijevo.
learner.en: Great, now I can see the marker. This time we're going left.

conversations.title: A car that will not start

partner.en: Why haven't you left yet?

learner.hr: Auto se neće pokrenuti, a za sat vremena moram biti na poslu.
learner.en: The car won't start, and I have to be at work in an hour.

partner.en: Have you called anyone yet?

learner.hr: Jesam, servis može poslati čovjeka tek poslije podne.
learner.en: I have; the garage can only send someone this afternoon.

partner.en: I can give you a lift.

learner.hr: Stvarno? To bi mi spasilo jutro.
learner.en: Really? That would save my morning.

partner.hr: Nije problem, ionako idem u tom smjeru.
partner.en: It's no problem; I'm going that way anyway.

learner.hr: Hvala ti. Samo da uzmem torbu i javim kolegi da kasnim.
learner.en: Thank you. Let me just get my bag and tell my colleague I'm running late.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li se moći vratiti kući?
partner.en: Will you be able to get home?

learner.hr: Hoću, mogu autobusom. Za auto ću se pobrinuti večeras.
learner.en: Yes, I can take the bus. I'll deal with the car this evening.

partner.en: I'll wait outside the building.

learner.hr: Dolazim odmah. Danas sam stvarno imao sreće s tobom.
learner.en: I'm coming now. I really am lucky to have you today.

conversations.title: Waiting for a delayed ferry

partner.hr: Znaš li zašto još ne ukrcavaju putnike?
partner.en: Do you know why they aren't boarding passengers yet?

learner.hr: Kažu da je more nemirno i da moramo još malo čekati.
learner.en: They say the sea is rough and we have to wait a little longer.

partner.hr: Hoćemo li stići na otok prije večeri?
partner.en: Will we reach the island before evening?

learner.hr: Nadam se. No važnije mi je da putujemo sigurno.
learner.en: I hope so. But travelling safely matters more to me.

partner.hr: Gdje su ostali iz naše grupe?
partner.en: Where are the others in our group?

learner.hr: Oni su otišli po nešto za jelo, a mi čuvamo prtljagu.
learner.en: They've gone to get something to eat, and we're watching the luggage.

partner.hr: Treba li javiti domaćinu da kasnimo?
partner.en: Should we tell our host we're late?

learner.hr: Treba. Poslat ću mu poruku čim objave novo vrijeme polaska.
learner.en: Yes. I'll send him a message as soon as they announce the new departure time.

partner.hr: Upravo su rekli da krećemo za pola sata.
partner.en: They've just said we're leaving in half an hour.

learner.hr: Odlično, onda ću sad javiti i prijateljima da se vrate.
learner.en: Great, then I'll tell our friends to come back now.

partner.en: It looks as though the wind has died down.

learner.hr: Čini se. Veselim se kad napokon ugledamo obalu otoka.
learner.en: It seems so. I'm looking forward to finally seeing the island's coast.

conversations.title: Preparing for a job interview

partner.hr: Jesi li spremna za sutrašnji razgovor?
partner.en: Are you ready for tomorrow's interview?

learner.hr: Gotovo. Još želim nekoliko puta naglas proći odgovore.
learner.en: Almost. I still want to go through my answers aloud a few times.

partner.en: Would you like me to play the employer?

learner.hr: Molim te. Pitaj me prvo zašto želim promijeniti posao.
learner.en: Please. Ask me first why I want to change jobs.

partner.hr: Dobro, zašto želite raditi kod nas?
partner.en: All right, why would you like to work for us?

learner.hr: Želim više prilika za učenje i zadatke na kojima mogu samostalno raditi.
learner.en: I'd like more opportunities to learn and tasks I can work on independently.

partner.hr: To zvuči dobro. Imaš li konkretan primjer?
partner.en: That sounds good. Do you have a specific example?

learner.hr: Imam. Prošle sam godine sama organizirala projekt za cijeli odjel.
learner.en: I do. Last year I organised a project for the whole department on my own.

partner.hr: Nemoj zaboraviti reći kakav je bio rezultat.
partner.en: Don't forget to say what the result was.

learner.hr: Imaš pravo. Često pričam o radu, a preskočim ono što smo postigli.
learner.en: You're right. I often talk about the work and skip what we achieved.

partner.hr: Mislim da ćeš ostaviti dobar dojam.
partner.en: I think you'll make a good impression.

learner.hr: Hvala. Već mi je lakše jer znam što želim reći.
learner.en: Thank you. I already feel better because I know what I want to say.

conversations.title: A visit to grandparents in the village

partner.en: How are Grandma and Grandpa?

learner.hr: Dobro su, ali im nedostaje društvo otkad smo svi otišli iz sela.
learner.en: They're well, but they miss having company since we all left the village.

partner.hr: Jesi li ih posjetio ovaj mjesec?
partner.en: Have you visited them this month?

learner.hr: Jesam. Pomagao sam djedu u vrtu i popravio vrata na ogradi.
learner.en: I have. I helped Grandpa in the garden and repaired the gate.

partner.hr: Je li baka opet pripremila previše hrane?
partner.en: Did Grandma make too much food again?

learner.hr: Naravno. Rekla je da sam premršav, kao i svaki put.
learner.en: Of course. She said I was too thin, as she always does.

partner.en: What did you bring home?

learner.hr: Jaja, jabuke i toliko povrća da smo jedva zatvorili prtljažnik.
learner.en: Eggs, apples, and so many vegetables that we could barely close the boot.

partner.en: We should go together soon.

learner.hr: Slažem se. Znaš koliko bi im značilo da vide i tebe.
learner.en: I agree. You know how much it would mean to them to see you too.

partner.en: Then let's call them this evening.

learner.hr: Može. Djed će već početi planirati što sve trebamo napraviti.
learner.en: All right. Grandpa will immediately start planning everything we need to do.

conversations.title: Viewing a flat with a friend

partner.en: What do you think of the flat?

learner.hr: Svjetliji je nego na fotografijama, a sobe su prilično prostrane.
learner.en: It's brighter than in the photographs, and the rooms are quite spacious.

partner.hr: Smeta li ti što nema balkona?
partner.en: Does it bother you that there's no balcony?

learner.hr: Malo, ali više me zanima koliko je bučno navečer.
learner.en: A little, but I'm more interested in how noisy it is in the evening.

partner.en: We can ask the neighbours when we leave.

learner.hr: Dobra ideja. Želim znati i kakvi su troškovi zimi.
learner.en: Good idea. I'd also like to know what the costs are in winter.

partner.hr: Vlasnik kaže da je grijanje novo.
partner.en: The owner says the heating is new.

learner.hr: To je dobro, ali svejedno bih htio vidjeti prijašnje račune.
learner.en: That's good, but I'd still like to see previous bills.

partner.en: Are you going to decide straight away?

learner.hr: Neću. Prvo ću pročitati ugovor i usporediti ovaj stan s drugim.
learner.en: No. First I'll read the contract and compare this flat with the other one.

partner.en: I can help you go through the notes.

learner.hr: Hvala. Lakše je primijetiti važne stvari kad nisi sam.
learner.en: Thank you. It's easier to notice important things when you're not alone.

conversations.title: A parcel with the wrong contents

partner.hr: Je li ti napokon stigla narudžba?
partner.en: Has your order finally arrived?

learner.hr: Jest, ali unutra nije ono što sam naručila.
learner.en: It has, but what's inside isn't what I ordered.

partner.en: Did they send the wrong size?

learner.hr: Nije stvar u veličini. Poslali su potpuno drugi proizvod.
learner.en: It's not about the size. They sent a completely different product.

partner.en: Have you photographed the parcel?

learner.hr: Jesam, i sačuvala sam ambalažu i sve naljepnice.
learner.en: I have, and I've kept the packaging and all the labels.

partner.en: What does customer service say?

learner.hr: Zasad ništa. Poslala sam im poruku prije sat vremena.
learner.en: Nothing yet. I sent them a message an hour ago.

partner.hr: Možda im treba malo vremena da provjere.
partner.en: Perhaps they need a little time to check.

learner.hr: Vjerojatno. Samo se nadam da neću morati sve objašnjavati više puta.
learner.en: Probably. I just hope I won't have to explain everything several times.

partner.en: Let me know how it turns out.

learner.hr: Hoću. Sljedeći put ću još pažljivije provjeriti prodavača.
learner.en: I will. Next time I'll check the seller even more carefully.

conversations.title: After a concert

partner.en: What was the concert like?

learner.hr: Fantastičan! Nikad ih prije nisam čuo uživo.
learner.en: Fantastic! I'd never heard them live before.

partner.hr: Jesu li svirali tvoju omiljenu pjesmu?
partner.en: Did they play your favourite song?

learner.hr: Jesu, baš na kraju. Svi smo pjevali zajedno s njima.
learner.en: They did, right at the end. We all sang along with them.

partner.en: Where were you standing?

learner.hr: Blizu pozornice, ali ipak dovoljno daleko od zvučnika.
learner.en: Near the stage, but still far enough from the speakers.

partner.en: Who went with you?

learner.hr: Išla su dva prijatelja i moja rođakinja koja inače ne sluša tu glazbu.
learner.en: Two friends and my cousin, who doesn't usually listen to that music.

partner.hr: Je li se i njoj svidjelo?
partner.en: Did she like it too?

learner.hr: Jest. Rekla je da je energija publike potpuno drugačija nego kod kuće.
learner.en: Yes. She said the crowd's energy was completely different from listening at home.

partner.en: I'm coming next time too.

learner.hr: Obavezno. Samo ćemo karte kupiti ranije da ne ostanemo bez njih.
learner.en: Definitely. We'll just buy the tickets earlier so we don't miss out.

conversations.title: Different reactions to a painting

partner.en: What do you think of this painting?

learner.hr: Privlači me boja neba, ali ne razumijem što prikazuje tamni dio.
learner.en: I'm drawn to the colour of the sky, but I don't understand what the dark area shows.

partner.en: To me it looks like a city at night.

learner.hr: Možda imaš pravo. Ja sam prvo pomislila na šumu.
learner.en: Perhaps you're right. My first thought was a forest.

partner.hr: Hoćemo li pročitati opis uz sliku?
partner.en: Shall we read the description beside the painting?

learner.hr: Hoćemo, ali voljela bih prvo stvoriti vlastiti dojam.
learner.en: We will, but I'd like to form my own impression first.

partner.hr: Zašto te baš ova toliko zanima?
partner.en: Why does this particular one interest you so much?

learner.hr: Zato što me podsjeća na mjesto koje sam sanjala kao dijete.
learner.en: Because it reminds me of a place I dreamed about as a child.

partner.hr: Zanimljivo je kako vidimo različite stvari.
partner.en: It's interesting how we see different things.

learner.hr: Jest. Ne mora sve imati samo jedno objašnjenje.
learner.en: It is. Not everything has to have just one explanation.

partner.hr: Ovdje piše da je umjetnik slikao pogled s prozora.
partner.en: It says here that the artist painted the view from a window.

learner.hr: Onda smo oboje nešto pogodili. Pogledaj, iza kuća se stvarno vide stabla.
learner.en: Then we both got something right. Look, there really are trees behind the houses.

conversations.title: Rescuing a disappointing dinner

partner.en: How is dinner coming along?

learner.hr: Iskreno, ne baš dobro. Juha mi je ispala preslana.
learner.en: Honestly, not very well. My soup has turned out too salty.

partner.en: Did you follow the recipe?

learner.hr: Jesam, ali nisam primijetio da je i temeljac već slan.
learner.en: I did, but I didn't notice that the stock was already salty too.

partner.hr: Imamo li nešto drugo što možemo poslužiti?
partner.en: Do we have something else we can serve?

learner.hr: Imamo povrće, kruh i sir. Mogli bismo složiti jednostavnu večeru.
learner.en: We have vegetables, bread, and cheese. We could put together a simple dinner.

partner.en: That sounds perfectly good to me.

learner.hr: Hvala. Htio sam da sve bude savršeno pa sam se nepotrebno uzrujao.
learner.en: Thank you. I wanted everything to be perfect, so I got upset unnecessarily.

partner.hr: Došli smo biti zajedno, a ne ocjenjivati tvoje kuhanje.
partner.en: We came to spend time together, not to grade your cooking.

learner.hr: Znam. Onda ću maknuti juhu i narezati povrće.
learner.en: I know. Then I'll put the soup aside and chop the vegetables.

partner.en: I'll set the table.

learner.hr: Odlično. Na kraju će ovo ipak biti lijepa večer.
learner.en: Great. In the end, this will still be a lovely evening.

conversations.title: Cancelling plans without causing offence

partner.en: What time are you coming this evening?

learner.hr: Žao mi je, ali mislim da ipak neću moći doći.
learner.en: I'm sorry, but I don't think I'll be able to come after all.

partner.en: Has something happened?

learner.hr: Moram ostati s mamom jer se danas ne osjeća dobro.
learner.en: I have to stay with Mum because she isn't feeling well today.

partner.en: Of course, family comes first.

learner.hr: Hvala što razumiješ. Znam da si se potrudio oko svega.
learner.en: Thank you for understanding. I know you've made an effort with everything.

partner.hr: Nemoj zbog toga imati osjećaj krivnje.
partner.en: Don't feel guilty about it.

learner.hr: Pokušat ću. Samo mi je žao što ti javljam tako kasno.
learner.en: I'll try. I'm just sorry I'm letting you know so late.

partner.hr: Možemo se vidjeti kad se situacija smiri.
partner.en: We can meet when things settle down.

learner.hr: Možemo. Javit ću ti se čim budem znao više.
learner.en: We can. I'll contact you as soon as I know more.

partner.en: Give your mum my regards.

learner.hr: Hoću, sigurno će joj biti drago. Čujemo se sutra.
learner.en: I will; she'll certainly be pleased. Speak tomorrow.

conversations.title: Understanding an unfamiliar expression

partner.en: Why did you pause in the middle of the conversation?

learner.hr: Kolega je upotrijebio izraz koji nikad prije nisam čula.
learner.en: My colleague used an expression I'd never heard before.

partner.hr: Jesi li ga pitala što znači?
partner.en: Did you ask him what it meant?

learner.hr: Jesam. Prije bih samo kimnula i pretvarala se da razumijem.
learner.en: I did. Before, I would just nod and pretend I understood.

partner.en: That's a big step forward.

learner.hr: I meni se čini. Lakše učim kad se ne bojim postaviti pitanje.
learner.en: I think so too. I learn more easily when I'm not afraid to ask a question.

partner.en: How did he react?

learner.hr: Sasvim normalno. Objasnio je značenje i dao mi još jedan primjer.
learner.en: Perfectly normally. He explained the meaning and gave me another example.

partner.en: Will you write the expression down?

learner.hr: Hoću, ali uz cijelu rečenicu, da zapamtim kako se upotrebljava.
learner.en: I will, but with the whole sentence, so I remember how it's used.

partner.en: We can practise it together later.

learner.hr: Okej, to bi mi pomoglo da ga idući put sama upotrijebim.
learner.en: Okay, that would help me use it myself next time.

conversations.title: Helping a neighbour in the garden

partner.hr: Vidim da imaš mnogo posla u vrtu.
partner.en: I can see you have a lot to do in the garden.

learner.hr: Imam. Nakon kiše je sve naraslo, osobito korov.
learner.en: I do. Everything has grown after the rain, especially the weeds.

partner.en: Do you need a hand?

learner.hr: Treba, ako imaš vremena. Ja ću zalijevati, a ti možeš skupiti grane.
learner.en: Yes, if you have time. I'll water the plants, and you can collect the branches.

partner.en: Where should I put them?

learner.hr: Na onu hrpu uz ogradu, dalje od cvijeća.
learner.en: On that pile by the fence, away from the flowers.

partner.en: Are these new seedlings?

learner.hr: Jesu. Dobio sam ih od prijatelja, ali još ne znam hoće li se primiti.
learner.en: Yes. A friend gave them to me, but I don't know yet whether they'll take root.

partner.hr: Vrt već sad izgleda mnogo urednije.
partner.en: The garden already looks much tidier.

learner.hr: Izgleda, i to zahvaljujući tebi. Sam bih radio cijelo poslijepodne.
learner.en: It does, and that's thanks to you. On my own, I'd have been working all afternoon.

partner.hr: Nema na čemu, bilo mi je lijepo biti vani.
partner.en: You're welcome; it was nice to be outdoors.

learner.hr: Onda dođi na sok i malo se odmori u hladu.
learner.en: Then come and have some juice and rest in the shade.

conversations.title: Inspecting a second-hand bicycle

partner.hr: Je li bicikl još na prodaju?
partner.en: Is the bicycle still for sale?

learner.hr: Jest. Kupio sam drugi pa mi ovaj više ne treba.
learner.en: Yes. I've bought another one, so I no longer need this one.

partner.en: How long have you used it?

learner.hr: Oko četiri godine, uglavnom za vožnju do posla.
learner.en: About four years, mostly for riding to work.

partner.hr: Je li ikad imao veći kvar?
partner.en: Has it ever had a major fault?

learner.hr: Nije. Mijenjao sam gume i lanac, ali okvir je ostao isti.
learner.en: No. I've changed the tyres and chain, but the frame is the same.

partner.en: Can I try it for a moment?

learner.hr: Naravno. Napravi krug po dvorištu i provjeri kako ti odgovara.
learner.en: Of course. Ride around the courtyard and see how it suits you.

partner.en: The saddle is a little too low for me.

learner.hr: To možemo odmah podesiti. Imam alat u garaži.
learner.en: We can adjust that straight away. I have tools in the garage.

partner.hr: Sad je dobro. Mislim da ću ga uzeti.
partner.en: That's good now. I think I'll take it.

learner.hr: Odlično. Dat ću ti i račun za dijelove koje sam nedavno zamijenio.
learner.en: Great. I'll also give you the receipt for the parts I've replaced recently.

conversations.title: Finding the right suitcase

partner.hr: Je li tvoj kovčeg već stigao?
partner.en: Has your suitcase arrived yet?

learner.hr: Još nije, barem ga ja nisam vidjela na traci.
learner.en: Not yet; at least I haven't seen it on the carousel.

partner.en: What does it look like?

learner.hr: Plav je i ima crvenu vrpcu oko ručke.
learner.en: It's blue and has a red ribbon around the handle.

partner.hr: Je li to onaj koji upravo dolazi?
partner.en: Is it that one coming now?

learner.hr: Nije, taj je manji. Moj ima i ogrebotinu s prednje strane.
learner.en: No, that one's smaller. Mine also has a scratch on the front.

partner.hr: Ostalo je još nekoliko komada prtljage.
partner.en: There are still a few pieces of luggage left.

learner.hr: Znam, ali počinjem se brinuti jer gotovo svi već odlaze.
learner.en: I know, but I'm starting to worry because almost everyone is leaving already.

partner.hr: Ako ne stigne, pitajmo na šalteru.
partner.en: If it doesn't arrive, let's ask at the desk.

learner.hr: Dobro, imam potvrdu o predanoj prtljazi u torbi.
learner.en: All right; I have the checked-baggage receipt in my bag.

partner.hr: Pogledaj, evo jednog s crvenom vrpcom!
partner.en: Look, here's one with a red ribbon!

learner.hr: Da, to je moj! Sad konačno možemo potražiti autobus.
learner.en: Yes, that's mine! Now we can finally look for the bus.

conversations.title: Admitting to feeling overwhelmed

partner.hr: Djeluješ umorno. Je li sve u redu?
partner.en: You look tired. Is everything all right?

learner.hr: Iskreno, imam osjećaj da više ne stižem ni razmišljati.
learner.en: Honestly, I feel as though I no longer even have time to think.

partner.en: Do you have too many commitments?

learner.hr: Imam. Stalno prihvaćam nove zadatke i onda ostajem budan do kasno.
learner.en: I do. I keep taking on new tasks and then staying awake until late.

partner.hr: Jesi li o tome razgovarao s voditeljem?
partner.en: Have you spoken to your manager about it?

learner.hr: Nisam još. Bojim se da će misliti kako nisam sposoban za posao.
learner.en: Not yet. I'm afraid he'll think I'm not capable of doing the job.

partner.hr: Tražiti pomoć ne znači da ne znaš raditi.
partner.en: Asking for help doesn't mean you don't know how to do your job.

learner.hr: Znam, i prijatelju bih rekao isto, ali sebi to teško priznajem.
learner.en: I know, and I'd tell a friend the same thing, but I find it hard to admit it to myself.

partner.hr: Želiš li mi prvo ispričati što te najviše pritišće?
partner.en: Would you like to tell me first what's weighing on you most?

learner.hr: Želim. Možda ću lakše shvatiti odakle početi ako sve izgovorim naglas.
learner.en: I would. Perhaps I'll understand where to start more easily if I say it all aloud.

partner.en: I'm listening; we have time.

learner.hr: Hvala ti. Već mi znači što ne moram sve držati u sebi.
learner.en: Thank you. It already means a lot that I don't have to keep everything inside.

conversations.title: Splitting a restaurant bill

partner.en: Shall we ask for the bill?

learner.hr: Možemo, samo da provjerimo tko je što naručio.
learner.en: We can; let's just check who ordered what.

partner.hr: Ja sam imao ribu i jednu čašu vina.
partner.en: I had the fish and a glass of wine.

learner.hr: A ja tjesteninu i vodu. Predjelo smo dijelili.
learner.en: And I had the pasta and water. We shared the starter.

partner.hr: Želiš li podijeliti ukupni iznos napola?
partner.en: Would you like to split the total in half?

learner.hr: Može, meni je to najjednostavnije ako se i ti slažeš.
learner.en: Sure; that's easiest for me if you agree too.

partner.en: I agree. Shall we add a tip?

learner.hr: Ja bih ostavio nešto jer je konobar bio stvarno pažljiv.
learner.en: I'd leave something because the waiter was really attentive.

partner.en: I only have a card.

learner.hr: Nema problema, mogu ja ostaviti gotovinu za taj dio.
learner.en: No problem; I can leave cash for that part.

partner.en: Great, then I'll call the waiter.

learner.hr: Dobro. Ovdje bismo mogli opet doći, baš smo lijepo jeli.
learner.en: All right. We could come here again; we had a lovely meal.

conversations.title: A printer that refuses to print

partner.en: Why are you sighing like that?

learner.hr: Pisač opet ne radi, a trebam ispisati nekoliko važnih stranica.
learner.en: The printer isn't working again, and I need to print a few important pages.

partner.hr: Piše li kakva poruka na zaslonu?
partner.en: Is there a message on the screen?

learner.hr: Piše da nema papira, iako je ladica puna.
learner.en: It says there's no paper, even though the tray is full.

partner.hr: Jesi li pogledao je li nešto zapelo unutra?
partner.en: Have you checked whether something is stuck inside?

learner.hr: Nisam, prvo sam mislio da je problem u računalu.
learner.en: Not yet; at first I thought the problem was with the computer.

partner.en: I can see a folded sheet here.

learner.hr: Aha, zato ga nije mogao povući. Sad mi je jasnije.
learner.en: Ah, that's why it couldn't pull it through. Now it makes more sense.

partner.en: Will you try once more?

learner.hr: Hoću, ali prvo ću maknuti stare zadatke iz reda za ispis.
learner.en: I will, but first I'll remove the old jobs from the print queue.

partner.en: There, it's printing now.

learner.hr: Napokon! Hvala što si pogledao, sam se vrtim u krug kad se iznerviram.
learner.en: Finally! Thank you for looking; I go round in circles on my own when I get frustrated.

conversations.title: Asking a professor for a reference

partner.hr: Dobar dan, dugo vas nisam vidjela.
partner.en: Hello, I haven't seen you for a long time.

learner.hr: Dobar dan, profesorice. Nadam se da vas ne ometam.
learner.en: Hello, Professor. I hope I'm not disturbing you.

partner.en: Not at all. What do you need?

learner.hr: Prijavljujem se za stipendiju pa sam vas htjela zamoliti za preporuku.
learner.en: I'm applying for a scholarship, and I wanted to ask you for a reference.

partner.en: Why did you choose me in particular?

learner.hr: Vi najbolje znate kako sam radila na završnom radu.
learner.en: You know best how I worked on my final dissertation.

partner.hr: Rado ću vam pomoći. Pošaljite mi pojedinosti.
partner.en: I'd be happy to help. Send me the details.

learner.hr: Hvala vam. Želite li i moj životopis ili samo opis programa?
learner.en: Thank you. Would you like my CV too, or just the programme description?

partner.hr: Pošaljite oboje pa ću sve pregledati.
partner.en: Send both, and I'll go through everything.

learner.hr: Hoću. Vrlo sam vam zahvalna što ste našli vremena za mene.
learner.en: I will. I'm very grateful that you've found time for me.

conversations.title: Offering someone a seat

partner.en: Is this seat free?

learner.hr: Jest. Oprostite, želite li da se pomaknem bliže prozoru?
learner.en: Yes. Excuse me, would you like me to move closer to the window?

partner.hr: Hvala, lakše mi je sjediti uz prolaz.
partner.en: Thank you; it's easier for me to sit by the aisle.

learner.hr: Razumijem. Mogu li vam pomoći s vrećicama?
learner.en: I understand. May I help you with your bags?

partner.hr: Možete ovu veću staviti na pod.
partner.en: You can put the bigger one on the floor.

learner.hr: Naravno. Čini se da ste danas puno toga kupili.
learner.en: Of course. It looks as though you've bought a lot today.

partner.hr: Dolaze mi unuci pa pripremam ručak.
partner.en: My grandchildren are coming over, so I'm making lunch.

learner.hr: Onda vas čeka lijepo poslijepodne. Koliko ih imate?
learner.en: Then you have a lovely afternoon ahead. How many do you have?

partner.hr: Troje, i svi su uvijek gladni.
partner.en: Three, and they're always hungry.

learner.hr: Vjerujem! Recite mi prije nego što izlazite da vam dodam stvari.
learner.en: I believe it! Tell me before you get off so I can pass you your things.

conversations.title: Clarifying a work arrangement

partner.en: Have you read the proposed contract?

learner.hr: Jesam, ali imam par pitanja u vezi s radnim vremenom.
learner.en: Yes, but I have a couple of questions about working hours.

partner.en: Tell me what you'd like to know.

learner.hr: Rekli ste da je raspored fleksibilan. Što to točno znači u ovom timu?
learner.en: You said the schedule was flexible. What exactly does that mean in this team?

partner.hr: Važno nam je da smo svi dostupni između deset i tri.
partner.en: It's important to us that everyone is available between ten and three.

learner.hr: Dakle, mogao bih početi ranije i ranije završiti?
learner.en: So I could start earlier and finish earlier?

partner.en: Yes, when we agree in advance.

learner.hr: To mi odgovara. Mislite li da možemo taj dogovor navesti i pisano?
learner.en: That suits me. Do you think we could put that arrangement in writing too?

partner.en: We can; I'll add a clarification.

learner.hr: Hvala. Draže mi je da sve bude jasno prije početka suradnje.
learner.en: Thank you. I'd rather have everything clear before we start working together.

conversations.title: Remembering a neighbour who died

partner.hr: Čula sam za vašeg susjeda. Žao mi je.
partner.en: I heard about your neighbour. I'm sorry.

learner.hr: Hvala. Još mi je teško prihvatiti da je mrtav; jučer kao da je još bio ovdje.
learner.en: Thank you. I still find it hard to accept that he's dead; it feels as though he was here only yesterday.

partner.en: Had you known each other for a long time?

learner.hr: Gotovo cijeli život. Bio je dobar čovjek i uvijek je znao nekoga nasmijati.
learner.en: Almost all my life. He was a good man and always knew how to make someone smile.

partner.hr: Po čemu ćete ga najviše pamtiti?
partner.en: What will you remember him for most?

learner.hr: Po tome kako je pomagao ljudima, a nikada nije tražio ništa zauzvrat.
learner.en: The way he helped people and never asked for anything in return.

partner.hr: Ima li nešto što mogu učiniti za vas?
partner.en: Is there anything I can do for you?

learner.hr: Značilo bi mi da malo sjednete sa mnom. Kuća je danas neobično tiha.
learner.en: It would mean a lot if you sat with me for a while. The house is unusually quiet today.

partner.en: Of course; I have time.

learner.hr: Hvala. Volio bih vam ispričati jednu lijepu uspomenu na njega.
learner.en: Thank you. I'd like to tell you a happy memory of him.

conversations.title: Reassuring a child before school

partner.hr: Što ako sutra nitko ne želi sjediti sa mnom?
partner.en: What if no one wants to sit with me tomorrow?

learner.hr: Dušo, još ne znaš kakvi će biti drugi učenici. Daj im priliku.
learner.en: Sweetheart, you don't know what the other pupils will be like yet. Give them a chance.

partner.en: But I don't know anyone there.

learner.hr: Znam. I ja sam se tako osjećala kad sam došla u novu školu.
learner.en: I know. I felt the same way when I came to a new school.

partner.en: How did you find friends, then?

learner.hr: Prvo sam pitala jednu djevojčicu mogu li s njom podijeliti užinu.
learner.en: First I asked one girl if I could share my snack with her.

partner.hr: Moram li odmah pričati sa svima?
partner.en: Do I have to talk to everyone straight away?

learner.hr: Ne moraš. Budi ono što jesi i razgovaraj kad se budeš osjećala spremna.
learner.en: No. Be yourself and talk when you feel ready.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li me čekati poslije nastave?
partner.en: Will you wait for me after school?

learner.hr: Hoću, bit ću ispred ulaza. Onda ćeš mi ispričati svoj prvi dan.
learner.en: I will; I'll be outside the entrance. Then you can tell me about your first day.

conversations.title: Helping a player after a mistake

partner.hr: Ja sam kriv što smo izgubili.
partner.en: It's my fault we lost.

learner.hr: Prestani sve svaljivati na sebe. Nitko nije odigrao savršenu utakmicu.
learner.en: Stop putting all the blame on yourself. Nobody played a perfect match.

partner.hr: Ali ja sam promašio na kraju.
partner.en: But I missed at the end.

learner.hr: Jesi, no prije toga si našoj ekipi mnogo puta pomogao.
learner.en: You did, but before that you helped our team many times.

partner.en: I keep thinking about that moment.

learner.hr: Pusti da se osjećaji malo smire, pa ćemo zajedno pogledati što se dogodilo.
learner.en: Let your feelings settle a little, and then we'll look at what happened together.

partner.hr: Misliš da me dečki neće kriviti?
partner.en: Do you think the guys won't blame me?

learner.hr: Znam da im je stalo do tebe. Nemaš razloga skrivati se od njih.
learner.en: I know they care about you. You have no reason to hide from them.

partner.en: All right, I'll go and talk to them.

learner.hr: Tako treba. Momci smo koji igraju zajedno, a ne jedni protiv drugih.
learner.en: That's the way. We're guys who play together, not against one another.

conversations.title: Setting a boundary with a friend

partner.hr: Zašto nećeš opet posuditi svoj auto?
partner.en: Why won't you lend me your car again?

learner.hr: Zato što si ga prošli put vratio bez goriva i nisi mi to rekao.
learner.en: Because last time you returned it without fuel and didn't tell me.

partner.hr: Mislio sam da to nije velika stvar.
partner.en: I thought it wasn't a big deal.

learner.hr: Tebi možda nije, ali meni je zbog toga kasnilo cijelo jutro.
learner.en: Perhaps not to you, but it delayed my whole morning.

partner.en: So what do you want me to do?

learner.hr: Želim da shvatiš zašto više nisam spreman dati ti ključeve.
learner.en: I want you to understand why I'm no longer willing to give you the keys.

partner.hr: Znači da mi uopće ne vjeruješ?
partner.en: Does that mean you don't trust me at all?

learner.hr: Ne kažem to. Kažem da trebamo poštovati tuđe stvari i dogovore.
learner.en: That's not what I'm saying. I'm saying we need to respect other people's things and our agreements.

partner.hr: Dobro, žao mi je što sam tako postupio.
partner.en: All right, I'm sorry I acted like that.

learner.hr: Hvala. Možemo biti prijatelji i kad ti ne mogu ispuniti svaku želju.
learner.en: Thank you. We can be friends even when I can't grant every wish you have.

conversations.title: Talking about an early fishing trip

partner.hr: Zašto si jutros ustao tako rano?
partner.en: Why did you get up so early this morning?

learner.hr: Otišao sam s ocem na ribanje dok je more još bilo mirno.
learner.en: I went fishing with my father while the sea was still calm.

partner.en: Did you catch anything?

learner.hr: Jesmo, nekoliko riba, ali jednu malu smo odmah vratili u more.
learner.en: We did, a few fish, but we put one small one straight back into the sea.

partner.en: Are you going to cook them today?

learner.hr: Hoćemo. Mama zna od ribe napraviti zaista dobar ručak.
learner.en: Yes. Mum knows how to make a really good lunch from fish.

partner.hr: Voliš li više ribati ili jesti ribu?
partner.en: Do you prefer fishing or eating fish?

learner.hr: Iskreno, najviše volim biti s ocem na brodu, bez obzira na ulov.
learner.en: Honestly, what I like most is being on the boat with my father, regardless of the catch.

partner.en: It sounds like a lovely morning.

learner.hr: Bilo je. To su trenuci kojih ću se sjećati cijelog života.
learner.en: It was. Those are the moments I'll remember all my life.

conversations.title: Preparing for a snowy outing

partner.hr: Idemo li ipak u planine ovaj vikend?
partner.en: Are we still going to the mountains this weekend?

learner.hr: Idemo, ali moramo provjeriti uvjete prije nego što krenemo.
learner.en: Yes, but we have to check the conditions before we set off.

partner.en: I only have ordinary shoes.

learner.hr: Onda nemoj računati na dugu šetnju po snijegu. Trebaš odgovarajuću obuću.
learner.en: Then don't count on a long walk in the snow. You need suitable footwear.

partner.hr: Mogu li posuditi čizme od brata?
partner.en: Can I borrow boots from my brother?

learner.hr: Možeš ga pitati, samo ih prije toga isprobaj i provjeri odgovaraju li ti.
learner.en: You can ask him; just try them on beforehand and check that they fit.

partner.hr: A što ako gore bude previše hladno?
partner.en: And what if it's too cold up there?

learner.hr: Ostat ćemo bliže domu i vratiti se prije nego što padne mrak.
learner.en: We'll stay nearer the mountain hut and return before it gets dark.

partner.hr: Dobro, ne želim se dokazivati na silu.
partner.en: All right; I don't want to force myself to prove anything.

learner.hr: Ni ja. Idemo uživati u prirodi, a ne nepotrebno riskirati.
learner.en: Neither do I. We're going to enjoy nature, not take unnecessary risks.

conversations.title: Discussing a neighbourhood meeting

partner.hr: Hoćeš li doći na sastanak stanara?
partner.en: Will you come to the residents' meeting?

learner.hr: Hoću. Želim čuti što drugi misle o uređenju našeg dvorišta.
learner.en: I will. I want to hear what the others think about improving our courtyard.

partner.en: Some want more parking spaces.

learner.hr: Znam, ali nama s djecom važno je i mjesto za igru.
learner.en: I know, but a place to play matters to those of us with children too.

partner.hr: Misliš li da ćemo se lako dogovoriti?
partner.en: Do you think we'll reach an agreement easily?

learner.hr: Ne znam. Ipak vjerujem da postoji rješenje koje uzima u obzir potrebe svih.
learner.en: I don't know. Still, I believe there's a solution that takes everyone's needs into account.

partner.hr: Treba nam netko tko će smireno voditi razgovor.
partner.en: We need someone to lead the discussion calmly.

learner.hr: Slažem se. Najbolje je saslušati ljude prije nego što odlučimo što ćemo napraviti.
learner.en: I agree. It's best to listen to people before we decide what to do.

partner.en: Shall we present a proposal together?

learner.hr: Hoćemo. Ovako ćemo se pripremiti, a ne samo žaliti da ništa ne valja.
learner.en: Yes. That way we'll prepare, rather than just complain that nothing is right.

conversations.title: Checking a passenger’s ticket

partner.en: Hello, do you need my ticket?

learner.hr: Dobar dan. Da, molim vas kartu i potvrdu rezervacije.
learner.en: Hello. Yes, your ticket and booking confirmation, please.

partner.hr: Imam ih na mobitelu, samo trenutak.
partner.en: I have them on my phone; just a moment.

learner.hr: Naravno, ne morate žuriti. Ovdje imate dovoljno mjesta za torbu.
learner.en: Of course; there's no need to hurry. You have enough room for your bag here.

partner.hr: Evo, je li ovo sve u redu?
partner.en: Here, is everything in order?

learner.hr: Jest. Putujete do zadnje postaje ili izlazite ranije?
learner.en: Yes. Are you travelling to the last stop or getting off earlier?

partner.en: I'm getting off at the next large station.

learner.hr: Dobro. Vidite onaj zaslon? Na njemu će pisati naziv postaje.
learner.en: All right. Do you see that screen? It will show the station name.

partner.en: Thank you; I don't travel by train often.

learner.hr: Nema na čemu. Ako budete imali još pitanja, obratite mi se.
learner.en: You're welcome. If you have any more questions, please ask me.

conversations.title: Describing a strange dream

partner.en: Why are you so thoughtful this morning?

learner.hr: Sanjala sam našu staru kuću, ali sve u njoj bilo je nekako drukčije.
learner.en: I dreamed about our old house, but everything inside it was somehow different.

partner.en: What was different?

learner.hr: Vrata su vodila u nepoznate sobe, a kroz prozor se vidio grad u kojem nikada nisam bila.
learner.en: The doors led to unfamiliar rooms, and through the window I could see a city I'd never been to.

partner.en: Was it a frightening dream?

learner.hr: Ne baš. Više sam se osjećala izgubljeno nego uplašeno.
learner.en: Not really. I felt more lost than frightened.

partner.hr: Je li u kući bilo još nekoga?
partner.en: Was there anyone else in the house?

learner.hr: Bila je jedna žena koja mi je rekla da ne moram odmah pronaći pravi izlaz.
learner.en: There was a woman who told me I didn't have to find the right exit straight away.

partner.en: Interesting. Will you write the dream down?

learner.hr: Hoću, prije nego što zaboravim pojedinosti. Možda od toga nastane neka priča.
learner.en: I will, before I forget the details. Perhaps it will turn into a story.

conversations.title: Talking about a poem

partner.en: Why do you keep reading the same poem?

learner.hr: Svaki put pronađem neku riječ koju prije nisam primijetio.
learner.en: Each time I find a word I hadn't noticed before.

partner.en: What is it actually about?

learner.hr: Za mene govori o ljubavi, ali i o strahu da ćemo izgubiti ono što volimo.
learner.en: To me it's about love, but also about the fear of losing what we love.

partner.hr: Misliš li da je to autor htio reći?
partner.en: Do you think that's what the writer meant?

learner.hr: Ne znam. Možda je njemu značila nešto drugo, ali meni sada znači to.
learner.en: I don't know. Perhaps it meant something else to him, but that's what it means to me now.

partner.en: Do you have a favourite line?

learner.hr: Imam, onaj u kojem srce uspoređuje s kućom koja čuva svjetlo.
learner.en: I do, the one where he compares the heart to a house that keeps a light burning.

partner.en: Read it aloud to me.

learner.hr: Hoću. Onda mi reci kakav svijet ti vidiš u tim riječima.
learner.en: I will. Then tell me what kind of world you see in those words.

conversations.title: Checking what money to bring

partner.hr: Jesi li već pripremio novac za put?
