partner.en: Have you prepared money for the trip yet?

learner.hr: Jesam nešto eura, ali ne znam trebam li ponijeti i dolare.
learner.en: I've prepared some euros, but I don't know whether I should bring dollars too.

partner.hr: Što piše u informacijama koje smo dobili?
partner.en: What does the information we were given say?

learner.hr: Piše da provjerimo koje se valute primaju na mjestima koja posjećujemo.
learner.en: It says to check which currencies are accepted in the places we're visiting.

partner.en: Then let's look at the itinerary first.

learner.hr: Slažem se. Ne želim mijenjati novac samo zato što netko kaže da tako treba.
learner.en: I agree. I don't want to exchange money just because someone says I should.

partner.en: We also have our guide's number.

learner.hr: Odlično. Pitat ću ga kakva su njegova iskustva na toj ruti.
learner.en: Great. I'll ask him about his experience on that route.

partner.en: It'll be easier to decide after that.

learner.hr: Upravo tako. Najprije informacije, a onda priprema torbe i dokumenata.
learner.en: Exactly. Information first, and then packing the bag and documents.

conversations.title: Negotiating over an old watch

partner.hr: Koliko tražite za ovaj stari sat?
partner.en: How much are you asking for this old watch?

learner.hr: Sto eura, jer je nedavno pregledan i dobro radi.
learner.en: A hundred euros, because it has recently been checked and works well.

partner.en: May I look at it closely?

learner.hr: Naravno. Vidite malu ogrebotinu ovdje, na rubu kućišta?
learner.en: Of course. Can you see the little scratch here, on the edge of the case?

partner.hr: Vidim, ali ne smeta mi. Znate li koliko je star?
partner.en: I can, but it doesn't bother me. Do you know how old it is?

learner.hr: Prema prethodnom vlasniku, više od četrdeset godina.
learner.en: According to the previous owner, more than forty years old.

partner.hr: Biste li pristali na malo nižu cijenu?
partner.en: Would you agree to a slightly lower price?

learner.hr: Mogao bih spustiti cijenu za deset eura, ali više od toga ne bih.
learner.en: I could lower the price by ten euros, but I wouldn't go further than that.

partner.en: All right, we have a deal.

learner.hr: Odlično. Dat ću vam i kutiju da ga možete sigurno odnijeti.
learner.en: Great. I'll give you the box too, so you can carry it home safely.

conversations.title: Deciding whether to keep a secret

partner.en: Why do you look so worried?

learner.hr: Prijatelj mi je povjerio nešto zbog čega ne mogu mirno razmišljati.
learner.en: A friend told me something in confidence, and I can't stop thinking about it.

partner.hr: Je li te zamolio da nikome ne kažeš?
partner.en: Did he ask you not to tell anyone?

learner.hr: Jest, i ne želim izdati njegovo povjerenje.
learner.en: Yes, and I don't want to betray his trust.

partner.en: You don't have to tell me the details.

learner.hr: Hvala. Treba mi razgovor o tome što znači biti dobar prijatelj, a ne netko tko samo širi priče.
learner.en: Thank you. I need to talk about what it means to be a good friend, rather than someone who just spreads stories.

partner.hr: Možda bi prvo trebao ponovno razgovarati s njim.
partner.en: Perhaps you should speak to him again first.

learner.hr: Mislim da hoću. Želio bih da zna kako se i ja osjećam u ovoj situaciji.
learner.en: I think I will. I'd like him to know how I feel in this situation too.

partner.hr: Možeš biti iskren i pritom pažljiv.
partner.en: You can be honest and considerate at the same time.

learner.hr: To mi je važno. Prijateljstvo ne bi trebalo značiti da sve moramo nositi sami.
learner.en: That's important to me. Friendship shouldn't mean having to carry everything alone.

conversations.title: Sorting donations with volunteers

partner.en: Where should we leave these boxes?

learner.hr: Stavite ih uz zid, a odjeću ćemo razvrstati na srednjem stolu.
learner.en: Put them by the wall, and we'll sort the clothes on the middle table.

partner.hr: Trebate li prvo dječju ili odraslu odjeću?
partner.en: Do you need children's or adults' clothes first?

learner.hr: Oboje nam treba. Samo nemojte miješati mokre stvari sa suhima.
learner.en: We need both. Just don't mix wet things with dry ones.

partner.en: We have a few warm blankets too.

learner.hr: Sjajno, njih ćemo staviti u zasebne vreće da ostanu čisti.
learner.en: Great, we'll put those in separate bags to keep them clean.

partner.en: How many more of us are coming today?

learner.hr: Još troje ljudi. Kažu da će pomoći s prijevozom.
learner.en: Three more people. They say they'll help with transport.

partner.hr: Onda bismo mogli sve završiti do večeri.
partner.en: Then we might finish everything by this evening.

learner.hr: Nadam se. Hvala vam svima, bez zajedničkog rada ne bismo mnogo postigli.
learner.en: I hope so. Thank you all; without working together, we wouldn't achieve much.

conversations.title: Learning the rules of a board game

partner.hr: Jesi li ikad igrao ovu igru?
partner.en: Have you ever played this game?

learner.hr: Nisam. Morat ćeš mi objasniti pravila prije nego što počnemo.
learner.en: No. You'll have to explain the rules before we begin.

partner.hr: Svaki igrač prvo dobije pet karata.
partner.en: Each player gets five cards first.

learner.hr: Dobro. Smijem li odmah pogledati svoje karte?
learner.en: All right. May I look at my cards straight away?

partner.hr: Smiješ, ali ih nemoj pokazivati drugima.
partner.en: Yes, but don't show them to the others.

learner.hr: Jasno. A čemu služe ove male figure na ploči?
learner.en: Understood. And what are these small pieces on the board for?

partner.hr: Njima označavaš koliko si bodova osvojio.
partner.en: You use them to mark how many points you've scored.

learner.hr: Dakle, ako sam dobro shvatio, trebam skupiti deset bodova prije ostalih.
learner.en: So, if I've understood correctly, I need to collect ten points before the others.

partner.hr: Tako je. Hoćemo probati jedan krug?
partner.en: That's right. Shall we try one round?

learner.hr: Hoćemo. Najlakše ću zapamtiti kad vidim kako sve ide.
learner.en: Yes. It'll be easiest to remember when I see how it all works.

conversations.title: Preparing to play in front of others

partner.hr: Hoćeš li svirati na završnoj priredbi?
partner.en: Will you play at the end-of-term performance?

learner.hr: Hoću, ali još nisam sigurna da sam dovoljno spremna.
learner.en: I will, but I'm not sure I'm ready enough yet.

partner.hr: Koji ti dio skladbe stvara problem?
partner.en: Which part of the piece gives you trouble?

learner.hr: Onaj brzi prijelaz pred kraj. Ruke mi se uvijek malo ukoče.
learner.en: That fast transition near the end. My hands always get a little stiff.

partner.en: Have you practised it separately?

learner.hr: Jesam, i polako ide dobro, ali pred drugima požurim.
learner.en: I have, and it goes well slowly, but in front of others I rush.

partner.hr: Mogu ti biti publika za jednu probu.
partner.en: I can be your audience for a practice run.

learner.hr: To bi mi pomoglo. Samo nemoj prestati slušati ako pogriješim.
learner.en: That would help. Just don't stop listening if I make a mistake.

partner.hr: Neću. Slušaj, važna je cijela izvedba, ne samo jedna nota.
partner.en: I won't. Listen, the whole performance matters, not just one note.

learner.hr: Znam. Pokušat ću se sjetiti zašto toliko volim glazbu, umjesto da mislim samo na greške.
learner.en: I know. I'll try to remember why I love music so much, instead of thinking only about mistakes.

conversations.title: Watching birds from a balcony

partner.hr: Zašto svako jutro sjediš na balkonu?
partner.en: Why do you sit on the balcony every morning?

learner.hr: Promatram ptice koje dolaze na stablo ispred zgrade.
learner.en: I watch the birds that come to the tree outside the building.

partner.hr: Znaš li kako se sve zovu?
partner.en: Do you know what they're all called?

learner.hr: Ne znam još. Neke prepoznam po boji, a neke samo po glasu.
learner.en: Not yet. I recognise some by their colour, and others only by their call.

partner.hr: Imaš li knjigu koja ti pomaže?
partner.en: Do you have a book that helps?

learner.hr: Imam, ali najbolje učim kad usporedim sliku s onim što stvarno vidim.
learner.en: I do, but I learn best when I compare the picture with what I actually see.

partner.hr: Jesi li danas primijetio nešto novo?
partner.en: Have you noticed anything new today?

learner.hr: Jesam, jednu malu pticu s crvenim dijelom na prsima.
learner.en: Yes, a little bird with a red patch on its breast.

partner.hr: Mogu li ti se pridružiti sutra?
partner.en: May I join you tomorrow?

learner.hr: Naravno. Samo dođi tiho da ih ne uplašimo.
learner.en: Of course. Just come quietly so we don't frighten them away.

conversations.title: Checking a rumour before repeating it

partner.hr: Jesi li čuo da nam mijenjaju cijeli raspored?
partner.en: Have you heard they're changing our whole schedule?

learner.hr: Čuo sam, ali nisam siguran je li to istina ili samo priča.
learner.en: I have, but I'm not sure whether it's true or just a rumour.

partner.hr: Meni je to rekao čovjek iz drugog odjela.
partner.en: A man from another department told me.

learner.hr: A od koga je on čuo? Ponekad se poruka promijeni dok dođe do nas.
learner.en: And who did he hear it from? Sometimes a message changes by the time it reaches us.

partner.hr: Kaže da je bio na sastanku o tome.
partner.en: He says he was at a meeting about it.

learner.hr: Onda bi možda trebao znati više, ali svejedno želim provjeriti.
learner.en: Then perhaps he should know more, but I'd still like to check.

partner.en: Will you ask the manager?

learner.hr: Hoću. Bolje je postaviti jedno pitanje nego cijeli dan širiti nepotpunu vijest.
learner.en: I will. It's better to ask one question than spend all day spreading incomplete news.

partner.en: Let me know what she says.

learner.hr: Hoću. Do tada neću pretpostavljati da se već sve promijenilo.
learner.en: I will. Until then, I won't assume everything has already changed.

conversations.title: Returning something found in a park

partner.en: Mum, look what I found!

learner.hr: Vidim, lijep sat. Gdje je bio?
learner.en: I see, a lovely watch. Where was it?

partner.en: On the bench, under a sheet of paper.

learner.hr: Onda ga je netko vjerojatno zaboravio. Moramo pokušati pronaći vlasnika.
learner.en: Then someone has probably forgotten it. We need to try to find the owner.

partner.en: Can't I keep it?

learner.hr: Ne možemo uzeti nešto samo zato što ne znamo čije je.
learner.en: We can't take something just because we don't know whose it is.

partner.hr: Možda je onaj gospodin izgubio sat.
partner.en: Perhaps that gentleman lost a watch.

learner.hr: Možda jest. Hajde, pitajmo ga je li nedavno nešto izgubio.
learner.en: Perhaps he did. Come on, let's ask him whether he's lost something recently.

partner.hr: Kaže da je njegov i pokazao je fotografiju.
partner.en: He says it's his and showed a photograph.

learner.hr: Onda je dobro što si ga primijetio. Učinio si nekome veliku uslugu.
learner.en: Then it's a good thing you noticed it. You've done someone a great favour.

conversations.title: Discussing a role in a play

partner.hr: Koju ulogu imaš u novoj predstavi?
partner.en: What role do you have in the new play?

learner.hr: Glumim vojnika koji se nakon mnogo godina vraća kući.
learner.en: I play a soldier who returns home after many years.

partner.en: Is it the main role?

learner.hr: Nije, ali moj lik povezuje dvije važne scene.
learner.en: No, but my character links two important scenes.

partner.hr: Što mu je najteže nakon povratka?
partner.en: What's hardest for him after returning?

learner.hr: Shvaća da ljudi koje je poznavao više nisu isti, kao što nije ni on.
learner.en: He realises that the people he knew are no longer the same, just as he isn't either.

partner.en: He sounds like a demanding character.

learner.hr: Jest. Želim pokazati i njegov strah i želju da ponovno pripada obitelji.
learner.en: He is. I want to show both his fear and his wish to belong to the family again.

partner.en: When can we come and see you?

learner.hr: Premijera je iduće subote. Bit će mi drago vidjeti vas u publici.
learner.en: The opening night is next Saturday. I'll be happy to see you in the audience.

conversations.title: Two sisters disagree about family plans

partner.hr: Zašto si rekla mami da ću sigurno doći?
partner.en: Why did you tell Mum I'd definitely come?

learner.hr: Mislila sam da želiš provesti vikend s nama.
learner.en: I thought you wanted to spend the weekend with us.

partner.hr: Želim, ali prvo moram završiti svoj posao.
partner.en: I do, but I have to finish my work first.

learner.hr: Znam, trebala sam te pitati prije nego što sam odgovorila umjesto tebe.
learner.en: I know; I should have asked you before answering on your behalf.

partner.hr: Ne želim da se ona razočara.
partner.en: I don't want her to be disappointed.

learner.hr: Reći ću joj što se dogodilo. Ti nisi ništa obećala.
learner.en: I'll tell her what happened. You haven't promised anything.

partner.hr: Mogla bih doći barem na ručak u nedjelju.
partner.en: I could come at least for lunch on Sunday.

learner.hr: To bi bilo lijepo, ali nemoj zbog nas zanemariti svoje obaveze.
learner.en: That would be lovely, but don't neglect your commitments because of us.

partner.en: I'll let you know my decision tomorrow.

learner.hr: Dobro. Ovaj put ću pričekati tvoj odgovor.
learner.en: All right. This time I'll wait for your answer.

conversations.title: Disagreeing about a borrowed book

partner.hr: Zašto mi vraćaš knjigu s presavijenim stranicama?
partner.en: Why are you returning my book with folded pages?

learner.hr: Oprosti, trebao sam uzeti oznaku za čitanje.
learner.en: Sorry, I should have used a bookmark.

partner.hr: Rekao sam ti da pazim na svoje knjige.
partner.en: I told you I take care of my books.

learner.hr: Jesi. Nisam razmišljao o tome koliko ti je ova važna.
learner.en: You did. I wasn't thinking about how important this one is to you.

partner.en: It's not just about the book.

learner.hr: Razumijem. Stvar je u tome da trebam poštovati ono što mi povjeriš.
learner.en: I understand. It's about respecting what you entrust to me.

partner.en: Can you be more careful in future?

learner.hr: Mogu. I neću se praviti da je tvoja briga pretjerana samo zato što ja drukčije čitam.
learner.en: I can. And I won't pretend your concern is excessive just because I read differently.

partner.hr: Dobro, hvala što si me saslušao.
partner.en: All right, thank you for listening.

learner.hr: Hvala tebi što si mi jasno rekao što te smeta.
learner.en: Thank you for telling me clearly what's bothering you.

conversations.title: Choosing to spend a weekend alone

partner.hr: Zašto ne želiš ići s nama?
partner.en: Why don't you want to come with us?

learner.hr: Ovaj put želim ostati sam i malo se odmoriti od svega.
learner.en: This time I'd like to stay on my own and get a little rest from everything.

partner.hr: Je li te netko od nas naljutio?
partner.en: Has one of us upset you?

learner.hr: Nije. Volim vaše društvo, ali treba mi i vrijeme za sebe.
learner.en: No. I enjoy your company, but I need time to myself too.

partner.en: What are you planning to do, then?

learner.hr: Čitati, kuhati nešto jednostavno i možda prošetati bez posebnog cilja.
learner.en: Read, cook something simple, and perhaps go for a walk without a particular destination.

partner.en: That actually sounds lovely.

learner.hr: Meni zvuči kao upravo ono što mi sada treba.
learner.en: To me it sounds like exactly what I need right now.

partner.en: All right, speak on Monday.

learner.hr: Može. Želim vam dobar provod, pa ću sljedeći put rado s vama.
learner.en: All right. Have a good time, and I'll happily join you next time.

conversations.title: Choosing a film despite different tastes

partner.hr: Hoćemo li gledati onaj novi akcijski film?
partner.en: Shall we watch that new action film?

learner.hr: Radije bih nešto drugo. Ne volim kad je svaka scena puna oružja i buke.
learner.en: I'd rather watch something else. I don't like it when every scene is full of weapons and noise.

partner.hr: Ali ti inače voliš napete priče.
partner.en: But you usually like suspenseful stories.

learner.hr: Volim, ali napetost ne mora značiti da netko stalno pokušava nekoga ubiti.
learner.en: I do, but suspense doesn't have to mean that someone is constantly trying to kill someone else.

partner.en: What would you suggest, then?

learner.hr: Možda misterij u kojem su važniji likovi i njihove odluke.
learner.en: Perhaps a mystery where the characters and their choices matter more.

partner.en: We can watch the trailer and then decide.

learner.hr: Možemo. Ne želim uvijek birati samo prema svom ukusu.
learner.en: We can. I don't always want to choose according to my own taste alone.

partner.en: This other one looks interesting to both of us.

learner.hr: Slažem se. Onda pripremi kokice, a ja ću odabrati titlove.
learner.en: I agree. Then you prepare the popcorn, and I'll choose the subtitles.

conversations.title: Remembering an important date late

partner.hr: Znaš li koji je danas datum?
partner.en: Do you know today's date?

learner.hr: Bože, tek sam sad shvatio. Danas nam je godišnjica.
learner.en: Oh God, I've only just realised. It's our anniversary today.

partner.en: I didn't want you to have to guess.

learner.hr: Znam. Trebao sam se sam sjetiti, umjesto da čekam tvoj podsjetnik.
learner.en: I know. I should have remembered myself, instead of waiting for your reminder.

partner.en: I don't need an expensive present.

learner.hr: Razumijem. Želiš osjetiti da mislim na ono što nam je zajedničko.
learner.en: I understand. You want to feel that I think about what we share.

partner.en: Exactly.

learner.hr: Onda bih volio da večeras ugasimo mobitele i provedemo vrijeme zajedno.
learner.en: Then I'd like us to switch off our phones this evening and spend time together.

partner.en: I'd like that too.

learner.hr: Hvala ti. Želim pamtiti ove stvari zbog nas, a ne samo zbog datuma u kalendaru.
learner.en: Thank you. I want to remember these things because of us, not just because of a date in the calendar.

conversations.title: Putting away a phone during dinner

partner.hr: Možeš li barem za stolom ostaviti mobitel?
partner.en: Can you put your phone away at least at the table?

learner.hr: Imaš pravo, samo sam htio odgovoriti na jednu poruku.
learner.en: You're right; I just wanted to answer one message.

partner.en: You've said that three times already.

learner.hr: Znam. Nisam primijetio koliko često prekidam razgovor.
learner.en: I know. I hadn't noticed how often I interrupt the conversation.

partner.hr: Osjećam se kao da ti je sve drugo važnije.
partner.en: I feel as though everything else matters more to you.

learner.hr: Žao mi je. Ti si mi važna i ne želim da se tako osjećaš.
learner.en: I'm sorry. You matter to me, and I don't want you to feel that way.

partner.hr: Ne tražim da budeš nedostupan cijeli dan.
partner.en: I'm not asking you to be unavailable all day.

learner.hr: Razumijem. Mogu odvojiti pola sata za nas bez stalnog gledanja u zaslon.
learner.en: I understand. I can set aside half an hour for us without constantly looking at a screen.

partner.hr: Dobro, onda mi ispričaj kakav ti je bio dan.
partner.en: All right, then tell me how your day was.

learner.hr: Hoću. Samo da odložim mobitel u drugu sobu.
learner.en: I will. Let me just leave my phone in the other room.

conversations.title: Visiting friends with a new baby

partner.hr: Je li sada dobar trenutak za posjet?
partner.en: Is now a good time to visit?

learner.hr: Jest, samo budite malo tiši jer je naš sin upravo zaspao.
learner.en: Yes, just be a little quieter because our son has just fallen asleep.

partner.en: Of course. How are the two of you?

learner.hr: Sretni smo, ali spavamo vrlo malo i još učimo što sve trebamo raditi.
learner.en: We're happy, but we get very little sleep and are still learning everything we need to do.

partner.hr: Donijeli smo ručak da ne morate kuhati.
partner.en: We've brought lunch so you don't have to cook.

learner.hr: Hvala vam, baš ste pogodili što nam danas najviše treba.
learner.en: Thank you; you've chosen exactly what we need most today.

partner.hr: Trebate li da vam nešto donesemo iz trgovine?
partner.en: Do you need us to bring anything from the shop?

learner.hr: Za sada imamo sve. Više nam znači malo društva bez žurbe.
learner.en: We have everything for now. A little unhurried company means more to us.

partner.hr: Onda ćemo kratko sjesti pa vas pustiti da odmorite.
partner.en: Then we'll sit for a little while and leave you to rest.

learner.hr: Može. Drago nam je što ste došli upoznati našu malu obitelj.
learner.en: All right. We're glad you've come to meet our little family.

conversations.title: Talking about being afraid of deep water

partner.en: Why are you staying close to the shore?

learner.hr: Nije me sram priznati da se bojim duboke vode.
learner.en: I'm not ashamed to admit that I'm afraid of deep water.

partner.hr: Jesi li imao neko loše iskustvo?
partner.en: Did you have a bad experience?

learner.hr: Jesam kao dijete, i taj mi se osjećaj vrati čak i kad znam da sam na sigurnom.
learner.en: I did as a child, and that feeling comes back even when I know I'm safe.

partner.hr: Ne moraš ići dalje zbog drugih ljudi.
partner.en: You don't have to go further because of other people.

learner.hr: Znam, ali nekad se uspoređujem s njima i budem ljut na sebe.
learner.en: I know, but sometimes I compare myself with them and get angry with myself.

partner.hr: Meni je drago što si mi rekao.
partner.en: I'm glad you told me.

learner.hr: I meni je lakše kad ne moram izmišljati izgovore zašto ne idem s vama.
learner.en: I feel better too when I don't have to make up excuses about why I'm not going with you.

partner.en: We can stay here together.

learner.hr: To bi mi bilo lijepo. Danas želim uživati u moru na svoj način.
learner.en: I'd like that. Today I want to enjoy the sea in my own way.

conversations.title: Finding a friend in heavy rain

partner.hr: Gdje čekaš taksi? Ovdje te nema.
partner.en: Where are you waiting for the taxi? You're not here.

learner.hr: Preko puta, ispod velikog nadstreška. Dođi ovamo da ne stojiš na kiši.
learner.en: Across the road, under the big shelter. Come over here so you're not standing in the rain.

partner.en: Wait, a car is arriving now.

learner.hr: Stani, prvo provjeri registraciju. Naš bi trebao biti crn.
learner.en: Stop, check the registration first. Ours should be black.

partner.en: You're right, this isn't ours.

learner.hr: Evo poruke od vozača. Kaže da nas vidi, ali ne može stati na toj strani.
learner.en: Here's a message from the driver. He says he can see us, but can't stop on that side.

partner.en: Shall we go to the corner?

learner.hr: Hoćemo, samo drži kišobran malo više da i ja vidim kuda idem.
learner.en: Yes, just hold the umbrella a little higher so I can see where I'm going too.

partner.en: He's finally found us now.

learner.hr: Odlično. Daj mi svoju torbu dok ulaziš pa ćemo brzo krenuti.
learner.en: Great. Give me your bag while you get in, and then we'll be off quickly.

conversations.title: Helping a grandmother send a photo

partner.hr: Kako da pošaljem ovu fotografiju tvojoj sestri?
partner.en: How do I send this photograph to your sister?

learner.hr: Prvo otvori razgovor s njom, bako, pa dodirni ovaj znak.
learner.en: First open your conversation with her, Grandma, and then tap this symbol.

partner.hr: Je li to ova mala slika dolje?
partner.en: Is it this little picture at the bottom?

learner.hr: Jest, baš ta. Sada odaberi fotografiju koju želiš poslati.
learner.en: Yes, that one. Now choose the photograph you'd like to send.

partner.hr: Hoće li je vidjeti samo ona ili svi?
partner.en: Will only she see it, or everyone?

learner.hr: Samo ona, jer si otvorila vaš privatni razgovor.
learner.en: Only she will, because you've opened your private conversation.

partner.hr: A mogu li joj nešto napisati uz sliku?
partner.en: And can I write something alongside the picture?

learner.hr: Možeš. Ovdje dodaj poruku, pa ćemo zajedno provjeriti sve prije slanja.
learner.en: You can. Add a message here, and then we'll check everything together before sending it.

partner.en: Sent! That wasn't so difficult.

learner.hr: Nije, i sljedeći put ćeš se lakše sjetiti koraka. Ako zapneš, nazovi me.
learner.en: No, and next time you'll remember the steps more easily. If you get stuck, call me.

conversations.title: Welcoming visitors to an office

partner.en: Hello, we have an appointment.

learner.hr: Dobar dan, dobro došli. Kako se zove osoba koju trebate?
learner.en: Hello, welcome. What's the name of the person you need to see?

partner.en: Ms Kovač, from the sales department.

learner.hr: Hvala. Jeste li joj već javili da ste stigli?
learner.en: Thank you. Have you let her know you've arrived?

partner.en: No, we've only just come in.

learner.hr: U redu, ja ću je nazvati. Vi možete pričekati ovdje kod nas.
learner.en: All right, I'll call her. You can wait here with us.

partner.en: Is there somewhere we can leave our coats?

learner.hr: Naravno, vješalica je iza vaših leđa, a vaše torbe mogu ostati kraj stolaca.
learner.en: Of course; the coat rack is behind you, and your bags can stay beside the chairs.

partner.en: Thank you for your help.

learner.hr: Nema na čemu. Gospođa upravo dolazi, pa ćete uskoro moći početi sastanak.
learner.en: You're welcome. Ms Kovač is on her way, so you'll be able to start the meeting soon.

conversations.title: Finding an unusual object at a market

partner.en: What are you carrying in your hand?

learner.hr: Našao sam mali drveni predmet na sajmu, ali nisam siguran čemu služi.
learner.en: I found a small wooden object at the fair, but I'm not sure what it's for.

partner.hr: Meni izgleda poput dijela nekog starog alata.
partner.en: To me it looks like part of an old tool.

learner.hr: I meni, ali prodavač kaže da je to ukras za kuću.
learner.en: To me too, but the seller says it's a decoration for the house.

partner.en: Why did you buy it, then?

learner.hr: Zato što me podsjetio na nešto što je moj djed držao u radionici.
learner.en: Because it reminded me of something my grandfather kept in his workshop.

partner.en: Can you ask him?

learner.hr: Nažalost ne mogu više, ali pokazat ću ocu. Možda on zna nešto o tome.
learner.en: Unfortunately I can't anymore, but I'll show my father. Perhaps he knows something about it.

partner.en: If you find out, let me know.

learner.hr: Hoću. Ponekad je priča iza stvari zanimljivija od same stvari.
learner.en: I will. Sometimes the story behind an object is more interesting than the object itself.

conversations.title: Deciding what to keep in a shared room

partner.hr: Moramo li baš danas pospremati sobu?
partner.en: Do we really have to tidy the room today?

learner.hr: Moramo, jer se više ne može proći između stola i kreveta.
learner.en: We do, because it's no longer possible to walk between the desk and the bed.

partner.hr: Nemoj dirati moje stvari bez pitanja.
partner.en: Don't touch my things without asking.

learner.hr: Neću, ali ni tvoje stvari ne mogu stalno ostajati na mom dijelu stola.
learner.en: I won't, but your things can't keep staying on my side of the desk either.

partner.en: This box can go under the bed.

learner.hr: Može, samo prvo pogledaj imamo li unutra nešto što još trebamo.
learner.en: It can; just first check whether there's anything inside that we still need.

partner.hr: Tu su neke stare bilježnice i karte.
partner.en: There are some old notebooks and maps here.

learner.hr: Onda izdvojimo važno, a ostalo ćemo zajedno pregledati prije bacanja.
learner.en: Then let's set aside what's important and go through the rest together before throwing it away.

partner.en: The room looks bigger now.

learner.hr: I meni. Još samo da se dogovorimo kako ćemo je takvom održavati.
learner.en: I think so too. Now we just need to agree on how to keep it this way.

conversations.title: Asking for quiet politely

partner.en: Is our conversation bothering you?

learner.hr: Malo, oprostite. Pokušavam završiti nešto za što mi treba mir.
learner.en: A little, sorry. I'm trying to finish something I need quiet for.

partner.en: We didn't notice how loud we were.

learner.hr: Razumijem. Možda biste mogli nastaviti u prostoru za grupni rad.
learner.en: I understand. Perhaps you could continue in the group study area.

partner.en: Do you know where it is?

learner.hr: Znam, s druge strane hodnika, iza staklenih vrata.
learner.en: Yes, on the other side of the corridor, behind the glass doors.

partner.en: All right, we'll move.

learner.hr: Hvala vam. Nisam htjela biti neugodna, samo se teško koncentriram uz govor.
learner.en: Thank you. I didn't mean to be unpleasant; I just find it hard to concentrate with people talking.

partner.en: No problem; we should have been more considerate.

learner.hr: Sve je u redu. Želim vam uspješan rad.
learner.en: It's all right. I hope your work goes well.

conversations.title: Noticing regional ways of speaking

partner.hr: Zašto u svoju bilježnicu zapisuješ cijele razgovore?
partner.en: Why are you writing whole conversations in your notebook?

learner.hr: Primjećujem kako ljudi govore drukčije od onoga što čitam u udžbeniku.
learner.en: I'm noticing how people speak differently from what I read in the textbook.

partner.en: For example?

learner.hr: U razgovoru često čujem šta, a u udžbeniku piše što.
learner.en: In conversation I often hear šta, while the textbook says što.

partner.hr: To može ovisiti o kraju i načinu govora.
partner.en: That can depend on the region and the way someone speaks.

learner.hr: Znači da ne trebam odmah misliti da sam pogrešno razumjela značenje?
learner.en: So I shouldn't immediately think I've misunderstood the meaning?

partner.hr: Tako je, ali pazi što biraš za službeno pisanje.
partner.en: That's right, but be careful about what you choose for formal writing.

learner.hr: Razumijem. Želim znati i kako ljudi stvarno razgovaraju i kako uredno pisati.
learner.en: I understand. I want to know both how people really talk and how to write properly.

partner.hr: Dobro je što pitaš umjesto da samo nagađaš.
partner.en: It's good that you ask instead of just guessing.

learner.hr: Hvala. Onda ću uz takve primjere zapisati i u kakvoj sam ih situaciji čula.
learner.en: Thank you. Then I'll also note the situation in which I heard examples like those.

conversations.title: Fixing a shelf with Dad

partner.en: Can you hold the shelf for me?

learner.hr: Mogu, tata. Samo trenutak, moram maknuti knjige sa stola.
learner.en: Yes, Dad. Just a moment, I need to move the books off the table.

partner.en: Are you holding it firmly?

learner.hr: Držim je objema rukama. Hoćeš li moći dohvatiti onaj zadnji vijak?
learner.en: I'm holding it with both hands. Will you be able to reach that last screw?

partner.hr: Mogu, ali dodaj mi manji odvijač.
partner.en: I can, but pass me the smaller screwdriver.

learner.hr: Izvoli. Nisam znala da popravak ovoga može biti tako naporan.
learner.en: Here you are. I didn't know fixing this could be so tiring.

partner.en: Almost done.

learner.hr: Dobro, ali nemoj se previše naginjati. Nećeš valjda pasti zbog moje police.
learner.en: Good, but don't lean over too far. You're not going to fall because of my shelf, are you?

partner.en: Done. You can let go now.

learner.hr: Napokon. Sretan si kad možeš nešto popraviti svojim rukama, zar ne?
learner.en: Finally. You're happy when you can fix something with your own hands, aren't you?

conversations.title: An unexpected homecoming

partner.en: Hey, what are you doing at the door?

learner.hr: Bok! Došao sam ranije jer su nam otkazali zadnji sastanak.
learner.en: Hi! I came home early because our last meeting was cancelled.

partner.en: Why didn't you call?

learner.hr: Htio sam te iznenaditi. Zapravo, prvo sam pokušao nazvati, ali ti je telefon bio isključen.
learner.en: I wanted to surprise you. Actually, I tried calling first, but your phone was off.

partner.en: Yes, the battery died.

learner.hr: Ma nema veze. Jesi li već jela ili da nam napravim nešto?
learner.en: Oh, never mind. Have you eaten yet, or shall I make us something?

partner.en: We have soup left from yesterday.

learner.hr: Odlično. Morao sam preskočiti ručak, pa bih mogao pojesti i dvije zdjele.
learner.en: Great. I had to skip lunch, so I could eat two bowls.

partner.hr: Idi se prvo presvuci pa ću je zagrijati.
partner.en: Go and change first, and I'll heat it up.

learner.hr: Hvala, draga. Zbilja je lijepo vratiti se doma prije mraka.
learner.en: Thanks, darling. It really is nice to get home before dark.

conversations.title: A school play feels too daunting

partner.hr: Zašto si se sakrio iza pozornice?
partner.en: Why are you hiding behind the stage?

learner.hr: Slušaj, ne mogu izaći pred sve te ljude. Uopće nisam spreman.
learner.en: Listen, I can't go out in front of all those people. I'm not ready at all.

partner.hr: Znaš svoj tekst bolje od mene.
partner.en: You know your lines better than I do.

learner.hr: Znam ga u svojoj sobi, ali sad mi je sve nestalo iz glave.
learner.en: I know them in my room, but now everything has gone out of my head.

partner.en: Look at me if you get stuck.

learner.hr: A što ako se djeca počnu smijati? To bi bilo strašno.
learner.en: What if the children start laughing? That would be awful.

partner.hr: Smijali su se i na probi jer je predstava smiješna.
partner.en: They laughed at the rehearsal too because the play is funny.

learner.hr: Imaš pravo. Valjda sam zaboravio da igram smiješnog kralja.
learner.en: You're right. I suppose I forgot that I'm playing a funny king.

partner.en: Ready? We're going on together.

learner.hr: Jesam. Ostani blizu mene i bit će sve u redu.
learner.en: Yes. Stay close to me and everything will be all right.

conversations.title: A phone call in a quiet room

partner.en: Madam, could you speak more quietly?

learner.hr: Ispričavam se. Nisam primijetila da sam još u čitaonici.
learner.en: I'm sorry. I didn't notice that I was still in the reading room.

partner.hr: Možete izaći u hodnik ako želite završiti poziv.
partner.en: You can go into the corridor if you want to finish your call.

learner.hr: Hvala, odmah ću van. Ne želim smetati nikome tko uči.
learner.en: Thank you, I'll go out straight away. I don't want to disturb anyone who's studying.

partner.hr: Niste prvi kojima se to dogodilo.
partner.en: You're not the first person this has happened to.

learner.hr: Ipak sam trebala paziti. Moja kći zvala je zbog važnih vijesti pa sam se uzbudila.
learner.en: Still, I should have been more careful. My daughter called with important news, so I got excited.

partner.hr: Nadam se da je sve dobro.
partner.en: I hope everything is all right.

learner.hr: Jest, dobila je posao koji je dugo željela. Jako sam ponosna na nju.
learner.en: Yes, she got the job she'd wanted for a long time. I'm very proud of her.

partner.hr: Onda joj čestitajte i u naše ime.
partner.en: Then congratulate her from us too.

learner.hr: Hoću, hvala. Kad se vratim, stavit ću telefon na tiho.
learner.en: I will, thank you. When I come back, I'll put my phone on silent.

conversations.title: A first drive with a parent

partner.hr: Zašto već deset minuta sjediš u autu?
partner.en: Why have you been sitting in the car for ten minutes?

learner.hr: Tata, pokušavam se sjetiti svega što mi je instruktor govorio.
learner.en: Dad, I'm trying to remember everything my instructor told me.

partner.hr: Ne moraš odmah na glavnu cestu.
partner.en: You don't have to go onto the main road straight away.

learner.hr: Znam. Prvo ću polako voziti po parkiralištu dok se ne opustim.
learner.en: I know. I'll drive slowly around the car park first until I relax.

partner.hr: Želiš li da idem s tobom?
partner.en: Would you like me to come with you?

learner.hr: Želim, ali nemoj vikati ako pogriješim. Onda se još više zbunim.
learner.en: Yes, but don't shout if I make a mistake. That makes me even more confused.

partner.en: I promise I'll stay calm.

learner.hr: Dobro. Pazi samo da su ti vrata zatvorena i veži pojas.
learner.en: Good. Just make sure your door is closed and fasten your seat belt.

partner.en: Everything's ready, son.

learner.hr: Onda krećemo. Čovječe, nisam mislio da ću se toliko veseliti ovome.
learner.en: Then let's go. Wow, I didn't think I'd be so excited about this.

conversations.title: Reporting a missing dog

partner.en: What are you calling about?

learner.hr: Dobar dan. Naš pas nestao je jutros iz vrta pa tražimo pomoć.
learner.en: Hello. Our dog went missing from the garden this morning, and we're looking for help.

partner.en: Could you describe him?

learner.hr: Smeđ je, ima bijelu mrlju na prsima i nosi crvenu ogrlicu.
learner.en: He's brown, has a white patch on his chest, and wears a red collar.

partner.hr: Znate li u kojem je smjeru otišao?
partner.en: Do you know which way he went?

learner.hr: Susjedi su ga vidjeli kako trči prema rijeci, ali ondje ga nismo pronašli.
learner.en: Our neighbours saw him running towards the river, but we didn't find him there.

partner.en: Do you have a recent photograph?

learner.hr: Imam nekoliko slika na telefonu. Mogu vam odmah poslati najbolju.
learner.en: I have several pictures on my phone. I can send you the best one right away.

partner.en: We'll pass it on to the volunteers.

learner.hr: Hvala vam. Moji roditelji također ga traže, pa ću im javiti da ste uključeni.
learner.en: Thank you. My parents are looking for him too, so I'll let them know you're involved.

conversations.title: Avoiding a mystery spoiler

partner.hr: Jesi li završio knjigu koju sam ti posudio?
partner.en: Have you finished the book I lent you?

learner.hr: Nisam još. Molim te, nemoj mi reći tko je ubojica.
learner.en: Not yet. Please don't tell me who the murderer is.

partner.hr: Ništa ti neću otkriti. Gdje si stao?
partner.en: I won't reveal anything. Where have you got to?

learner.hr: Detektiv je upravo pronašao pištolj, ali nema dokaz da pripada osumnjičenom.
learner.en: The detective has just found a gun, but there's no proof that it belongs to the suspect.

partner.en: Do you have your own theory?

learner.hr: Mislim da njegov brat zna istinu i da je lagao policiji.
learner.en: I think his brother knows the truth and lied to the police.

partner.en: Why do you suspect him in particular?

learner.hr: Zato što je jedini ušao u kuću prije nego što je policija stigla.
learner.en: Because he's the only one who entered the house before the police arrived.

partner.en: Interesting. We'll talk when you finish.

learner.hr: Dogovoreno. Ako pogodim, častiš me kavom, a ako ne, ja častim tebe.
learner.en: Agreed. If I get it right, you buy me a coffee; if I don't, I'll buy you one.

conversations.title: An old family letter

partner.en: What are you reading so carefully?

learner.hr: Pismo svog oca. Našla sam ga među majčinim stvarima.
learner.en: A letter from my father. I found it among my mother's things.

partner.hr: Nisam znala da je sačuvala njegova pisma.
partner.en: I didn't know she'd kept his letters.

learner.hr: Nisam ni ja. U ovome piše o danu kad je prvi put vidio moju majku.
learner.en: Neither did I. In this one he writes about the day he first saw my mother.

partner.hr: Je li ti ikad pričao o tome?
partner.en: Did he ever tell you about it?

learner.hr: Jest, ali ovdje ima puno više detalja. Očito je bio jako zaljubljen.
learner.en: Yes, but there are many more details here. He was clearly very much in love.

partner.en: You must miss him.

learner.hr: Nedostaje. Umro je prije deset godina, a ja se još sjećam njegova glasa.
learner.en: I do. He died ten years ago, and I still remember his voice.

partner.en: Will you show the letter to your brother?

learner.hr: Hoću. Voljela bih da i njegov sin nešto sazna o djedovu životu.
learner.en: Yes. I'd like his son to learn something about his grandfather's life too.

conversations.title: Preparing a charity boat trip

partner.hr: Koliko ljudi danas vodimo na izlet?
partner.en: How many people are we taking on the trip today?

learner.hr: Osam odraslih i šestero djece. Kapetan kaže da svi mogu sigurno stati na brod.
learner.en: Eight adults and six children. The captain says they can all fit safely on the boat.

partner.en: Are the life jackets ready?

learner.hr: Jesu. Za djecu imamo manje, a ove veće držimo pored ulaza.
learner.en: Yes. We have smaller ones for the children, and we keep these larger ones beside the entrance.

partner.en: Who will explain the rules to them?

learner.hr: Ja ću. Želimo da svi znaju kamo smiju ići tijekom plovidbe.
learner.en: I will. We want everyone to know where they're allowed to go during the trip.

partner.en: Do we need to bring anything else?

learner.hr: Trebaju nam voda i malo hrane. Nećemo se vraćati prije tri sata.
learner.en: We need water and some food. We won't be back before three o'clock.

partner.en: Then I'll go and get the sandwiches.

learner.hr: Odlično. Kad budemo spremni, pozvat ću putnike da uđu.
learner.en: Great. When we're ready, I'll invite the passengers aboard.

conversations.title: Welcoming a small celebration

partner.en: Good evening. Do you have a reservation?

learner.hr: Imamo, na ime Marić. Naša obitelj večeras slavi majčin rođendan.
learner.en: Yes, under Marić. Our family is celebrating our mother's birthday tonight.

partner.hr: Dobrodošli. Je li vas ukupno sedmero?
partner.en: Welcome. Are there seven of you altogether?

learner.hr: Jest. Niste li možda dobili i našu poruku o dječjoj stolici?
learner.en: Yes. Did you happen to receive our message about a high chair too?

partner.en: Yes, everything's ready.

learner.hr: Hvala vam. Vaša kolegica bila je veoma ljubazna kad sam zvala.
learner.en: Thank you. Your colleague was very kind when I called.

partner.en: Would you like to order drinks straight away?

learner.hr: Najprije bismo htjeli pogledati jelovnik. Možete li nam dati minutu?
learner.en: We'd like to look at the menu first. Could you give us a minute?

partner.hr: Naravno. Javite mi kad budete spremni.
partner.en: Of course. Let me know when you're ready.

learner.hr: Hoćemo. I molim vas, tortu ostavite u kuhinji dok vam ne dam znak.
learner.en: We will. And please leave the cake in the kitchen until I give you a signal.

conversations.title: Training cancelled by rain

partner.en: Are you at the playing field already?

learner.hr: Jesam, ali ovdje nema nikoga. Jesam li krivo razumio vrijeme treninga?
learner.en: Yes, but there's nobody here. Did I misunderstand the training time?

partner.hr: Trener je upravo javio da je otkazano.
partner.en: The coach has just said it's cancelled.

learner.hr: Ozbiljno? Stajao sam vani dvadeset minuta i sav sam mokar.
learner.en: Seriously? I've been standing outside for twenty minutes, and I'm soaked.

partner.hr: Žao mi je, mislila sam da si vidio poruku.
partner.en: Sorry, I thought you'd seen the message.

learner.hr: Nisam. Telefon mi je bio u torbi, a ja sam slušao glazbu.
learner.en: I hadn't. My phone was in my bag, and I was listening to music.

partner.hr: Možeš li se negdje skloniti dok dođem?
partner.en: Can you take shelter somewhere until I get there?

learner.hr: Mogu u kafić preko puta. Ondje ću se barem malo ugrijati.
learner.en: I can go to the café across the road. At least I'll warm up a little there.

partner.en: I'll be there in five minutes.

learner.hr: Ne brini, ne moraš voziti brže zbog mene. Sad sam već pod krovom.
learner.en: Don't worry, you don't need to drive faster because of me. I'm under cover now.

conversations.title: Opening exam results together

partner.en: Why haven't you opened your results yet?

learner.hr: Bojim se da nisam prošla. Cijelu noć sanjala sam isti loš san.
learner.en: I'm afraid I haven't passed. I had the same bad dream all night.

partner.hr: Želiš li da ih pogledamo zajedno?
partner.en: Would you like us to look at them together?

learner.hr: Želim. Samo sjedni uz mene i nemoj ništa govoriti dok pročitam.
learner.en: Yes. Just sit beside me and don't say anything while I read.

partner.en: All right. Can you see your name?

learner.hr: Vidim ga. Čekaj, ovo znači da sam dobila najvišu ocjenu?
learner.en: I can. Wait, does this mean I got the highest grade?

partner.en: That's what it says. Congratulations!

learner.hr: Ne mogu vjerovati. Bila sam sigurna da sam jedan zadatak pogrešno riješila.
learner.en: I can't believe it. I was sure I'd answered one question incorrectly.

partner.en: Shall we celebrate?

learner.hr: Hoćemo. Prvo ću nazvati mamu, a zatim te vodim na kolače.
learner.en: Yes. I'll call Mum first, and then I'm taking you out for cake.

conversations.title: Welcoming a new neighbour

partner.hr: Zdravo, tek sam se doselila. Ja sam Petra.
partner.en: Hello, I've just moved in. I'm Petra.

learner.hr: Drago mi je. Zovem se Ivan i živim u stanu pored vašeg.
learner.en: Nice to meet you. My name is Ivan, and I live in the flat next to yours.

partner.hr: Nadam se da vas selidba nije ometala.
partner.en: I hope the move didn't disturb you.

learner.hr: Nimalo. Čuli smo malo buke, ali znali smo da nosite namještaj.
learner.en: Not at all. We heard a little noise, but we knew you were carrying furniture.

partner.hr: Postoji li nešto važno što bih trebala znati?
partner.en: Is there anything important I should know?

learner.hr: Smeće odnosimo dolje, a vrata dvorišta uvijek držimo zatvorena zbog djece.
learner.en: We take rubbish downstairs, and we always keep the courtyard gate closed because of the children.

partner.hr: Hvala. Još ne poznajem nikoga u zgradi.
partner.en: Thank you. I don't know anyone in the building yet.

learner.hr: Upoznat ću vas s ostalima. Većina stanara rado će vam pomoći.
learner.en: I'll introduce you to the others. Most residents will be happy to help you.

partner.hr: To je baš lijepo od vas.
partner.en: That's very kind of you.

learner.hr: Slobodno pokucajte ako vam išta zatreba. Dobrodošli u naš mali dio grada.
learner.en: Feel free to knock if you need anything. Welcome to our little corner of the city.

conversations.title: Checking in after a long silence

partner.hr: Hej, dugo se nismo čuli. Kako si?
partner.en: Hey, we haven't spoken for a long time. How are you?

learner.hr: Iskreno, posljednjih mjeseci nije mi bilo lako. Zato se nisam javljao.
learner.en: Honestly, the last few months haven't been easy. That's why I haven't been in touch.

partner.en: Would you like to talk about it?

learner.hr: Možda kasnije. Zasad mi samo treba društvo nekog koga dobro poznajem.
learner.en: Maybe later. For now, I just need the company of someone I know well.

partner.en: We can go for a walk without any big conversations.

learner.hr: To bi bilo dobro. Ne moramo riješiti sve probleme u jednom danu.
learner.en: That would be good. We don't have to solve every problem in one day.

partner.hr: Naravno da ne. Gdje ćemo se naći?
partner.en: Of course we don't. Where shall we meet?

learner.hr: Kod starog mosta. Tamo smo išli gotovo svakog dana kad smo bili mlađi.
learner.en: By the old bridge. We used to go there almost every day when we were younger.

partner.en: I'll be there at six.

learner.hr: Hvala ti. Znači mi više nego što možeš zamisliti.
learner.en: Thank you. It means more to me than you can imagine.

conversations.title: Finding a family at a festival

partner.en: Excuse me, are you looking for someone?

learner.hr: Da, tražim svoju kćer. Prije trenutka bila je sa mnom, a sad je ne vidim.
learner.en: Yes, I'm looking for my daughter. A moment ago she was with me, and now I can't see her.

partner.hr: Koliko ima godina i što nosi?
partner.en: How old is she, and what is she wearing?

learner.hr: Ima sedam godina. Ima plavu jaknu i drži malog medvjeda u rukama.
learner.en: She's seven. She's wearing a blue jacket and holding a little teddy bear in her hands.

partner.hr: Javit ću kolegama na ulazu. Ostanite ovdje.
partner.en: I'll tell my colleagues at the entrance. Stay here.

learner.hr: Hoću. Moj muž upravo gleda kod pozornice, pa ću ga nazvati da se vrati.
learner.en: I will. My husband is looking by the stage, so I'll call him and ask him to come back.

partner.hr: Kolegica je pronašla djevojčicu koja odgovara opisu.
partner.en: My colleague has found a little girl who matches the description.

learner.hr: Hvala bogu. Je li dobro? Možete li mi pokazati gdje je?
learner.en: Thank goodness. Is she all right? Can you show me where she is?

partner.hr: Dobro je, čeka s kolegicom kod plavog šatora.
partner.en: She's fine, waiting with my colleague by the blue tent.

learner.hr: Hvala vam na pomoći. Kad je vidim, bit ću mnogo mirnija.
learner.en: Thank you for your help. I'll feel much calmer when I see her.

conversations.title: Doubts about moving abroad

partner.hr: Jesi li prihvatila posao u drugoj zemlji?
partner.en: Have you accepted the job in another country?

learner.hr: Još nisam. To je velika odluka, a ne želim je donijeti na brzinu.
learner.en: Not yet. It's a big decision, and I don't want to rush it.

partner.en: What worries you most?

learner.hr: Kako ću živjeti toliko daleko od obitelji. Nikad nisam bila sama u stranom gradu.
learner.en: How I'll manage living so far from my family. I've never been alone in a foreign city.

partner.hr: Ali oduvijek si željela takvu priliku.
partner.en: But you've always wanted an opportunity like this.

learner.hr: Jesam. Zato mi je glupo odustati samo zato što me strah nepoznatog.
learner.en: I have. That's why it seems silly to give up just because I'm afraid of the unknown.

partner.hr: Možeš li najprije otići na nekoliko mjeseci?
partner.en: Can you go for a few months first?

learner.hr: Mogu. Ponudili su mi privremeni smještaj dok ne nađem vlastiti stan.
learner.en: Yes. They've offered me temporary accommodation until I find my own flat.

partner.hr: Onda ne moraš odlučiti za cijeli život.
partner.en: Then you don't have to decide for your whole life.

learner.hr: Imaš pravo. Mogu pokušati, a povratak nije nikakav poraz.
learner.en: You're right. I can try, and coming back wouldn't be a defeat.

conversations.title: Choosing a film without an argument

partner.hr: Hoćemo li gledati novi ratni film?
partner.en: Shall we watch the new war film?

learner.hr: Radije ne bih. Sinoć sam gledala nešto slično i loše sam spavala.
learner.en: I'd rather not. I watched something similar last night and slept badly.

partner.hr: Mislio sam da voliš povijesne filmove.
partner.en: I thought you liked historical films.

learner.hr: Volim povijest, ali ne želim cijelu večer gledati oružje, krv i smrt.
learner.en: I like history, but I don't want to spend the whole evening watching weapons, blood and death.

partner.en: What would you choose, then?

learner.hr: Možda komediju u kojoj se ljudi ne deru jedni na druge svake dvije minute.
learner.en: Maybe a comedy where people don't yell at each other every two minutes.

partner.hr: Imamo i onu priču o putovanju.
partner.en: We've also got that story about a journey.

learner.hr: To zvuči bolje. Glavni glumac mi je drag i obično bira dobre uloge.
learner.en: That sounds better. I like the lead actor, and he usually chooses good roles.

partner.en: Agreed. I'll make the popcorn.

learner.hr: A ja ću ugasiti svjetla. Ovaj put telefon ostavljam u drugoj sobi.
learner.en: And I'll turn off the lights. This time I'm leaving my phone in the other room.

conversations.title: An extra guest at dinner

partner.en: How many people are you setting the table for?

learner.hr: Za četvero. Zar nas neće biti samo četiri večeras?
learner.en: Four. Aren't there only going to be four of us tonight?

partner.hr: Pozvao sam i svoju sestru, zaboravio sam ti reći.
partner.en: I invited my sister too; I forgot to tell you.

learner.hr: Onda nas je petero. Dobro da imamo dovoljno hrane.
learner.en: Then there are five of us. It's a good thing we have enough food.

partner.hr: Nadam se da ti ne smeta.
partner.en: I hope you don't mind.

learner.hr: Ne smeta mi, ali sljedeći put reci ranije. Ne mogu čitati tvoje misli.
learner.en: I don't mind, but tell me earlier next time. I can't read your mind.

partner.hr: Imaš pravo. Mogu li nešto učiniti?
partner.en: You're right. Is there anything I can do?

learner.hr: Možeš donijeti još jedan tanjur i svoju najbolju stolicu iz radne sobe.
learner.en: You can bring another plate and your best chair from the study.

partner.hr: Odmah ću. Treba li još salate?
partner.en: I'll do that now. Do we need more salad?

learner.hr: Treba. I nazovi sestru da ne donosi desert, jer sam već napravila tortu.
learner.en: Yes. And call your sister and tell her not to bring dessert, because I've already made a cake.

conversations.title: Making a bicycle theft report

partner.en: What happened?

learner.hr: Netko mi je ukrao bicikl ispred ureda. Htio bih prijaviti krađu.
learner.en: Someone stole my bicycle from outside the office. I'd like to report the theft.

partner.hr: Kada ste ga zadnji put vidjeli?
partner.en: When did you last see it?

learner.hr: Jutros oko devet. Kad sam izašao na ručak, više ga nije bilo.
learner.en: Around nine this morning. When I came out for lunch, it was gone.

partner.en: Was it locked?

learner.hr: Jest. Pronašao sam samo prerezani lokot na zemlji.
learner.en: Yes. I found only the cut lock on the ground.

partner.hr: Imate li serijski broj ili fotografiju?
partner.en: Do you have the serial number or a photograph?

learner.hr: Imam oboje. Broj sam zapisao kad sam ga kupio, a sliku mogu pokazati na telefonu.
learner.en: Both. I wrote down the number when I bought it, and I can show you a picture on my phone.

partner.en: We'll take the details for the report.

learner.hr: Hvala. Znam da to ne znači da ćete ga odmah pronaći, ali želim pokušati.
learner.en: Thank you. I know that doesn't mean you'll find it straight away, but I want to try.

conversations.title: Packing for a first sleepover

partner.hr: Jesi li sve spremio za noćenje kod prijatelja?
partner.en: Have you packed everything for your sleepover?

learner.hr: Mislim da jesam, ali ne znam trebam li ponijeti svoj jastuk.
learner.en: I think so, but I don't know if I should bring my own pillow.

partner.hr: Ponesi ga ako ćeš lakše zaspati.
partner.en: Take it if it'll help you fall asleep.

learner.hr: Hoću. Mogu li uzeti i onu knjigu koju čitamo prije spavanja?
learner.en: I will. Can I take that book we read before bed too?

partner.en: Of course. Why do you look worried?

learner.hr: Nikad nisam spavao kod nekog drugog. Što ako se probudim i poželim kući?
learner.en: I've never slept at someone else's house. What if I wake up and want to come home?

partner.hr: Možeš me nazvati i doći ću po tebe.
partner.en: You can call me, and I'll come and get you.

learner.hr: Obećavaš? Nećeš se ljutiti ako bude usred noći?
learner.en: Do you promise? You won't be cross if it's the middle of the night?

partner.hr: Obećavam. Važno mi je da se osjećaš sigurno.
partner.en: I promise. It's important to me that you feel safe.

learner.hr: Onda ću pokušati. Možda bude toliko zabavno da uopće neću misliti na dom.
learner.en: Then I'll give it a try. Maybe it'll be so much fun that I won't think about home at all.

conversations.title: Writing a retirement speech

partner.en: Why are you still sitting in the office?

learner.hr: Pišem govor za kolegu koji odlazi u mirovinu. Ne znam odakle početi.
learner.en: I'm writing a speech for a colleague who's retiring. I don't know where to start.

partner.en: How long have you worked together?

learner.hr: Skoro dvadeset godina. Bio mi je prvi šef i puno sam naučio od njega.
learner.en: Almost twenty years. He was my first boss, and I learned a lot from him.

partner.hr: Onda opiši nešto što je učinio za tebe.
partner.en: Then describe something he did for you.

learner.hr: Kad sam napravio veliku pogrešku, nije me ponizio pred ostalima nego mi je pomogao.
learner.en: When I made a big mistake, he didn't humiliate me in front of the others; he helped me.

partner.hr: To zvuči kao dobra priča za govor.
partner.en: That sounds like a good story for the speech.

learner.hr: Jest. Želim da zna koliko nam je značio svojim mirnim pristupom.
learner.en: Yes. I want him to know how much his calm approach meant to us.

partner.en: You don't have to write a perfect speech.

learner.hr: Znam. Trebam govoriti iskreno, a ne pokušavati zvučati kao netko drugi.
learner.en: I know. I need to speak honestly rather than try to sound like someone else.

conversations.title: Strange noises outside a tent

partner.en: Can you hear something outside the tent?

learner.hr: Čujem. Zvuči kao da netko hoda oko naših stvari.
learner.en: Yes. It sounds as though someone is walking around our things.

partner.en: Maybe it's just the wind.

learner.hr: Vjetar ne otvara vrećicu s hranom. Gledaj, nešto se miče kod stola.
learner.en: Wind doesn't open a bag of food. Look, something's moving by the table.

partner.en: Will you switch on the torch?

learner.hr: Hoću. Samo nemoj vikati i probuditi cijeli kamp.
learner.en: Yes. Just don't shout and wake up the whole campsite.

partner.en: It's a cat!

learner.hr: Mačka? A ja sam skoro povjerovao da je medvjed došao po naše sendviče.
learner.en: A cat? And I nearly believed a bear had come for our sandwiches.

partner.hr: Sad nam barem neće biti dosadno.
partner.en: At least we won't be bored now.

learner.hr: Možda, ali hranu ipak nosim unutra. Ne želim dijeliti doručak s njom.
learner.en: Maybe, but I'm still bringing the food inside. I don't want to share breakfast with her.

conversations.title: Sorting out a wedding seating plan

partner.hr: Zašto si stavila mog brata tako daleko od nas?
partner.en: Why have you put my brother so far away from us?

learner.hr: Zato što je rekao da želi sjediti sa svojim prijateljima.
learner.en: Because he said he wanted to sit with his friends.

partner.hr: Mislio sam da će se naljutiti.
partner.en: I thought he'd get upset.

learner.hr: Neće. Razgovarali smo jučer i sam je predložio ovaj stol.
learner.en: He won't. We spoke yesterday, and he suggested this table himself.

partner.en: And where are his daughters sitting?

learner.hr: S našim nećakinjama, pored prozora. Sve se već poznaju iz škole.
learner.en: With our nieces, beside the window. They all know each other from school already.

partner.hr: Još samo moramo pronaći mjesto za tetu.
partner.en: We just need to find a place for our aunt now.

learner.hr: Nju bih stavila bliže izlazu jer teško hoda i ne voli se provlačiti među stolicama.
learner.en: I'd put her closer to the exit because she has difficulty walking and doesn't like squeezing between chairs.

partner.en: Good, I think we're finished.

learner.hr: Napokon. Nadam se da će na vjenčanju svi misliti na zabavu, a manje na raspored.
learner.en: Finally. I hope everyone at the wedding thinks about having fun rather than the seating plan.

conversations.title: Returning a wallet

partner.en: Are you Mrs Novak?

learner.hr: Jesam. Oprostite, poznajemo li se?
learner.en: Yes. Excuse me, do we know each other?

partner.hr: Ne, pronašao sam novčanik s vašim dokumentima.
partner.en: No, I found a wallet with your documents in it.

learner.hr: Moj novčanik! Tražila sam ga cijelo jutro i mislila da sam ga izgubila u autobusu.
learner.en: My wallet! I've been looking for it all morning and thought I'd lost it on the bus.

partner.hr: Bio je na klupi ispred dućana.
partner.en: It was on the bench outside the shop.

learner.hr: Ondje sam sjela da popravim cipelu. Vjerojatno mi je ispao iz torbe.
learner.en: I sat there to fix my shoe. It probably fell out of my bag.

partner.en: Check that everything is inside.

learner.hr: Sve je tu, čak i novac. Ne znam kako da vam zahvalim.
learner.en: Everything's here, even the money. I don't know how to thank you.

partner.hr: Dovoljno mi je da ste ga dobili natrag.
partner.en: I'm just glad you've got it back.

learner.hr: Ipak mi dopustite da vas počastim kavom. Spasili ste mi dan.
learner.en: Still, let me buy you a coffee. You've saved my day.

conversations.title: Helping a grandfather with a video call

partner.en: Can you see me on the screen?

learner.hr: Vidim te, djede, ali ne čujem tvoj glas.
learner.en: I can see you, Grandad, but I can't hear your voice.

partner.hr: A sad? Ja tebe čujem dobro.
partner.en: What about now? I can hear you clearly.

learner.hr: Sad je bolje. Mislim da si prije držao ruku preko mikrofona.
learner.en: That's better. I think you were covering the microphone with your hand before.

partner.hr: Što trebam pritisnuti da vidim i tvoju sestru?
partner.en: What should I press to see your sister too?

learner.hr: Ništa, samo čekaj da se uključi. Poslala sam joj istu poveznicu.
learner.en: Nothing, just wait for her to join. I sent her the same link.

partner.hr: Nekad mi je sve ovo previše složeno.
partner.en: Sometimes this all feels too complicated.

learner.hr: Znam, ali već si puno naučio. Prije mjesec dana nisi znao ni uključiti kameru.
learner.en: I know, but you've learned a lot already. A month ago you didn't even know how to turn on the camera.

partner.hr: Ipak je najljepše kad ste ovdje uživo.
partner.en: Still, it's nicest when you're here in person.

learner.hr: I nama. Doći ćemo za vikend i donijeti ti one slike koje si tražio.
learner.en: For us too. We'll come at the weekend and bring you those pictures you asked for.

conversations.title: Talking about repeated lateness

partner.en: Sorry I'm late again.

learner.hr: Čekam te već pola sata. Nije mi svejedno što se ovo stalno događa.
learner.en: I've been waiting for half an hour. It bothers me that this keeps happening.

partner.hr: Nisam znao da će biti takva gužva.
partner.en: I didn't know the traffic would be so bad.

learner.hr: Gužva se može dogoditi, ali mogao si poslati poruku prije nego što sam krenula.
learner.en: Traffic can happen, but you could have sent a message before I left.

partner.hr: Misliš li da te namjerno ostavljam čekati?
partner.en: Do you think I'm deliberately leaving you waiting?

learner.hr: Ne mislim to. Samo želim da moje vrijeme poštuješ kao i svoje.
learner.en: I don't think that. I just want you to respect my time as well as your own.

partner.hr: Imaš pravo. Kako da to popravim?
partner.en: You're right. How can I fix it?

learner.hr: Sljedeći put javi čim shvatiš da nećeš stići. Tako mogu promijeniti svoje planove.
learner.en: Next time, let me know as soon as you realise you won't make it. Then I can change my plans.

partner.hr: Dogovoreno. Jesmo li još za šetnju?
partner.en: Agreed. Are we still going for a walk?

learner.hr: Jesmo. Drago mi je da smo o ovome razgovarali bez svađe.
learner.en: Yes. I'm glad we talked about this without arguing.

conversations.title: Two identical suitcases

partner.hr: Oprostite, mislim da je ovo moj kovčeg.
partner.en: Excuse me, I think this is my suitcase.

learner.hr: Stvarno? Moj je također crn i ima crvenu vrpcu na ručki.
learner.en: Really? Mine is black too and has a red ribbon on the handle.

partner.en: We can check the name on the label.

learner.hr: Naravno. Ah, imate pravo, ovdje piše vaše ime, a ne moje.
learner.en: Of course. Ah, you're right, that's your name on it, not mine.

partner.hr: Možda je vaš još na traci.
partner.en: Maybe yours is still on the conveyor belt.

learner.hr: Eno ga, upravo dolazi. Nevjerojatno koliko su slični.
learner.en: There it is, coming now. It's incredible how similar they are.

partner.hr: Dobro je da niste već otišli.
partner.en: It's a good thing you hadn't left yet.

learner.hr: Jest. Bilo bi nezgodno tek u hotelu otvoriti tuđi kovčeg.
learner.en: Yes. It would be awkward to open someone else's suitcase at the hotel.

partner.en: Have a good onward journey.

learner.hr: Hvala, također. Sljedeći put stavit ću svoje ime na vidljivije mjesto.
learner.en: Thank you, you too. Next time I'll put my name somewhere easier to see.

conversations.title: A village welcome after many years

partner.hr: Pa jesi li to stvarno ti?
partner.en: Is that really you?

learner.hr: Jesam, teta. Nisam znao hoćeš li me prepoznati nakon toliko godina.
learner.en: Yes, Auntie. I didn't know if you'd recognise me after so many years.

partner.hr: Imaš iste oči kao tvoj otac.
partner.en: You've got the same eyes as your father.

learner.hr: To mi svi govore. A ja se svaki put sjetim kako smo ga ovdje čekali pred kućom.
learner.en: Everyone tells me that. And every time I remember how we used to wait for him outside this house.

partner.en: How long are you staying this time?

learner.hr: Samo nekoliko dana. Želim obići rodbinu i pokazati ženi gdje sam odrastao.
learner.en: Only a few days. I want to visit the family and show my wife where I grew up.

partner.en: Where is she now?

learner.hr: Razgovara s mojim bratom u vrtu. Došli su do iste priče o staroj kruški.
learner.en: She's talking to my brother in the garden. They've got onto that same story about the old pear tree.

partner.hr: Onda ćete sigurno ostati na večeri.
partner.en: Then you must stay for dinner.

learner.hr: Rado ćemo ostati. Neki se dijelovi svijeta mijenjaju, ali ovdje se uvijek osjećam kao doma.
learner.en: We'd love to. Some parts of the world change, but I always feel at home here.

conversations.title: An apology after losing patience

partner.en: Did you want to speak to me?

learner.hr: Jesam. Htio bih se ispričati zbog svog ponašanja jutros.
learner.en: Yes. I'd like to apologise for my behaviour this morning.

partner.en: Do you mean the conversation at the checkout?

learner.hr: Da. Bio sam ljut zbog dugog čekanja, ali nisam smio tako govoriti vašoj kolegici.
learner.en: Yes. I was angry about the long wait, but I shouldn't have spoken to your colleague like that.

partner.en: We had a system fault.

learner.hr: Sad to shvaćam. Ona nije bila kriva i pokušavala je pomoći koliko je mogla.
learner.en: I understand that now. It wasn't her fault, and she was trying to help as much as she could.

partner.hr: Drago mi je da ste se vratili to reći.
partner.en: I'm glad you came back to say that.

learner.hr: Želim joj se ispričati osobno, ako ima vremena. Ne želim je ponovno ometati dok radi.
learner.en: I'd like to apologise to her in person if she has time. I don't want to interrupt her work again.

partner.hr: Pitat ću je želi li doći.
partner.en: I'll ask her if she'd like to come over.

learner.hr: Hvala. Razumjet ću i ako ne želi razgovarati sa mnom.
learner.en: Thank you. I'll understand if she doesn't want to talk to me.

conversations.title: A photograph that looks more dramatic than it was

partner.hr: Jesi li stvarno stajao na rubu litice?
partner.en: Were you really standing on the edge of a cliff?

learner.hr: Ne baš. Na slici izgleda opasno, ali ispred mene je bila široka staza.
learner.en: Not exactly. It looks dangerous in the picture, but there was a wide path in front of me.

partner.en: Why didn't you show it?

learner.hr: Htio sam da fotografija izgleda poput prizora iz pustolovnog filma.
learner.en: I wanted the photo to look like a scene from an adventure film.

partner.hr: Ja sam se ozbiljno zabrinula kad sam je vidjela.
partner.en: I was seriously worried when I saw it.

learner.hr: Oprosti. Nisam mislio da ćeš povjerovati da visim iznad mora.
learner.en: Sorry. I didn't think you'd believe I was hanging over the sea.

partner.hr: Sljedeći put pošalji i sliku onoga što je ispod.
partner.en: Next time, send a picture of what's underneath too.

learner.hr: Hoću. Ovdje možeš vidjeti cijelu stazu i ljude koji sjede na klupi pored nje.
learner.en: I will. Here you can see the whole path and the people sitting on the bench beside it.

partner.en: Good, now I feel better.

learner.hr: Meni nije. Sad znaš da nisam ni približno tako hrabar kako izgledam na internetu.
learner.en: I don't. Now you know I'm nowhere near as brave as I look online.

conversations.title: A confusing ticket machine

partner.en: Do you need help with the machine?

learner.hr: Trebam, hvala. Ne znam koju kartu odabrati za vožnju do glavnog kolodvora.
learner.en: Yes, thank you. I don't know which ticket to choose for the journey to the main station.

partner.hr: Za to vam je dovoljna ova gradska karta.
partner.en: This city ticket is enough for that.

learner.hr: Dobro. Mogu li platiti karticom ili aparat prima samo gotovinu?
learner.en: All right. Can I pay by card, or does the machine only take cash?

partner.en: It takes both. Press here.

learner.hr: Jesam. Sad traži da potvrdim cijenu, ali još nisam odabrala broj karata.
learner.en: Done. Now it's asking me to confirm the price, but I haven't selected the number of tickets yet.

partner.hr: Jedna je već odabrana. Trebate li više?
partner.en: One is already selected. Do you need more?

learner.hr: Trebam dvije. Moja prijateljica čeka s našim torbama na drugoj strani.
learner.en: Two. My friend is waiting with our bags on the other side.

partner.en: There, you can pay now.

learner.hr: Hvala vam. Bez vaše pomoći vjerojatno bih propustila tramvaj.
learner.en: Thank you. Without your help, I'd probably have missed the tram.

conversations.title: A neighbourhood garden proposal

partner.hr: Jesi li pročitala prijedlog za prazno zemljište?
partner.en: Have you read the proposal for the empty plot?

learner.hr: Jesam. Mislim da bi zajednički vrt bio bolji izbor od još jednog parkirališta.
learner.en: Yes. I think a community garden would be a better choice than another car park.

partner.hr: Neki susjedi kažu da nemaju gdje ostaviti auto.
partner.en: Some neighbours say they have nowhere to leave their cars.

learner.hr: Razumijem njihov problem, ali djeca također trebaju prostor izvan kuće.
learner.en: I understand their problem, but children need space outside the house too.

partner.en: How would we pay to prepare it?

learner.hr: Mogli bismo podijeliti troškove i dio posla obaviti dobrovoljno. Ne mora sve biti gotovo odmah.
learner.en: We could share the costs and do some of the work voluntarily. It doesn't all have to be finished immediately.

partner.hr: A tko bi poslije brinuo o biljkama?
partner.en: And who would look after the plants afterwards?

learner.hr: Svaka obitelj mogla bi preuzeti jedan tjedan. Tako odgovornost ne bi pala samo na jednu osobu.
learner.en: Each family could take one week. That way the responsibility wouldn't fall on just one person.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li to predložiti na sastanku?
partner.en: Will you suggest that at the meeting?

learner.hr: Hoću. Prvo ću razgovarati i s onima koji se ne slažu, da čujem njihove razloge.
learner.en: Yes. First I'll talk to those who disagree too, so I can hear their reasons.

partner.hr: Možda pronađemo rješenje koje svima odgovara.
partner.en: Maybe we'll find a solution that works for everyone.

learner.hr: Nadam se. Važno je da odlučimo zajedno, a ne da se posvađamo prije početka.
learner.en: I hope so. It's important that we decide together rather than fall out before we've even started.

conversations.title: A card that stopped working

partner.hr: Dobar dan, kako vam mogu pomoći?
partner.en: Hello, how can I help you?

learner.hr: Dobar dan. Moja kartica od jutros ne radi, a ne znam zbog čega.
learner.en: Hello. My card hasn't worked since this morning, and I don't know why.

partner.hr: Je li problem nastao pri plaćanju ili na bankomatu?
partner.en: Did the problem occur when paying or at an ATM?

learner.hr: Pri plaćanju u dućanu. Aparat je odbio karticu i tražio sam drugi način plaćanja.
learner.en: When paying in a shop. The machine declined the card, and I had to look for another way to pay.

partner.en: Did you try again?

learner.hr: Jesam, u drugom dućanu, ali dogodilo se isto. Imam dovoljno novca na računu.
learner.en: Yes, in another shop, but the same thing happened. I have enough money in my account.

partner.hr: Morat ćemo provjeriti podatke na šalteru.
partner.en: We'll need to check your details at the counter.

learner.hr: U redu. Ponio sam osobnu iskaznicu i karticu, ako vam to treba.
learner.en: All right. I've brought my identity card and bank card if you need them.

partner.hr: Hvala, nemojte naglas govoriti svoj tajni broj.
partner.en: Thank you; don't say your PIN aloud.

learner.hr: Naravno. Samo želim saznati je li kartica oštećena ili je problem u nečem drugom.
learner.en: Of course. I just want to find out whether the card is damaged or the problem is something else.

partner.en: We'll go through it together.

learner.hr: Hvala vam. Ako moram naručiti novu, želio bih znati koliko ću čekati.
learner.en: Thank you. If I have to order a new one, I'd like to know how long I'll have to wait.

conversations.title: Questions during a flat viewing

partner.hr: Izvolite, ovo je stan iz oglasa.
partner.en: Here you are; this is the flat from the advert.

learner.hr: Hvala. Ja sam razgovarala s vašom agenticom jučer, ali nisam znala da ste vi agent za ovu zgradu.
learner.en: Thank you. I spoke to your female colleague yesterday, but I didn't know you were the agent for this building.

partner.hr: Da, danas sam zamijenio kolegicu. Što vas zanima?
partner.en: Yes, I'm covering for my colleague today. What would you like to know?

learner.hr: Najprije adresa. U oglasu je pisala druga ulica pa sam se malo zbunila.
learner.en: The address, first of all. The advert listed another street, so I got a little confused.

partner.hr: Zgrada ima ulaze iz obje ulice.
partner.en: The building has entrances on both streets.

learner.hr: A-ha, sad razumijem. Ima li stan vlastito spremište ili svi koristimo isti prostor?
learner.en: Aha, now I understand. Does the flat have its own storage room, or does everyone use the same space?

partner.en: It has its own storage room in the basement.

learner.hr: Dobro. Mogu li otvoriti prozor da čujem koliko je bučno kad prolaze automobili?
learner.en: Good. May I open the window to hear how noisy it is when cars pass?

partner.hr: Svakako. Želite li pogledati i balkon?
partner.en: Certainly. Would you like to see the balcony too?

learner.hr: Želim. Na fotografijama je djelovao malen, ali čini se da ovdje ipak stanu stol i dvije stolice.
learner.en: Yes. It looked small in the photos, but it seems a table and two chairs would fit here after all.

partner.hr: Hoćete li razmisliti pa nam se javiti?
partner.en: Would you like to think it over and contact us?

learner.hr: Hoću. Prije odluke želim pročitati ugovor i usporediti ukupne troškove.
learner.en: Yes. Before deciding, I want to read the contract and compare the total costs.

conversations.title: Waiting for a bird photograph

partner.hr: Zašto si donio tako velik aparat?
partner.en: Why have you brought such a big camera?

learner.hr: Želim snimiti ptice na drugoj obali. S telefonom ih ne mogu dovoljno približiti.
learner.en: I want to photograph the birds on the other bank. I can't zoom in enough with my phone.

partner.hr: Već sat vremena sjedimo bez ijedne slike.
partner.en: We've been sitting here for an hour without a single picture.

learner.hr: Znam, ali moramo biti strpljivi. Divlje životinje ne dolaze kad ih mi pozovemo.
learner.en: I know, but we have to be patient. Wild animals don't come when we call them.

partner.hr: Možda su se sakrile zbog vjetra.
partner.en: Maybe they're hiding because of the wind.

learner.hr: Moguće. Vidiš li onaj tamni oblak iznad šume? Možda se sprema oluja.
learner.en: Possibly. Can you see that dark cloud above the forest? There might be a storm coming.

partner.hr: Trebamo li otići prije nego što počne kiša?
partner.en: Should we leave before the rain starts?

learner.hr: Pričekaj još minutu. Upravo je jedna ptica sletjela na granu iznad vode.
learner.en: Wait another minute. A bird has just landed on the branch above the water.

partner.en: Did you get the shot?

learner.hr: Jesam. Raširila je krila baš kad sam pritisnuo okidač.
learner.en: Yes. It spread its wings just as I pressed the shutter.

partner.en: So the wait was worth it.

learner.hr: Jest. Sad možemo spremiti opremu i krenuti natrag prije pljuska.
learner.en: Yes. Now we can pack up the equipment and head back before the downpour.

conversations.title: Revising a detective scene

partner.hr: Zašto si prekrižila cijelu završnu scenu?
partner.en: Why have you crossed out the whole final scene?

learner.hr: Zato što detektivka nema dovoljno dokaza. Ne može nekoga optužiti samo na temelju osjećaja.
learner.en: Because the detective doesn't have enough evidence. She can't accuse someone just on the basis of a feeling.

partner.hr: Ali gledatelji već znaju da je on kriv.
partner.en: But the audience already knows he's guilty.

learner.hr: Gledatelji znaju, ali ona još ne zna. Moramo joj dati uvjerljiv razlog da ga ispita.
learner.en: The audience knows, but she doesn't yet. We have to give her a convincing reason to question him.

partner.hr: Što ako svjedok prepozna njegov automobil?
partner.en: What if a witness recognises his car?

learner.hr: To bi pomoglo. Onda možemo pokazati da je njegova priča o odlasku iz grada bila laž.
learner.en: That would help. Then we can show that his story about leaving the city was a lie.

partner.hr: Treba li nam još jedan lik za svjedoka?
partner.en: Do we need another character as the witness?

learner.hr: Ne nužno. Konobar iz prve scene može se vratiti i povezati početak s krajem.
learner.en: Not necessarily. The waiter from the first scene can return and connect the beginning with the ending.

partner.hr: Sviđa mi se. Tko onda vodi ispitivanje?
partner.en: I like it. Who leads the questioning, then?

learner.hr: Detektivka. Njezin kolega može pratiti razgovor i kasnije uočiti detalj koji je ona propustila.
learner.en: The female detective. Her colleague can follow the conversation and later notice a detail she missed.

partner.en: The ending sounds more convincing now.

learner.hr: I meni. Želim da priča bude napeta, ali i da se ponašanje likova može razumjeti.
learner.en: I agree. I want the story to be suspenseful, but I also want the characters' behaviour to make sense.

conversations.title: Remembering neighbours helping after a fire

partner.hr: Zašto na ovoj slici nema krova na kući?
partner.en: Why is there no roof on the house in this picture?

learner.hr: Fotografija je snimljena nakon požara. Vatra je uništila krov, ali nitko nije stradao.
learner.en: The photo was taken after the fire. The fire destroyed the roof, but nobody was hurt.

partner.hr: Gdje ste živjeli dok ste je popravljali?
partner.en: Where did you live while you were repairing it?

learner.hr: Susjedi su nam dali sobu. U njihovoj kući ostali smo gotovo dva mjeseca.
learner.en: The neighbours gave us a room. We stayed in their house for almost two months.

partner.hr: Jesu li vam i drugi pomogli?
partner.en: Did other people help too?

learner.hr: Jesu. Jedni su donijeli hranu, drugi odjeću, a neki su radili na obnovi svaki slobodan dan.
learner.en: Yes. Some brought food, others brought clothes, and some worked on the repairs every day they had off.

partner.hr: Mora da vam je to mnogo značilo.
partner.en: That must have meant a lot to you.

learner.hr: Značilo nam je sve. Bez njihove pomoći ne bismo uspjeli ponovno izgraditi svoj dom.
learner.en: It meant everything. Without their help, we wouldn't have managed to rebuild our home.

partner.hr: Jeste li ostali bliski s tim susjedima?
partner.en: Did you stay close to those neighbours?

learner.hr: Jesmo. Njihova djeca i naši sinovi odrasli su zajedno i još se često druže.
learner.en: Yes. Their children and our sons grew up together and still spend time together often.
