learner.en: That's it! The sky finally makes sense again.

partner.en: Will you frame it?

learner.hr: Hoću, prije nego što mačka predloži novu verziju.
learner.en: Yes, before the cat suggests a new version.

conversations.title: A pupil helps in the school library

partner.hr: Je li ovo mjesto za vraćene knjige?
partner.en: Is this where returned books go?

learner.hr: Jest. Ostavi ih ovdje, pa ću provjeriti popis.
learner.en: Yes. Leave them here, and I'll check the list.

partner.en: May I take another one?

learner.hr: Smiješ. Koju vrstu priče danas tražiš?
learner.en: Yes. What kind of story are you looking for today?

partner.en: Something with a monster.

learner.hr: Imamo jednu u kojoj čudovište zapravo štiti selo.
learner.en: We've got one where the monster actually protects the village.

partner.en: Isn't it frightening?

learner.hr: Nije previše. Više govori o strahu od drukčijih.
learner.en: Not too much. It's more about fear of those who are different.

partner.en: I'll take it.

learner.hr: Dobro. Samo nemoj presavijati stranice kao prošli put.
learner.en: Good. Just don't fold the pages like last time.

conversations.title: A view blocked by a tall hat

partner.en: Why do you keep moving?

learner.hr: Gospodin ispred mene nosi visoku kapu. Ne vidim platno.
learner.en: The gentleman in front of me has a tall hat on. I can't see the screen.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li ga zamoliti da je skine?
partner.en: Will you ask him to take it off?

learner.hr: Hoću. Bolje to nego provesti film gledajući u šešir.
learner.en: Yes. Better than spending the film staring at a hat.

partner.en: What did he say?

learner.hr: Ispričao se. Nije primijetio da nekome zaklanja pogled.
learner.en: He apologised. He hadn't noticed he was blocking anyone's view.

partner.en: Can you see clearly now?

learner.hr: Sad vidim sve, uključujući titlove na dnu.
learner.en: Now I can see everything, including the subtitles at the bottom.

partner.en: It's good that you asked.

learner.hr: Jest. Nisam morala u sebi smišljati cijelu svađu.
learner.en: Yes. I didn't need to imagine a whole argument in my head.

conversations.title: A name the family cannot agree on

partner.hr: Jeste li odabrali ime za bebu?
partner.en: Have you chosen a name for the baby?

learner.hr: Još nismo. Svaki član obitelji ima vlastiti prijedlog.
learner.en: Not yet. Every family member has a suggestion.

partner.en: Who will you leave the decision to?

learner.hr: Nama roditeljima, koliko god ostali voljeli raspravljati.
learner.en: To us parents, however much everyone else likes debating it.

partner.en: Have you at least got a shortlist?

learner.hr: Imamo tri imena, ali nijedno još ne djeluje pravo.
learner.en: Three names, but none feels right yet.

partner.en: Maybe you'll decide when you see her.

learner.hr: Možda. Trenutno je zovemo jednostavno naša djevojčica.
learner.en: Maybe. For now we simply call her our little girl.

partner.en: That sounds lovely too.

learner.hr: Zvuči, ali teško bi stalo u rubriku za ime.
learner.en: It does, but it would hardly fit in the name box.

conversations.title: The wrong jar beside the stove

partner.en: Why are you looking at the soup strangely?

learner.hr: Zato što sam zamijenio sol i šećer.
learner.en: Because I mixed up the salt and sugar.

partner.en: How much did you add?

learner.hr: Dovoljno da znam da ovo više nije obična juha.
learner.en: Enough to know this isn't ordinary soup anymore.

partner.en: Maybe it isn't that bad.

learner.hr: Probaj prije nego što mi odlučiš vjerovati.
learner.en: Try it before you decide to believe me.

partner.en: Oh, it really is sweet.

learner.hr: Znam. Lonac me upravo naučio čitati oznake.
learner.en: I know. The pot has just taught me to read labels.

partner.en: What shall we eat now?

learner.hr: Sendviče. Njih ću barem pripremiti bez tih staklenki.
learner.en: Sandwiches. At least I'll make those without those jars.

conversations.title: A microphone catches a sleepy remark

partner.hr: Znaš da ti je mikrofon uključen?
partner.en: You know your microphone's on?

learner.hr: Sranje, jesu li svi čuli što sam rekao?
learner.en: Damn, did everyone hear what I said?

partner.hr: Čuli smo da ti treba još kave.
partner.en: We heard that you need more coffee.

learner.hr: Dobro. Bojao sam se da sam komentirao sastanak.
learner.en: Good. I was afraid I'd commented on the meeting.

partner.en: No, you just yawned.

learner.hr: Onda imam sreće. Nisam dobro spavao noćas.
learner.en: Then I'm lucky. I didn't sleep well last night.

partner.en: You can turn your camera off briefly.

learner.hr: Hoću, dok donesem vodu i otvorim prozor.
learner.en: I will, while I get water and open the window.

partner.en: We're returning to your presentation.

learner.hr: Spreman sam. Ovaj put slušam i vlastiti mikrofon.
learner.en: I'm ready. This time I'm paying attention to my own microphone too.

conversations.title: A host family asks about arrival

partner.en: When are you coming to England?

learner.hr: U ponedjeljak. Nikad prije nisam bila u Engleskoj.
learner.en: On Monday. I've never been to England before.

partner.hr: Hoće li ti engleski biti problem?
partner.en: Will English be a problem for you?

learner.hr: Razumijem ga, ali engleskog se naglaska malo bojim.
learner.en: I understand it, but I'm a little afraid of the English accent.

partner.en: We'll speak more slowly if needed.

learner.hr: Hvala. Želim vježbati engleski, ne samo klimati glavom.
learner.en: Thank you. I want to practise English, not just nod.

partner.en: How are you travelling from the airport?

learner.hr: Vlakom. Pošalji mi adresu da ne odem krivo.
learner.en: By train. Send me the address so I don't go the wrong way.

partner.en: We'll meet you at the station.

learner.hr: Odlično. Engleska mi već djeluje manje nepoznato.
learner.en: Great. England already feels less unfamiliar.

conversations.title: A postcard arrives after its writer

partner.hr: Stigla je tvoja razglednica iz Njemačke.
partner.en: Your postcard from Germany has arrived.

learner.hr: Stvarno? Ja sam se iz Njemačke vratila prije tjedan dana.
learner.en: Really? I came back from Germany a week ago.

partner.en: It says you're enjoying Berlin.

learner.hr: Jesam. U Berlinu sam upoznala vrlo zanimljive ljude.
learner.en: I did. I met some very interesting people in Berlin.

partner.en: Did you speak German?

learner.hr: Pokušavala sam. Moj njemački bolji je na papiru.
learner.en: I tried. My German is better on paper.

partner.en: Will you travel there again?

learner.hr: Hoću. Njemačka ima još gradova koje želim vidjeti.
learner.en: Yes. Germany has other cities I want to see.

partner.en: I'll keep the postcard.

learner.hr: Sačuvaj. Dokaz je da sam mislila na tebe.
learner.en: Do. It's proof I was thinking of you.

conversations.title: A cousin packs for a long visit

partner.hr: Zašto ti je kovčeg tako velik?
partner.en: Why is your suitcase so big?

learner.hr: Idem u Ameriku na mjesec dana, ne na vikend.
learner.en: I'm going to America for a month, not a weekend.

partner.en: Doesn't your cousin have a washing machine?

learner.hr: Imaju je. Dobro, možda nosim previše odjeće.
learner.en: They do. All right, perhaps I'm bringing too many clothes.

partner.en: What will you do in America?

learner.hr: Posjetit ću obitelj i upoznati njihovu novu djecu.
learner.en: Visit family and meet their new children.

partner.en: Do the children speak Croatian?

learner.hr: Malo. Njihov otac je Amerikanac, ali majka ih uči.
learner.en: A little. Their father is American, but their mother teaches them.

partner.en: Take them a picture book.

learner.hr: Hoću. Za knjigu uvijek mogu izvaditi jednu košulju.
learner.en: I will. I can always remove one shirt for a book.

conversations.title: An unfamiliar menu on holiday

partner.en: Do you understand this menu?

learner.hr: Pomalo. Talijanski sam učio, ali nisam zapamtio nazive jela.
learner.en: A little. I studied Italian but didn't remember the dish names.

partner.en: Order something familiar, then.

learner.hr: Radije ću pitati konobara nego opet jesti isto.
learner.en: I'd rather ask the waiter than eat the same thing again.

partner.en: What are you interested in?

learner.hr: Ovo s povrćem. Ne znam sadrži li i meso.
learner.en: This vegetable dish. I don't know whether it also contains meat.

partner.en: We can point at the menu.

learner.hr: Možemo. Jezik služi razgovoru, ne polaganju ispita.
learner.en: Yes. Language is for communicating, not passing an exam.

partner.en: Here's the waiter.

learner.hr: Dobro, ovaj ću put govoriti ja.
learner.en: Good; I'll do the talking this time.

conversations.title: Brothers arrive in matching suits

partner.en: Did you deliberately dress alike?

learner.hr: Nismo. Moja braća očito imaju isti ukus kao ja.
learner.en: No. My brothers clearly have the same taste as me.

partner.hr: Vi ste svi kupili isto odijelo?
partner.en: You all bought the same suit?

learner.hr: Jesmo, samo su njihove kravate drukčije.
learner.en: Yes; only their ties are different.

partner.hr: Kako ćemo vas razlikovati na slici?
partner.en: How will we tell you apart in the photo?

learner.hr: Po visini. Ja sam najniži od braće.
learner.en: By height. I'm the shortest of the brothers.

partner.en: Call them over to stand together.

learner.hr: Zovem braću već deset minuta, ali ne čuju.
learner.en: I've been calling my brothers for ten minutes, but they can't hear.

partner.en: Maybe they're hiding deliberately.

learner.hr: Onda ću reći da je torta stigla. To čuju.
learner.en: Then I'll say the cake's here. They'll hear that.

conversations.title: An uncle remembers a much larger fish

partner.hr: Tko je ulovio ribu na slici?
partner.en: Who caught the fish in the picture?

learner.hr: Moj stric. Ali stric tvrdi da je bila dvostruko veća.
learner.en: My uncle. But he claims it was twice as big.

partner.en: Maybe you should ask him again.

learner.hr: Striče, koliko je riba zapravo bila velika?
learner.en: Uncle, how big was the fish really?

partner.hr: Kaže da fotografija loše pokazuje veličinu.
partner.en: He says the photograph doesn't show its size well.

learner.hr: Naravno. Kod strica je uvijek kriv aparat.
learner.en: Of course. With my uncle it's always the camera's fault.

partner.hr: Jesi li ti bio s njim?
partner.en: Were you with him?

learner.hr: Jesam. Ribu sam nosio ja, pa se dobro sjećam.
learner.en: Yes. I carried the fish, so I remember it well.

partner.en: Don't spoil his story.

learner.hr: Neću. I mala riba zaslužuje veliku uspomenu.
learner.en: I won't. Even a small fish deserves a big memory.

conversations.title: A recipe hidden in a family book

partner.en: Why are you calling your aunt so early?

learner.hr: Trebam njen recept prije nego što krenem peći.
learner.en: I need her recipe before I start baking.

partner.en: Didn't you write it down?

learner.hr: Jesam, ali sam karticu stavila u nepoznatu knjigu.
learner.en: Yes, but I put the card in a book I can't identify.

partner.en: Maybe the one about cakes.

learner.hr: Prejednostavno. Kod mene važne stvari završe u romanima.
learner.en: Too simple. Important things end up in novels in my house.

partner.en: Here's a slip of paper between the pages.

learner.hr: To je tetkin rukopis! Spasio si mi jutro.
learner.en: That's my aunt's handwriting! You've saved my morning.

partner.en: Now you don't need to wake her.

learner.hr: Ne moram, ali ću joj poslije odnijeti kolač.
learner.en: No, but I'll take her some cake later.

conversations.title: An empty base in a space game

partner.en: Why is the space base empty?

learner.hr: Posada je otišla na drugi planet prije oluje.
learner.en: The crew left for another planet before the storm.

partner.en: How do you know?

learner.hr: Pronašao sam njihov dnevnik u kontrolnoj sobi.
learner.en: I found their diary in the control room.

partner.en: Should we follow them?

learner.hr: Prvo provjerimo gorivo. Naš brod ne može svuda.
learner.en: Let's check the fuel first. Our ship can't go everywhere.

partner.hr: Na karti ima još jedna baza.
partner.en: There's another base on the map.

learner.hr: Vidim je. Ondje bismo mogli napuniti spremnik.
learner.en: I see it. We could fill the tank there.

partner.en: Take the controls.

learner.hr: Preuzimam. Samo mi nemoj opet sakriti koordinate.
learner.en: I'm taking over. Just don't hide the coordinates again.

conversations.title: An admiral with the wrong costume

partner.en: Why are you wearing two different shoes?

learner.hr: Jer admiral nema dovoljno vremena za garderobu.
learner.en: Because the admiral doesn't have enough time for the costume department.

partner.en: The audience will notice.

learner.hr: Onda mi pomogni pronaći drugu crnu cipelu.
learner.en: Then help me find the other black shoe.

partner.en: Admiral, it's under the chair.

learner.hr: Hvala, kapetane. Naša mornarica opet ima urednog zapovjednika.
learner.en: Thank you, Captain. Our navy has a tidy commander again.

partner.en: Do you at least know your lines?

learner.hr: Znam. Zapovijed je jednostavna: svi se vraćamo kući.
learner.en: Yes. The order is simple: we're all going home.

partner.en: That's only at the end.

learner.hr: Znam, ali moj lik od početka priželjkuje kraj.
learner.en: I know, but my character wants the ending from the start.

conversations.title: Confusing two characters in a historical film

partner.en: Is this man the colonel?

learner.hr: Nije. Pukovnik je lik koji je ostao u stožeru.
learner.en: No. The colonel is the character who stayed at headquarters.

partner.en: And who is this one speaking to?

learner.hr: Naredniku. Narednik vodi vojnike do mosta.
learner.en: The sergeant. The sergeant leads the soldiers to the bridge.

partner.en: All the uniforms look the same to me.

learner.hr: I meni, ali pratim lica umjesto oznaka.
learner.en: To me too, but I follow faces rather than insignia.

partner.en: What happened to the lieutenant?

learner.hr: Ostao je pomagati ranjenom vojniku u prethodnoj sceni.
learner.en: He stayed to help the wounded soldier in the previous scene.

partner.en: It's clearer now.

learner.hr: Dobro. Samo nemoj tražiti da ti nacrtam cijelu vojsku.
learner.en: Good. Just don't ask me to draw the whole army for you.

conversations.title: A bird chooses an inconvenient balcony

partner.en: Why aren't you going onto the balcony?

learner.hr: Ptica je napravila gnijezdo među mojim loncima.
learner.en: A bird has built a nest among my pots.

partner.en: Are there eggs already?

learner.hr: Ne vidim dobro. Ne želim joj prilaziti preblizu.
learner.en: I can't see clearly. I don't want to get too close.

partner.en: And where are your plants?

learner.hr: Privremeno unutra. Balkon je očito dobio novog stanara.
learner.en: Temporarily indoors. The balcony clearly has a new resident.

partner.en: Can you photograph it?

learner.hr: Mogu kroz staklo, ali bez otvaranja vrata.
learner.en: Through the glass, yes, without opening the door.

partner.en: You're very hospitable.

learner.hr: Jesam, samo ne znam kako joj naplatiti stanarinu.
learner.en: Yes; I just don't know how to charge her rent.

conversations.title: A child dislikes a carnival costume

partner.en: Why don't you want to go closer to the stage?

learner.hr: Onaj klaun izgleda strašno. Ne sviđa mi se maska. Znam da je to samo glumac, ali uplašen sam. Ne želim da mi priđe.
learner.en: That clown looks scary. I don't like the mask. I know it's only an actor, but I'm scared. I don't want him to approach me.

partner.en: We can stay here.

learner.hr: Dobro. Nemoj me tjerati da se slikam s njim.
learner.en: Good. Don't make me have my photo taken with him.

partner.en: I won't. What would you like to watch?

learner.hr: Plesače s velikim perjem i šarenim šeširima.
learner.en: The dancers with big feathers and colourful hats.

partner.en: They're coming after this group.

learner.hr: Onda ću pričekati. Njihova glazba već se čuje.
learner.en: Then I'll wait. I can already hear their music.

partner.en: Can you see them now?

learner.hr: Vidim! Ovaj dio karnevala puno mi je draži.
learner.en: Yes! I like this part of the carnival much more.

conversations.title: A dancer packs the wrong shoes

partner.en: Are you ready for the audition?

learner.hr: Nisam. Ponijela sam tenisice umjesto plesnih cipela.
learner.en: No. I brought trainers instead of my dance shoes.

partner.hr: Jesu li tvoje još kod kuće?
partner.en: Are yours still at home?

learner.hr: Jesu, ispod kreveta. Potpuno sam zaboravila provjeriti torbu.
learner.en: Yes, under the bed. I completely forgot to check my bag.

partner.en: I've got a spare pair.

learner.hr: Stvarno? Koju veličinu nosiš? Možda imamo iste.
learner.en: Really? What size do you wear? We might be the same.

partner.en: Try them.

learner.hr: Pristaju mi. Dugujem ti veliko hvala.
learner.en: They fit. I owe you a big thank-you.

partner.en: Just return them after the performance.

learner.hr: Hoću. I sutra pakiram torbu prema popisu.
learner.en: I will. And tomorrow I'm packing my bag with a checklist.

conversations.title: A flat tyre changes the day

partner.en: Why are you pushing the bike?

learner.hr: Prednja guma je prazna. Našao sam čavao u njoj.
learner.en: The front tyre's flat. I found a nail in it.

partner.en: Have you got a spare inner tube?

learner.hr: Nemam. Danas sam očito precijenio svoju pripremljenost.
learner.en: No. I've clearly overestimated my preparedness today.

partner.en: The repair shop's nearby.

learner.hr: Znam, ali otvara tek popodne. Ostavit ću bicikl doma.
learner.en: I know, but it doesn't open until the afternoon. I'll leave the bike at home.

partner.en: Will you take the bus, then?

learner.hr: Hoću. Vozač barem neće od mene tražiti pumpu.
learner.en: Yes. At least the driver won't ask me for a pump.

partner.en: See you in the centre.

learner.hr: Vidimo se. Kasnim zbog kotača, ne zbog spavanja.
learner.en: See you. I'm late because of a wheel, not oversleeping.

conversations.title: The camera cannot save another photograph

partner.en: Why aren't you photographing the sunset?

learner.hr: Memorijska kartica je puna, a rezervna je doma.
learner.en: The memory card is full, and the spare is at home.

partner.en: Can you delete old pictures?

learner.hr: Ne znam koje su već kopirane. Ne želim izgubiti uspomene.
learner.en: I don't know which ones are copied already. I don't want to lose memories.

partner.en: Use your phone, then.

learner.hr: Hoću. Ovaj prizor neće čekati da sredim arhivu.
learner.en: I will. This scene won't wait for me to organise my archive.

partner.en: Will the quality be worse?

learner.hr: Možda, ali fotografija će postojati. To je važnije.
learner.en: Maybe, but the photograph will exist. That's more important.

partner.en: The sun's disappearing now.

learner.hr: Vidim. Sad prestajem pričati i počinjem snimati.
learner.en: I see. Now I'll stop talking and start taking pictures.

conversations.title: A password written in the wrong notebook

partner.en: Why are you looking through old notebooks?

learner.hr: Tražim zaporku za svoje staro računalo.
learner.en: I'm looking for the password to my old computer.

partner.en: Don't you have it saved?

learner.hr: Imam, očito u bilježnici koju više ne prepoznajem.
learner.en: I do, apparently in a notebook I no longer recognise.

partner.en: What's important on it?

learner.hr: Fotografije roditelja koje još nisam prebacio na novi uređaj.
learner.en: Photos of my parents that I haven't transferred to the new device yet.

partner.en: Maybe this blue one.

learner.hr: Jest! Prepoznajem oznaku, ali neću naglas čitati zaporku.
learner.en: Yes! I recognise the label, but I won't read the password aloud.

partner.en: Have you got in?

learner.hr: Jesam. Sad prvo radim kopiju, prije novog zaborava.
learner.en: Yes. Now I'm making a copy first, before forgetting again.

conversations.title: Coffee beans with nothing to grind them

partner.en: Will you make coffee?

learner.hr: Htio bih, ali kupio sam zrna umjesto mljevene kave.
learner.en: I'd like to, but I bought beans instead of ground coffee.

partner.en: Have you got a grinder?

learner.hr: Nemam. Ambalaža mi je izgledala potpuno isto.
learner.en: No. The packaging looked exactly the same to me.

partner.en: The neighbour might have one.

learner.hr: Pitat ću je. Ne bih sad izmišljao kuhinjski eksperiment.
learner.en: I'll ask her. I wouldn't invent a kitchen experiment now.

partner.en: What did she say?

learner.hr: Ima ga i pozvala nas je na kavu.
learner.en: She has one and invited us for coffee.

partner.en: Then the problem's solved.

learner.hr: Jest. Moja pogreška pretvorila se u posjet.
learner.en: Yes. My mistake has turned into a visit.

conversations.title: A bowl becomes something else

partner.hr: Je li ovo tvoja prva zdjela?
partner.en: Is this your first bowl?

learner.hr: Jest, ali jedna strana mnogo je viša od druge.
learner.en: Yes, but one side is much higher than the other.

partner.en: Maybe you can fix it.

learner.hr: Pokušala sam. Svaki dodir stvori novu udubinu.
learner.en: I tried. Every touch creates another dent.

partner.en: What does the teacher suggest?

learner.hr: Da prestanem prije nego što nestane i dno.
learner.en: That I stop before the bottom disappears too.

partner.en: What will you use it for?

learner.hr: Za ključeve. Oni se neće žaliti na oblik.
learner.en: Keys. They won't complain about the shape.

partner.en: I think it's charming.

learner.hr: I meni. Barem je nitko neće zamijeniti sa svojom.
learner.en: So do I. At least nobody will mistake it for theirs.

conversations.title: A sword too large for the costume

partner.en: Why can't the knight sit down?

learner.hr: Mač mu zapinje za stolicu svaki put kad se okrene.
learner.en: His sword catches on the chair whenever he turns.

partner.en: Can we use a shorter one?

learner.hr: Možemo. Ovaj rekvizit više odgovara divu nego čovjeku.
learner.en: Yes. This prop suits a giant better than a person.

partner.en: Where are the other swords?

learner.hr: U kutiji iza scene, pored kraljičine krune.
learner.en: In the box backstage, beside the queen's crown.

partner.en: This one's wooden.

learner.hr: Odlično. Izdaleka izgleda isto, a lakši je.
learner.en: Great. It looks the same from a distance and is lighter.

partner.en: He can sit down now.

learner.hr: Napokon. Kraljevski sastanak može početi bez borbe s namještajem.
learner.en: Finally. The royal meeting can begin without fighting the furniture.

conversations.title: A street name on an old map

partner.hr: Zašto ne mogu pronaći ovu ulicu?
partner.en: Why can't I find this street?

learner.hr: Gledaš stari plan. Ulica danas ima drugo ime.
learner.en: You're looking at an old map. The street has a different name today.

partner.en: Have they demolished the houses too?

learner.hr: Nisu sve. Ona velika kuća na uglu još stoji.
learner.en: Not all of them. That big house on the corner is still standing.

partner.en: My great-grandfather lived there.

learner.hr: Onda tražimo kuću, a ne samo stari naziv.
learner.en: Then we're looking for the house, not just the old name.

partner.en: How shall we check the number?

learner.hr: Usporedimo prozore sa slikom koju je baka sačuvala.
learner.en: Let's compare the windows with the picture Grandma kept.

partner.en: They look the same!

learner.hr: Da, prošlost se ipak nije potpuno sakrila.
learner.en: Yes, the past hasn't hidden completely after all.

conversations.title: A rehearsal without its conductor

partner.en: Where's the conductor?

learner.hr: Zapeo je u prometu. Orkestar zasad vodi njegova asistentica.
learner.en: He's stuck in traffic. His assistant is leading the orchestra for now.

partner.en: Shall we start without him?

learner.hr: Hoćemo. Glazbenici već podešavaju instrumente na pozornici.
learner.en: Yes. The musicians are already tuning their instruments on stage.

partner.en: Which part are we rehearsing?

learner.hr: Završnicu, jer puhači i gudači ulaze u različito vrijeme.
learner.en: The finale, because the wind and string players come in at different times.

partner.en: Should I turn the pages?

learner.hr: Da, prati partituru, ne samo glasnoću glazbe.
learner.en: Yes, follow the score, not just how loud the music is.

partner.en: The conductor's just arrived.

learner.hr: Dobro. Neka čuje koliko smo bez njega napredovali.
learner.en: Good. Let him hear how much progress we've made without him.

conversations.title: A ribbon for a memorial wreath

partner.en: What flowers would you like?

learner.hr: Bijele ruže za vijenac. Preminuo je naš susjed.
learner.en: White roses for a wreath. Our neighbour has died.

partner.en: Would you like a ribbon with a message?

learner.hr: Želim. Napisala bih posljednji pozdrav od stanara zgrade.
learner.en: Yes. I'd write a final farewell from the building's residents.

partner.en: Would you like to include names?

learner.hr: Ne pojedinačno. Cijelo susjedstvo htjelo se oprostiti.
learner.en: Not individually. The whole neighbourhood wanted to say goodbye.

partner.en: When's the funeral?

learner.hr: Sutra u podne. Došla bih po vijenac ujutro.
learner.en: Tomorrow at noon. I'd collect the wreath in the morning.

partner.en: It'll be ready.

learner.hr: Hvala vam. Bio je tih čovjek, ali nedostajat će svima.
learner.en: Thank you. He was a quiet man, but everyone will miss him.

conversations.title: Finding a relative at a hospital

partner.en: Are you looking for someone?

learner.hr: Tražim sestru. Rekla je da čeka u prizemlju bolnice.
learner.en: I'm looking for my sister. She said she's waiting on the hospital's ground floor.

partner.en: By the main entrance?

learner.hr: Nisam siguran. Posjetila je našeg oca nakon operacije.
learner.en: I'm not sure. She visited our father after his operation.

partner.en: You can call her.

learner.hr: Pokušavam, ali telefon joj je očito utišan.
learner.en: I'm trying, but her phone is clearly muted.

partner.hr: Je li ono ona kod lifta?
partner.en: Is that her by the lift?

learner.hr: Jest! Nosi očevu torbu i njegov stari ogrtač.
learner.en: Yes! She's carrying Dad's bag and his old dressing gown.

partner.en: It's good that you've found her.

learner.hr: Hvala na pomoći. Sad barem ne lutamo oboje.
learner.en: Thanks for your help. At least we're not both wandering around now.

conversations.title: A child asks about a parent’s work

partner.en: What does your mother do?

learner.hr: Ona je kirurg, a moj otac radi u laboratoriju.
learner.en: She's a surgeon, and my father works in a laboratory.

partner.hr: Želiš li i ti biti liječnik?
partner.en: Do you want to be a doctor too?

learner.hr: Nisam odlučio. Više me zanimaju pokusi nego bolnice.
learner.en: I haven't decided. I'm more interested in experiments than hospitals.

partner.hr: Je li ti otac pokazao laboratorij?
partner.en: Has your father shown you the laboratory?

learner.hr: Jest. Svi su nosili zaštitne naočale i bijele kute.
learner.en: Yes. Everyone wore safety glasses and white coats.

partner.en: Were you allowed to do anything?

learner.hr: Samo promatrati. Nisam dirao uzorke ni uređaje.
learner.en: Only observe. I didn't touch the samples or equipment.

partner.en: And what did you learn?

learner.hr: Da znanstveni rad uključuje više zapisivanja nego u filmovima.
learner.en: That scientific work involves more writing than it does in films.

conversations.title: Waiting in the wrong queue at a bank

partner.en: Why did you take so long?

learner.hr: U banci sam čekala na pogrešnom šalteru.
learner.en: I waited at the wrong counter in the bank.

partner.en: Didn't you take a number?

learner.hr: Jesam, ali za drugu uslugu. Nisam pročitala zaslon.
learner.en: Yes, but for another service. I didn't read the screen.

partner.en: Did you still get everything done?

learner.hr: Jesam. Službenica me uputila kolegi i objasnila postupak.
learner.en: Yes. The clerk directed me to a colleague and explained the procedure.

partner.en: Do you need to go back to the bank?

learner.hr: Ne moram, dokumenti su predani i zahtjev zaprimljen.
learner.en: No, the documents are submitted and the request received.

partner.en: Then we can go home.

learner.hr: Možemo. Danas mi je dosta redova i brojeva.
learner.en: Yes. I've had enough queues and numbers today.

conversations.title: Writing a letter about night-time noise

partner.en: Who are you writing to for so long?

learner.hr: Gradskom vijeću, zbog noćne buke s novog parkirališta.
learner.en: The city council, about night-time noise from the new car park.

partner.hr: Jesi li naveo kada se događa?
partner.en: Have you said when it happens?

learner.hr: Jesam. Zapisao sam datume, vrijeme i trajanje buke.
learner.en: Yes. I've recorded the dates, times and duration of the noise.

partner.en: What are you asking them for?

learner.hr: Odgovor kome se obratiti i postoji li dogovoreno rješenje.
learner.en: An answer about whom to contact and whether there's an agreed solution.

partner.en: Will the neighbours sign?

learner.hr: Hoće. Ne želimo da izgleda kao osobni sukob.
learner.en: Yes. We don't want it to look like a personal dispute.

partner.en: Read it once more before sending.

learner.hr: Hoću. Izbacit ću ljutite komentare i ostaviti činjenice.
learner.en: I will. I'll remove the angry comments and keep the facts.

conversations.title: A statue with a missing hand

partner.en: Why doesn't the statue have a hand?

learner.hr: Oštećen je davno, ali ne piše točno kada.
learner.en: It was damaged long ago, but it doesn't say exactly when.

partner.en: Do they know whom it represents?

learner.hr: Pretpostavljaju da je vladar, zbog odjeće i položaja tijela.
learner.en: They assume it's a ruler, because of the clothing and body position.

partner.en: What was he holding?

learner.hr: Možda žezlo. To je rekonstrukcija, ne sačuvani dokaz.
learner.en: Perhaps a sceptre. That's a reconstruction, not surviving evidence.

partner.en: Can they make him a new one?

learner.hr: Mogli bi, ali tako bi dodali nešto nesigurno izvorniku.
learner.en: They could, but that would add something uncertain to the original.

partner.en: I find him interesting like this too.

learner.hr: I meni. Nedostatak ponekad otvara više pitanja.
learner.en: So do I. Sometimes an absence opens up more questions.

conversations.title: Agreeing on rules for a debate

partner.en: How shall we choose the debate winner?

learner.hr: Prema argumentima, ne prema tome tko govori najglasnije.
learner.en: By the arguments, not by who speaks loudest.

partner.en: How much time does each speaker have?

learner.hr: Dvije minute, a zatim slijede pitanja protivničke ekipe.
learner.en: Two minutes, followed by questions from the opposing team.

partner.en: Are we allowed to interrupt?

learner.hr: Ne. Zapišite prigovor i pričekajte svoj red.
learner.en: No. Write down your objection and wait your turn.

partner.en: Who's watching the time?

learner.hr: Ja. Sudjelujem kao voditelj, a ne kao natjecatelj.
learner.en: I am. I'm taking part as moderator, not competitor.

partner.en: What if the result is tied?

learner.hr: Onda čestitamo objema ekipama. Nije svaka rasprava bitka.
learner.en: Then we'll congratulate both teams. Not every discussion is a battle.

conversations.title: A magic trick reveals the wrong card

partner.en: Is this your card?

learner.hr: Nije. Moja je bila kraljica, a to je as.
learner.en: No. Mine was a queen, and that's an ace.

partner.en: Maybe I misunderstood you.

learner.hr: Nisam ti rekao kartu. To je bio smisao trika.
learner.en: I didn't tell you the card. That was the point of the trick.

partner.en: All right, let's try again.

learner.hr: Može, samo nemoj krišom pogledati špil.
learner.en: Fine; just don't peek at the deck.

partner.en: Now I'm sure.

learner.hr: Ovaj put si pogodio! Kako si to izveo?
learner.en: You got it this time! How did you do that?

partner.en: Magicians don't reveal secrets.

learner.hr: Dobro. Ni publika neće spominjati prvi pokušaj.
learner.en: All right. The audience won't mention the first attempt either.

conversations.title: A character’s name keeps slipping out

partner.en: Why are you laughing during rehearsal?

learner.hr: Stalno kažem Marko, a moj lik treba zvati Johna.
learner.en: I keep saying Marko, but my character's meant to call John.

partner.en: Try saying the whole sentence.

learner.hr: Johne, obećao si da ćeš se vratiti prije mraka.
learner.en: John, you promised you'd return before dark.

partner.en: That was good.

learner.hr: Jest, jer nisam gledala Marka ravno u oči.
learner.en: Yes, because I wasn't looking Marko straight in the eye.

partner.en: What do you say in the next scene?

learner.hr: Adame, jesi li vidio mog brata? Još jedno ime!
learner.en: Adam, have you seen my brother? Another name!

partner.en: You'll get used to it by opening night.

learner.hr: Nadam se. Zasad je predstava potraga za imenima.
learner.en: I hope so. So far the play's a search for names.

conversations.title: A van full of unexpected furniture

partner.en: Have you got a van?

learner.hr: Jesam, ali kombi je manji nego što sam zamišljao.
learner.en: Yes, but the van's smaller than I imagined.

partner.en: Will the wardrobe fit inside?

learner.hr: Stane rastavljen. U kombiju nema mjesta za cijeli ormar.
learner.en: Taken apart, yes. There's no room for the whole wardrobe in the van.

partner.en: What about the sofa?

learner.hr: Kauč ostaje. Kupac će organizirati vlastiti prijevoz.
learner.en: The sofa's staying. The buyer will arrange their own transport.

partner.en: Have you got a list of boxes?

learner.hr: Imam. Najteže kutije označio sam crvenom trakom.
learner.en: Yes. I marked the heaviest boxes with red tape.

partner.en: Then we can start.

learner.hr: Možemo, čim vlasniku vratim ključ od garaže.
learner.en: Yes, as soon as I return the garage key to the owner.

conversations.title: An old fountain returns to the square

partner.en: Why is the square fenced off?

learner.hr: Obnavljaju fontanu. Radnici su upravo vratili kameni rub.
learner.en: They're restoring the fountain. The workers have just replaced the stone rim.

partner.en: Has the pump been repaired?

learner.hr: Još nije. Prvo moraju provjeriti cijevi ispod tla.
learner.en: Not yet. First they need to check the pipes underground.

partner.hr: Sjećaš li se kad je radila?
partner.en: Do you remember it working?

learner.hr: Sjećam se vode i golubova koji su se kupali.
learner.en: I remember the water and the pigeons bathing.

partner.en: Will it look as it did before?

learner.hr: Prema nacrtu hoće, samo će rasvjeta biti nova.
learner.en: According to the drawing, yes; only the lighting will be new.

partner.en: I'm looking forward to the result.

learner.hr: I ja. Trg bez nje djeluje nekako prazan.
learner.en: Me too. The square feels rather empty without it.

conversations.title: A photograph from an old journey

partner.en: Where did you take this photograph?

learner.hr: U Africi, tijekom putovanja s prijateljicom.
learner.en: In Africa, during a trip with a friend.

partner.en: Did you see wild animals?

learner.hr: Jesam, ali iz vozila i uz vodiča.
learner.en: Yes, but from a vehicle and with a guide.

partner.hr: Što ti je ostalo u sjećanju?
partner.en: What stayed in your memory?

learner.hr: Tišina pred zoru i boje na nebu.
learner.en: The silence before dawn and the colours in the sky.

partner.en: Why don't you have more pictures?

learner.hr: Aparat mi se pokvario. Većinu prizora pamtim bez fotografija.
learner.en: My camera broke. I remember most scenes without photographs.

partner.en: Would you go again?

learner.hr: Bih, ali ne da ponovim potpuno isto putovanje.
learner.en: Yes, but not to repeat exactly the same journey.

conversations.title: Two friends choose shirts for a match

partner.en: Which shirt are you wearing today?

learner.hr: Crvenu. Moj prijatelj Amerikanac posudio mi je svoju.
learner.en: A red one. My American friend lent me his.

partner.en: Are you supporting his team?

learner.hr: Danas da. Britanci iz susjednog stana navijaju protiv nas.
learner.en: Today, yes. The British people next door support the other side.

partner.en: Will you argue?

learner.hr: Nećemo. Naš sportski rivalitet završava nakon zvižduka.
learner.en: No. Our sporting rivalry ends after the whistle.

partner.en: Who's preparing the food?

learner.hr: Oni. Mi donosimo pića i američki umak.
learner.en: They are. We're bringing drinks and American sauce.

partner.en: And who's washing up?

learner.hr: To nismo dogovorili. Tu bi mogao početi pravi sukob.
learner.en: We haven't agreed on that. That could start the real conflict.

conversations.title: A confusing family in a mythology comic

partner.en: Why are you reading the same page again?

learner.hr: Ovi bogovi imaju previše rođaka. Gubim se među imenima.
learner.en: These gods have too many relatives. I'm getting lost among the names.

partner.en: Isn't there a family tree?

learner.hr: Ima. Ovaj bog je onome brat, ali i neprijatelj.
learner.en: There is. This god is that one's brother, but also his enemy.

partner.en: Why are they quarrelling?

learner.hr: Zbog vlasti. Svaki tvrdi da njemu pripada kraljevstvo.
learner.en: Over power. Each claims the kingdom belongs to him.

partner.en: Do people help them?

learner.hr: Neki vjeruju jednom bogu, drugi drugome. Sve je zapetljano.
learner.en: Some believe in one god, others in another. It's all tangled.

partner.en: Will you finish the comic?

learner.hr: Hoću. Crteži su prekrasni, čak i kad zaplet ne razumijem.
learner.en: Yes. The drawings are beautiful even when I don't understand the plot.

conversations.title: A fishing trip becomes a picnic

partner.en: Why aren't you taking out the rod?

learner.hr: Zaboravio sam dozvolu. Neću pecati dok to ne provjerim.
learner.en: I forgot my permit. I won't fish until I've checked that.

partner.en: Are we going home?

learner.hr: Ne moramo. Ponijeli smo hranu i deku.
learner.en: We don't have to. We brought food and a blanket.

partner.en: So we'll just sit here?

learner.hr: Možemo hodati uz obalu i promatrati ribare.
learner.en: We can walk along the bank and watch the anglers.

partner.en: I hadn't planned that.

learner.hr: Nisam ni ja, ali rijeka je lijepa i bez ulova.
learner.en: Neither had I, but the river's lovely even without a catch.

partner.en: Open the sandwiches, then.

learner.hr: Otvaram. Ribe su danas sigurno zadovoljne našom organizacijom.
learner.en: I'm opening them. The fish must be pleased with our organisation today.

conversations.title: A label reveals the wrong gift

partner.hr: Je li ovo vino za mog oca?
partner.en: Is this wine for my father?

learner.hr: Mislio sam da jest, ali na etiketi piše ocat.
learner.en: I thought so, but the label says vinegar.

partner.en: How did you mix them up?

learner.hr: Boce su stajale zajedno. Gledao sam oblik, ne sadržaj.
learner.en: The bottles were together. I looked at the shape, not the contents.

partner.en: At least he likes cooking.

learner.hr: Voli, ali ocat ipak nije isto što i boca vina.
learner.en: He does, but vinegar still isn't the same as a bottle of wine.

partner.en: We can add olive oil.

learner.hr: Dobra ideja. Tako poklon djeluje namjerno odabran.
learner.en: Good idea. Then the gift looks deliberately chosen.

partner.en: Will you tell him?

learner.hr: Hoću. Priča će ga više nasmijati nego etiketa.
learner.en: Yes. The story will amuse him more than the label.

conversations.title: Choosing wood for a small shelf

partner.en: Which board would you like?

learner.hr: Ovu svjetliju, ako je dovoljno čvrsta za knjige.
learner.en: This lighter one, if it's strong enough for books.

partner.en: Have you measured the space?

learner.hr: Jesam. Polica mora stati između ormara i zida.
learner.en: Yes. The shelf has to fit between the wardrobe and wall.

partner.en: We've got darker wood too.

learner.hr: Vidim, ali tamna boja ne odgovara ostalom namještaju.
learner.en: I see, but a dark colour doesn't match the other furniture.

partner.en: What length do we need?

learner.hr: Zapisala sam mjere. Neću ovaj put nagađati rukama.
learner.en: I wrote down the measurements. I won't guess with my hands this time.

partner.en: Show the note to the craftsman, then.

learner.hr: Hoću. Ja biram izgled, a on neka procijeni izvedbu.
learner.en: I will. I'll choose the appearance and let him assess the construction.

conversations.title: A curtain stops the show before it begins

partner.en: Why's the audience still waiting?

learner.hr: Zastor se zaglavio. Tehničar pokušava otkriti uzrok.
learner.en: The curtain's stuck. The technician is trying to find the cause.

partner.en: Can we start without it?

learner.hr: Možemo ako redatelj odobri promjenu ulaska.
learner.en: Yes, if the director approves changing the entrance.

partner.en: What should I tell the actors?

learner.hr: Neka ostanu spremni i neka nitko ne dira mehanizam.
learner.en: Tell them to stay ready and not touch the mechanism.

partner.en: The technician says he needs time.

learner.hr: Onda objavimo kratku odgodu, umjesto da publika nagađa.
learner.en: Then let's announce a short delay instead of leaving the audience guessing.

partner.en: The curtain just moved!

learner.hr: Odlično. Večeras je i on odlučio imati glavnu ulogu.
learner.en: Great. Tonight it's decided to have a leading role too.

conversations.title: A helmet that blocks an actor’s hearing

partner.hr: Zašto ne odgovaraš na moj tekst?
partner.en: Why aren't you responding to my lines?

learner.hr: Pod ovom kacigom gotovo ništa ne čujem.
learner.en: I can barely hear anything under this helmet.

partner.en: The audience needs to hear the answer.

learner.hr: Znam, ali moram i ja čuti pitanje.
learner.en: I know, but I need to hear the question too.

partner.hr: Možeš li je skinuti u sceni?
partner.en: Can you take it off in the scene?

learner.hr: Mogu. Moj vojnik upravo se vratio s dugog puta.
learner.en: Yes. My soldier has just returned from a long journey.

partner.en: Put it on the bench, then.

learner.hr: Hoću. Odložit ću i štit da mogu sjesti.
learner.en: I will. I'll put down the shield too so I can sit.

partner.en: Let's try again now.

learner.hr: Spreman sam. Vojnik konačno može slušati naredbe.
learner.en: I'm ready. The soldier can finally hear the orders.

conversations.title: A first visit to the ice rink

partner.hr: Jesi li već stao na led?
partner.en: Have you stepped onto the ice yet?

learner.hr: Jesam, i odmah shvatio zašto svi drže ogradu.
learner.en: Yes, and immediately understood why everyone's holding the rail.

partner.en: Do the skates hurt?

learner.hr: Malo. Stopala mi nisu navikla na ovakvu obuću.
learner.en: A little. My feet aren't used to footwear like this.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li prvo polako uz rub?
partner.en: Will you start slowly along the edge?

learner.hr: Hoću. Ne treba mi brzina nego ravnoteža.
learner.en: Yes. I need balance, not speed.

partner.en: You're staying upright better now.

learner.hr: Hvala. S leda se grad vidi iz sasvim drugog kuta.
learner.en: Thanks. From the ice the city looks quite different.

partner.en: Another lap?

learner.hr: Hoću, ali poslije sjedam. Dosta mi je hladnoće.
learner.en: Yes, but then I'm sitting down. I've had enough cold.

conversations.title: Choosing ice cream takes too long

partner.hr: Jesi li odlučila koji okus želiš?
partner.en: Have you decided which flavour you want?

learner.hr: Nisam. Sladoled od pistacije izgleda odlično, ali volim čokoladu.
learner.en: No. The pistachio ice cream looks great, but I love chocolate.

partner.en: Get a scoop of each.

learner.hr: Dobra ideja. Gladna sam dovoljno za dvije.
learner.en: Good idea. I'm hungry enough for two.

partner.en: Would you like a cone?

learner.hr: Radije čašicu. Sladoled mi se uvijek otopi po prstima.
learner.en: A cup, preferably. Ice cream always melts over my fingers.

partner.en: There, it's melting already.

learner.hr: Onda prestajem govoriti i počinjem jesti.
learner.en: Then I'll stop talking and start eating.

partner.en: Is the pistachio good?

learner.hr: Izvrsna. Sljedeći put uzimam dvije iste kuglice.
learner.en: Excellent. Next time I'm getting two scoops of the same flavour.

conversations.title: A drawing on the back of an important page

partner.en: Why did you hide the drawing?

learner.hr: Nacrtala sam portret na poleđini tvog važnog papira.
learner.en: I drew a portrait on the back of your important document.

partner.en: Which document?

learner.hr: Onog s pečatom. Mislila sam da je običan papir.
learner.en: The one with the stamp. I thought it was ordinary paper.

partner.en: That's only a copy.

learner.hr: Hvala bogu. Već sam zamišljala veliko objašnjavanje.
learner.en: Thank goodness. I was already imagining a long explanation.

partner.en: Show me the portrait.

learner.hr: Evo. Tvoj nos ispao je malo predugačak.
learner.en: Here. Your nose came out a little too long.

partner.en: At least I recognise myself.

learner.hr: Onda crtež vrijedi sačuvati, čak i na službenom papiru.
learner.en: Then the drawing's worth keeping, even on official paper.

conversations.title: An inscription for someone else

partner.en: Whom should I dedicate the book to?

learner.hr: Mojoj majci. Ona prati vaš rad od prvog romana.
learner.en: My mother. She's followed your work since the first novel.

partner.en: What's her name?

learner.hr: Marija. Željela je doći, ali danas radi.
learner.en: Marija. She wanted to come, but she's working today.

partner.en: Would you like a personal autograph too?

learner.hr: Ne treba meni. Njoj će vaš potpis puno značiti.
learner.en: Not for me. Your signature will mean a lot to her.

partner.en: What does she like about my stories?

learner.hr: Kaže da poznaje ljude poput vaših likova.
learner.en: She says she knows people like your characters.

partner.en: That's a lovely compliment.

learner.hr: Mogu vas fotografirati s knjigom, ako vam ne smeta?
learner.en: May I photograph you with the book, if you don't mind?

conversations.title: Watching a riding lesson before joining

partner.en: Will you ride too?

learner.hr: Danas ću samo gledati konje i razgovarati s instruktorom.
learner.en: Today I'll just watch the horses and talk to the instructor.

partner.en: Are you afraid of them?

learner.hr: Pomalo. Konj je mnogo veći kad stojiš uz njega.
learner.en: A little. A horse is much bigger when you're standing beside it.

partner.en: This one is used to beginners.

learner.hr: Dobro. Ipak želim prvo naučiti kako se ponašati.
learner.en: Good. Still, I want to learn how to behave first.

partner.en: The instructor will explain everything.

learner.hr: Nadam se. Moje znanje zasad dolazi uglavnom iz filmova.
learner.en: I hope so. So far my knowledge mostly comes from films.

partner.en: Will you stay until the end?

learner.hr: Hoću. Već mi je zanimljivo promatrati različite pokrete.
learner.en: Yes. Watching the different movements is already interesting.

conversations.title: An assignment has no recorded mark

partner.en: Did you need to ask me something?

learner.hr: Da, profesore. Za moj sastavak još nema ocjene.
learner.en: Yes, Professor. My essay still has no mark.

partner.hr: Jesi li ga predala na vrijeme?
partner.en: Did you submit it on time?

learner.hr: Jesam. Poslala sam ga zajedno s ostalim zadacima.
learner.en: Yes. I sent it together with the other assignments.

partner.en: Have you got a sending confirmation?

learner.hr: Imam. Učitelj iz drugog predmeta savjetovao mi je čuvati potvrde.
learner.en: Yes. A teacher from another subject advised me to keep them.

partner.hr: Pronašao sam ga u drugoj mapi.
partner.en: I've found it in another folder.

learner.hr: Dobro. Bojala sam se da je moj trud izgubljen.
learner.en: Good. I was afraid my effort was lost.

partner.en: I'll look at it today.

learner.hr: Hvala. Važnije mi je čuti komentar nego samo broj.
learner.en: Thank you. Hearing your feedback matters more to me than just the number.

conversations.title: A photograph helps at a station

partner.hr: Kako si se snašao u Parizu?
partner.en: How did you manage in Paris?

learner.hr: Uz kartu i nekoliko francuskih riječi koje sam zapamtio.
learner.en: With a map and a few French words I remembered.

partner.en: Did French help you?

learner.hr: Jest, ali fotografija naziva stanice pomogla je još više.
learner.en: Yes, but a photo of the station name helped even more.

partner.en: Why did you photograph it?

learner.hr: Da mogu pokazati kamo želim kad pogrešno izgovorim naziv.
learner.en: So I could show where I wanted to go when I mispronounced the name.

partner.en: Did you learn something anyway?

learner.hr: Jesam. Sad znam pitati za smjer bez potpunog očaja.
learner.en: Yes. Now I can ask for directions without complete despair.

partner.en: Will you go to Paris again?

learner.hr: Hoću, ali ovaj put želim bolje razumjeti odgovore.
learner.en: Yes, but this time I want to understand the answers better.

conversations.title: A picnic spot is not where the map suggests

partner.hr: Je li ovo livada koju tražimo?
partner.en: Is this the meadow we're looking for?

learner.hr: Ne, ovo je polje. Put se nastavlja uz ogradu.
learner.en: No, this is a field. The path continues along the fence.

partner.en: Can we cross it?

learner.hr: Radije ne. Vidim usjeve i ne želim ih gaziti.
learner.en: I'd rather not. I can see crops and don't want to trample them.

partner.en: How much farther do we walk?

learner.hr: Prema karti, manje od kilometra do rijeke.
learner.en: According to the map, less than a kilometre to the river.

partner.en: I'm hungry already.

learner.hr: I ja. Zato sam ponio više hrane nego opreme.
learner.en: Me too. That's why I brought more food than equipment.

partner.en: There's the grassy bank.

learner.hr: Napokon. Sad deka može izaći iz ruksaka.
learner.en: Finally. Now the blanket can come out of the backpack.

conversations.title: A client receives the wrong colour

partner.en: Why's the client calling again?

learner.hr: Dobio je crvene stolice, a naručio je crne.
learner.en: He received red chairs but ordered black ones.

partner.en: Was the quotation clear?

learner.hr: Jest. Provjerila sam ponudu i potvrdu narudžbe.
learner.en: Yes. I checked the quotation and order confirmation.

partner.en: Where did the error happen?

learner.hr: U skladištu su zamijenili oznake dviju pošiljki.
learner.en: The warehouse mixed up the labels on two shipments.

partner.en: What shall we tell the client?

learner.hr: Ispričat ćemo se i dati točan plan zamjene.
learner.en: We'll apologise and give a precise plan for the replacement.

partner.en: Will you call him?

learner.hr: Hoću, čim potvrdim prijevoz, da ne obećavam napamet.
learner.en: Yes, as soon as I confirm transport, so I don't make promises blindly.

conversations.title: A cat makes a difficult painting subject

partner.hr: Zašto je mačka na slici siva?
partner.en: Why's the cat grey in the picture?

learner.hr: Zato što se crna i bijela boja još nisu osušile.
learner.en: Because the black and white paint hasn't dried yet.

partner.en: Your cat isn't grey.

learner.hr: Znam. Njezin bijeli trbuh upravo se spojio s crnim leđima.
learner.en: I know. Her white belly has just merged with her black back.

partner.en: Can you fix it later?

learner.hr: Mogu kad se podloga osuši. Sad samo razmazujem boju.
learner.en: Yes, when the base dries. Now I'm just smearing paint.

partner.hr: Hoće li ti opet mirno sjediti?
partner.en: Will she sit still for you again?

learner.hr: Neće. Morat ću koristiti fotografiju umjesto živog modela.
learner.en: No. I'll need to use a photograph instead of a live model.

partner.en: Or paint a grey cat.

learner.hr: To bi bilo jednostavnije, ali moja bi se uvrijedila.
learner.en: That would be simpler, but mine would be offended.

conversations.title: Arriving at a mountain hut

partner.en: Did you reach the summit?

learner.hr: Jesmo. S vrha planine vidjeli smo čak i udaljeno jezero.
learner.en: Yes. From the mountaintop we could even see the distant lake.

partner.en: Was the climb difficult?

learner.hr: Posljednji dio jest. Noge su mi postale teške.
learner.en: The last part was. My legs grew heavy.

partner.en: Would you like tea or soup?

learner.hr: Juhu, molim. Treba mi topao obrok prije povratka.
learner.en: Soup, please. I need a warm meal before returning.

partner.en: You can sit by the stove.

learner.hr: Hvala. Gore je zrak bio mnogo hladniji nego ovdje.
learner.en: Thank you. Up there the air was much colder than here.

partner.en: When are you continuing?

learner.hr: Kad se odmorimo. Planine nisu mjesto za našu žurbu.
learner.en: Once we've rested. The mountains aren't a place for our rushing.

conversations.title: A supporter at the wrong finish line

partner.hr: Jesi li me vidio na cilju?
partner.en: Did you see me at the finish?

learner.hr: Nisam. Čekao sam ispod natpisa za pet kilometara.
learner.en: No. I waited under the sign for five kilometres.

partner.en: I ran ten.

learner.hr: Sad znam. Zato su svi prolazili mnogo ranije.
learner.en: I know now. That's why everyone passed much earlier.

partner.en: Did you at least keep the water?

learner.hr: Jesam. Imam i tvoju jaknu i bananu.
learner.en: Yes. I've also got your jacket and a banana.

partner.en: Where are you now?

learner.hr: Uz glavnu pozornicu, gdje dijele nagrade.
learner.en: By the main stage, where they're handing out prizes.

partner.en: I'm coming slowly.

learner.hr: Čekam te. Danas si ti prešla dovoljno kilometara za oboje.
learner.en: I'll wait. Today you've covered enough kilometres for both of us.

conversations.title: A dress that needs a different hem

partner.en: What would you like changed on the dress?

learner.hr: Haljina je preduga. Rub mi se vuče po podu.
learner.en: The dress is too long. The hem drags on the floor.

partner.hr: Imate li cipele za tu večer?
partner.en: Have you got the shoes for that evening?

learner.hr: Imam. Ponijela sam ih da mjera bude točna.
learner.en: Yes. I brought them so the measurement will be right.

partner.en: Is this red ribbon staying?

learner.hr: Ostaje, ali maknula bih mašnu s leđa.
learner.en: Yes, but I'd remove the bow from the back.

partner.en: We can use it as a decoration.

learner.hr: Radije je sačuvajte. Možda je dodam torbici kasnije.
learner.en: Please keep it instead. I might add it to my handbag later.

partner.en: Come for a fitting on Friday.

learner.hr: Hoću. Veselim se konačno hodati bez podizanja haljine.
learner.en: I will. I'm looking forward to walking without lifting the dress.

conversations.title: A new guest finds his bunk

partner.en: Is this room twelve?

learner.hr: Jest. Dobrodošao, tvoj je donji krevet uz prozor.
learner.en: Yes. Welcome; yours is the lower bunk by the window.

partner.en: Where can I leave my things?

learner.hr: U ormariću ispod kreveta. Svaki gost dobije vlastiti ključ.
learner.en: In the locker below the bed. Each guest gets their own key.

partner.en: Have you eaten already?

learner.hr: Jesmo, ali kuhinja je još otvorena ako si gladan.
learner.en: Yes, but the kitchen's still open if you're hungry.

partner.hr: Smeta li vam da prvo nazovem doma?
partner.en: Do you mind if I call home first?

learner.hr: Ne smeta. Samo ćemo kasnije prigušiti svjetlo zbog spavanja.
learner.en: No. We'll just dim the light later for sleeping.

partner.en: Thanks; I'll keep it short.

learner.hr: U redu. Ako trebaš punjač, moj je u slobodnoj utičnici.
learner.en: All right. If you need a charger, mine's in the spare socket.

conversations.title: A familiar tram takes an unfamiliar turn

partner.en: Why's the tram turning here?

learner.hr: Izgleda da je linija privremeno promijenjena zbog radova.
learner.en: It seems the route's temporarily changed because of roadworks.

partner.en: Did you hear the announcement?

learner.hr: Nisam jasno. Pitajmo na kojoj stanici trebamo izaći.
learner.en: Not clearly. Let's ask which stop we need to get off at.

partner.en: The driver says the next one.

learner.hr: Dobro. Stanica je blizu mosta pa možemo nastaviti pješice.
learner.en: Good. The stop's near the bridge, so we can continue on foot.

partner.en: Will we be late?

learner.hr: Možda malo. Poslat ću poruku da nas pričekaju.
learner.en: Maybe a little. I'll send a message asking them to wait.

partner.en: I've never got off here before.

learner.hr: Nisam ni ja. Promjena linije donijela nam je novu šetnju.
learner.en: Neither have I. The route change has given us a new walk.

conversations.title: A chorus nobody can stop singing

partner.hr: Možeš li prestati pjevati tu pjesmu?
partner.en: Can you stop singing that song?

learner.hr: Pokušavam, ali refren mi se stalno vraća.
learner.en: I'm trying, but the chorus keeps coming back to me.

partner.hr: Čula sam ga već dvadeset puta.
partner.en: I've heard it twenty times already.

learner.hr: Znam. Ni ja više ne uživam u vlastitom glasu.
learner.en: I know. Even I don't enjoy my own voice anymore.

partner.en: Why don't you listen to another song?

learner.hr: Dobra ideja. Možda nova melodija istisne staru.
learner.en: Good idea. Maybe a new tune will push the old one out.

partner.en: Just not loudly.

learner.hr: Stavit ću slušalice. Ti zaslužuješ malo tišine.
learner.en: I'll put headphones on. You deserve some quiet.

partner.en: You're humming again.

learner.hr: Znam, ali sad barem imamo drugi problem.
learner.en: I know, but at least now we have a different problem.

conversations.title: An unexpected prize in the post

partner.en: What arrived in the post?

learner.hr: Obavijest da je moja pjesma dobila nagradu.
learner.en: A notice that my poem has won a prize.

partner.hr: Nisam znao da si je poslala.
partner.en: I didn't know you'd submitted it.

learner.hr: Jesam, ali nisam očekivala pobjedu. Gotovo sam zaboravila natječaj.
learner.en: I did, but I wasn't expecting to win. I'd almost forgotten the competition.

partner.en: Will you go to the ceremony?

learner.hr: Hoću. Moram pročitati pjesmu pred publikom.
learner.en: Yes. I have to read the poem to an audience.

partner.en: Does that sound frightening to you?

learner.hr: Malo. Papir ne vidi kad mi drhte ruke.
learner.en: A little. Paper doesn't notice when my hands shake.

partner.en: We'll practise together.

learner.hr: Hvala. Nagrada je lijepa, ali podrška mi sada više treba.
learner.en: Thank you. The prize is lovely, but I need support more right now.

conversations.title: Apples remain out of reach

partner.en: Why are you just looking at the apples?

learner.hr: Najljepše su na vrhu, a ljestve su kod susjeda.
learner.en: The loveliest ones are at the top, and the ladder's at the neighbour's.

partner.en: Can we reach them with a branch?

learner.hr: Radije bih pričekao. Ne želim uništiti grane zbog žurbe.
learner.en: I'd rather wait. I don't want to damage branches by rushing.

partner.en: We can pick these lower ones.

learner.hr: Možemo. Donesi košaru pa ćemo početi s njima.
learner.en: Yes. Bring the basket, and we'll start with those.

partner.en: How many do we need for pie?

learner.hr: Dovoljno ih već imamo. Ostale ćemo odnijeti baki.
learner.en: We've already got enough. We'll take the others to Grandma.

partner.en: And those at the top?

learner.hr: Njihova najveća prednost zasad je dobar pogled na nas.
learner.en: Their biggest advantage for now is a good view of us.

conversations.title: A school balloon drifts out of frame

partner.en: Did the camera record the balloon?

learner.hr: Samo početak leta. Poslije ga je vjetar odnio iz kadra.
learner.en: Only the start of the flight. Then the wind carried it out of frame.

partner.en: Do we at least have measurements?

learner.hr: Imamo vrijeme i smjer, ali ne pouzdanu visinu.
learner.en: We have the time and direction, but not a reliable height.

partner.en: What will we write in the report?

learner.hr: Točno to. Nećemo izmišljati podatke koji nedostaju.
learner.en: Exactly that. We won't invent the missing data.

partner.en: Can we repeat the experiment?

learner.hr: Možemo nakon dogovora s učiteljicom i bolje pripreme.
learner.en: Yes, after discussing it with the teacher and preparing better.

partner.en: What do we change next time?

learner.hr: Položaj kamere. I netko mora pratiti balon, ne nas.
learner.en: The camera position. And someone needs to follow the balloon, not us.

conversations.title: A shift swap for a family event

partner.hr: Možeš li zamijeniti smjenu sa mnom?
partner.en: Can you swap shifts with me?

learner.hr: Možda. Koji dan trebaš biti slobodna?
learner.en: Maybe. Which day do you need off?

partner.en: Sunday, for a family lunch.

learner.hr: Ja mogu u nedjelju ako ti preuzmeš moju srijedu.
learner.en: I can work Sunday if you take my Wednesday.

partner.en: Wednesday works for me.

learner.hr: Onda provjerimo s voditeljem prije nego što promijenimo raspored.
learner.en: Then let's check with the supervisor before changing the rota.

partner.en: He agrees.

learner.hr: Odlično. Zapiši promjenu da kolege ne dobiju krivu informaciju.
learner.en: Great. Write down the change so our colleagues don't get the wrong information.

partner.en: Thanks; it means a lot.

learner.hr: Nema na čemu. Sljedeća usluga možda će trebati meni.
learner.en: You're welcome. Maybe I'll need the next favour.

conversations.title: A safe that is not the final puzzle

partner.en: Have you opened the safe?

learner.hr: Jesam, ali unutra je samo novi trag.
learner.en: Yes, but there's only another clue inside.

partner.en: What does the paper say?

learner.hr: Da inspektor nije pregledao sve ladice.
learner.en: That the inspector hasn't searched every drawer.

partner.en: Then we've got more work.

learner.hr: Imamo, detektive. Istraživanje očito nije završilo s bravom.
learner.en: We have, Detective. The investigation clearly didn't end with the lock.

partner.en: I've found another envelope.

learner.hr: Otvori je. Možda konačno saznamo tko je izmišljeni lopov.
learner.en: Open it. Maybe we'll finally discover who the fictional thief is.

partner.en: There are two minutes left.

learner.hr: Onda prestajem nagađati i čitam svaki red pažljivo.
learner.en: Then I'll stop guessing and read every line carefully.

conversations.title: An extra cannot stop moving

partner.en: Why did they repeat the shot?

learner.hr: Pomaknuo sam glavu. Moj lik trebao bi biti mrtav.
learner.en: I moved my head. My character's supposed to be dead.

partner.en: Is it uncomfortable lying there?

learner.hr: Jest. Tijelo mi je ukočeno nakon svih ponavljanja.
learner.en: Yes. My body's stiff after all the repeats.

partner.en: Can you ask for a break?

learner.hr: Jesam. Redatelj se slaže da i mrtvi trebaju odmor.
learner.en: I have. The director agrees even the dead need a rest.

partner.en: What do you do while filming?

learner.hr: Gledam jednu točku i pokušavam ne reagirati na buku.
learner.en: I look at one spot and try not to react to noise.

partner.en: Will you be an extra again?

learner.hr: Hoću, ali drugi put biram živog prolaznika.
learner.en: Yes, but next time I'll choose a living passer-by.

conversations.title: A costume stain before a party

partner.en: Why are you washing the collar?

learner.hr: Lažna krv s kostima ostavila je mrlju na košulji.
learner.en: The fake blood from the costume left a stain on my shirt.

partner.en: How much did you use?

learner.hr: Previše. Htio sam izgledati kao vampir iz filma.
learner.en: Too much. I wanted to look like a vampire from a film.

partner.en: Where are your teeth?

learner.hr: U kutiji. S njima nisam mogao jasno govoriti.
learner.en: In the box. I couldn't speak clearly with them.

partner.en: Now you look like a tired waiter.

learner.hr: Znam. Od strašnog lika ostali su samo crni plašt i podočnjaci.
learner.en: I know. All that's left of the scary character is a black cape and dark circles.

partner.en: Will you go to the party anyway?

learner.hr: Hoću. Možda osvojim nagradu za najzbunjenijeg vampira.
learner.en: Yes. Maybe I'll win the prize for the most confused vampire.

conversations.title: A parcel is heavier than expected

partner.en: Do you know the parcel's weight?

learner.hr: Ne točno. U njemu su knjige i vuneni šal.
learner.en: Not exactly. It contains books and a woollen scarf.

partner.en: Put it on the scale.

learner.hr: Izvolite. Nisam očekivala da papir može biti tako težak.
learner.en: Here you are. I didn't expect paper to weigh so much.

partner.en: Have you got the full address?

learner.hr: Imam ulicu, broj i poštanski broj primatelja.
learner.en: I have the street, number and recipient's postcode.

partner.en: Would you like a receipt?

learner.hr: Želim, da mogu javiti sestri da je pošiljka predana.
learner.en: Yes, so I can tell my sister the parcel's been sent.

partner.en: Keep this number.

learner.hr: Hoću. Pošaljite paket, a ja ću joj poslati poruku. Htjela bih je razveseliti prije nego što diplomira. Godinama je učila za tu diplomu.
learner.en: I will. Send the parcel, and I'll send her a message. I'd like to cheer her up before she graduates. She studied for years for that diploma.

conversations.title: A conference badge has the wrong job title

partner.en: Why have you covered part of your badge?

learner.hr: Piše da sam direktor, a zapravo predstavljam mali tim.
learner.en: It says I'm the director, but I'm actually representing a small team.

partner.en: Maybe the organiser made a mistake.

learner.hr: Očito. Ne želim da klijenti dobiju pogrešan dojam.
learner.en: Clearly. I don't want clients to get the wrong impression.

partner.en: Have you asked for a new one?

learner.hr: Jesam. Rekli su da mogu ispisati ispravnu oznaku.
learner.en: Yes. They said they can print a correct badge.

partner.en: Until then you're the boss anyway.

learner.hr: Nisam. Šefe, to ću prepustiti nekome s većom plaćom.
learner.en: No. Boss, I'll leave that to someone with a bigger salary.

partner.en: Here's the new badge.

learner.hr: Odlično. Moja kratka karijera direktora upravo je završila.
learner.en: Great. My brief career as director has just ended.

conversations.title: The last crate of fruit

partner.en: Is this the last crate?

learner.hr: Jest. Ostalo voće već su kupili restorani.
learner.en: Yes. The restaurants have already bought the other fruit.

partner.en: Can I take just half?

learner.hr: Možete. Ne morate kupiti cijelu količinu.
learner.en: Yes. You don't have to buy the whole amount.

partner.hr: Jesu li sve jabuke iste sorte?
partner.en: Are all the apples the same variety?

learner.hr: Nisu. Ove manje su slađe, a veće malo kiselije.
learner.en: No. The smaller ones are sweeter, and the bigger ones a little more sour.

partner.en: I need fruit for baking.

learner.hr: Onda uzmite ove čvršće. Gospođa prije vas tražila je iste.
learner.en: Then take these firmer ones. The lady before you wanted the same ones.

partner.en: All right, weigh those for me.

learner.hr: Odmah. Hoćete li vrećicu ili imate svoju košaru?
learner.en: Right away. Would you like a bag, or have you got your own basket?

conversations.title: Glasses vanish before a class photograph

partner.en: Why are you searching the desks?

learner.hr: Ne mogu pronaći naočale, a fotograf nas već čeka.
learner.en: I can't find my glasses, and the photographer's already waiting.

partner.en: Are they in your pocket?

learner.hr: Nisu. Provjerio sam sve džepove i torbu.
learner.en: No. I've checked every pocket and my bag.

partner.en: Look at your reflection.

learner.hr: Na glavi su! Kako ih nisam osjetio? Baš sam zbunjen. Inače mi klize niz nos, pa ih odmah primijetim.
learner.en: They're on my head! How did I not feel them? I'm really confused. Usually they slide down my nose, so I notice them immediately.

partner.en: You were thinking too much.

learner.hr: Ili premalo. Ne znam koja je verzija bolja.
learner.en: Or too little. I don't know which version's better.

partner.en: Now smile for the picture.

learner.hr: Mogu. Ovaj osmijeh barem nije glumljen.
learner.en: I can. At least this smile isn't fake.

conversations.title: A bicycle needs its own place on the ferry

partner.en: Are you travelling with a bicycle too?

learner.hr: Da. Nisam ga naveo pri kupnji karte.
learner.en: Yes. I didn't include it when buying the ticket.

partner.en: We need to check whether there's room.

learner.hr: Razumijem. Ne želim blokirati prolaz drugim putnicima.
learner.en: I understand. I don't want to block the passage for other passengers.

partner.hr: Kolega kaže da ga možete ukrcati.
partner.en: My colleague says you can bring it aboard.

learner.hr: Odlično. Gdje trebam čekati prije ukrcaja? Mogu li ostati uz bicikl dok putnici ne prođu? Ne želim da netko zapne za pedalu.
learner.en: Great. Where should I wait before boarding? May I stay beside the bicycle until the passengers have passed? I don't want anyone to catch themselves on a pedal.

partner.en: With the other cyclists, beside the fence.

learner.hr: Vidim ih. Slijedit ću upute osoblja.
learner.en: I see them. I'll follow the staff's instructions.

partner.en: Keep this confirmation too.

learner.hr: Hoću. Sljedeći put rezerviram putovanje za oboje.
learner.en: I will. Next time I'll book the journey for both of us.

conversations.title: A familiar game in an unfamiliar language

partner.en: Why aren't you starting to read the rules?

learner.hr: Zato što je izdanje na jeziku koji ne govorim.
learner.en: Because this edition's in a language I don't speak.

partner.en: Haven't you played before?

learner.hr: Jesam, ali ove kartice imaju nove zadatke.
learner.en: Yes, but these cards have new tasks.

partner.en: We can look for another copy of the rules.

learner.hr: Možemo. Važno je da odgovara ovoj verziji igre.
learner.en: Yes. It's important that it matches this version of the game.

partner.hr: Našao sam isti naslov i godinu.
partner.en: I've found the same title and year.

learner.hr: Dobro. Sad usporedimo simbole na ploči i karticama.
learner.en: Good. Now let's compare the symbols on the board and cards.

partner.en: Everything matches.

learner.hr: Onda igramo. Prva prepreka bila je očito prijevod.
learner.en: Let's play, then. The first obstacle was clearly the translation.

conversations.title: A missing receipt for a work trip

partner.en: Have you submitted your travel expenses?

learner.hr: Nisam. Nedostaje račun za jednu vožnju taksijem.
learner.en: No. The receipt for one taxi ride is missing.

partner.en: Maybe you have an electronic copy.

learner.hr: Provjerit ću poruke. Vožnju sam naručio preko aplikacije.
learner.en: I'll check my messages. I ordered the ride through an app.

partner.en: Have you found anything?

learner.hr: Jesam, potvrdu s datumom, iznosom i nazivom prijevoznika.
learner.en: Yes, a confirmation with the date, amount and transport company's name.

partner.en: Ask accounts whether that's enough.

learner.hr: Hoću. Neću sam odlučivati što oni prihvaćaju.
learner.en: I will. I won't decide for myself what they accept.

partner.en: Send the other receipts too.

learner.hr: Šaljem. Ovaj put spremam sve u istu mapu.
learner.en: I'm sending them. This time I'm saving everything in the same folder.

conversations.title: A photograph shows an unexpected companion

partner.hr: Jesi li konačno razvrstao slike iz Rima?
partner.en: Have you finally sorted the pictures from Rome?

learner.hr: Jesam. Rim na mojim fotografijama uglavnom skriva jedna golubica.
learner.en: Yes. In my photographs, a pigeon mostly hides Rome.

partner.en: How did you manage that?

learner.hr: Sletjela je ispred objektiva baš kad sam fotografirao fontanu.
learner.en: It landed in front of the lens just as I photographed the fountain.

partner.en: Did you take any others?

learner.hr: Jesam, ali ova mi je najdraža zbog izraza ptice.
learner.en: Yes, but this is my favourite because of the bird's expression.

partner.hr: Izgleda kao da ti nešto zamjera.
partner.en: It looks as though it's annoyed with you.

learner.hr: Možda joj dugujem naknadu za poziranje u Rimu.
learner.en: Maybe I owe it a modelling fee in Rome.

partner.en: Will you print it?

learner.hr: Hoću. Za arhitekturu mogu kupiti razglednicu.
learner.en: Yes. I can buy a postcard for the architecture.

conversations.title: A train waits for unexpected traffic

partner.en: Why's the train stopped in a field?

learner.hr: Osoblje je javilo da su krave na pruzi.
learner.en: The staff announced that there are cows on the track.

partner.en: Are you joking?

learner.hr: Ne šalim. Vidim ih kroz prozor, iza one ograde.
learner.en: I'm not. I can see them through the window, behind that fence.

partner.en: Will we wait long?

learner.hr: Ne znam. Radije čekam nego da vlak krene nesigurno.
learner.en: I don't know. I'd rather wait than have the train move unsafely.

partner.en: Should we let home know?

learner.hr: Već sam javio. Kažu da prvi put čuju takav razlog kašnjenja.
learner.en: I already have. They say they've never heard that reason for a delay before.

partner.en: It looks like we're moving.

learner.hr: Napokon. Krave su očito završile svoj sastanak.
learner.en: Finally. The cows have clearly finished their meeting.

conversations.title: A clothes swap changes someone’s style

partner.en: Why are you holding that blue jacket?

learner.hr: Razmišljam bih li je uzela na razmjeni odjeće.
learner.en: I'm thinking of taking it at the clothes swap.

partner.en: It isn't really your usual style.

learner.hr: Znam. Zato mi je zanimljivija od još jedne crne.
learner.en: I know. That's why it's more interesting than another black one.

partner.en: Try it on in front of the mirror.

learner.hr: Pristaje mi, ali rukavi su predugi.
learner.en: It fits, but the sleeves are too long.

partner.en: You can shorten them.

learner.hr: Mogu. Donijela sam tri komada, a našla jedan vrijedan popravka.
learner.en: Yes. I brought three items and found one worth repairing.

partner.en: Take it, then.

learner.hr: Hoću. Moja odjeća danas ima bolji društveni život od mene.
learner.en: I will. My clothes have a better social life than I do today.

conversations.title: A cake arrives one floor too early

partner.en: Have you ordered a cake?

learner.hr: Jesam, ali zašto dostavljač stoji pred tvojim vratima?
learner.en: Yes, but why's the delivery person outside your door?

partner.hr: Na kutiji piše tvoj broj stana.
partner.en: The box has your flat number on it.

learner.hr: Onda je zamijenio katove. Ja sam iznad tebe.
learner.en: Then he's mixed up the floors. I'm above you.

partner.en: Shall I take it?

learner.hr: Molim te, ako možeš. Silazim čim obujem cipele.
learner.en: Please, if you can. I'll come down as soon as I put my shoes on.

partner.en: It looks very festive.

learner.hr: Trebala bi. Moja kći danas slavi prvi rođendan.
learner.en: It should. My daughter's celebrating her first birthday today.

partner.en: Congratulations to the whole family, then.

learner.hr: Hvala. Za tvoju pomoć rezerviram najveći komad.
learner.en: Thank you. I'm reserving the biggest slice for your help.

conversations.title: An echo on a school trip

partner.en: Why does our voice come back?

learner.hr: To je jeka. Vodič je rekao da slušamo odjek.
learner.en: It's an echo. The guide told us to listen to it.

partner.en: May I shout my name?

learner.hr: Prvo pitaj. Ostali posjetitelji možda ne žele slušati viku.
learner.en: Ask first. Other visitors may not want to hear shouting.

partner.en: The guide says we can once.

learner.hr: Onda govorite redom, da čujemo razliku između glasova.
learner.en: Then speak one at a time so we can hear the difference between voices.

partner.en: Mine sounded really deep.

learner.hr: Moj je djelovao kao da netko stoji iza nas.
learner.en: Mine sounded as though someone was standing behind us.

partner.en: Shall we carry on?

learner.hr: Hoćemo. Dosta mi je razgovora sa samim sobom.
learner.en: Yes. I've had enough of talking to myself.

conversations.title: A ghost story has a familiar source

partner.hr: Jeste li čuli za duha na ovom otoku?
partner.en: Have you heard about the ghost on this island?

learner.hr: Jesmo. Tu priču ispričao si nam i prošlog ljeta.
learner.en: Yes. You told us that story last summer too.

partner.hr: Ali ovaj put ima novi kraj.
partner.en: But this time it has a new ending.

learner.hr: Dobro. Je li duh opet tvoj izgubljeni ručnik?
learner.en: All right. Is the ghost your missing towel again?

partner.hr: Ne, ovaj put je prava zvijer.
partner.en: No, this time it's a real beast.

learner.hr: Onda pripovijedaj tiše, da ne probudiš cijeli kamp.
learner.en: Then tell it more quietly so you don't wake the whole campsite.

partner.en: Aren't you frightened at all?

learner.hr: Strah nas je da ćemo propustiti večeru dok završiš.
learner.en: We're afraid we'll miss dinner before you finish.

partner.en: All right, the ghost can wait.

learner.hr: Pametna odluka. I duhovi bi trebali poštovati raspored.
learner.en: A wise decision. Even ghosts should respect the timetable.

conversations.title: A gap in an inherited stamp album

partner.hr: Zašto je ovo mjesto u albumu prazno?
partner.en: Why's this space in the album empty?

learner.hr: Djed je tražio tu marku godinama, ali je nije našao.
learner.en: Grandad searched for that stamp for years but never found it.

partner.en: Will you continue the search?

learner.hr: Hoću, ali prvo želim naučiti prepoznati izvornik.
learner.en: Yes, but first I want to learn to recognise an original.

partner.en: Are there copies?

learner.hr: Postoje. Ne želim zamijeniti obiteljsku uspomenu skupom pogreškom.
learner.en: Yes. I don't want to turn a family memory into an expensive mistake.

partner.en: Whom can you ask?

learner.hr: U gradu postoji klub kolekcionara. Ponijet ću cijeli album.
learner.en: There's a collectors' club in town. I'll take the whole album.

partner.hr: Što ako marka nikad ne dođe?
partner.en: What if the stamp never turns up?

learner.hr: Ostat će praznina, ali i priča zbog koje je gledamo.
learner.en: There'll still be a gap, but also the story that makes us look at it.

conversations.title: A request for a neighbour’s birthday

partner.en: Whom would you like to dedicate the song to?

learner.hr: Susjedi koja danas slavi osamdeseti rođendan.
learner.en: My neighbour, who's celebrating her eightieth birthday today.

partner.en: Is she listening now?

learner.hr: Sluša vas svakog jutra dok priprema doručak.
learner.en: She listens every morning while preparing breakfast.

partner.en: Which song are you requesting?

learner.hr: Onu koju je pjevala sa suprugom. Poslao sam naslov porukom.
learner.en: The one she sang with her husband. I sent the title in a message.

partner.en: We've got it. What should we say?

learner.hr: Da joj cijela zgrada šalje čestitke i zagrljaj.
learner.en: That the whole building sends congratulations and a hug.

partner.en: It's coming right after the news.

learner.hr: Hvala vam. Sad moram provjeriti da joj radio nije ugašen.
learner.en: Thank you. Now I need to check she hasn't turned her radio off.

conversations.title: Opening a childhood time capsule

partner.en: Can we finally open the box?

learner.hr: Smijemo. Prošlo je deset godina otkad smo je zatvorili.
learner.en: Yes. It's been ten years since we closed it.

partner.en: What did you put inside?

learner.hr: Pismo budućoj sebi i fotografiju naše stare kuće.
learner.en: A letter to my future self and a photograph of our old house.

partner.en: Have you achieved your plans?

learner.hr: Neke jesam. Druge sam promijenila, što tada nisam mogla zamisliti.
learner.en: Some. Others I've changed, which I couldn't imagine back then.

partner.hr: Je li ti žao zbog toga?
partner.en: Are you sorry about that?
