learner.hr: Nije. Moje djetinjstvo nije moralo odlučiti cijelu budućnost.
learner.en: No. My childhood didn't have to decide my whole future.

partner.en: Shall we make a new box?

learner.hr: Hoćemo, ali ovaj put ostavljam više mjesta za iznenađenja.
learner.en: Yes, but this time I'm leaving more room for surprises.

conversations.title: Two agencies and one misplaced appointment

partner.en: Why are you calling so many numbers?

learner.hr: Agencija me poslala drugoj agentici, ali nemam naziv njezine agencije.
learner.en: The agency sent me to another agent, but I don't have her agency's name.

partner.en: Don't you have the agent's name?

learner.hr: Imam ime agenta koji je otišao. Ostali agenti danas nisu dostupni.
learner.en: I have the name of the agent who left. The other agents aren't available today.

partner.en: Can you go in person?

learner.hr: Mogu. Pitat ću recepciju za raspored agenata i točnu lokaciju.
learner.en: Yes. I'll ask reception for the agents' timetable and the exact location.

partner.en: What will you say?

learner.hr: Agentice, trebam potvrdu termina, ne novu ponudu. To ću jasno naglasiti.
learner.en: Madam, I need confirmation of the appointment, not a new offer. I'll make that clear.

partner.en: Have they answered?

learner.hr: Jesu. Agente, hvala na strpljenju, ali provjerimo adresu još jednom.
learner.en: Yes. Sir, thank you for your patience, but let's check the address once more.

conversations.title: A family car in a museum

partner.en: Why are you looking at that particular car?

learner.hr: Moj djed vozio je sličan. U automobilu je uvijek mirisalo na kožu.
learner.en: My grandfather drove a similar one. Inside the car it always smelled of leather.

partner.en: Did you travel in it?

learner.hr: Jesmo, autom smo prelazili pola države. Nije bilo automatski podesivih sjedala.
learner.en: Yes, we'd cross half the country by car. There were no automatically adjustable seats.

partner.en: Was it comfortable?

learner.hr: Nama djeci jest. Odrasli su se žalili zbog veličine automobila.
learner.en: For us children, yes. The adults complained about the car's size.

partner.en: What happened to it?

learner.hr: Prodali su ga državnoj ustanovi. Kasnije ga je preuzela lokalna zbirka.
learner.en: They sold it to a state institution. A local collection acquired it later.

partner.en: Maybe this is his very car.

learner.hr: Možda. Provjerit ću broj motora u starim državnim dokumentima koje čuvamo.
learner.en: Maybe. I'll check the engine number in the old state documents we keep.

conversations.title: A lid almost goes in the rubbish

partner.en: What are you looking for in that bag?

learner.hr: Poklopac. Mislim da sam ga bacila s ambalažom.
learner.en: A lid. I think I threw it away with the packaging.

partner.en: Have you checked the bin?

learner.hr: Jesam. Ti baci samo papir, a plastične dijelove ostavi ovdje.
learner.en: Yes. You throw away only the paper, and leave the plastic parts here.

partner.en: Shall I throw this piece away too?

learner.hr: Nemoj. Njega smo već jednom bacili pa tražili cijelo jutro.
learner.en: Don't. We already threw that away once and searched all morning.

partner.en: What about these boxes?

learner.hr: Sačuvajmo dvije, ostale bacimo. Luka je svoje već bacio.
learner.en: Let's keep two and throw the others away. Luka has already thrown his away.

partner.en: I've found the lid!

learner.hr: Odlično. Bacite samo ono što više nitko ne može iskoristiti.
learner.en: Great. Throw away only what nobody can use anymore.

conversations.title: Interviewing a neighbour about his hobby

partner.en: What do you do after work?

learner.hr: Bavim se popravkom satova. Moj otac bavio se istim zanatom.
learner.en: I repair clocks. My father practised the same craft.

partner.en: How did you start?

learner.hr: Počeo sam koristeći njegov alat. Sada koristim i neke nove uređaje.
learner.en: I started by using his tools. Now I also use some new devices.

partner.en: Is there much work?

learner.hr: Ima. Ljudi koji koriste stare satove često trebaju zamjenske dijelove.
learner.en: Yes. People who use old clocks often need replacement parts.

partner.hr: Može li se time svatko baviti?
partner.en: Can anyone take it up?

learner.hr: Može učiti. Ako se baviš sitnicama, strpljenje je važnije od brzine.
learner.en: They can learn. If you work with tiny things, patience matters more than speed.

partner.en: Will you carry on for a long time?

learner.hr: Hoću. Ovim sam se koristio godinama, a svaki sat donese nešto drukčije.
learner.en: Yes. I've used this for years, and every clock brings something different.

conversations.title: A board game escape goes wrong

partner.en: Why are we going back to the start?

learner.hr: Naš bijeg nije uspio. Straža nas je pronašla u tunelu.
learner.en: Our escape failed. The guards found us in the tunnel.

partner.en: Can we try again?

learner.hr: Možemo, ali ne bježimo istim putem. Ostali već bježe prema luci.
learner.en: Yes, but let's not escape the same way. The others are already fleeing towards the harbour.

partner.en: What does your card say?

learner.hr: Piše da sam u bijegu izgubio kartu. Sad nemam smjer.
learner.en: It says I lost the map while fleeing. Now I've got no direction.

partner.en: Follow me, then.

learner.hr: Ako ti bježiš bez plana, ne pomaže nam ni prednost.
learner.en: If you're fleeing without a plan, even a head start won't help.

partner.en: We've got one more exit.

learner.hr: Dobro. Nakon ovog bijega biram mirniju igru, bez straže.
learner.en: Good. After this escape I'm choosing a calmer game, without guards.

conversations.title: A wealthy king with a poor plan

partner.en: Why does the king want more gold?

learner.hr: Bogat je, ali misli da bogatstvo može kupiti odanost.
learner.en: He's rich, but thinks wealth can buy loyalty.

partner.hr: Jesu li svi u kraljevstvu bogati?
partner.en: Is everyone in the kingdom rich?

learner.hr: Nisu. Bogata je samo njegova obitelj, a ostali rade za nju.
learner.en: No. Only his family is rich; everyone else works for them.

partner.en: What do the neighbouring kings do?

learner.hr: Traže savez. Njihove bogate pokrajine također se boje rata.
learner.en: They seek an alliance. Their wealthy provinces fear war too.

partner.en: Who opposes the king?

learner.hr: Kći kraljice. Kaže da se od straha ne može graditi mir.
learner.en: The queen's daughter. She says peace can't be built out of fear.

partner.en: Is it a children's book?

learner.hr: Jest, ali kraljeva odluka otvara pitanja i odraslima.
learner.en: Yes, but the king's decision raises questions for adults too.

conversations.title: Illness changes the theatre cast

partner.en: Why are you cancelling rehearsal?

learner.hr: Glumica je bolesna, a glavni glumac također je bolestan.
learner.en: The actress is ill, and the lead actor is ill too.

partner.en: Can others replace them?

learner.hr: Drugi već zamjenjuju kolege koji su bolesni od prošlog tjedna.
learner.en: The others are already covering for colleagues who've been ill since last week.

partner.en: Is the performance cancelled?

learner.hr: Zasad nije. Zbog bolesti ćemo ipak promijeniti raspored proba.
learner.en: Not for now. We will change the rehearsal schedule because of the illness, though.

partner.en: Are you worried about opening night?

learner.hr: Brinemo, ali njihovo zdravlje važnije je od datuma. To je dobrobit cijele ekipe.
learner.en: We are, but their health matters more than the date. It's about the whole team's well-being.

partner.en: What should I tell the others?

learner.hr: Recite da ostanu doma i da im želimo miran oporavak.
learner.en: Tell them to stay home and that we wish them a peaceful recovery.

conversations.title: A boxer in a documentary

partner.en: Who's the woman in the documentary?

learner.hr: Bivša boksačica. Borila se godinama prije nego što je postala trenerica.
learner.en: A former boxer. She competed for years before becoming a coach.

partner.en: Why did she stop?

learner.hr: Kaže da se više borila sa strahom nego s protivnicama.
learner.en: She says she was fighting fear more than opponents.

partner.en: What does she teach others now?

learner.hr: Da znaju zašto se bore. Ne borimo se svi za isti cilj.
learner.en: To know why they fight. We don't all fight for the same goal.

partner.hr: Je li njezin brat isto sportaš?
partner.en: Is her brother an athlete too?

learner.hr: Jest. Borio se na turnirima, a danas organizira natjecanja.
learner.en: Yes. He fought in tournaments and now organises competitions.

partner.hr: Što ti je ostalo u sjećanju?
partner.en: What stayed with you?

learner.hr: Rečenica da se boriš bolje kad ne moraš stalno dokazivati vrijednost.
learner.en: The line about fighting better when you don't constantly need to prove your worth.

conversations.title: Neighbours worry about a young tree

partner.en: Why do you visit the tree every morning?

learner.hr: Brinem jer mu lišće blijedi. Prošle godine brinula sam za drugo.
learner.en: I'm worried because its leaves are fading. Last year I worried about another one.

partner.en: Have you asked the gardener?

learner.hr: Jesam. Rekao je: ne brinite unaprijed, prvo ću ga pregledati.
learner.en: Yes. He said: don't worry in advance; I'll inspect it first.

partner.en: Will he come today?

learner.hr: Hoće. Susjed se također brinuo pa mu je poslao fotografije.
learner.en: Yes. The neighbour was worried too and sent him photographs.

partner.en: Do you need help while waiting?

learner.hr: Trebam dobro društvo. S dobrim društvom manje zamišljam loše ishode.
learner.en: I need good company. With good company I imagine fewer bad outcomes.

partner.en: Then I'll stay a while.

learner.hr: Hvala. Na dobroj klupi možemo pričekati i dobre vijesti.
learner.en: Thank you. On a good bench we can wait for good news too.

conversations.title: Water runs the wrong way through a model

partner.en: Why's the model wet?

learner.hr: Pukla je cijev u maloj fontani. Voda se razlila po cijeloj podlozi.
learner.en: A pipe in the little fountain split. Water spilled across the entire base.

partner.en: Can you stop it?

learner.hr: Mogu isključiti pumpu. Isključi i rasvjetu dok brišemo vodu.
learner.en: I can switch off the pump. Switch off the lighting too while we wipe up.

partner.en: Is the city ruined?

learner.hr: Nije. Cijelim rubom stavio sam zaštitu, ali sam preskočio taj spoj.
learner.en: No. I put protection around the entire edge but missed that joint.

partner.en: Who joined the parts?

learner.hr: Ja. Previše sam cijenio brzinu, a premalo provjeru prije uključivanja.
learner.en: I did. I valued speed too much and checking before switching on too little.

partner.en: Can we still exhibit the model?

learner.hr: Možemo bez vode. U cijeni projekta barem nismo obećali pravi vodovod.
learner.en: Yes, without water. At the project's price we at least didn't promise real plumbing.

conversations.title: Two entrances to a gallery

partner.en: Where's the entrance?

learner.hr: Na desnoj strani. Desna vrata vode u galeriju, lijeva u ured.
learner.en: On the right. The right-hand door leads to the gallery, the left to the office.

partner.en: And the ticket desk?

learner.hr: Uz lijevi zid. Na lijevoj polici ostavili su kataloge.
learner.en: By the left wall. They left catalogues on the left-hand shelf.

partner.en: Where do we turn now?

learner.hr: Desno, prema desnom hodniku. Pogledaj strelicu iznad prolaza.
learner.en: Right, towards the right-hand corridor. Look at the arrow above the passage.

partner.en: What's in the other room?

learner.hr: Skulpture. Na lijevoj strani izložene su kopije, na desnoj izvornici.
learner.en: Sculptures. Copies are displayed on the left, originals on the right.

partner.en: How do you remember all that?

learner.hr: Ne pamtim. U lijevoj ruci držim plan, a desnu koristim za pokazivanje.
learner.en: I don't. I hold the plan in my left hand and use my right to point.

conversations.title: A coach chooses a team photograph

partner.en: Which picture are we publishing?

learner.hr: Ovu s dečkima nakon turnira. Jednog dečka na prethodnoj nema.
learner.en: This one with the boys after the tournament. One boy is missing from the previous one.

partner.en: Who's standing behind?

learner.hr: Trener s djevojkama iz drugog kluba. Pomagale su nam cijeli dan.
learner.en: The coach with the girls from another club. They helped us all day.

partner.en: And that young man?

learner.hr: On je s mojim dečkom došao po opremu, nije igrač.
learner.en: He came with my boyfriend to collect equipment; he isn't a player.

partner.en: Do we have everyone's permission?

learner.hr: Imamo. Pitala sam dečke, a djevojku s kapom nazvala sam zasebno.
learner.en: Yes. I asked the boys and called the girl in the cap separately.

partner.en: Then add a caption.

learner.hr: Hoću. Zahvalit ću djevojkama i dečku koji je snimio fotografiju.
learner.en: I will. I'll thank the girls and the boy who took the photograph.

conversations.title: Different letters from a scholarship programme

partner.en: Have you had a reply?

learner.hr: Jesam. Dobivam stipendiju, a sestra dobiva pomoć za putovanje.
learner.en: Yes. I'm receiving a scholarship, and my sister's receiving travel support.

partner.en: What if you accept?

learner.hr: Dobijem smještaj. Ako prihvatimo obje, dobijemo i zajedničku sobu.
learner.en: I get accommodation. If we both accept, we also get a shared room.

partner.en: Is the application period still open?

learner.hr: Jest. Kad dobijete potvrdu prijave, dobit ćete i raspored razgovora.
learner.en: Yes. When you receive confirmation of your application, you'll also get an interview schedule.

partner.en: Does everyone receive the same?

learner.hr: Ne. Neki dobivaju samo smještaj, drugi dobivaju dodatnu potporu.
learner.en: No. Some receive only accommodation; others receive additional support.

partner.en: Why are you so happy?

learner.hr: Jer dobivamo priliku koju smo čekale. Nije mi najvažnije dobivanje novca.
learner.en: Because we're getting the opportunity we waited for. Receiving money isn't what matters most to me.

conversations.title: Welcoming a returning volunteer

partner.en: I'm back!

learner.hr: Dobrodošla! Pripremili smo ti dobrodošlicu i posao na ulazu.
learner.en: Welcome! We've prepared a welcome for you and a job at the entrance.

partner.en: What's changed?

learner.hr: Voditelj događaja je novi, a događaj traje cijeli vikend.
learner.en: The event organiser is new, and the event lasts all weekend.

partner.en: Were there problems?

learner.hr: Događalo se svašta. Na prošlom događaju nestalo je struje.
learner.en: All sorts of things happened. The power failed at the previous event.

partner.en: Who's looking after the programme now?

learner.hr: Kolegica prati događaje na dvije pozornice. Ja se bavim dolaskom gostiju.
learner.en: A colleague follows events on two stages. I'm handling the guests' arrival.

partner.en: Where should I start?

learner.hr: Na ulazu. Poželi dobrodošlicu svima, posebno dobrom starom susjedu koji stalno pomaže.
learner.en: At the entrance. Welcome everyone, especially our good old neighbour who always helps.

conversations.title: Evidence in a mystery manuscript

partner.en: Why are you deleting the ending?

learner.hr: Detektiv nije dokazao krivnju. Dokazi zasad samo povezuju osumnjičenog s kućom.
learner.en: The detective hasn't proved guilt. The evidence only connects the suspect with the house so far.

partner.en: What's missing?

learner.hr: Motiv i trag koji dokazuje vrijeme dolaska. Moram istražiti taj dio zapleta.
learner.en: A motive and a clue proving the arrival time. I need to investigate that part of the plot.

partner.en: Can a witness help?

learner.hr: Može ako dokaže da je vidio baš njega, ne sličnog čovjeka.
learner.en: Yes, if he proves he saw that particular man, not someone similar.

partner.en: Why doesn't he confess immediately?

learner.hr: Dokaži mi da bi to odgovaralo njegovu karakteru. Dosad izbjegava istinu.
learner.en: Prove to me it would suit his character. So far he avoids the truth.

partner.en: Will you add a scene?

learner.hr: Hoću. Njome pokušavam dokazati nešto čitatelju, a ne samo izreći presudu.
learner.en: Yes. With it I'm trying to prove something to the reader, not simply deliver a verdict.

conversations.title: Doctors in a school performance

partner.en: Who plays the physicians?

learner.hr: Marko je doktor, a Ana doktorica. Ostali doktori dolaze u drugom činu.
learner.en: Marko is the male doctor and Ana the female doctor. The other doctors appear in the second act.

partner.en: What do I say?

learner.hr: Doktore, izgubili ste popis. Zatim doktoru predaš praznu mapu.
learner.en: Doctor, you've lost the list. Then you give the doctor an empty folder.

partner.en: And to Ana?

learner.hr: Doktorice, ovo nije vaša torba. Ona tada traži doktora u hodniku.
learner.en: Doctor, this isn't your bag. Then she looks for the other doctor in the corridor.

partner.en: Why's everyone running?

learner.hr: Zbog zamjene torbi, ne pacijenata. Liječnici u ovoj komediji stalno griješe.
learner.en: Because the bags were mixed up, not because of patients. The physicians in this comedy keep making mistakes.

partner.en: How does the scene end?

learner.hr: Ulaskom pravog liječnika. On pita zašto nitko ne sluša liječnike.
learner.en: With the real physician's entrance. He asks why nobody listens to the physicians.

conversations.title: Visitors arrive at different times

partner.en: Who's arriving first?

learner.hr: Tetka. Dolazila je ranije i prošlih godina, zbog jutarnjeg vlaka.
learner.en: Our aunt. She arrived earlier in previous years too because of the morning train.

partner.en: And our cousins?

learner.hr: Oni su dolazili autom. Ove godine dolaze autobusom do našeg mjesta.
learner.en: They used to come by car. This year they're coming to our town by bus.

partner.en: Shall I wait for them?

learner.hr: Ako dolaziš prije podne, možeš. Po dolasku samo javi gdje si.
learner.en: If you're coming before noon, you can. Just say where you are on arrival.

partner.en: Did Grandad come often?

learner.hr: Jest. Njemu nije bilo teško dolaziti ni po kiši.
learner.en: Yes. Coming even in the rain wasn't difficult for him.

partner.en: When are you arriving?

learner.hr: Pri kraju dana. Vrijeme dolaska ovisi o dolasku našeg zamjenskog vozača.
learner.en: Towards the end of the day. Our arrival time depends on our replacement driver's arrival.

conversations.title: Permission to film on a roof terrace

partner.en: Can we film upstairs?

learner.hr: Samo ako vlasnica dopusti. Prošli put nije dopustila cijeloj ekipi ulaz.
learner.en: Only if the owner allows it. Last time she didn't allow the whole crew in.

partner.en: Why not?

learner.hr: Dopustili su troje ljudi, a pojavilo se deset. Nije imala dovoljno prostora.
learner.en: They allowed three people, and ten turned up. She didn't have enough room.

partner.en: What shall we do now?

learner.hr: Pitati je otvoreno što dopušta. Ne želim pretpostaviti da je sve dopušteno.
learner.en: Ask openly what she permits. I don't want to assume everything is allowed.

partner.en: Will you call?

learner.hr: Hoću. Dopusti mi da objasnim plan prije nego što rezerviraš opremu.
learner.en: Yes. Let me explain the plan before you reserve the equipment.

partner.en: What if she refuses?

learner.hr: To moramo dopustiti bez nagovaranja. Snimanje možemo premjestiti u dvorište.
learner.en: We have to allow that without persuasion. We can move the filming to the courtyard.

conversations.title: Someone brings more guests than expected

partner.en: Why are there so many children?

learner.hr: Sestra je dovela nećakinje, a brat je doveo njihove prijatelje.
learner.en: My sister brought our nieces, and my brother brought their friends.

partner.en: Did we invite them all?

learner.hr: Doveli su ih bez dogovora. To nas je dovelo do manjka stolica.
learner.en: They brought them without asking. That left us short of chairs.

partner.en: Can I help?

learner.hr: Dovedi starije u vrt. Ja ću dovesti susjedu da pomogne s hranom.
learner.en: Bring the older ones into the garden. I'll bring the neighbour to help with food.

partner.en: Should we call the parents?

learner.hr: Da. Zamoli ih da dovedu dodatne čaše kad dođu.
learner.en: Yes. Ask them to bring extra glasses when they come.

partner.en: What should I tell the children?

learner.hr: Dovedite nam svoje roditelje prije odlaska. Moramo provjeriti tko ide s kim.
learner.en: Bring your parents to us before leaving. We need to check who's going with whom.

conversations.title: A permit becomes a puppet-show prop

partner.en: What does the king's messenger carry?

learner.hr: Dozvolu za ulazak u grad. Bez dozvole stražari ga ne puštaju.
learner.en: A permit to enter the city. The guards won't let him in without it.

partner.en: Is the paper real?

learner.hr: Nije. Dozvola je rekvizit, s nacrtanim pečatom i izmišljenim imenom.
learner.en: No. The permit's a prop, with a drawn seal and a made-up name.

partner.en: What does he say to the guard?

learner.hr: Dozvolite mi ulaz, nosim pismo. Stražar tada mora provjeriti dozvolu.
learner.en: Allow me in; I'm carrying a letter. The guard then has to check the permit.

partner.en: Why doesn't he let him in?

learner.hr: Kralj mu nije dozvolio. Kasnije će kraljica dozvoliti ulazak svima.
learner.en: The king hasn't allowed it. Later the queen will allow everyone to enter.

partner.en: What do we need to draw?

learner.hr: Još dvije dozvole. Dozvoljeno nam je koristiti kopije tijekom predstave.
learner.en: Two more permits. We're allowed to use copies during the performance.

conversations.title: Two stands at an international fair

partner.en: Whose stand is this?

learner.hr: Francuske obitelji. Francuzi su donijeli kolače iz Francuske.
learner.en: A French family's. The French visitors brought cakes from France.

partner.en: And the next one?

learner.hr: Američka udruga. Amerikanci pripremaju jela iz različitih američkih krajeva.
learner.en: An American association. The Americans are preparing dishes from different American regions.

partner.en: Have you been there?

learner.hr: U Francuskoj jesam. Francuska mi je ostala u lijepom sjećanju.
learner.en: I've been to France. I have happy memories of France.

partner.en: Where next?

learner.hr: U Ameriku, ali prvo moram upoznati običaje američke obitelji koja me zove.
learner.en: To America, but first I need to learn the customs of the American family inviting me.

partner.en: What shall we taste?

learner.hr: Francuski kolač i američku pitu. Za razgovor nam ne trebaju putovnice.
learner.en: French cake and American pie. We don't need passports for a conversation.

conversations.title: An interview needs a correction

partner.en: Why are you calling the newsroom?

learner.hr: Novinar je zamijenio moje ime. U novinama sada govorim tuđim imenom.
learner.en: The reporter mixed up my name. In the newspaper I'm speaking under someone else's name.

partner.en: Are you angry with the reporters?

learner.hr: Nisam. Novinarima ću poslati ispravak, ne javno napadati novinara.
learner.en: No. I'll send the reporters a correction, not publicly attack the reporter.

partner.en: Is the article important?

learner.hr: Jest, govori o javnom prostoru i novim pravilima njegova korištenja.
learner.en: Yes, it's about public space and new rules for its use.

partner.en: What does the public need to know?

learner.hr: Da javni sastanak nije otkazan. Ta je obavijest važna za javnost.
learner.en: That the public meeting isn't cancelled. That announcement matters to the public.

partner.en: Will they publish a correction?

learner.hr: Hoće. Od novina očekujem točnost, ali greške se mogu ispraviti.
learner.en: Yes. I expect accuracy from newspapers, but mistakes can be corrected.

conversations.title: A committee discusses a footbridge

partner.en: Who called the meeting?

learner.hr: Gradonačelnik. Gradski odbor treba odlučiti hoćemo li graditi novi pješački most.
learner.en: The mayor. The city committee needs to decide whether to build a new footbridge.

partner.en: Why's the bridge needed?

learner.hr: Hodanje gradom traje dugo kad ne možeš prijeći rijeku blizu škole.
learner.en: Walking through the city takes a long time when you can't cross the river near the school.

partner.en: What do the committee members say?

learner.hr: Dio odbora želi prvo popraviti stari most. Predstavit će to odboru večeras.
learner.en: Some want to repair the old bridge first. They'll present that to the committee tonight.

partner.en: Will you speak?

learner.hr: Hoću. Pitat ću gradonačelnika kako će uključiti stanovnike u odluku.
learner.en: Yes. I'll ask the mayor how residents will be included in the decision.

partner.en: Have you prepared questions?

learner.hr: Jesam. Prijedlog mora odgovarati potrebama javnog prijevoza i ljudi koji hodaju.
learner.en: Yes. The proposal needs to serve public transport and people walking.

conversations.title: A fridge stops working before an exhibition

partner.en: Why are the drinks warm?

learner.hr: Hladnjak ne radi. Sok nije hladan, a ni voda nije hladna.
learner.en: The fridge isn't working. The juice isn't cold, and the water isn't cold either.

partner.en: Did someone touch the plug?

learner.hr: Kolega je isključio uređaj tijekom čišćenja. Kasnije ga nitko nije uključio.
learner.en: A colleague switched it off while cleaning. Nobody switched it back on later.

partner.en: What now?

learner.hr: Isključite taj drugi uređaj, kaže tehničar. Treba provjeriti raspoloživu utičnicu.
learner.en: Switch off that other device, the technician says. He needs to check the available socket.

partner.en: Will we have cold drinks?

learner.hr: Kasnije. Zasad nema hladnih boca, ali možemo ponuditi čaj.
learner.en: Later. There are no cold bottles for now, but we can offer tea.

partner.en: The visitors have arrived already.

learner.hr: Onda ih dočekajmo. Nije toliko hladno da će odbiti toplo piće.
learner.en: Let's welcome them. It isn't so cold that they'll refuse a warm drink.

conversations.title: An oral exam interrupted by a mistake

partner.en: How was the exam?

learner.hr: Ispit je počeo dobro, ali tijekom ispitivanja zamijenili su moj zadatak.
learner.en: It started well, but during the questioning they mixed up my assignment.

partner.en: Did you say so?

learner.hr: Jesam. Zamolila sam da pročitaju broj ispravno. Nesporazum treba ispraviti.
learner.en: Yes. I asked them to read the number correctly. The misunderstanding needs to be cleared up.

partner.en: Did they listen?

learner.hr: Jesu. Profesor me nastavio ispitivati prema pravom popisu.
learner.en: Yes. The professor continued examining me using the right list.

partner.en: Did you get an apology?

learner.hr: Jesam. Rekla sam da prihvaćam ispriku i da nisu potrebne dodatne isprike.
learner.en: Yes. I said I accepted the apology and no further apologies were needed.

partner.en: And the result?

learner.hr: Položila sam. Važno je ispitati znanje, ne sposobnost pogađanja tuđeg zadatka.
learner.en: I passed. What matters is examining knowledge, not guessing someone else's assignment.

conversations.title: An investigation in a radio mystery

partner.en: What are you listening to?

learner.hr: Radioigru. Istražitelj istražuje nestanak slike iz muzeja.
learner.en: A radio play. An investigator's investigating a painting's disappearance from a museum.

partner.en: Does he have help?

learner.hr: Ima. Istražitelji dijele istragu, a kustosica pomaže u istrazi.
learner.en: Yes. The investigators divide the investigation between them, and the curator helps with it.

partner.en: Who's suspected?

learner.hr: Čuvar kojeg je netko pratio. Istragom su otkrili da nije bio sam.
learner.en: A guard someone was following. Through the investigation they discovered he wasn't alone.

partner.en: Have they found the painting?

learner.hr: Još nisu. Moraju istraživati stare zapise i istraživanja jednog povjesničara.
learner.en: Not yet. They must investigate old records and a historian's research.

partner.en: Why don't you read the ending?

learner.hr: Jer želim otkriti rješenje sa slušateljima, ne preskočiti cijelu istragu.
learner.en: Because I want to discover the solution with the listeners, not skip the whole investigation.

conversations.title: Choosing a class logo fairly

partner.en: Which symbol do you want?

learner.hr: Izabrala sam stablo, ali drugi su izabrali zvijezdu.
learner.en: I chose a tree, but the others chose a star.

partner.en: Who decides?

learner.hr: Razred. Nitko nije izabran da odlučuje sam.
learner.en: The class. Nobody's been elected to decide alone.

partner.en: What if the star wins again?

learner.hr: Prihvatit ću. Izabrati zajedno važnije je nego uvijek dobiti svoje.
learner.en: I'll accept it. Choosing together matters more than always getting my way.

partner.en: Do we need a third suggestion?

learner.hr: Izaberi neki svoj. I Luka je izabrao drukčiji oblik.
learner.en: Choose one of your own. Luka chose a different shape too.

partner.en: How shall we vote?

learner.hr: Na papiru. Neka svaki učenik ima jednako vremena za izbor.
learner.en: On paper. Let every pupil have equal time to choose.

conversations.title: Leaving an exhibition before the crowd

partner.en: When are we leaving?

learner.hr: Čim izađe zadnja grupa iz hodnika. Ne želim blokirati izlaz.
learner.en: As soon as the last group leaves the corridor. I don't want to block the exit.

partner.en: Shall I go first?

learner.hr: Izađi i pričekaj. Kad izađem, zajedno ćemo do autobusa.
learner.en: Go out and wait. When I come out, we'll go to the bus together.

partner.en: What about the others?

learner.hr: Zamolit ću ih: izađite kroz desna vrata, a ne kroz skladište.
learner.en: I'll ask them: leave through the right-hand door, not through the storeroom.

partner.en: Can they stay here?

learner.hr: Mogu dok ne izađu svi posjetitelji. Osoblje provjerava oba izlaza.
learner.en: Yes, until all the visitors leave. The staff are checking both exits.

partner.en: What if we split up?

learner.hr: Kad izađeš, javi lokaciju. Tako se nađemo bez vraćanja unutra.
learner.en: When you leave, send your location. That way we can meet without going back inside.

conversations.title: A scene removed from a short film

partner.en: Why aren't I in the film?

learner.hr: Montažer je izbacio dugačak razgovor. Nisi izbačen ti, nego scena.
learner.en: The editor cut a long conversation. You weren't removed; the scene was.

partner.en: Wasn't it important?

learner.hr: Redateljica je izbacila i svoj uvod. Pokušava skratiti trajanje.
learner.en: The director cut her own introduction too. She's trying to shorten the running time.

partner.en: What else did you change?

learner.hr: Izbacili smo ponavljanja. Nitko nije htio izbaciti smisao priče.
learner.en: We removed repetitions. Nobody wanted to remove the story's meaning.

partner.en: Will there be a longer version?

learner.hr: Možda. Predložit ću da ne izbaci originalne snimke iz arhive.
learner.en: Maybe. I'll suggest that he doesn't remove the original footage from the archive.

partner.en: Can I watch it?

learner.hr: Možeš. Bez izgovora ću objasniti zašto je tvoja scena ipak ostala vani.
learner.en: Yes. I'll explain without excuses why your scene was still left out.

conversations.title: A surprise after a difficult dance rehearsal

partner.en: Why did you look sad?

learner.hr: Mislio sam da sam vas iznevjerio. Moj izlazak na pozornicu bio je prerano.
learner.en: I thought I'd let you down. My entrance on stage was too early.

partner.en: Were we angry?

learner.hr: Nisam znao. Bio sam iznenađen što ste me poslije zagrlili.
learner.en: I didn't know. I was surprised that you hugged me afterwards.

partner.en: What worried you most?

learner.hr: Da više nećete htjeti izlaziti sa mnom pred publiku.
learner.en: That you wouldn't want to go on stage with me anymore.

partner.en: And now?

learner.hr: Trenerica je rekla da je iznenađena jer sam pogodio sve ostale pokrete.
learner.en: The coach said she was surprised because I got all the other movements right.

partner.en: Are you coming tomorrow?

learner.hr: Dolazim. Ne želim iznevjeriti sebe tako da zbog jednog izlaska odustanem.
learner.en: Yes. I don't want to let myself down by quitting over one entrance.

conversations.title: Photographs stuck behind a drawer

partner.en: What's stuck?

learner.hr: Fotografije. Izvukla sam ladicu, ali nisam ih uspjela izvući.
learner.en: Photographs. I pulled the drawer out but couldn't get them out.

partner.en: Want help?

learner.hr: Da. Izvuci samo okvir, pa pokušajmo izvući album zajedno.
learner.en: Yes. Pull out just the frame, then let's try getting the album out together.

partner.en: Is this everything?

learner.hr: Nije. Kad izvučem ovu kuvertu, vidjet ću što preostaje.
learner.en: No. When I pull out this envelope, I'll see what's left.

partner.en: Who put them away?

learner.hr: Brat. Izvukao je dokumente, a slike gurnuo preduboko.
learner.en: My brother. He pulled out documents and pushed the pictures too far in.

partner.en: Here's the album.

learner.hr: Napokon smo ga izvukli. Sad izvučemo i pouku: ne pretrpavati ladice.
learner.en: We've finally got it out. Now we can draw a lesson too: don't overfill drawers.

conversations.title: A model displayed the wrong way round

partner.en: Why's the house turned around?

learner.hr: Postavljač ju je okrenuo prema zidu. Treba je okrenuti.
learner.en: The installer turned it towards the wall. It needs turning around.

partner.en: Like this?

learner.hr: Okreni još malo. Maketa se okreće na podlozi.
learner.en: Turn it a little more. The model turns on its base.

partner.en: Is it right now?

learner.hr: Jest. Okrenite i natpis, da ga posjetitelji mogu pročitati.
learner.en: Yes. Turn the label too so visitors can read it.

partner.en: Why's the picture crooked?

learner.hr: Autorica ju je okrenula namjerno. Na zidu piše objašnjenje.
learner.en: The artist turned it deliberately. There's an explanation on the wall.

partner.en: We don't touch that?

learner.hr: Ne. Takav je prikaz zamišljen, za razliku od naše kuće.
learner.en: No. That display's intentional, unlike our house.

conversations.title: A district boundary on a school map

partner.en: Why are you drawing a boundary?

learner.hr: Naš okrug od susjednog okruga odvaja rijeka.
learner.en: A river separates our district from the neighbouring district.

partner.en: Where's the school?

learner.hr: U ovom okrugu, okružena stablima. Pogledaj krug oko nje.
learner.en: In this district, surrounded by trees. Look at the circle around it.

partner.en: What does the red line represent?

learner.hr: Glavnu cestu. Istočno je most, a istok je na desnoj strani.
learner.en: The main road. The bridge is east, and east is on the right.

partner.en: Where do the buses go?

learner.hr: Prema istoku ujutro, natrag poslijepodne. Kreću gotovo istovremeno.
learner.en: East in the morning, back in the afternoon. They leave almost simultaneously.

partner.en: Can I add the park?

learner.hr: Dodaj ga na istoj podlozi, samo izvan označenog kruga.
learner.en: Add it on the same base, just outside the marked circle.

conversations.title: A film club discusses convincing danger

partner.en: Is the jump real?

learner.hr: Ne. Opasan prizor stvoren je montažom i posebnim efektima.
learner.en: No. The dangerous scene was created with editing and special effects.

partner.en: And the fire?

learner.hr: Ni ona nije prava. Opasna izgleda zbog svjetla.
learner.en: That isn't real either. It looks dangerous because of the lighting.

partner.en: Why are they showing the filming?

learner.hr: Da pokažu kako opasne scene nastaju bez takve opasnosti.
learner.en: To show how dangerous scenes are made without that danger.

partner.en: Are the actors brave?

learner.hr: Jesu, ali nisu neoprezni. Opasni postupci nisu dokaz hrabrosti.
learner.en: Yes, but not careless. Dangerous actions aren't proof of courage.

partner.en: Will you try it?

learner.hr: Ne. Ovakav film nije uputa za ovakvo ponašanje.
learner.en: No. A film like this isn't an instruction for behaviour like that.

conversations.title: A poem needs a different tone

partner.en: Why are you changing the poem?

learner.hr: Ne govori o osjećajima koje smo stvarno osjećali.
learner.en: It doesn't describe the feelings we actually felt.

partner.en: What do you mean?

learner.hr: Osjećamo tugu, ali i olakšanje. Tekst opisuje samo ljutnju.
learner.en: We feel sadness but also relief. The text describes only anger.

partner.en: What do you want to add?

learner.hr: Trenutak kad sam osjetila mir. To mi je posebno osjetljiva uspomena.
learner.en: The moment I felt peace. That's a particularly sensitive memory for me.

partner.en: Is that difficult?

learner.hr: Jest. Kad osjetim nelagodu, zastanem. Osjećanja se ne mogu požuriti.
learner.en: Yes. When I feel discomfort, I pause. Feelings can't be rushed.

partner.en: May I read it?

learner.hr: Smiješ. Reci što osjetiš, ne što misliš da trebam čuti.
learner.en: Yes. Tell me what you feel, not what you think I need to hear.

conversations.title: Making space for a community workshop

partner.en: Where's the workshop?

learner.hr: U skladištu, ako uspijemo osloboditi dovoljno mjesta.
learner.en: In the storeroom, if we manage to free enough space.

partner.en: Who's clearing it?

learner.hr: Luka je oslobodio jedan kut. Mi trebamo osloboditi drugi.
learner.en: Luka freed one corner. We need to free the other.

partner.en: What should I tell the others?

learner.hr: Oslobodite prolaz i ostavite stolove uz zid.
learner.en: Clear the passage and leave the tables beside the wall.

partner.en: Is this box going?

learner.hr: Da, oslobodi tu policu. Oslobođen prostor trebamo za materijal.
learner.en: Yes, clear that shelf. We need the freed space for materials.

partner.en: Is that enough?

learner.hr: Jest. Ovako se možemo kretati bez preskakanja prepreka.
learner.en: Yes. Like this we can move without jumping over obstacles.

conversations.title: Friends decide who stays overnight

partner.en: Who's staying?

learner.hr: Mi ostajemo. Ostali ostaju samo do zadnjeg autobusa.
learner.en: We're staying. The others are staying only until the last bus.

partner.en: Are you staying too?

learner.hr: Ako ostanem, moram javiti doma. Ako ostaneš, podijelit ćemo sobu.
learner.en: If I stay, I need to let home know. If you stay, we'll share the room.

partner.en: Where's the bedding?

learner.hr: Ostavim je na kauču. Vi ostanete ovdje dok donesem deke.
learner.en: I'll leave it on the sofa. You stay here while I fetch blankets.

partner.en: What about the food?

learner.hr: Ostavimo ostatke u kutijama. Ostaci ne moraju završiti u smeću.
learner.en: Let's leave the leftovers in boxes. Leftovers needn't end up in the bin.

partner.en: Should I help?

learner.hr: Da, ne ostavljaj suđe vani. Za sobom ostavljaš trag čaša.
learner.en: Yes, don't leave dishes outside. You're leaving a trail of glasses behind you.

conversations.title: An archaeological discovery changes a display

partner.en: Why are they changing the exhibition?

learner.hr: Arheolozi su otkrili novi ulaz. Otkriće mijenja tumačenje kuće.
learner.en: Archaeologists discovered a new entrance. The discovery changes the interpretation of the house.

partner.en: Who found it?

learner.hr: Studentica je otkrila stepenice, a tim je otkrio cijeli prolaz.
learner.en: A student discovered steps, and the team discovered the whole passage.

partner.en: What does the passage reveal?

learner.hr: Kako su ljudi ulazili. Nova otkrića ne otkrivaju nužno sve.
learner.en: How people entered. New discoveries don't necessarily reveal everything.

partner.en: Can we see it?

learner.hr: Kad otkriju siguran put za posjetitelje. Ne želim smetati istraživanju.
learner.en: When they find a safe visitor route. I don't want to disturb the research.

partner.en: What shall we do meanwhile?

learner.hr: Čitati izvještaj. Možda i sami otkrijemo nešto što nismo primijetili.
learner.en: Read the report. Perhaps we'll discover something we hadn't noticed ourselves.

conversations.title: The keys to a shared studio

partner.en: Who opens tomorrow?

learner.hr: Ja sam otvorio danas. Sutra trebaju otvoriti Ana i Marko.
learner.en: I opened today. Ana and Marko need to open tomorrow.

partner.en: Have they been already?

learner.hr: Jesu. Otvorili su prozore i provjerili opremu.
learner.en: Yes. They opened the windows and checked the equipment.

partner.en: What should I tell them?

learner.hr: Otvorite samo glavna vrata. Kad otvoriš bočna, ulazi vjetar.
learner.en: Open only the main door. When you open the side one, wind comes in.

partner.en: Where are we holding the workshop?

learner.hr: Na otvorenom ako bude sunčano. Tada otvorimo i dvorište.
learner.en: Outdoors if it's sunny. Then we'll open the courtyard too.

partner.en: What if it rains?

learner.hr: Neka otvore veliku sobu. Ovakvim danima trebamo rezervni plan.
learner.en: Have them open the big room. On days like this we need a backup plan.

conversations.title: A list of characters for a hospital drama

partner.en: Who comes in first?

learner.hr: Pacijent koji traži torbu. Ostali pacijenti sjede u čekaonici.
learner.en: The patient looking for his bag. The other patients sit in the waiting room.

partner.en: What do I do?

learner.hr: Pitaš pacijenta za ime, zatim pacijentima objašnjavaš zamjenu torbi.
learner.en: Ask the patient his name, then explain the bag mix-up to the patients.

partner.en: Why am I nervous?

learner.hr: Tvoj lik želi biti pametan, ali brka imena pacijenata.
learner.en: Your character wants to be clever but mixes up the patients' names.

partner.en: How does he get out of it?

learner.hr: Pametno prizna pogrešku. Pametniji je kad posluša pomoćnicu.
learner.en: He wisely admits the mistake. He's smarter when he listens to the assistant.

partner.en: What does he say at the end?

learner.hr: Pametni ljudi također griješe. Samo ne moraju glumiti savršenstvo.
learner.en: Clever people make mistakes too. They just needn't pretend to be perfect.

conversations.title: Labels on a model solar system

partner.en: Why are you moving the spheres?

learner.hr: Svaki model planeta treba svoju oznaku. Dvije planete zamijenile su mjesta.
learner.en: Each planet model needs its label. Two planets have swapped places.

partner.en: What does this say?

learner.hr: Na ovoj planeti nema nacrtanog oceana. Plavu oznaku stavili smo na drugi planet.
learner.en: There's no ocean drawn on this planet. We put the blue label on another planet.

partner.en: Is the spacing accurate?

learner.hr: Nije. U svemiru su udaljenosti mnogo veće nego u našoj kutiji.
learner.en: No. In space the distances are much greater than in our box.

partner.en: What's this arrow?

learner.hr: Svemirski brod, dio priče. Na modelu svemira teško je prikazati kretanje.
learner.en: A spaceship, part of the story. It's difficult to show movement on a model of the universe.

partner.en: May I add a star?

learner.hr: Smiješ, ali ne na planetu. Neka se zna što je model, a što mašta.
learner.en: Yes, but not on the planet. Let's make clear what's a model and what's imagination.

conversations.title: A group splits a meal bill

partner.en: Who paid?

learner.hr: Ana je platila stol, a Marko je platio glazbu. Hranu još trebamo platiti.
learner.en: Ana paid for the table and Marko paid for the music. We still need to pay for the food.

partner.en: Can I pay for everything?

learner.hr: Ne treba. Plati svoj dio, a ja platim ono što sam naručio.
learner.en: No need. Pay your share, and I'll pay for what I ordered.

partner.en: How are the others paying?

learner.hr: Oni plaćaju zajedno. Ti plaćaš odvojeno jer odlaziš ranije.
learner.en: They're paying together. You're paying separately because you're leaving early.

partner.en: Is the tip included?

learner.hr: Nije. Ako platiš karticom, prvo provjeri ukupan iznos.
learner.en: No. If you pay by card, check the total first.

partner.en: What about the cooks?

learner.hr: Oni su plaćeni za rad. Naš račun nije njihova plaća.
learner.en: They're paid for their work. Our bill isn't their salary.

conversations.title: Three blue scarves at a lost-property desk

partner.en: Which scarf is yours?

learner.hr: Plavi s resama. Ona plava kapa nije moja.
learner.en: The blue one with fringes. That blue hat isn't mine.

partner.en: Is it this one?

learner.hr: Nije. Moj je svjetliji, gotovo plavo nebo.
learner.en: No. Mine is lighter, almost sky blue.

partner.en: Who wore it?

learner.hr: Moja sestra, plavuša na fotografiji. Uz šal je nosila plave rukavice.
learner.en: My sister, the blonde in the photograph. She wore blue gloves with the scarf.

partner.en: How did it go missing?

learner.hr: Zaboravila ga je u najbližem kafiću, pa su je poslali ovamo.
learner.en: She left it in the nearest café, and they sent her here.

partner.en: Here's another one.

learner.hr: Taj je pravi. Tko ga je donio zaslužuje posebnu zahvalnost.
learner.en: That's the right one. Whoever brought it deserves special thanks.

conversations.title: A dog is frightened by stage thunder

partner.en: Why's the dog trembling?

learner.hr: Plaši ga zvuk grmljavine s probe. Takvi zvukovi plaše ga i doma.
learner.en: The rehearsal's thunder sound frightens him. Sounds like that frighten him at home too.

partner.en: Shall I turn off the recording?

learner.hr: Molim te. Ne želim ga plašiti samo da provjerimo zvučnik.
learner.en: Please. I don't want to frighten him just to test a speaker.

partner.en: Are you afraid too?

learner.hr: Ne plašim se grmljavine, ali bojim se da će pobjeći.
learner.en: I'm not frightened of thunder, but I worry he'll run away.

partner.en: Are you going home?

learner.hr: Idemo u mirniju sobu. Ti se ne plašiš, ali njemu ovo nije igra.
learner.en: We're going to a quieter room. You're not frightened, but this isn't a game to him.

partner.en: Let me know if you need help.

learner.hr: Hoću. Ne treba vikati da bude hrabar; trebamo mu dati mir.
learner.en: I will. We don't need to shout at him to be brave; we need to give him peace.

conversations.title: A winner shares a chess lesson

partner.en: Who won?

learner.hr: Lea je pobijedila u finalu. Naša ekipa pobijedila je i jučer.
learner.en: Lea won the final. Our team won yesterday too.

partner.en: Did you expect to win?

learner.hr: Nadali smo se, ali pobjeda nije bila sigurna. Pobijedili smo tijesno.
learner.en: We hoped to, but victory wasn't certain. We won narrowly.

partner.en: What does the winner say?

learner.hr: Da nitko ne pobjeđuje sam. Treneri su pripremili cijelu ekipu.
learner.en: That nobody wins alone. The coaches prepared the whole team.

partner.en: Why's everyone laughing?

learner.hr: Mali brat kaže da on pobijedi svakoga kod kuće.
learner.en: Her little brother says he beats everyone at home.

partner.en: Are you celebrating tonight?

learner.hr: Da, ali sutra nastavljamo vježbati. Od pobjede ne postaješ nepogrešiv.
learner.en: Yes, but tomorrow we resume practising. Winning doesn't make you infallible.

conversations.title: Neighbours organise a basement reading room

partner.en: What's happening in the basement?

learner.hr: Lokalna udruga uređuje čitaonicu. Cijelo susjedstvo treba nam dati podršku.
learner.en: A local association is making a reading room. We need the whole neighbourhood's support.

partner.en: Who's involved?

learner.hr: Lokalni knjižničari i stanovnici ovog područja. Želimo podržati djecu koja nemaju mir.
learner.en: Local librarians and residents of this area. We want to support children without a quiet space.

partner.en: Have you got money?

learner.hr: Dio. Lokalne trgovine poklonile su police, a ostalo skupljamo.
learner.en: Some. Local shops donated shelves, and we're collecting the rest.

partner.en: Why there?

learner.hr: U tom području nema knjižnice. Lokacija je dostupna pješice.
learner.en: That area has no library. The location is reachable on foot.

partner.en: How can I help?

learner.hr: Obiđi lokacije s koordinatoricom. Tražimo i drugu lokaciju za veće grupe.
learner.en: Visit the locations with the coordinator. We're also looking for a second location for larger groups.

conversations.title: Choosing a photograph from a contact sheet

partner.en: Which shall we frame?

learner.hr: Pogledam ovu još jednom. Ana je pogledala sve i odabrala treću.
learner.en: I'll look at this one again. Ana looked at them all and chose the third.

partner.en: Have we seen it already?

learner.hr: Jesmo, pogledali smo je na ekranu, ali ne na papiru.
learner.en: Yes, we looked at it on screen, but not on paper.

partner.en: What should I compare?

learner.hr: Kad pogledate lica, vidite razliku u pogledu. Ovdje djeluju opuštenije.
learner.en: When you look at the faces, you see the difference in their expression. Here they seem more relaxed.

partner.en: What if we take both?

learner.hr: Možemo. Pogledamo ih zajedno na zidu prije konačne odluke.
learner.en: We can. We'll look at them together on the wall before deciding.

partner.en: And the small picture?

learner.hr: Kad pogledaš pozadinu, primijetiš dijete koje pogleda ravno u aparat. Ta mi je posebna.
learner.en: When you look at the background, you notice a child looking straight at the camera. That one's special to me.

conversations.title: A guessing game at a fair

partner.en: What are we guessing?

learner.hr: Pogodi broj gumba u staklenci. Ako pogodite, dobijete knjigu.
learner.en: Guess the number of buttons in the jar. If you get it right, you win a book.

partner.en: Has anyone managed?

learner.hr: Jedna djevojčica je pogodila gotovo točno. Nitko nije potpuno pogodio.
learner.en: A little girl got almost exactly right. Nobody got it completely right.

partner.en: What's the other game?

learner.hr: Meta od papira. Cilj je pogođen kad ga dotakne mekana loptica.
learner.en: A paper target. The target's hit when the soft ball touches it.

partner.en: Why aren't they working?

learner.hr: Nedostaje pogon na modelu koji okreće metu. Popravak je u tijeku.
learner.en: The drive on the model that turns the target is missing. Repairs are underway.

partner.en: Shall we wait?

learner.hr: Možemo. Pogodite prvo što ću uzeti za ručak; to je besplatna zagonetka.
learner.en: We can. First guess what I'll have for lunch; that's a free puzzle.

conversations.title: Several people receive the wrong forms

partner.en: Why are you sending a new message?

learner.hr: Poslala sam pogrešne obrasce. Pogriješila sam pri odabiru datoteke.
learner.en: I sent the wrong forms. I made a mistake selecting the file.

partner.en: Is it only your mistake?

learner.hr: Nije. Pogriješili smo i pri provjeri, ali ja sam odgovorna za slanje.
learner.en: No. We made mistakes checking too, but I'm responsible for sending.

partner.en: What does your colleague say?

learner.hr: Preuzeo je svoj dio odgovornosti. Oboje smo odgovorni za ispravak.
learner.en: He's accepted his share of responsibility. We're both responsible for the correction.

partner.en: What are you asking recipients to do?

learner.hr: Da pričekaju. Pogrešna verzija nije konačna, a ja ću im odgovoriti danas.
learner.en: To wait. The incorrect version isn't final, and I'll reply today.

partner.en: Do they need an explanation?

learner.hr: Da, bez skrivanja odgovora. Odgovoran pristup važniji je od dobrog izgovora.
learner.en: Yes, without hiding answers. A responsible approach matters more than a good excuse.

conversations.title: Guests appear at a surprise party

partner.en: Why are you hiding the cakes?

learner.hr: Još se nisu pojavili gosti. Pojavili su se samo susjedi.
learner.en: The guests haven't appeared yet. Only the neighbours have turned up.

partner.en: Who's arriving last?

learner.hr: Brat će se pojaviti sa slavljenicom. Ona ništa ne zna.
learner.en: My brother will appear with the birthday girl. She knows nothing.

partner.en: What if she sees us?

learner.hr: Ako se pojavi prerano, reci da čekamo majstora.
learner.en: If she appears early, say we're waiting for a repairman.

partner.en: Where's your sister?

learner.hr: Pojavila se na stražnjem ulazu. Donijela je pojačanje i još stolica.
learner.en: She appeared at the back entrance. She brought reinforcements and more chairs.

partner.en: Is everything ready?

learner.hr: Jest. Takve pojave dobre volje popravljaju svaki plan.
learner.en: Yes. Such displays of goodwill improve any plan.

conversations.title: A puppet refuses to move

partner.en: Why's the puppet standing still?

learner.hr: Pokreće je motor, ali nitko nije spojio pogon.
learner.en: A motor moves it, but nobody connected the drive.

partner.en: Can you start it?

learner.hr: Mogu nakon provjere. Pokreni snimanje kad vidimo prvi pokret.
learner.en: After checking it, yes. Start recording when we see the first movement.

partner.en: Who built it?

learner.hr: Brat je pokrenuo projekt, a ja sam nacrtala redoslijed pokreta.
learner.en: My brother started the project, and I drew the sequence of movements.

partner.en: Why are you adding cloth?

learner.hr: Treba pokriti spojeve. Kostim pokriva mehanizam dok je lutka u pokretu.
learner.en: The joints need covering. The costume covers the mechanism while the puppet's moving.

partner.en: Is it working now?

learner.hr: Radi. Kretanje je malo čudno, ali odgovara smiješnom liku.
learner.en: Yes. The movement's a little strange, but it suits the funny character.

conversations.title: A kite lands in the wrong garden

partner.en: Where's the kite?

learner.hr: Pokupio ga je susjed. Pokušavali smo ga spustiti na travu.
learner.en: The neighbour picked it up. We were trying to land it on the grass.

partner.en: What went wrong?

learner.hr: Vjetar. Pokušavamo ga razumjeti, ali ne možemo ga kontrolirati.
learner.en: The wind. We're trying to understand it, but can't control it.

partner.en: Shall we fetch it?

learner.hr: Da. Pokupi konop, a ja pokupim ostatak opreme.
learner.en: Yes. Pick up the string, and I'll collect the rest of the equipment.

partner.en: Shall we fly again?

learner.hr: Pokušajmo kasnije. Pokupila sam dovoljno blata za danas.
learner.en: Let's try later. I've collected enough mud for today.

partner.en: What does the neighbour say?

learner.hr: Da pokušate dalje od njegova povrtnjaka. Pokušali smo obećati najbolji mogući let.
learner.en: To try farther from his vegetable patch. We tried to promise the best flight possible.

conversations.title: A police station holds an open day

partner.en: Whom did you meet?

learner.hr: Policajka nas je provela postajom, a policajac je pokazao vozilo.
learner.en: A policewoman showed us around the station, and a policeman showed us the vehicle.

partner.en: Did the children ask questions?

learner.hr: Jesu. Policajci su strpljivo slušali, a jednom policajcu postavili su deset pitanja.
learner.en: Yes. The officers listened patiently, and one officer got ten questions.

partner.en: What was most interesting?

learner.hr: Razgovor s policijom o svakodnevnom poslu, umjesto samo filmskih potjera.
learner.en: Talking with the police about everyday work instead of just film chases.

partner.en: May they photograph things?

learner.hr: Pitali smo policajca. Policijska oprema smije se snimiti samo gdje su rekli.
learner.en: We asked an officer. The police equipment can be photographed only where they specified.

partner.en: How did it end?

learner.hr: Pozdravili smo policajce i pozvali policiju na školski sajam.
learner.en: We said goodbye to the officers and invited the police to the school fair.

conversations.title: Actors discuss a romantic scene

partner.en: Have you agreed on the scene?

learner.hr: Jesmo. Poljubac ćemo samo naznačiti pokretom, bez stvarnog ljubljenja.
learner.en: Yes. We'll only suggest the kiss through movement, without actually kissing.

partner.en: Why did you change the script?

learner.hr: Glumica nije htjela da je poljubi. Redatelj je to prihvatio.
learner.en: The actress didn't want him to kiss her. The director accepted that.

partner.en: Did her partner understand?

learner.hr: Jest. Rekao je da neće poljubiti nikoga protiv dogovora.
learner.en: Yes. He said he wouldn't kiss anyone against their agreement.

partner.en: Will the audience understand?

learner.hr: Hoće. Lik kaže da ju je poljubio u snu, a ona njega nije poljubila.
learner.en: Yes. The character says he kissed her in a dream, but she didn't kiss him.

partner.en: How do you finish?

learner.hr: Pogledom i osmijehom. Ljubavni prizor ne mora prijeći osobne granice.
learner.en: With a look and a smile. A romantic scene needn't cross personal boundaries.

conversations.title: Everyone helps at a book fair

partner.en: Who's helping you?

learner.hr: Pomoćnik nosi kutije, a pomoćnica provjerava popis stolova.
learner.en: The male assistant carries boxes, and the female assistant checks the table list.

partner.en: Do you need more people?

learner.hr: Da, pomozite nam složiti knjige. Djeca pomažu označavati cijene.
learner.en: Yes, help us arrange the books. The children are helping label prices.

partner.en: Can I call my brother?

learner.hr: Možeš. Ako mu pomogneš pronaći adresu, ranije će doći.
learner.en: Yes. If you help him find the address, he'll arrive sooner.

partner.en: Where should he go?

learner.hr: Do pomoćnika. Kad mu pomognemo s kutijama, otvorit ćemo sajam.
learner.en: To the assistant. When we help him with the boxes, we'll open the fair.

partner.en: We'll stay until the end.

learner.hr: Hvala. Ljudi koji pomognu pri spremanju posebno nam mnogo znače.
learner.en: Thank you. People who help with packing up mean a great deal to us.

conversations.title: A joke goes wrong during rehearsal

partner.en: Why did she leave?

learner.hr: Rekao sam glupu šalu. Ponašao sam se kao da smo svi isti.
learner.en: I made a foolish joke. I acted as if we were all the same.

partner.en: What were you thinking?

learner.hr: Mislio sam je nasmijati. Nisam pomislio kako će se osjećati.
learner.en: I thought I'd make her laugh. I didn't think how she'd feel.

partner.en: Will you apologise?

learner.hr: Hoću. Ne želim da pomisli da mi je njezina nelagoda smiješna.
learner.en: Yes. I don't want her to think I find her discomfort funny.

partner.en: Is that enough?

learner.hr: Možda nije. Moram promijeniti ponašanje, ne samo ponavljati isprike.
learner.en: Perhaps not. I need to change my behaviour, not just repeat apologies.

partner.en: How will you start?

learner.hr: Kad pomislim na šalu, kažem sebi: ponašaj se pristojno.
learner.en: When I think of a joke, I tell myself to behave politely.

conversations.title: A parent waits up after a graduation party

partner.en: Why aren't you asleep yet?

learner.hr: Čekala sam da se vratiš. Ponosim se tobom i ovom diplomom.
learner.en: I waited for you to come back. I'm proud of you and this degree.

partner.en: Am I too late?

learner.hr: Nisi. Tek je prošla ponoć, a i mi smo nekad slavili do ponoći.
learner.en: No. Midnight has only just passed, and we used to celebrate until midnight too.

partner.en: Did you all watch the broadcast?

learner.hr: Jesmo. Bili smo ponosni, a baka je tražila da ponovimo snimku.
learner.en: Yes. We were proud, and Grandma asked us to replay the recording.

partner.en: Can I call her tomorrow?

learner.hr: Možeš. Njezin ponos čut ćeš u svakoj rečenici.
learner.en: Yes. You'll hear her pride in every sentence.

partner.en: Want to see the degree again?

learner.hr: Hoću. Rado ću ponoviti i čestitke, koliko god puta želiš.
learner.en: Yes. I'll gladly repeat the congratulations too, as often as you like.

conversations.title: An offer that needs time to consider

partner.en: Why didn't you accept immediately?

learner.hr: Ponuda je dobra, ali trebam razmisliti prije odluke.
learner.en: The offer's good, but I need to think before deciding.

partner.en: What did they offer?

learner.hr: Ponudili su prostor. Vlasnica je ponudila i dio opreme.
learner.en: They offered space. The owner offered some equipment too.

partner.en: What are you offering?

learner.hr: Mogu ponuditi radionice, ali ne mogu obećati svaki vikend.
learner.en: I can offer workshops, but can't promise every weekend.

partner.en: Has anyone advised you?

learner.hr: Kolega je ponudio pomoć. Kaže: ponudi raspored koji stvarno možeš ispuniti.
learner.en: A colleague offered help. He says: offer a schedule you can actually fulfil.

partner.en: When do you answer?

learner.hr: Sutra. Dotad ću pripremiti potpunu sliku svojih obaveza.
learner.en: Tomorrow. By then I'll prepare a complete picture of my commitments.

conversations.title: A thermos comes home empty

partner.en: Who drank the tea?

learner.hr: Svi smo popili po malo. Nismo provjerili koliko ostaje.
learner.en: We all drank a little. We didn't check how much was left.

partner.en: Did you too?

learner.hr: Jesam, popila sam zadnju šalicu. Mislila sam da si već pio.
learner.en: Yes, I drank the last cup. I thought you'd already had some.

partner.en: What should I drink?

learner.hr: Popij vodu, a doma ću skuhati novi čaj.
learner.en: Have some water, and I'll make fresh tea at home.

partner.en: Is anything else missing?

learner.hr: Da, s popisa stvari nestala je i mala žlica.
learner.en: Yes, the little spoon's also gone from the list of things we packed.

partner.en: Where did we leave it?

learner.hr: Možda uz prazne čaše. Kad popijemo vodu, provjerimo stol još jednom.
learner.en: Maybe beside the empty cups. When we've drunk the water, let's check the table again.

conversations.title: A damaged bench becomes an excuse to talk

partner.en: Why are you carrying tools?

learner.hr: Trebam popraviti klupu i popričati s prijateljem koji ju je napravio.
learner.en: I need to repair a bench and talk to the friend who made it.

partner.en: Did you argue?

learner.hr: Jesmo. Pomisao na susret bila mi je poprilično neugodna.
learner.en: Yes. The thought of meeting was quite uncomfortable for me.

partner.en: What do you want to say?

learner.hr: Da se želim pomiriti. Klupu možemo popraviti dok popričamo.
learner.en: That I want to make peace. We can repair the bench while talking.

partner.en: Will he come?

learner.hr: Hoće. Rekao je: popravi nosač, a ja ću donijeti daske.
learner.en: Yes. He said: repair the support, and I'll bring the boards.

partner.en: And your relationship?

learner.hr: Nadam se da ga popravimo također. Moram najprije iskreno popričati, ne glumiti da je sve prošlo.
learner.en: I hope we repair that too. First I need an honest talk, not to pretend it's all over.

conversations.title: A special museum visit for a family

partner.en: Why are you arriving earlier?

learner.hr: Dogovorili smo posebnu posjetu. Djed teško hoda kroz velike grupe.
learner.en: We've arranged a special visit. Grandad finds it difficult to walk through large groups.

partner.en: What interests him?

learner.hr: Posjetio je ovaj posjed kao dijete. Sada ga posjeduje muzej.
learner.en: He visited this estate as a child. Now the museum owns it.

partner.en: Do you have special requests?

learner.hr: Samo klupu. Posebna oprema nije potrebna, ali odmori mu znače mnogo.
learner.en: Just a bench. Special equipment isn't needed, but rests matter to him.

partner.en: How many are coming?

learner.hr: Pet posjetitelja. Termin posjete potvrdili smo posebnim obrascem.
learner.en: Five visitors. We confirmed the visit time using a special form.

partner.en: Would you like a guide?

learner.hr: Da, ako može govoriti o povijesti posjeda, ne samo o izložbi.
learner.en: Yes, if they can talk about the estate's history, not only the exhibition.

conversations.title: A petition needs valid signatures

partner.en: Is the application ready?

learner.hr: Gotovo. Potpisali smo izjavu, ali potpuna lista priloga još nedostaje.
learner.en: Almost. We signed the declaration, but the complete attachment list is still missing.

partner.en: Has Marko signed?

learner.hr: Jest. Potpisao je jučer, ali zaboravio je upisati datum.
learner.en: Yes. He signed yesterday but forgot to enter the date.

partner.en: What should I do?

learner.hr: Potpiši ovdje tek nakon čitanja. Nema smisla potpisati nepročitan tekst.
learner.en: Sign here only after reading. There's no point signing an unread text.

partner.en: Can I send it now?

learner.hr: Ne još. Treba nam potpuni popis i potvrda da su podaci potpuni.
learner.en: Not yet. We need a full list and confirmation that the details are complete.

partner.en: Why so much checking?

learner.hr: Da u potpunosti razumijemo zahtjev. Želimo poslati potpunu prijavu.
learner.en: So we fully understand the requirement. We want to send a complete application.

conversations.title: A costume disappears before a show

partner.en: Where's the cloak?

learner.hr: Ne znam. Organizirali smo potragu jer je potreban u prvoj sceni.
learner.en: I don't know. We organised a search because it's needed in the first scene.

partner.en: What's been searched?

learner.hr: Garderoba. U potrazi smo za tamnim ogrtačem, ne za potrebnim nakitom.
learner.en: The dressing room. We're looking for a dark cloak, not the necessary jewellery.

partner.en: Do I need assistants?

learner.hr: Da, potrebni su nam ljudi koji poznaju skladište.
learner.en: Yes, we need people who know the storeroom.

partner.en: Where else should I look?

learner.hr: Potraži iza kulisa. Potreba za rezervnim kostimom sada je očita.
learner.en: Look backstage. The need for a spare costume is obvious now.

partner.en: Will it take long?

learner.hr: Može potrajati, ali potrebne su nam mirne glave, ne panika.
learner.en: It might take a while, but what we need is calm heads, not panic.

conversations.title: Photographs connect two family stories

partner.en: Why are you carrying two albums?

learner.hr: Priče su povezane. Djed je poveo baku na taj izlet.
learner.en: The stories are connected. Grandad took Grandma on that trip.

partner.en: What shows the connection?

learner.hr: Ista kuća. S njom je povezan početak njihove veze.
learner.en: The same house. The beginning of their relationship is connected to it.

partner.en: Who else can we ask?

learner.hr: Povedi tetu. Može nas povesti do mjesta sa slike.
learner.en: Bring our aunt. She can take us to the place in the picture.

partner.hr: Jesu li svi ti ljudi povezani?
partner.en: Are all those people connected?

learner.hr: Jesu. Povezano je više obitelji, ne samo naša.
learner.en: Yes. Several families are connected, not just ours.

partner.en: Do we need a bigger album?

learner.hr: Trebamo povećati broj stranica, ne samo naslagati slike bez objašnjenja.
learner.en: We need to increase the page count, not just stack pictures without explanation.

conversations.title: A scratch on a borrowed table

partner.en: Why are you looking at the table?

learner.hr: Površina je izgrebena. Na površini se vide tragovi metalne kutije.
learner.en: The surface is scratched. You can see marks from the metal box on it.

partner.en: Did you do that?

learner.hr: Jesam. Pri povratku sam zaboravila zaštititi površinu ispod kutije.
learner.en: Yes. On the return trip I forgot to protect the surface under the box.

partner.en: Will you tell the owner?

learner.hr: Hoću. Ne želim je povrijediti skrivanjem štete.
learner.en: Yes. I don't want to hurt her by hiding the damage.

partner.en: What if she's angry?

learner.hr: Ima razloga. Ja bih također bila povrijeđena da netko prešuti oštećenje.
learner.en: She has reason to be. I'd feel hurt too if someone hid damage.

partner.en: Can you offer to repair it?

learner.hr: Mogu. Poslije povrede povjerenja moram pokazati odgovornost, ne samo žaljenje.
learner.en: Yes. After a breach of trust I need to show responsibility, not just regret.

conversations.title: A player tries a different position

partner.en: Why are you at the back today?

learner.hr: Trener mijenja pozicije. Na ovoj poziciji moram pratiti cijeli teren.
learner.en: The coach is changing positions. In this position I need to watch the whole field.

partner.en: Do you like it?

learner.hr: Zasad imam pozitivan osjećaj. Pozitivno je učiti nešto novo.
learner.en: So far I feel positive. It's positive to learn something new.

partner.en: What's hardest?

learner.hr: Zadržati poziciju kad lopta ode naprijed. Instinkt me vuče za njom.
learner.en: Holding my position when the ball goes forward. Instinct pulls me after it.

partner.en: What does the coach say?

learner.hr: Pozivam te da razmisliš prije trčanja, kaže svaki put.
learner.en: I invite you to think before running, he says every time.

partner.en: Will you continue?

learner.hr: Hoću. Njegove pozive na strpljenje slušam; ostali pozivi mogu čekati.
learner.en: Yes. I listen to his calls for patience; other calls can wait.

conversations.title: An old teacher looks familiar

partner.en: Do you know that lady?

learner.hr: Poznam je iz škole. Njezino lice dobro mi je poznato.
learner.en: I know her from school. Her face is very familiar to me.

partner.en: Was she famous?

learner.hr: Nama jest. Poznata učiteljica u malom mjestu poznaje sve obitelji.
learner.en: To us she was. A well-known teacher in a small town knows every family.

partner.en: Have you spoken?

learner.hr: Jesmo. Poznavala je moju majku, a roditelji su poznavali njezine roditelje.
learner.en: Yes. She knew my mother, and our parents knew her parents.

partner.en: What did she say?

learner.hr: Da prepoznaješ ljude po glasu, ne samo po licu. Mene je prepoznala odmah.
learner.en: That you recognise people by their voice, not just their face. She recognised me immediately.

partner.en: Will you invite her?

learner.hr: Hoćemo. Poznati iz razreda organiziraju susret za sve poznate učitelje.
learner.en: Yes. Acquaintances from our class are organising a gathering for all the teachers we knew.

conversations.title: An usher tries to gather a scattered group

partner.en: Who's still missing?

learner.hr: Dvoje ljudi. Zamolit ću redara: pozovite ih s balkona.
learner.en: Two people. I'll ask the usher: call them from the balcony.

partner.en: How will he recognise them?

learner.hr: Kad ih pozove, neka kaže naziv naše škole.
learner.en: When he calls them, have him say our school's name.

partner.en: What do you tell the group?

learner.hr: Pozor, obratite pozornost na izlaz! Ne želim ih izgubiti opet.
learner.en: Attention, pay attention to the exit! I don't want to lose them again.

partner.en: And the two of them?

learner.hr: Kad pozoveš prijatelje, odgovoran si da znaju gdje se okupljamo.
learner.en: When you invite friends, you're responsible for them knowing where we're gathering.

partner.en: Is everyone finally here?

learner.hr: Jesu. Redar se našalio da ga zovemo pozorniče, kao u starom filmu.
learner.en: Yes. The usher joked that we should call him constable, like in an old film.

conversations.title: A course begins with practical work

partner.en: How did it begin?

learner.hr: Počelo je kišom. Ipak smo počeli raditi odmah nakon uvoda.
learner.en: It began with rain. We still started working right after the introduction.

partner.en: What are you starting?

learner.hr: Počinjemo saditi, počevši od najjednostavnijih biljaka.
learner.en: We're starting to plant, beginning with the simplest plants.

partner.en: Did you miss anything?

learner.hr: Nisam. Sve grupe počinju u isto vrijeme, a ja sam stigla ranije.
learner.en: No. All groups begin at the same time, and I arrived early.

partner.en: What does the instructor say?

learner.hr: Kad počinješ, ne moraš znati sve. Važno je pitati.
learner.en: When you're starting, you needn't know everything. Asking matters.

partner.en: And afterwards?

learner.hr: Nakon nastave trebamo počistiti prostor. Želimo ostaviti vrt boljim nego prije.
learner.en: After class we need to clean up. We want to leave the garden better than before.

conversations.title: Someone apologises to a postal worker

partner.en: Why did you return?

learner.hr: Bio sam neugodan djelatnici. Pošta nije kriva što sam zakasnio.
learner.en: I was unpleasant to the clerk. It isn't the post office's fault I was late.

partner.en: What will you tell her?

learner.hr: Da poštujem njezin rad i da moje ponašanje nije bilo pošteno.
learner.en: That I respect her work and that my behaviour wasn't fair.

partner.en: Will she listen?

learner.hr: Nadam se. Ne tražim uslugu, nego želim pokazati poštovanje.
learner.en: I hope so. I'm not asking a favour; I want to show respect.

partner.en: Why does it matter?

learner.hr: Ljudi poštuju mirne kupce. I ona zaslužuje da je se poštuje.
learner.en: People respect calm customers. She deserves to be respected too.

partner.en: Are you going now?

learner.hr: Da, u poštu. Bez velikog govora, samo iskrena isprika iz poštovanja.
learner.en: Yes, to the post office. No big speech, just a sincere apology out of respect.

conversations.title: A parade needs people at both ends

partner.en: Where are the volunteers?

learner.hr: Prate povorku. Mi pratimo kraj, a druga grupa početak.
learner.en: They're following the parade. We follow the rear; another group follows the front.

partner.en: Who's leading the children?

learner.hr: Učitelj ih je pratio do ulaza. Sada imaju pratnju roditelja.
learner.en: The teacher accompanied them to the entrance. Now their parents accompany them.

partner.en: What should I tell the others?

learner.hr: Pratite oznake. Ako pratiš samo glazbu, možeš skrenuti krivo.
learner.en: Follow the signs. If you only follow the music, you may turn the wrong way.

partner.en: Have you done this before?

learner.hr: Jesmo, pratili smo povorku lani. Gledali smo je godinama prije volontiranja.
learner.en: Yes, we followed the parade last year. We'd watched it for years before volunteering.

partner.en: What if someone stops?

learner.hr: Pomozite mu. Kad gledate cijelu grupu, primijetite tko treba odmor.
learner.en: Help them. When you watch the whole group, you notice who needs a rest.

conversations.title: A book club debates justice

partner.hr: Zašto ti se kraj ne sviđa?
partner.en: Why don't you like the ending?

learner.hr: Pravda nije isto što i osveta. Lik traži pravdu, ali kažnjava sve.
learner.en: Justice isn't the same as revenge. The character seeks justice but punishes everyone.

partner.en: Wasn't he hurt?

learner.hr: Jest. To mu daje prava, ali ne pravo na tuđe poniženje.
learner.en: Yes. That gives him rights, but not a right to humiliate others.

partner.en: What would be fair?

learner.hr: Dati prostor i drugoj strani. Bez nje nema pravog osjećaja pravde.
learner.en: Give the other side space too. Without it there's no real sense of justice.

partner.en: Did he act correctly?

learner.hr: Ne mislim. S pravim informacijama možda bi odabrao drukčije.
learner.en: I don't think so. With the right information he might have chosen differently.

partner.en: Is that why you want a sequel?

learner.hr: Da vidim može li priznati da je bio na krivom putu.
learner.en: To see whether he can admit he was on the wrong path.

conversations.title: A recording interrupted three times

partner.en: Why are you recording again?

learner.hr: Prekinula nas je dostava, a onda je susjed prekinuo tišinu bušilicom.
learner.en: A delivery interrupted us, and then the neighbour broke the silence with a drill.

partner.en: Couldn't you continue?

learner.hr: Jesmo, ali prekid se čuje. Prekinuli smo i dogovorili novu snimku.
learner.en: We could, but the interruption is audible. We stopped and arranged a new recording.

partner.en: What does the guest say?

learner.hr: Prekinite slobodno, kaže. On razumije koliko zvuk utječe na razgovor.
learner.en: Feel free to stop, he says. He understands how sound affects a conversation.

partner.en: Why's your colleague calling?

learner.hr: Kaže: prekini kad treba, nemoj pustiti da umor prekida misao.
learner.en: She says: stop when needed; don't let tiredness interrupt your train of thought.

partner.en: Will you finish today?

learner.hr: Hoćemo. Samo moramo prekinuti naviku ostavljanja uključenih telefona.
learner.en: Yes. We just need to break the habit of leaving phones switched on.

conversations.title: Moving reveals an old box

partner.en: What did you find?

learner.hr: Kutiju pisama. Preselili smo je triput, a nismo je otvorili.
learner.en: A box of letters. We moved it three times without opening it.

partner.en: Whose letters are they?

learner.hr: Stričeva. Kad se preselio, zamolio nas je da ih čuvamo.
learner.en: Our uncle's. When he moved, he asked us to keep them.

partner.en: Will you read them?

learner.hr: Samo ako dopusti. Nećemo pretražiti tuđe uspomene bez pitanja.
learner.en: Only if he allows it. We won't search someone else's memories without asking.

partner.en: Was he looking for them?

learner.hr: Jest. Pretražili smo podrum i prestali tek kad smo našli kutiju.
learner.en: Yes. We searched the basement and stopped only when we found the box.

partner.en: Can you call him?

learner.hr: Hoću. Nije prestar da se preseli bliže nama, ako to poželi.
learner.en: I will. He isn't too old to move closer to us if he wants to.

conversations.title: An actor plays an unconvincing liar

partner.en: Why does the audience believe you?

learner.hr: Moj prevarant djeluje ljubazno. Prevario je i glumce na prvoj probi.
learner.en: My conman seems kind. He fooled even the actors at the first rehearsal.

partner.en: Is that deliberate?

learner.hr: Jest. Ne smijem pokazati da pokušava prevariti ljude prije završetka.
learner.en: Yes. I mustn't show that he's trying to deceive people before the ending.

partner.en: Who exposes him?

learner.hr: Žena koja kaže da je i sama prevarila nekoga. Prepoznaje njegove laži.
learner.en: A woman who says she has deceived someone herself. She recognises his lies.

partner.en: What does she say to him?

learner.hr: Lažeš, a misliš da si jedini pametan. On prvi put zastane.
learner.en: You're lying, and think you're the only clever one. He pauses for the first time.

partner.en: And then?

learner.hr: Prizna da laže jer se boji istine. Nije opravdanje, nego objašnjenje.
learner.en: He admits he lies because he's afraid of the truth. It's an explanation, not an excuse.

conversations.title: Different survivors tell the same story

partner.en: Who survived?

learner.hr: Dvoje putnika. Ona je preživjela oluju, a on je preživio nesreću prije nje.
learner.en: Two passengers. She survived the storm; he survived an accident before it.

partner.en: What connects them?

learner.hr: Preživjeli su zajedno. Preživljavanje im je promijenilo odnos prema malim stvarima.
learner.en: They survived together. Survival changed their attitude to small things.

partner.en: Is the story tense?

learner.hr: Jest, ali nije uputa kako da se preživi. Više govori o povjerenju.
learner.en: Yes, but it isn't a survival guide. It's more about trust.

partner.en: Does it mention fate?

learner.hr: Ona vjeruje u sudbinu, on misli da je sudbina samo drugo ime za slučajnost.
learner.en: She believes in fate; he thinks fate is just another name for chance.

partner.en: Who's right?

learner.hr: Pisac ne odlučuje. Ostavlja nam dvije sudbine i prostor za razmišljanje.
learner.en: The writer doesn't decide. He leaves us two destinies and room to think.

conversations.title: Accepting a volunteer role with limits

partner.en: Did you agree?

learner.hr: Jesam. Prihvatila sam ulogu, ali nisam prihvatila svaki predloženi termin.
learner.en: Yes. I accepted the role, but not every proposed time slot.

partner.en: Were they upset?

learner.hr: Nisu. Prihvatili su moj raspored. I novi koordinator ga je prihvatio.
learner.en: No. They accepted my schedule. The new coordinator accepted it too.

partner.en: What do you tell your sister?
