learner.hr: Prihvati posao samo ako ti odgovara. Nitko ne mora prihvaćati sve.
learner.en: Accept the job only if it suits you. Nobody has to accept everything.

partner.en: What does the association ask?

learner.hr: Odgovornost. Prihvaća ljude s različitim mogućnostima, ne traži stalnu dostupnost.
learner.en: Responsibility. It accepts people with different capacities, not constant availability.

partner.en: Is that a relief?

learner.hr: Jest. Pristajem pomagati, ne pristajem nestati pod obavezama.
learner.en: Yes. I agree to help, not to disappear under obligations.

conversations.title: Several neighbours report a damaged bike rack

partner.en: Have you reported the fault?

learner.hr: Jesam. Prijavio sam oštećeni stalak i poslao fotografiju.
learner.en: Yes. I reported the damaged rack and sent a photograph.

partner.en: Hadn't Ana already done that?

learner.hr: Jest, prijavila ga je jučer. Prijavili smo isto na dva mjesta.
learner.en: Yes, she reported it yesterday. We reported the same thing in two places.

partner.en: Will you combine the reports?

learner.hr: Pitat ćemo. Uz prijavu sam naveo kontakt odgovorne službe.
learner.en: We'll ask. I included the responsible department's contact with the report.

partner.en: What does the neighbour say?

learner.hr: Prijavi i drugu pukotinu, kaže. Boji se da predstavlja prijetnju prolaznicima.
learner.en: Report the other crack too, he says. He fears it poses a threat to passers-by.

partner.en: Has anyone replied?

learner.hr: Jest. Bez prijetnje ili svađe dogovorili smo pregled, prijateljski i jasno.
learner.en: Yes. Without threats or arguing we arranged an inspection, in a friendly, clear way.

conversations.title: A parcel receipt identifies the wrong recipient

partner.en: Has the parcel arrived?

learner.hr: Piše primljeno, ali ja ništa nisam primio.
learner.en: It says received, but I haven't received anything.

partner.en: Who received it?

learner.hr: Susjeda je primila paket. Broj stana zamijenjen je na oznaci.
learner.en: A neighbour received the parcel. The flat number was mixed up on the label.

partner.en: What does the delivery person say?

learner.hr: Pita jesmo li primili obavijest. Ja primam poruke na drugom broju.
learner.en: He asks whether we received a notification. I receive messages on another number.

partner.en: Can you collect it?

learner.hr: Mogu. Primi poziv ako me traži, dok odem do susjede.
learner.en: Yes. Take the call if he asks for me while I go to the neighbour.

partner.en: What actually happened?

learner.hr: Nitko nije primijetio krivi broj. Nije nestanak, nego pogrešan prijem.
learner.en: Nobody noticed the wrong number. It isn't a disappearance, but delivery to the wrong person.

conversations.title: A princess refuses the expected ending

partner.en: Why does the princess leave?

learner.hr: Ne želi čekati princa. Princ u ovoj priči uopće nije spasitelj.
learner.en: She doesn't want to wait for the prince. The prince isn't a rescuer in this story at all.

partner.en: What does the king say?

learner.hr: Princezo, pripadaš našem dvoru. Ona odgovara da pripada sebi.
learner.en: Princess, you belong to our court. She replies that she belongs to herself.

partner.en: What does the prince want?

learner.hr: Svojim likovima ne pripisujemo ista htijenja. On želi učiti vrtlarstvo.
learner.en: We don't give our characters identical wishes. He wants to learn gardening.

partner.en: Will they meet?

learner.hr: Hoće. Princezu čeka vrt, a njemu pripadaju sjemenke koje je donijela.
learner.en: Yes. The garden awaits the princess, and the seeds she brought belong to him.

partner.en: Is that the ending?

learner.hr: Jest. Pripadam ovoj priči jer dopušta drukčije planove, rekla je mala glumica.
learner.en: Yes. I belong in this story because it allows different plans, the little actress said.

conversations.title: A walk supplies materials for an art class

partner.en: What are you collecting?

learner.hr: Samo otpalo lišće. Priroda nije skladište iz kojeg uzimamo sve.
learner.en: Only fallen leaves. Nature isn't a storeroom where we take everything.

partner.en: Why leaves?

learner.hr: Zanimaju nas prirodni oblici i prirodna promjena boja.
learner.en: We're interested in natural shapes and the natural change of colours.

partner.en: Will you paint?

learner.hr: Hoćemo, ali prvo razgovaramo o zaštiti prirode. To pripada zadatku.
learner.en: Yes, but first we're discussing nature conservation. That's part of the assignment.

partner.en: What does the teacher say?

learner.hr: Da je prirodno biti znatiželjan, ali nije dobro ostaviti smeće u šumi.
learner.en: That being curious is natural, but leaving rubbish in the forest isn't good.

partner.en: How do you finish the walk?

learner.hr: Provjerom okoliša. Neka naša prisutnost ne bude teret životinjama.
learner.en: By checking the surroundings. Let's not make our presence a burden to animals.

conversations.title: An invitation should not feel compulsory

partner.en: Why didn't your colleague come?

learner.hr: Nije mogla pristupiti pozivu. Bila je prisutna na drugom sastanku.
learner.en: She couldn't join the call. She was present at another meeting.

partner.en: Did you pressure her?

learner.hr: Nisam. Ne želim prisiliti nikoga da bira bez dovoljno informacija.
learner.en: No. I don't want to force anyone to choose without enough information.

partner.en: What did the others say?

learner.hr: Pristali su premjestiti razgovor. Jedan kolega pristao je voditi bilješke.
learner.en: They agreed to move the discussion. One colleague agreed to take notes.

partner.en: Was that awkward?

learner.hr: Malo, ali pristojan odgovor olakšao je dogovor.
learner.en: A little, but a courteous reply made agreement easier.

partner.en: What did you write to her?

learner.hr: Pristojno sam objasnio promjenu. Nije morala opravdavati svoju odsutnost.
learner.en: I explained the change politely. She didn't have to justify her absence.

conversations.title: Private pages left in a shared printer

partner.en: Why are you covering the printout?

learner.hr: Na papiru su privatne informacije. Privatna poruka nije za hodnik.
learner.en: The paper contains private information. A private message doesn't belong in a corridor.

partner.en: What should I do?

learner.hr: Pritisni zaustavljanje. Jednim pritiskom možemo prekinuti daljnji ispis.
learner.en: Press stop. With one press we can stop further printing.

partner.en: Will you read it?

learner.hr: Neću. Privatnost vrijedi i kad netko slučajno ostavi papir.
learner.en: No. Privacy matters even when someone leaves paper behind accidentally.

partner.en: Whom shall we give it to?

learner.hr: Vlasnici, privatno. Ne želim stvoriti pritisak pred kolegama.
learner.en: The owner, privately. I don't want to put pressure on her in front of colleagues.

partner.en: Is the printer free?

learner.hr: Sad jest. Uzmi svoje stranice, a tuđe ostavi pokrivene.
learner.en: Now it is. Take your pages and leave the other person's covered.

conversations.title: Someone admits breaking a favourite mug

partner.en: Why are you so quiet?

learner.hr: Razbila sam šalicu i nisam priznala. Sad me muči krivnja.
learner.en: I broke a mug and didn't admit it. Now guilt's bothering me.

partner.en: Who was blamed?

learner.hr: Brat. Nije krivac, a ja moram priznati istinu.
learner.en: My brother. He isn't the culprit, and I need to admit the truth.

partner.en: What are you waiting for?

learner.hr: Da skupim hrabrost. Kažem sebi: priznaj prije nego što postane gore.
learner.en: To gather courage. I tell myself: admit it before it gets worse.

partner.en: What if they're angry?

learner.hr: To prihvaćam. Kad priznam, mogu barem prestati skrivati krivnju.
learner.en: I accept that. When I admit it, at least I can stop hiding my guilt.

partner.en: Did your brother say anything?

learner.hr: Rekao je da je i on priznao svoju pogrešku jučer. Priznanje nije slabost.
learner.en: He said he admitted his own mistake yesterday too. Admitting something isn't weakness.

conversations.title: Recording a story before everyone interrupts

partner.en: Who speaks first?

learner.hr: Baka. Pričala nam je o školi, ali svi pričaju istovremeno.
learner.en: Grandma. She told us about school, but everyone's speaking at once.

partner.en: What should I say?

learner.hr: Pričaj polako, bako. Ostali će pitati kad završiš.
learner.en: Tell it slowly, Grandma. The others will ask when you've finished.

partner.en: Why are you recording?

learner.hr: Jer smo pričali o tome da priče sačuvamo. Djed je također pričao mnogo.
learner.en: Because we talked about preserving the stories. Grandad told lots too.

partner.en: What shall we ask?

learner.hr: O čemu pričate kad spomenete stari most? Tko je tada prelazio?
learner.en: What are you talking about when you mention the old bridge? Who crossed then?

partner.en: Shall we publish it?

learner.hr: Samo uz dopuštenje. Svojom pričom baka nam poklanja vrijeme, ne vlasništvo nad uspomenama.
learner.en: Only with permission. In sharing her story, Grandma gives us time, not ownership of her memories.

conversations.title: A bakery tests a new loaf

partner.en: Have you tasted them yet?

learner.hr: Probala sam tamni kruh. Kolega je probao svijetli.
learner.en: I tried the dark bread. My colleague tried the light one.

partner.en: Which do we offer guests?

learner.hr: Probajmo oba. Kad probamo, lakše ćemo objasniti razliku.
learner.en: Let's try both. Once we try them, it'll be easier to explain the difference.

partner.en: What should I write on the board?

learner.hr: Probajte novi kruh, pa nam recite kako vam odgovara.
learner.en: Try the new bread, then tell us how it suits you.

partner.en: Does it taste different?

learner.hr: Jest. Kad probaš koricu, osjetiš koliko je hrskava. Ja probam i sredinu.
learner.en: Yes. When you try the crust, you feel how crisp it is. I try the middle too.

partner.en: May I take a piece?

learner.hr: Smiješ. Cilj je probati, ne samo gledati lijepo složene kriške.
learner.en: Yes. The point is tasting, not just looking at nicely arranged slices.

conversations.title: Three friends share a second-hand stall

partner.en: What are you selling?

learner.hr: Prodajem knjige, a sestra prodaje stare igračke.
learner.en: I'm selling books, and my sister's selling old toys.

partner.en: Have you earned anything?

learner.hr: Jesmo. Prodala je lutku, a ja sam prodao tri romana.
learner.en: Yes. She sold a doll, and I sold three novels.

partner.en: Who else is here?

learner.hr: Susjed. Prodavao je ploče godinama, a sad prodaju prepušta nama.
learner.en: A neighbour. He sold records for years and now leaves the selling to us.

partner.en: Why not give everything away?

learner.hr: Dio darujemo. Prodaja drugog dijela pokriva najam stola.
learner.en: We give some away. Selling the rest covers the table hire.

partner.en: Are you coming again?

learner.hr: Vjerojatno. Lijepo je prodavati nešto što drugome još može koristiti.
learner.en: Probably. It's nice selling something someone else can still use.

conversations.title: An old walking route looks new

partner.en: Why did you stop?

learner.hr: Ovim prolazom nisam dugo prolazila. Sada se sve zeleni.
learner.en: I haven't walked through this passage for ages. Everything's green now.

partner.en: What's changed?

learner.hr: Proljeće. Dok prolazim, primjećujem cvijeće koje zimi ne vidim.
learner.en: Spring. As I pass, I notice flowers I don't see in winter.

partner.en: Did you live here?

learner.hr: Jesam. Brat je svaki dan prolazio ovuda do škole.
learner.en: Yes. My brother passed this way to school every day.

partner.en: Why didn't we come earlier?

learner.hr: Promet nas je odvraćao. Promjene na cesti sada pomažu pješacima.
learner.en: The traffic put us off. The road changes now help pedestrians.

partner.en: Shall we go a little farther?

learner.hr: Idemo. Veselim se toj promjeni ritma, umjesto stalne vožnje.
learner.en: Let's. I'm glad of that change of pace instead of always driving.

conversations.title: An audio recording hides in the wrong folder

partner.en: Have you found the recording?

learner.hr: Još ne. Nadam se da je pronađemo prije sastanka.
learner.en: Not yet. I hope we find it before the meeting.

partner.en: Where did you look?

learner.hr: U arhivi. Ako pronađeš datoteku, provjeri datum prije slanja.
learner.en: In the archive. If you find the file, check the date before sending.

partner.en: What does the editor say?

learner.hr: Pronađite original, kaže. Pronađena kopija nema cijeli razgovor.
learner.en: Find the original, she says. The copy that was found doesn't have the whole conversation.

partner.en: Maybe it has another name?

learner.hr: Moguće. Pronađi popis starih naziva, pa ćemo usporediti.
learner.en: Possibly. Find the list of old names, and we'll compare.

partner.en: Is it this one?

learner.hr: Jest! Pronađeno je i uvodno pitanje. Kad ga pronađu, ostali mogu završiti obradu.
learner.en: Yes! The opening question has been found too. Once the others locate it, they can finish editing.

conversations.title: A picnic becomes an indoor celebration

partner.en: Has the plan failed?

learner.hr: Piknik jest, ali proslavu možemo premjestiti unutra.
learner.en: The picnic has, but we can move the celebration indoors.

partner.en: Have we got room?

learner.hr: Imamo prostoriju u prizemlju. Ne moramo dopustiti da propast jednog plana uništi dan.
learner.en: We've got a ground-floor room. We needn't let one plan's failure ruin the day.

partner.en: What about the food?

learner.hr: Unesimo je. Može propasti ako je ostavimo na kiši.
learner.en: Let's bring it in. It could be ruined if we leave it in the rain.

partner.en: Shall we still celebrate?

learner.hr: Hoćemo. Proslavimo susret, ne savršenu vremensku prognozu.
learner.en: Yes. Let's celebrate meeting up, not a perfect forecast.

partner.en: What does the birthday boy say?

learner.hr: Želi proslaviti s nama. Kaže da nije propustio ništa osim mokre trave.
learner.en: He wants to celebrate with us. He says he missed nothing except wet grass.

conversations.title: An artist practises drawing hands

partner.en: Why are you drawing only hands?

learner.hr: Položaj prstiju stalno pogriješim. Ovaj prst izgleda prekratko.
learner.en: I keep getting the finger positions wrong. This finger looks too short.

partner.en: How do you check?

learner.hr: Uspoređujem duljinu svakog prsta. Ne želim nacrtati pet jednakih štapića.
learner.en: I compare each finger's length. I don't want to draw five identical sticks.

partner.en: Can I model?

learner.hr: Možeš. Raširi prste, a zatim prstom pokaži prema prozoru.
learner.en: Yes. Spread your fingers, then point towards the window with one finger.

partner.en: Must I stay like this long?

learner.hr: Ne. Prsti mogu biti opušteni; samo mi treba oblik šake.
learner.en: No. Your fingers can relax; I just need the hand's shape.

partner.en: Is it better now?

learner.hr: Jest. Umjesto pet prstiju bez veze, crtež izgleda kao ljudska ruka.
learner.en: Yes. Instead of five disconnected fingers, the drawing looks like a human hand.

conversations.title: A football drill is mistaken for a match

partner.en: Who's winning?

learner.hr: Nitko, vježbamo. Pucali smo na gol iz različitih položaja.
learner.en: Nobody; we're practising. We shot at goal from different positions.

partner.en: Why's the coach shouting?

learner.hr: Kaže pucaj tek kad si spreman. Ja pucam prerano.
learner.en: He says shoot only when ready. I shoot too early.

partner.en: What are the others doing?

learner.hr: Pucaju redom. Jedan je pucao tako slabo da je vratar zijevnuo.
learner.en: They shoot in turns. One shot so weakly that the goalkeeper yawned.

partner.en: Can I join too?

learner.hr: Pucajte poslije zagrijavanja, kaže trener novoj grupi. Moramo završiti svoj red.
learner.en: Shoot after warming up, the coach tells the new group. We need to finish our turn.

partner.en: Are you pleased?

learner.hr: Jesam. Moj udarac napokon ide kamo želim, a ne kamo lopta odluči.
learner.en: Yes. My shot finally goes where I want, not where the ball decides.

conversations.title: Friends disagree over a playlist

partner.en: Why did you switch off the music?

learner.hr: Pustili smo istu pjesmu pet puta. Želim da puste nešto drugo.
learner.en: We've played the same song five times. I want them to play something else.

partner.en: What should I play?

learner.hr: Pusti ono što je Ana predložila. Ja sam svoje već pustio.
learner.en: Play what Ana suggested. I've already played my choice.

partner.en: Can we vote?

learner.hr: Možemo, ali pustimo prvo do kraja. Prekidanje svake pjesme kvari večer.
learner.en: Yes, but let's let it finish first. Interrupting every song spoils the evening.

partner.en: What does the host say?

learner.hr: Pustite jedni druge da birate. Ne morate imati isti ukus.
learner.en: Let each other choose. You needn't have the same taste.

partner.en: Is this one good?

learner.hr: Jest. Kad pustiš nešto nepoznato, otkriješ da nisi čuo sve dobro.
learner.en: Yes. When you play something unfamiliar, you discover you haven't heard all the good music yet.

conversations.title: A new employee learns how a workshop runs

partner.en: How's the first day?

learner.hr: Radni prostor je malen, ali svaki radnik zna svoj zadatak.
learner.en: The workspace is small, but every worker knows their task.

partner.en: Who's teaching you?

learner.hr: Stariji radnik. Zamijenio je radnika koji je danas odsutan.
learner.en: An older worker. He's covering for a worker who's absent today.

partner.en: How long do you work?

learner.hr: Radno vrijeme piše na ulazu. Poslije radnog dana ne ostajemo bez dogovora.
learner.en: Working hours are on the entrance. We don't stay after the workday without agreement.

partner.en: How do you feel?

learner.hr: Malo sam napet, ali ekipa je raspoložena pomoći.
learner.en: A little tense, but the team's willing to help.

partner.en: Are you coming tomorrow?

learner.hr: Dolazim. Na raspolaganju imam bilješke, pa ću ih večeras pročitati.
learner.en: Yes. I have notes available, so I'll read them tonight.

conversations.title: A picnic lifts a friend’s mood

partner.en: Why don't you want to come?

learner.hr: Nisam raspoložen. Cijeli tjedan sve se raspada u mom rasporedu.
learner.en: I'm not in the mood. My schedule has been falling apart all week.

partner.en: Do you have to talk?

learner.hr: Ne želim odmah raspravu. Radije bih malo tišine.
learner.en: I don't want a discussion straight away. I'd rather have some quiet.

partner.en: You can just sit.

learner.hr: Onda dolazim. Možda se raspoloženje promijeni kad izađem iz kuće.
learner.en: Then I'll come. Perhaps my mood will change when I leave the house.

partner.en: Is it better now?

learner.hr: Jest. Ana je danas raspoložena za šalu, pa smo se nasmijali.
learner.en: Yes. Ana's in the mood for jokes today, so we laughed.

partner.en: Are you staying until the end?

learner.hr: Ostajem. Nedostajala mi je šala, a tvoj glas mi je nedostajao. Nisam riješio sve, ali lakše mi je.
learner.en: Yes. I missed joking around, and I missed your voice. I haven't solved everything, but I feel better.

conversations.title: A repair club improves its check-in routine

partner.en: Why a new form?

learner.hr: Provjera uređaja bila je nejasna. Želimo izbjeći ponavljanje grešaka.
learner.en: The device check was unclear. We want to avoid repeating mistakes.

partner.en: What do you record?

learner.hr: Što je vlasnik već provjerio. Provjere ćemo zatim ponoviti prije rada.
learner.en: What the owner has already checked. We'll then repeat the checks before working.

partner.en: Have you tried it?

learner.hr: Jesmo. Provjerili smo obrazac s tri volontera i popravili upute.
learner.en: Yes. We checked the form with three volunteers and improved the instructions.

partner.en: What do we tell visitors?

learner.hr: Provjerite osobne stvari prije odlaska. Ne želimo tražiti tuđe punjače satima.
learner.en: Check your belongings before leaving. We don't want to search for other people's chargers for hours.

partner.en: And after the workshop?

learner.hr: Provedi kratki razgovor s ekipom. Tako provodim pregled obavljenog posla svaki put.
learner.en: Have a short discussion with the team. That's how I review the completed work each time.

conversations.title: A missing key delays closing

partner.en: Where's the key?

learner.hr: Netko ga je uzeo sa stola. Tražimo ga već satima.
learner.en: Someone took it from the desk. We've been looking for hours.

partner.en: Have you searched the bags?

learner.hr: Svatko je pogledao svoju. Nećemo pretraživati tuđe stvari bez pitanja.
learner.en: Everyone checked their own. We won't search other people's belongings without asking.

partner.en: Who saw it last?

learner.hr: Domar. Rekao je da se kroz prolaz provukao kabel, pa je odnio ključ dalje od ruba.
learner.en: The caretaker. He said a cable ran through the passage, so he moved the key away from the edge.

partner.en: Does he have it?

learner.hr: Jest! Kaže da ga je privremeno spremio u džep.
learner.en: Yes! He says he temporarily put it in his pocket.

partner.en: What are you changing now?

learner.hr: Trebamo nabaviti ormarić; domar je već nabavio bravu. Prethodno nismo odredili tko je zadužen za zatvaranje.
learner.en: We need to obtain a cabinet; the caretaker has already obtained a lock. Previously we hadn't specified who's responsible for closing.

conversations.title: A guide corrects a mistaken street story

partner.en: Why did you stop the guide?

learner.hr: Ispričao je priču o pogrešnoj zgradi. Prepoznajete razliku po tornju.
learner.en: He told the story about the wrong building. You can recognise the difference by the tower.

partner.en: Was he upset?

learner.hr: Nije. Rekao je da je prepoznao moju fotografiju, ali zamijenio adresu.
learner.en: No. He said he'd recognised my photograph but mixed up the address.

partner.en: What did he do?

learner.hr: Preveo je objašnjenje drugoj grupi i jasno rekao da je pogriješio.
learner.en: He translated the explanation for the other group and clearly said he'd made a mistake.

partner.en: Will you continue?

learner.hr: Hoćemo. Prepusti mu da završi, ne moramo ispravljati svaku riječ.
learner.en: Yes. Let him finish; we needn't correct every word.

partner.en: Why do you say that?

learner.hr: Jer nije prevarant nego umoran čovjek. To je ljudski, ali ispravak je potreban.
learner.en: Because he's a tired person, not a fraud. That's human, but a correction is needed.

conversations.title: A documentary follows animals without a villain

partner.en: Why's there no villain?

learner.hr: Jer je ovo dokumentarac. Životinje ne slijede ljudska pravila priče.
learner.en: Because this is a documentary. Animals don't follow human storytelling rules.

partner.en: Are the scenes real?

learner.hr: Jesu, ali odabir prizora je ljudski. Ne prikazuje sve ljudsko znanje o njima.
learner.en: Yes, but selecting scenes is human. It doesn't show all human knowledge about them.

partner.en: What interests you?

learner.hr: Razlika između ljudske namjere i ponašanja životinja. Ne želim im pripisivati naše razloge.
learner.en: The difference between human intention and animal behaviour. I don't want to give them our reasons.

partner.en: How do they explain it?

learner.hr: Uz pomoć stručnjaka. S ljudskim usporedbama treba biti pažljiv.
learner.en: With experts' help. We need to be careful with human comparisons.

partner.en: Would you recommend it?

learner.hr: Da. Govori o ljudskom promatranju prirode, a priznaje granice ljudskih zaključaka.
learner.en: Yes. It's about human observation of nature and acknowledges the limits of human conclusions.

conversations.title: A portrait class chooses varied models

partner.en: Who's modelling today?

learner.hr: Jedan muškarac i dvije žene. Prošli put pozirali su samo muškarci.
learner.en: A man and two women. Last time only men modelled.

partner.en: Why change?

learner.hr: Želimo različita lica. Crtanje muškaraca nije isto iskustvo svakom polazniku.
learner.en: We want varied faces. Drawing men isn't the same experience for every student.

partner.en: Whom are you drawing?

learner.hr: Muškarca uz prozor. S tim muškarcem dogovorila sam položaj ruku.
learner.en: The man by the window. I agreed on his hand position with him.

partner.en: What does the teacher say?

learner.hr: Da muškarcu ne dodajem zamišljenu strogoću. Muški lik ne mora izgledati ljutito.
learner.en: Not to give the man an imagined sternness. A male figure needn't look angry.

partner.en: Is it better now?

learner.hr: Jest. Gledam osobu, a ne predodžbu koju pripisujem muškarcima.
learner.en: Yes. I'm looking at a person, not an idea I attribute to men.

conversations.title: The goggles are in the wrong locker

partner.en: Why are you standing in the corridor?

learner.hr: Naočale su mi ostale u ormariću, a ključ je kod brata.
learner.en: My goggles are in the locker, and my brother has the key.

partner.en: Where is he?

learner.hr: U bazenu. Mislio je da sam već spreman.
learner.en: In the pool. He thought I was ready already.

partner.en: Can you call him?

learner.hr: Pokušavam, ali odavde ne vidim drugi kraj bazena.
learner.en: I'm trying, but I can't see the other end of the pool from here.

partner.en: There he is on the steps.

learner.hr: Vidim ga. Mahnut ću mu da izađe.
learner.en: I see him. I'll wave for him to come out.

partner.en: Is he bringing the key?

learner.hr: Da. Sljedeći put bazen dolazi tek nakon provjere torbe.
learner.en: Yes. Next time the pool comes after checking my bag.

conversations.title: A child finishes her first pool length

partner.en: Why are you smiling so much?

learner.hr: Preplivala sam cijelu dužinu, bez zaustavljanja kod užeta. Sad se mogu usredotočiti i na disanje. Dosad sam samo htjela doći do ruba.
learner.en: I swam the whole length without stopping at the rope. Now I can focus on my breathing too. Until now I just wanted to reach the edge.

partner.en: Were you afraid?

learner.hr: Na početku jesam. Onda sam gledala samo kamo idem.
learner.en: At first, yes. Then I just looked where I was going.

partner.en: What did the coach say?

learner.hr: Da sam bila hrabra, ali da ne moram odmah ponoviti.
learner.en: That I was brave, but didn't have to repeat it straight away.

partner.en: Will you show Dad?

learner.hr: Hoću, kad dođe. Sada mi treba malo odmora.
learner.en: Yes, when he comes. I need a little rest now.

partner.en: Can I message him?

learner.hr: Možeš, samo napiši da sam plivala, ne da sam osvojila more.
learner.en: Yes; just say I swam, not that I conquered the sea.

conversations.title: Fog changes the view from the harbour

partner.en: Where have the boats gone?

learner.hr: Iza magle. Još čujem motore, ali ne vidim ni obalu.
learner.en: Behind the fog. I can still hear engines but can't even see the shore.

partner.en: Are we leaving soon?

learner.hr: Posada kaže da čekamo novu obavijest. Ne zna se još.
learner.en: The crew says we're waiting for another announcement. It's not known yet.

partner.en: Have you travelled by boat before?

learner.hr: Jesam, ali nikad uz ovoliko magle.
learner.en: Yes, but never in this much fog.

partner.en: Shall we sit inside?

learner.hr: Hoćemo. Promatranje nevidljivih brodova prilično je hladan hobi.
learner.en: Yes. Watching invisible boats is a rather chilly hobby.

partner.en: Do you think it'll clear?

learner.hr: Nadam se. Želio sam ti pokazati otoke, ne samo sivu boju.
learner.en: I hope so. I wanted to show you the islands, not just the colour grey.

conversations.title: A fundraiser needs one more volunteer

partner.en: Have you got an hour tomorrow?

learner.hr: Imam ujutro. O kakvoj je akciji riječ?
learner.en: In the morning, yes. What kind of campaign is it?

partner.en: We're collecting school supplies.

learner.hr: Mogu donijeti prazne kutije. Ostale su mi nakon selidbe.
learner.en: I can bring empty boxes. I have some left after moving.

partner.en: We need someone to sort things.

learner.hr: To mogu. Na prošloj akciji cijelo sam jutro slagala bilježnice.
learner.en: I can do that. At the last campaign I spent the whole morning arranging notebooks.

partner.en: Then we're counting on you.

learner.hr: Dobro. Pošalji vrijeme početka akcije i točnu adresu.
learner.en: Good. Send me the campaign's start time and exact address.

partner.en: Thank you so much.

learner.hr: Nema na čemu. Ako se akcija produži, mogu ostati do podne.
learner.en: You're welcome. If the campaign runs longer, I can stay until noon.

conversations.title: Twins confuse a neighbour at a bus stop

partner.en: Why are you looking at me so strangely?

learner.hr: Jer sam te prije pet minuta vidio u trgovini.
learner.en: Because I saw you in the shop five minutes ago.

partner.en: That was my brother.

learner.hr: Nisam znao da ste blizanci. Čak vam je i jakna ista.
learner.en: I didn't know you were twins. Even your jackets are the same.

partner.en: His has a red zip.

learner.hr: Dobro, pokušat ću zapamtiti. Inače vam nisam dovoljno blizak za takve detalje.
learner.en: All right, I'll try to remember. I don't know you closely enough for details like that yet.

partner.en: At least now you know the secret.

learner.hr: Znam. U blizini očito postoji više istih lica nego što mislim.
learner.en: I do. There are clearly more identical faces nearby than I thought.

partner.en: Your bus is coming.

learner.hr: Hvala. Ako sretnem brata, ovaj put ću mu pravilno reći ime.
learner.en: Thanks. If I meet your brother, I'll get his name right this time.

conversations.title: A platform changes after the suitcase is lifted

partner.en: Did you hear the announcement?

learner.hr: Jesam. Naravno da mijenjaju peron čim sam podigao kovčeg.
learner.en: Yes. Of course they change platforms as soon as I've lifted the suitcase.

partner.en: We've still got fifteen minutes.

learner.hr: Onda ne moramo trčati. Pogledajmo gdje je dizalo.
learner.en: Then we don't need to run. Let's look for the lift.

partner.en: There, behind the kiosk.

learner.hr: Dobro. Daj mi onu manju torbu, da ti oslobodim ruku.
learner.en: Good. Give me the smaller bag so you've got a free hand.

partner.hr: Jesi li siguran da je četvrti?
partner.en: Are you sure it's the fourth?

learner.hr: Provjerio sam zaslon. Ovaj put vjerujem njemu, ne starom papiru.
learner.en: I checked the display. This time I trust it, not the old paper.

partner.en: We got here on time.

learner.hr: Jesmo. Sad možemo mirno čekati sljedeću promjenu mišljenja kolodvora.
learner.en: Yes. Now we can calmly wait for the station's next change of mind.

conversations.title: A tree root lifts the paving

partner.en: Why did you stop?

learner.hr: Korijen je podigao ploču. Skoro sam zapela za nju.
learner.en: A root has lifted a paving slab. I almost tripped over it.

partner.en: Someone should be told.

learner.hr: Hoću. Stablo je lijepo, ali prolaz mora biti siguran.
learner.en: I will. The tree's lovely, but the path needs to be safe.

partner.en: Will they cut it down?

learner.hr: Nadam se da neće. Možda se ploče mogu premjestiti.
learner.en: I hope not. Perhaps the slabs can be moved.

partner.en: There aren't many trees here.

learner.hr: Znam. Ljeti je hlad ispod drveća jedini razlog da hodam ovuda.
learner.en: I know. In summer, the shade under the trees is my only reason for walking this way.

partner.en: I can send you a photograph.

learner.hr: Pošalji. Tako ćemo pokazati problem, ne tražiti uklanjanje drveta.
learner.en: Do. That way we'll show the problem rather than ask for the tree's removal.

conversations.title: A busker recognises an old classmate

partner.en: Why don't you go over to the singer?

learner.hr: Išle smo zajedno u školu. Nisam sigurna sjeća li me se.
learner.en: We went to school together. I'm not sure she remembers me.

partner.en: She has a lovely voice.

learner.hr: Ima. Oduvijek je pjevala, čak i dok smo čekale autobus.
learner.en: She does. She always sang, even while we waited for the bus.

partner.en: There, the song's finished.

learner.hr: Dobro, sad ću prići. Ne želim je prekidati usred nastupa.
learner.en: All right, I'll go over now. I don't want to interrupt her performance.

partner.en: She recognised you immediately!

learner.hr: Jest. Rekla je da još pamti moje užasne školske šale.
learner.en: Yes. She said she still remembers my terrible school jokes.

partner.en: Are you going for coffee?

learner.hr: Hoćemo kad spremi opremu. Lijepo je čuti poznat glas na novom mjestu.
learner.en: Yes, once she's packed her equipment. It's lovely hearing a familiar voice somewhere new.

conversations.title: A bag of chestnuts has to wait

partner.en: Why are you holding the bag so far away?

learner.hr: Kesteni su vrući, a papir je tanak.
learner.en: The chestnuts are hot, and the paper's thin.

partner.en: Want my spare bag?

learner.hr: Hoću, hvala. Miris me natjerao da kupim više nego što mogu pojesti.
learner.en: Yes, thanks. The smell made me buy more than I can eat.

partner.en: We can share them.

learner.hr: Možemo, samo pričekaj. Gladni smo, ali ne moramo se opeći.
learner.en: Yes, just wait. We're hungry, but we don't need to burn ourselves.

partner.en: This one's hard to open.

learner.hr: I moj. Izgleda da smo kupili i mali zadatak za prste.
learner.en: Mine too. Looks like we've bought a little task for our fingers as well.

partner.en: They're good, though.

learner.hr: Odlični. Jesen mi je mnogo draža kad miriše ovako.
learner.en: Excellent. I like autumn much more when it smells like this.

conversations.title: Someone forgets a load in the shared laundry

partner.en: Whose laundry is this?

learner.hr: Susjedino, mislim. Vidjela sam je jutros s istom košarom.
learner.en: The neighbour's, I think. I saw her this morning with the same basket.

partner.en: I need to use the machine.

learner.hr: Nazvat ću je. Ne želim premještati njezine stvari bez pitanja.
learner.en: I'll call her. I don't want to move her things without asking.

partner.en: Is she answering?

learner.hr: Da, kaže da je potpuno zaboravila vrijeme. Dolazi odmah.
learner.en: Yes, she says she completely lost track of time. She's coming right away.

partner.en: I can wait a little longer.

learner.hr: Hvala. I ja sam jednom ostavila posteljinu do večeri.
learner.en: Thanks. I once left bedding there until the evening too.

partner.en: Here she is at the door.

learner.hr: Dobro. Danas je barem nitko nije morao tražiti po cijeloj zgradi.
learner.en: Good. At least nobody had to search the whole building for her today.

conversations.title: An honest answer before a party

partner.en: What do you think of the dress?

learner.hr: Lijepa je, ali stalno povlačiš rukave. Je li ti udobna?
learner.en: It's lovely, but you keep pulling at the sleeves. Is it comfortable?

partner.en: It's a little tight.

learner.hr: Onda obuci drugu. Ideš plesati, ne stajati kao kip.
learner.en: Wear the other one, then. You're going dancing, not standing like a statue.

partner.hr: Bojiš se reći da je loša?
partner.en: Are you afraid to say it's bad?

learner.hr: Nije loša. Samo mi se čini da se u njoj ne osjećaš dobro.
learner.en: It isn't bad. I just don't think you feel good in it.

partner.en: All right, I'll take the blue one.

learner.hr: Tu voliš. Zašto je uopće ostavljaš u ormaru?
learner.en: You like that one. Why are you leaving it in the wardrobe anyway?

partner.en: Because everyone's seen it.

learner.hr: Pa neka. I tebe znaju, a ipak te zovu.
learner.en: So what? They know you too, and still invite you.

conversations.title: A toy robot repeats a private joke

partner.en: Why's Dad laughing?

learner.hr: Robot je ponovio ono što sam mu jučer rekao.
learner.en: The robot repeated what I said to it yesterday.

partner.en: What did you say?

learner.hr: Da tata hrče glasnije od usisavača.
learner.en: That Dad snores louder than the vacuum cleaner.

partner.en: Was he angry?

learner.hr: Nije, kaže da će razgovarati s robotovim roditeljima.
learner.en: No, he says he'll speak to the robot's parents.

partner.en: What did you answer?

learner.hr: Da sam robotu ja roditelj, pa može pitati mene.
learner.en: That I'm the robot's parent, so he can ask me.

partner.en: And who won?

learner.hr: Mama. Rekla je da obojica ugasimo uređaje i dođemo jesti.
learner.en: Mum. She told both of us to switch off our devices and come and eat.

conversations.title: Saying goodbye without making it forever

partner.en: Why are you so serious?

learner.hr: Ne volim rastanke. Zbogom mi zvuči kao da odlaziš zauvijek.
learner.en: I don't like farewells. Goodbye sounds as though you're leaving forever.

partner.en: I'm coming back in three months.

learner.hr: Znam. Svejedno mi nedostaješ već dok stojiš ovdje.
learner.en: I know. I miss you already while you're standing here.

partner.en: I'll call on Sunday.

learner.hr: Hoćeš, ali nemoj zvati u šest ujutro po mom vremenu.
learner.en: Yes, but don't call at six in the morning my time.

partner.en: Agreed. I'll send pictures too.

learner.hr: Šalji i one obične, ne samo svečane trenutke.
learner.en: Send the ordinary ones too, not only special occasions.

partner.en: I need to board now.

learner.hr: Idi. Ja ću mahati dok te još mogu vidjeti.
learner.en: Go. I'll wave while I can still see you.

conversations.title: A draught closes a door at the wrong moment

partner.en: Why are you sitting on the steps?

learner.hr: Vjetar je zatvorio vrata, a ključ je ostao unutra.
learner.en: The wind closed the door, and the key's still inside.

partner.en: Does anyone have a spare?

learner.hr: Moja žena, ali još je u uredu.
learner.en: My wife, but she's still at the office.

partner.en: Want to wait at my place?

learner.hr: Rado. Nemam ni jaknu, samo ovu vrećicu krumpira.
learner.en: Gladly. I don't even have a jacket, just this bag of potatoes.

partner.en: At least we can start lunch.

learner.hr: Možemo. U ovom slučaju imam dobar razlog da ostanem.
learner.en: We can. In this case I've got a good reason to stay.

partner.en: Have you told her?

learner.hr: Jesam. Kaže da ne pojedemo sve prije nego dođe.
learner.en: Yes. She says not to eat everything before she arrives.

conversations.title: A grandmother waits at another entrance

partner.en: Where's Grandma?

learner.hr: Rekla je da čeka ispred zgrade, ali ovdje je nema.
learner.en: She said she's waiting outside the building, but she isn't here.

partner.en: Have you checked the other entrance?

learner.hr: Nisam. Ti pričekaj taksi, ja ću obići zgradu.
learner.en: No. You wait for the taxi; I'll go around the building.

partner.en: Have you found her?

learner.hr: Jesam, razgovara sa susjedom. Potpuno je zaboravila na nas.
learner.en: Yes, she's chatting with a neighbour. She's completely forgotten us.

partner.en: The driver's asking if we'll be long.

learner.hr: Reci da dolazimo. Baku je teže odvesti od razgovora nego iz kuće.
learner.en: Say we're coming. It's harder to take Grandma away from a conversation than from home.

partner.en: At least she's coming now.

learner.hr: Dolazi, ali još pozdravlja pola ulice.
learner.en: She is, but she's still saying goodbye to half the street.

conversations.title: Rain gets to a library book

partner.en: Why's the cover wavy?

learner.hr: Knjiga mi se smočila u torbi. Nisam primijetio otvoren zatvarač.
learner.en: The book got wet in my bag. I didn't notice the zip was open.

partner.en: Is it yours?

learner.hr: Nije, iz knjižnice je. Moram im reći što se dogodilo.
learner.en: No, it's from the library. I need to tell them what happened.

partner.en: Maybe it'll dry.

learner.hr: Možda, ali neću skrivati oštećenje i samo je vratiti na policu.
learner.en: Maybe, but I won't hide the damage and just return it to the shelf.

partner.en: Are you going today?

learner.hr: Da. Pitam što mogu napraviti, umjesto da sam nagađam. Ako postoji postupak za ovakve slučajeve, slijedit ću ga. Ne želim stvarati još veći problem.
learner.en: Yes. I'll ask what I can do instead of guessing myself. If there's a procedure for cases like this, I'll follow it. I don't want to create an even bigger problem.

partner.en: Take a bag too.

learner.hr: Hoću. Ovaj put knjiga dobiva bolju zaštitu od mene.
learner.en: I will. This time the book gets better protection than I do.

conversations.title: A festival wristband disappears under a sleeve

partner.en: Why won't they let you in?

learner.hr: Ne vide narukvicu, a ja sam zaboravio gdje sam je stavio.
learner.en: They can't see my wristband, and I've forgotten where I put it.

partner.en: You didn't take it off?

learner.hr: Nisam. Čekaj, cijelo vrijeme je pod rukavom.
learner.en: No. Wait, it's been under my sleeve the whole time.

partner.en: Have you shown them?

learner.hr: Jesam. Redar se nasmijao prije nego što sam išta objasnio.
learner.en: Yes. The steward laughed before I'd explained anything.

partner.en: I can hear the concert starting.

learner.hr: Onda požuri, ne želim zbog rukava propustiti prvu pjesmu.
learner.en: Hurry, then. I don't want to miss the first song because of a sleeve.

partner.en: Shall we stay together?

learner.hr: Da, ali ako se izgubimo, nađemo se kod ulaza.
learner.en: Yes, but if we get separated, let's meet at the entrance.

conversations.title: A child learns the wrong words to a song

partner.en: What are you singing?

learner.hr: Pjesmu iz vrtića, ali brat kaže da riječi nisu takve.
learner.en: A song from nursery, but my brother says the words aren't like that.

partner.en: How did you remember them?

learner.hr: Tako mi zvuče kad ih svi pjevaju glasno.
learner.en: That's how they sound when everyone sings loudly.

partner.en: We can listen to a recording.

learner.hr: Možemo, samo nemoj odmah reći da sam sve krivo pjevao.
learner.en: Yes; just don't immediately say I sang it all wrong.

partner.en: Your version's fun.

learner.hr: Znam. U njoj medvjed vozi autobus umjesto da spava.
learner.en: I know. In it the bear drives a bus instead of sleeping.

partner.en: Want to learn the real one too?

learner.hr: Hoću, ali svoju ću sačuvati za put do vrtića.
learner.en: Yes, but I'll keep mine for the journey to nursery.

conversations.title: A first flight with an unexpected seat neighbour

partner.en: How was the flight?

learner.hr: Bolje nego što sam očekivala. U avionu sam sjedila pokraj bake s unukom.
learner.en: Better than expected. On the plane I sat beside a grandmother and her grandson.

partner.en: Were you afraid?

learner.hr: Malo pri polijetanju. Onda me dječak pitao letim li prvi put.
learner.en: A little at take-off. Then the boy asked whether it was my first flight.

partner.en: What did you say?

learner.hr: Da jest. On je ozbiljno rekao da on leti već treći put.
learner.en: That it was. He solemnly said he was already on his third flight.

partner.en: So you got a guide.

learner.hr: Jesam. Cijeli put objašnjavao mi je oblake.
learner.en: Yes. He explained the clouds to me all the way.

partner.en: Would you fly again?

learner.hr: Bih. Samo se nadam da će i drugi put biti takvo društvo.
learner.en: Yes. I just hope I'll have company like that next time too.

conversations.title: A weather bet ends in sunshine

partner.en: Where's your umbrella?

learner.hr: Doma. Kladio sam se sa sestrom da danas neće kišiti.
learner.en: At home. I bet my sister it wouldn't rain today.

partner.en: What did you stake?

learner.hr: Pranje posuđa. Ne želim se kladiti za novac.
learner.en: Washing up. I don't want to bet money.

partner.en: Look at those clouds.

learner.hr: Vidim ih. Još se nadam da samo prolaze.
learner.en: I see them. I'm still hoping they're just passing through.

partner.en: There's the sun again.

learner.hr: Znao sam! Dobro, nisam znao, samo sam imao sreće.
learner.en: I knew it! All right, I didn't know; I was just lucky.

partner.en: Will you boast about it?

learner.hr: Hoću. Kladim se da će reći da je posuđe ionako moje.
learner.en: Yes. I bet she'll say the washing up was mine anyway.

conversations.title: A friend stops joining balcony smoke breaks

partner.en: Are you going onto the balcony?

learner.hr: Ne danas. Pokušavam provesti večer bez cigarete.
learner.en: Not today. I'm trying to spend the evening without a cigarette.

partner.en: Shall I stay with you?

learner.hr: Možeš ako želiš. Samo nemoj od toga raditi veliku stvar.
learner.en: If you want. Just don't make a big thing of it.

partner.en: What shall we do?

learner.hr: Nađimo neku igru. Kad imam karte u rukama, manje mislim na cigaretu.
learner.en: Let's find a game. With cards in my hands, I think less about a cigarette.

partner.en: Where are the others?

learner.hr: Još su vani. Rekao sam im da mi ne nude cigarete.
learner.en: Still outside. I told them not to offer me cigarettes.

partner.en: Here's the deck.

learner.hr: Odlično. Sad imam drugi problem: ti uvijek pobjeđuješ.
learner.en: Great. Now I've got another problem: you always win.

conversations.title: A tattoo is revealed at a family lunch

partner.en: Why are you still wearing your shirt?

learner.hr: Čekam pravi trenutak da mami pokažem tetovažu.
learner.en: I'm waiting for the right moment to show Mum my tattoo.

partner.en: Do you think she hasn't seen it?

learner.hr: Nadam se. Ili mi samo daje vremena da sam kažem.
learner.en: I hope so. Or she's just giving me time to say it myself.

partner.en: What did you get drawn?

learner.hr: Mali brod. Isti kao onaj koji je djed crtao na pismima.
learner.en: A little boat. Like the one Grandad drew on letters.

partner.en: Then she'll understand.

learner.hr: Možda. Važno mi je da čuje priču prije nego komentira izgled.
learner.en: Maybe. I want her to hear the story before commenting on its appearance.

partner.en: She's calling you now.

learner.hr: Dobro, skidam košulju. Tetovaža ne može zauvijek ostati obiteljska tajna.
learner.en: All right, I'm taking the shirt off. The tattoo can't stay a family secret forever.

conversations.title: An angel costume loses a wing

partner.en: Why are you crying backstage?

learner.hr: Jedno krilo mi je otpalo. Sad nisam pravi anđeo.
learner.en: One wing fell off. Now I'm not a proper angel.

partner.en: We've got time to fix it.

learner.hr: Ostali anđeli već čekaju. Ne želim da zbog mene kasne.
learner.en: The other angels are already waiting. I don't want them to be late because of me.

partner.en: Just hold this end.

learner.hr: Ovako? Mama je rekla da ništa ne povlačim.
learner.en: Like this? Mum said not to pull anything.

partner.en: There, it's staying on now.

learner.hr: Hvala. Izgledam li opet kao na slici anđela?
learner.en: Thanks. Do I look like the picture of the angel again?

partner.en: Even better. Go slowly.

learner.hr: Idem. Ovaj put ću kroz vrata bočno, da sačuvam oba krila.
learner.en: I will. This time I'll go through the door sideways to keep both wings.

conversations.title: Fresh cheese arrives from a family farm

partner.en: What's in this basket?

learner.hr: Sir s tetine farme. Zamolila me da ga podijelim susjedima.
learner.en: Cheese from my aunt's farm. She asked me to share it with the neighbours.

partner.en: Does she make it herself?

learner.hr: Da. Na farmi ima nekoliko životinja i malu radionicu.
learner.en: Yes. On the farm she has a few animals and a little workshop.

partner.en: We should visit her sometime.

learner.hr: Možemo kad nas pozove. Njoj to nije samo lijep vikend nego posao.
learner.en: We can when she invites us. For her it isn't just a lovely weekend; it's work.

partner.en: How much should I take?

learner.hr: Uzmi ovaj komad. Ostatak nosim gospođi na katu.
learner.en: Take this piece. I'm taking the rest to the lady upstairs.

partner.en: Tell her thank you.

learner.hr: Hoću. Bit će joj drago da smo sve pojeli, umjesto samo fotografirali.
learner.en: I will. She'll be glad we ate it all instead of just photographing it.

conversations.title: An office changes its name but not its neighbours

partner.en: Has the company moved?

learner.hr: Nije. Promijenili su natpis, pa sad izgleda kao drugi ured.
learner.en: No. They changed the sign, so now it looks like a different office.

partner.en: Do you still work there?

learner.hr: Radim. U firmi je ista ekipa, samo svi učimo novi naziv.
learner.en: Yes. The company's got the same team; we're just learning the new name.

partner.en: That's why I was looking for the wrong door.

learner.hr: Nisi jedini. Jutros je i dostavljač pitao gdje smo nestali.
learner.en: You're not the only one. This morning the delivery driver also asked where we'd disappeared to.

partner.en: You need a temporary sign.

learner.hr: Slažem se. Napisat ću da ljudi još traže staru firmu.
learner.en: I agree. I'll point out that people still look for the old company.

partner.en: Can I come in now?

learner.hr: Uđi. Kava barem još ima isto ime.
learner.en: Come in. At least coffee still has the same name.

conversations.title: Choosing flowers for a family grave

partner.en: Which flowers are we taking?

learner.hr: Ono bijelo. Baka ga je uvijek sadila uz ogradu.
learner.en: The white ones. Grandma always planted them by the fence.

partner.en: Do you remember the way?

learner.hr: Sjećam se. Grob je ispod čempresa, malo dalje od ulaza.
learner.en: Yes. The grave's under the cypress, a little beyond the entrance.

partner.en: Would you like to stay long?

learner.hr: Malo bih sjedio. Nisam bio na groblju od proljeća. Pokraj groba je klupa, pa možemo ostaviti svijeće i sjesti.
learner.en: I'd like to sit a while. I haven't been to the cemetery since spring. There is a bench beside the grave, so we can leave the candles and sit down.

partner.en: I can keep you company.

learner.hr: Hvala. Ne moramo ništa govoriti ako ti je neugodno.
learner.en: Thank you. We needn't say anything if you feel awkward.

partner.en: I don't feel awkward.

learner.hr: Dobro. Poslije možemo proći pokraj njezine stare kuće.
learner.en: Good. Afterwards, we can pass her old house.

conversations.title: A school photograph recalls an enormous lunch

partner.en: Why are you all holding plates?

learner.hr: To je bio izlet. Nakon hodanja umrli smo od gladi.
learner.en: It was an outing. After walking, we were starving.

partner.en: Is this you?

learner.hr: Jesam, s najvećom porcijom. Uvijek sam prvi tražio još.
learner.en: Yes, with the biggest portion. I was always first to ask for more.

partner.en: It's no different today.

learner.hr: Nije. Neke se navike iz djetinjstva stvarno dobro drže.
learner.en: No. Some childhood habits really stick.

partner.en: Who cooked?

learner.hr: Jedna gospođa iz sela. Donijeli smo joj cvijeće prije povratka.
learner.en: A lady from the village. We brought her flowers before returning.

partner.en: Do you remember the taste?

learner.hr: Sjećam. Ili pamtim glad, pa mi je sve djelovalo posebno.
learner.en: Yes. Or I remember the hunger, so everything seemed special.

conversations.title: A rumour makes a move sound permanent

partner.en: Is it true you're leaving?

learner.hr: Na mjesec dana. Tko je rekao da se ne vraćam?
learner.en: For a month. Who said I wasn't coming back?

partner.en: I heard you're selling the flat.

learner.hr: To su glasine. Iznajmljujem sobu, ne prodajem stan.
learner.en: That's a rumour. I'm renting out a room, not selling the flat.

partner.en: It's good I asked.

learner.hr: Jest. U svakoj verziji priče selim se sve dalje.
learner.en: Yes. In every version of the story I'm moving farther away.

partner.en: Shall I tell the others?

learner.hr: Reci samo da me pitaju. Ne trebamo novu službenu priču o mom životu.
learner.en: Just say they should ask me. We don't need a new official story about my life.

partner.hr: Onda se ipak vidimo na ljeto.
partner.en: Then we'll still see each other in summer.

learner.hr: Naravno. Još mi duguješ večeru, nisam to zaboravio.
learner.en: Of course. You still owe me dinner; I haven't forgotten.

conversations.title: A noisy suitcase becomes easy to recognise

partner.en: What's rattling like that?

learner.hr: Moj kovčeg. Kotač je odlučio privući pažnju.
learner.en: My suitcase. A wheel's decided to attract attention.

partner.en: Will it last?

learner.hr: Nadam se. Do hotela ima još samo dvjesto metara.
learner.en: I hope so. The hotel's only two hundred metres away.

partner.en: I can carry it.

learner.hr: Nemoj, pretežak je. Samo hodaj sporije sa mnom.
learner.en: Don't; it's too heavy. Just walk more slowly with me.

partner.en: People are turning round.

learner.hr: Znam. Barem ga nitko neće neprimjetno odvesti.
learner.en: I know. At least nobody can take it away unnoticed.

partner.en: There's our hotel.

learner.hr: Napokon. Moj orkestar sad može na zasluženi odmor.
learner.en: Finally. My orchestra can have a well-earned rest.

conversations.title: A café regular orders something different

partner.en: The usual?

learner.hr: Danas ne. Donesite mi čaj umjesto kave.
learner.en: Not today. Bring me tea instead of coffee.

partner.en: Everything all right?

learner.hr: Jest. Samo želim prestati naručivati bez razmišljanja.
learner.en: Yes. I just want to stop ordering without thinking.

partner.en: What tea do you like?

learner.hr: Eto, to ne znam. Što imate bez voćnog okusa?
learner.en: That's what I don't know. What do you have without a fruity flavour?

partner.en: We've got mint.

learner.hr: Može. I onaj mali kolač koji stalno gledam. Molim i čašu vode dok čekam da se čaj malo ohladi.
learner.en: That'll do. And that little cake I keep looking at. A glass of water too, please, while I wait for the tea to cool a little.

partner.en: So a change today.

learner.hr: Da. Ali stol uz prozor ipak ostaje moj.
learner.en: Yes. But the window table's still mine.

conversations.title: The bins leave before a neighbour wakes up

partner.en: Why are you pushing a full bin back?

learner.hr: Propustio sam odvoz. Kamion je došao ranije.
learner.en: I missed the collection. The truck came early.

partner.en: I heard them at seven.

learner.hr: Ja sam čuo alarm, ali sam ga ugasio.
learner.en: I heard my alarm but switched it off.

partner.hr: Imaš li prostora do sljedećeg puta?
partner.en: Have you got room until next time?

learner.hr: Imam. Morat ću samo pažljivije odvajati ambalažu.
learner.en: Yes. I'll just need to separate the packaging more carefully.

partner.en: I can remind you next time.

learner.hr: Možeš. Jedna poruka prije kave možda mi spasi jutro.
learner.en: You can. One message before coffee might save my morning.

partner.en: Agreed.

learner.hr: Hvala. Kanta je danas barem prošetala oko kuće.
learner.en: Thanks. At least the bin got a walk around the house today.

conversations.title: An audiobook narrator sounds unusually worried

partner.en: Why are you laughing at the book?

learner.hr: Pripovjedač govori kao da bježi od nekoga.
learner.en: The narrator sounds as though he's running away from someone.

partner.en: Is it written like that?

learner.hr: Nije. Slučajno sam ubrzao reprodukciju.
learner.en: No. I accidentally sped up playback.

partner.en: Put it back to normal.

learner.hr: Evo. Sad svi likovi djeluju mnogo smirenije.
learner.en: There. Now all the characters seem much calmer.

partner.en: Do you understand more?

learner.hr: Puno više. Cijeli razgovor odjednom ima smisla.
learner.en: Much more. The whole conversation suddenly makes sense.

partner.en: Will you replay the chapter?

learner.hr: Hoću. Dugujem likovima priliku da govore bez panike.
learner.en: Yes. I owe the characters a chance to speak without panic.

conversations.title: The wrong keyring comes to work

partner.en: Why aren't you opening up?

learner.hr: Ponio sam ključeve od roditelja, ne od ureda.
learner.en: I brought my parents' keys, not the office keys.

partner.en: How did you mix them up?

learner.hr: Oba privjeska su crvena. Jutros nisam gledao.
learner.en: Both keyrings are red. I wasn't looking this morning.

partner.en: Who else has a key?

learner.hr: Kolegica dolazi za deset minuta. Već sam je nazvao.
learner.en: My colleague's coming in ten minutes. I've called her already.

partner.en: We can wait at the bakery.

learner.hr: Možemo. Prvi sastanak danas očito uključuje pecivo.
learner.en: We can. Today's first meeting apparently includes a pastry.

partner.en: A message has arrived.

learner.hr: Kaže da želi isto. Pametno je iskoristila moje kašnjenje.
learner.en: She says she wants one too. She's made good use of my delay.

conversations.title: An audio guide begins in the wrong language

partner.en: Do you understand the guide?

learner.hr: Nijednu riječ. Odabrao sam pogrešan jezik.
learner.en: Not a word. I selected the wrong language.

partner.en: Can you change it?

learner.hr: Tražim oznaku. Zaslon je prilično sitan.
learner.en: I'm looking for the icon. The screen's rather small.

partner.en: Try this button.

learner.hr: Eto, sad govori hrvatski. Trebali smo početi ovdje.
learner.en: There, now it's speaking Croatian. We should have started here.

partner.en: Which object was it describing?

learner.hr: Onu zdjelu. Ja sam cijelo vrijeme gledao mač.
learner.en: That bowl. I'd been looking at the sword the whole time.

partner.en: Go back to the beginning, then.

learner.hr: Hoću. Ovaj put spajam jezik i predmet.
learner.en: I will. This time I'm matching the language and the object.

conversations.title: A surprise party leaves someone in slippers

partner.en: Why did you come in slippers?

learner.hr: Rekli su da samo siđem po paket.
learner.en: They told me just to come downstairs for a parcel.

partner.en: Didn't you suspect anything?

learner.hr: Nisam. Nisam očekivao dvadeset ljudi u dvorištu.
learner.en: No. I wasn't expecting twenty people in the courtyard.

partner.en: Would you like to change?

learner.hr: Želim barem cipele. Na fotografijama izgledam kao da sam pobjegao iz kreveta.
learner.en: I'd at least like shoes. In the photos I look as though I escaped from bed.

partner.en: The cake can wait.

learner.hr: Dobro. Nemojte pojesti ukrase dok me nema.
learner.en: Good. Don't eat the decorations while I'm gone.

partner.en: Will you be back quickly?

learner.hr: Hoću. Ovako dobru zamku ne napuštam dugo.
learner.en: Yes. I won't leave a trap this good for long.

conversations.title: A rehearsal accidentally invents a better ending

partner.en: Why's the director laughing?

learner.hr: Zaboravio sam tekst pa sam liku ponudio čaj.
learner.en: I forgot my lines, so I offered the character tea.

partner.en: In the middle of a big argument?

learner.hr: Da. Nisam mogao smisliti ništa pametnije.
learner.en: Yes. I couldn't think of anything cleverer.

partner.en: What did your partner do?

learner.hr: Prihvatila je šalicu i nastavila svađu tišim glasom.
learner.en: She accepted the cup and continued arguing more quietly.

partner.en: Will you keep it?

learner.hr: Možda. Prizor djeluje stvarnije nego naše veliko vikanje. Nismo očekivali da ćemo usred sukoba stvoriti malo smijeha.
learner.en: Maybe. The scene feels more real than our loud shouting. We didn't expect to create a little laughter in the middle of the conflict.

partner.en: And the actual lines?

learner.hr: Još ću ga naučiti. Ne mogu svaku prazninu zaliti čajem.
learner.en: I'll still learn them. I can't fill every gap with tea.

conversations.title: A paper under the windscreen causes a fright

partner.en: Why are you running to the car?

learner.hr: Vidim papir pod brisačem. Bojim se da je kazna.
learner.en: I can see paper under the wiper. I'm afraid it's a fine.

partner.en: Did you park incorrectly?

learner.hr: Nisam mislio da jesam. Sad više nisam siguran.
learner.en: I didn't think so. Now I'm not sure anymore.

partner.en: What does it say?

learner.hr: Reklama za pranje automobila. Nema kazne.
learner.en: An advert for a car wash. No fine.

partner.en: You went pale immediately.

learner.hr: Znam. Taj mi je papir upravo skratio život za jednu minutu.
learner.en: I know. That paper just shortened my life by a minute.

partner.en: Can we leave now?

learner.hr: Možemo. I skinuti reklamu prije nego me opet preplaši.
learner.en: Yes. And remove the advert before it frightens me again.

conversations.title: A familiar client sends an unexpected card

partner.en: Who sent you flowers?

learner.hr: Klijent s kojim radim godinama. Danas nam je godišnjica suradnje.
learner.en: A client I've worked with for years. Today's the anniversary of our collaboration.

partner.en: Did you remember?

learner.hr: Nisam. Kartica me potpuno iznenadila.
learner.en: No. The card completely surprised me.

partner.en: Will you call him?

learner.hr: Hoću. Ne želim odgovoriti samo službenom porukom.
learner.en: Yes. I don't want to reply with only a formal message.

partner.en: Do you have many clients like that?

learner.hr: Nekoliko. Dobro je kad posao s vremenom postane i povjerenje.
learner.en: A few. It's good when work turns into trust over time.

partner.en: What will you say?

learner.hr: Hvala za sve ove godine, pa predložiti kavu.
learner.en: Thank you for all these years, then suggest coffee.

conversations.title: An employee returns to a former workplace

partner.en: Are you really going back?

learner.hr: Da. Kompanija mi je ponudila posao na drugom odjelu.
learner.en: Yes. The company offered me a job in another department.

partner.en: Didn't you want a change?

learner.hr: Jesam, i dobila sam je. Ovo nije isto mjesto koje sam napustila.
learner.en: Yes, and I got one. This isn't the same role I left.

partner.en: Do you know the new team?

learner.hr: Dvoje ljudi. Ostale ću tek upoznati u ponedjeljak.
learner.en: Two people. I'll meet the others on Monday.

partner.en: Isn't going back strange?

learner.hr: Malo jest. Ali ne vraćam se zato što se bojim drugdje.
learner.en: A little. But I'm not returning because I'm afraid of elsewhere.

partner.en: Then I wish you a good start.

learner.hr: Hvala. Ovaj put barem znam gdje se skriva dobar aparat za kavu.
learner.en: Thanks. At least this time I know where the good coffee machine hides.

conversations.title: A sister envies an effortless outfit

partner.en: Why are you looking at my jacket?

learner.hr: Ljubomorna sam. Tebi sve stoji dobro bez razmišljanja.
learner.en: I'm jealous. Everything looks good on you without any thought.

partner.hr: Da znaš koliko sam se presvlačila.
partner.en: If you knew how often I changed.

learner.hr: Stvarno? Mislila sam da si samo otvorila ormar.
learner.en: Really? I thought you just opened the wardrobe.

partner.en: I tried four combinations.

learner.hr: Dobro, onda mi je lakše. Moj kaos nije jedini.
learner.en: Good; then I feel better. My chaos isn't the only one.

partner.en: Want to borrow the jacket?

learner.hr: Hoću, ali ne želim ti odmah uzeti sve što pohvalim.
learner.en: Yes, but I don't want to take everything I compliment.

partner.en: Bring it back tomorrow.

learner.hr: Dogovoreno. Danas ću se praviti da sam i ja sve smislila sama.
learner.en: Agreed. Today I'll pretend I thought it all up myself too.

conversations.title: Admitting why an invitation was declined

partner.en: I didn't see you at the concert.

learner.hr: Nisam došla. Lagala sam da imam drugi dogovor.
learner.en: I didn't come. I lied about having another arrangement.

partner.en: Why didn't you tell me?

learner.hr: Nisam znala kako reći da mi se samo ostaje doma.
learner.en: I didn't know how to say I just wanted to stay home.

partner.en: You don't need to make things up for me.

learner.hr: Znam. Sad mi je neugodno jer sam zakomplicirala jednostavnu stvar.
learner.en: I know. Now I'm embarrassed because I complicated something simple.

partner.en: Just say so next time.

learner.hr: Hoću. I hvala što me nisi odmah napao.
learner.en: I will. And thanks for not immediately having a go at me.

partner.en: Did you at least enjoy staying home?

learner.hr: Jesam, do trenutka kad sam počela smišljati što ću ti reći.
learner.en: Yes, until I started thinking up what to tell you.

conversations.title: An official-looking envelope contains good news

partner.en: Why are you opening the envelope so slowly?

learner.hr: Dolazi iz ministarstva. Odmah mislim da nešto nedostaje u prijavi.
learner.en: It's from the ministry. I immediately think something's missing from the application.

partner.en: Just read it.

learner.hr: Dobili smo sredstva za radionice! Nisam to očekivala.
learner.en: We got funding for the workshops! I wasn't expecting that.

partner.en: That's good news.

learner.hr: Jesu. Sad mogu nazvati ljude koji su čekali odgovor.
learner.en: Yes. Now I can call the people who've been waiting for an answer.

partner.en: Will you start immediately?

learner.hr: Prvo provjeravamo uvjete. Ne želim u veselju preskočiti važan detalj.
learner.en: First we'll check the conditions. I don't want to miss an important detail in the excitement.

partner.en: Want company while reading?

learner.hr: Trebam. Ti čitaj, ja ću kuhati slavljeničku kavu.
learner.en: Yes. You read; I'll make celebratory coffee.

conversations.title: Old holiday money appears in a coat

partner.en: What did you find?

learner.hr: Novac u starom kaputu. Zaboravio sam da sam ga tu ostavio.
learner.en: Money in an old coat. I forgot I'd left it there.

partner.en: How much?

learner.hr: Dovoljno za ručak, ali ne za veliko bogatstvo.
learner.en: Enough for lunch, but not a fortune.

partner.en: Then you're treating today.

learner.hr: Dogovoreno. Lijepo je iznenaditi samoga sebe vlastitim novcem.
learner.en: Agreed. It's nice surprising yourself with your own money.

partner.en: Did you check the other pocket?

learner.hr: Jesam. Tamo je samo račun za nešto čega se ne sjećam.
learner.en: Yes. Just a receipt for something I don't remember.

partner.en: That's a less pleasant surprise.

learner.hr: Zato ću se usredotočiti na ručak.
learner.en: That's why I'll focus on lunch.

conversations.title: A careless joke reaches the wrong person

partner.en: Why are you waiting outside the office?

learner.hr: Moram se ispričati kolegi. Rekao sam glupost pred drugima.
learner.en: I need to apologise to a colleague. I said something stupid in front of others.

partner.en: Was it a joke?

learner.hr: Meni jest, njemu očito nije. Nisam trebao spominjati njegovu pogrešku.
learner.en: To me it was; clearly not to him. I shouldn't have mentioned his mistake.

partner.en: What will you say?

learner.hr: Da sam ispao glup, ne da je on preosjetljiv.
learner.en: That I acted foolishly, not that he's oversensitive.

partner.en: You've thought that through well.

learner.hr: Nadam se. Ne želim držati govor, samo preuzeti odgovornost.
learner.en: I hope so. I don't want to give a speech, just take responsibility.

partner.en: Here he comes.

learner.hr: Dobro. Sad moram izgovoriti ono što vježbam već deset minuta.
learner.en: Good. Now I need to say what I've been practising for ten minutes.

conversations.title: A father gives up control of the kitchen

partner.en: Why are you making lunch?

learner.hr: Tata mi je napokon prepustio kuhinju bez stalnih komentara.
learner.en: Dad finally left the kitchen to me without constant comments.

partner.en: Where is he?

learner.hr: U dnevnoj sobi. Svakih pet minuta ipak proviri.
learner.en: In the living room. He still peeks in every five minutes.

partner.en: Is he helping?

learner.hr: Ako pomoć znači pitati imam li dovoljno soli, onda da.
learner.en: If helping means asking whether I've got enough salt, then yes.

partner.en: What are you cooking?

learner.hr: Njegovo omiljeno jelo. Zato sam malo nervozniji nego inače.
learner.en: His favourite dish. That's why I'm a little more nervous than usual.

partner.en: Can I set the table?

learner.hr: Možeš. I reci mu da sinu vjeruje barem do prvog zalogaja.
learner.en: Yes. And tell him to trust his son at least until the first bite.

conversations.title: A cat takes over a work call

partner.en: Why has everyone suddenly gone quiet?

learner.hr: Moja mačka stoji ispred kamere. Vjerojatno vide samo krzno.
learner.en: My cat's standing in front of the camera. They probably only see fur.

partner.en: Can you move her?

learner.hr: Mogu, ako odluči surađivati. Zauzela je cijelu tipkovnicu.
learner.en: Yes, if she decides to cooperate. She's taken over the whole keyboard.

partner.en: Has she sent anything?

learner.hr: Još nije. To smatram velikim uspjehom.
learner.en: Not yet. I consider that a great success.

partner.en: The boss is laughing.

learner.hr: Dobro. Bojao sam se da će tražiti da i ona predstavi rezultate.
learner.en: Good. I was afraid he'd ask her to present results too.

partner.en: She's gone now.

learner.hr: Onda nastavljam. Moj pomoćnik očito smatra da je sastanak završen.
learner.en: Then I'll continue. My assistant clearly thinks the meeting's over.

conversations.title: A family photograph carries some news

partner.hr: Zašto želiš da se svi okupimo?
partner.en: Why do you want everyone together?

learner.hr: Imam vijest, ali prvo želim fotografiju naših lica.
learner.en: I've got news, but first I want a photo of our faces.

partner.en: What's happening?

learner.hr: Trudna sam. Na proljeće dobivate još jednog člana obitelji.
learner.en: I'm pregnant. In spring you're getting another family member.

partner.en: Really? I can't believe it!

learner.hr: Znam, i meni je trebalo vremena da shvatim.
learner.en: I know; it took me time to take it in too.

partner.en: That's why you're smiling so much.

learner.hr: Da. A sad se nasmiješi i ti, kamera nas snima.
learner.en: Yes. Now smile too; the camera's recording us.

partner.en: Can I hug you?

learner.hr: Naravno. Samo nemoj srušiti stalak od veselja.
learner.en: Of course. Just don't knock the stand over with excitement.

conversations.title: A baby hat is smaller than expected

partner.hr: Je li ovo kapa za lutku?
partner.en: Is this a doll's hat?

learner.hr: Nije, za bebu. Zaboravila sam koliko su bebe male.
learner.en: No, for the baby. I forgot how small babies are.

partner.en: Will it fit her?

learner.hr: Ne znam još. Sačuvala sam račun za zamjenu. Možda je bebi već premala. U tom slučaju uzet ću veću.
learner.en: I don't know yet. I kept the receipt for an exchange. It may already be too small for the baby. In that case I'll get a bigger one.

partner.hr: Imaš li i nešto za roditelje?
partner.en: Have you got something for the parents too?

learner.hr: Imam večeru. Rekli su da im to sada najviše znači.
learner.en: Dinner. They said that means the most to them right now.

partner.en: Are we staying long?

learner.hr: Ne moramo. Odnijet ćemo stvari pa vidjeti žele li društvo.
learner.en: We needn't. We'll take the things over and see whether they want company.

partner.en: I'll put the hat in the bag, then.

learner.hr: Stavi je u malu kutiju, da ne nestane među posudama.
learner.en: Put it in a little box so it doesn't disappear among the containers.

conversations.title: A wedding invitation creates a family misunderstanding

partner.en: Why's everyone congratulating me?

learner.hr: Tetka je rekla da se ženiš. Zar nije istina?
learner.en: Auntie said you're getting married. Isn't it true?

partner.en: I'm going to someone else's wedding.

learner.hr: Aha. Dakle, odijelo nije dokaz da si odlučio oženiti se.
learner.en: Ah. So a suit isn't proof you've decided to get married.

partner.en: Exactly.

learner.hr: Morat ću je nazvati prije nego što pozove ostatak obitelji.
learner.en: I'll need to call her before she invites the rest of the family.

partner.en: Can you do it now?

learner.hr: Mogu. Reći ću da si gost, ne mladoženja.
learner.en: Yes. I'll say you're a guest, not the groom.

partner.en: Thanks; you've saved my weekend.

learner.hr: Nema na čemu. Tvoj brak može još malo ostati tvoja stvar.
learner.en: You're welcome. Your marriage can remain your own business a little longer.

conversations.title: A bride changes into trainers

partner.en: Why are you carrying trainers?

learner.hr: Mlada mi je dala svoje cipele i rekla da ih sakrijem.
learner.en: The bride gave me her shoes and told me to hide them.

partner.en: Is everything all right?

learner.hr: Jest, samo želi plesati bez boli u nogama.
learner.en: Yes; she just wants to dance without sore feet.

partner.en: What about the photographs?

learner.hr: Već su snimljene. Sada joj je važnije uživati.
learner.en: They've already been taken. Enjoying herself matters more to her now.

partner.en: Where shall we put the shoes?

learner.hr: U ovu kutiju, da ih poslije ne tražimo po dvorani.
learner.en: In this box so we don't search the hall for them later.

partner.en: Shall we dance too?

learner.hr: Idemo. Ako mladoj ne smetaju tenisice, zašto bi smetale nama?
learner.en: Let's. If the bride doesn't mind trainers, why should we?

conversations.title: A grandchild does not recognise a young grandmother

partner.en: Who's this girl?

learner.hr: Ja. Fotografija je iz moje mladosti.
learner.en: Me. The photograph's from my youth.

partner.en: Did you really have hair like that?

learner.hr: Jesam. Tada mi je bilo važno da izgleda veća od glave.
learner.en: Yes. Back then I wanted it to look bigger than my head.

partner.en: Did you know Grandad then?

learner.hr: Nisam još. Upoznali smo se tek godinu kasnije.
learner.en: Not yet. We met a year later.

partner.en: He'd have fallen in love straight away.

learner.hr: Možda u kosu. Meni je trebalo duže da ga zavolim.
learner.en: Maybe with the hair. It took me longer to love him.

partner.en: Can I make a copy?

learner.hr: Smiješ. Samo nemoj reći da sam na njoj neprepoznatljiva.
learner.en: Yes. Just don't say I'm unrecognisable in it.

conversations.title: A visitor asks for a quieter place to sit

partner.en: Excuse me, does anyone work here?

learner.hr: Ja pomažem danas. Što trebate, gospodine?
learner.en: I'm helping today. What do you need, sir?

partner.en: I need to sit down a little.

learner.hr: Naravno. Iza pregrade je klupa, ondje je tiše.
learner.en: Of course. There's a bench behind the partition; it's quieter there.

partner.en: I won't miss anything?

learner.hr: Nećete. Govor počinje za dvadeset minuta, javit ću vam.
learner.en: No. The speech starts in twenty minutes; I'll let you know.

partner.hr: Može li i moja žena tamo?
partner.en: Can my wife go there too?

learner.hr: Može. Pitat ću gospođu uz vrata treba li i ona mjesto.
learner.en: Yes. I'll ask the lady by the door whether she needs a seat too.

partner.en: You're very kind.

learner.hr: Hvala. Želimo da svi mogu uživati u izložbi svojim tempom.
learner.en: Thank you. We want everyone to enjoy the exhibition at their own pace.

conversations.title: A waiter cannot hear an order over the music

partner.en: Can we order?

learner.hr: Naravno. Čujete li me dobro preko glazbe?
learner.en: Of course. Can you hear me clearly over the music?

partner.en: Barely.

learner.hr: Onda ću zamoliti da je stišaju prije narudžbe.
learner.en: Then I'll ask them to turn it down before taking your order.

partner.en: That's better now.

learner.hr: Dobro. Kažete dvije juhe i jednu salatu?
learner.en: Good. Did you say two soups and one salad?

partner.en: Yes, and bread for everyone.

learner.hr: Zapisano. Želite li vodu odmah ili uz jelo?
learner.en: Noted. Would you like water now or with the meal?

partner.en: Now, please.

learner.hr: Donosim. Ovaj put barem znamo da smo se razumjeli.
learner.en: I'll bring it. At least this time we know we understood each other.

conversations.title: A passenger has a ticket but cannot find it

partner.en: Where's my ticket?

learner.hr: Ušao si s njom u ruci. Provjeri džep kaputa.
learner.en: You boarded with it in your hand. Check your coat pocket.

partner.en: It isn't there.

learner.hr: Nemate slučajno dvije karte tamo, gospođo? Možda ju je vjetar odnio.
learner.en: Do you happen to have two tickets there, madam? The draught may have carried it away.

partner.en: The lady says she doesn't.

learner.hr: Onda pogledaj ispod torbe, prije nego počneš paničariti.
learner.en: Then look under your bag before panicking.

partner.hr: Tu je, zalijepila se za dno.
partner.en: Here it is, stuck to the bottom.

learner.hr: Dobro. Stavi je u džep i više je ne premještaj.
learner.en: Good. Put it in your pocket and stop moving it around.

partner.en: Thanks for helping.

learner.hr: Nema na čemu. Šest stanica tražimo jedan mali papir.
learner.en: You're welcome. We've spent six stops looking for one little piece of paper.

conversations.title: A colleague talks to a new office plant

partner.en: Who are you talking to?

learner.hr: S biljkom. Neka zna da je dobrodošla.
learner.en: The plant. Let it know it's welcome.

partner.en: Will it answer you?

learner.hr: Nadam se da neće. U protivnom idem doma ranije.
learner.en: I hope not. Otherwise I'm going home early.

partner.en: What are you doing with it?

learner.hr: Stavljamo je uz prozor, ali ne na izravno sunce.
learner.en: Putting it by the window, but not in direct sun.

partner.en: Who'll water it?

learner.hr: Napravit ćemo mali raspored. Ne treba joj pet brižnih ljudi isti dan.
learner.en: We'll make a little rota. It doesn't need five caring people on the same day.

partner.en: Can I name it?

learner.hr: Možeš. Samo nemoj odabrati ime našeg šefa.
learner.en: Yes. Just don't choose our boss's name.

conversations.title: A welcome cake reaches the wrong flat

partner.hr: Oprostite, je li ovo za mene?
partner.en: Excuse me, is this for me?

learner.hr: Za nove susjede. Vi niste ti koji su se jučer uselili?
learner.en: For the new neighbours. Aren't you the ones who moved in yesterday?

partner.en: I've lived here for ten years.

learner.hr: Onda sam promašila kat. Pripremila sam kolač i zaboravila adresu.
learner.en: Then I've got the wrong floor. I made a cake and forgot the address.

partner.en: They're in the flat above.

learner.hr: Hvala. Sad mi je jasno zašto me gledate zbunjeno. U poruci je pisalo kat iznad, a ja sam gledala samo broj stana.
learner.en: Thank you. Now I understand why you look puzzled. The message said the floor above, but I was only looking at the flat number.

partner.en: No problem; it's a lovely gesture.

learner.hr: Dođite i vi na kavu ako budu raspoloženi.
learner.en: Come for coffee too if they're in the mood.

partner.en: I might.

learner.hr: Odlično. Kolač je barem dovoljno velik za moje pogreške.
learner.en: Great. At least the cake's big enough for my mistakes.

conversations.title: An aunt asks for a quiet moment at a wedding

partner.en: Why do you want us to wait a moment?

learner.hr: Tetka bi htjela izreći blagoslov prije večere.
learner.en: Our aunt would like to say a blessing before dinner.

partner.en: Have the couple agreed?

learner.hr: Jesu. Pitala ih je unaprijed, da nikome ne bude neugodno.
learner.en: Yes. She asked beforehand so nobody would feel awkward.

partner.en: Will it take long?

learner.hr: Neće. Rekla je da su joj važnije iskrene riječi nego dug govor.
learner.en: No. She said sincere words matter more to her than a long speech.

partner.en: What should I do?

learner.hr: Samo zamoli goste za trenutak tišine.
learner.en: Just ask the guests for a moment of quiet.

partner.en: All right, I can do that.

learner.hr: Hvala. Poslije se svi možemo vratiti hrani i glazbi.
learner.en: Thanks. Afterwards everyone can return to the food and music.

conversations.title: Practising before calling an English host

partner.en: Why are you reading the message aloud?

learner.hr: Moram nazvati domaćina na engleskom, pa vježbam prvu rečenicu.
learner.en: I need to call the host in English, so I'm practising the first sentence.

partner.en: What do you need to ask?

learner.hr: Mogu li doći kasnije. Avion mi slijeće navečer.
learner.en: Whether I can arrive later. My plane lands in the evening.

partner.en: You can say that simply.
