learner.hr: Znam. Samo mi glas postane čudan čim čujem englesku sekretaricu.
learner.en: I know. My voice just goes strange as soon as I hear an English voicemail greeting.

partner.en: Shall I stay here?

learner.hr: Ostani, ali nemoj mi šaptati svaku riječ. Onda ništa ne čujem.
learner.en: Stay, but don't whisper every word to me. Then I can't hear anything.

partner.en: He's answering.

learner.hr: Dobro. Sad prestajem vježbati i stvarno govorim.
learner.en: Good. Now I'll stop practising and actually speak.

conversations.title: A family dog has too many nicknames

partner.en: Why isn't the dog responding?

learner.hr: Zoveš ga Maks, a brat ga cijelo jutro zove Roki.
learner.en: You're calling him Max, and my brother's called him Rocky all morning.

partner.en: What's his real name?

learner.hr: Maks. Roki je ime psa iz filma koji je brat gledao.
learner.en: Max. Rocky's the dog from a film my brother watched.

partner.en: We need to agree.

learner.hr: Slažem se. Jadni pas već ima više imena nego mi.
learner.en: I agree. The poor dog already has more names than we do.

partner.en: Here he is; he's coming after all.

learner.hr: Dolazi jer čuje vrećicu s hranom, ne zbog našeg dogovora.
learner.en: He's coming because he hears the food bag, not because of our agreement.

partner.en: He's cleverer than us.

learner.hr: Za doručkom sigurno. Sad mu barem reci pravo ime.
learner.en: At breakfast, certainly. At least use his real name now.

conversations.title: A neighbour leaves instructions for the fish

partner.hr: Možeš li pogledati ribice za vikend?
partner.en: Can you check on the fish this weekend?

learner.hr: Mogu. Napiši mi što točno radiš svaki dan.
learner.en: Yes. Write down exactly what you do each day.

partner.en: Everything's beside the tank.

learner.hr: Dobro. Radije čitam tvoje upute nego da nagađam.
learner.en: Good. I'd rather read your instructions than guess.

partner.en: Do you like them?

learner.hr: Jesu. Ova narančasta stalno mi prilazi kroz staklo.
learner.en: Yes. This orange one keeps coming towards me through the glass.

partner.en: That one always expects food.

learner.hr: Onda ima nešto zajedničko s mojom mačkom.
learner.en: Then it has something in common with my cat.

partner.hr: Zvat ću te ako zaboravim nešto.
partner.en: I'll call if I forget anything.

learner.hr: Može. Samo se lijepo provedite, ribice imaju društvo.
learner.en: Fine. Just enjoy yourselves; the fish have company.

conversations.title: A handmade gift is recognised too soon

partner.en: Why are you hiding that mug?

learner.hr: Tvoj je poklon. Nisi je trebao vidjeti prije rođendana.
learner.en: It's your present. You weren't meant to see it before your birthday.

partner.en: Did you make it yourself?

learner.hr: Jesam. Zato ručka izgleda kao da ima vlastiti plan.
learner.en: Yes. That's why the handle looks as though it has its own plan.

partner.en: I think it's brilliant.

learner.hr: Hvala, ali pričekaj slavlje prije nego je odneseš.
learner.en: Thanks, but wait for the party before taking it away.

partner.en: I can pretend to be surprised.

learner.hr: Dobro. I nemoj ostalima reći da već znaš boju.
learner.en: Good. And don't tell the others you already know the colour.

partner.en: Agreed.

learner.hr: Sad mi vrati kutiju da je barem mogu zamotati.
learner.en: Now give me the box back so I can at least wrap it.

conversations.title: Two identical lunches in a shared fridge

partner.en: Did you take my lunch?

learner.hr: Mislio sam da je moj. Posude izgledaju jednako.
learner.en: I thought it was mine. The containers look identical.

partner.en: What's inside?

learner.hr: Riža i povrće. Ako je tvoje, još nisam počeo jesti.
learner.en: Rice and vegetables. If it's yours, I haven't started eating yet.

partner.en: Mine has peas too.

learner.hr: Onda je ovo tvoje. Moje strpljivo čeka u hladnjaku.
learner.en: Then this one's yours. Mine's waiting patiently in the fridge.

partner.en: We should write our names on them.

learner.hr: Trebamo. Kuhamo slično, ali pamćenje nam nije jednako dobro.
learner.en: We should. We cook similarly, but our memories aren't equally good.

partner.en: Here's yours.

learner.hr: Hvala. Danas sam barem saznao što ti jedeš za ručak.
learner.en: Thanks. At least today I learned what you have for lunch.

conversations.title: A curtain becomes an accidental signal

partner.en: Why did you wave to me this morning?

learner.hr: Mislio sam da otvaraš prozor baš da me pozdraviš.
learner.en: I thought you were opening the window specifically to greet me.

partner.en: I was just opening the curtains.

learner.hr: Aha. Ja sam odgovorio kao da se nismo vidjeli godinu dana.
learner.en: Ah. I responded as though we hadn't seen each other for a year.

partner.en: I saw; it was sweet.

learner.hr: Dobro. Već sam mislio da sam zbunio cijelu zgradu.
learner.en: Good. I thought I'd confused the whole building.

partner.en: We can wave anyway.

learner.hr: Možemo. Ne mora svaki pozdrav imati važan razlog.
learner.en: Yes. Not every greeting needs an important reason.

partner.en: Until tomorrow morning, then.

learner.hr: Do sutra. Samo nemoj očekivati da sam u osam već budan. Ako si ti već budna, nemoj zaključiti da sam i ja spreman za razgovor.
learner.en: Until tomorrow. Just don't expect me to be awake at eight. If you're already awake, don't assume I'm ready for a conversation too.

conversations.title: A note in a lunchbox reaches the wrong sibling

partner.hr: Zašto mi piše sretno na ispitu?
partner.en: Why does this say good luck on your exam?

learner.hr: Uzela si bratovu kutiju. Tvoja je na stolu.
learner.en: You took your brother's lunchbox. Yours is on the table.

partner.hr: Ali ja sam već u školi.
partner.en: But I'm already at school.

learner.hr: Onda danas imaš njegov sendvič i moje dobre želje.
learner.en: Then today you've got his sandwich and my good wishes.

partner.en: What's left for him?

learner.hr: Tvoja salata. Nije baš oduševljen. Gleda je kao da sam mu dao kaznu umjesto ručka.
learner.en: Your salad. He's not exactly delighted. He's looking at it as though I've given him a punishment instead of lunch.

partner.hr: Možeš mu reći da ne kuka?
partner.en: Can you tell him not to complain?

learner.hr: Mogu, ali ti mu zauzvrat prestani slati slike sendviča.
learner.en: Yes, but in return stop sending him pictures of the sandwich.

partner.en: All right, agreed.

learner.hr: Hvala. Sutra ću na kutije napisati i ime, ne samo poruku.
learner.en: Thanks. Tomorrow I'll put names on the boxes, not just messages.

conversations.title: A shopping list doubles as a bookmark

partner.hr: Zašto je popis namirnica u romanu?
partner.en: Why's the shopping list in the novel?

learner.hr: Sinoć nisam našla oznaku za knjigu, pa sam uzela prvi papir.
learner.en: I couldn't find a bookmark last night, so I used the first paper I saw.

partner.en: I was looking for it this morning.

learner.hr: Oprosti. Trebala sam ti reći prije nego krenem čitati.
learner.en: Sorry. I should have told you before I started reading.

partner.hr: Jesi li barem zapamtila što trebamo?
partner.en: Did you at least remember what we need?

learner.hr: Mlijeko, limun i nešto što si napisao potpuno nečitko. Ovo prvo slovo izgleda kao da ima rep. Trebam prijevod tvog rukopisa.
learner.en: Milk, a lemon and something you wrote completely illegibly. This first letter looks as though it has a tail. I need a translation of your handwriting.

partner.en: That's flour.

learner.hr: Dobro. Mislila sam da je ime nekog lika.
learner.en: Good. I thought it was a character's name.

partner.en: Can I have the list back?

learner.hr: Vraćam. Knjiga će do večeras čekati s razglednicom.
learner.en: Yes. The book will wait until tonight with a postcard in it.

conversations.title: A language student enters a choir rehearsal

partner.en: Why are you carrying sheet music?

learner.hr: Ušao sam u krivu učionicu. Tamo vježba zbor.
learner.en: I went into the wrong classroom. A choir's rehearsing there.

partner.en: Didn't you notice immediately?

learner.hr: Nisam. Svi su sjedili za stolovima kao na tečaju.
learner.en: No. Everyone was sitting at tables like in a class.

partner.en: And what happened?

learner.hr: Podijelili su mi note i pitali jesam li tenor.
learner.en: They gave me sheet music and asked whether I was a tenor.

partner.en: What did you answer?

learner.hr: Da sam početnik u njemačkom, što im nije puno pomoglo.
learner.en: That I'm a beginner in German, which didn't help them much.

partner.en: Did you find your class?

learner.hr: Jesam, vrata dalje. Danas učim i jezik i čitanje natpisa.
learner.en: Yes, next door. Today I'm learning both the language and how to read signs.

conversations.title: Getting used to an earlier morning

partner.en: Why are you outside already?

learner.hr: Počeo sam ranije raditi. Još se pokušavam naviknuti.
learner.en: I started working earlier. I'm still trying to get used to it.

partner.en: Is it going well?

learner.hr: Polako. Navikao sam piti kavu tek kad se cijela kuća probudi.
learner.en: Slowly. I'm used to having coffee only when the whole house wakes up.

partner.en: It's quieter now.

learner.hr: Jest. Jutros sam prvi put čuo ptice umjesto prometa.
learner.en: Yes. This morning I heard birds instead of traffic for the first time.

partner.en: Maybe you'll like it.

learner.hr: Možda. Samo tijelu još nisam objasnio zašto ustajemo tako rano.
learner.en: Maybe. I just haven't explained to my body why we're getting up so early.

partner.en: You look sleepy.

learner.hr: Znam. Dobro jutro zasad izgovaram više iz pristojnosti nego uvjerenja.
learner.en: I know. For now I say good morning more out of politeness than conviction.

conversations.title: Breakfast means the end of someone else’s day

partner.en: Why are you ordering soup in the morning?

learner.hr: Meni je kraj dana. Upravo sam završio noćnu smjenu.
learner.en: It's the end of my day. I just finished the night shift.

partner.en: Now I understand.

learner.hr: Svi se čude, a ja sam samo gladan nakon posla.
learner.en: Everyone's surprised, but I'm just hungry after work.

partner.en: Will you sleep straight away?

learner.hr: Hoću kad pojedem. Danas mi trebaju tišina i zatvorene zavjese.
learner.en: After eating. Today I need quiet and closed curtains.

partner.en: I can bring you bread later.

learner.hr: Hvala. Samo nemoj zvoniti ako ti se ne javim.
learner.en: Thanks. Just don't ring the bell if I don't answer.

partner.en: I'll leave it by the door.

learner.hr: Odlično. Moje jutro može malo pričekati.
learner.en: Great. My morning can wait a little.

conversations.title: Two buttons make a coat feel different

partner.en: Which button do you want?

learner.hr: Onaj jednostavniji. Sjajni mi izgleda previše svečano.
learner.en: The simpler one. The shiny one looks too formal to me.

partner.en: The coat's dark otherwise.

learner.hr: Znam. Zato želim da gumb ne bude prva stvar koju ljudi vide. Želim da odjeća bude u skladu s mojim ukusom, ne da izgleda kao tuđa.
learner.en: I know. That's why I don't want the button to be the first thing people see. I want the clothes to be in keeping with my taste, not look as though they belong to someone else.

partner.hr: Mogu ih staviti jedan pokraj drugog.
partner.en: I can put them side by side.

learner.hr: Možeš. Lakše odlučim kad ne moram pamtiti razliku.
learner.en: Yes. I decide more easily when I don't have to remember the difference.

partner.en: There, look.

learner.hr: Da, prvi. S njim kaput opet izgleda kao moj.
learner.en: Yes, the first. With it, the coat looks like mine again.

partner.en: Then we'll sew it on.

learner.hr: Hvala. Nisam znala da mogu toliko razmišljati o jednom gumbu.
learner.en: Thanks. I didn't know I could think so much about one button.

conversations.title: A handwritten birthday letter arrives early

partner.en: Why aren't you opening the envelope?

learner.hr: Od mame je, a na njoj piše da pričekam rođendan.
learner.en: It's from Mum, and it says to wait until my birthday.

partner.hr: To je tek za tjedan dana.
partner.en: That's a week away.

learner.hr: Znam. Sad je stavila moje strpljenje na pravi ispit. Još sedam dana znatiželje. Njezina je strategija očito uspjela.
learner.en: I know. Now she's really testing my patience. Another seven days of curiosity. Her strategy has clearly worked.

partner.en: You can put it in a drawer.

learner.hr: Mogu, ali znam da ću svaki dan gledati u nju.
learner.en: I can, but I know I'll look at it every day.

partner.en: What do you think is inside?

learner.hr: Pismo i neka stara fotografija. Tako me uvijek iznenadi.
learner.en: A letter and an old photograph. That's how she always surprises me.

partner.en: Will you hold out anyway?

learner.hr: Hoću. Mami dugujem barem jedan tjedan čekanja.
learner.en: Yes. I owe Mum at least one week of waiting.

conversations.title: A small cutting comes back as a large plant

partner.hr: Je li ovo stvarno od moje biljke?
partner.en: Is this really from my plant?

learner.hr: Jest. Dala si mi grančicu prije dvije godine.
learner.en: Yes. You gave me a little cutting two years ago.

partner.hr: Tvoja je sad veća od moje.
partner.en: Yours is bigger than mine now.

learner.hr: Izgleda da joj odgovara prozor. Nisam napravila ništa posebno.
learner.en: Apparently it likes the window. I didn't do anything special.

partner.en: Will you give me a cutting?

learner.hr: Naravno. Lijepo je da se biljka vraća kući drugim putem.
learner.en: Of course. It's lovely that the plant's finding another way home.

partner.en: Maybe it'll work for me this time.

learner.hr: Možda. Samo joj nemoj svaki dan mjeriti napredak.
learner.en: Maybe. Just don't measure its progress every day.

partner.en: So, patience.

learner.hr: Da. I mjesto na polici koje neće zauzeti nova knjiga.
learner.en: Yes. And a shelf spot that won't be taken over by a new book.

conversations.title: A paper map will not fold back

partner.en: Why are you fighting with the map?

learner.hr: Otvorila se lako, ali očito se ne želi zatvoriti.
learner.en: It opened easily, but clearly doesn't want to close.

partner.en: Want me to try?

learner.hr: Probaj. Ti barem još vjeruješ da papir ima logiku.
learner.en: Try. At least you still believe paper has logic.

partner.en: This goes inwards here.

learner.hr: Aha. Ja sam ga cijelo vrijeme savijao na drugu stranu.
learner.en: Ah. I've been folding it the other way the whole time.

partner.en: There, it fits in a pocket.

learner.hr: Hvala. Sada još moramo pronaći mjesto na kojem stojimo.
learner.en: Thanks. Now we just need to find where we're standing.

partner.en: Don't you know that yet?

learner.hr: Znam otprilike. Previše sam vremena posvetio origamiju.
learner.en: Roughly. I spent too much time on origami.

conversations.title: Sunlight hides a presentation

partner.en: Can you see the chart?

learner.hr: Jedva. Sunce udara ravno u platno.
learner.en: Barely. The sun's shining directly onto the screen.

partner.en: Shall I lower the blinds?

learner.hr: Da, ako možemo. Ne želim pola razgovora nagađati brojeve.
learner.en: Yes, if we can. I don't want to spend half the discussion guessing numbers.

partner.en: Is this better?

learner.hr: Puno bolje. Sad vidim i što sam pogrešno pročitao.
learner.en: Much better. Now I can see what I misread too.

partner.en: Do we need to correct something?

learner.hr: Samo moj komentar. Zaključio sam prerano zbog loše slike.
learner.en: Only my comment. I jumped to a conclusion because of the poor image.

partner.en: You can speak up.

learner.hr: Hoću. Lakše mi je priznati nego dalje braniti pogrešan broj.
learner.en: I will. It's easier to admit it than keep defending the wrong number.

conversations.title: Summer hours catch a reader out

partner.en: Why are you standing outside locked doors?

learner.hr: Nisam znao da knjižnica ljeti radi kraće.
learner.en: I didn't know the library has shorter summer hours.

partner.en: Do you need to return a book?

learner.hr: Da, ali mogu je staviti u kutiju za povrat.
learner.en: Yes, but I can put it in the returns box.

partner.en: Why don't you return it, then?

learner.hr: Zato što sam planirao uzeti i nastavak. Posljednja stranica prve knjige završava usred razgovora. Moram saznati odgovor.
learner.en: Because I planned to borrow the sequel too. The last page of the first book ends in the middle of a conversation. I have to find out the answer.

partner.en: I can lend you mine.

learner.hr: Stvarno? Onda mi je dan upravo spašen.
learner.en: Really? Then my day's just been saved.

partner.hr: Samo ga nemoj završiti prije večere.
partner.en: Just don't finish it before dinner.

learner.hr: Ne obećavam ništa. Prva knjiga završila je baš napeto.
learner.en: I promise nothing. The first book ended on a real cliffhanger.

conversations.title: A borrowed charger goes home in the wrong bag

partner.hr: Je li moj punjač kod tebe?
partner.en: Is my charger with you?

learner.hr: Jest. Spremio sam ga s laptopom bez razmišljanja. Tek doma sam primijetio da imam dupli punjač. Nisam odmah znao čiji je drugi.
learner.en: Yes. I packed it with my laptop without thinking. Only when I got home did I notice I had a second charger. I didn't immediately know whose the other one was.

partner.en: I need it today.

learner.hr: Mogu ga donijeti za pola sata.
learner.en: I can bring it in half an hour.

partner.en: Will you make it before the meeting?

learner.hr: Hoću ako krenem odmah. Koliko ti je ostalo baterije?
learner.en: Yes, if I leave now. How much battery have you got left?

partner.en: Enough until then.

learner.hr: Dobro. Ovaj put ću provjeriti torbu prije odlaska.
learner.en: Good. This time I'll check my bag before leaving.

partner.en: See you at the entrance.

learner.hr: Vidimo se. Tvoj punjač barem zna put do mog stana.
learner.en: See you. At least your charger knows the way to my flat.

conversations.title: A comic is read in the wrong order

partner.en: Why don't I find anything funny?

learner.hr: Čitaš stupce, a ovaj strip ide po redovima. Prvo prati gornju traku slijeva nadesno, pa prijeđi na onu ispod.
learner.en: You're reading down the columns, but this comic goes across the rows. First follow the top strip from left to right, then move to the one below.

partner.en: That's why the story keeps changing.

learner.hr: Da. Sama si složila mnogo čudniji zaplet.
learner.en: Yes. You've created a much stranger plot yourself.

partner.en: Should I start again?

learner.hr: Počni. Sada ćeš barem znati zašto lik drži ribu.
learner.en: Start again. Now you'll at least know why the character's holding a fish.

partner.en: Now it makes sense.

learner.hr: Dobro. Bojao sam se da se smijem jedini.
learner.en: Good. I was afraid I was the only one laughing.

partner.en: My version's still interesting.

learner.hr: Vjerujem. Možda si upravo izmislila novi strip.
learner.en: I believe you. Maybe you've just invented a new comic.

conversations.title: A scarf grows past its intended size

partner.en: How much longer are you knitting?

learner.hr: Trebala sam prestati jučer. Šal je već duži od mene.
learner.en: I should have stopped yesterday. The scarf's already longer than me.

partner.en: Who's it for?

learner.hr: Za brata. On voli veliki šal, ali ne treba mu deka.
learner.en: My brother. He likes a big scarf, but he doesn't need a blanket.

partner.en: You can finish now.

learner.hr: Mogu. Samo stalno mislim da još jedan red neće škoditi.
learner.en: I can. I just keep thinking one more row won't hurt.

partner.en: You've said that all evening.

learner.hr: Znam. Makni vunu prije nego što šal dođe do poda.
learner.en: I know. Move the yarn before the scarf reaches the floor.

partner.en: There, I've put it away.

learner.hr: Hvala. Brat sad može dobiti poklon, a ne nedovršeni tunel.
learner.en: Thanks. Now my brother can get a present, not an unfinished tunnel.

conversations.title: A toy almost stays on the train

partner.en: Have we got everything?

learner.hr: Torbe imamo, ali gdje je mali zec?
learner.en: We've got the bags, but where's the little rabbit?

partner.en: Isn't it in the backpack?

learner.hr: Nije. Ostao je na sjedalu, iza jastuka.
learner.en: No. It's on the seat behind the cushion.

partner.en: We're still by the door.

learner.hr: Pričekaj s djetetom, ja ću pitati osoblje mogu li ga uzeti.
learner.en: Wait with the child; I'll ask the staff whether I can fetch it.

partner.en: Did you manage?

learner.hr: Jesam. Kondukter ga je već pronašao.
learner.en: Yes. The conductor had already found it.

partner.en: Now we can go home.

learner.hr: Možemo. Zec je očito htio još jednu stanicu odmora.
learner.en: Yes. The rabbit clearly wanted another stop to rest.

conversations.title: A winter bag contains beach clothes

partner.en: Why have you taken out swimming trunks?

learner.hr: Uzeo sam torbu koju nisam ispraznio nakon ljeta.
learner.en: I took a bag I hadn't emptied after summer.

partner.en: We're in the mountains.

learner.hr: Znam. Krema za sunčanje barem nije potpuno beskorisna.
learner.en: I know. At least the sunscreen isn't completely useless.

partner.en: Have you got winter clothes?

learner.hr: Imam u velikom kovčegu. Ova torba trebala je biti moja ručna prtljaga.
learner.en: Yes, in the big suitcase. This bag was supposed to be my hand luggage.

partner.en: What else did you bring?

learner.hr: Peraje. Nemoj me pitati kako nisam primijetio težinu.
learner.en: Flippers. Don't ask how I didn't notice the weight.

partner.en: At least now we've got a story.

learner.hr: Imamo, ali bih radije imao rezervne čarape. Noge su mi već hladne, a tek smo stigli.
learner.en: We have, but I'd rather have spare socks. My feet are already cold, and we've only just arrived.

conversations.title: A host checks a guest’s food preferences

partner.en: What does your friend eat?

learner.hr: Ne jede meso. Mislio sam da sam ti već rekao.
learner.en: She doesn't eat meat. I thought I'd already told you.

partner.en: It's good I asked.

learner.hr: Ima li nešto što mogu pripremiti prije dolaska? Ne bih htio da večera prođe uz razgovor o tome zašto ne jede meso.
learner.en: Is there something I can prepare before she arrives? I wouldn't want the whole dinner to turn into a conversation about why she doesn't eat meat.

partner.en: The salad and vegetables are ready.

learner.hr: Mogu dodati tjesteninu, ali prvo ću je pitati odgovara li joj. Ako je gladna, ne mora čekati da svi stignu. Mogu joj odmah ponuditi nešto za početak.
learner.en: I can add pasta, but I'll ask her first whether that suits her. If she's hungry, she doesn't have to wait for everyone to arrive. I can offer her something to start with straight away.

partner.hr: Ne želim da se osjeća izdvojeno.
partner.en: I don't want her to feel singled out.

learner.hr: Neće ako je pitamo normalno, bez velikog objašnjavanja pred svima.
learner.en: She won't if we ask normally, without a big explanation in front of everyone.

partner.en: Send her a message.

learner.hr: Šaljem. Lakše je provjeriti nego cijelu večer nagađati.
learner.en: I'm sending it. Easier to check than guess all evening.

conversations.title: An imperfect vase finds another use

partner.en: Why are the pencils in a vase?

learner.hr: Zato što vaza ne drži vodu, ali drži olovke.
learner.en: Because the vase doesn't hold water, but it holds pencils.

partner.en: Is it cracked?

learner.hr: Malo pri dnu. Nisam primijetila dok nisam stavila cvijeće.
learner.en: A little at the bottom. I didn't notice until I put flowers in it.

partner.en: Can I fix it?

learner.hr: Možda, ali meni ovako odgovara. Stol je konačno uredniji. Ova nova namjena je praktična. Slomljena vaza ipak ne mora odmah u smeće.
learner.en: Maybe, but I like it like this. The desk's finally tidier. This new use is practical. A broken vase doesn't have to go straight in the rubbish after all.

partner.en: And the flowers?

learner.hr: U teglici od džema. Ono se nije žalilo.
learner.en: In a jam jar. They haven't complained.

partner.en: So we're throwing nothing away.

learner.hr: Danas ne. Samo smo predmetima zamijenili poslove.
learner.en: Not today. We've just swapped the objects' jobs.

conversations.title: A postcard’s stamp interests a child more than the view

partner.en: May I take this postcard?

learner.hr: Smiješ, ali nemoj otrgnuti marku prije nego pročitam poruku.
learner.en: Yes, but don't tear off the stamp before I read the message.

partner.en: There's an animal on the stamp.

learner.hr: Vidim. Tetka je očito znala da će ti se svidjeti.
learner.en: I see. Our aunt clearly knew you'd like it.

partner.en: Where is she now?

learner.hr: Tamo gdje je snimljena ona planina na prednjoj strani.
learner.en: Where that mountain on the front was photographed.

partner.en: I was only looking at the stamp.

learner.hr: Znam. Svakome je zanimljiv drugi dio putovanja.
learner.en: I know. Different parts of a journey interest different people.

partner.en: Can I keep the whole thing?

learner.hr: Naravno. Tako ćeš imati i marku i tetine riječi.
learner.en: Of course. Then you'll have both the stamp and our aunt's words.

conversations.title: Muddy footprints lead to a familiar suspect

partner.en: Who walked through the kitchen?

learner.hr: Prema tragovima, netko s četiri šape i bez osjećaja krivnje.
learner.en: Judging by the tracks, someone with four paws and no sense of guilt.

partner.en: Where's the dog?

learner.hr: Na kauču. Izgleda iznenađeno što ga uopće sumnjičimo.
learner.en: On the sofa. He looks surprised we're suspecting him at all.

partner.en: Is the sofa dirty too?

learner.hr: Jest, ali tamo je barem ostavio deku ispod sebe.
learner.en: Yes, but at least he left a blanket under himself there.

partner.en: Who forgot to wipe his paws?

learner.hr: Ja. Javio mi se telefon baš kad smo se vratili.
learner.en: Me. My phone rang just as we came back.

partner.en: Then you know where the cloth is.

learner.hr: Znam. Istraga je završena, sad počinje čišćenje.
learner.en: I know. The investigation's over; now the cleaning begins.

conversations.title: Clouds arrive with a borrowed telescope

partner.en: Is the telescope ready?

learner.hr: Jest, ali nebo nam nije ostavilo mnogo prostora.
learner.en: Yes, but the sky hasn't left us much room.

partner.en: Can we see the Moon?

learner.hr: Samo kad se oblaci razmaknu. Maloprije se pojavio na trenutak.
learner.en: Only when the clouds part. It appeared for a moment earlier.

partner.en: So we wait?

learner.hr: Čekamo. Ponio sam čaj, nisam računao da će to biti glavni sadržaj večeri.
learner.en: We wait. I brought tea; I didn't expect it to be the evening's main event.

partner.en: Is it worth coming out again tomorrow?

learner.hr: Pogledat ćemo prognozu. Teleskop nam ne odlazi večeras.
learner.en: We'll check the forecast. The telescope isn't leaving us tonight.

partner.en: There's a little gap!

learner.hr: Vidim. Brzo pogledaj, prije nego oblaci promijene mišljenje.
learner.en: I see it. Have a quick look before the clouds change their minds.

conversations.title: An inscription gives a second-hand book another story

partner.hr: Zašto čitaš prvu stranicu tako dugo?
partner.en: Why are you reading the first page for so long?

learner.hr: Netko je ovdje napisao posvetu prije trideset godina.
learner.en: Someone wrote an inscription here thirty years ago.

partner.en: What does it say?

learner.hr: Da je knjiga za početak novog života u drugom gradu.
learner.en: That the book's for the start of a new life in another city.

partner.en: Do you know whose it was?

learner.hr: Ne znam. Ime mi ništa ne govori. Ali netko je očito želio obilježiti važan početak. Iz papira još viri stari list s adresom.
learner.en: No. The name means nothing to me. But someone clearly wanted to mark an important beginning. An old sheet with an address is still sticking out of the pages.

partner.en: Will you buy it anyway?

learner.hr: Hoću. Sad me zanima i priča izvan onoga što je pisac napisao.
learner.en: Yes. Now I'm interested in a story beyond what the writer wrote too.

partner.en: Maybe you'll add your own inscription.

learner.hr: Možda, kad je jednog dana proslijedim dalje.
learner.en: Maybe, when I pass it on someday.

conversations.title: A trumpet rehearsal sounds like a car alarm

partner.en: Can you hear an alarm?

learner.hr: Nije alarm, susjed vježba trubu uz otvoren prozor.
learner.en: It isn't an alarm; the neighbour's practising trumpet by an open window.

partner.en: Is that really a trumpet?

learner.hr: Jest. Kad ponovi isti dio, prepozna se melodija.
learner.en: Yes. When he repeats the same part, you can recognise the tune.

partner.en: Has he been practising long?

learner.hr: Tek je počeo učiti. Sinoć mi je pokazao instrument.
learner.en: He's just started learning. He showed me the instrument last night.

partner.en: Then he needs time.

learner.hr: Znam. I zatvoren prozor bio bi dobar početak.
learner.en: I know. A closed window would be a good start too.

partner.en: Will you message him?

learner.hr: Hoću, pristojno. Ne želim da prestane svirati, samo da svi zadržimo malo mira. Mogu ga pitati da svira ranije. Tako će mu ostati vremena za vježbe, a meni za san.
learner.en: Yes, politely. I don't want him to stop playing, just for us all to keep some peace. I can ask him to play earlier. That way he'll have time for practice, and I'll have time for sleep.

conversations.title: A seagull takes an interest in a picnic

partner.en: Why are you looking above my head?

learner.hr: Galeb promatra tvoj sendvič. Mislim da čeka priliku. Izgleda kao da proučava plijen. Radije spremi sendvič dok ne nađemo zaklon.
learner.en: A gull's watching your sandwich. I think it's waiting for a chance. He looks as though he's studying his prey. Better put the sandwich away until we find some shelter.

partner.en: Surely it won't take it.

learner.hr: Ja se ne bih kladio na njegovu pristojnost.
learner.en: I wouldn't bet on its manners.

partner.en: Then I'll move farther from the edge.

learner.hr: Dobra ideja. Ovdje se ipak previše ističemo s hranom.
learner.en: Good idea. We're standing out a little too much here with food.

partner.en: It's gone now.

learner.hr: Našao je zanimljiviji ručak kod druge klupe.
learner.en: It found a more interesting lunch by another bench.

partner.en: Can I finally eat?

learner.hr: Možeš, ali gledaj i nebo, ne samo more.
learner.en: Yes, but watch the sky as well as the sea.

conversations.title: A language learner dreams in the wrong language

partner.en: Why were you looking for a dictionary this morning?

learner.hr: Sanjao sam na jeziku koji učim i nisam razumio kraj.
learner.en: I dreamed in the language I'm learning and didn't understand the ending.

partner.en: Not even in your own dream?

learner.hr: Čak ni tada. Moj mozak očito ima smisla za šalu.
learner.en: Not even then. My brain clearly has a sense of humour.

partner.en: Do you remember the words?

learner.hr: Jedne. Ali možda sam je potpuno izmislio.
learner.en: One. But I may have completely invented it.

partner.en: Did you find it?

learner.hr: Nisam. Ili sam postao pjesnik ili trebam više sna.
learner.en: No. Either I've become a poet or I need more sleep.

partner.en: What does your teacher say?

learner.hr: Rekla je da joj ispričam san, pa ćemo vježbati opisivanje.
learner.en: She said to tell her the dream so we can practise describing things.

conversations.title: A reservation is made under a family nickname

partner.en: Why can't they find the booking?

learner.hr: Možda je brat ostavio nadimak umjesto prezimena.
learner.en: Maybe my brother left a nickname instead of a surname.

partner.en: What nickname?

learner.hr: Medo. Tako ga zovemo otkad smo bili djeca.
learner.en: Bear. We've called him that since we were children.

partner.en: Are you really going to ask that?

learner.hr: Hoću. Bolje to nego čekati pred tuđim stolom.
learner.en: Yes. Better than waiting by someone else's table.

partner.en: Have they found it?

learner.hr: Jesu, za Medu i prijatelje. On očito nije očekivao da ja stižem prva.
learner.en: Yes, for Bear and friends. He clearly didn't expect me to arrive first.

partner.en: What will you tell him?

learner.hr: Da idući put on mora prvi razgovarati s osobljem.
learner.en: That next time he has to speak to the staff first.

conversations.title: A radio presenter forgets to start the song

partner.en: Why was there silence?

learner.hr: Najavio sam pjesmu, ali nisam je pokrenuo.
learner.en: I introduced the song but didn't start it.

partner.en: How long?

learner.hr: Meni je djelovalo kao pola sata. Kolegica kaže pet sekundi.
learner.en: It felt like half an hour to me. My colleague says five seconds.

partner.en: Did you recover?

learner.hr: Jesam, rekao sam da je to najtiši uvod naše emisije. U stvarnosti sam samo zaboravio pritisnuti tipku. Na snimci se čuje kako nervozno listam papire.
learner.en: Yes. I said it was the quietest introduction in our programme. In reality I simply forgot to press the button. On the recording you can hear me nervously shuffling papers.

partner.en: Did the listeners notice?

learner.hr: Jedan je poslao poruku da mu se novi smjer sviđa.
learner.en: One messaged to say he liked the new direction.

partner.en: What are you doing now?

learner.hr: Provjeravam gumb prije najave. Humor je dobar, ali glazba je ipak važnija.
learner.en: Checking the button before introducing songs. Humour's good, but music matters more.

conversations.title: A child gives a kite an impractical tail

partner.en: Why's the tail so long?

learner.hr: Želim da se moj zmaj vidi i s drugog kraja igrališta.
learner.en: I want my kite to be visible from the other end of the playground.

partner.en: Will it be able to fly?

learner.hr: Ne znam. Zato smo na radionici, da isprobamo.
learner.en: I don't know. That's why we're at the workshop—to try things.

partner.en: The instructor says it's too heavy.

learner.hr: Onda ću skratiti rep, ali sačuvati plavu vrpcu.
learner.en: Then I'll shorten the tail but keep the blue ribbon.

partner.en: It looks better now.

learner.hr: Meni je malo manje svečan, ali možda bude više letio.
learner.en: To me it's a little less festive, but maybe it'll fly more.

partner.en: Shall we go outside?

learner.hr: Idemo. Crtež je gotov, sad želim vidjeti radi li.
learner.en: Let's. The drawing's finished; now I want to see whether it works.

conversations.title: One last handful of confetti keeps returning

partner.en: Are we finished?

learner.hr: Skoro. Netko stalno unosi konfete na cipelama.
learner.en: Almost. Someone keeps bringing confetti in on their shoes.

partner.en: Maybe it's me.

learner.hr: Pogledaj potplate prije nego još jednom prijeđeš dvoranu.
learner.en: Check your soles before you cross the hall again.

partner.en: They're everywhere.

learner.hr: Znam. Slavlje je trajalo dva sata, čišćenje ima veće ambicije.
learner.en: I know. The party lasted two hours; the cleaning's more ambitious.

partner.en: I can bring another broom.

learner.hr: Donesi. Ja ću zadnji put proći oko pozornice.
learner.en: Do. I'll go around the stage one last time.

partner.en: Shall we get a drink afterwards?

learner.hr: Hoćemo. Samo biramo mjesto bez ikakvih papirnatih ukrasa.
learner.en: Yes. We're just choosing somewhere without any paper decorations.

conversations.title: A bedtime story has an unexpected sound effect

partner.en: What's that sound?

learner.hr: Moj telefon. Ostavila sam ga pod jastukom dok sam čitala.
learner.en: My phone. I left it under the pillow while reading.

partner.en: I thought it was the dragon.

learner.hr: Da je zmaj, vjerojatno ne bi tražio potvrdu sastanka.
learner.en: If it were a dragon, it probably wouldn't ask me to confirm a meeting.

partner.en: Can we continue?

learner.hr: Možemo. Prvo ga nosim u drugu sobu. Tamo barem neće kvariti čaroliju priče. Junak zaslužuje protivnika koji ne vibrira.
learner.en: Yes. First I'm taking it into the other room. At least it won't spoil the magic of the story there. The hero deserves an opponent who doesn't vibrate.

partner.en: Where did we stop?

learner.hr: Kod vrata dvorca. Junak još ne zna tko je unutra.
learner.en: At the castle door. The hero doesn't know who's inside yet.

partner.hr: Nadam se da nije drugi telefon.
partner.en: I hope it isn't another phone.

learner.hr: I ja. Večeras nam je dosta čudnih zvukova.
learner.en: So do I. We've had enough strange sounds tonight.

conversations.title: A tiny café has room for one more chair

partner.en: Is there room for me?

learner.hr: Ima ako se malo pomaknemo. Ovaj stol je veći nego što izgleda.
learner.en: Yes, if we move a little. This table's bigger than it looks.

partner.en: I don't want to disturb you.

learner.hr: Ne smetaš. Samo pripazi na nogu stolice, klima se.
learner.en: You're not. Just watch the chair leg; it wobbles.

partner.en: Then I'll take this one.

learner.hr: Dobro. Torbu mogu staviti ispod svog sjedala. Samo ću je odmaknuti od prolaza da se netko ne spotakne. Ovdje svi nosimo pola kuće sa sobom.
learner.en: Good. I can put the bag under my seat. I'll just move it away from the passage so nobody trips. We all carry half the house with us here.

partner.en: Now we're like a big family.

learner.hr: Jesmo, uključujući raspravu tko je čiju žličicu uzeo.
learner.en: Yes, including the argument about who took whose spoon.

partner.en: May I take the last biscuit?

learner.hr: Smiješ. Obitelj će ti ovaj put oprostiti.
learner.en: Yes. The family will forgive you this time.

conversations.title: Two heights under one umbrella

partner.en: Can you raise the umbrella?

learner.hr: Mogu, ali onda meni kiša ulazi sa strane.
learner.en: Yes, but then rain gets in from the side for me.

partner.en: Shall I carry it?

learner.hr: Probaj. Ti barem vidiš preko ruba.
learner.en: Try. At least you can see over the edge.

partner.en: Is this better?

learner.hr: Bolje, samo hodaj malo sporije. Moji koraci nisu toliko dugi.
learner.en: Better; just walk a little more slowly. My steps aren't that long.

partner.en: I didn't notice.

learner.hr: Znam. Tebi je ovo šetnja, meni lagano trčanje.
learner.en: I know. For you this is a walk; for me it's a gentle run.

partner.en: We're in step now.

learner.hr: Jesmo. Još da se kiša prilagodi nama, sve bi bilo odlično.
learner.en: Yes. If the rain would adapt to us too, everything would be great.

conversations.title: A wheelchair route to the theatre

partner.en: Why aren't we going through the main entrance?

learner.hr: Kolica ne mogu preko ovih stepenica. Tražim pristup bez prepreka.
learner.en: The wheelchair cannot go over these steps. I'm looking for access without obstacles.

partner.en: Do you see any sign?

learner.hr: Na lijevoj strani piše da je ulaz za posjetitelje s kolicima iza ugla.
learner.en: On the left it says that the entrance for visitors with wheelchairs is around the corner.

partner.en: Will we be late?

learner.hr: Nećemo ako skrenemo ovdje. Predstava počinje tek za pola sata.
learner.en: We won't if we turn here. The play doesn't start for another half hour.

partner.en: Do you need help with the door?

learner.hr: Pridrži ih, molim te. Ne mogu istodobno gurati kolica i otvarati vrata.
learner.en: Hold it, please. I cannot push the wheelchair and open the door at the same time.

partner.hr: Jesmo li sad na pravom mjestu?
partner.en: Are we in the right place now?

learner.hr: Jesmo. Službenik nam pokazuje put prema našem redu.
learner.en: Yes. An attendant is showing us the way to our row.

conversations.title: A warning light on a borrowed car

partner.en: Why did you stop?

learner.hr: U autu se upalilo crveno svjetlo. Ne znam što znači.
learner.en: A red light came on in the car. I don't know what it means.

partner.en: Did you check the manual?

learner.hr: Jesam. Piše da odmah zaustavimo automobil i ugasimo motor.
learner.en: Yes. It says to stop the car immediately and switch off the engine.

partner.hr: Možemo li barem do sljedećeg izlaza?
partner.en: Can we at least get to the next exit?

learner.hr: Radije ne bih riskirao. Već smo na sigurnom mjestu.
learner.en: I'd rather not risk it. We are already in a safe place.

partner.en: Who will you call?

learner.hr: Pomoć na cesti. Vlasniku auta ću također javiti što se dogodilo.
learner.en: Roadside assistance. I'll also let the owner of the car know what happened.

partner.en: Do you need the registration number?

learner.hr: Treba. Pročitaj ga polako dok razgovaram s operaterom.
learner.en: Yes. Read it slowly while I'm talking to the operator.

conversations.title: Bread dough refuses to rise

partner.en: How is the bread coming along?

learner.hr: Tijesto se nije diglo. Mislim da je kvascu istekao rok trajanja.
learner.en: The dough hasn't risen. I think the yeast has expired.

partner.hr: Je li u kuhinji dovoljno toplo?
partner.en: Is the kitchen warm enough?

learner.hr: Jest, ali možda sam ulio prevruću vodu. Nikako da naučim biti strpljiv.
learner.en: Yes, but perhaps I poured in water that was too hot. I just can't seem to learn to be patient.

partner.en: Will you throw everything away?

learner.hr: Ne još. Pokušat ću napraviti tanke pogače umjesto kruha.
learner.en: Not yet. I'll try making thin flatbreads instead of bread.

partner.en: Can I do something?

learner.hr: Možeš. Podijeli tijesto na manje dijelove i zagrij tavu.
learner.en: Yes. Divide the dough into smaller pieces and heat the frying pan.

partner.en: How did they turn out?

learner.hr: Izvrsno. Posluži ih dok su tople, uz malo sira.
learner.en: Excellent. Serve them while they're warm, with a little cheese.

conversations.title: A library holds the wrong book

partner.hr: Jesi li dobila poruku iz knjižnice?
partner.en: Did you get a message from the library?

learner.hr: Jesam. Piše da me knjiga čeka u knjižnici do petka.
learner.en: Yes. It says the book is waiting for me at the library until Friday.

partner.en: Why don't you collect it, then?

learner.hr: Na pultu su mi ponudili roman drugog autora s istim prezimenom.
learner.en: At the desk they offered me a novel by another author with the same surname.

partner.en: Did you explain the mix-up?

learner.hr: Jesam. Knjižničarka je pregledala moj zahtjev i pronašla grešku.
learner.en: Yes. The librarian checked my request and found the error.

partner.en: Do they have the right book?

learner.hr: Imaju, ali je trenutačno posuđena. Ponovno su me stavili na listu čekanja.
learner.en: They do, but it's currently on loan. They put me back on the waiting list.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li ipak pročitati ovaj roman?
partner.en: Will you read this novel anyway?

learner.hr: Možda. Nisam ga namjeravala posuditi, ali početak je zanimljiv.
learner.en: Maybe. I hadn't intended to borrow it, but the beginning is interesting.

conversations.title: A choir rehearsal moves downstairs

partner.en: Why is everyone going downstairs?

learner.hr: U gornjoj sali radi grijanje, ali ventilator nadglasava zbor.
learner.en: The heating works in the upstairs hall, but the fan drowns out the choir.

partner.en: Where will we rehearse, then?

learner.hr: Preselili smo se u manju salu. Tamo se bolje čujemo.
learner.en: We've moved to a smaller hall. We can hear one another better there.

partner.en: Is there room for everyone?

learner.hr: Ima ako stanemo u dva reda. Ja pjevam iza tenora.
learner.en: There is if we stand in two rows. I sing behind the tenors.

partner.en: Shall we start from the beginning?

learner.hr: Radije ponovimo posljednju strofu. Tu nam se glasovi razilaze.
learner.en: Let's repeat the last verse instead. That's where our voices drift apart.

partner.en: Was that better?

learner.hr: Jest. Kad slušam ostale umjesto da pjevam glasnije, lakše držim svoj dio.
learner.en: Yes. When I listen to the others instead of singing louder, I find it easier to hold my part.

conversations.title: A bank card stays in the machine

partner.en: Why are you still waiting outside the bank?

learner.hr: Bankomat je zadržao moju karticu, a poslovnica se uskoro otvara.
learner.en: The cash machine kept my card, and the branch opens soon.

partner.en: Did you enter the wrong number?

learner.hr: Nisam siguran. Dvaput sam pokušao, a onda je zaslon postao crn.
learner.en: I'm not sure. I tried twice, and then the screen went black.

partner.en: Do you have another way to pay?

learner.hr: Nemam dovoljno gotovine, ali račun mogu platiti mobitelom.
learner.en: I don't have enough cash, but I can pay the bill with my phone.

partner.en: What will you tell the clerk?

learner.hr: Objasnit ću što se dogodilo i pokazati osobnu iskaznicu.
learner.en: I'll explain what happened and show my identity card.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li ipak zakasniti na posao?
partner.en: Will you be late for work after all?

learner.hr: Vjerojatno. Već sam obavijestio kolege da me ne čekaju.
learner.en: Probably. I've already told my colleagues not to wait for me.

conversations.title: A family photograph needs permission

partner.hr: Zašto nisi objavila sliku s izleta?
partner.en: Why haven't you posted the picture from the outing?

learner.hr: Prije objave želim pitati roditelje djece za dopuštenje.
learner.en: Before posting it, I want to ask the children's parents for permission.

partner.hr: Nisu li već pristali na fotografiranje?
partner.en: Didn't they already agree to being photographed?

learner.hr: Jesu, ali fotografiranje i javno dijeljenje nisu isto.
learner.en: They did, but taking photographs and sharing them publicly are not the same thing.

partner.en: What if someone refuses?

learner.hr: Poštovat ću njihovu odluku. Mogu objaviti fotografiju krajolika bez ljudi.
learner.en: I'll respect their decision. I can post a landscape photograph without people.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li barem poslati slike obiteljima?
partner.en: Will you at least send the pictures to the families?

learner.hr: Da, privatno. Njihovi odgovori na poruku odredit će što smijem objaviti.
learner.en: Yes, privately. Their replies to the message will determine what I may post.

partner.hr: Jesmo li i mi na fotografijama?
partner.en: Are we in the photographs too?

learner.hr: Jesmo. Poslat ću ti poveznicu pa odaberi one koje želiš sačuvati.
learner.en: Yes. I'll send you a link so you can choose the ones you want to keep.

conversations.title: A new employee asks about overtime

partner.en: How did your first week go?

learner.hr: Poslovi su zanimljivi, ali još ne razumijem pravila o prekovremenom radu.
learner.en: The tasks are interesting, but I still don't understand the rules about overtime.

partner.en: What isn't clear?

learner.hr: U ugovoru piše da je potrebno odobrenje, a kolege samo ostaju dulje.
learner.en: The contract says approval is required, but my colleagues simply stay longer.

partner.en: Have you asked your supervisor?

learner.hr: Nisam još. Želim postaviti jasan upit bez optuživanja drugih.
learner.en: Not yet. I want to ask a clear question without accusing others.

partner.en: How will you put it?

learner.hr: Pitat ću tko odobrava dodatne sate i kako ih evidentiramo.
learner.en: I'll ask who approves extra hours and how we record them.

partner.hr: Misliš li da će joj smetati?
partner.en: Do you think it will bother her?

learner.hr: Ne bi trebalo. To su osnovne informacije koje svaki zaposlenik treba znati.
learner.en: It shouldn't. It's basic information every employee needs to know.

conversations.title: A dog is afraid of a new lift

partner.en: Why aren't you getting into the lift?

learner.hr: Pas se boji zvuka vrata. Prvi put je u ovoj zgradi.
learner.en: The dog is afraid of the sound of the doors. It's his first time in this building.

partner.en: Will you pull him inside?

learner.hr: Neću ga silom tjerati. Pričekat ću da se smiri.
learner.en: I won't force him. I'll wait for him to calm down.

partner.en: May I approach him?

learner.hr: Možeš, samo polako. Nježno mu ponudi ruku da je ponjuši.
learner.en: Yes, just slowly. Gently offer him your hand to sniff.

partner.en: Shall we take the stairs after all?

learner.hr: Da. Kasnije ću pokušati ponovno kad bude manje buke.
learner.en: Yes. I'll try again later when there is less noise.

partner.en: Is he usually this timid?

learner.hr: Nije. Uz poznate ljude je miran, ali na nagle zvukove burno reagira.
learner.en: No. He's calm around familiar people, but he reacts strongly to sudden sounds.

conversations.title: A washing label saves a wool jumper

partner.hr: Mogu li i ovu vestu staviti u perilicu?
partner.en: Can I put this jumper in the washing machine too?

learner.hr: Pričekaj. Vunena je, pa prvo pogledaj oznaku na unutarnjoj strani.
learner.en: Wait. It's woollen, so first check the label on the inside.

partner.en: What does the little hand mean?

learner.hr: Da je treba prati ručno. Vruća voda mogla bi je skupiti.
learner.en: That it needs to be washed by hand. Hot water could shrink it.

partner.en: Can I at least wring it out?

learner.hr: Nemoj je uvrtati. Lagano je pritisni ručnikom da upije vodu.
learner.en: Don't twist it. Press it gently with a towel to absorb the water.

partner.en: Shall I hang it on the balcony?

learner.hr: Bolje je položi na ravnu površinu. Mokra bi se na vješalici mogla rastegnuti.
learner.en: It's better to lay it on a flat surface. It could stretch on a hanger while wet.

partner.en: How do you know all that?

learner.hr: Jednom sam oprala svoju najdražu vestu na šezdeset stupnjeva. Više nije pristajala ni djetetu.
learner.en: I once washed my favourite jumper at sixty degrees. Afterwards it wouldn't even fit a child.

conversations.title: The wrong date on a concert ticket

partner.en: Did you buy the tickets?

learner.hr: Jesam, ali koncert je u petak, a ja sam rezervirao subotu.
learner.en: Yes, but the concert is on Friday, and I booked Saturday.

partner.en: Can you exchange them?

learner.hr: Pokušavam. Prodaja ide isključivo preko njihove stranice.
learner.en: I'm trying. Sales are exclusively through their website.

partner.en: What does customer service say?

learner.hr: Traže broj narudžbe i potvrdu plaćanja. Sve sam im poslao.
learner.en: They want the order number and payment confirmation. I sent them everything.

partner.en: Will we lose our seats?

learner.hr: Nadam se da nećemo. Još ima slobodnih sjedala na balkonu.
learner.en: I hope we won't. There are still free seats in the balcony.

partner.en: Have they replied?

learner.hr: Da, riješeno je. Dobili smo nove karte bez dodatne naplate.
learner.en: Yes, it's sorted. We got new tickets at no extra charge.

conversations.title: An envelope for the wrong apartment

partner.en: Is this your letter?

learner.hr: Nije. Na omotnici su moje prezime i adresa, ali tuđe ime.
learner.en: No. The envelope has my surname and address, but someone else's first name.

partner.en: Could it be for a former tenant?

learner.hr: Moguće. Pitam se je li ostavio novu adresu upravitelju.
learner.en: Possibly. I wonder whether he left his new address with the building manager.

partner.en: Will you open it?

learner.hr: Nipošto. Tuđu poštu ne otvaram.
learner.en: Absolutely not. I don't open other people's mail.

partner.en: What shall we do with it, then?

learner.hr: Predaj ga poštaru kad dođe. Objasni da primatelj ovdje ne stanuje.
learner.en: Hand it to the postman when he comes. Explain that the recipient doesn't live here.

partner.en: Shall I write a note on the envelope?

learner.hr: Možeš napisati da je adresa pogrešna, samo nemoj prekriti podatke pošiljatelja.
learner.en: You can write that the address is wrong, just don't cover the sender's details.

conversations.title: Two people learn a board game

partner.en: Who starts the game?

learner.hr: Prema pravilima počinje najmlađi igrač. To si ti.
learner.en: According to the rules, the youngest player starts. That's you.

partner.en: How many cards do I take?

learner.hr: Uzmi pet, a preostale stavi na sredinu stola.
learner.en: Take five and put the rest in the middle of the table.

partner.en: Can I exchange a card straight away?

learner.hr: Smiješ, ali onda preskačeš bacanje kocke.
learner.en: You can, but then you skip rolling the die.

partner.en: It looks like you've won.

learner.hr: Još nisam. Pobjednik je onaj tko prvi skupi dvadeset bodova.
learner.en: Not yet. The winner is whoever first collects twenty points.

partner.en: Shall we play a practice round?

learner.hr: Odlično. Igraj otvorenih karata pa ćemo usput razjasniti pravila.
learner.en: Great. Play with your cards face up and we'll clarify the rules as we go.

conversations.title: An actor forgets which side to enter

partner.hr: Zašto si ušao s lijeve strane?
partner.en: Why did you enter from the left?

learner.hr: U scenariju sam označio krivi ulaz. Mislio sam da čekam iza prozora.
learner.en: I marked the wrong entrance in the script. I thought I was waiting behind the window.

partner.en: Do you know when you need to leave?

learner.hr: Izlazim kad kralj pozove slugu, prije nego što princeza uđe.
learner.en: I leave when the king calls the servant, before the princess enters.

partner.hr: Zašto si onda ostao na pozornici?
partner.en: Why did you stay on stage, then?

learner.hr: Nisam čuo repliku. Glumac koji glumi kralja govorio je pretiho.
learner.en: I didn't hear the line. The actor playing the king spoke too quietly.

partner.en: Can we repeat the scene?

learner.hr: Naravno. Krenimo od trenutka kad sluga predaje pismo.
learner.en: Of course. Let's start from the moment the servant hands over the letter.

partner.en: Is it clear now?

learner.hr: Jest. Predstava će biti bolja ako se međusobno slušamo.
learner.en: Yes. The play will be better if we listen to one another.

conversations.title: A child keeps a nature diary

partner.en: What are you drawing in the notebook?

learner.hr: Bilježim koje ptice dolaze u vrt. Danas ih je bilo manje nego jučer.
learner.en: I'm recording which birds visit the garden. There were fewer today than yesterday.

partner.en: Do you think they've gone away?

learner.hr: Ne nužno. Možda samo traže hranu na drugom mjestu.
learner.en: Not necessarily. Perhaps they're just looking for food elsewhere.

partner.en: Will you leave them bread?

learner.hr: Radije sjeme. U vodiču piše da im kruh nije dobra hrana.
learner.en: Seeds instead. The guide says bread isn't good food for them.

partner.en: How will you recognise them?

learner.hr: Po boji perja, obliku kljuna i načinu na koji lete.
learner.en: By the colour of their feathers, the shape of their beaks and the way they fly.

partner.hr: Mogu li i ja nešto zapisati?
partner.en: Can I write something down too?

learner.hr: Možeš zabilježiti vrijeme i temperaturu. Takvi detalji pomažu usporediti opažanja.
learner.en: You can record the time and temperature. Details like that help compare observations.

conversations.title: A swimmer misreads the lane sign

partner.hr: Zašto ti je spasilac nešto rekao?
partner.en: Why did the lifeguard say something to you?

learner.hr: Plivao sam u stazi za brze plivače, a ja plivam sporo.
learner.en: I was swimming in the lane for fast swimmers, but I swim slowly.

partner.en: Aren't there other lanes?

learner.hr: Ima. Na znaku piše da je srednja namijenjena rekreativcima.
learner.en: There are. The sign says the middle one is for recreational swimmers.

partner.en: Did someone hit you?

learner.hr: Nije. Jedan me plivač samo dotaknuo po stopalu da ga pustim proći.
learner.en: No. A swimmer just touched my foot to ask me to let him pass.

partner.en: Will you carry on?

learner.hr: Hoću, ali sporijim ritmom. Pokušavam ravnomjerno disati.
learner.en: Yes, but at a slower pace. I'm trying to breathe evenly.

partner.en: How much longer are you swimming?

learner.hr: Još dvije dužine, a onda pauzu. Ramena su mi već umorna.
learner.en: Two more lengths, then a break. My shoulders are already tired.

conversations.title: A market stall cannot take a large note

partner.en: Do you have anything smaller?

learner.hr: Nažalost ne. Mogu li platiti karticom?
learner.en: Unfortunately not. Can I pay by card?

partner.en: The machine isn't working today.

learner.hr: Onda ću otići do bankomata. Sačuvajte mi ove jabuke, molim vas.
learner.en: Then I'll go to the cash machine. Please hold these apples for me.

partner.en: Do you need a bag too?

learner.hr: Ne treba, nosim svoju. Koliko sam vam dužan?
learner.en: No, I'm carrying my own. How much do I owe you?

partner.en: Four euros and fifty cents.

learner.hr: Evo pet eura. Imam i kovanicu od pedeset centi ako vam treba za ostatak.
learner.en: Here's five euros. I also have a fifty-cent coin if you need it for change.

partner.en: Thank you, that's easier now.

learner.hr: Nema na čemu. Sljedeći put ću ponijeti više sitnog novca.
learner.en: You're welcome. Next time I'll bring more small change.

conversations.title: A stranger returns a lost wallet

partner.en: Is this your wallet?

learner.hr: Jest. Prepoznao sam ga po ogrebotini na koži.
learner.en: Yes. I recognised it by the scratch on the leather.

partner.en: Check whether everything is inside.

learner.hr: Kartice su tu, a i novac. Gdje ste ga pronašli?
learner.en: The cards are here, and the money too. Where did you find it?

partner.en: On the bench by the station.

learner.hr: Mora da mi je ispao kad sam vadio kartu. Taj trenutak pamtim jer sam umalo propustio autobus. Morao sam potrčati.
learner.en: It must have fallen out when I was taking out my ticket. I remember that moment because I almost missed the bus. I had to run.

partner.hr: Pokušao sam vas pronaći preko recepcije.
partner.en: I tried to find you through reception.

learner.hr: Hvala vam na trudu i iskrenosti. Već sam mislio da je izgubljen zauvijek.
learner.en: Thank you for your effort and honesty. I'd already thought it was lost for good.

partner.en: What matters is that it's back with its owner.

learner.hr: Mogu li vas barem počastiti kavom? Zaista ste mi olakšali dan.
learner.en: Can I at least buy you a coffee? You've really made my day easier.

conversations.title: A street lamp shines into a bedroom

partner.hr: Zašto su ti zavjese stalno zatvorene?
partner.en: Why are your curtains always closed?

learner.hr: Nova ulična rasvjeta svijetli ravno u spavaću sobu.
learner.en: The new street lighting shines straight into the bedroom.

partner.en: Do the curtains help?

learner.hr: Malo, ali kroz rubove još prolazi svjetlo. Teško zaspim.
learner.en: A little, but light still comes through the edges. I find it hard to fall asleep.

partner.en: Have you reported the problem?

learner.hr: Jesam. Poslao sam fotografiju gradskoj službi i zatražio prilagodbu svjetiljke.
learner.en: Yes. I sent a photograph to the city department and asked for the lamp to be adjusted.

partner.en: What did they reply?

learner.hr: Potvrdili su primitak prijave. Kažu da će radnici pregledati položaj svjetla.
learner.en: They confirmed receipt of the report. They say workers will inspect the position of the light.

partner.en: Will you contact them again?

learner.hr: Ako se ništa ne promijeni za tjedan dana, nazvat ću ih.
learner.en: If nothing changes within a week, I'll call them.

conversations.title: A recipe needs less salt

partner.en: Why did you stop adding salt?

learner.hr: Juha je već slana jer sam upotrijebio gotov temeljac.
learner.en: The soup is already salty because I used ready-made stock.

partner.hr: Ali u receptu piše još žličica.
partner.en: But the recipe says another teaspoon.

learner.hr: Recept je za dvostruku količinu. Kuhamo samo za dvoje.
learner.en: The recipe is for twice the quantity. We're only cooking for two.

partner.en: Shall I at least add pepper?

learner.hr: Dodaj malo, pa kušaj. Lakše je dodati začin nego ga izvaditi.
learner.en: Add a little, then taste it. It's easier to add seasoning than to take it out.

partner.en: Does it need to cook longer?

learner.hr: Ne dugo. Povrće je mekano, a piletina je gotova.
learner.en: Not long. The vegetables are soft, and the chicken is done.

partner.en: Can I set the table?

learner.hr: Možeš. Izvadi duboke tanjure i stavi kruh u košaricu.
learner.en: Yes. Take out the soup plates and put the bread in the basket.

conversations.title: A museum label hides a whole history

partner.hr: Zašto toliko gledaš taj mali predmet?
partner.en: Why are you looking at that little object so long?

learner.hr: Na oznaci piše da je pronađen u ruševinama drevnog hrama.
learner.en: The label says it was found in the ruins of an ancient temple.

partner.hr: Zna li se čemu je služio?
partner.en: Do they know what it was used for?

learner.hr: Ne sasvim. Arheolozi smatraju da je bio dio obreda.
learner.en: Not entirely. Archaeologists think it was part of a ritual.

partner.en: Is it gold?

learner.hr: Nije. Izrađen je od drugog metala, ali je površina pozlaćena.
learner.en: No. It's made of another metal, but the surface is gilded.

partner.en: How did it end up here?

learner.hr: Darovan je muzeju nakon istraživanja. Podrijetlo je opisano u katalogu.
learner.en: It was donated to the museum after the research. Its origin is described in the catalogue.

partner.en: Shall we read some more?

learner.hr: Hoćemo. Jedan predmet očito može ispričati povijest čitave civilizacije.
learner.en: Yes. One object can clearly tell the history of an entire civilisation.

conversations.title: An interview recording needs consent

partner.hr: Jesi li spremna za intervju s djedom?
partner.en: Are you ready for the interview with your grandfather?

learner.hr: Jesam, ali prvo ću ga pitati smijem li snimati naš razgovor.
learner.en: Yes, but first I'll ask whether I may record our conversation.

partner.en: What questions do you have?

learner.hr: Zanima me njegovo djetinjstvo i kako je izgledao život u rodnom selu.
learner.en: I'm interested in his childhood and what life in his home village was like.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li ga prekidati radi pojašnjenja?
partner.en: Will you interrupt him to ask for clarification?

learner.hr: Samo ako nešto ne razumijem. Želim da govori svojim tempom.
learner.en: Only if I don't understand something. I want him to speak at his own pace.

partner.hr: Što ako mu neko sjećanje bude teško?
partner.en: What if a memory is difficult for him?

learner.hr: Prestat ću snimati. Nije dužan odgovarati na svako pitanje.
learner.en: I'll stop recording. He isn't obliged to answer every question.

partner.en: Who will you send the recording to?

learner.hr: Obitelji, ali tek kad je djed posluša i odobri dijeljenje.
learner.en: The family, but only after my grandfather listens to it and approves sharing it.

conversations.title: A patient prepares questions for a doctor

partner.en: Why are you taking a notebook to the appointment?

learner.hr: Zapisala sam simptome jer se u ordinaciji često zbunim.
learner.en: I've written down my symptoms because I often get flustered at the surgery.

partner.en: What worries you most?

learner.hr: Umor i bol koja se vraća. Želim to jasno opisati liječniku.
learner.en: The tiredness and the pain that keeps returning. I want to describe it clearly to the doctor.

partner.en: Do you have a list of medicines?

learner.hr: Imam. Zapisala sam nazive i dozu svakog lijeka koji uzimam.
learner.en: Yes. I've written down the names and the dose of every medicine I take.

partner.hr: Želiš li da pođem s tobom?
partner.en: Would you like me to come with you?

learner.hr: Voljela bih. Pomoći će mi ako netko zapamti objašnjenja.
learner.en: I'd like that. It will help if someone remembers the explanations.

partner.en: Will you have time to ask everything?

learner.hr: Pokušat ću prvo postaviti najvažnija pitanja, a ostala ako ostane vremena.
learner.en: I'll try to ask the most important questions first, and the others if there's time.

conversations.title: An office printer exposes a private document

partner.hr: Čiji su ovi papiri na pisaču?
partner.en: Whose papers are these on the printer?

learner.hr: Moji. Molim te, okreni ih licem prema dolje.
learner.en: Mine. Please turn them face down.

partner.en: Is something confidential?

learner.hr: Jest. Dokument sadrži osobne podatke klijenta.
learner.en: Yes. The document contains a client's personal details.

partner.en: Why did you leave them here?

learner.hr: Pisač je zastao pa sam otišla po tehničara. Nisam očekivala da će nastaviti.
learner.en: The printer stopped, so I went to get a technician. I didn't expect it to resume.

partner.en: Should the extra copies be destroyed?

learner.hr: Da, ali pomoću uređaja za uništavanje papira. Nemoj ih samo baciti u koš.
learner.en: Yes, but using the paper shredder. Don't just throw them in the bin.

partner.en: How will we avoid this in future?

learner.hr: Uključit ću ispis uz potvrdu na uređaju, ako naš sustav to podržava.
learner.en: I'll enable printing that requires confirmation at the device, if our system supports it.

conversations.title: A science club compares two samples

partner.en: Why do you have two identical pots?

learner.hr: Uspoređujem rast biljaka. Jedna je kontrola, a druga dobiva više svjetla.
learner.en: I'm comparing plant growth. One is the control, and the other gets more light.

partner.en: Will you water the other one more?

learner.hr: Neću. Količina vode mora ostati jednaka da usporedba ima smisla.
learner.en: No. The quantity of water must stay the same for the comparison to make sense.

partner.en: How do you measure the change?

learner.hr: Svaki dan mjerim visinu i zapisujem rezultate u tablicu.
learner.en: Every day I measure the height and record the results in a table.

partner.hr: Znači li veća biljka da je zdravija?
partner.en: Does a bigger plant mean it's healthier?

learner.hr: Ne nužno. Moram pratiti i boju listova te čvrstoću stabljike.
learner.en: Not necessarily. I also need to monitor leaf colour and the firmness of the stem.

partner.en: When will you present your conclusion?

learner.hr: Nakon četiri tjedna. Zasad imam premalo podataka za konačan zaključak.
learner.en: After four weeks. So far I have too little data for a final conclusion.

conversations.title: A local paper corrects a quotation

partner.en: Why are you calling the newsroom?

learner.hr: U novinama su objavili moju izjavu, ali su izostavili važan dio.
learner.en: The newspaper published my statement, but they left out an important part.

partner.en: Did it change the meaning?

learner.hr: Jest. Ispada da se protivim projektu, a zapravo podržavam njegov cilj.
learner.en: Yes. It makes it look as though I oppose the project, when I actually support its aim.

partner.en: Do you have a recording of the conversation?

learner.hr: Novinar ima snimku. Zamolit ću ga da provjeri što sam rekao.
learner.en: The journalist has a recording. I'll ask him to check what I said.

partner.en: Will you ask for an apology?

learner.hr: Prvo tražim ispravak. Čitatelji trebaju dobiti točnu informaciju.
learner.en: First I'm asking for a correction. Readers need accurate information.

partner.en: What if they don't reply?

learner.hr: Poslat ću pisani zahtjev uredniku i sačuvati kopiju.
learner.en: I'll send a written request to the editor and keep a copy.

conversations.title: A ferry passenger packs the wrong bag

partner.en: Why are you looking for the charger in the boot?

learner.hr: Ostavio sam ga u velikom kovčegu, a sada smo već na trajektu.
learner.en: I left it in the large suitcase, and now we're already on the ferry.

partner.hr: Smijemo li se vratiti do auta?
partner.en: Are we allowed to go back to the car?

learner.hr: Ne znam. Pitat ću člana posade prije nego što siđem.
learner.en: I don't know. I'll ask a crew member before I go down.

partner.hr: Je li ti mobitel sasvim prazan?
partner.en: Is your phone completely flat?

learner.hr: Još ima malo baterije. Kartu sam spremio i za izvanmrežni prikaz.
learner.en: There's still a little battery left. I've also saved the ticket for offline viewing.

partner.en: How long is the crossing?

learner.hr: Dva sata. Mogu izdržati bez telefona dok putujemo brodom.
learner.en: Two hours. I can manage without my phone while we're travelling by boat.

partner.en: What shall we do until then?

learner.hr: Izađimo na palubu. Otok se već vidi u daljini.
learner.en: Let's go out on deck. The island is already visible in the distance.

conversations.title: A flatmate asks for quiet at night

partner.en: Can we talk for a moment?

learner.hr: Naravno. Vidim da si uzrujana. Što se dogodilo?
learner.en: Of course. I can see you're upset. What happened?

partner.hr: Sinoć nisam mogla spavati od glazbe.
partner.en: I couldn't sleep because of the music last night.

learner.hr: Žao mi je. Nisam shvatio koliko se zvuk prenosi kroz zid.
learner.en: I'm sorry. I didn't realise how much sound carries through the wall.

partner.en: I'm working early again tomorrow.

learner.hr: Odsad ću nakon deset koristiti slušalice. Je li ti to prihvatljivo?
learner.en: From now on I'll use headphones after ten. Is that acceptable to you?

partner.hr: Jest, ali i razgovori su bili glasni.
partner.en: Yes, but the conversations were loud too.

learner.hr: Razumijem. Zamolit ću goste da i oni budu tiši.
learner.en: I understand. I'll ask my guests to be quieter too.

partner.en: I don't want to stop you having people over.

learner.hr: Znam. Dijelimo stan i oboje imamo pravo na odmor.
learner.en: I know. We share the flat and both have a right to rest.

conversations.title: A pensioner learns to enlarge text

partner.en: Why are you holding the phone so far away?

learner.hr: Slova su mi premala. Pokušavam pročitati poruku od unuke.
learner.en: The letters are too small for me. I'm trying to read a message from my granddaughter.

partner.en: Would you like to enlarge the text?

learner.hr: Hoću, samo mi pokaži gdje se to mijenja.
learner.en: Yes, just show me where to change it.

partner.en: Can you see the display settings?

learner.hr: Vidim. Ovdje piše veličina teksta, a ispod je klizač.
learner.en: Yes. It says text size here, with a slider underneath.

partner.en: Is it more readable now?

learner.hr: Puno. Ne moram više naprezati oči.
learner.en: Much more. I no longer have to strain my eyes.

partner.en: Shall we change anything else?

learner.hr: Zasad ne. Želim sam ponoviti ove korake da ih zapamtim.
learner.en: Not for now. I want to repeat these steps myself so I remember them.

conversations.title: A community garden shares its harvest

partner.hr: Tko bere rajčice iz zajedničkog vrta?
partner.en: Who picks tomatoes from the community garden?

learner.hr: Dogovorili smo se da beremo zrele plodove i ostavimo nešto ostalima.
learner.en: We agreed to pick ripe fruit and leave some for the others.

partner.en: But there are almost none today.

learner.hr: Netko je možda ubrao više nego što mu treba. Nemojmo odmah optuživati.
learner.en: Someone may have picked more than they need. Let's not immediately blame anyone.

partner.en: How will we resolve it?

learner.hr: Na sastanku možemo predložiti jasniju podjelu uroda.
learner.en: At the meeting we can propose a clearer way to divide the harvest.

partner.en: What about the surplus courgettes?

learner.hr: Višak ćemo darovati pučkoj kuhinji ako se skupina složi.
learner.en: We'll donate the surplus to the community kitchen if the group agrees.

partner.en: Shall I write up a proposal?

learner.hr: Napiši. Neka pravila budu jednostavna i razumljiva svim članovima.
learner.en: Yes. Keep the rules simple and understandable for all members.

conversations.title: A beginner joins a horse-riding lesson

partner.en: Have you ridden before?

learner.hr: Nisam. Želim naučiti jahati, ali pomalo me strah konja.
learner.en: No. I want to learn to ride, but I'm a little afraid of horses.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li prvo prići ovom mirnom konju?
partner.en: Would you like to approach this calm horse first?

learner.hr: Hoću. Samo mi reci gdje da stanem da ga ne prestrašim.
learner.en: Yes. Just tell me where to stand so I don't frighten him.

partner.en: You can stroke his neck.

learner.hr: Baš je topao. Nisam očekivao da će mi prići tako blizu.
learner.en: He's so warm. I didn't expect him to come so close to me.

partner.en: Ready for the helmet?

learner.hr: Jesam. Je li remen dovoljno čvrst ili ga trebam zategnuti?
learner.en: Yes. Is the strap tight enough, or should I tighten it?

partner.en: How do you feel now?

learner.hr: Mirnije. Za početak mi je dovoljno hodati uz konja, bez žurbe.
learner.en: Calmer. For a start, I'm happy just walking beside the horse, without rushing.

conversations.title: A film club debates an ambiguous ending

partner.hr: Misliš li da je glavni lik lagao?
partner.en: Do you think the main character was lying?

learner.hr: Mislim da je skrivao istinu, ali nisam siguran zašto.
learner.en: I think he was hiding the truth, but I'm not sure why.

partner.en: Perhaps he was protecting his sister?

learner.hr: Moguće. Ona je jedina znala gdje je bio te noći.
learner.en: Possibly. She was the only one who knew where he was that night.

partner.en: Did the ending disappoint you?

learner.hr: Malo. Očekivao sam objašnjenje, a dobili smo još jednu zagonetku. Nije mi problem otvoren kraj, nego dojam da nam nedostaje bitan dio priče.
learner.en: A little. I expected an explanation, and we got another puzzle. My problem isn't an open ending, but the feeling that we're missing a vital part of the story.

partner.hr: Zar nije zanimljivo da sami odlučimo?
partner.en: Isn't it interesting to decide for ourselves?

learner.hr: Jest, ako postoje tragovi. Ne želim nagađati bez ikakvog oslonca u priči.
learner.en: Yes, if there are clues. I don't want to guess without any support in the story.

partner.en: Will you watch it again?

learner.hr: Hoću. Možda sam propustio detalj koji mijenja smisao završetka.
learner.en: Yes. Perhaps I missed a detail that changes the meaning of the ending.

conversations.title: A charity explains its expenses

partner.en: Have you made the donation?

learner.hr: Još nisam. Prvo želim vidjeti godišnje izvješće organizacije.
learner.en: Not yet. First I want to see the organisation's annual report.

partner.en: What interests you in it?

learner.hr: Koliko sredstava ide korisnicima, a koliko na troškove rada.
learner.en: How much of the funding goes to beneficiaries and how much to operating costs.

partner.en: Don't the employees need a salary?

learner.hr: Naravno da trebaju. Ne očekujem rad bez naknade, nego transparentnost.
learner.en: Of course they do. I don't expect unpaid work, just transparency.

partner.en: Have they published the data?

learner.hr: Jesu. Troškovi su navedeni po kategorijama, uz opis provedenih aktivnosti.
learner.en: Yes. Expenses are listed by category, with descriptions of the activities carried out.

partner.en: Will you support them, then?

learner.hr: Hoću. Jasno objašnjenje ulijeva mi više povjerenja od same reklame.
learner.en: Yes. A clear explanation gives me more confidence than an advertisement alone.

conversations.title: A witness remembers less than expected

partner.hr: Jesi li vidio što se dogodilo?
partner.en: Did you see what happened?

learner.hr: Vidio sam pad biciklista, ali ne i trenutak prije pada.
learner.en: I saw the cyclist fall, but not the moment before the fall.

partner.en: So the car hit him?

learner.hr: To nisam rekao. Ne znam je li došlo do dodira.
learner.en: I didn't say that. I don't know whether there was any contact.

partner.en: Will you give a statement?

learner.hr: Hoću, ali opisat ću isključivo ono što sam osobno vidio.
learner.en: Yes, but I'll describe only what I personally saw.

partner.en: Do you remember the registration number?

learner.hr: Ne cijele. Zapamtio sam samo prva dva slova.
learner.en: Not all of it. I remember only the first two letters.

partner.hr: Možda ćeš se kasnije sjetiti ostatka.
partner.en: Perhaps you'll remember the rest later.

learner.hr: Možda, ali neću popunjavati praznine pretpostavkama.
learner.en: Perhaps, but I won't fill the gaps with assumptions.

conversations.title: A small business outgrows its spreadsheet

partner.en: Why are you changing how you manage orders?

learner.hr: Imamo sve više klijenata, a u tablici često nastaju dupli unosi.
learner.en: We have more and more clients, and duplicate entries often appear in the spreadsheet.

partner.en: Do you need a new program immediately?

learner.hr: Najprije trebam urediti postojeći postupak i odrediti tko unosi podatke.
learner.en: First I need to organise the existing procedure and decide who enters the data.

partner.en: What will you do with the incorrect records?

learner.hr: Pregledat ću ih s kolegicom. Ne želim slučajno izbrisati valjanu narudžbu.
learner.en: I'll review them with my colleague. I don't want to accidentally delete a valid order.

partner.en: Will that take a long time?

learner.hr: Prvi pregled hoće, ali kasnije ćemo manje vremena trošiti na ispravke.
learner.en: The first review will, but later we'll spend less time on corrections.

partner.hr: Kako ćeš znati da radi bolje?
partner.en: How will you know it's working better?

learner.hr: Usporedit ću broj pogrešaka i vrijeme potrebno za obradu narudžbe.
learner.en: I'll compare the number of errors and the time needed to process an order.

conversations.title: A school trip crosses a border

partner.hr: Jeste li spremili dokumente za put?
partner.en: Have you packed the travel documents?

learner.hr: Jesmo. Provjerili smo osobne iskaznice i suglasnosti roditelja.
learner.en: Yes. We checked identity cards and parental consent forms.

partner.en: Where will you cross the border?

learner.hr: Na prijelazu kojim obično prolazimo. Vozač kaže da jutros nema gužve.
learner.en: At the crossing we usually use. The driver says there's no congestion this morning.

partner.en: What if someone forgets a document?

learner.hr: Zato smo sve provjerili prije polaska. Ne možemo to rješavati na granici.
learner.en: That's why we checked everything before departure. We can't deal with it at the border.

partner.hr: Znaju li djeca kome se javiti?
partner.en: Do the children know whom to contact?

learner.hr: Znaju. Svaki učenik ima broj nastavnika i adresu smještaja.
learner.en: They do. Every pupil has the teacher's number and the accommodation address.

partner.hr: Hoćete li javiti da ste stigli?
partner.en: Will you let us know you've arrived?

learner.hr: Da. Poslat ćemo kratku poruku roditeljima kad se smjestimo. Ako kasnije ne odgovorimo odmah, možda nećemo imati signala.
learner.en: Yes. We'll send the parents a short message once we've settled in. If we don't reply immediately later on, we may not have a signal.

conversations.title: A student asks for a quieter exam room

partner.en: Why did you stay after the lecture?

learner.hr: Htjela sam razgovarati s profesorom o uvjetima ispita.
learner.en: I wanted to speak with the professor about the exam conditions.

partner.en: What do you need changed?

learner.hr: U velikoj dvorani teško se koncentriram. Pitala sam postoji li mirniji prostor.
learner.en: I find it difficult to concentrate in the large hall. I asked whether there's a quieter space.

partner.en: Did he accept the suggestion?

learner.hr: Rekao je da se javim nadležnoj službi radi službenog zahtjeva.
learner.en: He said I should contact the relevant department to make an official request.

partner.en: Is any documentation needed?

learner.hr: Treba. Poslat će mi popis potrebnih dokumenata i rok za prijavu.
learner.en: Yes. They'll send me a list of the required documents and the application deadline.

partner.en: Are you happy with the conversation?

learner.hr: Jesam. Bilo me strah pitati, ali odgovor je bio ljubazan i konkretan.
learner.en: Yes. I was afraid to ask, but the response was kind and specific.
