conversations.title: A bicycle brake rubs after transport

partner.en: What's making that noise?

learner.hr: Kočnice stružu o kotač otkad smo izvadili bicikl iz kombija.
learner.en: The brakes have been rubbing against the wheel since we took the bicycle out of the van.

partner.hr: Misliš li da je nešto slomljeno?
partner.en: Do you think something is broken?

learner.hr: Ne znam. Kotač možda nije pravilno postavljen.
learner.en: I don't know. The wheel may not be fitted correctly.

partner.en: Will you set off anyway?

learner.hr: Neću voziti dok ne provjerim kočnice. Otići ću pješice do servisa.
learner.en: I won't ride until I've had the brakes checked. I'll walk to the repair shop.

partner.en: Is it far?

learner.hr: Nije. Servis je u istoj ulici, odmah iza mosta. Odavdje mogu gurati bicikl, ne trebam prijevoz.
learner.en: No. The repair shop is on the same street, just beyond the bridge. I can push the bicycle from here; I don't need transport.

partner.en: Do you need me to wait for you?

learner.hr: Ne trebaš. Javit ću ti kad saznam mogu li danas nastaviti vožnju.
learner.en: No. I'll let you know when I find out whether I can continue the ride today.

conversations.title: A visitor waits at the wrong hospital entrance

partner.en: Why don't you go in?

learner.hr: Ova bolnica ima nekoliko ulaza. Tražim odjel na kojem mi leži brat.
learner.en: This hospital has several entrances. I'm looking for the ward where my brother is staying.

partner.hr: Znaš li na kojem je katu?
partner.en: Do you know which floor he's on?

learner.hr: Znam kat, ali ne i zgradu. U bolnici se lako izgubim.
learner.en: I know the floor, but not the building. I get lost easily in the hospital.

partner.en: Is the operation over?

learner.hr: Jest. Liječnik kaže da se dobro oporavlja nakon operacije.
learner.en: Yes. The doctor says he's recovering well after the operation.

partner.en: Are you allowed to visit him yet?

learner.hr: Smijem, ali posjeti su kratki. Ne želim ga umoriti.
learner.en: Yes, but visits are short. I don't want to tire him out.

partner.en: What will you bring him?

learner.hr: Samo čistu odjeću i knjigu. Za hranu ću prvo pitati medicinsku sestru.
learner.en: Just clean clothes and a book. I'll ask the nurse about food first.

conversations.title: A pharmacist checks an unclear label

partner.en: Why are you going back to the pharmacy?

learner.hr: Na kutiji lijeka ne razumijem uputu o uzimanju.
learner.en: I don't understand the directions on the medicine box.

partner.en: Didn't the doctor explain?

learner.hr: Jest, ali želim provjeriti jesam li dobro zapamtio dozu.
learner.en: Yes, but I want to check whether I remembered the dose correctly.

partner.en: Are you bringing your other medicines too?

learner.hr: Nosim popis lijekova. Ljekarnica treba znati što još uzimam.
learner.en: I'm bringing a list of medicines. The pharmacist needs to know what else I'm taking.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li usput uzeti nešto protiv kašlja?
partner.en: Will you get something for your cough while you're there?

learner.hr: Prvo ću pitati smijem li to uzimati s ovim lijekom.
learner.en: First I'll ask whether I can take it with this medicine.

partner.hr: Što ćeš napraviti s novim uputama?
partner.en: What will you do with the new instructions?

learner.hr: Zapisat ću ih na papir i držati uz lijekove. Ne želim nagađati.
learner.en: I'll write them on paper and keep them with the medicines. I don't want to guess.

conversations.title: A church choir welcomes a nonreligious visitor

partner.en: Will you come to hear the choir?

learner.hr: Hoću, iako inače ne idem u crkvu. Volim zborsku glazbu.
learner.en: Yes, although I don't usually go to church. I like choral music.

partner.en: Do you know where the concert is?

learner.hr: U crkvi pokraj trga. Na plakatu piše da je ulaz besplatan.
learner.en: In the church by the square. The poster says admission is free.

partner.en: Will there be a religious service?

learner.hr: Ne, samo koncert. Dio programa čine pjesme nadahnute tekstovima iz Biblije.
learner.en: No, just a concert. Part of the programme consists of songs inspired by texts from the Bible.

partner.hr: Je li ti zbog toga neugodno?
partner.en: Does that make you uncomfortable?

learner.hr: Nije. Mogu cijeniti glazbu i tuđu vjeru bez dijeljenja istih uvjerenja.
learner.en: No. I can appreciate music and someone else's faith without sharing the same beliefs.

partner.en: Where shall we meet?

learner.hr: Ispred crkve, deset minuta prije početka.
learner.en: Outside the church, ten minutes before it starts.

conversations.title: A tenant speaks to a lawyer

partner.en: Have you signed the new contract?

learner.hr: Nisam. Odvjetnik mi je savjetovao da prvo zatražim pojašnjenje jedne odredbe.
learner.en: No. A lawyer advised me to ask for clarification of one clause first.

partner.en: What does it say?

learner.hr: Da ja snosim sve troškove popravaka, bez obzira na uzrok oštećenja.
learner.en: That I bear all repair costs, regardless of the cause of the damage.

partner.en: Is that allowed?

learner.hr: Ne znam. Zato sam razgovarao s odvjetnikom umjesto da pretpostavljam.
learner.en: I don't know. That's why I spoke with a lawyer instead of making assumptions.

partner.en: Will you give up on the flat?

learner.hr: Ne nužno. Želim pregovarati o jasnijim uvjetima najma.
learner.en: Not necessarily. I want to negotiate clearer rental terms.

partner.en: What does the owner say?

learner.hr: Pristao je pogledati prijedlog izmjene. Čekam njegov pisani odgovor.
learner.en: He agreed to look at the proposed change. I'm waiting for his written reply.

conversations.title: A film subtitle changes a police rank

partner.en: Why did you pause the film?

learner.hr: U prijevodu policijski poručnik odjednom postaje kapetan.
learner.en: In the translation, a police lieutenant suddenly becomes a captain.

partner.hr: Je li unaprijeđen u toj sceni?
partner.en: Is he promoted in that scene?

learner.hr: Nije. Isti lik prije toga oslovljavaju riječju poručniče.
learner.en: No. Before that, they address the same character as lieutenant.

partner.en: Does that change your understanding of the story?

learner.hr: Malo. Izgleda kao da izdaje naredbe nadređenom, a zapravo mu podnosi izvješće.
learner.en: A little. It looks as though he's giving orders to a superior, when he's actually reporting to him.

partner.en: Will you send feedback?

learner.hr: Hoću. Navest ću vrijeme scene i objasniti nedosljednost u činovima.
learner.en: Yes. I'll give the scene's timestamp and explain the inconsistency in the ranks.

partner.en: Do all the subtitles need changing?

learner.hr: Ne, samo pogrešna mjesta. Ostatak prijevoda uglavnom je dobar.
learner.en: No, just the incorrect parts. The rest of the translation is mostly good.

conversations.title: An astronomy class waits for a clear sky

partner.en: What will we observe tonight?

learner.hr: Mjesec i planete, ako oblaci dopuste. Galaksije će biti teže vidljive.
learner.en: The Moon and planets, if the clouds allow it. Galaxies will be harder to see.

partner.hr: Je li ono zvijezda koja se miče?
partner.en: Is that a star that's moving?

learner.hr: Vjerojatno je satelit. Kreće se ravnomjerno i ne treperi.
learner.en: It's probably a satellite. It moves steadily and doesn't twinkle.

partner.en: Why is the telescope pointing at nothing?

learner.hr: Čekamo da se oblak pomakne. Iza njega je naš cilj.
learner.en: We're waiting for the cloud to move. Our target is behind it.

partner.en: How big is the universe, really?

learner.hr: Toliko da udaljenosti izražavamo u svjetlosnim godinama, a ne kilometrima.
learner.en: So big that we express distances in light years rather than kilometres.

partner.en: Can we look now?

learner.hr: Možemo. Približi oko, ali nemoj pomicati teleskop.
learner.en: Yes. Bring your eye closer, but don't move the telescope.

conversations.title: A reunion invitation uses an old surname

partner.hr: Zašto ti je pozivnica stigla na staro prezime?
partner.en: Why did the invitation arrive under your old surname?

learner.hr: Organizator nije znao da sam ga promijenila nakon razvoda.
learner.en: The organiser didn't know I'd changed it after the divorce.

partner.en: Will you correct him?

learner.hr: Hoću, ali privatno. Ne želim objašnjavati kraj braka cijeloj grupi.
learner.en: Yes, but privately. I don't want to explain the end of my marriage to the whole group.

partner.hr: Hoće li doći i tvoj bivši muž?
partner.en: Will your ex-husband come too?

learner.hr: Ne znam. Ako dođe, možemo biti pristojni jedno prema drugome.
learner.en: I don't know. If he comes, we can be polite to one another.

partner.hr: Želiš li da pođem s tobom?
partner.en: Would you like me to come with you?

learner.hr: Hvala, ali idem s prijateljicom. S njezinim društvom osjećam se opuštenije.
learner.en: Thank you, but I'm going with a friend. I feel more relaxed in her company.

partner.en: Are you looking forward to the reunion?

learner.hr: Veselim. Razvod je dio mog života, ali nije jedina stvar o kojoj želim razgovarati.
learner.en: I am. Divorce is part of my life, but it isn't the only thing I want to talk about.

conversations.title: A campsite asks visitors to separate waste

partner.en: Where should I throw this bottle?

learner.hr: Staklo ide u zeleni spremnik pokraj ulaza u kamp.
learner.en: Glass goes in the green container by the campsite entrance.

partner.en: And the leftovers from lunch?

learner.hr: Za njih je smeđa kanta. Na poklopcu su nacrtane vrste otpada.
learner.en: The brown bin is for those. The types of waste are illustrated on the lid.

partner.en: Why is this bin locked?

learner.hr: Da životinje ne raznose smeće po kampu. Ključ visi kod recepcije.
learner.en: So animals don't scatter rubbish around the campsite. The key hangs at reception.

partner.en: Do we need to wash the packaging?

learner.hr: Pogledaj upute na spremniku. Pravila odvajanja ovdje su posebno objašnjena.
learner.en: Look at the instructions on the container. The sorting rules here are explained specifically.

partner.en: Have you packed everything away?

learner.hr: Jesam. Provjerio sam i da ništa nije ostalo ispod šatora.
learner.en: Yes. I also checked that nothing was left under the tent.

conversations.title: A radio host receives a rude message

partner.hr: Zašto ne pročitaš tu poruku u emisiji?
partner.en: Why don't you read that message on the programme?

learner.hr: Sadrži uvrede. Kritiku mogu prihvatiti, ali ne želim širiti vrijeđanje.
learner.en: It contains insults. I can accept criticism, but I don't want to spread abuse.

partner.en: Did the listener identify a problem?

learner.hr: Jest. Kaže da sam pogrešno izgovorio ime gosta. U tome je u pravu.
learner.en: Yes. He says I pronounced the guest's name incorrectly. He's right about that.

partner.en: Will you apologise?

learner.hr: Hoću. Ispravit ću pogrešku bez čitanja nepristojnog dijela poruke.
learner.en: Yes. I'll correct the mistake without reading the rude part of the message.

partner.hr: Misliš li da će to biti dovoljno?
partner.en: Do you think that will be enough?

learner.hr: Ne mogu kontrolirati njegovu reakciju. Mogu odgovorno postupiti u svojoj emisiji.
learner.en: I can't control his reaction. I can act responsibly on my programme.

partner.en: Will you block him?

learner.hr: Ako nastavi slati uvrede, primijenit ću pravila moderiranja.
learner.en: If he keeps sending insults, I'll apply the moderation rules.

conversations.title: A family learns what a DNA kit can reveal

partner.hr: Zašto još nisi naručio taj test?
partner.en: Why haven't you ordered that test yet?

learner.hr: Želim razumjeti kome šaljem svoju DNK i kako se čuvaju podaci.
learner.en: I want to understand whom I'm sending my DNA to and how the data is stored.

partner.en: Doesn't it just show ancestry?

learner.hr: Tvrtka nudi i druge analize, ali procjene podrijetla nisu potpuna obiteljska povijest.
learner.en: The company offers other analyses too, but ancestry estimates aren't a complete family history.

partner.en: What worries you most?

learner.hr: Mogu li se podaci dijeliti s drugima i mogu li kasnije tražiti brisanje.
learner.en: Whether the data can be shared with others and whether I can request deletion later.

partner.en: Have you read the terms?

learner.hr: Čitam ih. Genetski podaci odnose se i na moje rođake, ne samo na mene.
learner.en: I'm reading them. Genetic data concerns my relatives too, not just me.

partner.en: Will you decide against it in the end?

learner.hr: Možda. Znatiželja mi nije važnija od privatnosti.
learner.en: Maybe. My curiosity isn't more important to me than privacy.

conversations.title: A driver refuses another drink

partner.en: Would you like another glass of wine?

learner.hr: Neću, hvala. Večeras vozim, pa ne pijem alkohol.
learner.en: No, thanks. I'm driving tonight, so I'm not drinking alcohol.

partner.en: Didn't you come by taxi?

learner.hr: Nisam. Došao sam svojim autom i obećao odvesti sestru kući.
learner.en: No. I came in my own car and promised to drive my sister home.

partner.en: I can pour you some juice.

learner.hr: To bi bilo odlično. Žedan sam nakon plesa.
learner.en: That would be great. I'm thirsty after dancing.

partner.en: When do you need to leave?

learner.hr: Sestra rano radi. Krenut ćemo čim pozdravimo domaćina.
learner.en: My sister starts work early. We'll leave as soon as we say goodbye to the host.

partner.en: Shall I pack you some cake?

learner.hr: Može, hvala. Uzmimo manju kutiju da se torta ne prevrne u vožnji.
learner.en: Yes, thank you. Let's use a smaller box so the cake doesn't tip over during the drive.

conversations.title: A climber turns back before the summit

partner.en: Why are you stopping? The summit is close.

learner.hr: Stijene su skliske, a vjetar je sve jači. Radije bih se vratio.
learner.en: The rocks are slippery, and the wind is getting stronger. I'd rather turn back.

partner.en: Are you disappointed?

learner.hr: Jesam, ali ne želim ugroziti ni sebe ni tebe zbog jednog pogleda.
learner.en: Yes, but I don't want to put either of us at risk for the sake of one view.

partner.en: Can we go down the same way?

learner.hr: Možemo. Držimo se označene staze i hodajmo polako.
learner.en: Yes. Let's stay on the marked trail and walk slowly.

partner.en: Do you need my walking stick?

learner.hr: Treba mi pri spuštanju. Koljena me već pomalo bole.
learner.en: I need it on the descent. My knees are already aching a little.

partner.en: Shall we try another time?

learner.hr: Hoćemo, kad uvjeti budu bolji. Planina nikamo neće otići.
learner.en: Yes, when the conditions are better. The mountain isn't going anywhere.

conversations.title: A roof leak reaches a neighbour

partner.hr: Zašto mi se na stropu pojavila mrlja?
partner.en: Why has a stain appeared on my ceiling?

learner.hr: Moguće je da voda curi s krova. I kod mene se zid navlažio.
learner.en: Water may be leaking from the roof. My wall has become damp too.

partner.en: Should we call the building manager?

learner.hr: Da, odmah. Fotografiraj mrlje dok su vidljive.
learner.en: Yes, immediately. Photograph the stains while they're visible.

partner.hr: Hoće li netko izaći na krov?
partner.en: Will someone go onto the roof?

learner.hr: Upravitelj će organizirati pregled. Ne bismo se smjeli sami penjati.
learner.en: The manager will arrange an inspection. We shouldn't climb up ourselves.

partner.en: Who pays for the repair?

learner.hr: Moramo provjeriti uzrok i uvjete osiguranja prije nego što to znamo.
learner.en: We need to check the cause and the insurance terms before we know that.

partner.hr: Što da radim s mokrim stvarima?
partner.en: What should I do with the wet things?

learner.hr: Odmakni ih od zida. Pomoći ću ti premjestiti ormarić.
learner.en: Move them away from the wall. I'll help you move the cabinet.

conversations.title: A child is disappointed by a lost race

partner.en: Why don't you want to talk?

learner.hr: Izgubio sam utrku. Tjednima sam trenirao, a završio sam posljednji.
learner.en: I lost the race. I trained for weeks and finished last.

partner.hr: Jesi li bio sporiji nego prije?
partner.en: Were you slower than before?

learner.hr: Nisam. Popravio sam svoj rekord, ali ostali su bili brži.
learner.en: No. I improved my personal record, but the others were faster.

partner.hr: Znači li to da je trening bio uzaludan?
partner.en: Does that mean the training was wasted?

learner.hr: Kad tako kažeš, ne znači. Ipak sam napredovao.
learner.en: When you put it that way, no. I did make progress.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li pitati trenera za savjet?
partner.en: Will you ask the coach for advice?

learner.hr: Hoću. Trebam naučiti bolje rasporediti snagu tijekom utrke.
learner.en: Yes. I need to learn to manage my energy better during the race.

partner.en: Are you going to the next competition?

learner.hr: Idem, ali prvo želim odmoriti i razmisliti o današnjoj utrci.
learner.en: Yes, but first I want to rest and think about today's race.

conversations.title: An artist explains an empty frame

partner.hr: Gdje je slika u ovom okviru?
partner.en: Where is the picture in this frame?

learner.hr: Umjetnik je namjerno ostavio prazno mjesto. Rad govori o gubitku.
learner.en: The artist deliberately left an empty space. The work is about loss.

partner.en: Can emptiness be art?

learner.hr: Meni može, ako potakne pitanje ili osjećaj koji inače ne bih imao.
learner.en: It can be for me, if it prompts a question or feeling I wouldn't otherwise have.

partner.en: What do you feel while looking at it?

learner.hr: Tugu, ali i znatiželju. Zamišljam čiji bi portret mogao biti unutra.
learner.en: Sadness, but also curiosity. I imagine whose portrait might belong inside.

partner.hr: Je li važno što je autor zamislio?
partner.en: Does it matter what the creator intended?

learner.hr: Važno je, ali promatrač može djelu dati i vlastito značenje.
learner.en: It matters, but a viewer can also give a work their own meaning.

partner.en: Will you read the description?

learner.hr: Hoću, tek nakon što još malo pogledam. Ne želim odmah preuzeti tuđe tumačenje.
learner.en: Yes, after I've looked a little longer. I don't want to immediately adopt someone else's interpretation.

conversations.title: A dentist asks about a damaged tooth

partner.en: What brings you in today?

learner.hr: Okrhnuo mi se zub dok sam jeo. Sad me smeta pri žvakanju.
learner.en: I chipped a tooth while eating. Now it bothers me when I chew.

partner.en: Do you feel any pain?

learner.hr: Povremeno, osobito kad pijem nešto hladno.
learner.en: Occasionally, especially when I drink something cold.

partner.en: Do you know which tooth it is?

learner.hr: Mislim da je ovaj straga, ali bol se širi pa nisam siguran.
learner.en: I think it's this one at the back, but the pain spreads, so I'm not sure.

partner.hr: Jeste li prije imali sličan problem?
partner.en: Have you had a similar problem before?

learner.hr: Jesam, na drugom zubu. Imam i staru snimku ako vam treba.
learner.en: Yes, with another tooth. I also have an old scan if you need it.

partner.en: Can we do an examination first?

learner.hr: Naravno. Molim vas samo da mi objasnite nalaz prije zahvata.
learner.en: Of course. Please just explain the findings to me before any procedure.

conversations.title: A daughter asks about an old medal

partner.en: Whose medal is this?

learner.hr: Pripadala je mom djedu. Dobio ju je dok je bio u vojsci.
learner.en: It belonged to my grandfather. He received it while he was in the army.

partner.en: Was he an officer?

learner.hr: Jest, ali rijetko je govorio o ratu. Više je pričao o prijateljima. Na jednoj fotografiji ima vojnu uniformu. Na poleđini je samo godina, bez imena ostalih.
learner.en: Yes, but he rarely spoke about the war. He talked more about his friends. In one photograph he is wearing a military uniform. On the back there is only a year, without the names of the others.

partner.hr: Znaš li zašto ju je dobio?
partner.en: Do you know why he received it?

learner.hr: U pismu piše da je pomogao pri spašavanju ranjenog vojnika.
learner.en: A letter says he helped rescue a wounded soldier.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li je staviti na zid?
partner.en: Will you put it on the wall?

learner.hr: Ne znam. Prvo želim saznati više o događaju i ljudima koji su bili s njim.
learner.en: I don't know. First I want to learn more about the event and the people who were with him.

partner.en: May I read the letter?

learner.hr: Možeš. Samo ga pažljivo izvadi jer je papir vrlo krhak.
learner.en: Yes. Just take it out carefully because the paper is very fragile.

conversations.title: A café corrects an allergy misunderstanding

partner.en: Why did you return the cake?

learner.hr: Na popisu sastojaka piše kikiriki, iako su mi rekli da ga nema.
learner.en: The ingredients list says peanuts, although they told me it had none.

partner.en: Did they understand the question?

learner.hr: Možda nisu. Ponovila sam da imam alergiju i trebam točnu informaciju.
learner.en: Perhaps not. I repeated that I have an allergy and need accurate information.

partner.en: What did they offer then?

learner.hr: Provjeru s kuharom, umjesto nagađanja. Pričekat ću odgovor.
learner.en: To check with the cook instead of guessing. I'll wait for the answer.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li uzeti neki drugi kolač?
partner.en: Will you have another cake?

learner.hr: Samo ako mogu pouzdano potvrditi sastojke i način pripreme.
learner.en: Only if they can reliably confirm the ingredients and how it's prepared.

partner.en: Can I at least bring you water?

learner.hr: Možeš, hvala. Ne žuri mi se s narudžbom.
learner.en: Yes, thank you. I'm in no rush to order.

conversations.title: A beginner hears the difference between two notes

partner.en: Why do you keep repeating the same note?

learner.hr: Učim ugoditi gitaru bez gledanja u zaslon.
learner.en: I'm learning to tune the guitar without looking at a screen.

partner.hr: Čuješ li da je ova žica niža?
partner.en: Can you hear that this string is lower?

learner.hr: Čujem, ali još ne znam koliko trebam zategnuti žicu.
learner.en: I can, but I don't yet know how much to tighten the string.

partner.en: Will you try slowly?

learner.hr: Hoću. Ne želim je previše zategnuti pa da pukne.
learner.en: Yes. I don't want to tighten it so much that it snaps.

partner.en: Is it better now?

learner.hr: Jest. Dva tona više ne zvuče kao da se svađaju.
learner.en: Yes. The two notes no longer sound as though they're arguing.

partner.en: What will you play first?

learner.hr: Jednostavnu pjesmu koju znam napamet. Još učim pravilno držati prste.
learner.en: A simple song I know by heart. I'm still learning how to position my fingers properly.

conversations.title: A visitor asks about a synagogue tour

partner.en: Why do we need to register in advance?

learner.hr: Obilazak sinagoge ima ograničen broj mjesta i sigurnosne provjere.
learner.en: The synagogue tour has limited places and security checks.

partner.en: Do we need to belong to the community?

learner.hr: Ne. Posjet je namijenjen svima koji žele upoznati židovsku povijest grada.
learner.en: No. The visit is for everyone who wants to learn about the city's Jewish history.

partner.en: What particularly interests you?

learner.hr: Kako su Židovi živjeli u ovom susjedstvu prije nego što se grad proširio.
learner.en: How Jewish people lived in this neighbourhood before the city expanded.

partner.hr: Hoće li biti vremena za pitanja?
partner.en: Will there be time for questions?

learner.hr: Hoće. Vodič je zamolio da pitanja ostavimo za kraj izlaganja.
learner.en: Yes. The guide asked us to save questions for the end of the talk.

partner.en: Do we need to bring anything?

learner.hr: Dokument koji su naveli u potvrdi prijave i poštovanje prema pravilima posjeta.
learner.en: The document specified in the registration confirmation, and respect for the visiting rules.

conversations.title: A friend is angry about a broken promise

partner.en: Why are you so quiet?

learner.hr: Bijesan sam. Obećao je doći, a opet se nije pojavio.
learner.en: I'm furious. He promised to come, and once again he didn't show up.

partner.en: Perhaps something happened?

learner.hr: Možda, ali izluđuje me što ne odgovara na poruke.
learner.en: Perhaps, but it drives me mad that he doesn't reply to messages.

partner.en: Will you call him?

learner.hr: Ne dok sam ovako ljut. Mogao bih reći nešto grubo.
learner.en: Not while I'm this angry. I might say something harsh.

partner.hr: Što bi mu zapravo htio reći?
partner.en: What would you actually like to tell him?

learner.hr: Da me povrijedio i da mi je teško vjerovati njegovim obećanjima.
learner.en: That he hurt me and that I find it hard to trust his promises.

partner.en: Shall we take a walk first?

learner.hr: Hoćemo. Treba mi malo zraka prije tog razgovora.
learner.en: Yes. I need some air before that conversation.

conversations.title: A new resident feels lonely in a busy city

partner.hr: Kako ti je u novom gradu?
partner.en: How are you finding the new city?

learner.hr: Grad mi se sviđa, ali navečer sam često usamljena.
learner.en: I like the city, but in the evenings I often feel lonely.

partner.hr: Zar se ne družiš s kolegama?
partner.en: Don't you spend time with your colleagues?

learner.hr: Družim se na poslu. Izvan posla još nemam bliske prijatelje.
learner.en: I do at work. Outside work, I don't have close friends yet.

partner.en: What would you like to do?

learner.hr: Pridružiti se čitateljskom klubu ili upisati tečaj plesa.
learner.en: Join a book club or take a dance course.

partner.en: What's stopping you?

learner.hr: Neugodno mi je doći sama. Osjećam se kao stranac među ljudima koji se poznaju.
learner.en: I feel awkward arriving alone. I feel like a stranger among people who know one another.

partner.en: Shall we go together the first time?

learner.hr: To bi mi puno značilo. Poslije ću se lakše usuditi otići sama.
learner.en: That would mean a lot to me. Afterwards I'll find it easier to dare to go alone.

conversations.title: A wedding invitation needs a tactful refusal

partner.en: Will you come to the wedding?

learner.hr: Voljela bih, ali taj vikend već putujem s obitelji.
learner.en: I'd like to, but I'm already travelling with my family that weekend.

partner.en: Can you change the trip?

learner.hr: Teško. Smještaj smo rezervirali prije nego što je stigla pozivnica.
learner.en: It would be difficult. We booked accommodation before the invitation arrived.

partner.en: Have you replied to them yet?

learner.hr: Jesam. Čestitala sam zaručnicima i objasnila zašto ne mogu doći.
learner.en: Yes. I congratulated the engaged couple and explained why I can't come.

partner.hr: Misliš li da su se uvrijedili?
partner.en: Do you think they took offence?

learner.hr: Nadam se da nisu. Njihova mi je sreća važna iako neću biti prisutna.
learner.en: I hope not. Their happiness matters to me even though I won't be there.

partner.en: Will you see each other afterwards?

learner.hr: Dogovorili smo večeru kad se vrate s medenog mjeseca.
learner.en: We've arranged dinner when they return from their honeymoon.

conversations.title: A promotion brings unexpected doubts

partner.en: Why aren't you celebrating your promotion?

learner.hr: Sretan sam, ali sumnjam jesam li spreman voditi tim.
learner.en: I'm happy, but I doubt whether I'm ready to lead a team.

partner.en: Haven't you already led a project?

learner.hr: Jesam, samo što je upravljanje ljudima drukčije od raspoređivanja zadataka.
learner.en: Yes, but managing people is different from assigning tasks.

partner.en: Can you ask for support?

learner.hr: Mogu. Dogovorio sam mentorstvo s iskusnijom voditeljicom.
learner.en: Yes. I've arranged mentoring with a more experienced manager.

partner.en: What do you want to learn first?

learner.hr: Kako dati korisnu povratnu informaciju bez ponižavanja suradnika.
learner.en: How to give useful feedback without humiliating a colleague.

partner.hr: Zvuči kao da ozbiljno shvaćaš ulogu.
partner.en: It sounds as though you take the role seriously.

learner.hr: Shvaćam. Želim steći povjerenje tima, ne samo novi naziv radnog mjesta.
learner.en: I do. I want to earn the team's trust, not just a new job title.

conversations.title: A child admits breaking a window

partner.hr: Znaš li kako je prozor puknuo?
partner.en: Do you know how the window broke?

learner.hr: Znam. Bacio sam loptu previsoko i pogodio staklo.
learner.en: Yes. I threw the ball too high and hit the glass.

partner.en: Why didn't you tell me immediately?

learner.hr: Uplašio sam se da ćeš vikati. Sakrio sam loptu iza garaže.
learner.en: I was afraid you would shout. I hid the ball behind the garage.

partner.en: Did anyone get hurt?

learner.hr: Nije. Odmaknuo sam mlađeg brata da ne stane na komadiće stakla.
learner.en: No. I moved my younger brother away so he wouldn't step on the pieces of glass.

partner.en: What do you intend to do now?

learner.hr: Ispričat ću se susjedu i pomoći platiti popravak iz svoje ušteđevine.
learner.en: I'll apologise to the neighbour and help pay for the repair from my savings.

partner.en: We can go together.

learner.hr: Hvala. Lakše mi je kad ne moram sam objasniti što sam učinio.
learner.en: Thank you. It's easier when I don't have to explain what I did on my own.

conversations.title: A bad review feels personal

partner.en: Why do you keep reading the same comment?

learner.hr: Gost je napisao da sam nepristojan. Pokušavam shvatiti što ga je povrijedilo.
learner.en: A guest wrote that I'm rude. I'm trying to understand what hurt him.

partner.en: Do you remember the encounter?

learner.hr: Sjećam se da je dugo čekao. Bio je nezadovoljan prije nego što smo razgovarali.
learner.en: I remember he waited a long time. He was unhappy before we spoke.

partner.en: Did you explain that to him?

learner.hr: Jesam, ali možda je moj ton zvučao hladno. Bio sam pod stresom.
learner.en: Yes, but perhaps my tone sounded cold. I was under stress.

partner.en: Will you reply to the review?

learner.hr: Hoću, smireno. Priznat ću čekanje i ponuditi razgovor o iskustvu.
learner.en: Yes, calmly. I'll acknowledge the wait and offer to discuss his experience.

partner.en: And what about your own feelings?

learner.hr: Napravit ću pauzu. Jedan komentar ne opisuje sav moj rad.
learner.en: I'll take a break. One comment doesn't describe all my work.

conversations.title: A father forgets a school performance

partner.en: Did you make it to the school performance?

learner.hr: Nisam. Pogrešno sam upisao vrijeme i propustio kćerin nastup.
learner.en: No. I entered the wrong time and missed my daughter's performance.

partner.en: How did she react?

learner.hr: Plakala je. Rekla je da su svi drugi roditelji bili tamo.
learner.en: She cried. She said all the other parents were there.

partner.en: What did you tell her?

learner.hr: Da mi je žao i da razumijem zašto je tužna. Nisam tražio izgovore.
learner.en: That I'm sorry and understand why she's sad. I didn't make excuses.

partner.en: Is there a recording?

learner.hr: Postoji, ali znam da to ne može zamijeniti moj dolazak.
learner.en: There is, but I know it can't replace my being there.

partner.en: Will you watch it together?

learner.hr: Ako bude htjela. Ne želim je prisiljavati da mi odmah oprosti.
learner.en: If she wants to. I don't want to force her to forgive me immediately.

conversations.title: A friend keeps a surprising secret

partner.hr: Zašto si skrivala da pišeš roman?
partner.en: Why did you hide that you're writing a novel?

learner.hr: Bojala sam se da ću odustati pa mi je bilo neugodno govoriti o tome.
learner.en: I was afraid I'd give up, so I felt awkward talking about it.

partner.en: Have you finished it?

learner.hr: Prvi nacrt jesam. Sad ga čitam iznova i brišem dijelove koji ne funkcioniraju.
learner.en: I've finished the first draft. Now I'm rereading it and deleting parts that don't work.

partner.en: May I read it?

learner.hr: Možeš, ako mi obećaš iskren odgovor, a ne samo pohvale.
learner.en: Yes, if you promise me an honest response rather than just praise.

partner.en: What are you most interested in?

learner.hr: Jesu li likovi uvjerljivi i postoji li dio na kojem priča postaje dosadna.
learner.en: Whether the characters are convincing and whether there's a point where the story becomes boring.

partner.en: When would you like the comments?

learner.hr: Za dva tjedna, ako stigneš. Ne očekujem da zbog mene ostaviš sve drugo.
learner.en: In two weeks, if you have time. I don't expect you to drop everything else for me.

conversations.title: A friend asks before giving advice

partner.en: Why are you just sitting beside me?

learner.hr: Nisam siguran želiš li savjet ili samo nekoga tko sluša.
learner.en: I'm not sure whether you want advice or just someone who listens.

partner.en: Don't you have any solution?

learner.hr: Imam ideje, ali ne želim pretpostaviti da znam što je najbolje za tebe.
learner.en: I have ideas, but I don't want to assume I know what's best for you.

partner.en: For now I need to talk.

learner.hr: U redu. Ispričaj mi što ti je danas bilo najteže.
learner.en: All right. Tell me what was hardest for you today.

partner.hr: Stalno osjećam da sve radim pogrešno.
partner.en: I keep feeling that I'm doing everything wrong.

learner.hr: Zvuči iscrpljujuće. Čujem koliko se trudiš, iako ti se rezultat ne sviđa.
learner.en: That sounds exhausting. I hear how hard you're trying, even though you don't like the result.

partner.hr: Hvala što me nisi odmah prekidao.
partner.en: Thank you for not interrupting me straight away.

learner.hr: Nema na čemu. Ako poslije poželiš moje mišljenje, slobodno pitaj.
learner.en: You're welcome. If you want my opinion later, feel free to ask.

conversations.title: A couple disagrees about moving

partner.en: Why are you avoiding talking about moving?

learner.hr: Jer imam dojam da si već odlučila bez mene.
learner.en: Because I feel you've already decided without me.

partner.en: I haven't decided, I'm just looking at listings.

learner.hr: Onda mi je lakše. Želim sudjelovati u odluci koja utječe na oboje.
learner.en: Then I feel better. I want to take part in a decision that affects us both.

partner.en: What matters most to you?

learner.hr: Blizina posla i troškovi. Veća kuća nije korisna ako si je ne možemo priuštiti.
learner.en: Being near work and the costs. A bigger house isn't useful if we can't afford it.

partner.en: I miss having a garden.

learner.hr: Razumijem. Možemo usporediti opcije bez obećanja da ćemo odmah preseliti.
learner.en: I understand. We can compare options without promising to move immediately.

partner.en: Shall we make a list of priorities?

learner.hr: Hoćemo, svatko svoj, pa ćemo potražiti ono oko čega se slažemo.
learner.en: Yes, one each, and then we'll look for what we agree on.

conversations.title: A crime novel names the wrong suspect

partner.hr: Jesi li stigla do kraja romana?
partner.en: Have you reached the end of the novel?

learner.hr: Jesam. Detektiv je uhitio pogrešnog čovjeka, a pravi ubojica je pobjegao.
learner.en: Yes. The detective arrested the wrong man, and the real killer escaped.

partner.en: Was the evidence convincing?

learner.hr: Nisu. Optužba se temeljila na iskazu svjedoka koji je kasnije promijenio priču.
learner.en: No. The accusation was based on the account of a witness who later changed his story.

partner.en: Why did the suspect confess, then?

learner.hr: Pokušavao je zaštititi sina. To saznajemo tek na posljednjim stranicama.
learner.en: He was trying to protect his son. We only find that out in the final pages.

partner.hr: Je li ti završetak bio pošten prema čitatelju?
partner.en: Did the ending seem fair to the reader?

learner.hr: Djelomično. Tragovi su postojali, ali motiv ubojstva nije dobro objašnjen.
learner.en: Partly. The clues were there, but the motive for the murder wasn't explained well.

partner.en: Will you read the sequel?

learner.hr: Hoću. Zanima me hoće li detektiv priznati vlastitu pogrešku.
learner.en: Yes. I want to see whether the detective will admit his own mistake.

conversations.title: A local election discussion stays civil

partner.hr: Hoćeš li doći na raspravu kandidata?
partner.en: Will you come to the candidates' debate?

learner.hr: Hoću. Želim čuti kako planiraju riješiti probleme u našem naselju.
learner.en: Yes. I want to hear how they plan to solve problems in our neighbourhood.

partner.en: Do you support a political party?

learner.hr: Ne glasam samo prema nazivu stranke. Gledam program i dosadašnji rad.
learner.en: I don't vote just on the basis of a party's name. I look at the programme and past work.

partner.en: What will you ask them about?

learner.hr: O javnom prijevozu i dostupnosti vrtića. To utječe na svakodnevni život građana.
learner.en: Public transport and nursery availability. Those affect residents' everyday lives.

partner.hr: Misliš li da će konkretno odgovoriti?
partner.en: Do you think they'll give a specific answer?

learner.hr: Nadam se. Ako odgovor bude općenit, postavit ću dodatno pitanje.
learner.en: I hope so. If the answer is vague, I'll ask a follow-up question.

partner.hr: Što ako se ne složimo oko izbora?
partner.en: What if we disagree about whom to choose?

learner.hr: Možemo se razlikovati u mišljenju i ipak razgovarati pristojno.
learner.en: We can differ in opinion and still speak politely.

conversations.title: A factory tour explains protective equipment

partner.en: Why do we have to put on these glasses?

learner.hr: U tvornici postoji opasnost od sitnih čestica u zraku.
learner.en: In the factory there's a risk of small particles in the air.

partner.en: May we photograph the machines?

learner.hr: Samo tamo gdje vodič dopusti. Neki dijelovi proizvodnje nisu za javnost.
learner.en: Only where the guide allows it. Some parts of production aren't public.

partner.en: What does this factory manufacture?

learner.hr: Dijelove za vlakove. Gotove proizvode šalju kupcima diljem Europe.
learner.en: Parts for trains. They send finished products to customers throughout Europe.

partner.en: Why are we standing behind the yellow line?

learner.hr: Da ostanemo izvan prostora kojim prolaze radna vozila.
learner.en: So we stay out of the area where work vehicles pass.

partner.en: Will we see the final inspection?

learner.hr: Hoćemo. Kažu da se svaki dio testira prije nego što napusti tvornicu.
learner.en: Yes. They say each part is tested before it leaves the factory.

conversations.title: A weather report cancels a boat trip

partner.en: Why isn't the boat departing today?

learner.hr: Najavljena je oluja. Vjetar i valovi već otežavaju plovidbu.
learner.en: A storm is forecast. Wind and waves are already making sailing difficult.

partner.en: Can we take another boat?

learner.hr: Sve su linije na toj ruti otkazane. Nije problem samo naš brod.
learner.en: All services on that route are cancelled. It isn't just our boat.

partner.hr: Što ćemo sa smještajem na otoku?
partner.en: What about our accommodation on the island?

learner.hr: Nazvat ću domaćina i objasniti situaciju. Možda možemo pomaknuti dolazak.
learner.en: I'll call the host and explain the situation. Perhaps we can move our arrival.

partner.en: Do they refund the tickets?

learner.hr: Provjerit ću uvjete povrata na stranici prijevoznika.
learner.en: I'll check the refund terms on the operator's website.

partner.en: Are you very disappointed?

learner.hr: Jesam, ali sigurnost mi je važnija od plana putovanja.
learner.en: Yes, but safety matters more to me than the travel plan.

conversations.title: A city removes a dangerous tree

partner.en: Why are they cutting down that big tree?

learner.hr: Stručnjak je utvrdio da je iznutra trulo i da bi moglo pasti.
learner.en: An expert found that it's rotten inside and could fall.

partner.en: It looks healthy from outside.

learner.hr: Znam. Krošnja je zelena, ali deblo ima duboko oštećenje.
learner.en: I know. The crown is green, but the trunk has deep damage.

partner.en: Will they plant another one?

learner.hr: Prema obavijesti hoće, na istom mjestu ako tlo bude prikladno.
learner.en: According to the notice, yes, in the same place if the soil is suitable.

partner.en: Why have they closed the passage?

learner.hr: Grane padaju blizu staze. Ograda štiti prolaznike tijekom radova.
learner.en: Branches are falling near the path. The barrier protects passers-by during the work.

partner.hr: Hoćemo li ipak moći do parka?
partner.en: Will we still be able to get to the park?

learner.hr: Hoćemo, samo moramo obići blok i ući s druge strane.
learner.en: Yes, we just need to go around the block and enter from the other side.

conversations.title: A customer questions a repair estimate

partner.en: Why haven't you approved the repair?

learner.hr: Procjena je gotovo jednaka cijeni novog uređaja. Želim znati što uključuje.
learner.en: The estimate is almost the price of a new appliance. I want to know what it includes.

partner.en: Did they list the parts?

learner.hr: Naveli su zamjenu motora, ali nije jasno je li rad uključen u cijenu.
learner.en: They listed a motor replacement, but it isn't clear whether labour is included in the price.

partner.en: Will you seek a second opinion?

learner.hr: Hoću ako ne dobijem jasno objašnjenje. Ne želim platiti dvaput isti posao.
learner.en: Yes, if I don't get a clear explanation. I don't want to pay twice for the same job.

partner.hr: Je li uređaj još pod jamstvom?
partner.en: Is the appliance still under warranty?

learner.hr: Nije. Jamstvo je isteklo prije dva mjeseca.
learner.en: No. The warranty expired two months ago.

partner.en: What will you ask them first?

learner.hr: Je li procjena konačna i nude li jamstvo na ugrađeni dio.
learner.en: Whether the estimate is final and whether they offer a warranty on the fitted part.

conversations.title: A child wants to keep a wild animal

partner.hr: Mogu li ponijeti ovu malu životinju kući?
partner.en: Can I take this little animal home?

learner.hr: Ne bismo smjeli uzimati divlje životinje samo zato što nam se sviđaju.
learner.en: We shouldn't take wild animals just because we like them.

partner.en: But it looks alone.

learner.hr: Možda joj je majka blizu. Promatrajmo je izdaleka da je ne prestrašimo.
learner.en: Its mother may be nearby. Let's watch from a distance so we don't frighten it.

partner.en: What if it's injured?

learner.hr: Onda ćemo nazvati službu za pomoć divljim životinjama i opisati što vidimo.
learner.en: Then we'll call a wildlife rescue service and describe what we see.

partner.en: May I feed it?

learner.hr: Prvo treba pitati stručnjaka. Pogrešna hrana može joj nauditi.
learner.en: We need to ask an expert first. The wrong food could harm it.

partner.en: Shall we leave it here?

learner.hr: Zasad da. Najbolja pomoć nije uvijek odnijeti životinju iz njezina okoliša.
learner.en: For now, yes. The best help isn't always to take an animal out of its environment.

conversations.title: A listener spots a misleading advertisement

partner.en: Do you believe that advertisement?

learner.hr: Sumnjam. Obećava nevjerojatne rezultate, ali ne navodi nikakve dokaze.
learner.en: I doubt it. It promises incredible results but gives no evidence.

partner.hr: Kažu da je proizvod znanstveno potvrđen.
partner.en: They say the product is scientifically validated.

learner.hr: To je tvrdnja. Želim vidjeti istraživanje, ne samo čovjeka u bijelom kaputu.
learner.en: That's a claim. I want to see the research, not just a man in a white coat.

partner.en: Perhaps users' experiences are enough?

learner.hr: Pojedinačna iskustva mogu biti iskrena, ali ne pokazuju nužno učinak proizvoda.
learner.en: Individual experiences can be honest, but they don't necessarily demonstrate the product's effect.

partner.en: Will you buy it anyway?

learner.hr: Ne dok ne provjerim izvor informacija i uvjete prodaje.
learner.en: Not until I check the information source and sales terms.

partner.en: Why the sales terms?

learner.hr: Zato što sitnim slovima piše da se narudžba automatski ponavlja svaki mjesec.
learner.en: Because the small print says the order automatically repeats every month.

conversations.title: A parent learns a child has been bullied

partner.en: Why don't you want to go to school?

learner.hr: Neki dječaci mi se rugaju i skrivaju torbu.
learner.en: Some boys make fun of me and hide my bag.

partner.en: How long has this been happening?

learner.hr: Već nekoliko tjedana. Mislio sam da će prestati ako ih ignoriram.
learner.en: For several weeks. I thought they'd stop if I ignored them.

partner.en: Have you told the teacher?

learner.hr: Nisam. Bojao sam se da će me zvati tužibabom.
learner.en: No. I was afraid they'd call me a telltale.

partner.hr: Želiš li da razgovaramo s njim zajedno?
partner.en: Would you like us to talk to him together?

learner.hr: Želim. Treba mi pomoć, ali ne želim da me pred svima ispituje.
learner.en: Yes. I need help, but I don't want him to question me in front of everyone.

partner.en: We'll arrange a private conversation.

learner.hr: Hvala što mi vjeruješ. Lakše mi je kad ne moram to skrivati.
learner.en: Thank you for believing me. It's easier when I don't have to hide it.

conversations.title: A baker explains why the price changed

partner.hr: Zašto ovaj kruh sad košta više?
partner.en: Why does this bread cost more now?

learner.hr: Pekar kaže da su porasli troškovi brašna, energije i rada.
learner.en: The baker says the costs of flour, energy and labour have risen.

partner.en: Is the loaf smaller too?

learner.hr: Čini mi se, ali trebamo usporediti težinu, ne samo izgled.
learner.en: It seems so to me, but we should compare the weight, not just the appearance.

partner.en: Is the price per kilogram displayed?

learner.hr: Piše na donjoj polici. Tako lakše uspoređujemo različita pakiranja.
learner.en: It's on the lower shelf. That makes it easier to compare different package sizes.

partner.en: Will you change bakeries?

learner.hr: Možda ću dio kruha peći doma, ali računam i vrijeme koje mi treba. Kad uračunam struju, ušteda nije tako velika kao što sam mislio.
learner.en: Perhaps I'll bake some bread at home, but I'm also taking account of the time I need. When I include the electricity, the saving isn't as big as I thought.

partner.en: Are we buying this loaf today?

learner.hr: Kupujemo manju. Ne želim da pola opet završi u smeću.
learner.en: We're buying a smaller one. I don't want half to end up in the rubbish again.

conversations.title: A suitcase arrives on a later flight

partner.en: Have you found your suitcase?

learner.hr: Nisam. Na aerodromu su mi rekli da je ostao u gradu presjedanja.
learner.en: No. At the airport they told me it stayed in the city where I changed planes.

partner.en: What did you have to do?

learner.hr: Ispunio sam prijavu i opisao prtljagu. Sačuvao sam broj predmeta.
learner.en: I filled in a report and described the luggage. I kept the case number.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li opet morati do zračne luke?
partner.en: Will you have to go back to the airport?

learner.hr: Kažu da će kovčeg dostaviti na adresu smještaja kad stigne sljedećim avionom.
learner.en: They say they'll deliver the suitcase to my accommodation address when it arrives on the next plane.

partner.en: Do you at least have clean clothes?

learner.hr: Imam majicu u ručnoj prtljazi, ali moram kupiti četkicu za zube.
learner.en: I have a T-shirt in my hand luggage, but I need to buy a toothbrush.

partner.en: Did you lose your temper?

learner.hr: Skoro. Onda sam shvatio da mi svađa sa službenicom neće vratiti kovčeg.
learner.en: Almost. Then I realised arguing with the clerk wouldn't bring my suitcase back.

conversations.title: A handwritten recipe names no quantities

partner.en: Why are you laughing at your grandmother's recipe?

learner.hr: Piše malo brašna i mlijeka po potrebi. Nema ni jedne mjere.
learner.en: It says a little flour and milk as needed. There isn't a single measurement.

partner.en: How did it always work, then?

learner.hr: Ona je znala po osjećaju. Ja bez njezina iskustva samo nagađam.
learner.en: She knew by feel. Without her experience, I'm just guessing.

partner.en: Can we call her?

learner.hr: Možemo. Pitat ću koliko jaja ide u smjesu za palačinke.
learner.en: Yes. I'll ask how many eggs go into the pancake batter.

partner.hr: Što ako kaže da ovisi o tavi?
partner.en: What if she says it depends on the pan?

learner.hr: Onda ćemo je pozvati da kuhamo zajedno i zapisati što stvarno koristi.
learner.en: Then we'll invite her to cook with us and record what she actually uses.

partner.en: Will you keep the old paper?

learner.hr: Naravno. Mrlje i njezin rukopis vrijede mi više od savršeno otisnutog recepta.
learner.en: Of course. The stains and her handwriting mean more to me than a perfectly printed recipe.

conversations.title: A volunteer learns to walk shelter dogs

partner.hr: Smijem li povesti bilo kojeg psa?
partner.en: May I take any dog?

learner.hr: Ne. U skloništu prvo određuju koji pas odgovara tvojem iskustvu.
learner.en: No. At the shelter they first decide which dog suits your experience.

partner.en: Why is this one wearing a yellow ribbon?

learner.hr: Treba više prostora. To je upozorenje da mu ne prilazimo naglo.
learner.en: He needs more space. It's a warning not to approach him suddenly.

partner.en: May I give him a treat?

learner.hr: Pitaj zaposlenika. Neki psi imaju posebnu prehranu.
learner.en: Ask a staff member. Some dogs have a special diet.

partner.en: Will you walk with me?

learner.hr: Hoću. Pokazat ću ti put kojim obično vodimo pse.
learner.en: Yes. I'll show you the route where we usually walk the dogs.

partner.en: What do we do when we get back?

learner.hr: Javimo osoblju kako je prošla šetnja i provjerimo ima li pas svježu vodu.
learner.en: We tell the staff how the walk went and check that the dog has fresh water.

conversations.title: A student receives a scholarship offer

partner.en: Why are you reading the message so carefully?

learner.hr: Dobila sam stipendiju, ali želim razumjeti sve uvjete prije prihvaćanja.
learner.en: I've been awarded a scholarship, but I want to understand all the conditions before accepting.

partner.en: Do you have to maintain a certain average grade?

learner.hr: Moram. Traže i potvrdu da sam upisana na sveučilište kao redovita studentica.
learner.en: Yes. They also require confirmation that I'm enrolled full-time at university.

partner.en: Does the scholarship cover accommodation?

learner.hr: Djelomično. Iznos se isplaćuje mjesečno tijekom akademske godine.
learner.en: Partly. The amount is paid monthly during the academic year.

partner.en: Will you stop working weekends?

learner.hr: Možda ću smanjiti broj smjena, ali prvo moram napraviti proračun.
learner.en: Perhaps I'll reduce my number of shifts, but first I need to make a budget.

partner.en: Have you told your parents yet?

learner.hr: Jesam. Ponosni su, a ja sam im zahvalna na podršci.
learner.en: Yes. They're proud, and I'm grateful for their support.

conversations.title: A chess player resigns too early

partner.en: Why did you resign the game?

learner.hr: Izgubio sam kraljicu i mislio da više nemam nikakve šanse.
learner.en: I lost my queen and thought I no longer had any chance.

partner.hr: Jesi li vidio ovaj potez skakačem?
partner.en: Did you see this knight move?

learner.hr: Nisam. Gledao sam samo što sam izgubio, a ne što još mogu učiniti.
learner.en: No. I was only looking at what I'd lost, not what I could still do.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li vratiti ploču na taj položaj?
partner.en: Shall we reset the board to that position?

learner.hr: Hoću. Želim razumjeti kako sam mogao nastaviti igru.
learner.en: Yes. I want to understand how I could have continued the game.

partner.en: Can you see the threat now?

learner.hr: Vidim. Sljedećim potezom mogao sam napasti kralja i osvojiti topa.
learner.en: Yes. On the next move I could have attacked the king and won a rook.

partner.en: Have we learned something useful?

learner.hr: Jesmo. U šahu trebam pogledati cijelu ploču prije nego što odustanem.
learner.en: Yes. In chess I need to look at the whole board before I give up.

conversations.title: A tailor asks a customer to move

partner.en: Why do you keep turning me around?

learner.hr: Provjeravam kako odijelo stoji kad se krećete, ne samo dok mirujete.
learner.en: I'm checking how the suit fits when you move, not just when you're standing still.

partner.en: Are the sleeves too long?

learner.hr: Malo. Označit ću kraću duljinu, ali prvo savijte ruku.
learner.en: A little. I'll mark a shorter length, but bend your arm first.

partner.en: And the trousers?

learner.hr: U struku su dobre. Treba prilagoditi samo donji rub.
learner.en: The waist fits well. Only the hem needs adjusting.

partner.en: May I sit down?

learner.hr: Svakako. Važno je da vam u odijelu bude udobno i dok sjedite.
learner.en: Certainly. It's important that you're comfortable in the suit when sitting too.

partner.en: When can I collect it?

learner.hr: U četvrtak. Nazovite prije dolaska da potvrdimo da je sve završeno.
learner.en: On Thursday. Call before coming so we can confirm everything is finished.

conversations.title: A flood warning changes a basement plan

partner.en: Why are you carrying boxes upstairs?

learner.hr: Najavili su obilnu kišu. Ne želim držati važne stvari u podrumu. Kad razina vode počne rasti, želim da su najvažnije stvari već na sigurnom.
learner.en: Heavy rain is forecast. I don't want to keep important things in the basement. When the water level starts rising, I want the most important things to be safe already.

partner.en: Has water already come in?

learner.hr: Nije, ali prošle je godine poplavila dio ulice.
learner.en: No, but last year it flooded part of the street.

partner.en: What should we move first?

learner.hr: Dokumente i fotografije. Namještaj se može zamijeniti, uspomene teže.
learner.en: Documents and photographs. Furniture can be replaced; memories are harder to replace.

partner.en: Shall we check the drains?

learner.hr: Da, prije pljuska. Kasnije ćemo pratiti službene obavijesti.
learner.en: Yes, before the downpour. Later we'll follow official notices.

partner.en: Should we tell the neighbours?

learner.hr: Treba. Neki nisu vidjeli upozorenje pa im možemo pokucati na vrata.
learner.en: Yes. Some haven't seen the warning, so we can knock on their doors.

conversations.title: A dancer chooses a simpler routine

partner.en: Why did you change the choreography?

learner.hr: Složeniji skok još ne izvodim sigurno. Za nastup biram jednostavniju verziju.
learner.en: I still can't perform the more complex jump safely. I'm choosing a simpler version for the performance.

partner.en: Won't you lose points that way?

learner.hr: Možda, ali ne želim riskirati ozljedu zbog jednog skoka.
learner.en: Perhaps, but I don't want to risk an injury for one jump.

partner.en: Did you ask your coach?

learner.hr: Jesam. Složila se da trebam prvo učvrstiti osnovne pokrete.
learner.en: Yes. She agreed that I need to strengthen the basic movements first.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li ga kasnije ponovno učiti?
partner.en: Will you learn it again later?

learner.hr: Hoću, postupno i uz nadzor. Ne odustajem zauvijek.
learner.en: Yes, gradually and with supervision. I'm not giving up forever.

partner.hr: Kako ti se sviđa nova verzija?
partner.en: How do you like the new version?

learner.hr: Zapravo mi je draža. Mirnije plešem kad ne razmišljam samo o doskoku.
learner.en: I actually prefer it. I dance more calmly when I'm not thinking only about the landing.

conversations.title: A clock repairer asks for patience

partner.hr: Hoće li sat danas biti gotov?
partner.en: Will the clock be ready today?

learner.hr: Još ne. Mehanizam sam očistio, ali moram provjeriti drži li točno vrijeme.
learner.en: Not yet. I've cleaned the mechanism, but I need to check whether it keeps accurate time.

partner.hr: Zar nije dovoljno da kazaljke idu?
partner.en: Isn't it enough that the hands move?

learner.hr: Nije. Sat može raditi, a ipak kasniti nekoliko minuta dnevno.
learner.en: No. A clock can work and still lose several minutes a day.

partner.en: Do you need to replace a part?

learner.hr: Jedna je opruga istrošena. Tražim odgovarajuću zamjenu.
learner.en: One spring is worn. I'm looking for a suitable replacement.

partner.hr: Isplati li se popravljati tako star sat?
partner.en: Is it worth repairing such an old clock?

learner.hr: Financijski možda ne, ali vi najbolje znate njegovu osobnu vrijednost.
learner.en: Financially perhaps not, but you know its personal value best.

partner.hr: Mogu li vam ostaviti još tjedan dana?
partner.en: Can I leave it with you for another week?

learner.hr: Možete. Javit ću vam se čim završim provjeru.
learner.en: Yes. I'll contact you as soon as I finish the check.

conversations.title: A picnic guest admits disliking a dish

partner.en: Why didn't you take any salad?

learner.hr: Ne volim sirovi luk, a čini mi se da ga u njoj ima dosta.
learner.en: I don't like raw onion, and there seems to be plenty in it.

partner.en: Will you at least try it?

learner.hr: Hvala, ali radije bih nešto drugo. Ne želim uzeti pa baciti.
learner.en: Thank you, but I'd rather have something else. I don't want to take some and then throw it away.

partner.en: We have roasted vegetables.

learner.hr: To obožavam. Mogu li dobiti malo patlidžana?
learner.en: I love those. May I have some aubergine?

partner.hr: Mislila sam da ne jedeš povrće.
partner.en: I thought you didn't eat vegetables.

learner.hr: Jedem mnogo povrća. Samo mi luk nije omiljena namirnica.
learner.en: I eat lots of vegetables. Onion just isn't my favourite ingredient.

partner.en: All right, I'll remember now.

learner.hr: Hvala što pitaš. Lakše mi je reći što volim nego glumiti da mi sve odgovara.
learner.en: Thank you for asking. It's easier for me to say what I like than to pretend everything suits me.

conversations.title: A night worker negotiates household noise

partner.en: Why are you sleeping in the middle of the day?

learner.hr: Ovaj tjedan radim noćnu smjenu. Tek sam jutros legao.
learner.en: I'm working the night shift this week. I only went to bed this morning.

partner.en: Does the washing machine bother you?

learner.hr: Da, prilično. Dok spavam, svaki me jači zvuk probudi.
learner.en: Yes, quite a lot. When I'm asleep, every louder sound wakes me.

partner.hr: Kad ti je najbolje vrijeme za odmor?
partner.en: When is the best time for you to rest?

learner.hr: Od osam do dva. Poslije možemo zajedno dogovoriti kućne poslove.
learner.en: From eight until two. Afterwards we can arrange the household chores together.

partner.en: Shall I switch off the radio too?

learner.hr: Molim te. Ili stavi slušalice, ne moraš sjediti u tišini.
learner.en: Please. Or use headphones; you don't have to sit in silence.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li mi javiti kad ustaneš?
partner.en: Will you let me know when you get up?

learner.hr: Hoću. Hvala ti što paziš na moje spavanje.
learner.en: Yes. Thank you for being considerate about my sleep.

conversations.title: A visitor mistakes an animal rescue for a zoo

partner.en: Why can't we stroke the wolf?

learner.hr: Ovo je utočište, ne mjesto za igru s divljim životinjama.
learner.en: This is a sanctuary, not a place to play with wild animals.

partner.en: But the wolf looks calm.

learner.hr: Izgled ne znači da je pitom. Čuvari znaju kako mu sigurno prići.
learner.en: Appearance doesn't mean he's tame. The keepers know how to approach him safely.

partner.hr: Hoće li se vratiti u prirodu?
partner.en: Will he return to the wild?

learner.hr: Vodič kaže da ovaj ne može jer je odrastao u zatočeništvu.
learner.en: The guide says this one can't because he grew up in captivity.

partner.en: What does he do here, then?

learner.hr: Ima zaštićen prostor i skrb. Posjetitelji uče zašto divlje životinje nisu kućni ljubimci.
learner.en: He has a protected space and care. Visitors learn why wild animals aren't pets.

partner.en: Can I at least take a photograph?

learner.hr: Možeš s označenog mjesta, bez bljeskalice i dozivanja životinje.
learner.en: You can from the marked spot, without a flash or calling to the animal.

conversations.title: A friend prepares for a funeral

partner.hr: Želiš li da idem s tobom?
partner.en: Would you like me to go with you?

learner.hr: Želim. Ovo mi je prvi pogreb bliske osobe i ne znam što očekivati.
learner.en: Yes. This is my first funeral for someone close to me, and I don't know what to expect.

partner.en: Do you know where we're meeting?

learner.hr: Ispred groblja, petnaest minuta prije obreda. Obitelj je zamolila da ne kasnimo.
learner.en: Outside the cemetery, fifteen minutes before the service. The family asked us not to be late.

partner.hr: Brine li te što reći obitelji?
partner.en: Are you worried about what to say to the family?

learner.hr: Da. Ne želim praznim riječima umanjiti njihovu tugu.
learner.en: Yes. I don't want empty words to diminish their grief.

partner.en: You can simply offer your condolences.

learner.hr: To ću i učiniti. Ako požele razgovarati, slušat ću.
learner.en: That's what I'll do. If they want to talk, I'll listen.

partner.en: Shall we take a short walk afterwards?

learner.hr: Hoćemo. Mislim da će mi trebati vremena da saberem misli.
learner.en: Yes. I think I'll need time to gather my thoughts.

conversations.title: A child asks why a fairy tale is frightening

partner.en: Why does the wizard live in darkness?

learner.hr: U toj priči tama stvara osjećaj opasnosti prije nego što ga upoznamo.
learner.en: In that story, darkness creates a sense of danger before we meet him.

partner.hr: Znači li to da je zao?
partner.en: Does that mean he's evil?

learner.hr: Ne nužno. Možda pisac želi da ga najprije pogrešno procijenimo.
learner.en: Not necessarily. Perhaps the writer wants us to misjudge him at first.

partner.hr: Ali pretvorio je ljude u kamen.
partner.en: But he turned people into stone.

learner.hr: Jest, to je okrutan čin. Zanima me hoće li pokušati ispraviti štetu.
learner.en: Yes, that's a cruel act. I'm interested to see whether he'll try to put the harm right.

partner.hr: Misliš li da će princeza razbiti čaroliju?
partner.en: Do you think the princess will break the spell?

learner.hr: Nadam se. Zasad jedina postavlja prava pitanja umjesto da slijedi glasine.
learner.en: I hope so. So far she's the only one asking the right questions instead of following rumours.

partner.hr: Hoćemo li pročitati još jedno poglavlje?
partner.en: Shall we read another chapter?

learner.hr: Hoćemo, a ako ti bude previše strašno, možemo stati.
learner.en: Yes, and if it gets too frightening for you, we can stop.

conversations.title: An old friend returns from abroad

partner.hr: Kako ti je opet živjeti ovdje?
partner.en: How does it feel to live here again?

learner.hr: Lijepo i čudno. Godinama sam govorio da ću se vratiti, a sad ne znam gdje pripadam.
learner.en: Lovely and strange. For years I said I'd return, and now I don't know where I belong.

partner.hr: Nisi li se tamo osjećao kao stranac?
partner.en: Didn't you feel like a foreigner there?

learner.hr: Jesam ponekad, ali tamo sam stekao prijatelje i navike.
learner.en: Sometimes, but I made friends and developed routines there.

partner.en: Do you miss them?

learner.hr: Jako. Čujemo se, ali razgovor na zaslonu nije isto što i zajednička večera.
learner.en: Very much. We keep in touch, but a conversation on a screen isn't the same as dinner together.

partner.en: Do you regret returning?

learner.hr: Nisam. Samo nisam očekivao da povratak također traži prilagodbu.
learner.en: No. I just didn't expect returning to require adjustment too.

partner.hr: Možemo polako obnoviti naše stare običaje.
partner.en: We can slowly revive our old routines.

learner.hr: Volio bih to. Krenimo od subotnje kave, bez velikih planova.
learner.en: I'd like that. Let's start with Saturday coffee, without grand plans.

conversations.title: A student changes a presentation after feedback

partner.en: Why are you redoing the slides?

learner.hr: Profesor je rekao da imam previše teksta, a premalo objašnjenja.
learner.en: The professor said I had too much text and too little explanation.

partner.en: Doesn't the text explain the topic?

learner.hr: Objašnjava, ali publika ne može istodobno čitati odlomke i slušati mene.
learner.en: It does, but the audience can't read paragraphs and listen to me at the same time.

partner.en: What will you change?

learner.hr: Ostavit ću glavne točke, a primjer ću objasniti usmeno.
learner.en: I'll leave the main points and explain an example aloud.

partner.en: Will you add pictures?

learner.hr: Samo ako pomažu razumijevanju. Ne želim ukrase bez svrhe.
learner.en: Only if they help understanding. I don't want decoration without a purpose.

partner.en: May I listen to a rehearsal?

learner.hr: Možeš. Zaustavi me ako govorim prebrzo ili preskočim važnu poveznicu.
learner.en: Yes. Stop me if I speak too fast or skip an important connection.

conversations.title: A birthday surprise clashes with a quiet preference

partner.en: Why did you cancel the big party?

learner.hr: Shvatila sam da je pripremam prema vlastitom ukusu, a ne prema njegovu.
learner.en: I realised I was preparing it to suit my taste rather than his.

partner.en: Doesn't he like surprises?

learner.hr: Ne voli biti u središtu pažnje, osobito pred velikom skupinom ljudi.
learner.en: He doesn't like being the centre of attention, especially in front of a large group.

partner.en: What will you organise, then?

learner.hr: Mirnu večeru s troje bliskih prijatelja, ako mu to odgovara.
learner.en: A quiet dinner with three close friends, if that suits him.

partner.en: Will you ask him beforehand?

learner.hr: Hoću. Njegov rođendan nije prilika da ostvarim svoju zamisao po svaku cijenu.
learner.en: Yes. His birthday isn't an opportunity for me to carry out my idea at any cost.

partner.en: So there won't be a big reveal?

learner.hr: Nema. Radije ću mu priuštiti ugodnu večer nego neugodno iznenađenje.
learner.en: No. I'd rather give him a pleasant evening than an uncomfortable surprise.

conversations.title: A couple chooses a wedding photographer

partner.hr: Zašto si odabrala baš tu fotografkinju?
partner.en: Why did you choose that photographer?

learner.hr: Sviđa mi se kako bilježi stvarne trenutke, bez stalnog namještanja ljudi.
learner.en: I like how she captures real moments without constantly arranging people.

partner.hr: Je li cijena u našem proračunu?
partner.en: Is the price within our budget?

learner.hr: Jest ako uzmemo kraći paket. Ne trebaju nam fotografije do zore.
learner.en: Yes, if we take the shorter package. We don't need photographs until dawn.

partner.en: What does the package include?

learner.hr: Dolazak prije obreda, grupne fotografije i nekoliko sati slavlja. Detalji su u ponudi.
learner.en: Arrival before the ceremony, group photographs and a few hours of the celebration. The details are in the offer.

partner.en: Do we need to pay in advance?

learner.hr: Dio iznosa, ali prvo ćemo pročitati ugovor i uvjete otkazivanja.
learner.en: Part of the amount, but first we'll read the contract and cancellation terms.

partner.en: Shall we confirm with her today?

learner.hr: Nakon što oboje pregledamo ponudu. Želim da odluka bude zajednička.
learner.en: After we both review the offer. I want the decision to be a joint one.

conversations.title: A farm visit has to fit feeding time

partner.hr: Hoćeš li sutra s nama na izlet?
partner.en: Will you come on the outing with us tomorrow?

learner.hr: Hoću, ako idemo na onu farmu kraj rijeke.
learner.en: Yes, if we're going to that farm by the river.

partner.en: What interests you most there?

learner.hr: Kako farma funkcionira kad nema posjetitelja. Sve životinje ipak treba nahraniti svaki dan.
learner.en: How the farm works when there are no visitors. All the animals still need feeding every day.

partner.hr: Domaćica kaže da možemo pomoći ujutro.
partner.en: The owner says we can help in the morning.

learner.hr: Onda nemojmo doći prekasno. Ne želim da zbog nas mijenja svoj raspored.
learner.en: Then let's not arrive too late. I don't want her to change her schedule because of us.

partner.en: Can we bring food for the animals?

learner.hr: Radije pitajmo što im inače daju. Ne bih im nosio ostatke našeg ručka.
learner.en: Let's ask what they usually feed them instead. I wouldn't bring them leftovers from our lunch.

partner.en: Shall we agree to leave at eight?

learner.hr: Može. Ponesimo i čizme, nakon kiše će sigurno biti blata.
learner.en: Yes. Let's bring boots too; there will surely be mud after the rain.

conversations.title: A reader finds a familiar name in an old magazine

partner.en: What did you find in the reading room?

learner.hr: Stari časopis s fotografijom moje ulice. Zgrade su gotovo iste.
learner.en: An old magazine with a photograph of my street. The buildings are almost the same.

partner.hr: Znaš li iz koje je godine?
partner.en: Do you know what year it's from?

learner.hr: S početka osamdesetih. Tražio sam novine iz tog razdoblja, a naišao na ovo.
learner.en: The early eighties. I was looking for newspapers from that period and came across this.

partner.hr: Zašto te zanima baš ta ulica?
partner.en: Why are you interested in that particular street?

learner.hr: Tamo je moj otac kao mladić radio u trgovini. Možda je i on na slici.
learner.en: My father worked in a shop there as a young man. Perhaps he's in the picture too.

partner.en: Can you borrow the magazine?

learner.hr: Ne mogu ga iznijeti, ali pitat ću smijem li fotografirati stranicu.
learner.en: I can't take it out, but I'll ask whether I may photograph the page.

partner.en: Will you show it to him?

learner.hr: Hoću. Možda prepozna nekoga i ispriča mi što se krije iza slike.
learner.en: Yes. Perhaps he'll recognise someone and tell me the story behind the picture.

conversations.title: Two friends choose a language course

partner.hr: Jesi li odabrala tečaj za jesen?
partner.en: Have you chosen a course for the autumn?

learner.hr: Još biram. Španjolski mi zvuči privlačno, ali zanima me i japanski.
learner.en: I'm still choosing. Spanish sounds appealing, but I'm also interested in Japanese.

partner.en: Why those two languages?

learner.hr: Na španjolskom već mogu nešto pročitati. Japanski bih morala učiti ispočetka.
learner.en: I can already read a little Spanish. I'd have to learn Japanese from scratch.

partner.en: Do you have time for both?

learner.hr: Nemam. Radije ću redovito učiti jedan nego stalno odustajati od dvaju.
learner.en: No. I'd rather study one regularly than keep giving up on two.

partner.hr: Što ti je važnije, putovanje ili čitanje?
partner.en: What matters more to you, travel or reading?

learner.hr: Putovanje zasad. Htjela bih sama naručiti ručak i razumjeti odgovor.
learner.en: Travel, for now. I'd like to order lunch myself and understand the reply.

partner.en: So the decision is almost made?

learner.hr: Izgleda da jest. Sad još moram pronaći grupu koja mi odgovara po rasporedu.
learner.en: It looks that way. Now I just need to find a group with a schedule that suits me.

conversations.title: A museum blacksmith lets visitors try a tool

partner.hr: Zašto nam daju tako male čekiće?
partner.en: Why are they giving us such small hammers?

learner.hr: Majstor kaže da je za prvi pokušaj važnija kontrola nego snaga.
learner.en: The craftsman says control matters more than strength for a first attempt.

partner.en: Will you go first?

learner.hr: Hoću, samo da vidim kako pravilno držati čekić.
learner.en: Yes, once I see how to hold the hammer properly.

partner.en: What are we actually making?

learner.hr: Malu kukicu za zid. Moj komad zasad izgleda kao savijena žlica.
learner.en: A little wall hook. My piece looks like a bent spoon so far.

partner.en: May I hold it with my hand?

learner.hr: Prvo pitaj majstora. Ne znam koliko je metal još vruć.
learner.en: Ask the craftsman first. I don't know how hot the metal still is.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li ponijeti svoj rad doma?
partner.en: Will you take your work home?

learner.hr: Hoću. Neće biti najljepši ukras, ali bit će moj.
learner.en: Yes. It won't be the prettiest decoration, but it'll be mine.

conversations.title: A guest discovers cat hair on a dark coat

partner.hr: Zašto četkaš kaput prije nego što sjedneš?
partner.en: Why are you brushing your coat before sitting down?

learner.hr: Na njemu su dlake. Sinoć sam čuvao prijateljičinu mačku.
learner.en: It has hair on it. I looked after a friend's cat last night.

partner.en: Didn't you know it sheds?

learner.hr: Znao sam, ali nisam očekivao da će mi kaput odabrati za krevet.
learner.en: I did, but I didn't expect it to choose my coat as a bed.

partner.en: Was it at least quiet?

learner.hr: Bila je dok sam čitao. Čim sam ugasio svjetlo, počela je juriti po stanu.
learner.en: It was while I was reading. As soon as I switched off the light, it started racing around the flat.

partner.en: Will you look after it again?

learner.hr: Hoću, samo ću drugi put zatvoriti ormar. Brže je to nego čistiti svu odjeću.
learner.en: Yes, I'll just close the wardrobe next time. That's quicker than cleaning all my clothes.

partner.en: I have a lint roller. Would you like it?

learner.hr: Molim te. Ne želim ostaviti dokaz mačjeg posjeta na tvojoj stolici.
learner.en: Please. I don't want to leave evidence of the cat's visit on your chair.

conversations.title: A retired sailor recognises a model ship

partner.en: Which model are you looking at so closely?

learner.hr: Ovaj s plavim trupom. Slični brodovi nekad su pristajali u našoj luci.
learner.en: This one with the blue hull. Similar ships used to dock at our port.

partner.en: Did you sail on one like that?

learner.hr: Jesam, ali naš je bio manji. Dobro pamtim te brodove i njihove uske kabine.
learner.en: Yes, but ours was smaller. I remember those ships and their narrow cabins well.

partner.en: Why does the model have a different flag?

learner.hr: Možda prikazuje kasnije razdoblje. Vlasnici su se mijenjali tijekom godina.
learner.en: Perhaps it depicts a later period. The owners changed over the years.

partner.en: Will you ask the maker?

learner.hr: Hoću. Zanima me odakle mu nacrti i koliko mu je trebalo za izradu.
learner.en: Yes. I'd like to know where he got the plans and how long it took to make.

partner.hr: Bi li i ti složio jedan?
partner.en: Would you build one too?

learner.hr: Možda manji. Za ovakav nemam ni dovoljno mjesta ni dovoljno strpljenja.
learner.en: Perhaps a smaller one. I don't have enough space or enough patience for one like this.

conversations.title: A dream keeps returning in different places

partner.hr: Zašto si jutros zapisivao čim si ustao?
partner.en: Why were you writing as soon as you got up this morning?

learner.hr: Pokušavam zapamtiti snove. Često sanjam istu kuću, ali nikad ista vrata.
learner.en: I'm trying to remember my dreams. I often dream of the same house, but never the same doors.

partner.hr: Je li to kuća koju poznaješ?
partner.en: Is it a house you know?

learner.hr: Djelomično. Moji snovi spajaju bakinu kuhinju i hodnik iz stare škole.
learner.en: Partly. My dreams combine my grandmother's kitchen and the corridor from my old school.

partner.en: Does it frighten you?

learner.hr: Ne, više me zbunjuje. U snu uvijek mislim da znam kamo idem.
learner.en: No, it confuses me more. In the dream I always think I know where I'm going.

partner.en: Are you looking for a meaning?

learner.hr: Zasad ne. Zanima me samo koliko brzo zaboravim detalje kad se razbudim.
learner.en: Not for now. I'm just interested in how quickly I forget the details when I wake up properly.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li od toga napisati priču?
partner.en: Will you turn it into a story?

learner.hr: Možda. Prvo želim skupiti dovoljno bilježaka da kuća prestane mijenjati katove.
learner.en: Maybe. First I want to gather enough notes for the house to stop changing its floors.

conversations.title: A neighbourhood story reaches the evening news

partner.hr: Zašto su kamere pred našom zgradom?
partner.en: Why are there cameras outside our building?

learner.hr: Novinari snimaju prilog o zajedničkom vrtu. Susjeda ih je pozvala.
learner.en: Journalists are filming a report about the community garden. A neighbour invited them.

partner.en: Will you speak on camera?

learner.hr: Radije ne bih. Mediji me malo zbunjuju, a tek sam se priključio vrtlarima.
learner.en: I'd rather not. I find dealing with the media a little confusing, and I've only just joined the gardeners.

partner.hr: Tko će onda objasniti kako je sve počelo?
partner.en: Who will explain how it all started, then?

learner.hr: Ona je vodila projekt od početka. Ima i fotografije prvih radova.
learner.en: She led the project from the beginning. She also has photographs of the first work.

partner.en: When will the report be shown?

learner.hr: Kažu večeras u vijestima, ako uspiju završiti montažu.
learner.en: They say on the news tonight, if they manage to finish editing it.

partner.en: Shall we watch it together?

learner.hr: Možemo. Samo nemoj snimati moj izraz lica ako ugledam sebe u pozadini.
learner.en: We can. Just don't film my expression if I spot myself in the background.

conversations.title: A flower brooch needs a different place

partner.en: What do you think of this decoration?

learner.hr: Cvijet je lijep, ali na toj haljini već ima mnogo detalja.
learner.en: The flower is lovely, but that dress already has lots of detail.

partner.en: Should I remove it, then?

learner.hr: Možda ga samo premjesti na kaput. Tamo će se bolje vidjeti.
learner.en: Perhaps just move it to the coat. It'll show up better there.

partner.hr: Hoće li ostati rupica od igle?
partner.en: Will the pin leave a little hole?

learner.hr: Nisam sigurna. Pogledaj s unutarnje strane prije nego što ga zakopčaš.
learner.en: I'm not sure. Look on the inside before fastening it.

partner.hr: Zašto ti se baš taj cvijet sviđa?
partner.en: Why do you like that particular flower?

learner.hr: Podsjeća me na onaj koji je mama nosila na vjenčanju. Sačuvala ga je godinama.
learner.en: It reminds me of the one Mum wore at her wedding. She kept it for years.

partner.en: Then I'm wearing it after all.

learner.hr: Nosi ga. Kad ukras ima priču, ne mora odgovarati svakom modnom pravilu.
learner.en: Wear it. When a decoration has a story, it doesn't have to follow every fashion rule.

conversations.title: A grandfather waits to meet a new baby

partner.en: Have you seen the little one yet?

learner.hr: Samo na fotografiji. Kći je jučer rodila, pa im ne želim odmah stvarati gužvu.
learner.en: Only in a photograph. My daughter gave birth yesterday, so I don't want to crowd them straight away.

partner.hr: Je li ti to prva unuka?
partner.en: Is she your first granddaughter?

learner.hr: Jest. Beba je, a već imam osjećaj da se cijela obitelj vrti oko nje.
learner.en: Yes. She's a baby, and I already feel as though the whole family revolves around her.

partner.en: Will you go over today?

learner.hr: Ako budu željeli posjet. Rekao sam da mogu samo ostaviti ručak pred vratima.
learner.en: If they want a visit. I said I could simply leave lunch at the door.

partner.en: What did you cook for them?

learner.hr: Juhu i nešto što mogu lako podgrijati. Sada im vjerojatno nije do kuhanja.
learner.en: Soup and something they can easily reheat. They probably don't feel like cooking right now.

partner.en: Can you hardly wait to hold her?
