learner.hr: Jedva. Ali mogu pričekati da se svi malo odmore.
learner.en: I can hardly wait. But I can wait until everyone has had a little rest.

conversations.title: A home recording captures the building works

partner.en: Why are you recording the song again?

learner.hr: Na snimci se čuje buka s ulice. Baš usred refrena počinje bušilica.
learner.en: You can hear noise from the street on the recording. A drill starts right in the middle of the chorus.

partner.en: Can you just turn it down?

learner.hr: Pokušao sam, ali onda promijenim i glasove. Zvučimo kao da pjevamo kroz jastuk.
learner.en: I tried, but then I change the voices too. We sound as though we're singing through a pillow.

partner.en: When do the workers finish?

learner.hr: Oko četiri. Pričekat ću pa ponovno snimiti taj dio.
learner.en: Around four. I'll wait and then record that part again.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li prepoznati gdje treba nastaviti?
partner.en: Will you know where to resume?

learner.hr: Hoću. Označio sam mjesto i sačuvao izvornu snimku.
learner.en: Yes. I've marked the place and kept the original recording.

partner.en: Can I help you?

learner.hr: Možeš poslušati završnu verziju. Nakon deset pokušaja više ne čujem vlastite pogreške.
learner.en: You can listen to the final version. After ten attempts I can no longer hear my own mistakes.

conversations.title: A rainbow appears after the picnic is packed

partner.en: Why have you taken your phone out again?

learner.hr: Iznad brda je duga. Pokušavam je uhvatiti prije nego što izblijedi.
learner.en: There's a rainbow above the hill. I'm trying to capture it before it fades.

partner.en: Aren't you afraid of the thunder?

learner.hr: Prije me ona munja pošteno prestrašila. Sad je oluja već daleko.
learner.en: That flash of lightning really frightened me earlier. Now the storm is far away.

partner.en: Shall we set the table again?

learner.hr: Ne bih. Trava je mokra, a sendviči su već u torbi.
learner.en: I'd rather not. The grass is wet, and the sandwiches are already in the bag.

partner.en: So we're eating at home today after all?

learner.hr: Da. Barem ne moramo prati deku koju smo jedva stigli spremiti.
learner.en: Yes. At least we don't have to wash the blanket we barely managed to pack away.

partner.en: Did you get the photograph?

learner.hr: Jesam, ali uživo je bilo ljepše. Na slici se jedva vidi druga duga.
learner.en: Yes, but it was lovelier in person. You can barely see the second rainbow in the picture.

conversations.title: An actor decides whether to audition

partner.hr: Hoćeš li se prijaviti za novu predstavu?
partner.en: Will you apply for the new play?

learner.hr: Razmišljam da odem na audiciju. Nisam glumio još od škole.
learner.en: I'm thinking of going to the audition. I haven't acted since school.

partner.en: Aren't they looking for professionals?

learner.hr: Ne, poziv je otvoren i početnicima. Traže nekoga za malu ulogu.
learner.en: No, the call is open to beginners too. They're looking for someone for a small role.

partner.en: What do you have to prepare?

learner.hr: Kratak monolog. Želim odabrati nešto što razumijem, ne samo dramatično vikati.
learner.en: A short monologue. I want to choose something I understand, not just shout dramatically.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li mi ga izvesti prije prijave?
partner.en: Will you perform it for me before applying?

learner.hr: Hoću, ako mi kažeš gdje zvučim neprirodno. Trebaju mi iskreni komentari.
learner.en: Yes, if you tell me where I sound unnatural. I need honest comments.

partner.en: When do we start rehearsing?

learner.hr: Sutra poslije večere. Večeras prvo moram naučiti tekst bez gledanja u papir.
learner.en: Tomorrow after dinner. Tonight I first need to learn the text without looking at the paper.

conversations.title: A flatmate loses the television remote

partner.en: Why are you sitting so close to the screen?

learner.hr: Daljinski je nestao, pa pokušavam promijeniti program na samom televizoru.
learner.en: The remote has disappeared, so I'm trying to change the channel on the television itself.

partner.en: Have you looked under the sofa?

learner.hr: Jesam. Našao sam olovku, tri novčića i nešto što ne želim dirati.
learner.en: Yes. I found a pencil, three coins and something I don't want to touch.

partner.hr: Možda je baterija prazna, a uređaj tu negdje?
partner.en: Perhaps the battery is flat and the device is somewhere nearby?

learner.hr: Možda, ali prvo trebam pronaći daljinski. Nova baterija ne pomaže ako ne znam gdje je.
learner.en: Perhaps, but first I need to find the remote. A new battery doesn't help if I don't know where it is.

partner.hr: Što ti je u džepu kućnog ogrtača?
partner.en: What's in your dressing-gown pocket?

learner.hr: Nemoj mi reći. Cijelo vrijeme nosim rješenje sa sobom.
learner.en: Don't tell me. I've been carrying the solution around with me the whole time.

partner.en: Does it work now?

learner.hr: Radi. Večeras ga ostavljam na stolu, daleko od svojih džepova.
learner.en: Yes. Tonight I'm leaving it on the table, far from my pockets.

conversations.title: A neighbour borrows a drill for one small shelf

partner.en: May I borrow the drill?

learner.hr: Možeš, ali nisam siguran jesam li vratio sve dijelove u kutiju.
learner.en: Yes, but I'm not sure whether I put all the parts back in the box.

partner.en: What might be missing?

learner.hr: Nastavak za zid. Jučer sam ga koristio dok sam uređivao garažu. U kutiji je ostalo dosta prašine.
learner.en: The masonry bit. I used it yesterday while tidying up the garage. There's quite a lot of dust left in the box.

partner.hr: Treba mi samo za dvije rupe.
partner.en: I only need it for two holes.

learner.hr: Onda pogledaj najprije kakav je zid. Ne odgovara svaki nastavak svakom materijalu.
learner.en: Then check what sort of wall it is first. Not every bit suits every material.

partner.en: Can you help me choose?

learner.hr: Mogu pogledati s tobom. Ako nismo sigurni, pitajmo majstora prije bušenja.
learner.en: I can look with you. If we're unsure, let's ask a tradesperson before drilling.

partner.en: When should I return the tool?

learner.hr: Kad završiš, samo stavi sve u istu kutiju. Ne želim opet tražiti dijelove po cijeloj kući.
learner.en: When you're done, just put everything in the same box. I don't want to search the whole house for the parts again.

conversations.title: A letter mentions an unfamiliar family profession

partner.en: What did you learn from the letter?

learner.hr: Da je pradjed bio inženjer. Uvijek sam mislio da je radio kao učitelj.
learner.en: That my great-grandfather was an engineer. I always thought he worked as a teacher.

partner.en: Does it say where he worked?

learner.hr: Na gradnji mosta. Spominje nacrte, radnike i vrijeme provedeno na terenu.
learner.en: On the construction of a bridge. He mentions plans, workers and time spent on site.

partner.en: Can we find that bridge?

learner.hr: Možda. U pismu nema imena, ali opisuje grad u dolini.
learner.en: Perhaps. The letter doesn't name it, but he describes a town in a valley.

partner.en: Will you ask your grandmother?

learner.hr: Hoću. Možda pamti nešto što se u obitelji više nije prepričavalo.
learner.en: Yes. Perhaps she remembers something the family stopped talking about.

partner.hr: Zašto ti je to toliko važno?
partner.en: Why does it matter so much to you?

learner.hr: Volio bih da iza njegova imena ostane nešto više od dviju godina na spomeniku.
learner.en: I'd like there to be more behind his name than two dates on a memorial.

conversations.title: A family avoids buying the same present twice

partner.en: Have you bought the present yet?

learner.hr: Nisam. Prvo provjeravam što ostali planiraju za godišnjicu.
learner.en: No. First I'm checking what the others are planning for the anniversary.

partner.en: Why don't you get that mirror?

learner.hr: Brat ga je već naručio. Ne želim da roditelji dobiju dva ista.
learner.en: My brother has already ordered it. I don't want our parents to get two identical ones.

partner.en: We could pay for their dinner.

learner.hr: Dobra ideja. Oni uvijek slave doma i rijetko izađu sami.
learner.en: Good idea. They always celebrate at home and rarely go out by themselves.

partner.hr: Treba li im odmah rezervirati stol?
partner.en: Should we book them a table straight away?

learner.hr: Radije neka sami izaberu datum. Dar ne bi trebao postati nova obveza.
learner.en: Better let them choose the date themselves. A present shouldn't become another obligation.

partner.en: Will you write the card?

learner.hr: Hoću. Ti pronađi omotnicu dovoljno veliku da u nju stanu svi naši potpisi.
learner.en: Yes. You find an envelope big enough for all our signatures.

conversations.title: A child counts the birds without counting one twice

partner.en: How many did you see?

learner.hr: Ne znam. Netko ih pokraj mene broji naglas, pa se zbunim čim prelete na drugo stablo.
learner.en: I don't know. Someone beside me is counting them aloud, so I get confused as soon as they fly to another tree.

partner.en: Would you like us to count together?

learner.hr: Hoću. Ti gledaj lijeve grane, a ja ću desne.
learner.en: Yes. You watch the branches on the left, and I'll watch those on the right.

partner.en: What if one changes sides?

learner.hr: Onda je nemojmo brojiti dvaput. Treba nam približan broj, ne savršen rezultat.
learner.en: Then let's not count it twice. We need an approximate number, not a perfect result.

partner.en: Can you see the one right at the top?

learner.hr: Vidim. Odande najbolje prati što rade ostale ptice.
learner.en: Yes. From there it has the best view of what the other birds are doing.

partner.en: Do we finally have a result?

learner.hr: Imamo, otprilike dvadeset. Zapisat ću da nisam sigurna za dvije iza lišća.
learner.en: Yes, about twenty. I'll note that I'm unsure about two behind the leaves.

conversations.title: A reading group disagrees about a rude character

partner.hr: Je li ti glavni lik simpatičan?
partner.en: Do you find the main character likeable?

learner.hr: Nije. Grub je prema svima, a pisac kao da očekuje da mu se divim.
learner.en: No. He's rude to everyone, and the writer seems to expect me to admire him.

partner.en: Perhaps he'll change by the end?

learner.hr: Nadam se. Zasad se ponaša kao da su svi ostali budale čim mu postave pitanje.
learner.en: I hope so. So far he acts as though everyone else is a fool as soon as they ask him a question.

partner.en: But he solves puzzles cleverly.

learner.hr: To priznajem. Samo ne mislim da inteligencija opravdava ponižavanje drugih.
learner.en: I admit that. I just don't think intelligence excuses humiliating other people.

partner.en: Will you finish the book anyway?

learner.hr: Hoću. Zanima me hoće li njegove riječi imati ikakve posljedice.
learner.en: Yes. I want to see whether his words will have any consequences.

partner.en: Shall we talk when we've both finished?

learner.hr: Može. Možda ti do tada primijetiš nešto što sam ja propustila.
learner.en: Yes. Perhaps by then you'll notice something I missed.

conversations.title: A friend admits being jealous of good news

partner.hr: Zašto si tako čudno reagirao na njegovu vijest?
partner.en: Why did you react so strangely to his news?

learner.hr: Bio sam ljubomoran. Nije mi drago to priznati, ali tako je.
learner.en: I was jealous. I'm not happy to admit it, but that's how it was.

partner.en: Because he got the job?

learner.hr: Da. I ja sam se prijavio, a nisam došao ni do razgovora.
learner.en: Yes. I applied too, and I didn't even get an interview.

partner.en: Did you congratulate him anyway?

learner.hr: Jesam, ali hladno. Želim mu se javiti i reći da nije kriv za moje razočaranje.
learner.en: Yes, but coldly. I want to contact him and say he isn't responsible for my disappointment.

partner.en: Do you think he'll understand?

learner.hr: Mislim da hoće ako sam iskren. Ne želim da se naša bliskost pretvori u nadmetanje.
learner.en: I think he will if I'm honest. I don't want our closeness to turn into competition.

partner.en: Will you call him today?

learner.hr: Hoću. Nije njegov uspjeh moj poraz, čak i ako mi je to danas teško osjetiti. Iza tog uspjeha stoji puno rada.
learner.en: Yes. His success isn't my defeat, even if I find it hard to feel that today. There's a lot of work behind that success.

conversations.title: A group chooses a flatter route for a walk

partner.en: Why aren't we going over the hill?

learner.hr: S nama ide moj stric. Teško hoda uzbrdo pa tražim ravniju stazu.
learner.en: My uncle is coming with us. He has difficulty walking uphill, so I'm looking for a flatter path.

partner.hr: Hoćemo li ga onda morati čekati?
partner.en: Will we have to wait for him, then?

learner.hr: Možda ćemo hodati sporije. Idemo se družiti, ne postavljati rekord.
learner.en: Perhaps we'll walk more slowly. We're going to spend time together, not set a record.

partner.hr: Što kaže na put uz jezero?
partner.en: What does he think of the lakeside path?

learner.hr: Sviđa mu se. Ima klupa i ne moramo završiti cijeli krug.
learner.en: He likes it. There are benches, and we don't have to complete the whole circuit.

partner.en: Shall I bring something for a break?

learner.hr: Ponesi vodu. Ja ću uzeti voće i provjeriti ima li tamo otvoren toalet.
learner.en: Bring water. I'll take fruit and check whether there's an open toilet there.

partner.en: When are we leaving?

learner.hr: Kad stric bude spreman. Ovaj put stvarno nema žurbe.
learner.en: When my uncle is ready. There really is no rush this time.

conversations.title: An amateur cook finally buys a proper apron

partner.en: Why did you buy an apron?

learner.hr: Uništio sam već tri majice umakom. Vrijeme je da zaštitim odjeću.
learner.en: I've already ruined three T-shirts with sauce. It's time to protect my clothes.

partner.en: Don't you have an old one at home?

learner.hr: Imam, ali remen je puknuo. Stalno je moram pridržavati jednom rukom.
learner.en: I do, but the strap broke. I have to keep holding it with one hand.

partner.en: You could have sewn it.

learner.hr: Mogao sam, i još ću ga popraviti. Ovu ću držati kao rezervnu.
learner.en: I could, and I'll still repair it. I'll keep this one as a spare.

partner.en: What are you cooking tonight?

learner.hr: Umak od rajčice. Očito nisam naučio iz prethodnih pokušaja.
learner.en: Tomato sauce. Clearly I haven't learned from the previous attempts.

partner.en: Will you at least turn the heat down?

learner.hr: Hoću. Manje prskanja i manje tragova na zidovima zvuči kao napredak.
learner.en: Yes. Less splashing and fewer marks on the walls sounds like progress.

conversations.title: A commuter practises driving a different car

partner.en: Why are you driving in circles around the car park?

learner.hr: Posudio sam sestrin auto. U mojem je sve na drugom mjestu.
learner.en: I've borrowed my sister's car. Everything is in a different place in mine.

partner.en: What confuses you most?

learner.hr: Mjenjač i širina auta. Želim se naviknuti prije nego što krenem u promet.
learner.en: The gear lever and the width of the car. I want to get used to it before joining traffic.

partner.hr: Trebaš li da sjednem s tobom?
partner.en: Do you need me to sit with you?

learner.hr: Možeš, ali nemoj me stalno požurivati. U ovom vozilu još tražim i brisače.
learner.en: You can, but don't keep rushing me. In this vehicle I'm still looking for the windscreen wipers.

partner.en: Have you adjusted the mirrors?

learner.hr: Jesam. Još ću provjeriti položaj sjedala pa možemo krenuti.
learner.en: Yes. I'll check the seat position once more, then we can go.

partner.en: Which way are you going?

learner.hr: Mirnijim ulicama. Nema potrebe da prvo iskustvo bude u najvećoj gužvi.
learner.en: Through quieter streets. There's no need for the first experience to be in the heaviest traffic.

conversations.title: A shopkeeper starts recognising a new regular

partner.hr: Zar ste opet došli po kruh?
partner.en: Have you come for bread again?

learner.hr: Jesam. Vaš dućan mi je usput pa svratim nakon posla.
learner.en: Yes. Your shop is on my way, so I drop in after work.

partner.hr: Mislio sam da ste samo u posjetu.
partner.en: I thought you were only visiting.

learner.hr: Tek sam se doselio. Još učim gdje je što u susjedstvu.
learner.en: I've only just moved here. I'm still learning where everything is in the neighbourhood.

partner.en: How do you like it so far?

learner.hr: Lijepo je kad me netko već prepozna. U velikoj trgovini osjećam se dosta anonimno.
learner.en: It's nice when someone already recognises me. In a large shop I feel fairly anonymous.

partner.en: Do you need anything else?

learner.hr: Trebam sapun, ako ga imate. Zaboravio sam ga staviti na popis.
learner.en: I need soap, if you have it. I forgot to put it on the list.

partner.en: On the lower shelf, by the till.

learner.hr: Vidim ga, hvala. Sutra ću se možda sjetiti svega prije nego što izađem iz kuće.
learner.en: I see it, thank you. Tomorrow perhaps I'll remember everything before leaving home.

conversations.title: A trial subscription is not as free as it looked

partner.en: Why are you checking that bill?

learner.hr: Mislio sam da je usluga besplatna. Ispalo je da je samo prvi mjesec besplatno.
learner.en: I thought the service was free. It turned out only the first month was free.

partner.hr: Jesi li pročitao uvjete kad si se prijavio?
partner.en: Did you read the terms when you signed up?

learner.hr: Nisam dovoljno pažljivo. Sad tražim kako otkazati pretplatu.
learner.en: Not carefully enough. Now I'm looking for how to cancel the subscription.

partner.hr: Možeš li to učiniti u aplikaciji?
partner.en: Can you do it in the app?

learner.hr: Izgleda da mogu na stranici računa. Želim provjeriti do kojeg datuma još imam pristup.
learner.en: It looks as though I can on the account page. I want to check until what date I still have access.

partner.en: Will you delete the app too?

learner.hr: Poslije. Brisanje aplikacije samo po sebi nije potvrda otkazivanja.
learner.en: Afterwards. Deleting the app by itself isn't confirmation of cancellation.

partner.en: Did you get confirmation?

learner.hr: Jesam, spremio sam poruku. Sljedeći put ću pročitati i sitna slova.
learner.en: Yes, I've saved the message. Next time I'll read the small print too.

conversations.title: A child asks a magician to repeat a trick

partner.hr: Zašto ga stalno gledaš u ruke?
partner.en: Why do you keep watching his hands?

learner.hr: Želim shvatiti trik. Novčić je bio ovdje, a sad je iza mog uha.
learner.en: I want to understand the trick. The coin was here, and now it's behind my ear.

partner.hr: Misliš li da je prava magija?
partner.en: Do you think it's real magic?

learner.hr: Ne znam. Ako nije, onda je jako dobro uvježbao pokrete.
learner.en: I don't know. If it isn't, he's practised the movements very well.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li ga pitati kako radi?
partner.en: Will you ask him how it works?

learner.hr: Hoću, ali možda ne želi otkriti sve trikove.
learner.en: Yes, but perhaps he doesn't want to reveal all his tricks.

partner.hr: Kaže da može pokazati jedan jednostavan.
partner.en: He says he can show you a simple one.

learner.hr: Odlično. Radije bih naučio jedan nego samo gledao deset drugih.
learner.en: Great. I'd rather learn one than just watch ten others.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li poslije nastupiti pred nama?
partner.en: Will you perform for us afterwards?

learner.hr: Hoću, čim naučim da mi novčić ne padne na pod usred nastupa.
learner.en: Yes, once I learn not to drop the coin on the floor in the middle of the performance.

conversations.title: A frozen lake looks safer than it feels

partner.en: Shall we cross the lake?

learner.hr: Ne bih. Ne znam koliko je led debeo.
learner.en: I'd rather not. I don't know how thick the ice is.

partner.en: But you can see tracks on it.

learner.hr: Vidim, ali tragovi mi ne govore je li danas sigurno hodati po ledu.
learner.en: I can, but tracks don't tell me whether it's safe to walk on the ice today.

partner.hr: Trebamo li onda obići cijelo jezero?
partner.en: Do we need to go all the way around the lake, then?

learner.hr: Trebamo. Možemo stati na čaj ako nam bude hladno.
learner.en: Yes. We can stop for tea if we get cold.

partner.hr: Žao ti je što smo ponijeli klizaljke?
partner.en: Are you sorry we brought the skates?

learner.hr: Malo, ali radije ću ih nositi bez razloga nego isprobavati sreću.
learner.en: A little, but I'd rather carry them for no reason than test my luck.

partner.en: Shall we go to the ice rink tomorrow?

learner.hr: Hoćemo. Tamo barem znam gdje mogu pitati za uvjete.
learner.en: Yes. At least there I know where I can ask about the conditions.

conversations.title: A child mistakes a ruin for a pile of stones

partner.en: Why have we come to look at stones?

learner.hr: To nisu samo slučajno složeni komadi. Ovdje su nekad živjeli Rimljani.
learner.en: These aren't just randomly arranged pieces. Romans once lived here.

partner.en: Where are the houses, then?

learner.hr: Ostali su temelji. Drevni grad ne izgleda uvijek kao slika iz udžbenika.
learner.en: The foundations remain. An ancient town doesn't always look like a textbook picture.

partner.hr: Kako znaju čemu je koja soba služila?
partner.en: How do they know what each room was used for?

learner.hr: Uspoređuju nalaze i raspored zidova. Neki zaključci su sigurniji od drugih.
learner.en: They compare finds and the layout of the walls. Some conclusions are more certain than others.

partner.en: May I take a little stone?

learner.hr: Ne bih uzimao ništa s nalazišta. Možemo kupiti razglednicu ili nacrtati što smo vidjeli.
learner.en: I wouldn't take anything from the site. We can buy a postcard or draw what we've seen.

partner.hr: Onda ću nacrtati kuću kakva je možda bila.
partner.en: Then I'll draw the house as it might have been.

learner.hr: Dobra ideja. Samo označi što si vidio, a što dodao iz mašte.
learner.en: Good idea. Just mark what you saw and what you added from your imagination.

conversations.title: A blunt knife ruins a tomato salad

partner.en: Why is the tomato so squashed?

learner.hr: Ovaj nož više ne reže kako treba. Moram ga prejako pritiskati.
learner.en: This knife no longer cuts properly. I have to press it too hard.

partner.en: Will you take another one?

learner.hr: Hoću. S ovim nožem ne mogu napraviti ni urednu krišku.
learner.en: Yes. With this knife I can't even make a neat slice.

partner.en: What shall we do with these pieces?

learner.hr: Stavit ćemo ih u umak. Za salatu ću narezati drugu rajčicu.
learner.en: We'll put them in the sauce. I'll slice another tomato for the salad.

partner.en: Should we sharpen the old knife?

learner.hr: Trebamo, ali danas ću ga ostaviti sa strane i koristiti drugi.
learner.en: Yes, but today I'll set it aside and use another one.

partner.en: Can I prepare the plates?

learner.hr: Možeš. Ovaj put salata stiže u kriškama, ne kao sok.
learner.en: Yes. This time the salad will arrive in slices rather than as juice.

conversations.title: A letter from the tax office waits unopened

partner.en: Why haven't you opened the letter?

learner.hr: Piše nešto o porezu, a bojim se da sam pogrešno ispunio obrazac.
learner.en: It says something about tax, and I'm afraid I filled in the form incorrectly.

partner.hr: Neće biti lakše ako ga ostaviš u ladici.
partner.en: It won't get easier if you leave it in the drawer.

learner.hr: Znam. Samo mi riječ porez odmah pokvari raspoloženje.
learner.en: I know. The word tax alone immediately spoils my mood.

partner.hr: Hoćemo li prvo pročitati što traže?
partner.en: Shall we first read what they want?

learner.hr: Hoćemo. Možda traže samo dopunu podataka, a ne novu uplatu.
learner.en: Yes. Perhaps they only want additional details, not another payment.

partner.en: Do you understand the calculation?

learner.hr: Ne sasvim. Zamolit ću službenika da mi objasni dio o obračunu poreza.
learner.en: Not entirely. I'll ask the clerk to explain the part about the tax calculation.

partner.hr: Je li sad barem malo lakše?
partner.en: Is it at least a little easier now?

learner.hr: Jest. Otvoreno pismo izgleda manje strašno od onoga što sam zamišljao.
learner.en: Yes. The opened letter looks less frightening than what I imagined.

conversations.title: A child loses a tooth during lunch

partner.en: Why did you stop chewing?

learner.hr: Ispao mi je zub. Nisam znala da se već toliko klimao.
learner.en: My tooth fell out. I didn't know it was already that loose.

partner.en: Did it stay on the plate?

learner.hr: Jest, pokraj kruha. Sad između zuba imam veliku rupu.
learner.en: Yes, beside the bread. Now I have a big gap between my teeth.

partner.en: Do you want to keep it?

learner.hr: Hoću. Samo ne znam gdje, da ga ne zamijenim s mrvicom.
learner.en: Yes. I just don't know where to put it so I don't mistake it for a crumb.

partner.en: I have a little box.

learner.hr: Može. Moji su zubi očito odlučili da ručak bude zanimljiviji.
learner.en: That will do. My teeth have apparently decided to make lunch more interesting.

partner.en: Shall we carry on eating?

learner.hr: Da, ali polako. Sad barem znam zašto mi je jabuka jutros smetala.
learner.en: Yes, but slowly. At least now I know why the apple bothered me this morning.

conversations.title: A pupil remembers homework after leaving school

partner.en: Why did you suddenly stop?

learner.hr: Zaboravio sam bilježnicu za domaći rad. Bez nje ne mogu napisati zadaću.
learner.en: I forgot my homework notebook. Without it I can't do the homework.

partner.en: Can you still go back?

learner.hr: Mogu ako učionica nije zaključana. Nastavnik je rekao da će još ostati.
learner.en: Yes, if the classroom isn't locked. The teacher said he'd stay a little longer.

partner.en: Why didn't you pack it straight away?

learner.hr: Razgovarao sam s prijateljem i mislio da je već u torbi.
learner.en: I was talking to a friend and thought it was already in my bag.

partner.en: Will you make the bus?

learner.hr: Možda neću. Radije ću pričekati sljedeći nego opet doći bez zadaće.
learner.en: Perhaps not. I'd rather wait for the next one than turn up without homework again.

partner.en: Would you like me to come with you?

learner.hr: Možeš. Ti me podsjeti da usput uzmem i jaknu s vješalice.
learner.en: You can. Remind me to take my jacket off the hook while we're there too.

conversations.title: A camping story lasts longer than the fire

partner.en: Why did you stop in the middle of the story?

learner.hr: Vatra se gasi. Gledao sam plamen i zaboravio što sam htio reći.
learner.en: The fire is dying down. I was watching the flame and forgot what I wanted to say.

partner.en: Shall I bring more wood?

learner.hr: Ne treba. Uskoro ćemo spavati, pa ne želim ponovno paliti vatru.
learner.en: No need. We'll be sleeping soon, so I don't want to light the fire again.

partner.hr: Ali još ne znamo kako priča završava.
partner.en: But we still don't know how the story ends.

learner.hr: Onda moram požuriti. Junak je ostao pred vratima, ako se dobro sjećam.
learner.en: Then I need to hurry. The hero was left outside the door, if I remember correctly.

partner.en: Shall I switch on the lamp?

learner.hr: Možeš, samo ne ravno u moje oči. Treba mi još trenutak da smislim kraj.
learner.en: Yes, just not straight into my eyes. I need another moment to come up with the ending.

partner.en: So you've been making it up all along?

learner.hr: Naravno. Da je priča iz knjige, već bismo odavno spavali.
learner.en: Of course. If the story were from a book, we'd have been asleep long ago.

conversations.title: A retiring librarian dislikes formal praise

partner.en: Why don't you want to give a speech?

learner.hr: Neugodno mi je kad me toliko hvale. Samo sam radio svoj posao.
learner.en: I feel awkward when they praise me so much. I was just doing my job.

partner.hr: Zar nije lijepo da ti zahvale?
partner.en: Isn't it nice that they thank you?

learner.hr: Jest, velika mi je čast. Samo ne želim da sve zvuči kao oproštaj zauvijek.
learner.en: It is, it's a great honour. I just don't want it all to sound like goodbye forever.

partner.hr: Pa dolazit ćeš i dalje po knjige.
partner.en: You'll still come in for books.

learner.hr: Upravo tako. Moje dužnosti prestaju, ali moje čitanje ne prestaje.
learner.en: Exactly. My duties are ending, but my reading isn't.

partner.en: What will you tell your colleagues, then?

learner.hr: Da sam zahvalan što smo godinama radili zajedno i da im ostavljam dobar aparat za kavu.
learner.en: That I'm grateful we worked together for years and that I'm leaving them a good coffee machine.

partner.hr: To zvuči dovoljno dobro za govor.
partner.en: That sounds good enough for a speech.

learner.hr: Možda imaš pravo. Kratko hvala bolje je od deset minuta skrivanja iza police.
learner.en: Perhaps you're right. A brief thank you is better than ten minutes hiding behind a shelf.

conversations.title: A muddy paw print appears on a new rug

partner.en: What's that dark stain?

learner.hr: Pas je prešao preko tepiha prije nego što sam mu obrisala šape.
learner.en: The dog walked across the rug before I wiped his paws.

partner.en: Didn't the rug arrive this morning?

learner.hr: Jest. Nije izdržao ni do večeri bez prvog otiska.
learner.en: Yes. It didn't even last until evening without its first print.

partner.en: Will you wash it straight away?

learner.hr: Prvo ću pogledati upute za čišćenje. Ne želim trljanjem napraviti još veći trag.
learner.en: First I'll check the cleaning instructions. I don't want to make a bigger mark by rubbing it.

partner.en: And what shall we do with the dog?

learner.hr: Ništa, nije znao da je tepih nov. Ručnik ću ostaviti bliže vratima.
learner.en: Nothing; he didn't know the rug was new. I'll leave the towel closer to the door.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li se uspjeti nasmijati tome?
partner.en: Will you manage to laugh about it?

learner.hr: Kasnije možda. Zasad on izgleda zadovoljnije od mene.
learner.en: Perhaps later. For now he looks more pleased than I do.

conversations.title: A sketch looks better before the colour is added

partner.en: Why did you stop colouring the drawing?

learner.hr: Sviđa mi se crno na bijelom. Bojim se da ću bojom izgubiti jednostavnost.
learner.en: I like the black on white. I'm afraid colour will make it lose its simplicity.

partner.en: Do you have to colour it at all?

learner.hr: Ne moram. Htjela sam samo naglasiti ovu crtu, ali sad već previše razmišljam.
learner.en: No. I just wanted to emphasise this line, but now I'm overthinking it.

partner.en: Can you try it on a copy?

learner.hr: Mogu. Na to nisam ni pomislila. Tako ću sačuvati izvornik.
learner.en: Yes. That hadn't even occurred to me. That way I'll keep the original.

partner.en: What will you add first?

learner.hr: Malo plave u pozadinu. Ako ne odgovara, barem znam što ne želim.
learner.en: A little blue in the background. If it doesn't work, at least I know what I don't want.

partner.en: Will you show both versions?

learner.hr: Hoću. Zanima me vidiš li istu razliku ili sam se ja samo vezala za prvi pokušaj.
learner.en: Yes. I want to know whether you see the same difference or whether I've simply become attached to the first attempt.

conversations.title: A nephew makes his first solo bus journey

partner.en: Who are you waiting for at the station?

learner.hr: Nećaka. Danas prvi put dolazi sam autobusom.
learner.en: My nephew. Today he's coming on the bus by himself for the first time.

partner.hr: Je li još mali za to?
partner.en: Is he still too young for that?

learner.hr: Nije, moj nećak već je viši od mene. Samo se meni čini da je još dijete.
learner.en: No, my nephew is already taller than I am. It just seems to me that he's still a child.

partner.en: Does he know where to get off?

learner.hr: Zna. Poslao sam mu fotografiju stanice i dogovorili smo gdje ću stajati.
learner.en: Yes. I sent him a photograph of the stop, and we agreed where I'll stand.

partner.hr: Zašto onda toliko gledaš na sat?
partner.en: Why do you keep looking at your watch, then?

learner.hr: Jer ja kasnim čak i kad čekam druge. Danas barem želim biti ovdje na vrijeme.
learner.en: Because I'm late even when waiting for others. Today I at least want to be here on time.

partner.en: Is this his bus?

learner.hr: Jest, već mi maše. Izgleda da sam se brinuo više nego on.
learner.en: Yes, he's already waving to me. It looks as though I worried more than he did.

conversations.title: A room colour changes after sunset

partner.en: Why are you looking at the paint samples again?

learner.hr: Zidovi su po danu izgledali toplije. Pod ovom lampom sve djeluje sivo.
learner.en: The walls looked warmer in daylight. Under this lamp everything looks grey.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li ponovno bojiti cijelu sobu?
partner.en: Will you repaint the whole room?

learner.hr: Neću odmah. Prvo ću staviti uzorke na različite zidove i gledati ih nekoliko dana.
learner.en: Not straight away. First I'll put samples on different walls and look at them for a few days.

partner.en: Perhaps the bulb is the problem?

learner.hr: Možda. I to želim provjeriti prije nego što kupim novu boju.
learner.en: Perhaps. I want to check that too before buying new paint.

partner.hr: Koja ti se zasad najviše sviđa?
partner.en: Which one do you like best so far?

learner.hr: Ona pokraj prozora, ali ne znam je li zbog boje ili zbog svjetla.
learner.en: The one by the window, but I don't know whether that's because of the colour or the light.

partner.en: So we're not painting anything tonight?

learner.hr: Ništa. Ovaj put ću odluku prespavati, a ne cijelu noć prati kistove.
learner.en: Nothing. This time I'll sleep on the decision rather than spend all night washing brushes.

conversations.title: A lakeside walk ends at the wrong picnic spot

partner.en: Why is nobody here?

learner.hr: Mislim da smo na pogrešnoj strani jezera. Na fotografiji se iza klupe vidi most.
learner.en: I think we're on the wrong side of the lake. In the photograph there's a bridge behind the bench.

partner.hr: Zar nisu rekli da se nalazimo na jezeru?
partner.en: Didn't they say we were meeting at the lake?

learner.hr: Jesu, ali jezero očito ima više od jedne klupe. Trebali smo pitati koju misle.
learner.en: Yes, but the lake clearly has more than one bench. We should have asked which one they meant.

partner.en: Can you call them?

learner.hr: Mogu. Neka mi pošalju položaj, to će biti brže od opisivanja stabala.
learner.en: Yes. Let them send me their location; that'll be quicker than describing trees.

partner.en: How long will it take us to reach them?

learner.hr: Petnaest minuta hoda. Ako krenemo sad, hrana će nas još dočekati.
learner.en: A fifteen-minute walk. If we leave now, there'll still be food waiting for us.

partner.en: Will you carry this bag?

learner.hr: Hoću. Barem smo dobili dužu šetnju nego što smo planirali.
learner.en: Yes. At least we got a longer walk than we planned.

conversations.title: A haircut photo hides the back of the head

partner.hr: Hoćeš li frizuru kao na fotografiji?
partner.en: Do you want a haircut like the one in the photo?

learner.hr: Sviđa mi se, ali slika pokazuje samo lice. Ne znam kako izgleda straga.
learner.en: I like it, but the picture only shows the face. I don't know what it looks like at the back.

partner.hr: Znaš li je li kosa slična tvojoj?
partner.en: Do you know whether the hair is similar to yours?

learner.hr: Nije. Moja kosa je valovita, a ovdje je gotovo ravna.
learner.en: It isn't. My hair is wavy, and here it's almost straight.

partner.hr: Što bi onda zadržala od ove ideje?
partner.en: What would you keep from this idea, then?

learner.hr: Duljinu oko lica. Frizura mi se zbog toga najviše i sviđa.
learner.en: The length around the face. That's what I like most about the hairstyle.

partner.hr: Želiš li svaki dan koristiti sušilo?
partner.en: Do you want to use a hairdryer every day?

learner.hr: Radije ne bih. Treba mi nešto što dobro izgleda i kad se kosa sama osuši.
learner.en: I'd rather not. I need something that looks good even when my hair dries on its own.

partner.hr: Da krenemo s malo dužom verzijom?
partner.en: Shall we start with a slightly longer version?

learner.hr: Može. Lakše ćemo skratiti još malo nego vratiti ono što smo odrezali.
learner.en: Yes. It'll be easier to cut a little more off than to put back what we've cut away.

conversations.title: A traveller boards a train going the other way

partner.en: Why are you looking at the map upside down?

learner.hr: Pokušavam shvatiti zašto putujemo na sjever, a naš je grad na jugu.
learner.en: I'm trying to understand why we're travelling north when our town is in the south.

partner.en: Are we on the wrong train?

learner.hr: Izgleda da jesmo. Broj perona bio je dobar, ali nisam provjerio smjer.
learner.en: It looks that way. The platform number was right, but I didn't check the direction.

partner.en: Can we get off straight away?

learner.hr: Na sljedećoj stanici. Prvo ću pitati konduktera kako se najlakše vratiti.
learner.en: At the next station. First I'll ask the conductor about the easiest way back.

partner.en: How late will we be?

learner.hr: Ne znam još. Javit ću obitelji da nas ne čeka s ručkom.
learner.en: I don't know yet. I'll tell the family not to wait for us with lunch.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li drugi put meni dati karte?
partner.en: Will you let me hold the tickets next time?

learner.hr: Hoću, ali pogledaj i ti kamo idemo. Dvoje ljudi može zajedno provjeriti jedan natpis.
learner.en: Yes, but you look where we're going too. Two people can check one sign together.

conversations.title: A sour cup of tea gets a gentler second attempt

partner.en: Why did you pull that face?

learner.hr: Dodao sam previše limuna. Htio sam nekoliko kapi, a stisnuo sam cijelu polovicu.
learner.en: I added too much lemon. I wanted a few drops and squeezed the whole half.

partner.en: Will you add honey?

learner.hr: Hoću, ali ovaj med ima jak okus. Ne želim njime prekriti sve ostalo.
learner.en: Yes, but this honey has a strong flavour. I don't want it to cover everything else.

partner.en: Shall I pour more tea?

learner.hr: To bi pomoglo. Podijelimo ovu šalicu u dvije pa dodajmo ostatak.
learner.en: That would help. Let's divide this cup between two and then add the rest.

partner.en: Is it better now?

learner.hr: Puno. Još uvijek se osjeti limun, ali više me ne tjera da se mrštim.
learner.en: Much better. I can still taste the lemon, but it no longer makes me pull a face.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li sljedeći put meni dati limun?
partner.en: Will you give me the lemon next time?

learner.hr: Možeš ga i ti stisnuti. Samo nemoj shvatiti moj prvi pokušaj kao recept.
learner.en: You can squeeze it too. Just don't take my first attempt as a recipe.

conversations.title: A path through the forest becomes quieter

partner.en: Why did you stop your bicycle?

learner.hr: Šuma je odjednom tiha. Htio sam malo poslušati prije nego što nastavimo.
learner.en: The forest has suddenly gone quiet. I wanted to listen for a while before we carry on.

partner.en: Can't you hear the birds?

learner.hr: Čujem, ali ne i cestu. Drveće ovdje zaklanja pogled i dio zvuka.
learner.en: I can, but not the road. The trees here block the view and some of the sound.

partner.en: Shall we take a break here?

learner.hr: Možemo, samo maknimo bicikle sa staze da drugi mogu proći.
learner.en: We can, just let's move the bicycles off the path so others can pass.

partner.en: Have you been here before?

learner.hr: Jesam zimi. Bez lišća mi je sve izgledalo mnogo otvorenije.
learner.en: Yes, in winter. Without the leaves, everything looked much more open to me.

partner.hr: Hoćemo li se vratiti i na jesen?
partner.en: Shall we come back in autumn too?

learner.hr: Hoćemo. Zanimljivo je koliko se isto mjesto promijeni, a put ostane isti.
learner.en: Yes. It's interesting how much the same place changes while the path stays the same.

conversations.title: A portrait session moves closer to a window

partner.en: Why are you moving the chair?

learner.hr: U ovom kutu nema dovoljno svjetlosti. Lice ti je gotovo u sjeni.
learner.en: There isn't enough light in this corner. Your face is almost in shadow.

partner.en: Will you switch on the ceiling light?

learner.hr: Radije bih prvo pokušala uz prozor. Izvana dolazi mekše svjetlo.
learner.en: I'd rather try by the window first. The light coming from outside is softer.

partner.hr: Moram li gledati ravno u tebe?
partner.en: Do I have to look straight at you?

learner.hr: Ne moraš. Pogledaj malo prema vratima pa ću usporediti dvije fotografije.
learner.en: No. Look slightly towards the door and I'll compare the two photographs.

partner.hr: Je li bolja ova uz prozor?
partner.en: Is the one by the window better?

learner.hr: Jest. Sad vidim izraz lica, a ne samo tamnu površinu.
learner.en: Yes. Now I can see your expression rather than just a dark surface.

partner.en: Shall we finish?

learner.hr: Još jednu, ako ti nije dosta. Ova mi se sviđa, ali uhvatila sam te usred treptaja.
learner.en: One more, if you haven't had enough. I like this one, but I caught you mid-blink.

conversations.title: A statue turns out to honour someone unexpected

partner.en: Is this monument to a king?

learner.hr: Na ploči piše da je posvećen liječniku. I ja sam mislio da je spomenik kralju.
learner.en: The plaque says it's dedicated to a doctor. I too thought the monument was to a king.

partner.hr: Zašto onda nosi tako svečanu odjeću?
partner.en: Why is he wearing such formal clothes, then?

learner.hr: I ljudi koji nisu kraljevi imali su svečane portrete. Trebali smo prvo pročitati natpis.
learner.en: People who weren't kings had formal portraits too. We should have read the inscription first.

partner.en: What did he do for the town?

learner.hr: Ovdje piše da je pomogao osnovati bolnicu. Ne navodi se mnogo detalja.
learner.en: It says here that he helped found a hospital. There aren't many details.

partner.en: Will you look for more information?

learner.hr: Hoću. Sad me zanima zašto prolazimo ovuda svaki dan, a nikad nismo pogledali ploču.
learner.en: Yes. Now I'm wondering why we pass here every day and have never looked at the plaque.

partner.en: We can ask at the museum.

learner.hr: Možemo. Tamo ćemo možda saznati i tko je izradio kip.
learner.en: We can. Perhaps there we'll also find out who made the statue.

conversations.title: A first radio interview runs out of time

partner.hr: Kako ti je bilo na radiju?
partner.en: How was being on the radio?

learner.hr: Bolje nego što sam očekivala. Samo nisam shvatila koliko brzo emisija prolazi.
learner.en: Better than I expected. I just didn't realise how quickly a programme goes by.

partner.en: Did you manage to say everything?

learner.hr: Nisam. Pripremila sam se za dugu priču, a intervju je trajao deset minuta.
learner.en: No. I prepared for a long story, and the interview lasted ten minutes.

partner.en: Did the host interrupt you?

learner.hr: Usmjeravao me pitanjima. Tek sad razumijem da je morao paziti na vrijeme.
learner.en: He guided me with questions. Only now do I understand that he had to watch the time.

partner.en: Can we listen to the programme anywhere?

learner.hr: Možemo. Poslat će mi poveznicu čim snimka bude dostupna.
learner.en: Yes. They'll send me a link as soon as the recording is available.

partner.en: Would you agree to be a guest again?

learner.hr: Bih. Drugi put ću izabrati tri glavne misli umjesto da pokušam ispričati cijelu godinu.
learner.en: I would. Next time I'll choose three main points instead of trying to describe a whole year.

conversations.title: A bell tower tour pauses before the bells ring

partner.hr: Zašto nas vodič zaustavlja na stepenicama?
partner.en: Why is the guide stopping us on the stairs?

learner.hr: Zvona će uskoro zazvoniti. Želi da pričekamo na nižoj razini.
learner.en: The bells will ring soon. He wants us to wait on a lower level.

partner.hr: Znaš li koliko je star toranj?
partner.en: Do you know how old the tower is?

learner.hr: Ne točno. Na ulazu piše da su ga dograđivali tijekom više stoljeća.
learner.en: Not exactly. At the entrance it says they added to it over several centuries.

partner.hr: Je li i najveće zvono toliko staro?
partner.en: Is the largest bell that old too?

learner.hr: Mislim da nije. Vodič je spomenuo zamjenu nakon oštećenja, ali nisam zapamtio godinu.
learner.en: I don't think so. The guide mentioned a replacement after damage, but I didn't remember the year.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li ga pitati kad se vratimo?
partner.en: Will you ask him when we get back?

learner.hr: Hoću. Radije ću pitati ponovno nego izmisliti podatak.
learner.en: Yes. I'd rather ask again than invent a fact.

partner.en: Can we go up now?

learner.hr: Izgleda da možemo. Pogled mora biti lijep kad smo već toliko stepenica prošli.
learner.en: It looks as though we can. The view must be lovely after all those stairs we've climbed.

conversations.title: A flatmate settles last month’s bill

partner.en: Why are you checking the payments?

learner.hr: Cimer mi još duguje dio za grijanje.
learner.en: My flatmate still owes me his share of the heating bill.

partner.en: Have you told him?

learner.hr: Jesam, ali možda je zaboravio iznos.
learner.en: Yes, but perhaps he's forgotten the amount.

partner.en: Will you remind him?

learner.hr: Hoću. Poslat ću mu račun, bez ljutnje.
learner.en: Yes. I'll send him the bill, without getting angry.

partner.en: What if he has no money now?

learner.hr: Možemo dogovoriti kasniju uplatu. Samo želim znati.
learner.en: We can agree on a later payment. I just want to know.

partner.en: Will you record expenses from now on?

learner.hr: Da, oboje trebamo vidjeti što je već plaćeno.
learner.en: Yes, we both need to see what's already been paid.

conversations.title: A babysitter meets a shy child

partner.en: Why is he hiding behind you?

learner.hr: Nova dadilja mu je još nepoznata.
learner.en: The new babysitter is still unfamiliar to him.

partner.en: Will you leave straight away?

learner.hr: Neću. Ostat ću dok se malo ne upoznaju.
learner.en: No. I'll stay until they get to know each other a little.

partner.en: What does he like doing?

learner.hr: Najlakše je doprijeti do djeteta kroz igru. Voli slagati vlakove.
learner.en: Play is the easiest way to connect with the child. He likes putting trains together.

partner.en: Shall I take out the box?

learner.hr: Možeš, ali pusti njega da pokaže gdje što ide.
learner.en: Yes, but let him show where everything goes.

partner.en: He's already explaining something to her.

learner.hr: Dobro. Sad mogu najaviti odlazak, bez skrivanja.
learner.en: Good. Now I can say I'm leaving, without sneaking away.

conversations.title: The washing finishes before the rain

partner.en: Why are you running to the balcony?

learner.hr: Rublje je gotovo suho, a kiša se približava.
learner.en: The laundry is almost dry, and rain is approaching.

partner.en: Do you need help?

learner.hr: Trebam. Plahte su spremne za spremanje, ručnici još nisu.
learner.en: Yes. The sheets are ready to put away; the towels aren't yet.

partner.en: Where should I put the towels?

learner.hr: Preko sušila unutra. Nemoj ih još slagati.
learner.en: Over the drying rack inside. Don't fold them yet.

partner.en: Have we brought everything in?

learner.hr: Još dvije čarape. Naravno da su na drugom kraju.
learner.en: Two more socks. Of course they're at the other end.

partner.en: We made it before the rain.

learner.hr: Jedva. Sad barem ne peremo sve ponovno.
learner.en: Barely. At least we aren't washing everything again now.

conversations.title: A bank branch has moved

partner.hr: Zašto si se vratio tako brzo?
partner.en: Why are you back so soon?

learner.hr: Došao sam do banke, a tamo je pekarnica.
learner.en: I got to the bank, and there's a bakery there.

partner.hr: Preselili su se prije mjesec dana.
partner.en: They moved a month ago.

learner.hr: Očito dugo nisam išao u banku. Gdje su sad?
learner.en: Clearly I haven't been to the bank for a while. Where are they now?

partner.en: Opposite the library.

learner.hr: Onda sam ih prošao usput, a nisam primijetio.
learner.en: Then I passed them on the way without noticing.

partner.en: Do you really need to go in person?

learner.hr: Trebam preuzeti dokument. Rekli su da me čeka.
learner.en: I need to collect a document. They said it's waiting for me.

partner.en: Did you at least buy bread?

learner.hr: Jesam. Pogrešna adresa ipak je bila korisna.
learner.en: Yes. The wrong address was useful after all.

conversations.title: A shaved beard reveals an old scar

partner.en: What's that beneath your chin?

learner.hr: Ožiljak. Godinama ga nisam vidio ovako jasno.
learner.en: A scar. I haven't seen it this clearly for years.

partner.en: How did you get it?

learner.hr: Pao sam s bicikla kao dječak.
learner.en: I fell off a bicycle as a boy.

partner.en: Is that why you grew a beard?

learner.hr: Ne, nego mi je dosadilo svakodnevno brijanje.
learner.en: No, I was tired of shaving every day.

partner.en: Will you grow it again?

learner.hr: Možda. Zasad se vlastitom odrazu još čudim.
learner.en: Maybe. For now I'm still surprised by my own reflection.

partner.en: I can hardly recognise you.

learner.hr: Ni ja se još nisam naviknuo. Trebat će mi koji dan.
learner.en: I haven't got used to it either. I'll need a few days.

conversations.title: A beginner chooses the gentler ski slope

partner.en: Are you coming up with us?

learner.hr: Ne još. Ovaj spust mi izgleda strašan.
learner.en: Not yet. This descent looks frightening to me.

partner.en: You can just have a look.

learner.hr: Znam, ali ne želim se praviti hrabar pred vama.
learner.en: I know, but I don't want to pretend to be brave in front of you.

partner.en: What would you prefer?

learner.hr: Vježbao bih ovdje. I to mi je dovoljno uzbudljivo.
learner.en: I'd practise here. That's exciting enough for me too.

partner.en: Shall I stay for another run?

learner.hr: Možeš. Nije mi lako priznati da nisam spreman, ali i to može biti hrabro.
learner.en: Yes. It isn't easy to admit I'm not ready, but that can be brave too.

partner.en: Shall we meet later, then?

learner.hr: Vidimo se. Ja ću do tada možda naučiti bolje stati.
learner.en: Yes. By then perhaps I'll have learned to stop better.

conversations.title: An evening walk follows an unfamiliar sound

partner.en: Why are we taking this street?

learner.hr: Jučer sam ovuda hodao i čuo glazbu iz dvorišta.
learner.en: I walked this way yesterday and heard music from a courtyard.

partner.en: Do you know whose house it is?

learner.hr: Ne znam. Nadam se da je bio javni nastup.
learner.en: No. I hope it was a public performance.

partner.en: Perhaps someone was just practising.

learner.hr: Moguće. Nećemo ulaziti bez poziva.
learner.en: Possibly. We won't go in without an invitation.

partner.en: There's a poster on the gate.

learner.hr: Piše da sviraju petkom. Danas smo zakasnili cijeli dan.
learner.en: It says they play on Fridays. Today we're a whole day late.

partner.en: Shall we come next Friday?

learner.hr: Hoćemo. Ovaj put barem znamo pravi termin.
learner.en: Yes. This time at least we know the right time.

conversations.title: A pottery mug has an oversized handle

partner.en: Is this really a cup?

learner.hr: Jest. Ručka je ispala veća od ostatka.
learner.en: Yes. The handle turned out bigger than the rest.

partner.en: Can you drink from it?

learner.hr: Može. Ima dvostruki sloj gline oko ručke, pa je malo teža.
learner.en: Yes. It has a double layer of clay around the handle, so it's a little heavier.

partner.en: Will you remake it?

learner.hr: Ne znam. U njezinu obliku ima nešto zabavno.
learner.en: I don't know. There's something amusing about its shape.

partner.hr: Meni se sviđa što nije savršena.
partner.en: I like that it isn't perfect.

learner.hr: I meni. Nisam išao na radionicu da napravim tvornički proizvod.
learner.en: So do I. I didn't go to the workshop to make a factory product.

partner.en: Who will you give it to?

learner.hr: Sebi. Samo ja znam koliko je pokušaja preživjela.
learner.en: Myself. Only I know how many attempts it survived.

conversations.title: A community notice uses too many abbreviations

partner.en: Do you understand this notice?

learner.hr: Polovicu. Kao da je napisana za članove nekog tajnog društva.
learner.en: Half of it. It's as though it's written for members of a secret society.

partner.en: What isn't clear?

learner.hr: Značenje ovih kratica. Ne znam komu se trebam javiti.
learner.en: The meaning of these abbreviations. I don't know whom I should contact.

partner.en: We can ask the organiser.

learner.hr: Možemo. Zamolit ću ga da napiše puna imena službi.
learner.en: We can. I'll ask him to write the departments' full names.

partner.hr: Možda je prostor na plakatu malen.
partner.en: Perhaps there's little space on the poster.

learner.hr: Jest, ali svrha je da ljudi razumiju poziv.
learner.en: There is, but the purpose is for people to understand the invitation.

partner.en: Will you send him a suggestion?

learner.hr: Hoću, uz pitanje jesam li uopće dobro shvatio datum.
learner.en: Yes, together with a question about whether I even understood the date correctly.

conversations.title: A child keeps the shell but leaves the crab

partner.en: Can I take this shell?

learner.hr: Pogledaj prvo krije li se netko unutra.
learner.en: First check whether someone is hiding inside.

partner.en: I think something moved.

learner.hr: Onda je ostavimo. Nekome je očito dom.
learner.en: Then let's leave it. It's clearly somebody's home.

partner.en: What about this empty one?

learner.hr: Pitajmo smije li se skupljati ovdje. Ovo je zaštićeno područje.
learner.en: Let's ask whether collecting is allowed here. This is a protected area.

partner.en: May I at least draw it?

learner.hr: Naravno. Tako ti ostaje uspomena bez oduzimanja tuđeg skloništa.
learner.en: Of course. That way you keep a memory without taking somebody else's shelter.

partner.en: The crab has come out again.

learner.hr: Vidiš, rak sad može nastaviti tražiti hranu. Ne trebamo ga ometati.
learner.en: You see, the crab can look for food again now. We don't need to disturb it.

conversations.title: A football team changes its plan at half-time

partner.en: Why are you playing closer to the goal today?

learner.hr: Obrana nam je slabija jer dvojica nisu došla.
learner.en: Our defence is weaker because two people didn't turn up.

partner.en: So you won't attack?

learner.hr: Hoću kad mogu, ali prvo moram pratiti put lopte.
learner.en: I will when I can, but first I need to track the ball.

partner.en: Does the change bother you?

learner.hr: Malo. Navikao sam trčati naprijed bez mnogo razmišljanja.
learner.en: A little. I'm used to running forward without much thought.

partner.en: What did the coach say?

learner.hr: Da igramo kao skupina, ne kao jedanaest zasebnih planova.
learner.en: To play as a group, not as eleven separate plans.

partner.en: Will you hold out?

learner.hr: Pokušat ćemo. Još imamo cijelo drugo poluvrijeme.
learner.en: We'll try. We still have the whole second half.

conversations.title: A festival visitor stays for unfamiliar songs

partner.en: Do you understand the song's words?

learner.hr: Ne, ali kultura nije samo ono što odmah razumijem.
learner.en: No, but culture isn't only what I understand immediately.

partner.en: Will you stay anyway?

learner.hr: Hoću. Zvuk jezika me zanima i bez prijevoda.
learner.en: Yes. I'm interested in the sound of the language even without translation.

partner.en: We can read the programme.

learner.hr: Dobra ideja. Možda piše o čemu pjevaju.
learner.en: Good idea. Perhaps it says what they're singing about.

partner.hr: Ova pjesma govori o odlasku iz sela.
partner.en: This song is about leaving a village.

learner.hr: Sad razumijem zašto je publika utihnula.
learner.en: Now I understand why the audience fell silent.

partner.en: Shall we move on afterwards?

learner.hr: Ostanimo još jednu. Počeo sam prepoznavati refren.
learner.en: Let's stay for one more. I've started recognising the chorus.

conversations.title: A child counts change for the first time

partner.en: Why have you separated all the coins?

learner.hr: Želim sam provjeriti koliko imam novaca.
learner.en: I want to check how much money I have myself.

partner.en: How much more do you need?

learner.hr: Malo, ali još miješam vrijednosti različitih kovanica.
learner.en: A little, but I still mix up the values of different coins.

partner.en: Shall we count together?

learner.hr: Hoću. Ti pokaži, a ja ću zbrajati.
learner.en: Yes. You point, and I'll add them up.

partner.en: Now you have the exact amount.

learner.hr: Onda ću novce spremiti odvojeno, da ih opet ne pomiješam.
learner.en: Then I'll keep the money separate so I don't mix it up again.

partner.en: Ready to make the purchase?

learner.hr: Jesam. Danas barem znam zašto vraćaju ostatak.
learner.en: Yes. Today at least I understand why they give change back.

conversations.title: A neighbour’s bicycle disappears from the courtyard

partner.en: Why is everyone watching the footage?

learner.hr: Susjedu je ukraden bicikl iz zajedničkog dvorišta.
learner.en: Our neighbour's bicycle was stolen from the shared courtyard.

partner.hr: Zna li se tko ga je odnio?
partner.en: Do they know who took it?

learner.hr: Ne. Krađa se dogodila dok su vrata bila otvorena.
learner.en: No. The theft happened while the gate was open.

partner.en: Did anyone see anything?

learner.hr: Jedna stanarka pamti kombi, ali ne registraciju.
learner.en: One resident remembers a van, but not the registration number.

partner.en: What are you doing now?

learner.hr: Predali smo ono što znamo policiji. Nećemo sami optuživati prolaznike.
learner.en: We've told the police what we know. We won't accuse passers-by ourselves.

partner.en: Will you close the gate more carefully?

learner.hr: Hoćemo, ali prvo želimo pomoći susjedu pronaći podatke o biciklu.
learner.en: Yes, but first we want to help our neighbour find the bicycle's details.

conversations.title: A student misses a laboratory session

partner.en: Why are you looking for the professor?

learner.hr: Propustila sam laboratorij zbog bolesti. Trebam dogovoriti nadoknadu.
learner.en: I missed the lab because I was ill. I need to arrange a replacement session.

partner.hr: Ima li još mjesta ovaj tjedan?
partner.en: Is there space this week?

learner.hr: Ne znam. Raspored laboratorija mijenja se zbog radova.
learner.en: I don't know. The laboratory schedule is changing because of building work.

partner.en: Will you send a message?

learner.hr: Hoću. Navest ću grupu i vježbu koju nisam odradila.
learner.en: Yes. I'll state my group and the practical I missed.

partner.en: Can you just copy the results?

learner.hr: Ne, trebam sama napraviti mjerenje i razumjeti postupak.
learner.en: No, I need to take the measurement myself and understand the procedure.

partner.en: Let me know if you need notes.

learner.hr: Hvala. Bilješke će pomoći, ali neće zamijeniti vježbu.
learner.en: Thank you. Notes will help, but they won't replace the practical.

conversations.title: A cook forgets which bowl contains sugar

partner.en: Why are you tasting from both containers?

learner.hr: Jedna je sol, druga šećer. Maknuo sam oznake.
learner.en: One has salt, the other sugar. I removed the labels.

partner.hr: Kako sad znaš koja je koja?
partner.en: How do you know which is which now?

learner.hr: Sad znam, ali bolje je da ih odmah ponovno označim.
learner.en: I know now, but I'd better label them again immediately.

partner.en: Shall I write the labels?

learner.hr: Možeš. Samo neka slova budu dovoljno velika.
learner.en: Yes. Just make the letters big enough.

partner.hr: Što bi bilo da si zamijenio sastojke?
partner.en: What if you'd mixed up the ingredients?

learner.hr: Kolač bi bio slan, a ja jako razočaran.
learner.en: The cake would be salty, and I'd be very disappointed.

partner.en: Have we saved dinner?

learner.hr: Desert jesmo. Za ostatak još nemoj biti previše uvjeren.
learner.en: The dessert, yes. Don't be too confident about the rest yet.

conversations.title: An older neighbour learns to send a voice message

partner.hr: Zašto govoriš telefonu, a ne zoveš?
partner.en: Why are you talking to the phone rather than calling?

learner.hr: Učim snimiti poruku kad mi tipkanje umori prste.
learner.en: I'm learning to record a message when typing tires my fingers.

partner.en: Are you holding the right button?

learner.hr: Mislim da da. Samo ne znam kada da ga pustim.
learner.en: I think so. I just don't know when to let go.

partner.en: Let go when you're finished.

learner.hr: Dobro. Sad mi pokaži kako da poruku prvo poslušam.
learner.en: All right. Now show me how to listen to the message first.

partner.en: Can you see the little arrow?

learner.hr: Vidim, ali slušalicu sam tražio na pogrešnom mjestu.
learner.en: Yes, but I was looking for the earpiece in the wrong place.

partner.en: Would you like to try again?

learner.hr: Želim. Unuka će danas dobiti cijeli mali govor.
learner.en: Yes. My granddaughter will get a whole little speech today.

conversations.title: A painted bird feeder attracts a squirrel

partner.hr: Zašto si kameru okrenula prema stablu?
partner.en: Why did you turn the camera towards the tree?

learner.hr: Netko uzima hranu iz kućice za ptice. Hrana je očito mamac i za druge životinje.
learner.en: Someone is taking food from the bird feeder. The food clearly attracts other animals too.

partner.en: Do you think it's a cat?

learner.hr: Ne. Vidjela sam rep, ali nije bio mačji.
learner.en: No. I saw a tail, but it wasn't a cat's.

partner.en: There's a squirrel on the fence.

learner.hr: To je ona. Preko grane je pronašla lakši pristup.
learner.en: That's her. She found an easier route across the branch.

partner.en: Will you move the feeder?

learner.hr: Pokušat ću. Ne bih stavljala mrežu da se životinje ne zapletu.
learner.en: I'll try. I wouldn't put up netting, in case animals get tangled in it.

partner.en: What if the squirrel returns?

learner.hr: Onda ću priznati da ima bolji plan od mojega.
learner.en: Then I'll admit she has a better plan than mine.

conversations.title: A school play needs a quieter villain

partner.hr: Zašto više ne vičeš u toj sceni?
partner.en: Why don't you shout in that scene anymore?

learner.hr: Redatelj kaže da zli lik može biti opasan i tih.
learner.en: The director says an evil character can be dangerous and quiet too.

partner.hr: Je li ti tako teže glumiti?
partner.en: Is it harder for you to act that way?

learner.hr: Jest. Glas mi je prije skrivao nesigurnost.
learner.en: Yes. My voice used to hide my uncertainty.

partner.en: What are you trying now?

learner.hr: Gledam partnera ravno u oči i čekam prije odgovora.
learner.en: I look my partner straight in the eyes and wait before answering.

partner.en: Does it seem scarier to the audience?

learner.hr: Na probi su svi utihnuli. To mi je bio dobar znak.
learner.en: Everyone went quiet in rehearsal. That was a good sign to me.

partner.en: Will you keep that approach?

learner.hr: Hoću. Manje vikanja, a više stvarnog slušanja.
learner.en: Yes. Less shouting and more real listening.

conversations.title: A guest is unsure how formally to dress

partner.en: Do I have to wear a tie?

learner.hr: Poziv ne kaže. Ja ću obući jednostavnu košulju.
learner.en: The invitation doesn't say. I'll put on a plain shirt.

partner.hr: A ako svi budu jako svečani?
partner.en: What if everyone is very dressed up?

learner.hr: Onda ćemo biti nešto manje svečani, ništa strašno.
learner.en: Then we'll be a little less dressed up, nothing terrible.

partner.en: I don't want to offend the host.

learner.hr: Pitaj ga kakvu odjeću očekuje. Nagađanje traje dulje od poruke.
learner.en: Ask him what clothes he expects. Guessing takes longer than a message.

partner.en: He says it's a relaxed dinner.

learner.hr: Eto. Ne treba ti ni posebna frizura ni posuđeno odijelo.
learner.en: There you go. You don't need a special hairstyle or a borrowed suit.

partner.en: Then I'll go like this after all.

learner.hr: Idi. Važnije je da stigneš nego da nas kravata zadrži doma.
learner.en: Do. Arriving matters more than a tie keeping us at home.

conversations.title: Full recycling bins delay a hallway clear-out

partner.hr: Zašto su vreće još u hodniku?
partner.en: Why are the bags still in the hallway?

learner.hr: Spremnici su puni. Ne želim ih ostaviti pokraj njih.
learner.en: The containers are full. I don't want to leave them beside them.

partner.hr: Jesu li sve vreće za papir?
partner.en: Are all the bags for paper?

learner.hr: Nisu, ove dvije su pune odjeće za darivanje.
learner.en: No, these two are full of clothes to donate.

partner.en: Do you know when they collect the paper?

learner.hr: Sutra ujutro. Do tada mogu sve odmaknuti od prolaza.
learner.en: Tomorrow morning. Until then I can move everything away from the passage.

partner.en: Will you take the clothes today?

learner.hr: Hoću ako mjesto za prikupljanje još radi.
learner.en: Yes, if the collection point is still open.

partner.en: Shall I check the opening hours?

learner.hr: Molim te. Hodnik će nam biti zahvalan.
learner.en: Please. Our hallway will be grateful.

conversations.title: A chess clock makes a familiar game feel different

partner.en: Why are you moving the pieces so quickly?

learner.hr: Na satu mi je ostalo manje od minute.
learner.en: I have less than a minute left on the clock.

partner.en: Didn't we agree on a relaxed game?

learner.hr: Jesmo. Dodali smo sat i zaboravili što znači opušteno.
learner.en: We did. We added a clock and forgot what relaxed means.

partner.en: Shall we stop it?

learner.hr: Hoćemo. Sad brojim sekunde umjesto da gledam ploču.
learner.en: Yes. Now I'm counting seconds instead of looking at the board.

partner.en: Would you like to carry on from here?

learner.hr: Želim. Napokon ću razmisliti prije nego izgubim još jednu figuru.
learner.en: Yes. I'll finally think before losing another piece.

partner.en: Without the clock next time?

learner.hr: Bez sata. Vrijeme ćemo mjeriti praznim šalicama.
learner.en: Without it. We'll measure time by empty cups.

conversations.title: A portrait painter gets colour on her face

partner.en: Why are you laughing at my picture?

learner.hr: Ne smijem se slici. Imaš plavi obraz.
learner.en: I'm not laughing at the picture. Your cheek is blue.

partner.en: How did I manage that?

learner.hr: Valjda si se naslonila na ruku punu boje.
learner.en: Perhaps you leaned on a hand covered in paint.

partner.en: Is there any elsewhere?

learner.hr: Pod nosom je zelena crta. Izgleda namjerno.
learner.en: There's a green line under your nose. It looks deliberate.

partner.en: Will you bring me a mirror?

learner.hr: Hoću, ali nemoj ga uzeti istom rukom.
learner.en: Yes, but don't take it with that same hand.

partner.hr: Sad sam i ja dio slike.
partner.en: Now I'm part of the picture too.

learner.hr: Jesi. Samo tebe možemo oprati prije izložbe.
learner.en: You are. Only we can wash you before the exhibition.

conversations.title: A family soup tastes different without meat

partner.en: Why is the soup different today?

learner.hr: Mama kuha bez mesa jer nam dolazi prijatelj vegetarijanac.
learner.en: Mum is cooking without meat because a vegetarian friend is coming.

partner.en: Will it lack something?

learner.hr: Meni zasad ne. Probaj prije nego što odlučiš.
learner.en: Not to me so far. Try it before deciding.

partner.en: It really is tasty.

learner.hr: Vidiš. Dodala je pečeno povrće da okus bude puniji.
learner.en: You see. She added roasted vegetables for a fuller flavour.

partner.hr: Zna li prijatelj da mislimo na njega?
partner.en: Does our friend know we're thinking of him?

learner.hr: Zna, pitali smo ga što mu odgovara.
learner.en: Yes, we asked him what suits him.

partner.en: Then can I have another bowl?

learner.hr: Možeš, samo ostavi nešto i gostu.
learner.en: Yes, just leave some for the guest too.

conversations.title: A crime-series recap skips an important hearing

partner.hr: Zašto je on opet u zatvoru?
partner.en: Why is he in prison again?

learner.hr: Ne znam. U prošloj epizodi bio je samo optužen.
learner.en: I don't know. In the last episode he had only been accused.

partner.en: Perhaps we skipped an episode?

learner.hr: Možda. Sad govore da je već osuđen.
learner.en: Perhaps. Now they're saying he's already been convicted.

partner.en: What number is on the screen?

learner.hr: Sedam. Mi smo jučer završili petu.
learner.en: Seven. We finished the fifth yesterday.

partner.en: Then we're missing the sixth.

learner.hr: Tako je. Zato mi se činilo da svi znaju nešto osim nas.
learner.en: Exactly. That's why it felt as though everyone knew something except us.

partner.en: Shall we go back?

learner.hr: Da, prije nego saznamo i tko je pravi krivac.
learner.en: Yes, before we also find out who really did it.

conversations.title: A volunteer cannot find the storeroom key

partner.en: Why aren't the tables outside yet?

learner.hr: Ne mogu naći ključ skladišta.
learner.en: I can't find the storeroom key.

partner.en: Who had it last?

learner.hr: Ja. Preuzeo sam čuvanje opreme nakon prošle priredbe.
learner.en: Me. I took over looking after the equipment after the last event.

partner.en: Have you looked among the receipts?

learner.hr: Nisam. Tamo sam spremio i popis stvari.
learner.en: No. That's where I put the inventory too.

partner.en: Here it is in the envelope.

learner.hr: Dobro da nisam već zvao sve bivše volontere.
learner.en: Good thing I hadn't already called all the former volunteers.

partner.en: Shall we make a label?

learner.hr: Hoćemo, i dogovoriti jedno mjesto za ključeve.
learner.en: Yes, and agree on one place for the keys.

conversations.title: A customer wants a haircut that still fits a helmet

partner.en: What change would you like?

learner.hr: Kraću frizuru, ali moram i dalje moći nositi kacigu.
learner.en: A shorter hairstyle, but I still need to be able to wear a helmet.

partner.en: Do you cycle every day?

learner.hr: Gotovo. U kosi mi se nakon vožnje vidi svaki rub.
learner.en: Almost. After a ride every edge shows in my hair.

partner.hr: Želiš li nešto što samo popraviš rukom?
partner.en: Do you want something you can fix with your hand?

learner.hr: Upravo to. Nemam vremena svako jutro ponovno se uređivati.
learner.en: Exactly. I don't have time to style it again every morning.

partner.hr: Mogu ostaviti malo dulji gornji dio.
partner.en: I can leave the top a little longer.

learner.hr: Može, ako neće trebati puno proizvoda.
learner.en: Yes, if it won't need lots of products.

partner.en: Shall we try and check?

learner.hr: Da. Kaciga mi je u torbi, prvi put korisna kod frizera.
learner.en: Yes. My helmet is in my bag, useful at the hairdresser's for the first time.

conversations.title: A child wants a dinosaur party without balloons

partner.hr: Zašto si prekrižio balone s popisa?
partner.en: Why did you cross balloons off the list?

learner.hr: Ne volim kad puknu. Zvuk me uplaši.
learner.en: I don't like it when they burst. The sound scares me.

partner.en: What shall we have instead?

learner.hr: Nacrtajmo velike tragove i nekoliko čudovišta od papira.
learner.en: Let's draw big footprints and a few paper monsters.

partner.hr: Zar nisu dinosauri, a ne čudovišta?
partner.en: Aren't they dinosaurs rather than monsters?

learner.hr: Jesu, ali još ih ne znam dobro nacrtati.
learner.en: Yes, but I can't draw them well yet.

partner.en: Will you decorate the door yourself?

learner.hr: Hoću. Neka svi odmah vide da ulaze u drugo doba.
learner.en: Yes. Let everyone see straight away that they're entering another age.

partner.en: What about the cake?

learner.hr: Na njoj može biti miran dinosaur. Ne mora sve režati.
learner.en: It can have a calm dinosaur. Not everything has to roar.

conversations.title: A friend keeps postponing a small repair

partner.en: Is that shelf still wobbling?

learner.hr: Da. Popravak stalno guram za sljedeći vikend.
learner.en: Yes. I keep putting the repair off until next weekend.

partner.en: What's stopping you?

learner.hr: Mislio sam da će biti komplicirano. Nisam ni pogledao nosače.
learner.en: I thought it would be complicated. I haven't even looked at the brackets.

partner.en: Shall we at least take the books off?

learner.hr: Hoćemo. To mogu učiniti bez velikog plana.
learner.en: Yes. I can do that without a grand plan.

partner.en: Can you see the problem now?

learner.hr: Jedan vijak nedostaje. Lakše je nego što sam zamišljao.
learner.en: One screw is missing. It's easier than I imagined.

partner.en: So we're sorting it out today?

learner.hr: Danas. Jednostavan posao postao je velik samo u mojoj glavi.
learner.en: Today. A simple job became big only in my head.

conversations.title: A pair of neighbours disagree about a shared bench

partner.hr: Zašto je klupa okrenuta prema zidu?
partner.en: Why is the bench facing the wall?

learner.hr: Netko ju je premjestio bez dogovora. Sad nitko ne vidi vrt.
learner.en: Someone moved it without agreement. Now nobody can see the garden.

partner.en: Perhaps the sun bothered them.

learner.hr: Moguće, ali trebamo pronaći mjesto koje odgovara većini.
learner.en: Possibly, but we need to find a spot that suits the majority.

partner.en: Shall we put it back straight away?

learner.hr: Radije prvo pitajmo susjede što su htjeli postići.
learner.en: Let's first ask the neighbours what they wanted to achieve.

partner.en: What if we disagree?

learner.hr: Možemo isprobati dva položaja, svaki po tjedan dana.
learner.en: We can try two positions, each for a week.

partner.en: Will you write a message?

learner.hr: Hoću. Ne treba nam svađa oko mjesta za odmor.
learner.en: Yes. We don't need an argument over a place to rest.

conversations.title: An unexpected shift swap changes dinner plans

partner.en: Why can't you come tonight?

learner.hr: Dopala me noćna smjena. Kolega se razbolio.
learner.en: I've been given the night shift. A colleague is ill.

partner.en: Isn't there anyone else?

learner.hr: Ja sam zamjena ovaj tjedan. Znali smo da se može dogoditi.
learner.en: I'm the replacement this week. We knew it might happen.

partner.en: Shall we save you dinner?

learner.hr: Molim vas. Sutra neću imati volje kuhati.
learner.en: Please. I won't feel like cooking tomorrow.

partner.en: When will you sleep?

learner.hr: Kad se vratim. Telefon ću utišati do poslijepodneva.
learner.en: When I get back. I'll silence my phone until the afternoon.

partner.en: Then we'll talk when you get up.

learner.hr: Dogovoreno. Nemojte otkazivati druženje zbog mene.
learner.en: Agreed. Don't cancel the gathering because of me.

conversations.title: A newly engaged friend dislikes a grand announcement

partner.en: Why are you hiding your left hand?

learner.hr: Ne skrivam, samo se još privikavam na prsten.
learner.en: I'm not hiding it, just getting used to the ring.

partner.en: Wait, are you engaged?

learner.hr: Jesmo. Zaprosio me tijekom sasvim obične šetnje.
learner.en: Yes. He proposed during a completely ordinary walk.

partner.en: Without elaborate preparations?

learner.hr: Bez publike, što mi je baš odgovaralo.
learner.en: Without an audience, which suited me perfectly.

partner.hr: Kako se sad zove vaš odnos?
partner.en: What do you call your relationship now?

learner.hr: I dalje smo mi. Samo je on odjednom moj zaručnik.
learner.en: We're still us. Only he's suddenly my fiancé.

partner.en: Will you celebrate?

learner.hr: Hoćemo, malom večerom. Nemoj još naručivati veliki natpis.
learner.en: Yes, with a small dinner. Don't order a huge sign yet.

conversations.title: A windy beach defeats a newspaper reader

partner.en: Why are you sitting on the newspaper?

learner.hr: Od vjetra su mi već dvije stranice pobjegle.
learner.en: The wind has already carried off two pages.

partner.en: Did you catch them?

learner.hr: Jesam, kod ograde. Nisam htio ostaviti smeće na plaži.
learner.en: Yes, by the fence. I didn't want to leave litter on the beach.

partner.hr: Možda danas nije dan za čitanje.
partner.en: Perhaps today isn't a day for reading.

learner.hr: Očito. Puše jače nego što sam očekivao.
learner.en: Clearly. It's windier than I expected.

partner.en: Shall we go behind the wall?

learner.hr: Možemo, ali novine spremam. Ne želim još jednu potjeru.
learner.en: We can, but I'm putting the paper away. I don't want another chase.

partner.en: What will you do, then?

learner.hr: Gledati more. Njegove stranice barem ne moram skupljati.
learner.en: Watch the sea. At least I don't have to collect its pages.

conversations.title: A pancake cook cracks an egg into the wrong bowl

partner.en: Why did you stop mixing?

learner.hr: Razbio sam jaje u zdjelu za ljuske.
learner.en: I cracked an egg into the bowl for the shells.

partner.en: Will you take it out?

learner.hr: Radije ću uzeti drugo. Previše sam žurio.
learner.en: I'd rather use another one. I was rushing too much.

partner.en: Can I carry on with the batter?

learner.hr: Možeš. Miješaj polako dok dodajem mlijeko.
learner.en: Yes. Stir slowly while I add the milk.

partner.en: Is it thick enough?

learner.hr: Izgleda dobro. Prva palačinka će nam reći više.
learner.en: It looks good. The first pancake will tell us more.

partner.en: The first one stuck a little.

learner.hr: Onda smo počeli sasvim uobičajeno. Druga će biti bolja.
learner.en: Then we've started quite normally. The second will be better.

conversations.title: A gardener finds more roots than expected

partner.en: Why isn't the hole ready yet?

learner.hr: Mislio sam da mogu brzo iskopati mjesto za grm.
learner.en: I thought I could quickly dig a spot for the shrub.

partner.en: What's slowing you down?

learner.hr: Korijenje. Ovdje očito ne mogu samo kopati bez razmišljanja.
learner.en: Roots. Clearly I can't just dig here without thinking.

partner.en: Is the old tree nearby?

learner.hr: Jest. Ne želim mu oštetiti korijen zbog nove sadnice.
learner.en: Yes. I don't want to damage its roots for a new plant.

partner.en: Shall we choose another spot?

learner.hr: Hoćemo. Bolje promijeniti plan nego siliti ovaj.
learner.en: Yes. Better change the plan than force this one.

partner.en: What about the hole?

learner.hr: Zatrpat ću je prije nego zaboravimo gdje je.
learner.en: I'll fill it before we forget where it is.

conversations.title: A stranger remembers a teacher by his laugh

partner.hr: Zašto si se okrenuo za njim?
partner.en: Why did you turn to look at him?

learner.hr: Prepoznao sam gospodina iz škole, po smijehu.
learner.en: I recognised a man from school, by his laugh.

partner.en: Your old teacher?

learner.hr: Da. Lice mi je bilo poznato, ali glas je presudio.
learner.en: Yes. His face looked familiar, but the voice settled it.

partner.en: Did you go up to him?

learner.hr: Jesam. Rekao je da pamti moje sastavke.
learner.en: Yes. He said he remembers my essays.

partner.en: That's a nice compliment.

learner.hr: Jest. Nisam očekivao kompliment nakon toliko godina.
learner.en: It is. I didn't expect a compliment after so many years.

partner.en: Will you meet again?

learner.hr: Možda na školskoj obljetnici. Sad barem znam da mu smijem prići.
learner.en: Perhaps at the school anniversary. At least now I know I can approach him.

conversations.title: A perfume sample follows someone home

partner.hr: Kakav se miris osjeti iz torbe?
partner.en: What's that smell coming from your bag?
