learner.hr: Parfem. Stavila sam unutra papir s uzorkom.
learner.en: Perfume. I put a sample strip inside.

partner.en: Do you like it?

learner.hr: U trgovini jest, ali sad mi je previše snažan.
learner.en: I did in the shop, but now it's too strong for me.

partner.en: Will you buy it anyway?

learner.hr: Neću žuriti. Miris mi treba odgovarati i nakon sat vremena.
learner.en: I won't rush. The scent needs to suit me after an hour too.

partner.en: Shall we take out the paper?

learner.hr: Da, prije nego cijela torba postane uzorak.
learner.en: Yes, before the whole bag becomes a sample.

partner.hr: Sad barem znamo da dugo traje.
partner.en: At least now we know it lasts.

learner.hr: Znamo. Samo dugotrajno nije uvijek isto što i ugodno.
learner.en: We do. Only long-lasting isn't always the same as pleasant.

conversations.title: A new employee confuses two office roles

partner.en: Who were you looking for at reception?

learner.hr: Mislio sam da me asistent treba uvesti u posao.
learner.en: I thought the assistant was supposed to show me the job.

partner.en: He's working from home today.

learner.hr: Onda sam pogrešno razumio poruku. Tko me čeka?
learner.en: Then I misunderstood the message. Who's waiting for me?

partner.en: Your team manager.

learner.hr: Dobro. Još učim tko je zadužen za što.
learner.en: All right. I'm still learning who's responsible for what.

partner.en: Will you write down the names?

learner.hr: Hoću. Lakše mi je nego svima ponavljati isto pitanje.
learner.en: Yes. That's easier for me than asking everyone the same question.

partner.en: The first day is always confusing.

learner.hr: Znam. Barem sam danas došao na pravi kat.
learner.en: I know. At least I came to the right floor today.

conversations.title: A dog refuses a tablet hidden in food

partner.en: Why are you checking the bowl?

learner.hr: Pas je pojeo hranu, a lijek uredno ostavio.
learner.en: The dog ate the food and neatly left the medicine.

partner.en: So he recognised the tablet?

learner.hr: Izgleda da jest. Ovi lijekovi mu očito nisu dragi.
learner.en: It looks that way. He clearly isn't fond of these medicines.

partner.en: Will you crush it?

learner.hr: Prvo ću pitati veterinarku smije li se tako dati.
learner.en: First I'll ask the vet whether it can be given that way.

partner.hr: Mogu li ga pričuvati dok zoveš?
partner.en: Can I watch him while you call?

learner.hr: Možeš. Ne želim da netko drugi pojede ostatke.
learner.en: Yes. I don't want someone else eating the leftovers.

partner.en: He looks pleased for now.

learner.hr: Jest. Misli da je upravo pobijedio veliki kulinarski dvoboj.
learner.en: He is. He thinks he's just won a great culinary duel.

conversations.title: A runner starts too fast in a charity race

partner.hr: Zašto si usporio nakon prve ulice?
partner.en: Why did you slow down after the first street?

learner.hr: Bio sam brz prvih sto metara i potrošio svu volju.
learner.en: I was fast for the first hundred metres and used up all my enthusiasm.

partner.en: Did you think you'd win?

learner.hr: Nisam, ali ponijela me gomila na startu.
learner.en: No, but the crowd at the start swept me along.

partner.en: We can walk part of the way.

learner.hr: Možemo. Ovo nije utrka u kojoj moram nešto dokazati.
learner.en: We can. This isn't a race where I need to prove something.

partner.en: How will you start next time?

learner.hr: Sporije. Za početak mi je i brza šetnja dovoljna.
learner.en: More slowly. For a start, even a brisk walk is enough for me.

partner.en: Shall we at least get to the next corner?

learner.hr: Idemo. Sad mogu i vidjeti za koga skupljamo donacije.
learner.en: Yes. Now I can also see whom we're raising donations for.

conversations.title: An old telephone makes a child wait for each digit

partner.hr: Zašto se taj krug vraća tako sporo?
partner.en: Why does that circle return so slowly?

learner.hr: Tako si nekad birao telefonski broj, znamenku po znamenku.
learner.en: That's how you used to dial a telephone number, one digit at a time.

partner.en: Did you use one like that?

learner.hr: Jesam. Takve telefone nismo mogli nositi u džepu.
learner.en: Yes. We couldn't carry phones like those in our pockets.

partner.en: What if you made a mistake near the end?

learner.hr: Morao si početi ponovno. Zato sam pažljivo gledao broj.
learner.en: You had to start again. That's why I watched the number carefully.

partner.en: Were people more patient?

learner.hr: Ne znam. I tada smo znali uzdisati dok čekamo.
learner.en: I don't know. We sighed while waiting back then too.

partner.en: May I try?

learner.hr: Možeš, ovo je muzejski primjerak za isprobavanje.
learner.en: Yes, this is a museum model for visitors to try.

conversations.title: A cardboard rocket will not fit through the door

partner.hr: Kako ćemo ovo odnijeti u školu?
partner.en: How will we take this to school?

learner.hr: Raketa je šira nego što sam planirao.
learner.en: The rocket is wider than I planned.

partner.en: Can we remove the wings?

learner.hr: Možemo. Dijelovi rakete drže se kopčama, ne ljepilom.
learner.en: Yes. The rocket's parts are held together by clips, not glue.

partner.hr: Zašto si je napravio tako veliku?
partner.en: Why did you make it so big?

learner.hr: Htio sam da u nju stane lutka. Nisam mislio na vrata.
learner.en: I wanted a doll to fit inside. I didn't think about the door.

partner.hr: Hoće li je biti lako sastaviti?
partner.en: Will it be easy to assemble?

learner.hr: Hoće ako označim koji dio ide kamo.
learner.en: Yes, if I mark which part goes where.

partner.en: Shall we try now?

learner.hr: Da. Bolje ovdje nego pred cijelim razredom.
learner.en: Yes. Better here than in front of the whole class.

conversations.title: A television interview cuts away at the wrong moment

partner.hr: Jesi li čuo što je odgovorila?
partner.en: Did you hear what she answered?

learner.hr: Nisam. Na televiziji su baš tada prešli na drugi prilog.
learner.en: No. On television they switched to another report just then.

partner.en: Perhaps the interview ended.

learner.hr: Možda, ali pitanje je ostalo bez odgovora.
learner.en: Perhaps, but the question was left unanswered.

partner.en: Will you look for the full recording?

learner.hr: Hoću. Televizor ću ugasiti, ionako samo čekam nešto što neće doći.
learner.en: Yes. I'll turn the television off; I'm just waiting for something that isn't coming anyway.

partner.en: Have you found it?

learner.hr: Jesam. Cijeli razgovor traje mnogo dulje od priloga.
learner.en: Yes. The full conversation is much longer than the report.

partner.en: Is the answer good?

learner.hr: Još slušam. Barem sad čujem cijelu rečenicu.
learner.en: I'm still listening. At least now I can hear the whole sentence.

conversations.title: Two siblings were born in different towns

partner.hr: Zašto na obrascima pišu različita mjesta?
partner.en: Why do the forms list different places?

learner.hr: Ja sam rođena ovdje, a brat je rođen prije selidbe.
learner.en: I was born here, and my brother was born before the move.

partner.en: Does he remember the old town?

learner.hr: Ne, bio je beba. Zna ga samo iz fotografija.
learner.en: No, he was a baby. He only knows it from photographs.

partner.en: Have you visited it together?

learner.hr: Jesmo lani. Tražili smo zgradu u kojoj su roditelji živjeli.
learner.en: Yes, last year. We looked for the building where our parents lived.

partner.en: Is it still there?

learner.hr: Jest, samo je ulaz drukčiji. Mama ga je jedva prepoznala.
learner.en: Yes, only the entrance is different. Mum could hardly recognise it.

partner.en: Will you go again?

learner.hr: Hoćemo, s više vremena i manje starih karata.
learner.en: Yes, with more time and fewer old maps.

conversations.title: A family album contains an unnamed school class

partner.en: Who are all these people?

learner.hr: Mamina generacija iz škole. Mnogih se više ni ona ne sjeća.
learner.en: Mum's year group from school. Even she no longer remembers many of them.

partner.en: Aren't there names on the back?

learner.hr: Samo datum i ime fotografa.
learner.en: Only a date and the photographer's name.

partner.en: We can ask her friend.

learner.hr: Možemo, možda prepozna lica koja su mami nepoznata.
learner.en: We can; perhaps she'll recognise faces Mum doesn't know.

partner.en: Why do you want to write down the names?

learner.hr: Da slika ne postane samo skup nepoznatih osmijeha.
learner.en: So the picture doesn't become just a collection of unfamiliar smiles.

partner.en: Shall we leave spaces for the unknown ones?

learner.hr: Da. Radije praznina nego pogrešno ime.
learner.en: Yes. Better a gap than the wrong name.

conversations.title: An early dinner interrupts a child’s game

partner.en: Why are you calling me already?

learner.hr: Danas jedemo ranije jer poslije idemo na predstavu.
learner.en: We're eating earlier today because we're going to a play afterwards.

partner.en: I haven't finished the game.

learner.hr: Spremi je. Možeš nastaviti kad se vratimo.
learner.en: Save it. You can continue when we get back.

partner.en: Can I eat in front of the screen?

learner.hr: Radije sjedni s nama. Želim čuti kako ti je bilo u školi.
learner.en: I'd rather you sat with us. I want to hear how school was.

partner.en: Then I'll eat quickly.

learner.hr: Jedi polako. Imamo vremena i za priču i za večeru.
learner.en: Eat slowly. We have time for both conversation and dinner.

partner.hr: A ako zaboravim gdje sam stao?
partner.en: What if I forget where I stopped?

learner.hr: Zapiši. I ja tako pamtim stvari koje mi ne stanu u glavu.
learner.en: Write it down. That's how I remember things that don't fit in my head too.

conversations.title: A company name changes but the people stay

partner.en: Don't you work there anymore?

learner.hr: Radim. Firma je promijenila ime, ne cijeli tim.
learner.en: I do. The company changed its name, not the whole team.

partner.hr: Zato te nisam našao na staroj stranici.
partner.en: That's why I couldn't find you on the old website.

learner.hr: Da. U tvrtki još ažuriramo potpise i adrese.
learner.en: Yes. At the company we're still updating signatures and addresses.

partner.hr: Je li se tvoj posao promijenio?
partner.en: Has your job changed?

learner.hr: Zasad nije. Samo svima objašnjavam isti novi naziv.
learner.en: Not so far. I just explain the same new name to everyone.

partner.en: Do you like it?

learner.hr: Lakše se izgovara. Za ostalo ću se morati naviknuti.
learner.en: It's easier to pronounce. I'll have to get used to the rest.

partner.en: Will you send me the new address?

learner.hr: Hoću, prije nego opet završiš na praznoj stranici.
learner.en: Yes, before you end up on an empty page again.

conversations.title: A wooden chest is too heavy to move full

partner.hr: Zašto sanduk ne ide ni milimetar?
partner.en: Why won't the chest move even a millimetre?

learner.hr: Jer sam ga napunio knjigama prije premještanja.
learner.en: Because I filled it with books before moving it.

partner.en: Shall we take everything out?

learner.hr: Morat ćemo. Kutija s jastucima bila je lakša proba.
learner.en: We'll have to. The box of cushions was an easier test.

partner.en: Where should I put the books?

learner.hr: Na stol, ne na pod. Još trebamo proći ovuda.
learner.en: On the table, not the floor. We still need to get through here.

partner.en: Now it moves.

learner.hr: Dobro. Sljedeći put prvo mislim, pa punim.
learner.en: Good. Next time I'll think first and fill it afterwards.

partner.en: Where are we actually taking it?

learner.hr: Pod prozor. Nadam se da sam barem širinu dobro izmjerio.
learner.en: Under the window. I hope I at least measured the width correctly.

conversations.title: A concert programme has the wrong song order

partner.en: Why is everyone leafing through the booklet?

learner.hr: Redoslijed pjesama nije isti kao u programu.
learner.en: The order of the songs isn't the same as in the programme.

partner.en: Did the performer skip something?

learner.hr: Nije, samo je zamijenio dvije skladbe.
learner.en: No, he just swapped two pieces.

partner.en: How did you notice?

learner.hr: Ovu pjevam kod kuće. Znam je po prvim tonovima.
learner.en: I sing this one at home. I know it from the opening notes.

partner.en: Does the change bother you?

learner.hr: Ne. Više me zanima koliko drukčije zvuči uživo.
learner.en: No. I'm more interested in how different it sounds live.

partner.en: Then put the booklet away.

learner.hr: Hoću. Večeras slušam, ne provjeravam popis.
learner.en: I will. Tonight I'm listening, not checking a list.

conversations.title: An outdoor cinema asks everyone to lower their screens

partner.hr: Zašto su zamolili da spustimo telefone?
partner.en: Why did they ask us to lower our phones?

learner.hr: Svijetle ravno ljudima iza nas.
learner.en: They're shining straight at the people behind us.

partner.en: I was only checking the time.

learner.hr: Znam, ali u mraku se vidi i malen zaslon.
learner.en: I know, but even a small screen shows in the dark.

partner.en: Shall I switch it off?

learner.hr: Ili ga spremi. Film ionako upravo počinje.
learner.en: Or put it away. The film is starting now anyway.

partner.hr: Nadam se da neće početi kiša.
partner.en: I hope it won't start raining.

learner.hr: I ja. Za svaki slučaj sjedim bliže zaklonu.
learner.en: So do I. Just in case, I'm sitting nearer the shelter.

partner.en: If you fall asleep, shall I wake you?

learner.hr: Probudi me tek kad krene pljesak.
learner.en: Wake me only when the applause starts.

conversations.title: A cobbler explains why a bag cannot be patched invisibly

partner.hr: Može li se ova torba popraviti?
partner.en: Can this bag be repaired?

learner.hr: Može, ali koža je na pregibu već jako tanka.
learner.en: Yes, but the leather at the fold is already very thin.

partner.en: Will the patch show?

learner.hr: Hoće. Nemam istog materijala, a novu boju ćete primijetiti.
learner.en: Yes. I don't have the same material, and you'll notice the new colour.

partner.hr: To mi ne smeta ako će držati.
partner.en: I don't mind if it will hold.

learner.hr: Onda možemo izabrati čvršću zakrpu umjesto nevidljive.
learner.en: Then we can choose a stronger patch rather than an invisible one.

partner.en: How long will the repair take?

learner.hr: Nekoliko dana. Prvo trebam provjeriti i šav ispod ručke.
learner.en: A few days. First I need to check the seam beneath the handle too.

partner.en: I'll leave it with you.

learner.hr: U redu. Javit ću ako pronađem još neko oštećenje.
learner.en: All right. I'll let you know if I find any more damage.

conversations.title: A photo editor goes too far with a sunset

partner.hr: Je li nebo stvarno bilo toliko narančasto?
partner.en: Was the sky really that orange?

learner.hr: Nije. Obrada mi je očito otišla predaleko.
learner.en: No. I've clearly gone too far with the editing.

partner.en: Do you still have the original photograph?

learner.hr: Imam. Ovu sam obradio kasno noću i više nisam vidio razliku.
learner.en: Yes. I edited this one late at night and stopped seeing the difference.

partner.en: Will you start again?

learner.hr: Hoću, s manje promjena. Želim sačuvati dojam tog trenutka.
learner.en: Yes, with fewer changes. I want to preserve the feeling of that moment.

partner.en: What will you restore first?

learner.hr: Boju mora. Sad izgleda kao da je iz drugog svijeta.
learner.en: The sea's colour. Now it looks as though it's from another world.

partner.en: May I see both versions?

learner.hr: Možeš. Tvoje odmorne oči su korisnije od još jednog klizača.
learner.en: Yes. Your rested eyes are more useful than another slider.

conversations.title: A summer reunion needs a halfway meeting point

partner.en: Are you going to France again?

learner.hr: Vjerojatno idemo u Francusku. Tamo ćemo se naći s prijateljima iz Engleske.
learner.en: We're probably going to France. We'll meet our friends from England there.

partner.en: Why don't they come here?

learner.hr: Lani su bili kod nas. Sad tražimo mjesto koje je svima novo.
learner.en: They visited us last year. Now we're looking for somewhere new to everyone.

partner.en: Do you know which town yet?

learner.hr: Još ne. Prvo uspoređujemo putovanja, a tek onda smještaj.
learner.en: Not yet. First we're comparing the journeys, then accommodation.

partner.en: Will you do lots of sightseeing?

learner.hr: Ne previše. Važnije nam je druženje nego popis znamenitosti.
learner.en: Not too much. Spending time together matters more than a list of sights.

partner.en: It sounds like a good holiday.

learner.hr: Nadam se. Samo da ne potrošimo cijeli odmor na dogovaranje.
learner.en: I hope so. As long as we don't spend the whole holiday making arrangements.

conversations.title: A quiet guest surprises everyone on the dance floor

partner.en: Where's that quiet colleague?

learner.hr: Tamo pleše kao da je tulum samo njegov.
learner.en: Over there, dancing as though the party belongs to him.

partner.en: I didn't know he liked dancing.

learner.hr: Ni ja. U uredu ga poznajemo u sasvim drugoj ulozi.
learner.en: Neither did I. We know him in a completely different role at the office.

partner.en: Will you join him?

learner.hr: Hoću kad odložim čašu. Ne želim je nositi među plesače.
learner.en: Yes, once I put down my glass. I don't want to carry it among the dancers.

partner.en: Shall I record the moment?

learner.hr: Prvo ga pitaj. Nije svaki dio zabave za objavu.
learner.en: Ask him first. Not every part of a party is for posting.

partner.hr: Onda spremam telefon i idem s vama.
partner.en: Then I'll put my phone away and come with you.

learner.hr: Dobra odluka. Večeras imamo dovoljno uspomena i bez zaslona.
learner.en: Good decision. Tonight we have enough memories without screens too.

conversations.title: A child draws the wrong animal on a boat sign

partner.hr: Zašto je na znaku velika peraja?
partner.en: Why is there a big fin on the sign?

learner.hr: Trebao je biti morski pas, ali izgleda kao prevrnut čamac.
learner.en: It was meant to be a shark, but it looks like an overturned boat.

partner.hr: Za što ti treba taj znak?
partner.en: What do you need the sign for?

learner.hr: Za školsku igru o moru. Svi crtamo jednu životinju.
learner.en: For a school game about the sea. We're each drawing an animal.

partner.en: Will you draw it again?

learner.hr: Možda samo dodam rep. Ne moram odmah baciti cijeli papir.
learner.en: Perhaps I'll just add a tail. I don't need to throw out the whole sheet immediately.

partner.en: Now it looks more like a fish.

learner.hr: Dobro. Oči ću pomaknuti da ne gleda u vlastiti trbuh.
learner.en: Good. I'll move the eyes so it isn't looking at its own belly.

partner.en: Is it finished?

learner.hr: Jest. Ako ga netko zamijeni za brod, dat ću mu ime.
learner.en: Yes. If someone mistakes it for a boat, I'll give it a name.

conversations.title: A harbour exhibition leaves out small working boats

partner.hr: Što ti nedostaje u ovoj izložbi?
partner.en: What do you find missing from this exhibition?

learner.hr: Cijela flota izgleda kao da su postojali samo veliki brodovi.
learner.en: The whole fleet looks as though only large ships existed.

partner.hr: A oni mali u zadnjoj vitrini?
partner.en: What about the small ones in the last display case?

learner.hr: Vidim ih. Taj dio flote zaslužuje malo više prostora.
learner.en: I see them. That part of the fleet deserves a little more space.

partner.hr: Zašto su ti baš oni važni?
partner.en: Why do those matter to you particularly?

learner.hr: Na takvom je djed prevozio robu između otoka.
learner.en: My grandfather carried goods between islands on one like that.

partner.en: Do you have a photograph?

learner.hr: Imam kod kuće. Mogao bih pitati zanima li ih kopija.
learner.en: I do at home. I could ask whether they'd be interested in a copy.

partner.en: That would broaden the story.

learner.hr: Upravo tako. Luka nije živjela samo od najvećih brodova.
learner.en: Exactly. The port didn't live only from the biggest ships.

conversations.title: A costume workshop mixes up two masks

partner.en: Why are you wearing my mask?

learner.hr: Mislio sam da su ove maske sve za istu grupu.
learner.en: I thought these masks were all for the same group.

partner.en: Mine has a gold line.

learner.hr: Onda sam tvoju masku uzeo još prije probe. Oprosti.
learner.en: Then I took your mask before rehearsal even started. Sorry.

partner.en: Where's yours?

learner.hr: Na stolici uz kaput. Nadam se da nije zgnječena.
learner.en: On the chair by the coat. I hope it isn't crushed.

partner.en: It looks fine; here it is.

learner.hr: Hvala. Označit ću unutarnju stranu svojim imenom.
learner.en: Thank you. I'll mark the inside with my name.

partner.en: Can we start now?

learner.hr: Možemo. Sad barem znam tko trebam biti.
learner.en: Yes. At least now I know who I'm meant to be.

conversations.title: A museum snake turns out to be a model

partner.en: Why did you stop so suddenly?

learner.hr: U vitrini je zmija. Nisam očekivao da je odmah uz lice.
learner.en: There's a snake in the case. I didn't expect it right by my face.

partner.en: It's only a model.

learner.hr: Znam sad. Ali ne volim zmije ni kad su od plastike.
learner.en: I know now. But I don't like snakes even when they're plastic.

partner.en: Shall we skip this section?

learner.hr: Možemo prvo pročitati opis. Možda me manje iznenadi kad znam što gledam.
learner.en: We can read the description first. Perhaps I'll be less startled when I know what I'm looking at.

partner.en: It says they're showing the skin pattern.

learner.hr: Onda ću gledati uzorak, ne oči.
learner.en: Then I'll look at the pattern, not the eyes.

partner.en: Is that easier?

learner.hr: Jest. Samo nemoj iz šale pomicati vitrinu.
learner.en: Yes. Just don't move the case as a joke.

conversations.title: A visitor learns which match matters to the café

partner.hr: Zašto je ovdje tako puno ljudi?
partner.en: Why are there so many people here?

learner.hr: Danas je važna utakmica. Svi su došli gledati.
learner.en: There's an important match today. Everyone came to watch.

partner.en: Is it a final?

learner.hr: Ne, ali na ovoj utakmici odlučuje se tko ostaje u ligi.
learner.en: No, but this match decides who stays in the league.

partner.en: So that's why everyone's tense.

learner.hr: Da. Liga im je važna, a ja sam samo htio mirnu kavu.
learner.en: Yes. The league matters to them, and I only wanted a quiet coffee.

partner.en: Shall we sit outside after all?

learner.hr: Hoćemo. Tamo mogu piti kavu bez praćenja rezultata.
learner.en: Yes. There I can drink coffee without following the score.

partner.en: If we hear shouting, we'll know.

learner.hr: Znat ćemo da se nešto dogodilo, ali ne nužno kome.
learner.en: We'll know something happened, but not necessarily to whom.

conversations.title: A former pianist tries a familiar piece again

partner.en: I didn't know you played.

learner.hr: Nekad sam svirao često. Sad sviram samo kad nitko ne sluša.
learner.en: I used to play often. Now I play only when nobody's listening.

partner.en: Why are you hiding it from us?

learner.hr: Ne skrivam, samo mi prsti više nisu sigurni kao prije.
learner.en: I'm not hiding it; my fingers just aren't as sure as before.

partner.en: Do you still recognise the old pieces?

learner.hr: Da, melodiju pamtim bolje nego pokrete.
learner.en: Yes, I remember the tune better than the movements.

partner.en: Will you play something short?

learner.hr: Hoću, ako ne očekuješ savršenstvo.
learner.en: Yes, if you don't expect perfection.

partner.en: I expect you to enjoy it.

learner.hr: Onda mogu početi. To je lakša publika nego što sam mislio.
learner.en: Then I can start. That's an easier audience than I thought.

conversations.title: A wedding guest asks whom to approach

partner.en: Who should I give these papers to?

learner.hr: Svećenik je rekao da ih ostavimo prije početka obreda.
learner.en: The priest said to leave them before the ceremony starts.

partner.en: Do you know where he is now?

learner.hr: Ne. Pitat ću kod ulaza gdje mogu naći svećenika.
learner.en: No. I'll ask at the entrance where I can find the priest.

partner.en: Will we be late with the preparations?

learner.hr: Imamo još pola sata. Nema potrebe trčati.
learner.en: We still have half an hour. There's no need to run.

partner.en: I'll take the flowers in the meantime.

learner.hr: Može, samo nemoj ništa postavljati prije dogovora.
learner.en: Yes, just don't arrange anything before checking.

partner.en: Here he is, coming towards us.

learner.hr: Dobro. Sad možemo mirno pitati što još treba.
learner.en: Good. Now we can calmly ask what else is needed.

conversations.title: A family gift prompts a conversation about belief

partner.en: What did your grandmother give you?

learner.hr: Bibliju s posvetom. Zna da me zanimaju obiteljske uspomene.
learner.en: A Bible with an inscription. She knows I'm interested in family memories.

partner.en: Are you a believer too?

learner.hr: Nisam siguran. Moja vjera nije ista kao njezina.
learner.en: I'm not sure. My faith isn't the same as hers.

partner.hr: Je li joj to teško prihvatiti?
partner.en: Is that hard for her to accept?

learner.hr: Ponekad, ali o tome možemo razgovarati bez svađe.
learner.en: Sometimes, but we can talk about it without arguing.

partner.en: Will you keep the book?

learner.hr: Hoću. Dar govori i o njoj, ne samo o mojim uvjerenjima.
learner.en: Yes. The gift says something about her, not just about my beliefs.

partner.en: What does the inscription say?

learner.hr: Da joj je važno da uvijek znam da me voli.
learner.en: That it matters to her that I always know she loves me.

conversations.title: A museum visitor confuses two painted rulers

partner.hr: Je li čovjek na slici car?
partner.en: Is the man in the picture an emperor?

learner.hr: Nije, ovo je grof. Car je na susjednom portretu.
learner.en: No, this is a count. The emperor is in the neighbouring portrait.

partner.en: How do you tell them apart?

learner.hr: Čitam pločice. Po odjeći bih i ja pogriješio.
learner.en: I read the labels. I'd get it wrong from the clothes too.

partner.hr: Jesu li živjeli u isto vrijeme?
partner.en: Did they live at the same time?

learner.hr: Izgleda da jesu, ali nisu prikazani u istoj dobi.
learner.en: It looks that way, but they aren't shown at the same age.

partner.hr: Zašto je jedan portret toliko veći?
partner.en: Why is one portrait so much larger?

learner.hr: Možda zbog naručitelja. U opisu ne vidim objašnjenje.
learner.en: Perhaps because of whoever commissioned it. I can't see an explanation in the description.

partner.en: Shall we ask the guide?

learner.hr: Hoćemo. Zanimljivije je od našeg nagađanja prema šeširima.
learner.en: Yes. That's more interesting than our guesses based on hats.

conversations.title: A puppet refuses to look like the intended animal

partner.hr: Zašto tvoj majmun ima tako duge uši?
partner.en: Why does your monkey have such long ears?

learner.hr: Trebao je biti magarac. Sad razumijem zašto se smiješ.
learner.en: It was supposed to be a donkey. Now I understand why you're laughing.

partner.en: Will you change the face?

learner.hr: Hoću. Nos je ispao prekratak.
learner.en: Yes. The nose turned out too short.

partner.en: Perhaps a different tail would help too.

learner.hr: Dobra ideja. Majmun bi barem imao razlog za ovaj rep.
learner.en: Good idea. At least a monkey would have a reason for this tail.

partner.en: What do you need the puppet for?

learner.hr: Pričamo priču mlađoj grupi u knjižnici.
learner.en: We're telling a story to a younger group at the library.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li priznati kako je nastala?
partner.en: Will you admit how it was made?

learner.hr: Hoću. Možda i popravak postane dio priče.
learner.en: Yes. Perhaps the repair will become part of the story too.

conversations.title: A new supervisor changes the meeting routine

partner.en: Why is today's meeting shorter?

learner.hr: Nova šefica traži da unaprijed napišemo glavna pitanja.
learner.en: The new supervisor asks us to write our main questions beforehand.

partner.en: Is that better?

learner.hr: Meni jest. Starom šefu smo sve objašnjavali tek za stolom.
learner.en: It is for me. We used to explain everything to the old boss only at the table.

partner.hr: A ako se pojavi novo pitanje?
partner.en: What if a new question comes up?

learner.hr: Ostavimo vrijeme za njega. Plan nije zabrana razgovora.
learner.en: We leave time for it. A plan isn't a ban on conversation.

partner.en: Will everyone accept the change?

learner.hr: Vidjet ćemo. Zasad manje čekamo da dođemo na red.
learner.en: We'll see. For now we spend less time waiting our turn.

partner.en: Will you tell her that?

learner.hr: Hoću. Korisno je čuti i što dobro radi.
learner.en: Yes. It's useful to hear what you're doing well too.

conversations.title: A baby’s day-trip bag contains almost everything

partner.en: Have we brought everything?

learner.hr: Pelene jesmo, ali ne vidim rezervnu odjeću.
learner.en: We've got nappies, but I can't see the spare clothes.

partner.en: It's in the side pocket.

learner.hr: Dobro. Dude su u maloj čistoj kutiji, zar ne?
learner.en: Good. The dummies are in the little clean box, aren't they?

partner.en: Yes, I checked.

learner.hr: Onda još trebamo vodu i možemo krenuti.
learner.en: Then we just need water and we can leave.

partner.en: Why is the bag so heavy?

learner.hr: Kao da putujemo na tjedan dana, ne na nekoliko sati.
learner.en: It's as though we're travelling for a week, not a few hours.

partner.en: And where are our sandwiches?

learner.hr: Njih smo zaboravili. Beba je očito jedina spremna.
learner.en: We forgot them. Clearly the baby is the only one ready.

conversations.title: A reservation uses a surname nobody recognises

partner.hr: Zašto nas ne nalaze na popisu?
partner.en: Why can't they find us on the list?

learner.hr: Rezervaciju sam stavila na muža, a govorim svoje prezime.
learner.en: I made the reservation under my husband's name but I'm giving my surname.

partner.en: Do you know the confirmation by heart?

learner.hr: Ne, ali poruku imam u telefonu.
learner.en: No, but I have the message on my phone.

partner.en: Will he arrive soon?

learner.hr: Hoće. S mužem sam se dogovorila da se nađemo ovdje.
learner.en: Yes. I agreed with my husband to meet here.

partner.en: They've found the reservation now.

learner.hr: Dobro. Idući put ću zapisati ime pod kojim rezerviram.
learner.en: Good. Next time I'll note the name I book under.

partner.hr: Hoćemo li sjesti dok ga čekamo?
partner.en: Shall we sit while we wait for him?

learner.hr: Hoćemo. Barem stol nije nestao, samo se krivo zvao.
learner.en: Yes. At least the table didn't disappear; it just had the wrong name.

conversations.title: Good news arrives during an ordinary lunch break

partner.en: I got the job!

learner.hr: Čestitam! Zato ti se lice promijenilo čim si pogledala telefon.
learner.en: Congratulations! That's why your expression changed as soon as you looked at your phone.

partner.hr: Još ne vjerujem da je stvarno.
partner.en: I still can't believe it's real.

learner.hr: Pročitaj poruku još jednom, polako. Neće nestati.
learner.en: Read the message once more, slowly. It won't disappear.

partner.en: I don't start until next month.

learner.hr: Onda imaš vremena pripremiti se i malo proslaviti.
learner.en: Then you have time to prepare and celebrate a little.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li sa mnom na kavu poslije?
partner.en: Will you have coffee with me afterwards?

learner.hr: Hoću. Radujem se što ovaj put slavimo dobru vijest.
learner.en: Yes. I'm happy that this time we're celebrating good news.

partner.hr: Ručak mi se sad potpuno ohladio.
partner.en: My lunch has gone completely cold now.

learner.hr: Nema veze. Danas barem imaš dobar razlog.
learner.en: Never mind. At least today you have a good reason.

conversations.title: A school gate sign is left over from building work

partner.en: Why aren't you going in this way?

learner.hr: Piše da je zabranjeno, ali radnici su već otišli.
learner.en: It says it's prohibited, but the workers have already left.

partner.en: Perhaps the sign was left by mistake.

learner.hr: Možda, ali neću ignorirati zabranu samo zato što mislim da više ne treba.
learner.en: Perhaps, but I won't ignore the ban just because I think it's no longer needed.

partner.en: Who can we ask?

learner.hr: Nekoga iz škole. Drugi ulaz je ionako otvoren.
learner.en: Someone from the school. The other entrance is open anyway.

partner.hr: Kažu da se staza još suši.
partner.en: They say the path is still drying.

learner.hr: Onda znak ima smisla. Dobro da nismo samo prošli.
learner.en: Then the sign makes sense. Good thing we didn't just walk through.

partner.en: Shall we go around?

learner.hr: Idemo. Izgubit ćemo dvije minute, ne cijeli dan.
learner.en: Yes. We'll lose two minutes, not a whole day.

conversations.title: A mature student finds a place in a new study group

partner.hr: Kako ti je bilo na prvom predavanju?
partner.en: How was your first lecture?

learner.hr: Dobro, iako su ostali studenti dosta mlađi.
learner.en: Good, although the other students are much younger.

partner.hr: Je li ti zbog toga neugodno?
partner.en: Does that make you uncomfortable?

learner.hr: Malo. Na studiju sam opet početnik, nakon godina na poslu.
learner.en: A little. At university I'm a beginner again, after years at work.

partner.en: Did you speak to anyone?

learner.hr: Jesam. Pitali su me želim li u njihovu grupu.
learner.en: Yes. They asked whether I'd like to join their group.

partner.en: Did you accept?

learner.hr: Jesam. Znaju nešto što ja ne znam, i obrnuto.
learner.en: Yes. They know things I don't, and vice versa.

partner.en: It sounds like a good start.

learner.hr: I meni. Sutra ću barem znati pokraj koga sjesti.
learner.en: To me too. Tomorrow at least I'll know whom to sit beside.

conversations.title: A market purchase uses the last cash in a travel wallet

partner.en: Why are you counting money before reaching the stall?

learner.hr: Ostalo mi je nekoliko funti i želim platiti u gotovini.
learner.en: I have a few pounds left and want to pay in cash.

partner.en: What are you planning to buy?

learner.hr: Staru razglednicu, ako nije preskupa.
learner.en: An old postcard, if it isn't too expensive.

partner.en: This one has a view of the river.

learner.hr: Sviđa mi se. Na njoj nema novih zgrada.
learner.en: I like it. It doesn't have the new buildings on it.

partner.en: Will you send it home?

learner.hr: Ne, sačuvat ću je uz današnju fotografiju istog mjesta.
learner.en: No, I'll keep it beside today's photograph of the same place.

partner.en: Do you have enough?

learner.hr: Imam, i još za čaj prije povratka.
learner.en: I do, and enough for tea before we return.

conversations.title: A walking tour gives a bridge two different stories

partner.en: Why is the other group saying something different?

learner.hr: Legenda očito ima više verzija.
learner.en: The legend clearly has several versions.

partner.en: Which one is right, then?

learner.hr: Ne znam. Takve legende često se mijenjaju dok se prepričavaju.
learner.en: I don't know. Legends like that often change as they're retold.

partner.en: Will you ask the guide?

learner.hr: Hoću, zanima me što je zapisano, a što usmena priča.
learner.en: Yes, I'm interested in what's recorded and what's an oral story.

partner.en: Will that spoil the experience?

learner.hr: Meni neće. I priča o promjeni priče može biti zanimljiva.
learner.en: Not for me. The story of how a story changes can be interesting too.

partner.en: Which version will we remember?

learner.hr: Obje, samo nećemo tvrditi da su povijesni dokaz.
learner.en: Both; we just won't claim they're historical proof.

conversations.title: A jigsaw animal has stripes in the wrong place

partner.en: Why does the lion have stripes?

learner.hr: Zato što sam ovdje složio dio na kojem je tigar.
learner.en: Because I put a piece from the tiger here.

partner.en: Do the pieces fit?

learner.hr: Skoro. Malo sam ih previše stiskao.
learner.en: Almost. I squeezed them a little too hard.

partner.en: Will you separate them?

learner.hr: Hoću. Nema smisla završiti sliku s pogrešnim životinjama.
learner.en: Yes. There's no point finishing the picture with the wrong animals.

partner.en: Where does this tail go, then?

learner.hr: Tu uz stablo. Sad vidim što sam zamijenio.
learner.en: Here beside the tree. Now I see what I mixed up.

partner.en: Have we saved the lion?

learner.hr: Jesmo. Sad ima pravo tijelo, bez tuđih pruga.
learner.en: Yes. Now it has the right body, without somebody else's stripes.

conversations.title: A cold walk ends with warm cups

partner.en: Why are you holding the cup with both hands?

learner.hr: Prsti su mi hladni nakon šetnje.
learner.en: My fingers are cold after the walk.

partner.en: Didn't you bring gloves?

learner.hr: Jesam, ali sam ih ostavio u torbi. Vrlo korisno.
learner.en: I did, but I left them in my bag. Very useful.

partner.en: Would you like more tea?

learner.hr: Hoću. Topla šalica mi zasad više znači od okusa.
learner.en: Yes. The warm cup matters more to me than the taste for now.

partner.hr: Sljedeći put provjeravamo torbe prije polaska.
partner.en: Next time we'll check our bags before leaving.

learner.hr: Ili ih otvorim tijekom šetnje. I to bi bio napredak.
learner.en: Or I could open mine during the walk. That would be progress too.

partner.en: Have your hands warmed up?

learner.hr: Jesu. Sad mogu napokon odvezati cipele.
learner.en: Yes. Now I can finally untie my shoes.

conversations.title: A neglected basil plant produces one new leaf

partner.hr: Zašto gledaš u teglicu kao u čudo?
partner.en: Why are you looking at the pot as though it's a miracle?

learner.hr: Biljka je još živa. Pojavio se novi list.
learner.en: The plant is still alive. A new leaf has appeared.

partner.en: Did you think it had dried out?

learner.hr: Jesam. Zaboravio sam je tijekom putovanja.
learner.en: Yes. I forgot it during my trip.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li je sad staviti na bolji prozor?
partner.en: Will you put it by a better window now?

learner.hr: Hoću, i pitati kako je pravilno njegovati.
learner.en: Yes, and ask how to care for it properly.

partner.en: So you're not buying another one?

learner.hr: Ne još. Prvo želim ovu održati živu.
learner.en: Not yet. First I want to keep this one alive.

partner.hr: A ako opet odeš na put?
partner.en: What if you go away again?

learner.hr: Dat ću ti ključ prije polaska, ne nakon povratka.
learner.en: I'll give you the key before leaving, not after returning.

conversations.title: A first window-seat passenger spots the wing

partner.en: Why are you leaning across me?

learner.hr: Želim vidjeti krilo zrakoplova. Nikad nisam sjedio uz prozor.
learner.en: I want to see the aircraft's wing. I've never sat by the window.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li se zamijeniti sa mnom?
partner.en: Would you like to swap with me?

learner.hr: Ako ti ne smeta. Zrakoplov mi izvana uvijek izgleda manji.
learner.en: If you don't mind. An aircraft always looks smaller to me from outside.

partner.en: Just wait until we're allowed to stand up.

learner.hr: Naravno. Nisam mislio preskakati sjedala.
learner.en: Of course. I wasn't planning to climb over the seats.

partner.en: Can you see better now?

learner.hr: Vidim. Čak mi je i oblake zanimljivo gledati ovako.
learner.en: Yes. Even the clouds are interesting to look at this way.

partner.hr: Probudi me kad bude nešto posebno.
partner.en: Wake me when there's something special.

learner.hr: Hoću, ali meni je zasad sve posebno.
learner.en: I will, but everything is special to me so far.

conversations.title: A missed deadline was hidden in an old message

partner.en: Why didn't you submit the request earlier?

learner.hr: Svjesna sam da kasnim. Gledala sam stari raspored.
learner.en: I'm aware I'm late. I was looking at the old schedule.

partner.en: Are you the only one?

learner.hr: Nisam. Ni kolega nije bio svjestan promjene datuma.
learner.en: No. My colleague wasn't aware of the date change either.

partner.en: So the message was unclear?

learner.hr: Možda, ali trebala sam provjeriti noviju obavijest.
learner.en: Perhaps, but I should have checked the newer notice.

partner.en: What can you do now?

learner.hr: Pitat ću postoji li mogućnost naknadne predaje.
learner.en: I'll ask whether late submission is possible.

partner.en: Will you write down the reply?

learner.hr: Hoću. Ovaj put neću vjerovati samo svom sjećanju.
learner.en: Yes. This time I won't rely only on my memory.

conversations.title: A language learner chooses a sustainable pace

partner.en: How often do you attend the course?

learner.hr: Jednom tjedno. Ostalim danima kratko ponavljam doma.
learner.en: Once a week. On the other days I review briefly at home.

partner.en: Isn't that too little?

learner.hr: U prvom tjednu htio sam učiti svaki dan satima. Nije potrajalo.
learner.en: In the first week I wanted to study for hours every day. It didn't last.

partner.en: What did you change?

learner.hr: Manji cilj. Bolje deset minuta nego stalno odgađanje.
learner.en: A smaller goal. Better ten minutes than constant postponement.

partner.en: Do you notice progress?

learner.hr: Primjećujem kad razumijem nešto što mi je prije zvučalo nepoznato.
learner.en: I notice it when I understand something that used to sound unfamiliar.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li kasnije dodati još vremena?
partner.en: Will you add more time later?

learner.hr: Možda. Zasad želim zadržati naviku, ne rekord.
learner.en: Perhaps. For now I want to maintain a habit, not a record.

conversations.title: A dog notices a rabbit before its owner does

partner.hr: Zašto si naglo skrenuo sa staze?
partner.en: Why did you suddenly turn off the path?

learner.hr: Pas je ugledao zeca, a ja sam gledao kartu.
learner.en: The dog spotted a rabbit while I was looking at the map.

partner.en: Did he pull the lead?

learner.hr: Jest, ali sam stao. Nismo krenuli za njim.
learner.en: Yes, but I stopped. We didn't go after it.

partner.en: Can you still see the rabbit?

learner.hr: Ne. Pas ga traži, a zec je već daleko.
learner.en: No. The dog is looking for it, and the rabbit is far away already.

partner.en: Shall we continue?

learner.hr: Hoćemo kad se malo smiri. Sad ništa drugo ne primjećuje.
learner.en: Yes, once he calms down a little. Right now he notices nothing else.

partner.en: What about the map?

learner.hr: Spremam je. Danas mi navigacija očito treba i ispred nogu.
learner.en: I'm putting it away. Today I clearly need navigation right in front of my feet too.

conversations.title: A reluctant singer finds one familiar karaoke song

partner.en: Why are you hiding behind the menu?

learner.hr: Nisam planirao pjevati pred svima. Došao sam jesti.
learner.en: I didn't plan to sing in front of everyone. I came to eat.

partner.en: You must know at least one song.

learner.hr: Znam nekoliko pjesama, ali u kuhinji zvučim hrabrije.
learner.en: I know a few songs, but I sound braver in the kitchen.

partner.en: We can sing together.

learner.hr: Onda možda. Samo izaberi nešto bez previsokih tonova.
learner.en: Then perhaps. Just choose something without very high notes.

partner.en: We listened to this one all summer.

learner.hr: Nju znam. Ako zaboravim riječi, ti nastavi.
learner.en: I know it. If I forget the words, you carry on.

partner.en: Ready?

learner.hr: Spreman koliko ću ikad biti. Večera mi sada izgleda lakši dio.
learner.en: As ready as I'll ever be. Dinner looks like the easy part now.

conversations.title: A found bracelet resembles two people’s missing jewellery

partner.en: Is this your bracelet?

learner.hr: Možda. Moja izgubljena narukvica imala je malo srce na kopči.
learner.en: Perhaps. My lost bracelet had a little heart on the clasp.

partner.en: This one was found by the post office.

learner.hr: Tamo sam jučer bila. Možeš li pokazati kopču?
learner.en: I was there yesterday. Can you show me the clasp?

partner.en: Here, there's no heart.

learner.hr: Onda nije moja. Nađena narukvica zaslužuje pravog vlasnika.
learner.en: Then it isn't mine. The bracelet that was found deserves its real owner.

partner.en: Shall I hand it in at the counter?

learner.hr: Pitaj postoji li njihovo mjesto za izgubljene stvari.
learner.en: Ask whether they have a place for lost property.

partner.en: What about yours?

learner.hr: Nastavit ću tražiti. Barem nisam ponijela tuđu doma.
learner.en: I'll keep looking. At least I didn't take somebody else's home.

conversations.title: A cleaning invoice lists the wrong apartment size

partner.en: Why haven't you paid the bill yet?

learner.hr: Cijena usluge je viša od dogovorene. Provjeravam razlog.
learner.en: The service price is higher than agreed. I'm checking why.

partner.en: Does it say what they did?

learner.hr: Piše, ali kvadratura stana je pogrešna.
learner.en: Yes, but the flat's floor area is wrong.

partner.en: Have you called them?

learner.hr: Jesam. Traže potvrdu ponude da provjere unos.
learner.en: Yes. They want the quote confirmation to check the entry.

partner.en: Do you still have it?

learner.hr: Imam poruku tvrtke s dogovorenim iznosom.
learner.en: I have the company's message with the agreed amount.

partner.en: Will you send it to them?

learner.hr: Hoću. Možda je obična pogreška, neću odmah zaključivati najgore.
learner.en: Yes. It may be a simple error; I won't immediately assume the worst.

conversations.title: A new mirror still has fingerprints beneath its wrapper

partner.en: Why are you wiping a brand-new mirror?

learner.hr: Ogledalo ima tragove prstiju ispod zaštitne folije.
learner.en: The mirror has fingerprints beneath the protective film.

partner.en: Are they scratches?

learner.hr: Ne, srećom. Samo se vide kad svjetlo padne sa strane.
learner.en: No, fortunately. They only show when light hits from the side.

partner.en: What will you use to remove them?

learner.hr: Prvo ću pogledati upute za čišćenje površine.
learner.en: First I'll check the instructions for cleaning the surface.

partner.en: Will you hang it straight away?

learner.hr: Kad ga očistim. Inače ću stalno gledati iste tragove.
learner.en: Once I've cleaned it. Otherwise I'll keep looking at the same marks.

partner.en: It looks better now.

learner.hr: Jest, samo ga nemoj opet uhvatiti po sredini.
learner.en: Yes, just don't grab it in the middle again.

conversations.title: A local quiz champion forgets an easy answer

partner.hr: Kako prvak nije znao ovo pitanje?
partner.en: How did the champion not know that question?

learner.hr: Dogodi se. Ni ja se nisam sjetio odgovora dok nije bilo prekasno.
learner.en: It happens. I didn't remember the answer either until it was too late.

partner.hr: Ali to mu je omiljena tema.
partner.en: But it's his favourite topic.

learner.hr: Znam. Kad te svi gledaju, i lak odgovor može nestati iz glave.
learner.en: I know. When everyone's watching, even an easy answer can slip your mind.

partner.en: Do we have a chance to win now?

learner.hr: Šansa postoji, ali još moramo odgovoriti na svoja pitanja.
learner.en: There's a chance, but we still have to answer our own questions.

partner.en: Then let's not celebrate too early.

learner.hr: Upravo tako. On je već okrenuo sljedeću karticu.
learner.en: Exactly. He's already turned over the next card.

partner.en: Do you know this answer?

learner.hr: Znam, samo mi daj da ga izgovorim prije nove rasprave.
learner.en: Yes, just let me say it before another discussion starts.

conversations.title: Residents prepare one clear question for a public meeting

partner.hr: Zašto pišeš govor za jednu minutu?
partner.en: Why are you writing a one-minute speech?

learner.hr: Vijeće prima pitanja građana. Ne želim potrošiti vrijeme na uvod.
learner.en: The council is taking residents' questions. I don't want to use up the time on an introduction.

partner.en: What will you ask?

learner.hr: Kad će se popraviti staza do stanice.
learner.en: When the path to the stop will be repaired.

partner.en: Didn't they already promise that?

learner.hr: Jesu. Zato građani žele rok, ne još jedno općenito obećanje.
learner.en: They did. That's why residents want a deadline, not another general promise.

partner.en: Will you add photographs?

learner.hr: Poslat ću ih unaprijed, da se vidi točno mjesto.
learner.en: I'll send them beforehand so the exact spot is clear.

partner.en: Shall I read the question before you send it?

learner.hr: Molim te. Ako zvuči nejasno, bolje da to sad saznam.
learner.en: Please. If it sounds unclear, I'd rather learn that now.

conversations.title: New dance shoes need a shorter first evening

partner.en: Why did you sit down in the middle of the song?

learner.hr: Desno stopalo me žulja. Cipele su nove.
learner.en: My right foot is chafing. The shoes are new.

partner.en: Will you try one more?

learner.hr: Ne odmah. Noga mi već traži odmor.
learner.en: Not straight away. My leg is already asking for a rest.

partner.en: Do you have other shoes?

learner.hr: Imam u torbi. Prvi put sam ih pametno ponijela.
learner.en: Yes, in my bag. For once I was sensible enough to bring them.

partner.en: Do you need help with the buckle?

learner.hr: Trebam. Sad je ne mogu ni pogledati bez ljutnje.
learner.en: Yes. Right now I can't even look at it without annoyance.

partner.en: Shall we dance later?

learner.hr: Može. Radije u običnim cipelama nego bolno u svečanim.
learner.en: Yes. Better in ordinary shoes than painfully in formal ones.

conversations.title: A child admits hiding a poor school result

partner.en: Why didn't you show me the test?

learner.hr: Bojao sam se da ćeš biti ljut, pa sam ga sakrio.
learner.en: I was afraid you'd be angry, so I hid it.

partner.hr: Znaš li što me sad brine?
partner.en: Do you know what worries me now?

learner.hr: Da ti lažem. Znam da tako ne možemo riješiti problem.
learner.en: That I'm lying to you. I know we can't solve the problem that way.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li mi reći što nisi razumio?
partner.en: Will you tell me what you didn't understand?

learner.hr: Hoću. Lakše mi je nego nastaviti lagati da je sve dobro.
learner.en: Yes. That's easier than continuing to lie that everything is fine.

partner.en: We can look at the exercises together.

learner.hr: Možemo, ali nemoj odmah govoriti odgovore umjesto mene.
learner.en: Yes, but don't immediately give the answers for me.

partner.en: Agreed, you try first.

learner.hr: U redu. Onda barem znam odakle početi.
learner.en: All right. Then at least I know where to begin.

conversations.title: A shadow game makes an ordinary room mysterious

partner.en: Why did you switch off the big lamp?

learner.hr: Da bude mračno iza nas. Tako se sjene bolje vide.
learner.en: To make it dark behind us. That makes the shadows clearer.

partner.en: What are you trying to make with your hands?

learner.hr: Pticu, ali zasad izgleda kao pokvaren kišobran.
learner.en: A bird, but so far it looks like a broken umbrella.

partner.en: Can I try?

learner.hr: Možeš. Samo nemoj stati ispred male lampe.
learner.en: Yes. Just don't stand in front of the little lamp.

partner.en: Is this a rabbit?

learner.hr: Jest, i bolji je od moje ptice.
learner.en: Yes, and it's better than my bird.

partner.hr: Hoćemo li pozvati mamu da pogodi?
partner.en: Shall we ask Mum to guess?

learner.hr: Hoćemo, bez objašnjavanja. Da vidimo je li zec i drugima.
learner.en: Yes, without explaining. Let's see whether it's a rabbit to other people too.

conversations.title: A choir leader learns to give one instruction at a time

partner.en: Why did you stop rehearsal?

learner.hr: Rekao sam slušajte, a onda dao pet različitih uputa.
learner.en: I said listen, then gave five different instructions.

partner.en: Did you lose them?

learner.hr: Potpuno. Ponavljao sam: djeco, polako. A zapravo sam trebao usporiti ja.
learner.en: Completely. I kept saying: children, slow down. But really I was the one who needed to slow down.

partner.en: How will you start again?

learner.hr: Jedna uputa, pa pokušaj. Ne cijeli govor prije prvog tona.
learner.en: One instruction, then an attempt. Not a whole speech before the first note.

partner.en: Will you demonstrate rather than explain?

learner.hr: Hoću. Možda se razlika lakše čuje nego opisuje.
learner.en: Yes. Perhaps the difference is easier to hear than describe.

partner.en: Is it better now?

learner.hr: Jest. I ja manje govorim, što je već uspjeh.
learner.en: Yes. And I'm talking less, which is already a success.

conversations.title: A drawing class starts with an unglamorous subject

partner.en: Why are we drawing old shoes today?

learner.hr: Umjetnost valjda može početi i od nečega što nije cvijeće.
learner.en: Art can surely begin with something other than flowers.

partner.en: But mine are really ugly.

learner.hr: Onda imaju mnogo detalja. Pogledaj pregibe i sjene.
learner.en: Then they have lots of detail. Look at the folds and shadows.

partner.hr: Mislio sam da ćemo nešto ljepše.
partner.en: I thought we'd do something prettier.

learner.hr: I ja, ali učimo gledati, ne samo birati ukrase.
learner.en: So did I, but we're learning to look, not just choose decorations.

partner.en: You sound like the teacher.

learner.hr: Previše sam čitao o umjetnosti prije prvog sata.
learner.en: I read too much about art before the first lesson.

partner.hr: Je li ti barem crtež dobar?
partner.en: Is your drawing at least good?

learner.hr: Još nije. Moje cipele zasad izgledaju kao dva kruha.
learner.en: Not yet. My shoes look like two loaves so far.

conversations.title: A small backpack forces a choice about extras

partner.en: Why are you taking the book out of the backpack?

learner.hr: Lagana torba ima prednosti, ali moram nešto ostaviti.
learner.en: A light bag has advantages, but I need to leave something behind.

partner.en: Did you plan to read at the summit?

learner.hr: Jesam, iako svaki put samo gledam krajolik.
learner.en: Yes, although every time I just look at the view.

partner.en: What about the spare jacket?

learner.hr: Ona ostaje. Bez nje je ipak prevelik rizik.
learner.en: That stays. It would be too risky without it.

partner.en: What else are you carrying for no reason?

learner.hr: Dvije bilježnice. Kao da jedna ne može primiti sve moje misli.
learner.en: Two notebooks. As though one can't hold all my thoughts.

partner.en: Is it lighter now?

learner.hr: Jest. Sad ne moram odmarati prije nego što uopće krenemo.
learner.en: Yes. Now I don't need to rest before we even set off.

conversations.title: A strategy-game player forgets to protect the gate

partner.en: Why is your castle empty?

learner.hr: Sav sam novac potrošio na napad.
learner.en: I spent all my money on the attack.

partner.en: Didn't you leave anyone at the gate?

learner.hr: Nisam. Očito moram učiti i obranu, ne samo skupljati vojsku.
learner.en: No. Clearly I need to learn defence too, not just gather an army.

partner.en: Shall we take back one move?

learner.hr: Radije ne. Želim vidjeti mogu li spasiti ovu situaciju.
learner.en: I'd rather not. I want to see whether I can salvage this situation.

partner.en: What do you have left?

learner.hr: Jedan zid i mnogo optimizma.
learner.en: One wall and a lot of optimism.

partner.en: Optimism isn't in the rules.

learner.hr: Šteta. To mi je trenutačno najjači resurs.
learner.en: A pity. It's my strongest resource at the moment.

conversations.title: A paper crown matches only half the costume

partner.hr: Zašto je kruna zlatna, a cipele plave?
partner.en: Why is the crown gold but the shoes blue?

learner.hr: Ponestalo nam je istog papira.
learner.en: We ran out of the same paper.

partner.en: Will you change everything now?

learner.hr: Ne. Zlatne cipele nisu uvjet da budeš kraljica.
learner.en: No. Gold shoes aren't a requirement for being a queen.

partner.hr: Ali na slici su sve iste boje.
partner.en: But in the picture they're all the same colour.

learner.hr: Naša verzija može biti drukčija. I lakše se hoda u pravim cipelama.
learner.en: Our version can be different. And it's easier to walk in real shoes.

partner.hr: Hoću li se ipak dobro vidjeti na pozornici?
partner.en: Will I still show up well on stage?

learner.hr: Hoćeš. Kruna ti gotovo dodiruje gornji rub kulise.
learner.en: Yes. Your crown almost touches the top of the scenery.

partner.en: Then I'm ready.

learner.hr: Jesi. Samo pri prolasku kroz vrata malo sagni glavu.
learner.en: You are. Just duck your head a little when going through the doorway.

conversations.title: A clean towel is mixed with the swimming bag

partner.en: Does this towel need washing?

learner.hr: Ne, čist je. Samo je završio u krivoj torbi.
learner.en: No, it's clean. It just ended up in the wrong bag.

partner.en: Why is it wet, then?

learner.hr: Bio je uz bocu koja je procurila. Nije prljav.
learner.en: It was next to a bottle that leaked. It isn't dirty.

partner.en: Shall I hang it up?

learner.hr: Da, neka se osuši prije spremanja.
learner.en: Yes, let it dry before putting it away.

partner.en: What about the other one?

learner.hr: Taj je stvarno s bazena. Njega slobodno stavi na pranje.
learner.en: That one really is from the pool. You can put it in the wash.

partner.en: We need to label the bags.

learner.hr: Ili ih isprazniti kad dođemo, što smo već sto puta rekli.
learner.en: Or empty them when we get home, which we've said a hundred times already.

conversations.title: A forgotten staff badge delays an office visit

partner.en: Why are you waiting at reception?

learner.hr: Zaboravio sam karticu. Moraju provjeriti moj identitet.
learner.en: I forgot my pass. They need to check my identity.

partner.en: Don't they know you here?

learner.hr: Nova je smjena. Osobna mi je srećom u novčaniku.
learner.en: It's a new shift. Fortunately my identity card is in my wallet.

partner.hr: Hoće li nazvati nekoga iz ureda?
partner.en: Will they call someone from the office?

learner.hr: Hoće, kolegicu koja zna da dolazim.
learner.en: Yes, a colleague who knows I'm coming.

partner.en: Does the wait annoy you?

learner.hr: Malo, ali pravila ne mogu ovisiti samo o tome koliko uvjerljivo izgledam.
learner.en: A little, but the rules can't depend only on how convincing I look.

partner.en: What will you do next time?

learner.hr: Karticu staviti uz ključeve, umjesto uz jučerašnji račun.
learner.en: Put the pass beside my keys instead of yesterday's receipt.

conversations.title: A plant pot arrives bigger than the photograph suggested

partner.hr: Je li ovo za tvoj mali balkon?
partner.en: Is this for your little balcony?

learner.hr: Jest. Lonac je ogroman u usporedbi sa slikom.
learner.en: Yes. The pot is enormous compared with the picture.

partner.en: Didn't you read the dimensions?

learner.hr: Jesam, ali nisam zamislio koliko prostora zauzima metar širine.
learner.en: I did, but I didn't picture how much space a metre in width takes up.

partner.en: Will it fit through the door?

learner.hr: Hoće ako ga okrenemo. Za balkon još nisam siguran.
learner.en: Yes, if we turn it. I'm still not sure about the balcony.

partner.en: Can you return it?

learner.hr: Provjerit ću. Ne želim prvo napuniti zemljom pa shvatiti da nemam prolaz.
learner.en: I'll check. I don't want to fill it with soil before realising I have no way past.

partner.en: What about the plant you planned?

learner.hr: Zasad ostaje u staroj posudi. Ona barem zna svoju veličinu.
learner.en: It's staying in the old pot for now. At least it knows its own size.

conversations.title: A friend cannot tell whether an invitation is a joke

partner.en: Why aren't you replying to the invitation?

learner.hr: Ne znam šališ li se ili stvarno očekuješ da dođem u šest ujutro.
learner.en: I don't know whether you're joking or really expect me at six in the morning.

partner.en: Really; we're going to watch the sunrise.

learner.hr: Onda govoriš ozbiljno. Ja sam mislio da je u poruci pogrešno vrijeme.
learner.en: So you're serious. I thought the time in the message was wrong.

partner.en: So you won't come?

learner.hr: Nisam to rekao. Samo mi treba vremena da prihvatim takav sat.
learner.en: I didn't say that. I just need time to accept an hour like that.

partner.en: Shall I bring you coffee?

learner.hr: To već zvuči kao uvjerljiviji plan.
learner.en: That sounds like a more convincing plan.

partner.en: Agreed, then?

learner.hr: Dogovoreno. Ako ne otvorim oči, barem ću mirisati kavu.
learner.en: Agreed. If I don't open my eyes, at least I'll smell the coffee.

conversations.title: A former smoker misses the usual balcony conversation

partner.hr: Zašto ne ideš s nama na balkon?
partner.en: Why aren't you coming to the balcony with us?

learner.hr: Ne pušim više, pa mi je čudno stajati tamo bez razloga.
learner.en: I don't smoke anymore, so it feels strange to stand there for no reason.

partner.en: The conversation can be a reason.

learner.hr: Može. Pušenje mi je bilo i izgovor za kratki predah.
learner.en: It can. Smoking was also my excuse for a short break.

partner.en: Would you like us to stay inside?

learner.hr: Ne morate zbog mene. Samo ću ponijeti čaj.
learner.en: You don't have to for me. I'll just bring tea.

partner.hr: Je li ti teško ovih dana?
partner.en: Is it difficult these days?

learner.hr: Ponekad. Najviše me iznenade navike kojih nisam bio svjestan.
learner.en: Sometimes. What surprises me most are habits I wasn't aware of.

partner.hr: Onda idemo polako, bez velikih govora.
partner.en: Then let's take it slowly, without grand speeches.

learner.hr: Hvala. Društvo mi je korisnije od još jednog predavanja.
learner.en: Thank you. Company is more useful to me than another lecture.

conversations.title: A science fair changes a child’s idea of a scientist

partner.hr: Što ti je danas bilo najzanimljivije?
partner.en: What interested you most today?

learner.hr: Što znanstvenik nije cijelo vrijeme stajao u bijelom kaputu.
learner.en: That the scientist didn't stand in a white coat the whole time.

partner.en: What was he doing?

learner.hr: Pokazivao kako mjeri temperaturu vode iz rijeke i zapisuje rezultate.
learner.en: Showing how he measures the temperature of river water and records the results.

partner.en: Were you expecting big machines?

learner.hr: Jesam. Znanost sam zamišljao kao svjetla i čudne zvukove.
learner.en: Yes. I imagined science as lights and strange noises.

partner.en: And now?

learner.hr: Sad mi je zanimljivo i obično pitanje na koje ne znam odgovor.
learner.en: Now even an ordinary question I can't answer interests me.

partner.en: Will you come back tomorrow?

learner.hr: Hoću. Rekli su da možemo donijeti svoje pitanje.
learner.en: Yes. They said we could bring our own question.

conversations.title: A thank-you note names the work people rarely notice

partner.hr: Zašto još pišeš nakon završetka priredbe?
partner.en: Why are you still writing after the event?

learner.hr: Sastavljam pismo zahvalnosti volonterima.
learner.en: I'm putting together a thank-you letter for the volunteers.

partner.hr: Ne možeš samo poslati kratko hvala?
partner.en: Can't you just send a brief thank you?

learner.hr: Mogu, ali želim navesti što je tko napravio.
learner.en: I can, but I want to mention what each person did.

partner.en: Who do people most often forget?

learner.hr: One koji čiste i spremaju kad publika ode.
learner.en: Those who clean and pack up after the audience leaves.

partner.en: Will you name them?

learner.hr: Hoću. Zahvaljujem im za sav trud koji se ne vidi na fotografijama.
learner.en: Yes. I'm thanking them for all the effort that doesn't show in photographs.

partner.en: Shall I check the list too?

learner.hr: Molim te. Ne želim da netko opet ostane nevidljiv.
learner.en: Please. I don't want anyone to be invisible again.

conversations.title: A small workshop hires its first employee

partner.en: Why do you have two sets of keys?

learner.hr: Zaposlio sam prvu osobu u radionici.
learner.en: I've hired the first person for the workshop.

partner.en: Isn't hiring someone difficult?

learner.hr: Jest. Želim zaposliti suradnika, ne samo nekoga tko će nositi kutije.
learner.en: Yes. I want to hire a colleague, not just someone to carry boxes.

partner.en: Has he started yet?

learner.hr: Od ponedjeljka je zaposlen. Ovaj tjedan pripremam radno mjesto.
learner.en: He's employed from Monday. This week I'm preparing the workspace.

partner.en: What will he do first?

learner.hr: Pokazat ću mu narudžbe pa ćemo dogovoriti podjelu.
learner.en: I'll show him the orders, then we'll agree how to divide the work.

partner.en: Are you looking forward to it?

learner.hr: Veselim. Samo se moram odviknuti da sve odlučujem sam.
learner.en: Yes. I just need to stop deciding everything by myself.

conversations.title: A student weighs two different placements

partner.en: Why haven't you chosen a placement yet?

learner.hr: Jedna mi je bliža, druga bolje odgovara mojoj karijeri.
learner.en: One is nearer; the other fits my career better.

partner.hr: Znaš li već čime se želiš baviti?
partner.en: Do you already know what you want to do?

learner.hr: Ne sasvim. Ne želim planirati cijelu karijeru prema jednoj ponudi.
learner.en: Not entirely. I don't want to plan my whole career around one offer.

partner.en: What would you like to learn?

learner.hr: Kako izgleda svakodnevni posao, ne samo lijepa strana karijere.
learner.en: What everyday work is like, not just the attractive side of a career.

partner.hr: Možeš li razgovarati s bivšim praktikantima?
partner.en: Can you speak with former interns?

learner.hr: Mogu. To ću napraviti prije odluke.
learner.en: Yes. I'll do that before deciding.

partner.en: Then you won't be choosing blindly.

learner.hr: Upravo tako. Blizina je važna, ali nije jedino pitanje.
learner.en: Exactly. Distance matters, but it isn't the only issue.

conversations.title: An amateur film gets a borrowed camera

partner.en: Where did you get this camera?

learner.hr: Producent kratkog filma posudio nam je svoju.
learner.en: A short-film producer lent us his.

partner.en: Will everything look professional now?

learner.hr: Oprema pomaže, ali profesionalno snimanje traži i znanje.
learner.en: Equipment helps, but professional filming also takes knowledge.

partner.hr: Hoće li on raditi s vama?
partner.en: Will he work with you?

learner.hr: Pokazat će nam osnove. Mi ostajemo amateri.
learner.en: He'll show us the basics. We're still amateurs.

partner.en: What are you filming first?

learner.hr: Jedan razgovor u kuhinji. Bez velikih pokreta kamere.
learner.en: A conversation in a kitchen. Without big camera movements.

partner.hr: A ako slika ipak bude loša?
partner.en: What if the picture is still poor?

learner.hr: Onda ćemo barem znati da ne možemo kriviti samo kameru.
learner.en: Then at least we'll know we can't blame only the camera.

conversations.title: A river sample arrives without its location label

partner.en: Why aren't you starting the analysis?

learner.hr: Netko je donio vodu bez oznake mjesta.
learner.en: Someone brought water without a location label.

partner.en: Can you do the tests anyway?

learner.hr: Možemo napraviti testove, ali ne možemo rezultat povezati s rijekom.
learner.en: We can do the tests, but we can't link the result to the river.

partner.en: Who brought it?

learner.hr: Učenik iz druge grupe. Pitat ću ima li bilješke.
learner.en: A pupil from another group. I'll ask whether he has notes.

partner.en: Did he record the time?

learner.hr: Jest. U bilježnici je opisao i mjesto uzimanja.
learner.en: Yes. In his notebook he described the collection spot too.

partner.en: Is the problem solved now?

learner.hr: Za ovu analizu jest. Sljedeći put oznake stavljamo odmah.
learner.en: For this analysis, yes. Next time we label things immediately.

conversations.title: A historical map changes between two pages

partner.hr: Zašto je isti grad druge boje?
partner.en: Why is the same town a different colour?

learner.hr: Na drugoj karti pripada drugom carstvu.
learner.en: On the second map it belongs to another empire.

partner.hr: Jesu li karte iz iste godine?
partner.en: Are the maps from the same year?

learner.hr: Nisu. Ovdje piše da se staro carstvo raspalo između tih datuma.
learner.en: No. It says the old empire broke apart between those dates.

partner.hr: Znači, ljudi su se svi preselili?
partner.en: So all the people moved?

learner.hr: Ne nužno. Promjena granice nije uvijek preseljenje stanovništva.
learner.en: Not necessarily. A border change isn't always a population move.

partner.en: What are we reading about next, then?

learner.hr: O životu u tim drevnim gradovima, ne samo o imenima vladara.
learner.en: Life in those ancient towns, not only rulers' names.

partner.en: Shall we keep both maps?

learner.hr: Hoćemo. Bez datuma bih i ja pomislio da je jedna pogrešna.
learner.en: Yes. Without the dates I'd have thought one was wrong too.

conversations.title: A new librarian learns the return machine

partner.hr: Zašto stojiš uz uređaj za povrat?
partner.en: Why are you standing beside the returns machine?

learner.hr: Danas imam obuku za njegovo korištenje.
learner.en: Today I have training in using it.

partner.en: Don't you just put the book in?

learner.hr: Korisnik da. Ja trebam znati što kad nešto zapne.
learner.en: The reader does. I need to know what to do when something gets stuck.

partner.en: Has that happened already?

learner.hr: Jest, vratili su knjigu s papirom preko oznake.
learner.en: Yes, someone returned a book with paper covering its code.

partner.en: Can you sort it out yourself now?

learner.hr: Mogu uz upute. Neću otvarati uređaj na svoju ruku.
learner.en: With instructions. I won't open the machine on my own initiative.

partner.en: How's your first week going?

learner.hr: Dobro. Svaki dan otkrijem koliko posla čitatelji ne vide.
learner.en: Well. Every day I discover how much work readers don't see.

conversations.title: A night crossing is somebody’s first cabin journey

partner.en: Why are you carrying a pillow onto the deck?

learner.hr: Nisam znao da ćemo spavati u kabini.
learner.en: I didn't know we'd sleep in a cabin.

partner.en: It said so on the ticket.

learner.hr: Izgleda da sam nepažljiv putnik. Pročitao sam samo vrijeme polaska.
learner.en: Apparently I'm an inattentive traveller. I only read the departure time.

partner.hr: Jesi li već bio na takvom putovanju?
partner.en: Have you been on a journey like this before?

learner.hr: Nisam. Na ovom putovanju sve mi je novo.
learner.en: No. Everything on this journey is new to me.

partner.en: Would you like to see the cabin first?

learner.hr: Hoću, da ne smetam s jastukom na večeri.
learner.en: Yes, so I don't get in the way with my pillow at dinner.

partner.en: You see, the bedding is already there.

learner.hr: Dobro. Moj jastuk očito je samo došao na odmor.
learner.en: Good. Clearly my pillow has just come along for a holiday.

conversations.title: A piano student compares recordings a year apart

partner.en: Why are you listening to an old recording?

learner.hr: Da čujem koliko sam napredovao. Inače primijetim samo današnje pogreške.
learner.en: To hear how much I've improved. Otherwise I only notice today's mistakes.

partner.en: Can you hear a big difference?

learner.hr: Čujem. Mislio sam da nemam sposobnosti za ovo.
learner.en: Yes. I thought I didn't have the ability for this.

partner.en: And now?

learner.hr: Sad vidim da je i ovo vještina koja raste vježbom.
learner.en: Now I see this is also a skill that grows with practice.

partner.en: Will you post both recordings?

learner.hr: Ne još. Zasad ih čuvam kao podsjetnik sebi.
learner.en: Not yet. For now I'm keeping them as a reminder to myself.

partner.en: What will you record next year?

learner.hr: Istu skladbu. Nadam se s manje ljutnje na vlastite prste.
learner.en: The same piece. Hopefully with less annoyance at my own fingers.

conversations.title: A social club changes its name on a sign

partner.en: Why are you rewriting the name?

learner.hr: Zajednica je promijenila ime nakon spajanja dviju grupa.
learner.en: The community changed its name after two groups merged.

partner.hr: Hoće li stari članovi biti zbunjeni?
partner.en: Will old members be confused?

learner.hr: Neki već jesu. Zato pišem i prethodne nazive.
learner.en: Some already are. That's why I'm writing the previous names too.

partner.en: What's actually changing?

learner.hr: Raspored prostora i sastanaka. Cilj zajednice ostaje isti.
learner.en: The room and meeting schedule. The community's purpose stays the same.

partner.hr: Možeš li to kratko objasniti ispod?
partner.en: Can you explain that briefly underneath?

learner.hr: Mogu, bez velikog govora. Ljudi samo žele znati kada doći.
learner.en: Yes, without a grand speech. People just want to know when to come.

partner.hr: Da stavimo i broj za pitanja?
partner.en: Shall we include a number for questions?

learner.hr: Da. Lakše je odgovoriti nego gledati ljude kako odlaze s krivih vrata.
learner.en: Yes. Answering is easier than watching people leave the wrong door.

conversations.title: A village bus route is shortened on a map

partner.hr: Zašto na novoj karti nema naše stanice?
partner.en: Why doesn't the new map show our stop?

learner.hr: Liniju su skratili do centra.
learner.en: They shortened the route to the centre.

partner.en: How will you get to work, then?

learner.hr: Morat ću presjesti. Već tražim kombinaciju koja nije preduga.
learner.en: I'll have to change. I'm already looking for a connection that isn't too long.

partner.en: Have you read the operator's notice?

learner.hr: Jesam. Piše da promjena počinje sljedeći mjesec.
learner.en: Yes. It says the change begins next month.

partner.en: Will you send feedback?

learner.hr: Hoćemo. Mnogim susjedima ova veza treba svakodnevno.
learner.en: Yes. Many neighbours need this connection every day.

partner.en: What will you state?

learner.hr: Konkretne polaske i vrijeme presjedanja, ne samo da nam smeta.
learner.en: Specific departures and transfer times, not just that it bothers us.

conversations.title: An old prison cell is smaller than a visitor expected

partner.hr: Je li ovo bila čitava soba?
partner.en: Was this the whole room?

learner.hr: Da, ova ćelija nije imala ni poseban prostor za spavanje.
learner.en: Yes, this cell didn't even have a separate sleeping area.

partner.en: May we go in?

learner.hr: Piše da smijemo, ali vrata ćelije ostaju otvorena.
learner.en: The sign says we may, but the cell door stays open.

partner.en: Why are you standing in the doorway?

learner.hr: Nije mi ugodno ni kad znam da mogu izaći.
learner.en: I feel uneasy even knowing I can leave.

partner.en: Shall we skip it?

learner.hr: Možemo samo pročitati opis. Ne moram sve iskusiti iznutra.
learner.en: We can just read the description. I don't have to experience everything from inside.

partner.en: Let's go to the next room, then.

learner.hr: Idemo. Želim pročitati i priče ljudi, ne samo gledati zidove.
learner.en: Yes. I want to read people's stories, not just look at walls.

conversations.title: A tennis beginner counts mistakes instead of points

partner.hr: Kako ti je prošao prvi meč?
partner.en: How did your first match go?

learner.hr: Izgubio sam, ali barem sam znao zašto.
learner.en: I lost, but at least I knew why.

partner.en: What bothered you most?

learner.hr: Nakon nekoliko loših udaraca prestao sam gledati lopticu.
learner.en: After a few bad shots I stopped watching the ball.

partner.en: What were you thinking about?

learner.hr: O prethodnoj pogrešci. Sljedeća bi me već čekala.
learner.en: The previous mistake. The next one would already be waiting for me.

partner.en: What does your coach say?

learner.hr: Da između poena trebam početi iznova, ne voditi cijelu raspravu.
learner.en: That between points I need to start fresh, not hold an entire debate.

partner.en: Will you play again?

learner.hr: Hoću. Sad barem imam nešto konkretnije za vježbu od želje da pobijedim.
learner.en: Yes. At least now I have something more concrete to practise than wanting to win.

conversations.title: A mine tour has an optional deeper section

partner.en: Why has the group stopped?

learner.hr: Rudnik ima dva obilaska. Sada biramo kraći ili dulji.
learner.en: The mine has two tours. Now we choose the shorter or longer one.

partner.en: Are you going deeper with the others?

learner.hr: Ne bih išao dublje. Zasad mi je ovo dovoljno.
learner.en: I'd rather not go deeper. This is enough for me for now.

partner.en: Will you wait for me above ground?

learner.hr: Hoću. Vodič kaže da možemo s njim natrag do izlaza.
learner.en: Yes. The guide says we can go back to the exit with him.

partner.hr: Je li ti žao propustiti dio?
partner.en: Are you sorry to miss part of it?

learner.hr: Malo, ali ne želim glumiti da mi je ugodno.
learner.en: A little, but I don't want to pretend I'm comfortable.

partner.en: I'll show you photographs.

learner.hr: Može. Ja ću dotad pronaći mjesto za kasni ručak.
learner.en: Yes. Meanwhile I'll find a place for a late lunch.

conversations.title: A friend waits at the wrong entrance to a station

partner.en: Why are you still late?

learner.hr: Ne kasnim, stojim kod ulaza već deset minuta.
learner.en: I'm not late; I've been at the entrance for ten minutes.

partner.en: I can't see you.

learner.hr: Čekaj, ima li tvoj ulaz veliko staklo iznad vrata?
learner.en: Wait, does your entrance have a big pane of glass above the door?

partner.en: No, there's a little kiosk here.

learner.hr: Onda gledamo različite strane zgrade. Ja sam na zapadu.
learner.en: Then we're looking at different sides of the building. I'm on the west side.

partner.en: Will you come over here?

learner.hr: Hoću, samo nemoj otići prema meni da se mimoiđemo.
learner.en: Yes, just don't walk towards me and let us pass each other.

partner.en: I'm waiting by the kiosk.

learner.hr: Sad ćemo stvarno zakasniti zajedno, što je barem pošteno.
learner.en: Now we'll really be late together, which is at least fair.

conversations.title: Two siblings remember disliking the same lunch

partner.en: Why are you smiling at your plate?

learner.hr: Kao mali sam mrzio ovo jelo. Danas sam ga sam naručio.
learner.en: As a child I hated this dish. Today I ordered it myself.

partner.en: What about your sister?

learner.hr: I ona ga je mrzila, ali zbog sasvim drugog sastojka.
learner.en: She hated it too, but because of a completely different ingredient.

partner.en: What changed?

learner.hr: Možda okus, možda činjenica da me nitko ne tjera.
learner.en: Perhaps my taste, perhaps the fact that nobody's making me eat it.

partner.en: Will you send her a picture?

learner.hr: Hoću. Neće vjerovati da je ovo moj ručak.
learner.en: Yes. She won't believe this is my lunch.

partner.en: What will she write?

learner.hr: Vjerojatno da napokon uzmem i povrće koje sam ostavljao na rubu.
learner.en: Probably to finally eat the vegetables I used to leave at the edge too.

conversations.title: A passport stamp belongs to a vanished country

partner.hr: Koja je ovo zastava na pečatu?
partner.en: What's this flag on the stamp?

learner.hr: Država se drukčije zvala kad je tata putovao.
learner.en: The country had a different name when Dad travelled.

partner.en: Did he live there long?

learner.hr: U toj državi je radio samo nekoliko mjeseci.
learner.en: He worked in that country for only a few months.

partner.en: Why did he keep the old document?

learner.hr: Podsjećao ga je na prvo samostalno putovanje u drugu državu.
