learner.en: It reminded him of his first independent journey to another country.

partner.hr: Možemo li znati kamo je išao?
partner.en: Can we know where he went?

learner.hr: Možemo pitati njega. Pečati daju samo dio priče.
learner.en: We can ask him. Stamps tell only part of the story.

partner.en: Will you photograph them?

learner.hr: Hoću, da mi pokaže mjesta bez držanja krhkih stranica.
learner.en: Yes, so he can show me the places without handling fragile pages.

conversations.title: A child learns why two farm animals stay apart

partner.hr: Zašto ovaj stoji iza druge ograde?
partner.en: Why is this one behind another fence?

learner.hr: Domaćin kaže da je to bik i da mu ne prilazimo.
learner.en: The owner says it's a bull and that we shouldn't approach it.

partner.en: What about that one over there?

learner.hr: Krava s mladunčetom. I njih ćemo gledati izdaleka.
learner.en: A cow with her calf. We'll watch them from a distance too.

partner.en: But I wanted to stroke them.

learner.hr: Znam. Posjet nije obećanje da možemo dodirnuti svaku životinju.
learner.en: I know. A visit isn't a promise that we can touch every animal.

partner.en: What can we do, then?

learner.hr: Pitajmo gdje smijemo pomoći, kao što smo dogovorili.
learner.en: Let's ask where we're allowed to help, as we agreed.

partner.hr: Kaže da možemo nositi prazne kante.
partner.en: He says we can carry the empty buckets.

learner.hr: Može. I to je posao koji treba napraviti.
learner.en: Yes. That's a job that needs doing too.

conversations.title: A spelling medal feels smaller than the effort behind it

partner.hr: Zašto stalno vadiš medalju iz torbe?
partner.en: Why do you keep taking the medal out of your bag?

learner.hr: Još mi je čudno da sam osvojio medalju.
learner.en: It still feels strange that I won a medal.

partner.en: Did you know all the words?

learner.hr: Jednu nisam, ali sam se snašao s ostalima.
learner.en: There was one I didn't know, but I managed the others.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li je objesiti u sobi?
partner.en: Will you hang it in your room?

learner.hr: Hoću, pokraj popisa riječi u kojima sam stalno griješio.
learner.en: Yes, beside the list of words I kept getting wrong.

partner.en: Why there?

learner.hr: Da se sjetim vježbe, ne samo završnog pljeska.
learner.en: To remember the practice, not just the final applause.

partner.en: May I show it to Grandma?

learner.hr: Smiješ. Samo joj reci da me još može pobijediti u križaljkama.
learner.en: Yes. Just tell her she can still beat me at crosswords.

conversations.title: A friend respects a work story that cannot be shared

partner.hr: Zašto ne kažeš što se dogodilo?
partner.en: Why won't you say what happened?

learner.hr: Zato što je povjerljivo. Nije moja priča za prepričavanje.
learner.en: Because it's confidential. It isn't my story to retell.

partner.en: But you can trust me.

learner.hr: Mogu, ali povjerenje ne ukida obvezu tajnosti.
learner.en: I can, but trust doesn't remove confidentiality.

partner.hr: Mogu li barem znati jesi li dobro?
partner.en: Can I at least know whether you're all right?

learner.hr: To možeš. Umoran sam, ali dobro sam.
learner.en: You can know that. I'm tired, but I'm all right.

partner.en: Would you like to change the subject?

learner.hr: Hvala, to bi mi više pomoglo od dodatnih pitanja.
learner.en: Thank you; that would help more than more questions.

partner.hr: Onda slušaj što mi je pas danas napravio.
partner.en: Then listen to what my dog did today.

learner.hr: To zvuči kao priča koju smijemo podijeliti.
learner.en: That sounds like a story we're allowed to share.

conversations.title: A technical explanation becomes clear after one drawing

partner.en: Do you understand what we need to change?

learner.hr: Ne još. Tehnički dio opisa mi je previše apstraktan.
learner.en: Not yet. The technical part of the description is too abstract for me.

partner.en: Shall I repeat it more slowly?

learner.hr: Pokušaj običnim jezikom, ili nacrtaj što je s čim povezano.
learner.en: Try everyday language, or draw what connects to what.

partner.hr: Ovako, kabel ide u ovaj ulaz.
partner.en: Like this; the cable goes into this socket.

learner.hr: Sad vidim. Riječ ulaz sam shvatio kao vrata na kući.
learner.en: Now I see. I took the word entrance to mean a door in a house.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li ti pokazati sljedeći korak?
partner.en: Will you show the next step?

learner.hr: Hoću, da provjerimo jesam li stvarno razumio.
learner.en: Yes, so we can check whether I really understood.

partner.en: Exactly, now it works.

learner.hr: Odlično. Jedan crtež mi je uštedio deset ponavljanja.
learner.en: Great. One drawing saved me ten repetitions.

conversations.title: A school alarm sounds during a quiet lesson

partner.en: Why is the siren sounding?

learner.hr: Danas je vježba. Sirena označava početak, a uzbuna je bila najavljena roditeljima.
learner.en: It's a drill today. The siren marks the start, and parents were told about the alarm.

partner.en: Should we take our bags?

learner.hr: Slijedimo upute učiteljice, bez skupljanja stvari.
learner.en: Let's follow the teacher's instructions without collecting things.

partner.hr: Ali ona je rekla da je samo vježba.
partner.en: But she said it was only a drill.

learner.hr: Jest, zato možemo mirno uvježbati izlazak.
learner.en: Yes, so we can calmly practise leaving.

partner.en: Where do we gather after leaving?

learner.hr: Na dogovorenom mjestu u dvorištu. Ostajem uz grupu.
learner.en: At the agreed spot in the yard. I'm staying with the group.

partner.en: Did we do everything properly?

learner.hr: Pitat ćemo kad završi. Vježba služi i da otkrijemo pogreške.
learner.en: We'll ask when it's over. A drill also helps us find mistakes.

conversations.title: A narrow path makes two walkers take turns

partner.en: Why did you stop at the wider section?

learner.hr: Čekam da prođu ljudi iz drugog smjera.
learner.en: I'm waiting for the people coming the other way to pass.

partner.en: Surely we can pass each other.

learner.hr: Radije sam oprezan. Rub je mokar.
learner.en: I'd rather be careful. The edge is wet.

partner.en: Would you like me to hold your bag?

learner.hr: Ne treba. Samo hodajmo oprezno kad krenemo.
learner.en: No need. Let's just walk carefully when we start.

partner.en: Everyone has passed now.

learner.hr: Dobro, možemo dalje bez gurkanja.
learner.en: Good, we can carry on without jostling.

partner.en: We only lost a minute.

learner.hr: Upravo tako. Pogled nije pobjegao dok smo čekali.
learner.en: Exactly. The view didn't run away while we waited.

conversations.title: A novelist spots her own book in a shop window

partner.en: Why did you stop outside the window?

learner.hr: To je moja knjiga. Izdavač ju je objavio prošli tjedan.
learner.en: That's my book. The publisher released it last week.

partner.hr: Nisi znala da će biti ovdje?
partner.en: Didn't you know it would be here?

learner.hr: Nisam. Prijatelj je izdao svoj novi roman i poslao me pogledati njegovu knjigu.
learner.en: No. My friend published his new novel and sent me to look at his book.

partner.hr: Čekaj, i njegova je u izlogu?
partner.en: Wait, is his in the window too?

learner.hr: Jest, odmah pokraj moje. Zato me i poslao ovuda.
learner.en: Yes, right beside mine. That's why he sent me this way.

partner.en: Will you go in?

learner.hr: Hoću, ali prvo fotografiju. Mama neće čekati da dođem doma.
learner.en: Yes, but first a photograph. Mum won't wait until I get home.

partner.en: Do you need to stand by the window?

learner.hr: Možeš slikati samo knjige. Ja sam već dovoljno zbunjena.
learner.en: You can photograph just the books. I'm flustered enough already.

conversations.title: A gold-coloured medal is not made of gold

partner.hr: Je li ovaj zlatni krug medalja?
partner.en: Is this gold disc a medal?

learner.hr: Jest. Zlatni sjaj ne znači da je od zlata.
learner.en: Yes. The golden shine doesn't mean it's made of gold.

partner.en: Why does it look like that, then?

learner.hr: Površina je pozlaćena. To piše u opisu ispod.
learner.en: The surface is gilded. It says so in the description below.

partner.en: Is it worth less, then?

learner.hr: Ovisi što misliš pod vrijednošću. Priča nije u težini metala.
learner.en: It depends what you mean by value. The story isn't in the metal's weight.

partner.en: Who received it?

learner.hr: Član spasilačke ekipe. Volio bih pročitati više o tome.
learner.en: A rescue-team member. I'd like to read more about that.

partner.en: Shall we go to the next panel?

learner.hr: Idemo. Tamo je možda objašnjen događaj, a ne samo predmet.
learner.en: Yes. Perhaps the event is explained there, not just the object.

conversations.title: A posted document has no tracking update yet

partner.en: Has the document arrived?

learner.hr: Još ne znam. Paket je poslan, ali praćenje se nije promijenilo.
learner.en: I don't know yet. The parcel was sent, but the tracking hasn't changed.

partner.en: Has the recipient replied?

learner.hr: Potvrdio je adresu, ne i primitak.
learner.en: He confirmed the address, not receipt.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li poslati još jednu kopiju?
partner.en: Will you send another copy?

learner.hr: Ne odmah. Prvo ću provjeriti gdje je prva.
learner.en: Not immediately. First I'll check where the first one is.

partner.en: Do you have proof of posting?

learner.hr: Imam. Spremio sam i fotografiju omotnice.
learner.en: Yes. I saved a photograph of the envelope too.

partner.hr: Onda možeš pitati s tim brojem.
partner.en: Then you can ask using that number.

learner.hr: Upravo to. Bolje nego poslati isti papir triput.
learner.en: Exactly. Better than sending the same paper three times.

conversations.title: A lecture recording reveals a missed qualification

partner.en: Why are you listening to the same part again?

learner.hr: Predavanje sam shvatio previše općenito.
learner.en: I took the lecture too generally.

partner.en: What did you miss?

learner.hr: Čuo sam profesora kako navodi pravilo, ali ne i iznimku.
learner.en: I heard the professor state the rule, but not the exception.

partner.en: Does that change your notes?

learner.hr: Mijenja. Podcrtao sam rečenicu koja vrijedi samo u određenom slučaju.
learner.en: Yes. I underlined a sentence that applies only in a particular case.

partner.en: Will you ask in the practical class?

learner.hr: Hoću ako mi nakon cijele snimke još ne bude jasno.
learner.en: Yes, if it's still unclear after the full recording.

partner.hr: Dobro da si se vratio na to.
partner.en: It's good you went back to it.

learner.hr: Jest. Kratka bilješka može sakriti veliko ali.
learner.en: Yes. A short note can hide a big but.

conversations.title: An apology names the hurt without arguing about intent

partner.en: Why do you want to speak privately?

learner.hr: Tvoja me šala povrijedila, a nisam htio raspravljati pred svima.
learner.en: Your joke hurt me, and I didn't want to argue in front of everyone.

partner.en: I didn't mean to offend you.

learner.hr: Vjerujem ti. Ali to što me nisi namjerno uvrijedio ne briše kako sam se osjećao.
learner.en: I believe you. But not offending me on purpose doesn't erase how I felt.

partner.en: I'm sorry; I didn't notice.

learner.hr: Hvala što slušaš. Samo nemojmo ponavljati šale o tome.
learner.en: Thank you for listening. Let's just not repeat jokes about that.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li mi drugi put odmah reći?
partner.en: Will you tell me immediately next time?

learner.hr: Pokušat ću. Ponekad tek kasnije shvatim zašto sam utihnuo.
learner.en: I'll try. Sometimes I only realise later why I went quiet.

partner.en: Can we move on now?

learner.hr: Možemo. Lakše mi je kad smo to izgovorili.
learner.en: Yes. I feel better now we've said it.

conversations.title: A child volunteers to prepare the painting table

partner.en: Can I prepare the paints?

learner.hr: Možeš. Napuni dvije posudice vodom, ne do vrha.
learner.en: Yes. Fill two little containers with water, not to the top.

partner.hr: Što je s ovim starim kistom?
partner.en: What about this old brush?

learner.hr: Operi ga prvo, pa ćemo vidjeti je li još upotrebljiv.
learner.en: Wash it first, then we'll see whether it's still usable.

partner.hr: Trebam li staviti novine na stol?
partner.en: Should I put newspapers on the table?

learner.hr: Da, osobito tamo gdje ćemo ostavljati mokre kistove.
learner.en: Yes, especially where we'll leave wet brushes.

partner.en: Everything's ready.

learner.hr: Hvala. Sad i ti izaberi papir prije nego počnemo.
learner.en: Thank you. Now choose your paper too before we start.

partner.en: Can I take the biggest one?

learner.hr: Možeš. Samo ostavi mjesta i za ostale.
learner.en: Yes. Just leave room for the others too.

conversations.title: A visitor follows the old city centre on a new map

partner.hr: Zašto tražiš trg na toj strani?
partner.en: Why are you looking for the square on that side?

learner.hr: Mislio sam da je središte još oko stare tržnice.
learner.en: I thought the centre was still around the old market.

partner.en: The town has expanded now.

learner.hr: Vidim. U središtu je danas nešto što je na staroj karti bio rub.
learner.en: I see. Somewhere that was the edge on the old map is in the centre today.

partner.en: Where do you actually want to go?

learner.hr: Do kuće u kojoj je baka radila. Nije važno je li danas u središtu ili na rubu.
learner.en: To the house where Grandma worked. It doesn't matter whether it's in the centre or on the edge today.

partner.en: Is the address still the same?

learner.hr: Ulica jest, ali broj moram još provjeriti.
learner.en: The street is, but I still need to check the number.

partner.en: Then let's look that up first.

learner.hr: Da. Stara karta će nam pomoći s pričom, nova s hodanjem.
learner.en: Yes. The old map will help with the story, the new one with walking.

conversations.title: A family event poster forgets the practical details

partner.en: Why are you changing the poster before printing?

learner.hr: Piše obiteljski dan, a nigdje nema vremena početka.
learner.en: It says family day, but there's no start time anywhere.

partner.en: What else needs adding?

learner.hr: Obiteljima treba reći gdje mogu ostaviti kolica i kome se javiti.
learner.en: Families need to know where they can leave pushchairs and whom to contact.

partner.en: Will it all fit?

learner.hr: Hoće ako skratimo veliki uvodni tekst.
learner.en: Yes, if we shorten the long introduction.

partner.en: A pity; I spent a long time writing it.

learner.hr: Može ostati na stranici događaja. Na plakatu tražim konkretne podatke.
learner.en: It can stay on the event page. On the poster I look for specific details.

partner.en: Check the address too, then.

learner.hr: Hoću. Lijep plakat ne pomaže ako svi dođu na krivo mjesto.
learner.en: I will. A lovely poster doesn't help if everyone comes to the wrong place.

conversations.title: A second-hand shop separates donated clothes from stock

partner.hr: Smijem li uzeti nešto iz ovih vreća?
partner.en: May I take something from these bags?

learner.hr: Još ne. Ta roba nije pregledana ni označena.
learner.en: Not yet. Those goods haven't been checked or labelled.

partner.hr: Mislio sam da je sve na prodaju.
partner.en: I thought everything was for sale.

learner.hr: Većina robe jest, ali donacije prvo razvrstamo.
learner.en: Most of the stock is, but we sort donations first.

partner.en: What do you look for when checking?

learner.hr: Je li odjeća čista i ima li oštećenja koja treba navesti.
learner.en: Whether the clothes are clean and have any damage we need to mention.

partner.hr: Mogu li kasnije doći po ovu jaknu?
partner.en: Can I come back for this jacket later?

learner.hr: Možeš pitati sutra, ali ne mogu je još rezervirati.
learner.en: You can ask tomorrow, but I can't reserve it yet.

partner.hr: U redu, pogledat ću ono na vješalicama.
partner.en: All right, I'll look at what's on the hangers.

learner.hr: Slobodno. Tamo već pišu veličine i cijene.
learner.en: Go ahead. The sizes and prices are already there.

conversations.title: A camp pickup needs the right names

partner.en: Who are you collecting from camp today?

learner.hr: Dvojicu susjedovih dječaka, uz svoje dijete.
learner.en: Two of the neighbour's boys, as well as my own child.

partner.en: Have the organisers been told?

learner.hr: Jesu. Roditelji su poslali imena i dogovor.
learner.en: Yes. The parents sent the names and arrangement.

partner.en: Do you know what they look like?

learner.hr: Znam, ali imena te dvojice uvijek prvo zamijenim.
learner.en: Yes, but I always mix up those two boys' names at first.

partner.en: Shall I send you a photograph?

learner.hr: Možeš, da ne vičem oba imena prema svakom djetetu.
learner.en: Yes, so I don't call both names towards every child.

partner.en: Have you arrived?

learner.hr: Jesam. Oni su mene prepoznali prije nego ja njih.
learner.en: Yes. They recognised me before I recognised them.

conversations.title: A postcard makes a distant relative feel nearer

partner.en: Where's the postcard from?

learner.hr: Od tete u Americi. Kaže da je konačno pronašla marke.
learner.en: From my aunt in America. She says she's finally found stamps.

partner.hr: Zar se ne čujete preko telefona?
partner.en: Don't you speak on the phone?

learner.hr: Čujemo se, ali Amerika mi je na papiru nekako bliža.
learner.en: We do, but on paper America somehow feels nearer.

partner.en: What's pictured on it?

learner.hr: Njezin grad, s mostom o kojem stalno priča.
learner.en: Her city, with the bridge she always talks about.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li joj odgovoriti isto tako?
partner.en: Will you reply the same way?

learner.hr: Hoću. Poslat ću pogled s našeg prozora, ne samo poznati trg.
learner.en: Yes. I'll send the view from our window, not just the famous square.

partner.en: Why the window?

learner.hr: Da vidi što mi je pred očima dok s njom razgovaram.
learner.en: So she can see what's in front of me while I'm talking to her.

conversations.title: An old letter contains two languages

partner.en: Can you read the whole letter?

learner.hr: Samo dio. Ruski natpis na kraju ne razumijem.
learner.en: Only part. I don't understand the Russian writing at the end.

partner.en: Why is the rest in German?

learner.hr: Autor je tada živio u Njemačkoj i pisao različitim rođacima.
learner.en: The writer lived in Germany then and wrote to different relatives.

partner.hr: Znaš li kome je ovo poslao?
partner.en: Do you know whom he sent this to?

learner.hr: Ne sasvim. Omotnica nije sačuvana.
learner.en: Not entirely. The envelope wasn't kept.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li pitati nekoga za prijevod?
partner.en: Will you ask someone for a translation?

learner.hr: Hoću, uz objašnjenje odakle je tekst. Ne želim nagađati imena.
learner.en: Yes, with an explanation of where the text came from. I don't want to guess the names.

partner.en: Perhaps there's an interesting story hidden in it.

learner.hr: Možda, ali prvo trebamo točno pročitati obične rečenice.
learner.en: Perhaps, but first we need to read the ordinary sentences accurately.

conversations.title: A menu translation turns a dish into a strange sentence

partner.hr: Zašto ti telefon nudi takvu rečenicu?
partner.en: Why is your phone suggesting that sentence?

learner.hr: Kineski tekst na jelovniku preveo je sasvim doslovno.
learner.en: It translated the Chinese text on the menu very literally.

partner.en: Do you at least understand the ingredients?

learner.hr: Neke. Tehnologija pomaže, ali ne zna uvijek što je naziv jela.
learner.en: Some. Technology helps, but it doesn't always know what's a dish's name.

partner.en: Will you order blindly?

learner.hr: Radije ću pitati osoblje i pokazati fotografiju.
learner.en: I'd rather ask the staff and show a photograph.

partner.en: It looks simpler now.

learner.hr: Jest. Na tanjuru je mnogo jasnije nego u automatskoj rečenici.
learner.en: Yes. It's much clearer on the plate than in the automatic sentence.

partner.en: Will you keep the translation?

learner.hr: Hoću kao šalu, ne kao pouzdan rječnik.
learner.en: Yes, as a joke, not as a reliable dictionary.

conversations.title: A heavy bag stays on the same shoulder

partner.en: Why are you holding your bag so oddly?

learner.hr: Rame mi je umorno. Cijeli dan je nosim na lijevom.
learner.en: My shoulder is tired. I've carried it on the left all day.

partner.en: Why didn't you switch sides?

learner.hr: Nisam primijetio koliko je teška dok nisam stao.
learner.en: I didn't notice how heavy it was until I stopped.

partner.en: What are you carrying anyway?

learner.hr: Knjigu, bocu i laptop koji mi danas nije trebao.
learner.en: A book, a bottle and a laptop I didn't need today.

partner.en: Can I take something for you?

learner.hr: Možeš knjigu do stana. Ostalo ću rasporediti bolje.
learner.en: You can take the book as far as the flat. I'll distribute the rest better.

partner.en: A smaller bag tomorrow?

learner.hr: Ili manje stvari. Torba se nije sama napunila.
learner.en: Or fewer things. The bag didn't fill itself.

conversations.title: A new driver volunteers for a familiar route

partner.en: Will you drive today?

learner.hr: Hoću. Vozačku imam mjesec dana, a ovaj put dobro poznajem.
learner.en: Yes. I've had my licence for a month, and I know this route well.

partner.hr: Želiš li da netko sjedne naprijed?
partner.en: Would you like someone in the front seat?

learner.hr: Možeš ti, samo bez razgovora svih odjednom.
learner.en: You can, just not everyone talking at once.

partner.en: Are we taking the faster road?

learner.hr: Danas vozimo poznatom rutom. Za novu ćemo ostaviti više vremena.
learner.en: Today we're driving the familiar route. We'll leave more time for a new one.

partner.en: Will you stop before the return?

learner.hr: Hoću ako se umorim. Ne moram sve napraviti bez pauze.
learner.en: Yes, if I get tired. I don't need to do everything without a break.

partner.en: Then let's leave when you're ready.

learner.hr: Spreman sam, samo da još provjerim sjedalo.
learner.en: I'm ready, once I check the seat again.

conversations.title: A dancer needs the starting point marked

partner.en: Why do I keep ending up too far left?

learner.hr: Prvi korak ti je duži nego na probi.
learner.en: Your first step is longer than in rehearsal.

partner.en: How can I remember that?

learner.hr: Mogu označiti početno mjesto pa ćeš lakše slijediti raspored.
learner.en: I can mark the starting spot so you can follow the arrangement more easily.

partner.hr: Hoće li oznaka ostati na nastupu?
partner.en: Will the mark stay for the performance?

learner.hr: Neće se vidjeti publici. Prvo ćemo pitati smijemo li je staviti.
learner.en: It won't show to the audience. First we'll ask whether we may put it there.

partner.en: Shall we repeat just the beginning?

learner.hr: Da. Nema potrebe svaki put plesati cijelu stvar.
learner.en: Yes. There's no need to dance the whole piece every time.

partner.en: Now I'm in the right place.

learner.hr: Dobro. Ponekad problem nije u zadnjem, nego u prvom pokretu.
learner.en: Good. Sometimes the problem isn't in the final movement but in the first.

conversations.title: A fundraiser chooses one person to answer questions

partner.en: Why is everyone sending journalists to you?

learner.hr: Dogovorili smo da ja dajem izjave o događaju.
learner.en: We agreed I'd give statements about the event.

partner.hr: Znači li to da ostali ne smiju govoriti?
partner.en: Does that mean the others can't speak?

learner.hr: Ne. Samo želimo da podaci budu jednaki i provjereni.
learner.en: No. We just want the information to be consistent and checked.

partner.hr: Što ako te pitaju nešto što ne znaš?
partner.en: What if they ask something you don't know?

learner.hr: Reći ću da trebam provjeriti, neću izmišljati odgovor.
learner.en: I'll say I need to check; I won't invent an answer.

partner.en: Do you need the registration count?

learner.hr: Trebam, i podatak do kojeg sata vrijedi. Broj se još mijenja.
learner.en: Yes, and the time it applies to. The number is still changing.

partner.en: I'll send you the list.

learner.hr: Hvala. Sad možemo odgovarati bez tri različite verzije.
learner.en: Thank you. Now we can answer without three different versions.

conversations.title: A Sunday pie recalls a grandmother’s kitchen

partner.en: Where's that familiar smell coming from?

learner.hr: Teta peče pitu po bakinu receptu.
learner.en: My aunt is baking a pie from Grandma's recipe.

partner.en: Why did you smile immediately?

learner.hr: Miris te pite uvijek me vrati u njezinu kuhinju.
learner.en: The smell of that pie always takes me back to her kitchen.

partner.en: Does it taste the same?

learner.hr: Još nisam probao. Miris pamtim jasnije nego točne sastojke.
learner.en: I haven't tried it yet. I remember the smell more clearly than the exact ingredients.

partner.en: Will you take the first slice?

learner.hr: Kad se malo ohladi. Ne želim uspomenu na opečen jezik.
learner.en: Once it cools a little. I don't want a memory of a burnt tongue.

partner.en: What if it isn't quite the same?

learner.hr: Onda će ovo biti tetina verzija, što je isto lijepo.
learner.en: Then it'll be my aunt's version, which is lovely too.

conversations.title: A shared dog walk needs more than one lead

partner.en: Why did you bring three leads?

learner.hr: Vodim susjedove pse. Jednom psu treba dulji od ostalih.
learner.en: I'm walking the neighbours' dogs. One dog needs a longer lead than the others.

partner.en: Can you hold them by yourself?

learner.hr: Radije bih pomoć. Među psima još nema puno strpljenja.
learner.en: I'd rather have help. There isn't much patience among the dogs yet.

partner.en: Which one should I take?

learner.hr: Ovog mirnijeg. Znaš ga od prošlog puta.
learner.en: The calmer one. You know him from last time.

partner.en: Are we going through the park?

learner.hr: Da, ali dalje od mjesta gdje je mnogo drugih pasa.
learner.en: Yes, but away from the place with lots of other dogs.

partner.en: Shall we stop by the bench?

learner.hr: Hoćemo, kad se svi malo umire. I mi smo dio tog svi.
learner.en: Yes, once everyone calms down a little. We're part of that everyone too.

conversations.title: A place card uses only one person’s surname

partner.en: Why are you looking for another place card?

learner.hr: Moj suprug je ovdje naveden, ali mene nema.
learner.en: My husband is listed here, but I'm not.

partner.en: Perhaps you're under the same surname?

learner.hr: Nismo. Zadržala sam svoje, pa trebaju tražiti drugo ime.
learner.en: No. I kept mine, so they need to look for another name.

partner.en: Have you asked the organiser?

learner.hr: Jesam. Rekla sam da sam došla sa suprugom, ali imam vlastitu prijavu.
learner.en: Yes. I said I'd come with my husband but had my own registration.

partner.en: Did she find the card?

learner.hr: Jest, na drugom stolu. Spremila ju je uz pogrešnu grupu.
learner.en: Yes, at another table. She'd put it with the wrong group.

partner.en: Can you sit together now?

learner.hr: Možemo. Suprugu ću pokazati naš stol pa ćemo se konačno opustiti.
learner.en: Yes. I'll show my husband our table, then we can finally relax.

conversations.title: A workshop cleanup uses the last clean cloth

partner.hr: Zašto ne brišeš i ovaj stol?
partner.en: Why aren't you wiping this table too?

learner.hr: Svi rubovi su prljavi, a krpa je već puna boje.
learner.en: All the edges are dirty, and the cloth is already full of paint.

partner.en: Is there another one in the drawer?

learner.hr: Ima, ali ova je također prljava. Trebamo oprati krpe prije nastavka.
learner.en: Yes, but this one's dirty too. We need to wash the cloths before continuing.

partner.en: Shall I at least move the dry things?

learner.hr: Možeš, samo ih nemoj staviti na mokru površinu.
learner.en: Yes, just don't put them on a wet surface.

partner.en: Now I can see how much work we did.

learner.hr: Da, ali nered nije jedini dokaz dobrog rada.
learner.en: Yes, but mess isn't the only proof of good work.

partner.en: Shall we finish cleaning together?

learner.hr: Hoćemo. Onda sutra možemo odmah početi, bez traženja mjesta za šalicu.
learner.en: Yes. Then tomorrow we can start immediately without looking for somewhere to put a cup.

conversations.title: A slow queue is longer than it first looked

partner.en: Are we nearly at the entrance?

learner.hr: Ovom brzinom nismo. Red se nastavlja iza ugla.
learner.en: Not at this speed. The queue continues around the corner.

partner.en: How many more people are there?

learner.hr: Ne znam, možda nekoliko stotina. Nisam ih brojio.
learner.en: I don't know, perhaps a few hundred. I haven't counted them.

partner.en: Do you want to stay?

learner.hr: Još deset minuta, pa ćemo vidjeti pomiče li se.
learner.en: Another ten minutes, then we'll see whether it's moving.

partner.en: I can go and get water.

learner.hr: Možeš, samo mi javi kad se vraćaš da te pronađem.
learner.en: Yes, just let me know when you're coming back so I can find you.

partner.en: The queue's finally moving now.

learner.hr: Dobro. Barem čekanje više nije jedino što ovdje radimo.
learner.en: Good. At least waiting isn't the only thing we're doing here anymore.

conversations.title: A classroom skeleton has a loose rib

partner.en: Why does the model sound like a rattle?

learner.hr: Jedna kost se olabavila. Mislim da je dio rebara.
learner.en: One bone has come loose. I think it's part of the ribs.

partner.en: May we repair it ourselves?

learner.hr: Radije ćemo pitati učitelja prije nego nešto skinemo.
learner.en: We'd better ask the teacher before removing anything.

partner.hr: Gdje bi taj dio trebao stajati?
partner.en: Where should that part go?

learner.hr: Na slici se rebra jasno vide oko prsnog koša.
learner.en: The ribs are clearly visible around the chest in the picture.

partner.hr: Zašto učimo na modelu, a ne samo u knjizi?
partner.en: Why do we learn with a model, not just a book?

learner.hr: Meni je raspored kostiju lakše shvatiti kad mogu gledati sa svih strana.
learner.en: I find the arrangement of bones easier to understand when I can look from every side.

partner.en: The teacher's coming; let's ask him.

learner.hr: Da. Ne želim da naš sat završi traženjem izgubljenog dijela po podu.
learner.en: Yes. I don't want our lesson to end with searching the floor for a lost part.

conversations.title: A game guard forgets to watch the gate

partner.hr: Kako si ušao u našu tvrđavu?
partner.en: How did you get into our fortress?

learner.hr: Nitko nije postavio stražu. Vrata su bila prazna.
learner.en: Nobody had posted a guard. The gate was empty.

partner.hr: Mislio sam da ti tamo stojiš.
partner.en: I thought you were standing there.

learner.hr: Mene si poslao po zalihe. Trebali ste drugog čuvara.
learner.en: You sent me for supplies. You needed another guard.

partner.en: Can we start over?

learner.hr: Možemo, ali prvo svima dajmo jasne uloge.
learner.en: Yes, but let's give everyone clear roles first.

partner.en: Will you guard it now?

learner.hr: Hoću, ako me opet ne pošalješ na tri mjesta odjednom.
learner.en: Yes, if you don't send me to three places at once again.

partner.en: Agreed; the gate is yours.

learner.hr: Dobro. Ovaj put barem znam što trebam gledati.
learner.en: Good. At least this time I know what to watch.

conversations.title: A writer cannot decide what is behind a door

partner.hr: Zašto tvoj lik već sat vremena stoji na hodniku?
partner.en: Why has your character been in the hallway for an hour?

learner.hr: U mislima vidim kuću, ali ne znam što je iza vrata.
learner.en: I can picture the house, but I don't know what's behind the door.

partner.en: Perhaps he doesn't need to go in.

learner.hr: Možda. Stalno tjeram maštu u isti smjer.
learner.en: Perhaps. I keep forcing my imagination in the same direction.

partner.en: Will you write two versions?

learner.hr: Hoću, jednu u kojoj uđe i jednu u kojoj ode.
learner.en: Yes, one where he goes in and one where he leaves.

partner.en: Do you have to choose the better one immediately?

learner.hr: Ne moram. To sam pravilo sam izmislio.
learner.en: No. I invented that rule myself.

partner.hr: Onda pusti lika da se pomakne.
partner.en: Then let the character move.

learner.hr: Hoću. Barem će završiti negdje drugdje do večere.
learner.en: I will. At least he'll end up somewhere else by dinner.

conversations.title: A kitchen radio finds a station from childhood

partner.en: Why aren't you changing the station?

learner.hr: Na radiju je pjesma koju godinama nisam čuo.
learner.en: There's a song on the radio I haven't heard for years.

partner.en: Do you know all of it?

learner.hr: Ne, ali zvuk starog radija odmah me vrati u bakinu kuhinju.
learner.en: No, but the sound of the old radio immediately takes me back to Grandma's kitchen.

partner.hr: Je li ona pjevala uz nju?
partner.en: Did she sing along to it?

learner.hr: Jest, pogotovo dok je mijesila tijesto.
learner.en: Yes, especially while kneading dough.

partner.en: Will you find the title?

learner.hr: Hoću kad završi. Zasad želim samo slušati.
learner.en: Yes, when it ends. For now I just want to listen.

partner.hr: Onda ću ja tiše s posuđem.
partner.en: Then I'll be quieter with the dishes.

learner.hr: Hvala. Ovu uspomenu radije ne bih prekrio zveckanjem tanjura.
learner.en: Thank you. I'd rather not cover this memory with clattering plates.

conversations.title: A team captain is not simply the top scorer

partner.en: Why didn't you choose the top scorer?

learner.hr: Tražili smo kapetana, a ne samo najboljeg igrača.
learner.en: We were looking for a captain, not just the best player.

partner.hr: Nije li to obično ista osoba?
partner.en: Isn't that usually the same person?

learner.hr: Nekad jest. Ovaj put važnije nam je tko sluša cijeli tim.
learner.en: Sometimes. This time who listens to the whole team matters more to us.

partner.en: Did he get angry?

learner.hr: Malo, ali razgovarali smo poslije treninga.
learner.en: A little, but we spoke after practice.

partner.en: What did you tell him?

learner.hr: Da njegova igra ostaje važna i bez dodatne uloge.
learner.en: That his playing still matters without the extra role.

partner.en: Will he support the decision?

learner.hr: Mislim da hoće. Jutros je prvi čestitao novoj kapetanici.
learner.en: I think so. This morning he was the first to congratulate the new captain.

conversations.title: A plant support bends under new growth

partner.en: Why is the whole plant leaning?

learner.hr: Štap je preslab za nove grane.
learner.en: The stake is too weak for the new branches.

partner.en: Will another one help?

learner.hr: Možda, ali žica kojom sam je vezao također je preuska.
learner.en: Perhaps, but the wire I tied it with is too narrow too.

partner.en: What will you do?

learner.hr: Pitat ću u rasadniku čime je bolje poduprijeti.
learner.en: I'll ask at the nursery what would support it better.

partner.en: Didn't you expect it to grow so much?

learner.hr: Nisam. Na fotografiji je izgledala kao biljka za malu policu.
learner.en: No. In the photograph it looked like a plant for a small shelf.

partner.hr: Znači, uskoro dobiva svoj kut sobe?
partner.en: So it's getting its own corner of the room soon?

learner.hr: Izgleda tako. Još malo pa će ona određivati raspored.
learner.en: It looks that way. Soon it'll be deciding the layout.

conversations.title: A club chair learns where her authority ends

partner.hr: Zašto pitaš cijeli odbor za ovu odluku?
partner.en: Why are you asking the whole committee about this decision?

learner.hr: Moje ovlasti ne uključuju samostalno trošenje tolikog iznosa.
learner.en: My powers don't include spending that amount on my own.

partner.en: But you lead the association.

learner.hr: Autoritet ne znači da mogu preskočiti naš dogovor.
learner.en: Authority doesn't mean I can skip our agreement.

partner.en: Will that slow the work down?

learner.hr: Malo, ali svi trebaju znati na što novac ide.
learner.en: A little, but everyone needs to know where the money goes.

partner.en: What will you send them?

learner.hr: Ponude i razlog zašto preporučujem jednu od njih.
learner.en: The quotes and why I'm recommending one of them.

partner.en: Do you need help with the summary?

learner.hr: Trebam. Želim da se odluka može razumjeti bez mene u sobi.
learner.en: Yes. I want the decision to be understandable without me in the room.

conversations.title: A daughter realises her mother kept every postcard

partner.hr: Zašto su sve ove kutije pune mojih kartica?
partner.en: Why are all these boxes full of my cards?

learner.hr: Majka je čuvala svaku poruku svoje kćeri.
learner.en: Your mother kept every message from her daughter.

partner.hr: Mislila sam da ih baca nakon čitanja.
partner.en: I thought she threw them away after reading.

learner.hr: Kad sam s majkom pregledavao stare kutije, i mene je isto iznenadilo.
learner.en: When I went through old boxes with my mother, I was just as surprised.

partner.en: Some are completely illegible.

learner.hr: Njoj su očito bile važne i bez urednog rukopisa.
learner.en: They clearly mattered to her even without neat handwriting.

partner.hr: Hoćemo li ih posložiti po godinama?
partner.en: Shall we sort them by year?

learner.hr: Hoćemo, ali ne moramo sve danas.
learner.en: Yes, but we don't have to do everything today.

partner.hr: Voljela bih je pitati zašto je sačuvala baš sve.
partner.en: I'd like to ask why she kept absolutely everything.

learner.hr: Pitaj je. Možda samo čeka da primijetiš.
learner.en: Ask her. Perhaps she's just waiting for you to notice.

conversations.title: Two children admit breaking different parts of a model

partner.en: Who knocked over the little house?

learner.hr: Ja sam slomio krov, ali nisam vidio da je zid već napukao.
learner.en: I broke the roof, but I didn't see that the wall was already cracked.

partner.en: Who made the crack?

learner.hr: Sestra kaže da ga je ona slomila dok je pomicala podlogu.
learner.en: My sister says she broke it while moving the base.

partner.en: Why didn't you say so immediately?

learner.hr: Oboje smo mislili da će onaj drugi objasniti.
learner.en: We both thought the other one would explain.

partner.en: Can we try repairing it?

learner.hr: Možemo. Prvo ćemo skupiti dijelove da ne nestanu.
learner.en: Yes. First we'll gather the pieces so they don't disappear.

partner.en: Will you work together now?

learner.hr: Hoćemo. To bi nam bilo pametnije i prije pada.
learner.en: Yes. That would have been wiser before the fall too.

conversations.title: A picnic cooler becomes a seat by accident

partner.en: Why are you sitting on the cool box?

learner.hr: Stolice smo zaboravili, a poklopac je ravan.
learner.en: We forgot the chairs, and the lid is flat.

partner.hr: Misliš da smije nositi toliku težinu?
partner.en: Do you think it can hold that much weight?

learner.hr: Dobro pitanje. Nisam genij zato što sam pronašao ravnu površinu.
learner.en: Good question. I'm not a genius just because I found a flat surface.

partner.en: Does it say anything on it?

learner.hr: Piše da nije za sjedenje. A meni je izgledalo genijalno.
learner.en: It says not to sit on it. And I thought it was brilliant.

partner.en: We have a blanket; we can sit on the ground.

learner.hr: Možemo. To je manje domišljato, ali puno jasnije.
learner.en: We can. It's less inventive, but much clearer.

partner.en: Shall I pass you a plate?

learner.hr: Molim te. Sad barem ne moram ustajati da uzmem hranu ispod sebe.
learner.en: Please. At least now I don't have to stand up to get the food beneath me.

conversations.title: A loose button delays someone at the door

partner.en: Why aren't you ready yet?

learner.hr: Gumb mi je ostao u ruci. Tražim iglu.
learner.en: The button came off in my hand. I'm looking for a needle.

partner.en: Can you take another coat?

learner.hr: Mogu, ali ovaj želim popraviti dok znam gdje je gumb.
learner.en: I can, but I want to repair this one while I know where the button is.

partner.en: Do you know how to sew it on?

learner.hr: Znam, samo ga trebam prišiti dovoljno čvrsto. Prošli je put brzo otpao.
learner.en: Yes, I just need to sew it on firmly enough. Last time it came off quickly.

partner.en: Shall I hold the light?

learner.hr: Možeš. Lakše mi je vidjeti rupice.
learner.en: Yes. It makes the holes easier to see.

partner.en: Is it done now?

learner.hr: Jest. Sljedeći put provjeravam kaput prije nego što obujem cipele.
learner.en: Yes. Next time I'll check the coat before putting my shoes on.

conversations.title: A film sound effect wakes a sleeping viewer

partner.en: What went bang so loudly?

learner.hr: Eksplozija u filmu. Ti si zaspao još prije potjere.
learner.en: An explosion in the film. You fell asleep before the chase.

partner.en: Was anyone hurt?

learner.hr: Nisam vidjela. Nakon eksplozije kadar je prešao na drugi lik.
learner.en: I didn't see. After the explosion the shot switched to another character.

partner.en: Can you turn it down a little?

learner.hr: Mogu. Dijalog je tih, a efekti puno glasniji.
learner.en: Yes. The dialogue is quiet, and the effects are much louder.

partner.en: Shall we rewind the part I missed?

learner.hr: Hoćemo, ako sad stvarno ostaješ budan.
learner.en: Yes, if you're really staying awake now.

partner.en: I'll get some water before we continue.

learner.hr: Dobra ideja. Film još ima četrdeset minuta.
learner.en: Good idea. The film still has forty minutes left.

conversations.title: Two editions give a fairy-tale wizard different names

partner.en: Why does he have a different name here?

learner.hr: Čarobnjak ima novo ime u ovom prijevodu.
learner.en: The wizard has a new name in this translation.

partner.en: Is the story the same?

learner.hr: Uglavnom. Čarolija djeluje isto, samo su neke rečenice promijenjene.
learner.en: Mostly. The spell works the same way; only some sentences have changed.

partner.en: Which version do you prefer?

learner.hr: Stara, ali možda zato što sam je slušao kao dijete.
learner.en: The old one, but perhaps because I heard it as a child.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li novu pročitati do kraja?
partner.en: Will you finish the new one?

learner.hr: Hoću. Želim vidjeti je li i kraj ostao isti.
learner.en: Yes. I want to see whether the ending stayed the same too.

partner.en: Can I borrow both afterwards?

learner.hr: Možeš, samo mi reci jesi li primijetila istu razliku.
learner.en: Yes, just tell me whether you noticed the same difference.

conversations.title: A sociable friend admits feeling lonely at weekends

partner.en: Are you working all weekend again?

learner.hr: Ne radim. Samo sam usamljen pa ostajem za računalom.
learner.en: I'm not working. I'm just lonely, so I stay at the computer.

partner.hr: Nisam znao da ti tako bude.
partner.en: I didn't know you felt that way.

learner.hr: Često mislimo da drugima uvijek netko pravi društvo.
learner.en: We often think others always have company.

partner.hr: Hoćeš sutra sa mnom u šetnju?
partner.en: Would you like to walk with me tomorrow?

learner.hr: Hoću. Dobro mi dođe konkretan dogovor.
learner.en: Yes. A specific arrangement helps me.

partner.en: What time suits you?

learner.hr: Oko jedanaest, ako ne trebamo nikamo žuriti.
learner.en: Around eleven, if we don't need to rush anywhere.

partner.en: Agreed; I'll let you know when I set off.

learner.hr: Hvala što si pitao, umjesto da pretpostaviš da sam zauzet.
learner.en: Thank you for asking instead of assuming I'm busy.

conversations.title: A family invitation lists someone’s new partner incorrectly

partner.en: Why are you correcting the invitation?

learner.hr: Rođak nije oženjen. Organizator je njegovu partnericu naveo kao suprugu.
learner.en: My cousin isn't married. The organiser listed his partner as his wife.

partner.en: Are they engaged?

learner.hr: Jesu. Ona je njegova zaručnica, ali nisu još odabrali datum.
learner.en: Yes. She's his fiancée, but they haven't chosen a date yet.

partner.hr: Je li im to važno na pozivnici?
partner.en: Does that matter to them on the invitation?

learner.hr: Rekli su da radije napišemo samo njihova imena.
learner.en: They said they'd rather we simply wrote their names.

partner.en: That's simplest.

learner.hr: I točno je bez nagađanja o njihovim planovima.
learner.en: And it's accurate without guessing about their plans.

partner.en: Does anything else need checking?

learner.hr: Adresu. Prošlog su se mjeseca preselili.
learner.en: The address. They moved last month.

conversations.title: A group video includes someone who did not agree to filming

partner.hr: Zašto ne šalješ snimku u grupu?
partner.en: Why aren't you sending the video to the group?

learner.hr: Snimili smo i ljude koji nisu znali da kamera radi.
learner.en: We also filmed people who didn't know the camera was running.

partner.en: But nobody was filming secretly.

learner.hr: Znam, ali vidljiva kamera ne znači da su svi pristali na dijeljenje.
learner.en: I know, but a visible camera doesn't mean everyone agreed to sharing.

partner.en: What do you suggest?

learner.hr: Pitajmo ih ili izaberimo dio bez njih.
learner.en: Let's ask them or choose a section without them.

partner.en: Will that take a while?

learner.hr: Malo. Nije nam hitno objaviti baš večeras.
learner.en: A little. We don't urgently need to post it tonight.

partner.hr: U redu, sačuvat ću je zasad.
partner.en: All right, I'll keep it for now.

learner.hr: Hvala. Lakše je pitati prije nego objašnjavati poslije.
learner.en: Thank you. Asking first is easier than explaining afterwards.

conversations.title: A compass stops a group arguing about a map

partner.en: Why are you turning the map?

learner.hr: Pokušavam shvatiti gdje je jug, ali vrtim je prema sebi.
learner.en: I'm trying to work out where south is, but I keep turning it towards myself.

partner.en: Do you have a compass?

learner.hr: Imam. Pokazuje da je naš cilj više prema sjeveru nego što sam mislio.
learner.en: Yes. It shows our destination is farther north than I thought.

partner.en: So did we set off the wrong way?

learner.hr: Ne još. Zato smo i stali provjeriti.
learner.en: Not yet. That's why we stopped to check.

partner.en: Which marker are we looking for now?

learner.hr: Plavu na početku šumske staze, odmah iza ograde.
learner.en: The blue one at the start of the forest path, just past the fence.

partner.en: Here it is; see?

learner.hr: Vidim. Sad možemo prestati uvjeravati kartu da se prilagodi nama.
learner.en: Yes. Now we can stop trying to make the map adapt to us.

conversations.title: A brightly coloured drink turns out to be alcohol-free

partner.en: What did you get at the bar?

learner.hr: Koktel bez alkohola. Htio sam nešto drugo osim soka.
learner.en: An alcohol-free cocktail. I wanted something other than juice.

partner.en: Is it very sweet?

learner.hr: Manje nego što boja sugerira. Osjeti se dosta limete.
learner.en: Less than the colour suggests. There's quite a lot of lime.

partner.en: Can I order the same?

learner.hr: Možeš, samo pitaj kako se zove. Ja sam pokazao sliku.
learner.en: Yes, just ask what it's called. I pointed at a picture.

partner.en: Will you get another one?

learner.hr: Možda kasnije. Prvo ću popiti vodu.
learner.en: Perhaps later. I'll drink water first.

partner.en: Shall we go back to the others?

learner.hr: Idemo. Inače će misliti da smo sami organizirali drugu zabavu.
learner.en: Yes. Otherwise they'll think we've organised a second party by ourselves.

conversations.title: A temperature display cannot decide which side of zero to show

partner.en: Why do you keep checking the display?

learner.hr: Prije je pisalo nula, sad pokazuje jedan stupanj.
learner.en: It showed zero before; now it shows one degree.

partner.en: Is that a big difference?

learner.hr: Nije, ali pokušavam odlučiti hoće li dvorište biti sklisko.
learner.en: No, but I'm trying to judge whether the yard will be slippery.

partner.en: You can simply look outside.

learner.hr: Imaš pravo. Broj na zaslonu ne govori je li staza suha.
learner.en: You're right. The number on the screen doesn't tell me whether the path is dry.

partner.en: How does it look?

learner.hr: Mokro, pa ću hodati pažljivo bez velike rasprave s termometrom.
learner.en: Wet, so I'll walk carefully without a long argument with the thermometer.

partner.en: Do you need me to wait?

learner.hr: Ne treba. Samo se nemoj zaletjeti niz stepenice.
learner.en: No need. Just don't rush down the steps.

conversations.title: A first payslip makes a planned purchase feel different

partner.en: Did you buy the headphones?

learner.hr: Još nisam. Kad sam vidio plaću, prvo sam zbrojio troškove.
learner.en: Not yet. When I saw my pay, I added up the expenses first.

partner.hr: Zar nisi baš za njih radio?
partner.en: Didn't you work specifically for them?

learner.hr: Jesam, ali nije mi svejedno kako ću potrošiti novac koji sam zaradio.
learner.en: Yes, but I care how I spend the money I've earned.

partner.en: Will you give up?

learner.hr: Ne nužno. Mogu pričekati i kupiti ih bez žurbe.
learner.en: Not necessarily. I can wait and buy them without rushing.

partner.en: That didn't bother you before.

learner.hr: Prije sam gledao cijenu, ne svoj raspored iza nje.
learner.en: Before I looked at the price, not my schedule behind it.

partner.hr: Hoćemo li ipak prošetati do trgovine?
partner.en: Shall we walk to the shop anyway?

learner.hr: Možemo pogledati. Ne moram danas izaći s vrećicom.
learner.en: We can look. I don't have to leave with a bag today.

conversations.title: A choir archive needs names, not just a group label

partner.en: What does it say beneath the old photograph?

learner.hr: Samo ženski zbor i godina. Nema pojedinačnih imena.
learner.en: Just women's choir and the year. No individual names.

partner.en: Can you recognise anyone?

learner.hr: Baku. O ostalim ženama zasad znam samo ono što je ona pričala.
learner.en: Grandma. For now I only know what she said about the other women.

partner.en: Will you ask the archive?

learner.hr: Hoću. Možda postoji popis članica iz te godine.
learner.en: Yes. Perhaps there's a membership list from that year.

partner.en: What if there isn't one?

learner.hr: Zapisat ću ono što sigurno znamo, bez popunjavanja praznina.
learner.en: I'll record what we know for certain without filling in the gaps.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li sačuvati i njihove pjesme?
partner.en: Will you keep their songs too?

learner.hr: Ako pronađem snimku. Imena i glasovi zajedno bi značili više.
learner.en: If I find a recording. Names and voices together would mean more.

conversations.title: A tiny rustle interrupts a quiet evening

partner.en: Can you hear something behind the wardrobe?

learner.hr: Čujem. Nadam se da nije miš.
learner.en: Yes. I hope it isn't a mouse.

partner.en: What if it is?

learner.hr: Neću ga pokušati uhvatiti golim rukama. Još nema nikakvog traga, samo zvuk.
learner.en: I won't try to catch it with my bare hands. There's no trace of anything yet, just a sound.

partner.en: Perhaps it's just a bag falling.

learner.hr: Moguće. Jučer sam tamo spremio papir.
learner.en: Possibly. I put paper there yesterday.

partner.en: There, the fan is moving the bag.

learner.hr: Dobro. Već sam u glavi preselio pola sobe.
learner.en: Good. I'd already moved half the room in my head.

partner.en: Will you remove it now?

learner.hr: Hoću, da sutra opet ne tražimo nepostojećeg gosta.
learner.en: Yes, so we don't look for a nonexistent guest again tomorrow.

conversations.title: A volunteer accepts a different task after declining one

partner.hr: Mislio sam da si odbila pomoći.
partner.en: I thought you'd refused to help.

learner.hr: Odbila sam voditi program, ne cijeli događaj.
learner.en: I declined hosting the programme, not the whole event.

partner.en: What did you take on, then?

learner.hr: Pristala sam pripremiti raspored iza pozornice. To mi bolje odgovara.
learner.en: I agreed to prepare the backstage schedule. That suits me better.

partner.en: Why didn't you want the microphone?

learner.hr: Ne osjećam se ugodno pred tolikom publikom.
learner.en: I don't feel comfortable in front of such a large audience.

partner.en: But you know the whole programme.

learner.hr: Znam, i to znanje mogu koristiti i bez govora pred svima.
learner.en: I do, and I can use that knowledge without speaking in front of everyone.

partner.en: Do you need help with the schedule?

learner.hr: Trebam da mi netko provjeri preklapaju li se nastupi.
learner.en: I need someone to check whether the performances overlap.

conversations.title: A train journey becomes a game of spotting landmarks

partner.hr: Je li tebi ovaj put dosadan?
partner.en: Is this journey boring to you?

learner.hr: Meni ovaj put nije dosadan. Dosadno mi bude kad ne znam što gledati.
learner.en: This journey isn't boring to me. I get bored when I don't know what to look for.

partner.en: What are you looking for now?

learner.hr: Brojim mostove i pokušavam ih pronaći na karti.
learner.en: I'm counting bridges and trying to find them on the map.

partner.en: Can I join in?

learner.hr: Možeš. Ti traži rijeku prije sljedećeg mosta.
learner.en: Yes. You look for the river before the next bridge.

partner.en: There it is behind the trees!

learner.hr: Dobro si je primijetio. Sad znamo otprilike gdje smo.
learner.en: Well spotted. Now we roughly know where we are.

partner.en: How many bridges do we have left?

learner.hr: Ne znam. Zato nam igra još nije završila.
learner.en: I don't know. That's why our game isn't over yet.

conversations.title: A dinner portion is smaller than the menu photograph

partner.en: Is that the whole steak?

learner.hr: Jest, odrezak je na fotografiji samo prikazan izbliza.
learner.en: Yes, the steak was just shown close up in the photograph.

partner.en: Will you order anything else?

learner.hr: Možda kasnije. Prvo ću pojesti ovaj komadić i vidjeti.
learner.en: Perhaps later. I'll eat this piece first and see.

partner.en: The side dish looks large.

learner.hr: I jest. Neću ostati gladan samo zbog omjera na slici.
learner.en: It is. I won't go hungry just because of the proportions in the picture.

partner.en: Is it at least tasty?

learner.hr: Jest. Već sam manje zaokupljen fotografijom.
learner.en: Yes. I'm already less preoccupied with the photograph.

partner.en: Then put the phone away and eat.

learner.hr: Hoću. Usporedba mi neće ugrijati večeru.
learner.en: I will. Comparing won't warm my dinner.

conversations.title: A stage illusion works differently from the side seats

partner.hr: Jesi li vidio kako je nestala kutija?
partner.en: Did you see how the box disappeared?

learner.hr: Jesam, ali sa strane sam primijetio mali pokret iza zastora.
learner.en: Yes, but from the side I noticed a little movement behind the curtain.

partner.hr: Znači, magija ti više nije zanimljiva?
partner.en: So magic no longer interests you?

learner.hr: Magija na pozornici mi je zanimljiva i kad znam da postoji trik.
learner.en: Stage magic interests me even when I know there's a trick.

partner.en: Why aren't you looking for the explanation, then?

learner.hr: Dio čari te magije je i način na koji nas navede da gledamo drugamo.
learner.en: Part of the charm of that magic is how it makes us look elsewhere.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li ostati na drugom dijelu?
partner.en: Will you stay for the second half?

learner.hr: Hoću. Možda ovaj put gledam baš ono što ne trebam.
learner.en: Yes. Perhaps this time I'll watch exactly what I shouldn't.

partner.hr: Nemoj mi šaptati otkrića tijekom nastupa.
partner.en: Don't whisper your discoveries to me during the show.

learner.hr: Neću. Pustit ću te da se iznenadiš.
learner.en: I won't. I'll let you be surprised.

conversations.title: A frown is mistaken for anger

partner.en: Why are you angry with me?

learner.hr: Nisam. Ljuti me što ne mogu riješiti ovaj račun.
learner.en: I'm not. I'm annoyed that I can't sort out this bill.

partner.hr: Mislio sam da sam nešto napravio.
partner.en: I thought I'd done something.

learner.hr: Oprosti, nije do tebe. Ne želim da se i ti ljutiš zbog mog mrštenja.
learner.en: Sorry, it isn't you. I don't want you getting upset because of my frowning either.

partner.en: Can you take a break?

learner.hr: Mogu. Ionako već peti put čitam isti redak.
learner.en: Yes. I'm reading the same line for the fifth time anyway.

partner.en: Shall we walk first?

learner.hr: Hoćemo. Račun neće otići, a možda se ja vratim mirniji.
learner.en: Yes. The bill won't go away, and perhaps I'll come back calmer.

partner.en: I'll get the jackets.

learner.hr: Hvala. I hvala što si pitao, umjesto da nagađaš.
learner.en: Thank you. And thank you for asking rather than guessing.

conversations.title: A wet poster is damaged but not lost

partner.hr: Je li naš plakat potpuno uništen?
partner.en: Is our poster completely ruined?

learner.hr: Nije uništen, samo se rub razlio od vode.
learner.en: It isn't ruined; only the edge ran because of the water.

partner.en: So we haven't destroyed it?

learner.hr: Nismo ga uništili. Glavni tekst se još dobro vidi.
learner.en: We haven't destroyed it. The main text is still clear.

partner.en: What shall we do with the wet part?

learner.hr: Pitat ćemo voditeljicu prije nego pokušamo nešto prekriti.
learner.en: We'll ask the workshop leader before trying to cover anything.

partner.en: Will we still show it?

learner.hr: Hoćemo. Možemo objasniti i što se dogodilo.
learner.en: Yes. We can also explain what happened.

partner.en: Farther from the glass next time?

learner.hr: Da, ili barem čaša dalje od cijelog našeg rada.
learner.en: Yes, or at least the glass farther from all our work.

conversations.title: A paper frog jumps farther than its maker expects

partner.hr: Zašto si žabu stavio na pod?
partner.en: Why did you put the frog on the floor?

learner.hr: Može skočiti s ruba stola pa je radije isprobavam dolje.
learner.en: It can jump off the edge of the table, so I'd rather test it down here.

partner.en: Does it really move by itself?

learner.hr: Kad pritisneš pregib, skoči. Barem bi trebala.
learner.en: When you press the fold, it jumps. At least it's meant to.

partner.en: That one flew towards the door.

learner.hr: Onda sam savio papir bolje nego prošli put.
learner.en: Then I folded the paper better than last time.

partner.en: Can I make my own?

learner.hr: Možeš, pokazat ću ti od početka.
learner.en: Yes, I'll show you from the beginning.

partner.en: Shall we race them?

learner.hr: Hoćemo, ali bez guranja tuđe žabe.
learner.en: Yes, but without pushing the other person's frog.

conversations.title: An exhibition invitation is read one day too early

partner.en: Why is it closed here?

learner.hr: Jer je otvaranje sutra. Pogledao sam vrijeme, ne datum.
learner.en: Because the opening is tomorrow. I looked at the time, not the date.

partner.en: So we came a day early?

learner.hr: Da. Sutra u ovo vrijeme više neće biti zatvoreno.
learner.en: Yes. At this time tomorrow it won't be closed anymore.

partner.en: Shall we come back tomorrow?

learner.hr: Ja mogu. Nadam se da i ti stigneš.
learner.en: I can. I hope you can too.

partner.en: I can after work.

learner.hr: Onda ti ovaj put ja kupujem kavu za nepotrebnu šetnju.
learner.en: Then this time I'll buy you coffee for the unnecessary walk.

partner.en: The walk wasn't bad.

learner.hr: Dobro. Barem se sutra nećemo pitati gdje je ulaz.
learner.en: Good. At least tomorrow we won't wonder where the entrance is.

conversations.title: A riverside path changes sides at a new footbridge

partner.hr: Zašto više ne pratimo ovu obalu?
partner.en: Why aren't we following this bank anymore?

learner.hr: Staza prelazi preko novog mostića. Ovdje završava oznaka.
learner.en: The path crosses the new footbridge. The marking ends here.

partner.hr: Jesmo li krenuli prema krivom selu?
partner.en: Did we head towards the wrong village?

learner.hr: Nismo. I dalje idemo u istom pravcu, samo drugom stranom rijeke.
learner.en: No. We're still going in the same direction, just on the other side of the river.

partner.en: The old map doesn't show that.

learner.hr: Zato gledam i nove oznake, ne samo papir.
learner.en: That's why I'm looking at the new markers too, not just the paper.

partner.en: Will you note the change?

learner.hr: Hoću, da je spomenem ostalima koji dolaze za nama.
learner.en: Yes, so I can mention it to the others coming after us.

partner.en: You can see the water better from there.

learner.hr: Vidiš, promjena nam je donijela i novi pogled.
learner.en: You see, the change gave us a new view too.

conversations.title: A shopping list gets shorter after the cupboard is checked

partner.en: Why are you crossing out half the list?

learner.hr: Našao sam namirnice iza velikog pakiranja brašna.
learner.en: I found the groceries behind the big bag of flour.

partner.en: Do we already have all that?

learner.hr: Imamo. Kupnju smo planirali prema sjećanju, ne prema polici.
learner.en: We do. We planned the shopping from memory, not from the shelf.

partner.en: Shall we still go to the shop?

learner.hr: Moramo po svježe stvari, ali sad nosimo manje vrećica.
learner.en: We need fresh things, but now we'll carry fewer bags.

partner.en: Should we check the dates?

learner.hr: Treba, da prvo iskoristimo ono što dulje stoji.
learner.en: Yes, so we use what's been there longer first.

partner.en: Next time we open the cupboard first.

learner.hr: Dogovoreno. To je najbliža trgovina koju imamo.
learner.en: Agreed. It's the nearest shop we have.

conversations.title: A sister’s first story collection contains familiar places

partner.en: Whose new book is this?

learner.hr: Sestra ju je izdala prošlog mjeseca. Još mi je neobično vidjeti njezino ime na koricama.
learner.en: My sister published it last month. It still feels strange to see her name on the cover.

partner.en: Are the stories invented?

learner.hr: Jesu, ali neke obiteljske tajne prepoznam kao početnu ideju.
learner.en: Yes, but I recognise some family secrets as the starting idea.

partner.en: Did she use real names?

learner.hr: Nije. I događaje je dosta promijenila.
learner.en: No. She changed the events quite a lot too.

partner.en: Does it bother you?

learner.hr: Razgovarali smo prije objave. Važno mi je da nas je pitala.
learner.en: We spoke before publication. It matters to me that she asked us.

partner.en: Will you lend it to me?

learner.hr: Hoću kad završim. Samo nemoj sve odmah pripisati nama.
learner.en: Yes, when I finish. Just don't immediately assume everything is about us.

conversations.title: A meeting invitation makes the purpose clearer than the agenda

partner.en: Do I really need to be there?

learner.hr: Volio bih da budeš prisutan jer ti preuzimaš sljedeći dio projekta.
learner.en: I'd like you to be there because you're taking over the next part of the project.

partner.en: Can't we sort it out by message?

learner.hr: Dio možemo. Za suradnju s novim timom korisno je da se upoznate.
learner.en: Partly. It helps your cooperation with the new team to meet one another.

partner.en: What should I prepare?

learner.hr: Dva pitanja i kratak opis onoga što ti treba od njih.
learner.en: Two questions and a short description of what you need from them.

partner.hr: Onda mi je jasnije zašto idem.
partner.en: Then it's clearer why I'm going.

learner.hr: Dobro. I meni smeta sastanak koji ne objasni svoju svrhu.
learner.en: Good. Meetings that don't explain their purpose bother me too.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li to dodati u poziv?
partner.en: Will you add that to the invitation?

learner.hr: Hoću, da i ostali ne nagađaju.
learner.en: Yes, so the others don't have to guess either.

conversations.title: An imperfect photograph becomes a treasured family picture

partner.hr: Zašto želiš isprintati baš ovu mutnu sliku?
partner.en: Why do you want to print this blurry picture in particular?

learner.hr: Zato što mi je vrijedna. Na njoj se svi smijemo, ne poziramo.
learner.en: Because it matters to me. We're all laughing in it, not posing.

partner.en: We're sharper in the other one.

learner.hr: Jesmo, ali ovdje vidim ljepotu tog trenutka, ne samo lica.
learner.en: Yes, but here I see the beauty of that moment, not just the faces.

partner.hr: Hoće li dobro izgledati u okviru?
partner.en: Will it look good in a frame?

learner.hr: Ne mora biti velika. Dovoljno je da je vidim s radnog stola.
learner.en: It doesn't have to be large. It's enough to see it from my desk.

partner.en: I can make two sizes for you.

learner.hr: Možeš, pa ćemo usporediti bez povećavanja na ekranu.
learner.en: Yes, then we can compare without enlarging it on the screen.

partner.en: So we're not fixing every flaw?

learner.hr: Ne ovu. Dio je razloga zašto je želim sačuvati.
learner.en: Not this one. It's part of why I want to keep it.

conversations.title: A rented van has an earlier return time than expected

partner.en: Why aren't we carrying the boxes yet?

learner.hr: Provjeravam vrijeme povrata. Unajmio sam kombi samo do popodneva.
learner.en: I'm checking the return time. I rented the van only until the afternoon.

partner.hr: Mislio sam da ga imamo cijeli dan.
partner.en: I thought we had it all day.

learner.hr: I ja, dok nisam ponovno pročitao taj dio ugovora.
learner.en: So did I, until I reread that part of the agreement.

partner.en: Can you extend the rental?

learner.hr: Pitat ću. Neću računati da mogu bez dogovora.
learner.en: I'll ask. I won't assume I can without agreeing it.

partner.en: What if you can't?

learner.hr: Prvo vozimo velike stvari. Za male možemo napraviti drugi plan.
learner.en: We'll move the large things first. We can make another plan for the small ones.

partner.en: Then let's start with the wardrobe.

learner.hr: Da. Raspored ćemo popraviti brže ako i radimo.
learner.en: Yes. We'll fix the schedule faster if we work as well.

conversations.title: A narrator loses her place when a stage entrance changes

partner.hr: Zašto si prestala čitati usred rečenice?
partner.en: Why did you stop reading mid-sentence?

learner.hr: Narator ne može opisivati ulazak nekoga tko još stoji iza kulise.
learner.en: The narrator can't describe someone entering when they're still behind the scenery.

partner.en: Didn't the actor hear the cue?

learner.hr: Nije, jer se glazba sada izvodi uživo i traje dulje.
learner.en: No, because the music is now performed live and lasts longer.

partner.hr: Treba li dodati pauzu u tekst?
partner.en: Should we add a pause to the text?

learner.hr: Treba. Pričekat ću njegov prvi korak, ne brojati sekunde napamet.
learner.en: Yes. I'll wait for his first step, not count seconds from memory.

partner.hr: Hoćemo li ponoviti samo taj dio?
partner.en: Shall we repeat just that part?

learner.hr: Hoćemo, s glazbom. Bez nje opet vježbamo drugi raspored.
learner.en: Yes, with the music. Without it we're rehearsing a different timing again.

partner.en: Now it all fitted together.

learner.hr: Jest. Na papiru je bilo jednostavnije nego na pozornici.
learner.en: Yes. It was simpler on paper than on stage.

conversations.title: A family uniform needs a more careful label

partner.hr: Je li ovo djedova radna odjeća?
partner.en: Is this Grandpa's work clothing?

learner.hr: Ne, vojna odora iz vremena kad je bio dio mornarice.
learner.en: No, a military uniform from when he was in the navy.

partner.en: Why does it only give his name?

learner.hr: Nisam siguran za godinu. Ne želim dodati pogrešan podatak.
learner.en: I'm not sure of the year. I don't want to add an incorrect detail.

partner.hr: Ima li fotografija u istoj odori?
partner.en: Is there a photograph in the same uniform?

learner.hr: Ima, ali na poleđini nema datuma.
learner.en: Yes, but there's no date on the back.

partner.en: We can ask his sister.

learner.hr: Možemo. Možda se sjeća gdje je tada živio.
learner.en: We can. Perhaps she remembers where he lived then.

partner.en: What if she doesn't remember?

learner.hr: Napisat ćemo približno razdoblje i navesti da nije potvrđeno.
learner.en: We'll write an approximate period and say it isn't confirmed.

conversations.title: A parent’s career change looks different in hindsight

partner.hr: Zar se tata nikad nije predomislio oko posla?
partner.en: Didn't Dad ever change his mind about work?

learner.hr: Jest. Njegov životni put nije bio tako ravan kako ga prepričava.
learner.en: He did. His life path wasn't as straight as he tells it.

partner.en: What did he do first?

learner.hr: Nešto sasvim drugo. Kasnije je ponovno učio.
learner.en: Something completely different. Later he studied again.

partner.en: Why does he rarely mention that?

learner.hr: Možda u svojim životima kasnije lakše vidimo red nego dok ih živimo.
learner.en: Perhaps we see more order in our lives afterwards than while living them.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li ga pitati za taj početak?
partner.en: Will you ask him about that beginning?

learner.hr: Hoću. Više mi znači čuti dvojbe nego samo uspjehe.
learner.en: Yes. Hearing the doubts means more to me than just the successes.

partner.hr: Možda mu bude drago da te zanima.
partner.en: Perhaps he'll be pleased you're interested.

learner.hr: Nadam se. Ne tražim savršen primjer, nego stvarnu priču.
learner.en: I hope so. I'm not looking for a perfect example, just a real story.

conversations.title: An airport shuttle leaves someone’s bag at the wrong door

partner.en: Where's your small bag?

learner.hr: Kod aerodroma sam je stavio uz vozača. Sad je ne vidim.
learner.en: At the airport I put it beside the driver. Now I can't see it.

partner.en: Didn't you leave it on the plane?

learner.hr: Nisam. Iz aviona sam izašao s njom i predao je tek kod autobusa.
learner.en: No. I left the plane with it and only handed it over at the bus.

partner.en: Shall we ask the driver?

learner.hr: Da, prije nego krene dalje. Možda ju je stavio kod drugih vrata.
learner.en: Yes, before he drives on. Perhaps he put it by the other door.

partner.en: There it is, beside your seat.

learner.hr: Dobro. Tražio sam mjesto gdje je bila, ne gdje je sada.
learner.en: Good. I was looking where it had been, not where it is now.

partner.en: Do you have everything now?

learner.hr: Imam. Još ću provjeriti ispod sjedala prije izlaska.
learner.en: Yes. I'll check beneath the seat too before leaving.

conversations.title: An invented creature gets a name after it is finished

partner.hr: Što je ova životinja s tri repa?
partner.en: What's this animal with three tails?

learner.hr: Još ne znam. Stvorenje je nastalo dok sam dodavao ostatke gline.
learner.en: I don't know yet. The creature appeared while I added leftover clay.

partner.hr: Postoje li slična u tvojoj priči?
partner.en: Are there similar ones in your story?

learner.hr: Postoje različita stvorenja, ali ovo još nema ulogu.
learner.en: There are various creatures, but this one has no role yet.

partner.en: Perhaps think of a name first.

learner.hr: Mogao bih. Ime mi ponekad pokaže kakav bi lik mogao biti.
learner.en: I could. A name sometimes shows me what kind of character it could be.

partner.en: It looks fairly peaceful.

learner.hr: Onda ga neću odmah pretvoriti u čuvara velikog blaga.
learner.en: Then I won't immediately make it the guardian of a great treasure.

partner.en: What will it do?

learner.hr: Možda samo čuvati vrt. Ne mora svatko spašavati svijet.
learner.en: Perhaps just look after a garden. Not everyone has to save the world.

conversations.title: Flat-pack instructions make more sense from the other side

partner.en: Why do you say a part is missing?

learner.hr: Ovo sastavljanje je živa muka. Crtež se ne slaže s mojim komadima.
learner.en: This assembly is a real ordeal. The drawing doesn't match my pieces.

partner.en: May I look?

learner.hr: Možeš. Možda vidiš nešto što sam ja već pet puta preskočio.
learner.en: Yes. Perhaps you'll see something I've overlooked five times already.

partner.en: You're holding the side panel upside down.

learner.hr: Onda si me upravo spasio velike muke.
learner.en: Then you've just saved me a lot of trouble.

partner.hr: Hoćemo li sad zajedno pratiti korake?
partner.en: Shall we follow the steps together now?

learner.hr: Hoćemo. Ja ću držati dijelove, ti čitaj redoslijed.
learner.en: Yes. I'll hold the parts; you read the sequence.

partner.en: There, it fits now.

learner.hr: Dobro. Prije prigovora proizvođaču barem ćemo okrenuti i zadnju stranicu.
learner.en: Good. Before complaining to the manufacturer, we'll at least turn the last page too.

conversations.title: A surprise party nearly gives itself away

partner.en: Why is everyone whispering all of a sudden?

learner.hr: Dolazi. Budimo mirni dok ne otvori vrata.
learner.en: She's coming. Let's stay quiet until she opens the door.

partner.en: Shall we sing immediately?

learner.hr: Pričekaj da uđe. Ne želim da je preplašimo na stepenicama.
learner.en: Wait until she comes in. I don't want us to scare her on the steps.

partner.hr: Čuje li se glazba iz kuhinje?
partner.en: Can you hear the music from the kitchen?

learner.hr: Čuje, stišat ću. I telefon netko treba maknuti s vibracije.
learner.en: Yes, I'll turn it down. Someone needs to stop the phone vibrating too.

partner.hr: Sad nas je sigurno već čula.
partner.en: She must have heard us by now.

learner.hr: Možda, ali može se još praviti da nije.
learner.en: Perhaps, but she can still pretend she hasn't.

partner.en: She's opening it!

learner.hr: Sad možemo prestati glumiti najtišu grupu u zgradi.
learner.en: Now we can stop pretending to be the quietest group in the building.

conversations.title: A familiar smell changes an old memory

partner.en: Why did you stop by the bakery?

learner.hr: Sjećanje mi se vratilo prije nego što sam prepoznala ulicu.
learner.en: A memory came back before I recognised the street.

partner.en: Did you live here?

learner.hr: Nisam, ali teta me ovuda vodila. Ta sjećanja su mi dugo bila maglovita.
learner.en: No, but my aunt used to bring me this way. Those memories were hazy for a long time.

partner.en: What became clearer now?

learner.hr: Miris toplog tijesta i mala klupa uz vrata.
learner.en: The smell of warm dough and the little bench by the door.

partner.en: Shall we sit there?

learner.hr: Možemo. Želim vidjeti sjećam li se stvarno mjesta ili samo osjećaja.
learner.en: We can. I want to see whether I really remember the place or just the feeling.

partner.en: What do you think?

learner.hr: Malo jednoga, malo drugoga. I to mi je dovoljno za danas.
learner.en: A little of each. That's enough for me today.

conversations.title: A magnet demonstration has no visible rope

partner.hr: Zašto se kolica miču bez dodira?
partner.en: Why is the little cart moving without being touched?

learner.hr: Sila djeluje iako između njih ne vidimo uže.
learner.en: A force is acting even though we can't see a rope between them.

partner.hr: Kako možemo provjeriti što ih vuče?
partner.en: How can we check what's pulling it?

learner.hr: Pomaknimo magnet dalje pa usporedimo učinak te sile.
learner.en: Let's move the magnet farther away and compare the effect of that force.

partner.en: Now it barely moves.

learner.hr: Da, zato zapisujemo i udaljenost, ne samo rezultat.
learner.en: Yes, that's why we record the distance too, not just the result.

partner.hr: Hoćemo li probati isti razmak ponovno?
partner.en: Shall we try the same distance again?

learner.hr: Hoćemo, da vidimo ponavlja li se opažanje.
learner.en: Yes, to see whether the observation repeats.

partner.en: Can I take notes?

learner.hr: Možeš. Ostavi mjesta i za pokušaj koji ne uspije.
learner.en: Yes. Leave room for the attempt that doesn't work too.

conversations.title: A stage fight looks convincing only at the right speed

partner.hr: Zašto je borba danas tako spora?
partner.en: Why is the fight so slow today?

learner.hr: Učimo pokrete. Borba se ne uvježbava prvo punom brzinom.
learner.en: We're learning the movements. A fight isn't rehearsed at full speed first.

partner.en: Will the audience see the gap?

learner.hr: To ćemo provjeriti s redateljem. Zasad vježbamo dogovorenu borbu.
learner.en: We'll check that with the director. For now we're practising the agreed fight.

partner.hr: Smijem li dodati jedan svoj pokret?
partner.en: May I add a movement of my own?

learner.hr: Ne bez dogovora s partnerom i voditeljem.
learner.en: Not without agreeing it with your partner and the instructor.

partner.en: So everything needs to stay the same?

learner.hr: Dok učimo ovaj dio, da. Iznenađenja ostavljamo za priču, ne za partnera.
learner.en: While we learn this part, yes. We leave surprises for the story, not our partner.

partner.en: Shall we start again?

learner.hr: Hoćemo, nakon što svi potvrde da su spremni.
learner.en: Yes, after everyone confirms they're ready.

conversations.title: Green curtains look different in a bright room

partner.en: Why do the curtains look pale?

learner.hr: Soba je jako svijetla. U trgovini nisu bile pokraj tolikog prozora.
learner.en: The room is very bright. In the shop they weren't beside such a large window.

partner.en: Will you exchange them?

learner.hr: Možda. Htio sam zelene zavjese, ne nešto što se izgubi uz zid.
learner.en: Perhaps. I wanted green curtains, not something that disappears against the wall.

partner.en: Look at them in the evening too.

learner.hr: Hoću. Neću odlučiti prema jednom satu dana.
learner.en: I will. I won't decide based on one hour of the day.

partner.hr: Imaš li još uzorak tamnije tkanine?
partner.en: Do you still have a sample of the darker fabric?

learner.hr: Imam, mogu ga staviti uz ovu pa usporediti.
learner.en: Yes, I can put it beside this one and compare.

partner.en: The difference is clearer now.

learner.hr: Jest. Bolje dvije male probe nego još dva velika paketa.
learner.en: Yes. Better two small tests than two more large parcels.

conversations.title: A canal drawing needs a bridge in the right place

partner.en: Why did you erase the whole bridge?

learner.hr: Kanal sam nacrtao preširoko, pa ništa nije stalo na papir.
learner.en: I drew the canal too wide, so nothing fitted on the paper.

partner.hr: Mora li sve biti potpuno točno?
partner.en: Does everything have to be completely accurate?

learner.hr: Ne sasvim, ali obale kanala trebaju ostati približno na pravom mjestu.
learner.en: Not entirely, but the canal banks need to stay roughly in the right place.

partner.en: Do you have a photograph to compare?

learner.hr: Imam. Gledao sam detalje mosta, a zaboravio cijeli prizor.
learner.en: Yes. I looked at the bridge details and forgot the whole scene.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li prvo napraviti mali nacrt?
partner.en: Will you make a small sketch first?

learner.hr: Hoću, ovaj put bez ukrasa dok ne odredim raspored.
learner.en: Yes, this time without decoration until I decide the layout.

partner.en: Now the bridge fits.

learner.hr: Dobro. Napokon ljudi na slici mogu prijeći na drugu stranu.
learner.en: Good. Finally the people in the picture can cross to the other side.

conversations.title: A comic-book cover hides the supporting characters

partner.hr: Je li glavni heroj uvijek sam?
partner.en: Is the main hero always alone?

learner.hr: Na naslovnici je heroj sam, ali u priči mu stalno netko pomaže.
learner.en: The hero is alone on the cover, but in the story someone is always helping him.

partner.hr: Zašto onda ostalih nema na slici?
partner.en: Why aren't the others in the picture, then?

learner.hr: Heroji koji mu pomažu očito nisu stali na naslovnicu.
learner.en: The heroes who help him apparently didn't fit on the cover.

partner.en: Which character is your favourite?
