learner.hr: Ona koja smišlja rješenja, iako se rijetko prva vidi.
learner.en: The one who comes up with solutions, although she's rarely seen first.

partner.en: Will she get her own story?

learner.hr: Nadam se. Zasad čitam nastavak zbog nje, ne zbog naslovnice.
learner.en: I hope so. For now I'm reading the sequel because of her, not the cover.

partner.en: Then lend me the first part.

learner.hr: Hoću, ali nemoj preskočiti male razgovore između velikih scena.
learner.en: I will, but don't skip the little conversations between the big scenes.

conversations.title: A report’s missing page explains a surprising total

partner.en: Why don't the figures match?

learner.hr: Nedostaje jedna stranica izvješća. Imam početak i zaključak.
learner.en: One page of the report is missing. I have the beginning and conclusion.

partner.en: So it isn't a calculation error?

learner.hr: Možda nije. U podacima koje imam nema cijelog mjeseca.
learner.en: Perhaps not. The data I have doesn't include the whole month.

partner.en: Can you ask for the original file?

learner.hr: Mogu. Ne želim popravljati nešto prije nego vidim sve.
learner.en: Yes. I don't want to fix something before seeing everything.

partner.en: Have you received the complete version?

learner.hr: Jest. Sad se vidi zašto je ukupan broj veći.
learner.en: Yes. Now it's clear why the total is higher.

partner.en: Will you update your notes?

learner.hr: Hoću, i napisati koju sam verziju koristio.
learner.en: Yes, and note which version I used.

conversations.title: A paper dragon runs out of one colour

partner.hr: Zašto zmaj ima samo jedno krilo?
partner.en: Why does the dragon have only one wing?

learner.hr: Žuti papir nam je pri kraju.
learner.en: We're running out of yellow paper.

partner.en: Can we make the other one red?

learner.hr: Možemo. Imamo dovoljno crvenog za oba ako želimo.
learner.en: Yes. We have enough red paper for both if we want.

partner.en: What about the first yellow one?

learner.hr: Sačuvajmo ga za rep ili neki drugi lik.
learner.en: Let's save it for the tail or another character.

partner.hr: Hoće li onda sve izgledati drukčije?
partner.en: Will everything look different, then?

learner.hr: Hoće, ali i dalje ćemo znati da je zmaj.
learner.en: Yes, but we'll still know it's a dragon.

partner.hr: Mogu li mu dodati zelene oči?
partner.en: May I give it green eyes?

learner.hr: Možeš. Sad smo već odlučili da nije iz obične knjige.
learner.en: Yes. We've already decided it isn't from an ordinary book now.

conversations.title: A bookseller cannot promise an out-of-print edition

partner.hr: Jeste li pronašli knjigu koju tražim?
partner.en: Have you found the book I'm looking for?

learner.hr: Još ne. Trgovac iz druge radnje također je nema.
learner.en: Not yet. The dealer from the other shop doesn't have it either.

partner.en: May I pay for it in advance?

learner.hr: Radije pričekajte. Na tržištu rabljenih knjiga ne mogu obećati kad će se pojaviti.
learner.en: Better wait. On the second-hand book market I can't promise when it'll appear.

partner.en: Is there a newer edition?

learner.hr: Postoji, ali nema ilustracije koje ste spomenuli.
learner.en: Yes, but it lacks the illustrations you mentioned.

partner.en: Then I'll wait for the old one.

learner.hr: Zapisat ću vaš broj i točan naziv izdanja.
learner.en: I'll note your number and the exact edition title.

partner.hr: Hvala što ne nudite samo sličnu.
partner.en: Thank you for not just offering a similar one.

learner.hr: Nema na čemu. Važno je pronaći ono što stvarno tražite.
learner.en: You're welcome. Finding what you really want matters.

conversations.title: A headteacher records the wrong announcement version

partner.en: Why is the headteacher recording the message again?

learner.hr: Ravnatelj je u prvoj verziji pročitao stari datum priredbe.
learner.en: The headteacher read the old event date in the first version.

partner.hr: Nije li to mogao samo izrezati?
partner.en: Couldn't he just cut it out?

learner.hr: Mogao je, ali taj je datum najvažniji podatak. Radije snima ponovno.
learner.en: He could, but that date is the most important detail. He'd rather record it again.

partner.en: Who will check the new version?

learner.hr: Nas dvoje ćemo poslušati prije objave.
learner.en: The two of us will listen before publication.

partner.en: What else should we compare?

learner.hr: Vrijeme, mjesto i broj za prijavu.
learner.en: The time, place and registration number.

partner.en: Everything's correct now.

learner.hr: Dobro. Staru datoteku označit ću da je slučajno ne pustimo.
learner.en: Good. I'll label the old file so we don't accidentally play it.

conversations.title: A forgotten bin explains a smell in a clean kitchen

partner.hr: Zašto smrdi kad smo sve oprali?
partner.en: Why does it smell when we've washed everything?

learner.hr: Smrad dolazi ispod sudopera. Tamo je ostala mala vrećica.
learner.en: The smell is coming from beneath the sink. A little bag was left there.

partner.hr: Mislio sam da si odnio smeće.
partner.en: I thought you'd taken out the rubbish.

learner.hr: Veliku vreću jesam, ovu nisam primijetio.
learner.en: The big bag, yes; I didn't notice this one.

partner.en: It looks even worse now.

learner.hr: Odvratno je, ali barem znamo što trebamo maknuti.
learner.en: It's disgusting, but at least we know what to remove.

partner.en: Will you open the window?

learner.hr: Hoću, dok ti odneseš vrećicu.
learner.en: Yes, while you take the bag out.

partner.hr: Sljedeći put provjeravamo i mali koš.
partner.en: Next time we check the small bin too.

learner.hr: Da. Čista radna ploha očito nije cijela kuhinja.
learner.en: Yes. A clean worktop clearly isn't the whole kitchen.

conversations.title: An improvised outing beats a cancelled plan

partner.hr: Je li ti žao što je izlet otkazan?
partner.en: Are you sorry the excursion was cancelled?

learner.hr: Bilo mi je, ali i ovaj dan je sjajan.
learner.en: I was, but this day is great too.

partner.en: We only walked around our own town.

learner.hr: Da, i vidjeli tri mjesta pokraj kojih inače samo prođemo.
learner.en: Yes, and saw three places we normally just pass.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li se vratiti u onaj mali muzej?
partner.en: Will you return to that little museum?

learner.hr: Hoću kad bude manje gužve. Danas smo uhvatili tek početak.
learner.en: Yes, when it's less busy. Today we only caught the beginning.

partner.en: At least we have a few photographs.

learner.hr: Imamo sjajne fotografije, i nijedna nije snimljena kroz prozor autobusa.
learner.en: We have great photographs, and none was taken through a bus window.

partner.en: So plan B is worth repeating?

learner.hr: Vrijedi, ali drugi put bez čekanja da plan A propadne.
learner.en: Yes, but next time without waiting for plan A to fail.

conversations.title: A weak phone signal cuts a conversation short

partner.en: Why does your voice keep disappearing?

learner.hr: Signal je slab. Upravo prolazimo kroz dio bez dobrog prijema.
learner.en: The signal is weak. We're going through an area with poor reception.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li me nazvati kad stigneš?
partner.en: Will you call me when you arrive?

learner.hr: Hoću, iako mi je i baterija već slaba.
learner.en: Yes, although my battery is already low too.

partner.en: Do you just need to send a message?

learner.hr: To će biti lakše. Najvažnije je da znaš kad dolazim.
learner.en: That'll be easier. What matters most is that you know when I'm arriving.

partner.en: I'll wait at the agreed place.

learner.hr: Dobro. Ako veza pukne, plan ostaje isti.
learner.en: Good. If the connection drops, the plan stays the same.

partner.en: Talk later.

learner.hr: Čujemo se, kad telefon prestane birati svaku drugu riječ.
learner.en: Talk later, when the phone stops choosing every other word.

conversations.title: A work handover needs a clear finish line

partner.hr: Što još trebamo napraviti prije odlaska?
partner.en: What else needs doing before we leave?

learner.hr: Obavimo provjeru popisa, pa možemo zatvoriti ured.
learner.en: Let's check the list, then we can close the office.

partner.en: Shall I check the invoices?

learner.hr: Da, obavi to dok ja spremim ugovore.
learner.en: Yes, do that while I put the agreements away.

partner.en: Everything's accounted for.

learner.hr: Dobro. Označit ću da je obavljeno, da sutra ne počnemo ispočetka.
learner.en: Good. I'll mark it done so we don't start again tomorrow.

partner.hr: Hoćemo li poslati i poruku kolegici?
partner.en: Shall we message our colleague too?

learner.hr: Hoćemo, s jednom rečenicom o tome gdje je što.
learner.en: Yes, with one sentence about where everything is.

partner.en: Can we leave now?

learner.hr: Možemo. Ovaj put bez vraćanja s parkirališta po papire.
learner.en: Yes. This time without coming back from the car park for papers.

conversations.title: A party cleanup leaves decorations for next year

partner.en: Can we throw these decorations away?

learner.hr: Ne sve. Spremite papirnate zvijezde u plitku kutiju.
learner.en: Not all of them. Put the paper stars in a shallow box.

partner.en: Why a shallow one?

learner.hr: Da ih ne zgnječimo. Za sljedeću godinu već ćemo imati nešto spremno.
learner.en: So we don't crush them. We'll already have something ready for next year.

partner.en: What about the damaged ones?

learner.hr: Odvojite ih, pa ćemo vidjeti što se može popraviti.
learner.en: Set them aside, then we'll see what can be repaired.

partner.en: Shall I write the year on the box?

learner.hr: Napiši i sadržaj. Godina nam neće reći gdje su zvijezde.
learner.en: Write the contents too. The year won't tell us where the stars are.

partner.en: Done; I'm leaving it on the shelf.

learner.hr: Hvala. Sad samo treba zapamtiti koju policu.
learner.en: Thank you. Now we just need to remember which shelf.

conversations.title: A changed meeting room needs more than a new calendar entry

partner.en: Why are you sending another message?

learner.hr: Moramo obavijestiti i ljude koji nisu u našoj grupi.
learner.en: We need to inform the people who aren't in our group too.

partner.en: Haven't we done that already?

learner.hr: Obavili smo promjenu u kalendaru, ne i poziv telefonom.
learner.en: We've changed the calendar entry, not made the phone call.

partner.en: Who will you call?

learner.hr: Dvoje starijih članova koji dolaze bez provjeravanja poruka.
learner.en: Two older members who come without checking messages.

partner.en: I can take one call.

learner.hr: Možeš. Reci i zašto smo promijenili prostoriju.
learner.en: Yes. Explain why we've changed the room too.

partner.en: They both know the new entrance.

learner.hr: Odlično. Sad promjena postoji i izvan našeg zaslona.
learner.en: Great. Now the change exists outside our screen too.

conversations.title: A missed turn is caught before the next junction

partner.en: Where should I turn?

learner.hr: Na sljedećem križanju skreni desno, uz pekarnicu.
learner.en: At the next junction turn right, beside the bakery.

partner.en: I just passed the bakery.

learner.hr: Onda si vjerojatno skrenuo ulicu prerano.
learner.en: Then you probably turned one street too early.

partner.en: Shall I go back immediately?

learner.hr: Prvo stani gdje možeš pa zajedno pogledajmo kartu.
learner.en: First stop somewhere suitable, then let's look at the map together.

partner.hr: Sad vidim, ona je imala dva ulaza.
partner.en: Now I see; it had two entrances.

learner.hr: Da, a ja sam opisao samo jedan.
learner.en: Yes, and I described only one.

partner.en: Will you send your location?

learner.hr: Hoću. Bit će jasniji od naše rasprave o kruhu.
learner.en: Yes. It'll be clearer than our discussion about bread.

conversations.title: A board-game stake turns into a washing-up agreement

partner.en: Are we playing for anything?

learner.hr: Ulog može biti pranje šalica, ništa više.
learner.en: The stake can be washing the cups, nothing more.

partner.hr: Zar si toliko siguran da pobjeđuješ?
partner.en: Are you that sure you'll win?

learner.hr: Nisam. Bez malo rizika i ti bi zaspao nad pločom.
learner.en: No. Without a little risk you'd fall asleep over the board too.

partner.en: What if it's a draw?

learner.hr: Onda peremo zajedno, što je možda i najbrže.
learner.en: Then we wash them together, which might be quickest anyway.

partner.en: It looks as though you've lost.

learner.hr: Vidim. Sad ću svoje velike najave zamijeniti spužvom.
learner.en: I see. Now I'll swap my grand announcements for a sponge.

partner.en: Would you like a rematch later?

learner.hr: Hoću, ali prvo da šalice stvarno budu oprane.
learner.en: Yes, but first let's actually get the cups washed.

conversations.title: A family tree mixes up a birthplace and a home town

partner.hr: Zašto si uz djeda napisao drugi grad?
partner.en: Why did you put another town beside Grandpa?

learner.hr: Tamo se rodio. Ovo gdje je živio nije njegovo mjesto rođenja.
learner.en: That's where he was born. Where he lived isn't his birthplace.

partner.en: Are you sure?

learner.hr: Provjerio sam dokument i pitao baku.
learner.en: I checked the document and asked Grandma.

partner.hr: Onda sam ja krivo razumio priču.
partner.en: Then I misunderstood the story.

learner.hr: Nije čudno. U obitelji smo uvijek spominjali kuću, ne bolnicu.
learner.en: Understandable. In the family we always mentioned the house, not the hospital.

partner.en: Shall we list both places?

learner.hr: Hoćemo, uz kratko objašnjenje što koje znači.
learner.en: Yes, with a short explanation of what each means.

partner.hr: Tako će i djeci biti jasnije.
partner.en: That will make it clearer for the children too.

learner.hr: Da, neće morati ponavljati našu malu potragu.
learner.en: Yes, they won't have to repeat our little investigation.

conversations.title: A swimming lesson starts from the shallower end

partner.en: Why are we going to the other end?

learner.hr: Tamo je bazen plići i lakše nam je započeti vježbu.
learner.en: The pool is shallower there and it's easier to start the exercise.

partner.en: So I don't need to dive straight away?

learner.hr: Ne. Udahni mirno i poslušaj što trenerica pokazuje.
learner.en: No. Take a calm breath and listen to what the coach is demonstrating.

partner.en: The others look unsure too.

learner.hr: Naravno. Svi smo ovdje da naučimo, ne da glumimo profesionalce.
learner.en: Of course. We're all here to learn, not pretend to be professionals.

partner.en: Can I just watch first?

learner.hr: Pitaj trenericu. Ona će ti reći kojim redom ide grupa.
learner.en: Ask the coach. She'll tell you the group's order.

partner.en: I feel a little better now.

learner.hr: Dobro. Jedan jasan korak pomaže više od zamišljanja cijele dužine.
learner.en: Good. One clear step helps more than imagining the whole length.

conversations.title: A repair estimate names a part the owner does not recognise

partner.en: Do you understand what they're replacing?

learner.hr: Ne sasvim. Tražio sam procjenu, ali naziv dijela mi ništa ne govori.
learner.en: Not entirely. I asked for an estimate, but the part's name means nothing to me.

partner.en: Can you ask what it does?

learner.hr: Mogu. Želim razumjeti koji problemi nastaju kad ne radi.
learner.en: Yes. I want to understand what problems arise when it doesn't work.

partner.en: Will you ask for a picture?

learner.hr: To bi pomoglo. Lakše povezujem naziv s predmetom nego s brojem artikla.
learner.en: That would help. I connect a name to an object more easily than to an item number.

partner.en: Will they think you're difficult?

learner.hr: Nadam se da neće. Pitanje je kratko i želim odobriti stvaran posao.
learner.en: I hope not. The question is brief, and I want to approve actual work.

partner.en: What did they reply?

learner.hr: Poslali su objašnjenje. Sad mi cijena barem ima smisla.
learner.en: They sent an explanation. At least now the price makes sense to me.

conversations.title: A gallery label credits the wrong generation

partner.en: Why did you stop at the signature?

learner.hr: Ovdje piše otac, a crtež je napravio sin.
learner.en: It says the father here, but the son made the drawing.

partner.en: How do you know?

learner.hr: Čitao sam o dvije generacije umjetnika iz iste obitelji.
learner.en: I read about two generations of artists in the same family.

partner.en: Perhaps they shared a workshop.

learner.hr: Jesu, ali oznaka ipak treba navesti pravog autora. Lako je prenijeti krivi potpis kad su imena slična.
learner.en: They did, but the label should still name the right creator. It's easy to copy the wrong credit when the names are similar.

partner.en: Will you report it?

learner.hr: Pitat ću jesam li dobro razumio, bez tvrdnje da svi drugi griješe.
learner.en: I'll ask whether I've understood correctly, without claiming everyone else is wrong.

partner.en: Do you have the source handy?

learner.hr: Imam bilješku u telefonu. Ako treba, mogu poslati poveznicu.
learner.en: I have a note on my phone. If needed, I can send a link.

conversations.title: A school club chooses a shorter name

partner.en: Why are you changing the club's name?

learner.hr: Novi članovi ne znaju što stara kratica znači.
learner.en: New members don't know what the old abbreviation means.

partner.en: Who chooses the new one?

learner.hr: Svi glasamo, ali prvo želimo razmotriti prijedloge.
learner.en: We all vote, but first we want to consider the suggestions.

partner.en: Which do you like?

learner.hr: Najkraći, ako jasno kaže da se bavimo prirodom.
learner.en: The shortest one, if it clearly says we work with nature.

partner.en: What about the old members?

learner.hr: Njima ćemo objasniti razlike, ne samo skinuti stari natpis.
learner.en: We'll explain the differences to them, not just take down the old sign.

partner.en: Will you keep the old sign?

learner.hr: Hoćemo u albumu. I on je dio naše priče.
learner.en: Yes, in the album. It's part of our story too.

conversations.title: An online print is advertised as an original

partner.en: Why aren't you ordering that picture?

learner.hr: Oglas kaže original, a na fotografiji se vidi tiskani potpis.
learner.en: The listing says original, but the photo shows a printed signature.

partner.en: Do you think it's a scam?

learner.hr: Možda. Neću reći da je prijevara prije nego pitam prodavača.
learner.en: Perhaps. I won't call it a scam before asking the seller.

partner.en: What would you write?

learner.hr: Neka objasni je li riječ o otisku ili ručnoj slici.
learner.en: I'd ask him to explain whether it's a print or a hand-painted picture.

partner.en: Has a reply arrived?

learner.hr: Jest. Priznaje da su u opisu ostale lažne informacije iz drugog oglasa.
learner.en: Yes. He admits false information from another listing remained in the description.

partner.en: Will you buy it anyway?

learner.hr: Ne ovu. Sad barem znam što se zapravo prodaje.
learner.en: Not this one. At least now I know what's actually for sale.

conversations.title: A newcomer is invited to join a sketching group

partner.en: May I just watch?

learner.hr: Naravno, ili nam se pridruži kad poželiš.
learner.en: Of course, or join us whenever you like.

partner.en: I didn't bring supplies.

learner.hr: Imamo viška olovaka. Ljudi su ovdje ljubazni i rado posuđuju pribor.
learner.en: We have spare pencils. People here are kind and happy to lend supplies.

partner.hr: Nisam ni znao da se sastajete.
partner.en: I didn't even know you met here.

learner.hr: Onda ostani danas, pa ćemo ti poslati raspored.
learner.en: Then stay today, and we'll send you the schedule.

partner.en: What are you drawing?

learner.hr: Svatko ono što vidi s mjesta na kojem sjedi.
learner.en: Each person draws what they can see from where they're sitting.

partner.hr: Onda mi je prvi predmet ova šalica.
partner.en: Then my first subject is this cup.

learner.hr: Dobar početak. Neće otići prije nego završiš.
learner.en: A good start. It won't leave before you finish.

conversations.title: A grandmother’s sewing pattern turns up in a book

partner.en: What did you take out of the book?

learner.hr: Izvadio sam kroj. U njezinom zapisu piše čemu je služio.
learner.en: I took out a sewing pattern. Her note says what it was used for.

partner.en: Do you mean Grandma?

learner.hr: Da. Ona je papirima označavala stranice umjesto da ih sprema posebno.
learner.en: Yes. She marked pages with papers instead of keeping them separately.

partner.hr: Znaš li za koji komad odjeće?
partner.en: Do you know which garment it was for?

learner.hr: Za dječji kaput. Veličina je napisana sa strane.
learner.en: A child's coat. The size is written at the side.

partner.en: Will you leave it inside?

learner.hr: Napravit ću omotnicu, a u knjigu staviti bilješku gdje je.
learner.en: I'll make an envelope and put a note in the book saying where it is.

partner.en: Why a note too?

learner.hr: Da sljedeći čitatelj ne traži isti trag po svim policama.
learner.en: So the next reader doesn't search every shelf for the same clue.

conversations.title: A business card keeps an outdated job title

partner.en: Why are you handing her business card back?

learner.hr: Na njenoj kartici piše stari odjel. Poslovni partner bi zato pisao krivoj osobi.
learner.en: Her card lists the old department. A business partner would therefore write to the wrong person.

partner.en: Haven't they printed new ones yet?

learner.hr: Jesu, samo je u torbu stavila staru kutiju.
learner.en: They have; she just put the old box in her bag.

partner.en: Can she correct it by hand?

learner.hr: Za danas može, uz novu adresu koju ćemo poslati porukom.
learner.en: For today she can, with the new address we'll send by message.

partner.en: Will you throw all the old ones away?

learner.hr: Prvo ćemo ih odvojiti da se više ne pomiješaju.
learner.en: First we'll separate them so they don't get mixed up again.

partner.en: A small thing, but it can easily cause confusion.

learner.hr: Upravo tako. Papir ne zna da smo se preselili.
learner.en: Exactly. The paper doesn't know we've moved.

conversations.title: A forgotten sports kit travels in somebody else’s bag

partner.hr: Je li ti brat uzeo opremu?
partner.en: Did your brother take your kit?

learner.hr: Jest, u njegovoj torbi je. Ja sam nosio samo loptu.
learner.en: Yes, it's in his bag. I only carried the ball.

partner.en: Where is he now?

learner.hr: Kod kuće. Zaboravio je da ja nemam drugi par tenisica.
learner.en: At home. He forgot I don't have another pair of trainers.

partner.en: Would you like me to call him?

learner.hr: Nazovi i reci da se sjeti ponijeti cijelu torbu, ne samo majicu.
learner.en: Call and tell him to remember the whole bag, not just the T-shirt.

partner.hr: Kaže da stiže za deset minuta.
partner.en: He says he'll arrive in ten minutes.

learner.hr: Dobro. Do tada mogu pomoći postaviti mrežu.
learner.en: Good. Until then I can help put up the net.

partner.en: Should you thank him?

learner.hr: Trebam. Iako smo obojica mogli bolje provjeriti stvari.
learner.en: Yes. Even though we both could have checked things better.

conversations.title: A community fridge needs a clearer donation note

partner.hr: Zašto ne ostavljaš ovu kutiju hrane?
partner.en: Why aren't you leaving this food box?

learner.hr: Na njoj nema podataka. Namjera mi je pomoći, ne stvarati dodatni posao.
learner.en: It has no information on it. My intention is to help, not create extra work.

partner.en: Can we just write lunch?

learner.hr: Radije navedimo sastojke i ono što pravila traže.
learner.en: Let's list the ingredients and what the rules require instead.

partner.en: Where are the rules?

learner.hr: Ovdje uz vrata. Pitajmo volonterku ako nešto nije jasno.
learner.en: Here by the door. Let's ask the volunteer if anything is unclear.

partner.hr: Ona kaže da našu hranu danas ne prima.
partner.en: She says she can't accept our food today.

learner.hr: Onda ćemo to poštovati, bez uvjeravanja da mi najbolje znamo.
learner.en: Then we'll respect that without insisting we know best.

partner.en: What can we bring next time?

learner.hr: Uzet ću njihov popis. Ova organizacija objavljuje potrebe i na vratima.
learner.en: I'll take their list. This organisation also posts its needs on the door.

conversations.title: A library display puts a romance in the wrong section

partner.hr: Zašto je ova knjiga među putopisima?
partner.en: Why is this book among travel accounts?

learner.hr: Vjerojatno zbog grada na koricama. Zapravo je romantično štivo.
learner.en: Probably because of the town on the cover. It's actually romantic reading.

partner.en: Have you read it?

learner.hr: Jesam. Ljubavnici mnogo hodaju, ali to je ipak roman.
learner.en: Yes. The lovers walk a lot, but it's still a novel.

partner.en: Will you move it yourself?

learner.hr: Pitat ću knjižničarku. Možda izlog ima temu koju nisam primijetio.
learner.en: I'll ask the librarian. Perhaps the display has a theme I haven't noticed.

partner.hr: Kaže da su knjige povezane istim gradom.
partner.en: She says the books are linked by the same town.

learner.hr: Onda ima smisla. Moja oznaka žanra nije bila cijeli odgovor.
learner.en: Then it makes sense. My genre label wasn't the whole answer.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li uzeti još jednu s izloga?
partner.en: Will you take another one from the display?

learner.hr: Hoću. Sad me zanima kako ga drugi pisac vidi.
learner.en: Yes. Now I want to know how another writer sees it.

conversations.title: A junior reporter learns to check a name twice

partner.en: Why are you calling the interviewee again?

learner.hr: Pogrešno sam zapisao kako se preziva.
learner.en: I wrote down his surname incorrectly.

partner.hr: Ne možeš li pogoditi prema poruci?
partner.en: Can't you guess from the message?

learner.hr: Ne vidim jasno jedan od znakova u poruci. Radije ću pitati nego krivo napisati prezime.
learner.en: I can't clearly see one of the characters in the message. I'd rather ask than misspell the surname.

partner.hr: Hoće li mu smetati dodatni poziv?
partner.en: Will the extra call bother him?

learner.hr: Nadam se da neće. Iskrenost mi je važnija od pretvaranja da sve znam.
learner.en: I hope not. Honesty matters more to me than pretending I know everything.

partner.en: Has he confirmed it now?

learner.hr: Jest, i rekao da mu se ime često krivo napiše.
learner.en: Yes, and said his name is often misspelled.

partner.en: Then you can finish the article.

learner.hr: Mogu, uz još jednu provjeru cijelog potpisa.
learner.en: Yes, with one more check of the whole credit.

conversations.title: A taxi stops at the old entrance to a clinic

partner.en: Why is the driver looking for another approach?

learner.hr: Tražimo novi ulaz u kliniku. Preselili su ga, a ja sam rekao samo staru adresu.
learner.en: We're looking for the new clinic entrance. They moved it, and I only gave the old address.

partner.en: Does he know where to go now?

learner.hr: Zna. Zvao sam recepciju u klinici i opisali su vrata.
learner.en: Yes. I called reception at the clinic and they described the door.

partner.en: Will you make your appointment?

learner.hr: Trebao bih, ali javio sam da možda kasnim nekoliko minuta.
learner.en: I should, but I said I might be a few minutes late.

partner.en: Do you need me to meet you?

learner.hr: Ne treba, sad vidim oznake.
learner.en: No need; I can see the signs now.

partner.en: Let me know when you're done.

learner.hr: Hoću. Za povratak ću barem znati prava vrata.
learner.en: I will. At least I'll know the right door for the return.

conversations.title: A child discovers a family nickname in a letter

partner.hr: Tko je ovaj čovjek kojeg baka zove junakom?
partner.en: Who's this man Grandma calls a hero?

learner.hr: Njezin brat. To je bio njihov nadimak iz djetinjstva.
learner.en: Her brother. That was their childhood nickname.

partner.en: Did he really rescue something?

learner.hr: Možda je to samo obiteljski mit. Ne znamo cijelu priču.
learner.en: Perhaps it's just a family myth. We don't know the whole story.

partner.en: Will you ask her?

learner.hr: Hoću. Takve male priče lako nestanu ako ih nitko ne zapiše.
learner.en: Yes. Little stories like that can easily disappear if nobody records them.

partner.en: Can I listen to the conversation?

learner.hr: Možeš ako joj odgovara. Pitat ćemo prije snimanja.
learner.en: Yes, if she's comfortable with it. We'll ask before recording.

partner.en: What if she doesn't remember?

learner.hr: Onda ćemo zapisati da je priča ostala misterija.
learner.en: Then we'll record that the story remained a mystery.

conversations.title: A crime novel gives two witnesses incompatible accounts

partner.hr: Zašto detektiv ponovno zove iste ljude?
partner.en: Why is the detective calling the same people again?

learner.hr: Tijekom istrage primijetio je da se njihova vremena ne slažu.
learner.en: During the investigation he noticed their times don't match.

partner.hr: Znači li to da jedan laže?
partner.en: Does that mean one is lying?

learner.hr: Možda, ali iskaz može biti pogrešan i zbog lošeg sjećanja.
learner.en: Perhaps, but an account can also be wrong because of poor memory.

partner.en: Who's he checking now?

learner.hr: Sve svjedoke, ne samo onoga koji mu je od početka sumnjiv.
learner.en: All the witnesses, not just the one he's suspected from the start.

partner.hr: Sviđa li ti se takav detektiv?
partner.en: Do you like that kind of detective?

learner.hr: Da, barem pokušava provjeriti vlastitu pretpostavku.
learner.en: Yes; at least he tries to check his own assumption.

partner.en: Will you reveal the solution to me?

learner.hr: Neću. Ali nemoj preskočiti razgovor u pekarnici.
learner.en: No. But don't skip the conversation in the bakery.

conversations.title: A building’s old name outlives its original purpose

partner.en: Why do they call this house a palace?

learner.hr: Ovdje je nekad boravio guverner. Danas su unutra uredi.
learner.en: A governor once stayed here. Today it contains offices.

partner.en: Are any of his belongings there?

learner.hr: Ne znam. Uz portret guvernera nisam vidio popis predmeta.
learner.en: I don't know. I didn't see an inventory beside the governor's portrait.

partner.en: Can we look inside?

learner.hr: Samo dio koji je otvoren posjetiteljima, kaže obavijest.
learner.en: Only the part open to visitors, the notice says.

partner.en: Will you go in?

learner.hr: Hoću, zanima me što je ostalo od starog rasporeda soba.
learner.en: Yes; I'm interested in what remains of the old room layout.

partner.en: A lot may have changed.

learner.hr: Sigurno nešto jest. Zgrade nastavljaju živjeti i nakon svojih prvih stanara.
learner.en: Some things surely have. Buildings go on living after their first occupants.

conversations.title: An actor needs a pause after an emotional scene

partner.en: Why aren't we repeating it immediately?

learner.hr: Nemam više snage za isti monolog bez predaha.
learner.en: I have no energy left for the same monologue without a break.

partner.en: Is the scene too difficult?

learner.hr: Snažna je, ali problem je što smo je prošli već šest puta.
learner.en: It's powerful, but the problem is we've gone through it six times already.

partner.en: Shall we look at another section?

learner.hr: Možemo prvo proći oznake na podu, bez cijelog teksta.
learner.en: We can go over the floor marks first, without the whole text.

partner.en: Will you tell the director?

learner.hr: Hoću. Treba znati da sad više ponavljam nego slušam partnera.
learner.en: Yes. She needs to know I'm now repeating rather than listening to my partner.

partner.en: Once more after a break?

learner.hr: Još jednom, ako se dogovorimo što točno želimo promijeniti.
learner.en: Once more, if we agree exactly what we want to change.

conversations.title: A jump measurement depends on the camera angle

partner.en: Why are you filming from the floor?

learner.hr: Želim vidjeti koliko sam visoko skočio, ali ovako izgleda pretjerano.
learner.en: I want to see how high I jumped, but this makes it look exaggerated.

partner.en: Shall I stand farther away?

learner.hr: Da, i podigni telefon da se oznaka jasno vidi.
learner.en: Yes, and raise the phone so the marker is clearly visible.

partner.en: Do you need to jump again immediately?

learner.hr: Prvo ću se odmoriti. Nije mi cilj dobra snimka pod svaku cijenu.
learner.en: I'll rest first. A good recording isn't my aim at any cost.

partner.en: What will you compare afterwards?

learner.hr: Položaj tijela i oznaku, ne samo dojam da letim.
learner.en: Body position and the marker, not just the impression of flying.

partner.en: The shot looks fairer now.

learner.hr: Dobro. Tako će mi snimka stvarno pomoći na treningu.
learner.en: Good. That way the recording will actually help me in training.

conversations.title: A student film uses a real story with permission

partner.en: Is this a true story?

learner.hr: Početak jest stvarna priča, ali smo kasnije događaje izmijenili.
learner.en: The beginning is true, but we changed the later events.

partner.en: Are the people recognisable?

learner.hr: Neki jesu. Stvarni ljudi nisu isto što i likovi koje možemo mijenjati bez pitanja.
learner.en: Some are. Real people aren't the same as characters we can change without asking.

partner.en: Did you show them the script?

learner.hr: Jesmo prije snimanja. Jednu smo scenu nakon toga izbacili.
learner.en: Yes, before filming. We removed one scene afterwards.

partner.hr: Je li priča zbog toga slabija?
partner.en: Is the story weaker because of that?

learner.hr: Meni nije. Sad više pažnje dajemo onome što smijemo pošteno prikazati.
learner.en: Not to me. Now we give more attention to what we can fairly portray.

partner.hr: Hoćete li napisati da je djelomično izmišljena?
partner.en: Will you say it's partly fictional?

learner.hr: Hoćemo, da gledatelji ne uzmu svaku rečenicu kao zapis događaja.
learner.en: Yes, so viewers don't take every line as a record of events.

conversations.title: A fantasy-game map puts a knight in the wrong country

partner.en: Why is your knight standing here?

learner.hr: Vitez je trebao biti na granici kraljevstva, a ja sam ga stavio na otok.
learner.en: The knight was supposed to be at the kingdom's border, but I put him on the island.

partner.en: Didn't you see the marker?

learner.hr: Vidio sam boju, ali nisam pročitao ime.
learner.en: I saw the colour but didn't read the name.

partner.en: Can you move him now?

learner.hr: Provjerimo pravilo. Još nismo odigrali prvi potez.
learner.en: Let's check the rule. We haven't played the first turn yet.

partner.hr: Piše da se početni raspored može ispraviti.
partner.en: It says the starting layout can be corrected.

learner.hr: Dobro. Onda ga vraćam tamo gdje stvarno počinje priča.
learner.en: Good. Then I'll put him back where the story really begins.

partner.en: Will you read next time?

learner.hr: Hoću. Moj vitez očito ne zna plivati preko cijele karte.
learner.en: Yes. My knight clearly can't swim across the whole map.

conversations.title: A condolence visit is kept short at the family’s request

partner.en: Shall we stay for coffee?

learner.hr: Danas ne. Udovica je zamolila za kratak posjet.
learner.en: Not today. The widow asked for a short visit.

partner.en: What shall I say to her?

learner.hr: Izrazi sućut jednostavno. Ne moraš imati rečenicu koja sve popravlja.
learner.en: Offer condolences simply. You don't need a sentence that fixes everything.

partner.en: May I offer help?

learner.hr: Možeš ponuditi nešto konkretno, ali prihvati i ako ne želi.
learner.en: You can offer something specific, but accept it if she doesn't want it.

partner.en: I brought lunch in a container.

learner.hr: Pitaj želi li ga sada. Ne želimo joj stvarati dodatni posao.
learner.en: Ask whether she'd like it now. We don't want to create more work for her.

partner.hr: Javit ćemo se opet za nekoliko dana?
partner.en: Shall we get in touch again in a few days?

learner.hr: Ako joj odgovara. Važno je slušati njezinu želju, ne samo naš plan posjeta.
learner.en: If that suits her. It's important to listen to what she wants, not only our visiting plan.

conversations.title: A school play’s uniform does not establish the rank

partner.hr: Je li moj lik ovdje običan vojnik?
partner.en: Is my character an ordinary soldier here?

learner.hr: U scenariju piše časnik. Kostim još nije dovršen.
learner.en: The script says officer. The costume isn't finished yet.

partner.en: Do you know his rank?

learner.hr: Ne znam. Za tog časnika zasad imamo samo ime i dvije replike.
learner.en: No. For that officer we only have a name and two lines so far.

partner.hr: Hoću li onda sam izabrati oznake?
partner.en: Shall I choose the insignia myself, then?

learner.hr: Radije pitaj kostimografkinju. Ne trebamo izmišljati svaki detalj zasebno.
learner.en: Better ask the costume designer. We don't need to invent every detail separately.

partner.hr: Možda je najvažnije kako se ponaša.
partner.en: Perhaps how he behaves matters most.

learner.hr: Jest, ali kostim treba pratiti istu priču.
learner.en: Yes, but the costume needs to follow the same story.

partner.en: Then I'll finish the lines first.

learner.hr: Dobro. Odora neće umjesto tebe izgovoriti replike.
learner.en: Good. The uniform won't say the lines for you.

conversations.title: Stage makeup looks too real in the corridor

partner.en: What happened to your face?

learner.hr: Ništa, modrice su nacrtane za predstavu.
learner.en: Nothing; the bruises are painted for the play.

partner.en: I was really worried.

learner.hr: Oprosti. Zaboravio sam kako to izgleda izvan pozornice.
learner.en: Sorry. I forgot how it looks offstage.

partner.hr: Je li u sceni netko stvarno udaren?
partner.en: Is someone actually hit in the scene?

learner.hr: Nije. Nitko me ne smije stvarno udariti zbog uvjerljivog prizora.
learner.en: No. Nobody gets to really hit me for a convincing scene.

partner.hr: Mogu li vidjeti kako to nastaje?
partner.en: May I see how it's done?

learner.hr: Pitaj šminkericu kad završi. Boje izbliza izgledaju sasvim drukčije.
learner.en: Ask the makeup artist when she's finished. The colours look quite different close up.

partner.hr: Hoćeš se oprati prije odlaska doma?
partner.en: Will you wash it off before going home?

learner.hr: Hoću. Ne trebam još jedan zabrinut razgovor u autobusu.
learner.en: Yes. I don't need another worried conversation on the bus.

conversations.title: A rowing plan is paused by changing water conditions

partner.en: Why haven't you launched the boat yet?

learner.hr: Struja je jača nego jutros. Čekamo upute voditelja.
learner.en: The current is stronger than this morning. We're waiting for the leader's instructions.

partner.hr: Ali vidim da netko već vesla.
partner.en: But I can see someone rowing already.

learner.hr: Vidim i ja, ali to ne govori jesu li uvjeti dobri za nas.
learner.en: So can I, but that doesn't tell us whether conditions are good for us.

partner.hr: Što je napravio onaj veliki trag na vodi?
partner.en: What made that big trail on the water?

learner.hr: Val od broda koji je upravo prošao.
learner.en: A wave from the boat that just passed.

partner.en: Will you give up?

learner.hr: Ako voditelj kaže da danas nije za našu grupu, da.
learner.en: If the leader says today isn't suitable for our group, yes.

partner.en: What about the afternoon, then?

learner.hr: Imamo i šetnju uz obalu. Plan ne mora završiti s čamcem.
learner.en: We can walk along the bank too. The plan doesn't have to end with the boat.

conversations.title: A crime film jumps from arrest to a much later scene

partner.en: Why is it suddenly a different year?

learner.hr: Film je preskočio vrijeme nakon njegova uhićenja.
learner.en: The film skipped the time after his arrest.

partner.en: Wasn't he only just arrested?

learner.hr: Uhićen je u prošloj sceni, ali sada gledamo događaje mnogo kasnije.
learner.en: He was arrested in the last scene, but now we're watching events much later.

partner.en: Where does it say that?

learner.hr: U kutu se nakratko pojavio datum.
learner.en: A date briefly appeared in the corner.

partner.en: Can you rewind a few seconds?

learner.hr: Mogu. I meni je prijelaz bio prebrz.
learner.en: Yes. The transition was too fast for me too.

partner.hr: Sad razumijem zašto su svi stariji.
partner.en: Now I understand why everyone is older.

learner.hr: Dobro. Ovaj put gledamo i sitna slova, ne samo lica.
learner.en: Good. This time we're watching the small text too, not just the faces.

conversations.title: A dark stage hides a clue too well

partner.en: Why didn't the audience notice the key?

learner.hr: U toj tami ni ja ga nisam vidio iz zadnjeg reda.
learner.en: In that darkness I couldn't see it from the back row either.

partner.en: Wasn't it meant to be hidden?

learner.hr: Skriveni trag ipak mora postati vidljiv u pravom trenutku.
learner.en: A hidden clue still needs to become visible at the right moment.

partner.en: Should all the lights be brighter?

learner.hr: Možda samo promijeniti kut jednog. Pitajmo rasvjetu.
learner.en: Perhaps just change the angle of one. Let's ask the lighting crew.

partner.en: Will you sit at the back again?

learner.hr: Hoću, tamo ćemo najbolje provjeriti razliku.
learner.en: Yes; that's where we'll check the difference best.

partner.en: Can you see it now?

learner.hr: Vidi. Još je tajanstveno, ali više nije izgubljeno.
learner.en: Yes. It's still mysterious, but no longer lost.

conversations.title: A long journey becomes easier to picture in smaller stages

partner.hr: Zašto imaš tri karte na stolu?
partner.en: Why do you have three maps on the table?

learner.hr: Pokušavam put kroz Europu podijeliti na manje dijelove.
learner.en: I'm trying to divide the journey across Europe into smaller sections.

partner.hr: Zar sve ne stane na jednu?
partner.en: Doesn't it all fit on one?

learner.hr: Stane, ali na toj razini ne vidim veze među gradovima u Europi.
learner.en: It does, but at that scale I can't see connections between European cities.

partner.en: Have you booked everything already?

learner.hr: Nismo. Prvo želimo znati koliko ćemo stvarno biti na putu.
learner.en: No. First we want to know how much time we'll really spend travelling.

partner.en: Will you leave somewhere out?

learner.hr: Vjerojatno. Radije dva dana negdje nego samo sat između vlakova.
learner.en: Probably. Better two days somewhere than just an hour between trains.

partner.hr: Krenimo od onoga što vam je najvažnije.
partner.en: Let's start with what matters most to you.

learner.hr: Da. Karta nije popis koji moramo cijeli označiti.
learner.en: Yes. A map isn't a list we have to tick off completely.

conversations.title: A sister’s exhibition happens far from home

partner.en: Where is your sister travelling?

learner.hr: U Meksiko, zbog zajedničke izložbe s kolegama.
learner.en: To Mexico, for a group exhibition with colleagues.

partner.en: Will you go with her?

learner.hr: Ne mogu ovaj put. U Meksiku će je dočekati prijateljica.
learner.en: I can't this time. A friend will meet her in Mexico.

partner.en: Is she nervous?

learner.hr: Jest, više zbog prijevoza radova nego zbog govora.
learner.en: Yes, more about transporting the work than the speech.

partner.hr: Možemo li izložbu vidjeti na internetu?
partner.en: Can we see the exhibition online?

learner.hr: Kaže da će poslati fotografije nakon postavljanja.
learner.en: She says she'll send photographs after it's installed.

partner.hr: Onda ćemo joj napisati podršku prije polaska.
partner.en: Then let's write her a supportive message before she leaves.

learner.hr: Hoćemo. Ne mora prije velikog dana odgovarati na sto pitanja.
learner.en: Yes. She doesn't need to answer a hundred questions before the big day.

conversations.title: A costume cupboard contains clothes for dolls too

partner.hr: Zašto ova haljina ne stane nikome?
partner.en: Why doesn't this dress fit anyone?

learner.hr: Malena je jer je dio pribora za lutke.
learner.en: It's small because it's part of the puppet supplies.

partner.hr: Mislio sam da su sve kutije iste.
partner.en: I thought all the boxes were the same.

learner.hr: Ova ima oznaku dječje predstave, ali unutra su i mali kostimi za lutke.
learner.en: This one is labelled children's performance, but it also contains little costumes for puppets.

partner.en: Where are ours, then?

learner.hr: U drugom ormaru. Prvo trebamo provjeriti popis uloga.
learner.en: In the other cupboard. We need to check the cast list first.

partner.en: Shall we put these back?

learner.hr: Hoćemo u istu vrećicu, da i sljedeća grupa nađe sve dijelove.
learner.en: Yes, in the same bag so the next group finds every part too.

partner.hr: Dobro da nisam pokušao navući rukav.
partner.en: Good thing I didn't try putting the sleeve on.

learner.hr: Dobro da si pitao prije nego što smo dobili novi posao sa šivanjem.
learner.en: Good thing you asked before we gave ourselves another sewing job.

conversations.title: A locked project file is not the same as a missing file

partner.hr: Zašto se ta datoteka ne otvara?
partner.en: Why won't that file open?

learner.hr: Zaključao sam datoteku lozinkom i zaboravio gdje sam zapisao šifru.
learner.en: I locked the file with a password and forgot where I recorded it.

partner.en: Has it disappeared?

learner.hr: Nije, još je tu. Samo ja nemam spreman pristup.
learner.en: No, it's still there. I just don't have access ready.

partner.en: Do you have your usual record?

learner.hr: Imam. Provjerit ću ga prije nego počnem nasumično pokušavati.
learner.en: Yes. I'll check it before trying at random.

partner.en: Did you find the right one?

learner.hr: Jesam, bila je pod nazivom projekta, ne datoteke.
learner.en: Yes; it was under the project name, not the filename.

partner.en: Is everything all right now?

learner.hr: Jest. A opis zapisa ću popraviti dok još znam što znači.
learner.en: Yes. And I'll improve the record's description while I still know what it means.

conversations.title: A back door stays locked during a public event

partner.en: Why aren't we going through here?

learner.hr: Ovaj prolaz je zaključan. Za goste je otvoren glavni ulaz.
learner.en: This passage is locked. The main entrance is open for guests.

partner.en: Didn't we come through here yesterday?

learner.hr: Jesmo dok se postavljala oprema. Danas je sve zaključano s ove strane.
learner.en: We did while equipment was being set up. Today everything on this side is locked.

partner.en: Shall we ask for a key?

learner.hr: Ne treba za nas. Samo idemo oko zgrade.
learner.en: We don't need one. We'll just go around the building.

partner.en: Will we lose our place?

learner.hr: Neće, ulaznice imamo. Stignemo prije početka.
learner.en: No; we have tickets. We'll get there before it starts.

partner.en: Then you lead.

learner.hr: Može. Barem smo sada naučili koji je pravi ulaz za publiku.
learner.en: Yes. At least now we know the right public entrance.

conversations.title: A file transfer starts with checking which computer has the latest copy

partner.en: Why aren't you connecting the devices yet?

learner.hr: Prvo moramo utvrditi na kojem je zadnja verzija.
learner.en: First we need to establish which has the latest version.

partner.hr: Mislio sam da su računala ista.
partner.en: I thought the computers were the same.

learner.hr: Izgledaju isto, ali sadržaj računala nije nužno jednak.
learner.en: They look the same, but their contents aren't necessarily identical.

partner.en: What should I check?

learner.hr: Datum i naziv datoteke, pa ćemo usporediti sadržaj.
learner.en: The date and filename, then we'll compare the contents.

partner.en: This one has the new conclusion.

learner.hr: Dobro. Nju ćemo sačuvati pa tek onda spojiti uređaje za prijenos.
learner.en: Good. We'll save that one, then connect the devices for the transfer.

partner.en: Why so much checking?

learner.hr: Da slučajno ne zamijenimo novu datoteku starom.
learner.en: So we don't accidentally replace the new file with the old one.

conversations.title: A student’s notes stay outside a borrowed book

partner.en: Why are you writing on separate paper?

learner.hr: Knjiga nije moja. Bilješke držim u svojem bloku.
learner.en: The book isn't mine. I keep notes in my own notebook.

partner.hr: Nećeš li zaboraviti na koju se stranicu odnose?
partner.en: Won't you forget which page they refer to?

learner.hr: Zato u bilješku dodam broj stranice i kratki naslov.
learner.en: That's why I add the page number and a short heading to the note.

partner.en: Can I borrow them later?

learner.hr: Poslat ću ti kopiju svojeg dijela projekta kad ga dovršim.
learner.en: I'll send you a copy of my section of the project when I finish it.

partner.en: What about the book?

learner.hr: Nju prvo moram vratiti vlasniku. Nismo dogovorili daljnje posuđivanje.
learner.en: I need to return that to its owner first. We didn't agree on lending it onwards.

partner.en: Then just send me the notes.

learner.hr: Hoću, uz podatak iz koje su knjige.
learner.en: I will, with the details of which book they're from.

conversations.title: Two friends bought cinema seats in different rows

partner.en: Why are you sitting so far away?

learner.hr: Ti sjediš u šestom, a ja imam sedmi red.
learner.en: You're in row six, and my ticket is for row seven.

partner.en: I thought we were booking together.

learner.hr: I ja. Očito ne sjedimo onako kako smo zamislili.
learner.en: So did I. Clearly we aren't sitting where we imagined.

partner.en: Can we just move?

learner.hr: Pitajmo osoblje, možda postoji slobodan par mjesta.
learner.en: Let's ask the staff; perhaps there's a free pair of seats.

partner.hr: Kažu da možemo pričekati do početka.
partner.en: They say we can wait until it starts.

learner.hr: U redu. Ako nitko ne dođe, pokazat će nam što je slobodno.
learner.en: All right. If nobody comes, they'll show us what's free.

partner.en: What if there aren't any?

learner.hr: Pogledat ćemo isti film iz dva kuta, pa se naći poslije.
learner.en: We'll watch the same film from two angles and meet afterwards.

conversations.title: A connection warning is confused with an update notice

partner.hr: Zašto si počeo preuzimati novu verziju?
partner.en: Why did you start downloading a new version?

learner.hr: Mislio sam da zato mreža ne radi.
learner.en: I thought that was why the network wasn't working.

partner.en: Does the notice say that?

learner.hr: Ne. Ova obavijest očito nije povezana s gubitkom veze.
learner.en: No. This notice clearly isn't connected to losing the connection.

partner.en: Shall we check the connection first?

learner.hr: Hoćemo. Mijenjao sam dvije stvari odjednom pa ne znam što pomaže.
learner.en: Yes. I was changing two things at once, so I don't know what's helping.

partner.en: The other device works normally.

learner.hr: Onda možemo suziti potragu na ovaj, bez nagađanja o cijeloj mreži.
learner.en: Then we can narrow the search to this one instead of guessing about the whole network.

partner.en: You're connected again now.

learner.hr: Dobro. A ažuriranje ću dovršiti kad ne trebam hitno slati poruku.
learner.en: Good. I'll finish the update when I don't urgently need to send a message.

conversations.title: A jewellery drawer mixes chains with spare craft wire

partner.en: What's caught in the drawer?

learner.hr: Pomiješao sam lance i ostatke žice iz radionice.
learner.en: I mixed chains with leftover wire from the workshop.

partner.en: Can you pull harder?

learner.hr: Radije ne. Ne želim pokidati nešto što se samo zaplelo.
learner.en: I'd rather not. I don't want to break something that's only tangled.

partner.en: Shall we take everything onto the table?

learner.hr: Da, na svijetlu krpu da vidimo sitne dijelove.
learner.en: Yes, onto a light cloth so we can see the little parts.

partner.en: What's this short wire for?

learner.hr: Za probni ukras. Trebao sam je odvojiti od gotovih stvari.
learner.en: A test decoration. I should have kept it apart from finished pieces.

partner.en: The drawer closes now.

learner.hr: Dobro. Sljedeći put dvije kutije umjesto jednog velikog čvora.
learner.en: Good. Next time, two boxes instead of one big knot.

conversations.title: A necklace gift needs a different length

partner.en: Why haven't you worn the gift yet?

learner.hr: Ogrlica mi je prekratka. Nakit mi se sviđa, samo mi ne stoji kako sam očekivala.
learner.en: The necklace is too short. I like the jewellery; it just doesn't sit as I expected.

partner.en: Will the giver be offended?

learner.hr: Nadam se da neće. Želim je nositi, ne držati u kutiji.
learner.en: I hope not. I want to wear it, not keep it in a box.

partner.en: Can it be lengthened?

learner.hr: Pitat ću u radionici prije nego pokušam sama.
learner.en: I'll ask at the workshop before trying myself.

partner.en: Do you have the receipt to check?

learner.hr: Imam, ostavljen je baš za ovakvu situaciju.
learner.en: Yes; it was included precisely for a situation like this.

partner.en: Then it makes sense to ask.

learner.hr: Da. Zahvala i prilagodba dara mogu ići zajedno.
learner.en: Yes. Gratitude and adjusting a gift can go together.

conversations.title: A parcel label keeps a friend’s old address

partner.hr: Zašto si mi poslao sliku naljepnice?
partner.en: Why did you send me a picture of the label?

learner.hr: Na tvome paketu je stara adresa. Jesi li to primijetio?
learner.en: Your parcel has the old address. Did you notice?

partner.en: No, it stayed saved.

learner.hr: Dobro da smo provjerili prije predaje.
learner.en: Good thing we checked before handing it over.

partner.en: Can you print a new one?

learner.hr: Mogu, s tvojom novom adresom i istim brojem telefona.
learner.en: Yes, with your new address and the same phone number.

partner.en: Do we need to remove the old one completely?

learner.hr: Treba ostati samo jasna nova oznaka. Pitajmo na šalteru ako se ova ne odvaja.
learner.en: Only the clear new label should remain. Let's ask at the counter if this one won't come off.

partner.en: It looks all right now.

learner.hr: Jest. Sljedeći put brišemo stare podatke čim ih promijeniš.
learner.en: Yes. Next time we'll remove old details as soon as you change them.

conversations.title: A backstage tour makes somebody want to see the play

partner.hr: Je li ti obilazak bio zanimljiv?
partner.en: Did you find the tour interesting?

learner.hr: Jest. Od samog ulaza gledao sam stvari koje publika inače ne vidi.
learner.en: Yes. From the entrance itself I was looking at things the audience doesn't normally see.

partner.en: What surprised you most?

learner.hr: Koliko mjesta zauzimaju kulise iza male pozornice.
learner.en: How much room the scenery takes up behind the little stage.

partner.en: Now you know all the tricks.

learner.hr: Ne znam sve. Želim vidjeti i samu predstavu.
learner.en: Not all. I want to see the play itself too.

partner.hr: Neće ti smetati što znaš što je iza zida?
partner.en: Won't it bother you to know what's behind the wall?

learner.hr: Mislim da neće. Možda ću samo više cijeniti promjene prizora.
learner.en: I don't think so. Perhaps I'll just appreciate the scene changes more.

partner.en: Shall we get tickets?

learner.hr: Provjerimo termine, pa odaberimo večer kad ne moramo žuriti.
learner.en: Let's check the dates and choose an evening when we don't need to rush.

conversations.title: A riverside walk reveals fields hidden from the road

partner.en: Why did you stop to take a photograph?

learner.hr: Duž rijeke vide se polja koja s ceste nikad ne primijetim.
learner.en: Along the river you can see fields I never notice from the road.

partner.hr: Mislio sam da ovdje nema ničega.
partner.en: I thought there was nothing here.

learner.hr: I ja, dok nisam došao pješice. Iz auta uglavnom gledam cestu.
learner.en: So did I, until I came on foot. From the car I mostly watch the road.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li staviti fotografiju uz onu zimsku?
partner.en: Will you put the photograph beside the winter one?

learner.hr: Hoću. Ista staza u različitim mjesecima izgleda kao nekoliko mjesta.
learner.en: Yes. The same path in different months looks like several places.

partner.en: Shall we go farther?

learner.hr: Možemo do zavoja, pa se vratiti prije mraka.
learner.en: We can go to the bend, then return before dark.

partner.en: Then save some battery.

learner.hr: Hoću. Ne moram svako stablo sačuvati posebno.
learner.en: I will. I don't have to keep every tree separately.

conversations.title: A lesson notebook contains tomorrow’s plan on today’s page

partner.hr: Zašto ne pišeš isti zadatak kao ostali?
partner.en: Why aren't you doing the same exercise as the others?

learner.hr: Današnji plan sam zamijenio s onim za sutra. Navika mi je otvarati bilježnicu tamo gdje sam stavio oznaku.
learner.en: I mixed up today's plan with tomorrow's. I have a habit of opening the notebook where I left the marker.

partner.en: Did you miss something?

learner.hr: Samo početnu uputu. Na sljedećem satu ovo će mi ipak trebati.
learner.en: Only the opening instruction. I'll still need this next lesson.

partner.hr: Možeš li sad prijeći na pravi zadatak?
partner.en: Can you switch to the right exercise now?

learner.hr: Mogu, ostavit ću oznaku na ovoj stranici.
learner.en: Yes; I'll mark this page.

partner.en: Do you need my notes from the beginning?

learner.hr: Trebam, da ne pitam ono što je već objašnjeno cijeloj grupi.
learner.en: Yes, so I don't ask what's already been explained to the whole group.

partner.hr: Evo, prve su tri točke ovdje.
partner.en: Here; the first three points are here.

learner.hr: Hvala. Sad ću i datum napisati malo većim slovima.
learner.en: Thank you. Now I'll write the date a little larger too.

conversations.title: A family photograph shows horses doing ordinary work

partner.hr: Zašto su konji ispred tih kola?
partner.en: Why are the horses in front of that cart?

learner.hr: Konji su vukli robu. To nije bila svečana vožnja.
learner.en: The horses pulled goods. It wasn't a ceremonial ride.

partner.en: Was Grandpa driving?

learner.hr: Ne znam. O konjima je pričao, ali vozača na slici ne prepoznajem.
learner.en: I don't know. He talked about the horses, but I don't recognise the driver in the picture.

partner.en: Can you enlarge the face?

learner.hr: Mogu, no fotografija neće otkriti detalj koji nije sačuvan.
learner.en: Yes, but the photograph won't reveal a detail that hasn't survived.

partner.en: Shall we ask Aunt?

learner.hr: Hoćemo, uz cijelu sliku. Možda prepozna kuću u pozadini.
learner.en: Yes, with the whole picture. Perhaps she'll recognise the house behind it.

partner.hr: To bi nam pomoglo s mjestom.
partner.en: That would help us with the location.

learner.hr: Upravo tako. Ponekad pozadina kaže više od lica.
learner.en: Exactly. Sometimes the background says more than the face.

conversations.title: An art display is hung for adults but viewed by children

partner.hr: Zašto su donje slike tako nisko?
partner.en: Why are the bottom pictures so low?

learner.hr: Dječja grupa je zamolila da ih može vidjeti bez podizanja.
learner.en: A children's group asked to be able to see them without being lifted.

partner.en: Should the description be lower too?

learner.hr: Treba ga staviti niže ako očekujemo da ga i djeca čitaju.
learner.en: We should put it lower if we expect children to read it too.

partner.hr: Hoće li onda odraslima biti nezgodno?
partner.en: Will it be awkward for adults, then?

learner.hr: Možemo imati dva primjerka teksta. Nije prostor najveći problem.
learner.en: We can have two copies of the text. Space isn't the biggest problem.

partner.en: What else is missing?

learner.hr: Jasniji naslov. Ovaj stručni izraz treba objasniti.
learner.en: A clearer title. This technical term needs explaining.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li ga prvo dati djeci na čitanje?
partner.en: Will you let the children read it first?

learner.hr: Hoću. Oni će brže pokazati gdje smo bili nejasni.
learner.en: Yes. They'll show us more quickly where we were unclear.

conversations.title: An album booklet makes a song’s dedication clear

partner.en: Why are you reading the booklet while we listen?

learner.hr: U njegovom albumu piše kome je pjesma posvećena.
learner.en: His album says whom the song is dedicated to.

partner.en: Do you mean the singer?

learner.hr: Da. Iz njegovog kratkog zapisa sad razumijem i naslov.
learner.en: Yes. His brief note helps me understand the title now too.

partner.en: Does that change your impression?

learner.hr: Malo. Prije sam pjesmu slušao kao običnu ljubavnu priču.
learner.en: A little. Before, I heard it as an ordinary love story.

partner.en: And now?

learner.hr: Sad čujem i dio oproštaja koji mi je promaknuo.
learner.en: Now I also hear a farewell I missed.

partner.en: Shall we play it again?

learner.hr: Hoćemo, ovaj put bez razgovora preko prvog stiha.
learner.en: Yes, this time without talking over the first line.

conversations.title: A furniture purchase waits for another measurement

partner.en: Have you ordered the table?

learner.hr: Nisam. Predomislio sam se oko veličine.
learner.en: No. I've changed my mind about the size.

partner.en: Hadn't we chosen it already?

learner.hr: Jesmo, ali želim odgoditi kupnju dok ne izmjerim prostor s otvorenim vratima.
learner.en: We had, but I want to delay buying until I measure the space with the door open.

partner.hr: Mislio sam da je sve stalo.
partner.en: I thought everything fitted.

learner.hr: I ja, samo smo mjerili praznu sobu, bez prolaza do kuhinje.
learner.en: So did I; we just measured an empty room without allowing a path to the kitchen.

partner.hr: Da označimo dimenzije trakom na podu?
partner.en: Shall we mark the dimensions with tape on the floor?

learner.hr: Dobra ideja. Lakše ćemo vidjeti kako se krećemo.
learner.en: Good idea. We'll see more easily how we move around.

partner.en: The smaller one looks sufficient.

learner.hr: I meni. Ne trebamo svaki dan obilaziti vlastiti stol.
learner.en: To me too. We don't need to walk around our own table every day.

conversations.title: A missing folder is found before anything is restored

partner.en: Have you lost all the photographs?

learner.hr: Još ne znam. Gubitak podataka mi je prva misao, ali možda sam premjestio mapu.
learner.en: I don't know yet. Data loss is my first thought, but perhaps I moved the folder.

partner.en: Will you restore the copy immediately?

learner.hr: Prvo ću pretražiti uređaj. Ne želim prepisati nešto što još postoji.
learner.en: First I'll search the device. I don't want to overwrite something that still exists.

partner.hr: Našao sam mapu pod drugim nazivom.
partner.en: I found the folder under another name.

learner.hr: Onda ne gubiš fotografije, samo ih tražiš na starom mjestu.
learner.en: Then you're not losing photographs; you're just looking in the old place.

partner.en: The dates match.

learner.hr: Dobro. Provjerimo nekoliko snimaka prije zaključka da je sve tu.
learner.en: Good. Let's check a few pictures before concluding everything's there.

partner.en: Yes, everything opens.

learner.hr: Onda ću promjenu naziva zapisati dok je još pamtim.
learner.en: Then I'll note the name change while I still remember it.

conversations.title: A guide asks visitors to change where they stand

partner.en: Why do we all need to take a step right?

learner.hr: Gledajte sliku iz tog kuta pa ćete vidjeti odsjaj.
learner.en: Look at the painting from that angle and you'll see the reflection.

partner.en: Now I can barely see anything.

learner.hr: Upravo zato molimo posjetitelje da ne stoje svi ravno pred staklom.
learner.en: That's exactly why we ask visitors not all to stand straight in front of the glass.

partner.hr: Je li tako bilo i prije zaštite?
partner.en: Was it like that before the protective glass?

learner.hr: Nisam siguran. Mogu provjeriti s kolegicom nakon obilaska.
learner.en: I'm not sure. I can check with my colleague after the tour.

partner.hr: Ovdje sa strane boje su jasnije.
partner.en: The colours are clearer from the side here.

learner.hr: Jesu, i detalj u donjem kutu se bolje razaznaje.
learner.en: Yes, and the detail in the bottom corner is easier to make out.

partner.en: Shall we leave a path for the others?

learner.hr: Da, pomaknimo se nakon što svi pogledaju.
learner.en: Yes, let's move once everyone's looked.

conversations.title: A club mailing list includes people who have left

partner.en: Why are the messages bouncing back?

learner.hr: Neki članovi više ne koriste iste adrese.
learner.en: Some members no longer use the same addresses.

partner.en: Do we have an updated membership list?

learner.hr: Ovo je službeni popis članova, ali očito nije dovoljno svjež.
learner.en: This is the official membership list, but clearly it isn't current enough.

partner.en: Shall I delete all the old ones immediately?

learner.hr: Ne bez provjere. Neki i dalje žele primati obavijesti drugim putem.
learner.en: Not without checking. Some still want notices another way.

partner.en: How shall we ask them?

learner.hr: Kroz kontakte koje još imamo, bez slanja tuđih podataka cijeloj grupi.
learner.en: Through contacts we still have, without sending other people's details to the whole group.

partner.en: Will you divide the tasks?

learner.hr: Hoću. Tako popis neće opet čekati sljedeću godinu.
learner.en: Yes. That way the list won't wait until next year again.

conversations.title: A restored tool is younger than its design

partner.hr: Je li ovaj alat star nekoliko stoljeća?
partner.en: Is this tool several centuries old?

learner.hr: Ovaj primjerak nastao je u prošlom stoljeću. Oblik je stariji.
learner.en: This example was made in the last century. The design is older.

partner.hr: Zašto se onda nalazi u ovoj vitrini?
partner.en: Why is it in this case, then?

learner.hr: Pokazuje način rada koji se koristio stoljećima.
learner.en: It shows a working method used for centuries.

partner.hr: Znači, nije iz istog vremena kao ostali?
partner.en: So it isn't from the same period as the others?

learner.hr: Tako piše u opisu. Dobro je razlikovati predmet od ideje.
learner.en: That's what the description says. It's good to distinguish the object from the idea.

partner.en: May we try it?

learner.hr: Samo onaj označen za demonstraciju, uz voditelja.
learner.en: Only the one marked for demonstration, with the instructor.

partner.en: Let's read the labels first.

learner.hr: Da, da ne pitamo za izvorni predmet kao da je igračka.
learner.en: Yes, so we don't ask about the original object as if it were a toy.

conversations.title: A new camera strap clip is confusing the first time

partner.en: How does this clip close?

learner.hr: Postavi taj ravni dio ovdje pa pogledaj poklapa li se oznaka.
learner.en: Put the flat part here, then check whether the marks line up.

partner.en: Now it won't move.

learner.hr: Stisni samo kako pokazuju upute, bez savijanja sa strane.
learner.en: Press only as the instructions show, without bending it sideways.

partner.en: There, it clicked.

learner.hr: Dobro. Još provjeri drži li prije nego pustiš aparat.
learner.en: Good. Check it holds before letting go of the camera.

partner.hr: Zašto stari remen nije imao ovo?
partner.en: Why didn't the old strap have this?

learner.hr: Drukčiji je model. Zato sam i pročitao upute, ne pogađao.
learner.en: It's a different model. That's why I read the instructions rather than guessed.

partner.en: Can I put the paper away now?

learner.hr: Možeš ga sačuvati uz kutiju. Možda nam zatreba kod skidanja.
learner.en: Keep it with the box. We might need it when removing the strap.

conversations.title: A surprising animal video is being played backwards

partner.hr: Kako je mačka uspjela taj skok?
partner.en: How did the cat manage that jump?

learner.hr: Nevjerojatan je, ali mislim da je snimka okrenuta unatrag.
learner.en: It's incredible, but I think the video is reversed.

partner.en: How can you tell?

learner.hr: Gledaj predmet koji pada uz nju. Kreće se čudnim smjerom.
learner.en: Look at the object falling beside it. It's moving in an odd direction.

partner.en: So it isn't a real scene?

learner.hr: Prizor možda jest, redoslijed nije. Apsurdno mi je kad to objave kao neobjašnjivo čudo.
learner.en: The scene may be real; the order isn't. I find it absurd when they post it as an unexplained miracle.

partner.en: Will you comment?

learner.hr: Mogu pitati postoji li izvorna snimka, bez vrijeđanja autora.
learner.en: I can ask whether the original recording exists without insulting the creator.

partner.hr: Sad i ja vidim taj predmet.
partner.en: Now I can see that object too.

learner.hr: Eto. Ponekad je sporedni detalj najbolji trag.
learner.en: There. Sometimes a side detail is the best clue.

conversations.title: A workshop host receives a thank-you message the next morning

partner.en: Why are you smiling at your phone?

learner.hr: Pišu da je večer bila divna.
learner.en: They wrote that the evening was lovely.

partner.hr: Jučer si mislio da ništa nije uspjelo.
partner.en: Yesterday you thought nothing had worked.

learner.hr: Jer sam vidio samo kašnjenje i proliven čaj.
learner.en: Because I saw only the delay and the spilled tea.

partner.en: What did they remember?

learner.hr: Razgovor i priliku da nešto naprave zajedno.
learner.en: The conversation and the chance to make something together.

partner.en: Will you reply?

learner.hr: Hoću, da smo i mi zahvalni što su došli i ostali pomagati.
learner.en: Yes, to say we're grateful too that they came and stayed to help.

partner.en: So you're running the workshop again?

learner.hr: Vjerojatno. Ovaj put uz još jednu krpu na stolu.
learner.en: Probably. This time with another cloth on the table.

conversations.title: Two friends remember liking different parts of a concert

partner.en: Did you like it?

learner.hr: Svidjelo mi se, osobito kad su na kraju svi pjevali zajedno.
learner.en: I did, especially when everyone sang together at the end.

partner.en: I liked the middle best.

learner.hr: I meni se ona tiha pjesma svidjela, samo je nisam očekivao.
learner.en: I liked that quiet song too; I just hadn't expected it.

partner.hr: Mislio sam da voliš samo brže stvari.
partner.en: I thought you only liked faster things.

learner.hr: Volim različito. Ovisi i o tome kako zvuči uživo.
learner.en: I like different things. It also depends on how they sound live.

partner.en: Will you look for a recording?

learner.hr: Hoću, ali možda ću je drukčije doživjeti doma.
learner.en: Yes, but perhaps I'll experience it differently at home.

partner.en: Shall we go again when they return?

learner.hr: Idemo, ako stignemo uzeti karte prije zadnjeg dana.
learner.en: Yes, if we manage to get tickets before the last day.

conversations.title: An emailed receipt hides under an unexpected subject line

partner.en: Did you find the purchase confirmation?

learner.hr: Tražio sam svugdje u svome pretincu, a nema poruke pod imenom trgovine.
learner.en: I looked everywhere in my inbox, but there's no message under the shop's name.

partner.en: Perhaps it comes from another address.

learner.hr: Moguće. Ni kad tražim po datumu, nigdje ne vidim pravi naslov.
learner.en: Possibly. Even when I search by date, I can't see the right subject anywhere.

partner.en: Try entering the product name.

learner.hr: Evo je. Naslov je samo broj narudžbe i ime proizvoda.
learner.en: Here it is. The subject is just the order number and product name.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li je sad spremiti posebno?
partner.en: Will you save it separately now?

learner.hr: Hoću, uz ostale račune za uređaje.
learner.en: Yes, with the other appliance receipts.

partner.en: Do you need a printout?

learner.hr: Zasad ne. Važno mi je da je sljedeći put mogu pronaći.
learner.en: Not for now. What matters is being able to find it next time.

conversations.title: A reunion greeting waits for the other person’s signal

partner.hr: Hoće li me ujak odmah zagrliti?
partner.en: Will Uncle hug me immediately?

learner.hr: Možda. Zagrli ga ako želiš, ali ne moraš žuriti.
learner.en: Perhaps. Hug him if you want to, but you don't need to rush.

partner.en: I haven't seen him for a long time.

learner.hr: Znam. Možeš prvo samo reći bok.
learner.en: I know. You can just say hello first.

partner.en: What if he offers his hand?

learner.hr: Možeš uzvratiti rukovanje. Nije ispit s jednim točnim pozdravom.
learner.en: You can shake his hand in return. It's not a test with one correct greeting.

partner.en: I feel less awkward now.

learner.hr: Dobro. Najvažnije je da se polako upoznate ponovno.
learner.en: Good. What matters is slowly getting to know each other again.

partner.en: I brought him a drawing too.

learner.hr: Onda već imaš temu za prvi razgovor.
learner.en: Then you already have a topic for the first conversation.

conversations.title: A museum wristband is not the ticket itself

partner.en: What do we get after the check?

learner.hr: Dajemo vam narukvice za ponovni ulaz tijekom dana. Zadržite ih dok ste u muzeju.
learner.en: We give you wristbands for re-entry during the day. Keep them while you're visiting the museum.

partner.en: Do we need to keep the ticket too?

learner.hr: Da, osobito ako želite poseban obilazak.
learner.en: Yes, especially if you want the special tour.

partner.hr: Je li ova narukvica dovoljno čvrsta?
partner.en: Is this wristband secure enough?

learner.hr: Podignite ruku da vidim spoj, pa ćemo provjeriti.
learner.en: Raise your hand so I can see the fastening, then we'll check.

partner.en: Is it all right now?

learner.hr: Jest. Ne treba je dodatno stezati.
learner.en: Yes. There's no need to tighten it further.

partner.en: Can we go out for lunch?

learner.hr: Možete, uz povratak prije zatvaranja. Radno vrijeme je uz izlaz.
learner.en: Yes, as long as you return before closing. The opening hours are by the exit.

conversations.title: A low photograph crops the person’s head

partner.en: Why is half my head missing?

learner.hr: Previše sam spustio kadar. Gledao sam samo pozadinu.
learner.en: I lowered the framing too much. I was looking only at the background.

partner.en: Want to try again?

learner.hr: Hoću. Spusti malo taj plakat da ti ne prekriva lice.
learner.en: Yes. Lower that poster a little so it doesn't cover your face.

partner.en: Like this?

learner.hr: Da. Sad ću provjeriti rubove slike prije snimanja.
learner.en: Yes. Now I'll check the picture's edges before taking it.

partner.en: Do you need to step back?

learner.hr: Jedan korak. Ne želim da poster izgleda veći od cijelog događaja.
learner.en: One step. I don't want the poster to look bigger than the whole event.

partner.en: Is it good now?

learner.hr: Jest, i glava je ponovno dio plana.
learner.en: Yes, and your head is part of the plan again.

conversations.title: A familiar song makes somebody miss their stop

partner.en: Why did you only get off here?

learner.hr: Posve sam zaboravio pratiti stanice dok sam slušao glazbu.
learner.en: I completely forgot to follow the stops while listening to music.

partner.hr: Je li pjesma bila toliko dobra?
partner.en: Was the song that good?

learner.hr: Predivno je zvučala, ali sad zbog nje hodam dvadeset minuta.
learner.en: It sounded beautiful, but now I'm walking twenty minutes because of it.

partner.en: You can take a bus back.

learner.hr: Mogu, samo trebam provjeriti drugu stranu ceste.
learner.en: I can; I just need to check the other side of the road.

partner.en: Will you turn off the headphones?

learner.hr: Dok ne stignem, da. Dosta mi je jednog produženog putovanja.
learner.en: Until I arrive, yes. One extended journey is enough.

partner.en: Let me know when you're outside the building.

learner.hr: Hoću. Ovaj put ću gledati i brojeve, ne samo naslov pjesme.
learner.en: I will. This time I'll watch the numbers too, not just the song title.

conversations.title: A recipe copy starts halfway through the instructions

partner.en: Why is the beginning of the recipe missing?

learner.hr: Kopirao sam od treće do pete stranice, a uvod je na drugoj.
learner.en: I copied pages three through five, but the introduction is on page two.

partner.en: Isn't the introduction just a story?

learner.hr: Ovaj uključuje veličinu posude i pripremu tijesta.
learner.en: This one includes the dish size and dough preparation.

partner.en: Can you send page two as well?

learner.hr: Mogu. Dobro da si pitao prije miješanja.
learner.en: Yes. Good thing you asked before mixing.

partner.en: What else needs checking?

learner.hr: Je li zadnja rečenica završena. Možda upute idu i dalje.
learner.en: Whether the last sentence is complete. Perhaps the instructions continue.

partner.en: Page six only has photographs.

learner.hr: Onda šaljem drugu i imamo cijeli postupak.
learner.en: Then I'll send page two and we'll have the whole method.

conversations.title: An installation uses more paper boats than visitors expect

partner.hr: Je li netko stvarno presavio sve ove brodove?
partner.en: Did someone really fold all these boats?

learner.hr: Da, stotine su samo na ovoj strani zida.
learner.en: Yes, there are hundreds on just this side of the wall.

partner.en: How many are there altogether?

learner.hr: Prema oznaci, dvije tisuće. Radili su ih mjesecima.
learner.en: According to the label, two thousand. They worked on them for months.

partner.en: May we take one?

learner.hr: Ne piše da smijemo. Pitajmo umjesto da pretpostavimo.
learner.en: It doesn't say we may. Let's ask rather than assume.

partner.hr: Kažu da na kraju možemo naučiti napraviti svoj.
partner.en: They say we can learn to make our own at the end.

learner.hr: To mi je draže. Imat ću uspomenu koju sam napravio.
learner.en: I'd prefer that. I'll have a souvenir I made myself.

partner.en: Will you sign up?

learner.hr: Hoću, samo ne obećavam da ću napraviti još dvije tisuće.
learner.en: Yes, but I won't promise to make another two thousand.

conversations.title: A parent’s worry becomes a practical travel agreement

partner.en: Why do you keep asking when we're leaving?

learner.hr: Zabrinuta sam jer prvi put putujete bez nas.
learner.en: I'm worried because it's your first trip without us.

partner.en: We've already agreed everything.

learner.hr: Znam. Moja zabrinutost ne znači da mislim da ste nesposobni.
learner.en: I know. My worry doesn't mean I think you're incapable.

partner.en: What would help you?

learner.hr: Kratka poruka kad stignete, ne stalno praćenje svake minute.
learner.en: A brief message when you arrive, not tracking every minute.

partner.en: We can do that.

learner.hr: Hvala. I ja ću pokušati ne slati deset pitanja na jedan odgovor.
learner.en: Thank you. I'll also try not to send ten questions in response to one answer.

partner.en: We'll talk once we've settled in.

learner.hr: Dogovoreno. Želim da uživate u putovanju, bez stalnog javljanja meni.
learner.en: Agreed. I want you to enjoy the trip without constantly checking in with me.

conversations.title: A group story changes when everyone adds one sentence

partner.hr: Kako smo završili s brodom usred parka?
partner.en: How did we end up with a boat in a park?

learner.hr: Stvorili smo priču bez dogovora o tome što je moguće.
learner.en: We created a story without agreeing what's possible.

partner.en: Should we fix it?

learner.hr: Ne nužno. Različiti prijedlozi stvaraju i zanimljiva iznenađenja.
learner.en: Not necessarily. Different suggestions create interesting surprises too.

partner.hr: Što ako se više ništa ne povezuje?
partner.en: What if nothing connects anymore?

learner.hr: Onda sljedeća rečenica može pokušati povezati dva detalja.
learner.en: Then the next sentence can try to connect two details.
