partner.en: Whose turn is it?

learner.hr: Ti. Samo nemoj zaboraviti čovjeka koji još čeka na klupi.
learner.en: Yours. Just don't forget the man still waiting on the bench.

partner.en: Perhaps he's the captain.

learner.hr: Eto, već imamo razlog za brod.
learner.en: There, we already have a reason for the boat.

conversations.title: A family photo print order waits for one last approval

partner.en: Have you sent the order yet?

learner.hr: Danas šaljemo fotografije za zajednički album.
learner.en: Today we're sending the photographs for the shared album.

partner.hr: Jesam li i ja na izboru?
partner.en: Am I in the selection too?

learner.hr: Jesi, zato čekam da potvrdiš svoju sliku.
learner.en: Yes, which is why I'm waiting for you to approve your picture.

partner.en: Can you show me both?

learner.hr: Mogu, samo da ti pošaljem dvije manje kopije.
learner.en: Yes, just let me send you two smaller copies.

partner.en: I prefer the second.

learner.hr: Dobro, uzimam nju. Prva ostaje samo u privatnoj mapi.
learner.en: Good; I'll use that one. The first stays only in the private folder.

partner.en: Thank you for asking.

learner.hr: Nema na čemu. Album treba biti drag svima koji su u njemu.
learner.en: You're welcome. The album should mean something to everyone in it.

conversations.title: A crossword is finished by combining two different memories

partner.en: Why are you still looking at the same line?

learner.hr: Ne nalazim riječ, iako mi je glumčevo lice sasvim poznato.
learner.en: I can't find the word, although the actor's face is very familiar.

partner.hr: Je li igrao u onoj seriji s otokom?
partner.en: Was he in that series with the island?

learner.hr: Jest. Ti pamtiš radnju, ja pamtim ime lika.
learner.en: Yes. You remember the plot; I remember the character's name.

partner.en: We'll remember together.

learner.hr: Očito zajedno nalazimo više nego svatko sam.
learner.en: Clearly we find more together than alone.

partner.hr: Ime počinje slovom koje nam nedostaje.
partner.en: The name starts with the letter we're missing.

learner.hr: Onda provjerimo i okomiti odgovor. Možda je tamo moja pogreška.
learner.en: Then let's check the vertical answer too. Perhaps that's where I went wrong.

partner.en: Now everything fits.

learner.hr: Dobro. Naša mala rasprava ipak je imala kraj.
learner.en: Good. Our little discussion had an ending after all.

conversations.title: A volunteer learns not to interrupt the clinic queue

partner.en: Whom should I call inside?

learner.hr: Medicinska sestra će prozvati pacijente. Mi samo pokazujemo gdje se čeka.
learner.en: The nurse will call the patients. We only show people where to wait.

partner.en: So I don't check their order?

learner.hr: Ne, to nije naš zadatak.
learner.en: No, that isn't our task.

partner.en: What if someone asks me?

learner.hr: Uputi ga osoblju koje vodi popis.
learner.en: Direct them to the staff managing the list.

partner.en: Can I at least show them the toilet?

learner.hr: Naravno. Te praktične informacije svima znače.
learner.en: Of course. That practical information matters to everyone.

partner.hr: Sad mi je jasnije što radim.
partner.en: Now it's clearer what I'm doing.

learner.hr: Dobro. Pomoć počinje i time da znaš svoje granice.
learner.en: Good. Helping also starts with knowing your boundaries.

conversations.title: A visit invitation leaves out which household is hosting

partner.en: Do you know where to come?

learner.hr: Znam gdje živiš, ali ne znam živite li svi na istoj adresi.
learner.en: I know where you live, but I don't know whether you all live at the same address.

partner.en: Tomorrow we're at my sister's.

learner.hr: Onda mi pošalji njezinu adresu.
learner.en: Then send me her address.

partner.hr: Mislio sam da si već bio.
partner.en: I thought you'd been there already.

learner.hr: Jesam, ali prije selidbe.
learner.en: Yes, but before she moved.

partner.en: Here's the new location.

learner.hr: Hvala, sad spremam pravu.
learner.en: Thank you; now I'm saving the right one.

partner.en: Will you come early?

learner.hr: Mogu pomoći postaviti stol ako joj to odgovara.
learner.en: I can help set the table if that suits her.

conversations.title: A missed call comes from an unexpected relative

partner.en: Who called you?

learner.hr: Nazvali su me rođaci, a mislio sam da je dostava.
learner.en: My relatives called; I thought it was a delivery.

partner.en: Why didn't you answer?

learner.hr: Nisam prepoznao broj. Zvali su s drugog telefona.
learner.en: I didn't recognise the number. They called from another phone.

partner.en: Did they leave a message?

learner.hr: Jesu, dolaze u grad sljedeći tjedan.
learner.en: Yes, they're coming to town next week.

partner.en: Will you call back?

learner.hr: Hoću, kad provjerim kada sam slobodan.
learner.en: Yes, once I check when I'm free.

partner.en: A lovely surprise.

learner.hr: Jest. Ovaj put propušteni poziv ima dobar nastavak.
learner.en: Yes. This time a missed call has a good follow-up.

conversations.title: A regular customer is mistaken for the café owner

partner.en: Are you the owner here?

learner.hr: Nisam, samo sam česta mušterija.
learner.en: No, I'm just a regular customer.

partner.en: Sorry; you were pointing things out to everyone.

learner.hr: Pokazivao sam slobodnu stolicu.
learner.en: I was showing them a free chair.

partner.en: Do you know where I can order?

learner.hr: Za pultom, kod kolegice s plavom pregačom.
learner.en: At the counter, with the woman in the blue apron.

partner.en: Thank you; it's my first time here.

learner.hr: Nema na čemu. I meni je prvi put trebalo pokazati gdje se naručuje.
learner.en: You're welcome. The first time I also needed someone to show me where to order.

partner.hr: Možda ću i ja postati redovit gost.
partner.en: Perhaps I'll become a regular too.

learner.hr: Onda će i vas uskoro pitati vodite li kafić.
learner.en: Then soon they'll ask you whether you run the café too.

conversations.title: A public discussion leaves room for a changed opinion

partner.en: Why did you change your mind?

learner.hr: Moj prvi stav nije uključivao podatak koji smo sad čuli.
learner.en: My initial position didn't include the information we've just heard.

partner.en: Doesn't that make you look indecisive?

learner.hr: Meni je razuman odgovor promijeniti zaključak kad se činjenice promijene.
learner.en: To me, changing a conclusion when the facts change is reasonable.

partner.hr: Hoćeš li to reći pred svima?
partner.en: Will you say that in front of everyone?

learner.hr: Hoću, bez pravljenja da sam oduvijek tako mislio.
learner.en: Yes, without pretending I always thought that.

partner.en: Perhaps it will help others too.

learner.hr: Možda. Cilj nam je izabrati dobar plan, ne pobijediti jedni druge.
learner.en: Perhaps. Our aim is to choose a good plan, not defeat each other.

partner.en: Then write the new question.

learner.hr: Hoću, s jasnim razlogom za promjenu.
learner.en: I will, with a clear reason for the change.

conversations.title: A plant pot drains differently after repotting

partner.en: Why is the water staying on top?

learner.hr: U tlu je možda previše zbijen sloj. Nisam siguran.
learner.en: Perhaps a layer in the soil is too compact. I'm not sure.

partner.en: Did you change the soil?

learner.hr: Jesam, jučer sam stavio novu zemlju.
learner.en: Yes, I put in new soil yesterday.

partner.en: What will you do now?

learner.hr: Poslat ću fotografiju rasadniku i opisati što sam upotrijebio.
learner.en: I'll send the nursery a photograph and describe what I used.

partner.en: Won't you repot it again immediately?

learner.hr: Ne želim mijenjati još nešto prije nego razumijem problem.
learner.en: I don't want to change something else before understanding the problem.

partner.en: Did you keep the packaging?

learner.hr: Jesam, pa mogu točno navesti sastav.
learner.en: Yes, so I can state the composition accurately.

conversations.title: A spring calendar opens on the wrong year

partner.hr: Zašto ti svi datumi padaju na drugi dan?
partner.en: Why do all your dates fall on a different day?

learner.hr: Svibanj gledam u prošlogodišnjem kalendaru.
learner.en: I'm looking at May in last year's calendar.

partner.hr: Je li rođendan ipak petog svibnja?
partner.en: Is the birthday still on the fifth of May?

learner.hr: Jest, petog svibnja. Samo sam krivo rekao dan u tjednu.
learner.en: Yes, the fifth of May. I just gave the wrong weekday.

partner.en: Can you send a correction now?

learner.hr: Mogu, prije nego netko uzme slobodan dan.
learner.en: Yes, before someone takes a day off.

partner.en: What about the old calendar?

learner.hr: Spremam ga s fotografijama, ne uz aktualne dogovore.
learner.en: I'm keeping it with the photographs, not current arrangements.

partner.en: So the celebration stays on the same date?

learner.hr: Ostaje. Pogrešna je bila samo moja sigurnost.
learner.en: It does. Only my confidence was misplaced.

conversations.title: A seasonal museum closes earlier than a visitor expects

partner.hr: Zašto nas ne primaju idući tjedan?
partner.en: Why won't they admit us next week?

learner.hr: Rade od ožujka do listopada. Sezona im je upravo završila.
learner.en: They're open from March to October. Their season has just ended.

partner.hr: Jesi li to našao na stranici?
partner.en: Did you find that on the website?

learner.hr: Jesam, pod radnim vremenom, ne na početnoj fotografiji.
learner.en: Yes, under opening hours, not on the main photograph.

partner.en: Shall we call to confirm?

learner.hr: Možemo pitati imaju li poseban termin za grupu.
learner.en: We can ask whether they have a special group time.

partner.en: What if they don't?

learner.hr: Izabrat ćemo nešto što je otvoreno, bez ljutnje na njihov kalendar.
learner.en: We'll choose something open without getting angry at their calendar.

partner.en: Check first next time.

learner.hr: Da. Lijepa fotografija ne znači da je muzej otvoren cijele godine.
learner.en: Yes. A lovely photograph doesn't mean the museum is open all year.

conversations.title: A wedding plan waits for two family calendars

partner.hr: Jeste li odlučili kada će biti?
partner.en: Have you decided when it will be?

learner.hr: Planiramo kraj travnja, ali datum vjenčanja još nije potvrđen.
learner.en: We're planning late April, but the wedding date isn't confirmed yet.

partner.en: What are you waiting for?

learner.hr: Još čekamo potvrdu dvoje bliskih ljudi koji trebaju doputovati.
learner.en: We're still waiting for confirmation from two people close to us who need to travel.

partner.en: Will you send an announcement to everyone?

learner.hr: Tek kad znamo sigurno. Ne želimo poslije ispravljati sto poruka.
learner.en: Only once we're sure. We don't want to correct a hundred messages later.

partner.en: Do you need help with the list?

learner.hr: Trebam, osobito s adresama koje nisam dugo koristio.
learner.en: Yes, especially addresses I haven't used for a long time.

partner.en: Then let's start with that.

learner.hr: Može. To barem možemo riješiti bez odluke o cvijeću.
learner.en: Yes. At least we can sort that out without deciding on flowers.

conversations.title: A puzzle book includes more than crosswords

partner.en: What did you buy for the journey?

learner.hr: Zbirku različitih tipova zagonetki, ne samo križaljke.
learner.en: A collection of different puzzle types, not just crosswords.

partner.hr: Što je ovaj zadatak sa slikama?
partner.en: What's this puzzle with pictures?

learner.hr: To je vrsta rebusa. Treba povezati crteže i slova.
learner.en: It's a type of rebus. You need to combine pictures and letters.

partner.en: Have you solved any yet?

learner.hr: Jedan, uz provjeru rješenja. Ove druge još učim.
learner.en: One, checking the solution. I'm still learning the others.

partner.en: Can I try the next one?

learner.hr: Možeš, ali prekrij donji rub da ne vidiš odgovor.
learner.en: Yes, but cover the bottom edge so you don't see the answer.

partner.en: We managed this one.

learner.hr: Onda knjiga već zaslužuje mjesto u torbi.
learner.en: Then the book already earns its place in the bag.

conversations.title: A venue’s phone line is busy before a public opening

partner.en: Why are you calling them again?

learner.hr: Nitko se ne javlja, a trebamo potvrdu termina.
learner.en: Nobody's answering, and we need to confirm the time.

partner.en: Hasn't the time already been announced?

learner.hr: Interno jest. Javnosti ga ne želim najaviti prije potvrde.
learner.en: Internally, yes. I don't want to announce it publicly before confirmation.

partner.en: Can you send a message?

learner.hr: Poslao sam, sad ću pričekati umjesto zvati svake minute.
learner.en: I have; now I'll wait rather than call every minute.

partner.en: Perhaps they're preparing the venue right now.

learner.hr: Moguće. Ne moraju našu žurbu vidjeti na isti način.
learner.en: Possibly. They don't necessarily see our urgency the same way.

partner.en: Here's the reply; the time is confirmed.

learner.hr: Dobro. Sad možemo poslati obavijest bez upitnika uz satnicu.
learner.en: Good. Now we can send the notice without a question mark beside the time.

conversations.title: A small railway station has no ticket counter

partner.en: Where do we buy a ticket?

learner.hr: Ova postaja nema otvoren šalter. Pogledajmo oznake.
learner.en: This station has no open ticket counter. Let's look at the signs.

partner.hr: Zar na svakoj postaji nema nekoga?
partner.en: Isn't there someone at every station?

learner.hr: Ne mora biti. Na ovoj postaji je uputa uz ulaz.
learner.en: Not necessarily. At this station the instructions are beside the entrance.

partner.hr: Piše da možemo pitati osoblje vlaka.
partner.en: It says we can ask the train staff.

learner.hr: Onda ćemo ih pitati prije nego pretpostavimo što vrijedi.
learner.en: Then we'll ask them before assuming what applies.

partner.en: We still have time.

learner.hr: Imamo, dobro da nismo došli u zadnjoj minuti.
learner.en: Yes; good thing we didn't come at the last minute.

partner.en: Can you see our platform number?

learner.hr: Vidim. Idemo tamo pa ćemo pitati osoblje prije ulaska.
learner.en: Yes. Let's go there and ask the staff before boarding.

conversations.title: A character’s fear changes how an actor moves

partner.en: Why is my movement too fast?

learner.hr: Lik kojeg igraš boji se prići vratima. Ti izgledaš kao da žuriš unutra.
learner.en: The character you play is afraid to approach the door. You look as though you're rushing in.

partner.en: Should I stop halfway?

learner.hr: Možeš pokušati. Dok izvodiš pokret, slušaj i ono što partner govori.
learner.en: You can try. While making the movement, listen to what your partner says too.

partner.en: Then perhaps I'll react more naturally.

learner.hr: Upravo to. Ne treba svaki korak izgledati unaprijed nacrtan.
learner.en: Exactly. Every step doesn't need to look drawn out beforehand.

partner.en: Can we repeat it without music?

learner.hr: Možemo, da prvo čuješ repliku.
learner.en: Yes, so you hear the line first.

partner.en: Now the pause has a reason.

learner.hr: Dobro. Publika treba vidjeti oklijevanje, ne samo spor hod.
learner.en: Good. The audience needs to see hesitation, not just slow walking.

conversations.title: An extra zero changes a school calculation

partner.hr: Zašto je moj rezultat toliko velik?
partner.en: Why is my result so large?

learner.hr: Napisao si milijun tamo gdje zadatak kaže sto tisuća.
learner.en: You wrote a million where the exercise says a hundred thousand.

partner.en: So one zero changes everything?

learner.hr: Ovdje da. U drugom primjeru je dva milijuna, zato si možda prepisao krivi redak.
learner.en: Here, yes. The other example has two million, so perhaps you copied the wrong line.

partner.en: Should I redo the calculation?

learner.hr: Da, ali prvo provjeri početne brojeve.
learner.en: Yes, but check the starting numbers first.

partner.en: Now I get the expected order of magnitude.

learner.hr: Dobro. Račun nije bio jedini dio zadatka.
learner.en: Good. Calculation wasn't the only part of the exercise.

partner.en: I'll write the numbers separately.

learner.hr: To bi ti moglo pomoći da ih ne zamijeniš.
learner.en: That might help you avoid mixing them up.

conversations.title: A public meeting gets a replacement speaker

partner.en: Is the municipal head coming to the discussion?

learner.hr: Načelnik ne može doći, pa stiže njegov zamjenik.
learner.en: The municipal head can't come, so his deputy is coming.

partner.en: Should the invitation change, then?

learner.hr: Treba. Ljudi trebaju znati tko će odgovarati.
learner.en: Yes. People need to know who'll be answering.

partner.hr: Hoćemo li ipak postaviti ista pitanja?
partner.en: Will we ask the same questions anyway?

learner.hr: Hoćemo, ali provjerit ćemo može li na sva dati odgovor.
learner.en: Yes, but we'll check whether he can answer all of them.

partner.hr: A ako nešto treba naknadno poslati?
partner.en: What if something needs a later response?

learner.hr: Zapisat ćemo pitanje i dogovoreni način odgovora.
learner.en: We'll record the question and the agreed way to reply.

partner.en: Then send the new invitation.

learner.hr: Hoću, s jasno označenom promjenom govornika.
learner.en: I will, with the speaker change clearly marked.

conversations.title: Interest in a workshop is not the same as registration

partner.hr: Zašto imamo manje prijava nego poruka?
partner.en: Why do we have fewer registrations than messages?

learner.hr: Interes postoji, ali ne potvrde svi dolazak.
learner.en: There's interest, but not everyone confirms attendance.

partner.en: Can we count them all?

learner.hr: Ne kao prijavljene. U našem je interesu imati stvaran broj mjesta.
learner.en: Not as registered. It's in our interest to have a real seat count.

partner.en: What shall we ask them?

learner.hr: Trebaju li još podatke prije odluke i žele li potvrditi mjesto.
learner.en: Whether they need more information before deciding and want to confirm a place.

partner.en: Will the reminder annoy them?

learner.hr: Poslat ćemo jedan jasan, ne svakodnevno požurivanje.
learner.en: We'll send one clear reminder, not daily pressure.

partner.en: Now we have a more complete list.

learner.hr: Dobro. Lakše je pripremiti stolove za ljude nego za pretpostavke.
learner.en: Good. It's easier to prepare tables for people than assumptions.

conversations.title: A fairy-tale title does not explain who actually owns the castle

partner.en: Why does everyone call him master?

learner.hr: Gospodar je dvorca, ali još ne znamo kako ga je dobio.
learner.en: He's the castle's master, but we don't yet know how he got it.

partner.en: Didn't he inherit everything?

learner.hr: Tako likovi misle. Priča o prethodnom gospodaru još nedostaje.
learner.en: That's what the characters think. The story of the previous master is still missing.

partner.en: Will he appear later?

learner.hr: Vjerojatno. Na zadnjoj stranici vidi se prsten starog gospodara.
learner.en: Probably. The last page shows the old master's ring.

partner.en: That sounds like an important clue.

learner.hr: Možda, ali ova knjiga voli i zavarati čitatelja.
learner.en: Perhaps, but this book also likes misleading the reader.

partner.en: May I read it after you?

learner.hr: Možeš. Onda ćemo usporediti jesmo li sumnjali u istog lika.
learner.en: Yes. Then we'll compare whether we suspected the same character.

conversations.title: A small grant means a project can finally begin

partner.en: The funding confirmation arrived!

learner.hr: To je sjajna vijest. Znači li da možemo naručiti materijal?
learner.en: That's great news. Does it mean we can order the materials?

partner.en: We can, according to the approved list.

learner.hr: Dobro. Iznimno mi je drago što ne moramo opet skraćivati plan.
learner.en: Good. I'm extremely pleased we don't have to cut the plan again.

partner.en: What will you prepare first?

learner.hr: Raspored nabave, da ne naručimo sve za isti dan.
learner.en: A purchasing schedule so we don't order everything for the same day.

partner.en: Will you tell the others?

learner.hr: Hoću, uz točno objašnjenje što je odobreno.
learner.en: Yes, with an exact explanation of what was approved.

partner.en: Then we can celebrate a little.

learner.hr: Možemo. Poslije slavlja dolazi popis, ali danas barem imamo dobar razlog.
learner.en: We can. The list comes after the celebration, but at least today we have a good reason.

conversations.title: An online disagreement stops being about the topic

partner.en: Why did you stop replying?

learner.hr: U razgovoru se pojavila mržnja prema ljudima. Više nije riječ o temi.
learner.en: Hatred towards people appeared in the conversation. It's no longer about the topic.

partner.en: Perhaps you can persuade them.

learner.hr: Možda nekoga, ali u porukama punim mržnje ne vidim prostor za taj razgovor.
learner.en: Perhaps someone, but in messages full of hatred I don't see room for that conversation.

partner.en: Will you report anything?

learner.hr: Pregledat ću pravila i prijaviti konkretne uvrede gdje je to predviđeno.
learner.en: I'll check the rules and report the specific insults where that's provided for.

partner.en: What about your own replies?

learner.hr: Provjerit ću i njih. Ne želim pridonijeti istom tonu.
learner.en: I'll check those too. I don't want to contribute to the same tone.

partner.hr: Hoćemo li ostaviti telefone malo sa strane?
partner.en: Shall we put the phones aside for a while?

learner.hr: Hoćemo. Ovaj razgovor možemo nastaviti mirnije uživo.
learner.en: Yes. We can continue this conversation more calmly in person.

conversations.title: Two invitations turn out to be for the same evening

partner.hr: Jesi li shvatio da su oba događaja u petak?
partner.en: Did you realise both events are on Friday?

learner.hr: Sad jesam. Suludo je pokušati stići na oba kraja grada u istom satu.
learner.en: Now I have. Trying to reach opposite ends of town in the same hour is absurd.

partner.en: Can you just drop in briefly?

learner.hr: Apsolutno ne mogu stići na oba događaja. Bolje da to odmah kažem.
learner.en: I absolutely can't make both events. I'd better say that now.

partner.en: Whom will you cancel on, then?

learner.hr: Prvo ću provjeriti može li se jedna večera pomaknuti.
learner.en: First I'll check whether one dinner can move.

partner.en: What if it can't?

learner.hr: Izabrat ću i iskreno objasniti, bez izmišljanja bolesti.
learner.en: I'll choose and explain honestly, without inventing an illness.

partner.hr: Bolje nego ne pojaviti se nigdje.
partner.en: Better than turning up nowhere.

learner.hr: Upravo tako. Dva potvrdna odgovora nisu stvorila drugi petak.
learner.en: Exactly. Two yeses didn't create a second Friday.

conversations.title: A classroom workshop starts with clearing space

partner.hr: Što prvo radimo s ovim stvarima?
partner.en: What do we do with these things first?

learner.hr: Pripremite čiste stolove, a materijal ostavite zasad u kutijama.
learner.en: Prepare clean tables, and leave the materials in the boxes for now.

partner.en: Shall we move the chairs too?

learner.hr: Samo višak. Sredite prolaz do vrata da nitko ne zapinje.
learner.en: Only the extra ones. Clear the passage to the door so nobody catches on anything.

partner.en: Where should the scissors go?

learner.hr: U sredinu svakog stola, uz pribor koji već poznajete.
learner.en: In the middle of each table, beside the supplies you already know.

partner.en: Everything's set out.

learner.hr: Dobro, sada možemo podijeliti materijal bez hodanja preko torbi.
learner.en: Good; now we can distribute materials without stepping over bags.

partner.en: Are we ready to start?

learner.hr: Jesmo. Hvala što ste prvo pripremili prostor, ne samo svoje mjesto.
learner.en: Yes. Thank you for preparing the room first, not just your own place.

conversations.title: A craft table has two boxes for unfinished parts

partner.hr: U koju kutiju ide ovaj gumb?
partner.en: Which box does this button go in?

learner.hr: Ubaci ga u malu, tamo su gotovi dijelovi.
learner.en: Put it in the small one; that's where the finished parts are.

partner.hr: A ovi s rupama koje još nisu očišćene?
partner.en: What about these with holes that haven't been cleaned yet?

learner.hr: Prebaci ih u drugu. Ne želimo ih opet provjeravati među gotovima.
learner.en: Move them to the other one. We don't want to check them again among the finished ones.

partner.en: Will you finish them today?

learner.hr: Ne sve. Označit ću što je ostalo, pa nastaviti sutra.
learner.en: Not all. I'll label what remains and continue tomorrow.

partner.en: Do you need more boxes?

learner.hr: Zasad ne. Dvije jasne su bolje od pet bez oznake.
learner.en: Not for now. Two clearly labelled ones are better than five without labels.

partner.hr: Onda i na ove stavljam natpis.
partner.en: Then I'll label these too.

learner.hr: Hvala. Sutra ćemo odmah znati što možemo upotrijebiti.
learner.en: Thank you. Tomorrow we'll immediately know what we can use.

conversations.title: An interview starts with a remembered family scene

partner.en: Where would you like me to begin?

learner.hr: Ispričajte nam kako je izgledala kuhinja u kojoj ste odrasli.
learner.en: Tell us what the kitchen you grew up in looked like.

partner.en: That isn't a grand story.

learner.hr: Meni je zanimljiva. Majka mi je ispričala samo dio.
learner.en: It's interesting to me. My mother told me only part of it.

partner.en: What particularly interests you?

learner.hr: Gdje ste sjedili i što se čulo s ulice.
learner.en: Where you sat and what you could hear from the street.

partner.en: I remember an old radio.

learner.hr: Onda krenimo od njega. Ne moramo odmah znati sve datume.
learner.en: Then let's begin with that. We don't need every date immediately.

partner.en: What if I mix something up?

learner.hr: Kasnije ćemo provjeriti. Zasad samo označimo gdje niste sigurni.
learner.en: We'll check later. For now let's just mark where you're unsure.

conversations.title: A younger sibling masters a skill before the older one

partner.hr: Je li sestra već naučila vezati cipele?
partner.en: Has your sister learned to tie shoes yet?

learner.hr: Naučila je, i sad želi vezati svačije.
learner.en: She has, and now she wants to tie everyone's.

partner.en: What about you?

learner.hr: Ja još vježbam. Mi smo naučili različite stvari različitim redom.
learner.en: I'm still practising. We learned different things in different orders.

partner.hr: Smeta li ti što je prva?
partner.en: Does it bother you that she was first?

learner.hr: Malo, ali ja njoj pokazujem kako složiti model vlaka.
learner.en: A little, but I show her how to build the model train.

partner.en: Will you help each other?

learner.hr: Hoćemo, bez natjecanja tko će prvi završiti.
learner.en: Yes, without competing over who finishes first.

partner.en: Then bring the shoes and the train.

learner.hr: Može. Samo da vlak ne dobije vezice umjesto kotača.
learner.en: Yes. Let's just make sure the train doesn't get shoelaces instead of wheels.

conversations.title: A short errand needs the borrowed book taken too

partner.en: Do we need anything from the shop?

learner.hr: Pođi prvo susjedi s knjigom koju vraćamo, pa do trgovine.
learner.en: Go to the neighbour first with the book we're returning, then to the shop.

partner.hr: Da joj samo ostavim pred vratima?
partner.en: Shall I just leave it at the door?

learner.hr: Kad pođeš, nazovi je. Ne znam je li kod kuće.
learner.en: When you set off, call her. I don't know whether she's home.

partner.en: What if she isn't?

learner.hr: Knjigu vrati nama, nemoj je ostavljati na hodniku.
learner.en: Bring the book back to us; don't leave it in the hallway.

partner.en: What am I buying, then?

learner.hr: Mlijeko i kruh, popis je uz ključeve.
learner.en: Milk and bread; the list is beside the keys.

partner.en: I've got everything.

learner.hr: Hvala. Javi ako se susjeda ne javlja.
learner.en: Thank you. Let me know if the neighbour doesn't answer.

conversations.title: A photography book includes methods no longer used at home

partner.hr: Zašto čitaš o tako starim postupcima?
partner.en: Why are you reading about such old processes?

learner.hr: Zanimljiv mi je razvoj fotografije, ne samo današnji uređaji.
learner.en: I'm interested in the development of photography, not just today's devices.

partner.en: Will you try repeating them?

learner.hr: Ne bih isprobavao ove metode bez radionice i stručnog vodstva.
learner.en: I wouldn't try these methods without a workshop and expert supervision.

partner.en: What's useful to you, then?

learner.hr: Vidjeti zašto neke slike imaju tragove koje danas pokušavamo ukloniti.
learner.en: Seeing why some pictures have marks we try to remove today.

partner.en: Like old family photographs?

learner.hr: Upravo tako. Sad ih gledam malo pažljivije.
learner.en: Exactly. Now I look at them a little more carefully.

partner.en: Will you show me an example?

learner.hr: Hoću, s objašnjenjem iz knjige, ne mojim nagađanjem.
learner.en: Yes, with the explanation from the book, not my guess.

conversations.title: An unfinished painting is mistaken for an abandoned one

partner.hr: Zar nisi odustala od ove slike?
partner.en: Didn't you give up on this painting?

learner.hr: Nisam odustala. Samo sam je ostavila da je pogledam svježim očima.
learner.en: I didn't give up. I just left it to look at it with fresh eyes.

partner.hr: Mislio sam da ti se više ne sviđa.
partner.en: I thought you didn't like it anymore.

learner.hr: Kad tako pričaš, zvuči kao da je svaka pauza kraj.
learner.en: When you talk like that, it sounds as though every pause is an ending.

partner.en: Sorry; I didn't mean that.

learner.hr: Znam. Sad mi je jasnije što želim promijeniti.
learner.en: I know. Now it's clearer what I want to change.

partner.en: What will you do first?

learner.hr: Pozadinu, jer je preuzela svu pažnju.
learner.en: The background, because it took all the attention.

partner.en: May I look afterwards?

learner.hr: Možeš, ali pitaj me jesam li spremna pokazati.
learner.en: Yes, but ask whether I'm ready to show it.

conversations.title: A first exhibition invitation makes its organiser forget the keys

partner.en: Why are you standing outside your own door?

learner.hr: Toliko sam uzbuđen zbog izložbe da sam ključeve ostavio unutra.
learner.en: I'm so excited about the exhibition that I left the keys inside.

partner.en: So you haven't left yet?

learner.hr: Nisam. Od uzbuđenja sam provjerio radove triput, a džepove nijednom.
learner.en: No. In my excitement I checked the works three times and my pockets not once.

partner.en: Does anyone have a spare set?

learner.hr: Ima sestra, upravo dolazi.
learner.en: My sister does; she's on her way.

partner.en: Will you arrive on time?

learner.hr: Hoću, jer smo srećom ostavili više vremena za put.
learner.en: Yes, because fortunately we allowed extra travel time.

partner.hr: Kad uđeš, prvo ključevi u torbu.
partner.en: When you get in, put the keys in your bag first.

learner.hr: Dogovoreno. A onda jedan miran pogled na popis.
learner.en: Agreed. Then one calm look at the list.

conversations.title: The last workshop guests help close the room

partner.en: Can we do anything else?

learner.hr: Zatvorite prozore uz stolove, pa ću provjeriti ostalo.
learner.en: Close the windows beside the tables, then I'll check the rest.

partner.hr: Treba li i ova vrata zaključati?
partner.en: Should this door be locked too?

learner.hr: Da, ali zaključati ih može voditelj koji ima ključ.
learner.en: Yes, but the leader with the key can lock it.

partner.en: Shall I call him?

learner.hr: Pozovi ga kad svi izađemo. Ne želimo zaključati dok ne provjerimo jesu li svi izašli.
learner.en: Call him once we're all out. We don't want to lock up until we've checked that everyone's out.

partner.en: All the belongings have been taken.

learner.hr: Dobro. Još ću pogledati ispod stolova.
learner.en: Good. I'll look beneath the tables too.

partner.en: Now we're really finished.

learner.hr: Jesmo. Hvala što ste ostali i za ovaj manje svečani dio.
learner.en: Yes. Thank you for staying for this less festive part too.

conversations.title: A shared album is finally ready to give away

partner.hr: Jesi li zadovoljan kako je ispalo?
partner.en: Are you happy with how it turned out?

learner.hr: Zadovoljan sam. Nismo stavili sve fotografije, ali priča je jasna.
learner.en: I am. We didn't include every photograph, but the story is clear.

partner.en: Will you change anything else?

learner.hr: Samo provjeriti imena, bez novog preslagivanja cijelog albuma.
learner.en: Just check the names, without rearranging the whole album again.

partner.hr: Je li ti bilo naporno raditi zajedno?
partner.en: Was working together difficult?

learner.hr: Ponekad, ali veliko je zadovoljstvo vidjeti koliko različitih uspomena stane unutra.
learner.en: Sometimes, but it's a great pleasure to see how many different memories fit inside.

partner.en: When are we giving it?

learner.hr: U nedjelju, ako svi mogu doći.
learner.en: On Sunday, if everyone can come.

partner.en: Then let's wrap the gift.

learner.hr: Može. Ovaj put završavamo prije nego što nam zatreba još jedna stranica.
learner.en: Yes. This time we're finishing before we need another page.
